‘If one of your brethren becomes poor, and falls into poverty among you, then you shall help him, like a stranger or a sojourner, that he may live with you.
Take no usury or interest from him; but fear your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, that your brother may live with you.
You shall not lend him your money for usury, nor lend him your food at a profit.
I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who brought you out of the land of Mitzraym, to give you the land of Canaan and to be your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
‘And if one of your brethren who dwells by you becomes poor, and sells himself to you, you shall not compel him to serve as a slave.
As a hired servant and a sojourner he shall be with you, and shall serve you until the Year of Yubalym.
And then he shall depart from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, he shall return to the possession of his fathers.
For they are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Mitzraym; they shall not be sold as slaves.
You shall not rule over him with rigor, but you shall fear your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
And as for your male and female slaves whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.
Moreover you may buy the children of the strangers who dwell among you, and their families who are with you, which they beget in your land; and they shall become your property.

And you may take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them as a possession; they shall be your permanent slaves. But regarding your brethren, the children of Yashar'AL, you shall not rule over one another with rigor.

‘Now if a sojourner or stranger close to you becomes rich, and one of your brethren who dwells by him becomes poor, and sells himself to the stranger or sojourner close to you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,
After he is sold he may be redeemed again. One of his brothers may redeem him;
Or his uncle or his uncle’s son may redeem him; or anyone who is near of kin to him in his family may redeem him; or if he is able he may redeem himself.

Thus he shall reckon with him who bought him: The price of his release shall be according to the number of years, from the year that he was sold to him until the Year of Yubalym; it shall be according to the time of a hired servant for him.
If there are still many years remaining, according to them he shall repay the price of his redemption from the money with which he was bought.
And if there remain but a few years until the Year of Yubalym, then he shall reckon with him, and according to his years he shall repay him the price of his redemption.
He shall be with him as a yearly hired servant, and he shall not rule with rigor over him in your sight.
And if he is not redeemed in these years, then he shall be released in the Year of Yubalym, he and his children with him.
For the children of Yashar'AL are servants to Me; they are My servants whom I brought out of the land of Mitzraym: I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“Do not make idols or set up carved images, or sacred pillars, or sculptured stones in your land so you may worship them. I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
You must keep my Shabbat days of rest and show reverence for my sanctuary. I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
“If you follow My decrees and you are careful to obey My commandments,
I will send you the seasonal rains. The land will then yield its crops, and the trees of the field will produce their fruit.
Your threshing season will overlap with the grape harvest, and your grape harvest will overlap with the season of planting grain. You will eat your fill and live securely in your own land.
“I will give you Shalum in the land, and you will be able to sleep with no cause for fear. I will rid the land of wild animals and keep your enemies out of your land.
In fact, you will chase down your enemies and slaughter them with your swords.
Five of you will chase a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase ten thousand! All your enemies will fall beneath your sword.
“I will look favorably upon you, making you fertile and multiplying your people. And I will fulfill my covenant with you.
You will have such a surplus of crops that you will need to clear out the old grain to make room for the new harvest!
I will live among you, and I will not despise you.
I will walk among you; I will be your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and you will be my people.

I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who brought you out of the land of Mitzraym so you would no longer be their slaves. I broke the yoke of slavery from your neck so you can walk with your heads held high.
“However, if you do not listen to me or obey all these commandments,
And if you break my covenant by rejecting my decrees, treating my regulations with contempt, and refusing to obey my commandments,

I will punish you. I will bring sudden terrors upon you, wasting diseases and burning fevers that will cause your eyes to fail and your life to ebb away. You will plant your crops in vain because your enemies will eat them.
I will turn against you, and you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will run even when no one is chasing you!
“And if, in spite of all this, you still disobey me, I will punish you seven times over for your sins.
I will break your proud spirit by making the skies as unyielding as iron and the Arath as hard as bronze.
All your work will be for nothing, for your land will yield no crops, and your trees will bear no fruit.
“If even then you remain hostile toward ME and refuse to obey ME, I will inflict disaster on you seven times over for your sins.
I will send wild animals that will rob you of your children and destroy your livestock. Your numbers will dwindle, and your roads will be deserted.
“And if you fail to learn the lesson and continue your hostility toward ME,
Then I myself will be hostile toward you. I will personally strike you with calamity seven times over for your sins.

I will send armies against you to carry out the curse of the covenant you have broken. When you run to your towns for safety, I will send a plague to destroy you there, and you will be handed over to your enemies.

I will destroy your food supply, so that ten women will need only one oven to bake bread for their families. They will ration your food by weight, and though you have food to eat, you will not be satisfied.
“If in spite of all this you still refuse to listen and still remain hostile toward me,
Then I will give full vent to my hostility. I myself will punish you seven times over for your sins.
Then you will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters.
I will destroy your pagan shrines and knock down your places of worship. I will leave your lifeless corpses piled on top of your lifeless idols, and I will despise you.
I will make your cities desolate and destroy your places of pagan worship. I will take no pleasure in your offerings that should be a pleasing aroma to ME.
Yes, I Myself will devastate your land, and your enemies who come to occupy it will be appalled at what they see.
I will scatter you among the nations and bring out my sword against you. Your land will become desolate, and your cities will lie in ruins.
Then at last the land will enjoy its neglected Shabbat years as it lies desolate while you are in exile in the land of your enemies. Then the land will finally rest and enjoy the Shabbats it missed.
As long as the land lies in ruins, it will enjoy the rest you never allowed it to take every seventh year while you lived in it.

“And for those of you who survive, I will demoralize you in the land of your enemies. You will live in such fear that the sound of a leaf driven by the wind will send you fleeing. You will run as though fleeing from a sword, and you will fall even when no one pursues you.
Though no one is chasing you, You will stumble over each other as though fleeing from a sword. You will have no power to stand up against your enemies.
You will die among the foreign nations and be devoured in the land of your enemies.
Those of you who survive will waste away in your enemies’ lands because of their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
“But at last my people will confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors for betraying ME and being hostile toward ME.
When I have turned their hostility back on them and brought them to the land of their enemies, then at last their stubborn hearts will be humbled, and they will pay for their sins.
Then I will remember my covenant with Ya'aqub and my covenant with Yachaq and my covenant with Abraham, and I will remember the land.

For the land must be abandoned to enjoy its years of Shabbat rest as it lies deserted. At last the people will pay for their sins, for they have continually rejected My regulations and despised My decrees.

“But despite all this, I will not utterly reject or despise them while they are in exile in the land of their enemies. I will not cancel my covenant with them by wiping them out, for I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

For their sakes I will remember my ancient covenant with their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Mitzraym in the sight of all the nations, that I might be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
These are the decrees, regulations, and instructions that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave through Musha on Mount Sinai as evidence of the relationship between himself and the Yasharalym.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha,
“Give the following instructions to the people of Yashar'AL. If anyone makes a special vow to dedicate someone to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by paying the value of that person,
Here is the scale of values to be used. A man between the ages of twenty and sixty is valued at fifty shekels of silver, as measured by the sanctuary shekel.
A woman of that age is valued at thirty shekels of silver.
A boy between the ages of five and twenty is valued at twenty shekels of silver; a girl of that age is valued at ten shekels of silver.
A boy between the ages of one month and five years is valued at five shekels of silver; a girl of that age is valued at three shekels of silver.
A man older than sixty is valued at fifteen shekels of silver; a woman of that age is valued at ten shekels of silver.
If you desire to make such a vow but cannot afford to pay the required amount, take the person to the Kuhan, he will determine the amount for you to pay based on what you can afford.
“If your vow involves giving an animal that is acceptable as an offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, any gift to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be considered Qadash.

You may not exchange or substitute it for another animal, neither a good animal for a bad one nor a bad animal for a good one. But if you do exchange one animal for another, then both the original animal and its substitute will be considered Qadash.
If your vow involves an unclean animal—one that is not acceptable as an offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH then you must bring the animal to the Kuhan.
He will assess its value, and his assessment will be final, whether high or low.
If you want to buy back the animal, you must pay the value set by the Kuhan, plus twenty percent.
“If someone dedicates a house to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the Kuhan will come to assess its value. The Kuhan’s assessment will be final, whether high or low.
If the person who dedicated the house wants to buy it back, he must pay the value set by the Kuhan, plus twenty percent. Then the house will again be his.

“If someone dedicates to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH a piece of his family property, its value will be assessed according to the amount of seed required to plant it, fifty shekels of silver for a field planted with five bushels of barley seed.
If the field is dedicated to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the Year of Yubalym, then the entire assessment will apply.

But if the field is dedicated after the Year of Yubalym, the Kuhan will assess the land’s value in proportion to the number of years left until the next Year of Yubalym. Its assessed value is reduced each year.
If the person who dedicated the field wants to buy it back, he must pay the value set by the Kuhan, plus twenty percent. Then the field will again be legally his.
But if he does not want to buy it back, and it is sold to someone else, the field can no longer be bought back.
When the field is released in the Year of Yubalym, it will be Qadash, a field specially set apart for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. It will become the property of the Kuhanym.
“If someone dedicates to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH a field he has purchased but which is not part of his family property,
The Kuhan will assess its value based on the number of years left until the next Year of Yubalym. On that day he must give the assessed value of the land as a sacred donation to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
In the Year of Yubalym the field must be returned to the person from whom he purchased it, the one who inherited it as family property.
All the payments must be measured by the weight of the sanctuary shekel, which equals twenty gerahs.
“You may not dedicate a firstborn animal to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for the firstborn of your cattle, sheep, and goats already belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

However, you may buy back the firstborn of a ceremonially unclean animal by paying the Kuhan’s assessment of its worth, plus twenty percent. If you do not buy it back, the Kuhan will sell it at its assessed value.

“However, anything specially set apart for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH whether a person, an animal, or family property, must never be sold or bought back. Anything devoted in this way has been set apart as Qadash, and it belongs to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
No person specially set apart for destruction may be bought back. Such a person must be put to death.
“One-tenth of the produce of the land, whether grain from the fields or fruit from the trees, belongs to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and must be set apart to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as Qadash.
If you want to buy back 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s tenth of the grain or fruit, you must pay its value, plus twenty percent.
Count off every tenth animal from your herds and flocks and set them apart for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as Qadash.

You may not pick and choose between good and bad animals, and you may not substitute one for another. But if you do exchange one animal for another, then both the original animal and its substitute will be considered Qadash and cannot be bought back.”
These are commands that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave through Musha on Mount Sinai for the Yasharalym.

books.name: Numbers
chapters: Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha in the Wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Mitzraym, saying:
“Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of names, every male individually,
From twenty years old and above, all who are able to go to war in Yashar'AL. You and Aarun shall number them by their armies.
And with you there shall be a man from every tribe, each one the head of his father’s house.
“These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: from Rauban, Alizur the son of Shadaur;
from Simaun, Shalumyal the son of Zurishaddai;
from Yahudah, Nahshun the son of Amminadab;
from Issachar, Nathanial the son of Zuar;
from Zabulun, Aliab the son of Halun;
from the sons of Ya'asaf: from Alphraim, Alishama the son of Ammihud; from Manassah, Gamalial the son of Pedahzur;
from BanYamin, Abidan the son of Gidauni;
from Dan, Ahiazar the son of Ammishaddai;
from Ashar, Pagial the son of Ucran;
from Gad, Aliasaph the son of Damaual;
from Naphtali, Ahira the son of Anan.”
These were chosen from the congregation, leaders of their fathers’ tribes, heads of the divisions in Yashar'AL.
Then Musha and Aarun took these men who had been mentioned by name,

And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they recited their ancestry by families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, each one individually.
As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha, so he numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai.

Now the children of Rauban, Yashar'AL’s oldest son, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, every male individually, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Rauban were forty-six thousand five hundred.

From the children of Simaun, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, of those who were numbered, according to the number of names, every male individually, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Simaun were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
From the children of Gad, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Gad were forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
From the children of Yahudah, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Yahudah were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
From the children of Issachar, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Issachar were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
From the children of Zabulun, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Zabulun were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

From the sons of Ya'asaf, the children of Alphraim, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Alphraim were forty thousand five hundred.
From the children of Manassah, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Manassah were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
From the children of BanYamin, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Banyamin were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
From the children of Dan, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Dan were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
From the children of Ashar, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Ashar were forty-one thousand five hundred.
From the children of Naphtali, their genealogies by their families, by their fathers’ house, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war:
those who were numbered of the tribe of Naphtali were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
These are the ones who were numbered, whom Musha and Aarun numbered, with the leaders of Yashar'AL, twelve men, each one representing his father’s house.
So all who were numbered of the children of Yashar'AL, by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and above, all who were able to go to war in Yashar'AL
all who were numbered were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
But the Lauym were not numbered among them by their fathers’ tribe;
for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had Dabar to Musha, saying:
“Only the tribe of La'uym you shall not number, nor take a census of them among the children of Yashar'AL;

but you shall appoint the Lauym over the tabernacle of the Testimony, over all its furnishings, and over all things that belong to it; they shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; they shall attend to it and camp around the tabernacle.
And when the tabernacle is to go forward, the Lauym shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Lauym shall set it up. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
The children of Yashar'AL shall pitch their tents, everyone by his own camp, everyone by his own standard, according to their armies;

but the Lauym shall camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL; and the Lauym shall keep charge of the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
Thus the children of Yashar'AL did; according to all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha, so they did.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha and Aarun, saying:
“Everyone of the children of Yashar'AL shall camp by his own standard, beside the emblems of his father’s house; they shall camp some distance from the tabernacle of meeting.

On the east side, toward the rising of the sun, those of the standard of the forces with Yahudah shall camp according to their armies; and Nahshun the son of Amminadab shall be the leader of the children of Yahudah.
And his army was numbered at seventy-four thousand six hundred.
“Those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar, and Nathanial the son of Zuar shall be the leader of the children of Issachar.”
And his army was numbered at fifty-four thousand four hundred.
“Then comes the tribe of Zabulun, and Aliab the son of Halun shall be the leader of the children of Zabulun.”
And his army was numbered at fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
“All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Yahudah, one hundred and eighty-six thousand four hundred, these shall break camp first.
“On the south side shall be the standard of the forces with Rauban according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Rauban shall be Alizur the son of Shadaur.”
And his army was numbered at forty-six thousand five hundred.
“Those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Simaun, and the leader of the children of Simaun shall be Shalumial the son of Zurishaddah.”
And his army was numbered at fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
“Then comes the tribe of Gad, and the leader of the children of Gad shall be Aliasaph the son of Raual.”
And his army was numbered at forty-five thousand six hundred and fifty.
“All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Rauban, one hundred and fifty-one thousand four hundred and fifty, they shall be the second to break camp.
“And the tabernacle of meeting shall move out with the camp of the Lauym in the middle of the camps; as they camp, so they shall move out, everyone in his place, by their standards.
“On the west side shall be the standard of the forces with Alphraim according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Alphraim shall be Alishama the son of Ammihud.”
And his army was numbered at forty thousand five hundred.
“Next to him comes the tribe of Manassah, and the leader of the children of Manassah shall be Gamalial the son of Padahzur.”
And his army was numbered at thirty-two thousand two hundred.
“Then comes the tribe of Banyamin, and the leader of the children of Banyamin shall be Abidan the son of Gidauni.”
And his army was numbered at thirty-five thousand four hundred.
“All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces with Alphraim, one hundred and eight thousand one hundred—they shall be the third to break camp.
“The standard of the forces with Dan shall be on the north side according to their armies, and the leader of the children of Dan shall be Ahiazar the son of Ammishaddai.”
And his army was numbered at sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
“Those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Ashar, and the leader of the children of Ashar shall be Pagial the son of Ucran.”
And his army was numbered at forty-one thousand five hundred.
“Then comes the tribe of Naphtali, and the leader of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Anan.”
And his army was numbered at fifty-three thousand four hundred.
“All who were numbered of the forces with Dan, one hundred and fifty-seven thousand six hundred, they shall break camp last, with their standards.”

These are the ones who were numbered of the children of Yashar'AL by their fathers’ houses. All who were numbered according to their armies of the forces were six hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty.
But the Lauym were not numbered among the children of Yashar'AL, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha.

Thus the children of Yashar'AL did according to all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha; so they camped by their standards and so they broke camp, each one by his family, according to their fathers’ houses.
Now these are the records of Aarun and Musha when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke with Musha on Mount Sinai.
And these are the names of the sons of Aarun: Nadab, the firstborn, and Abihu, Aliazar, and Ithamar.
These are the names of the sons of Aarun, the anointed Kuhan, whom he consecrated to minister as Kuhanym.

Nadab and Abihu had died before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH when they offered profane fire before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the Wilderness of Sinai; and they had no children. So Aliazar and Ithamar ministered as Kuhanym in the presence of Aarun their father.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“Bring the tribe of La'uy near, and present them before Aarun the Kuhan, that they may serve him.
And they shall attend to his needs and the needs of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of meeting, to do the work of the tabernacle.
Also they shall attend to all the furnishings of the tabernacle of meeting, and to the needs of the children of Yashar'AL, to do the work of the tabernacle.
And you shall give the Lauym to Aarun and his sons; they are given entirely to him from among the children of Yashar'AL.
So you shall appoint Aarun and his sons, and they shall be the Kuhanym; but the outsider who comes near shall be put to death.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“Now behold, I Myself have taken the Lauym from among the children of Yashar'AL instead of every firstborn who opens the womb among the children of Yashar'AL. Therefore the Lauym shall be Mine,

Because all the firstborn are Mine. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Mitzraym, I sanctified to Myself all the firstborn in Yashar'AL, both man and beast. They shall be Mine: I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying:
“Number the children of La'uy by their fathers’ houses, by their families; you shall number every male from a month old and above.”
So Musha numbered them according to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as he was commanded.
These were the sons of La'uy by their names: Garshun, Kuhath, and Marari.
And these are the names of the sons of Garshun by their families: Libni and Shimai.
And the sons of Kuhath by their families: Amram, Izahar, Habrun, and Uzzial.
And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the La'uym by their fathers’ houses.
From Garshun came the family of the Libnites and the family of the Shimites; these were the families of the Garshunites.
Those who were numbered, according to the number of all the males from a month old and above, of those who were numbered there were seven thousand five hundred.
The families of the Garshunites were to camp behind the tabernacle westward.
And the leader of the father’s house of the Garshonites was Aliasaph the son of Laal.
The duties of the children of Garshun in the tabernacle of meeting included the tabernacle, the tent with its covering, the screen for the door of the tabernacle of meeting,
The screen for the door of the court, the hangings of the court which are around the tabernacle and the altar, and their cords, according to all the work relating to them.
From Kuhath came the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Habrunites, and the family of the Uzzialites; these were the families of the Kuhathites.
According to the number of all the males, from a month old and above, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping charge of the sanctuary.
The families of the children of Kuhath were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle.
And the leader of the father's house of the families of the Kuhathites was Alizaphan the son of Uzzial.
Their duty included the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the utensils of the sanctuary with which they ministered, the screen, and all the work relating to them.
And Alaazar the son of Aarun the Kuhan was to be chief over the leaders of the La'uym, with oversight of those who kept charge of the sanctuary.
From Marari came the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites; these were the families of Marari.
And those who were numbered, according to the number of all the males from a month old and above, were six thousand two hundred.
The leader of the fathers’ house of the families of Marari was Zurial the son of Abihail. These were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
And the appointed duty of the children of Marari included the boards of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, its utensils, all the work relating to them,
And the pillars of the court all around, with their sockets, their pegs, and their cords.

Moreover those who were to camp before the tabernacle on the east, before the tabernacle of meeting, were Musha, Aarun, and his sons, keeping charge of the sanctuary, to meet the needs of the children of Yashar'AL; but the outsider who came near was to be put to death.
All who were numbered of the La'uym, whom Musha and Aarun numbered at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, by their families, all the males from a month old and above, were twenty-two thousand.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha: “Number all the firstborn males of the children of Yashar'AL from a month old and above, and take the number of their names.

And you shall take the Lauym for Me, I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH instead of all the firstborn among the children of Yashar'AL, and the livestock of the Lauym instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Yashar'AL.”
So Musha numbered all the firstborn among the children of Yashar'AL, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded him.
And all the firstborn males, according to the number of names from a month old and above, of those who were numbered of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred and seventy-three.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“Take the Lauym instead of all the firstborn among the children of Yashar'AL, and the livestock of the Lauym instead of their livestock. The Lauym shall be Mine: I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And for the redemption of the two hundred and seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Yashar'AL, who are more than the number of the Lauym,
You shall take five shekels for each one individually; you shall take them in the currency of the shekel of the sanctuary, the shekel of twenty gerahs.
And you shall give the money, with which the excess number of them is redeemed, to Aarun and his sons.”
So Musha took the redemption money from those who were over and above those who were redeemed by the Lauym.
From the firstborn of the children of Yashar'AL he took the money, one thousand three hundred and sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.
And Musha gave their redemption money to Aarun and his sons, according to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded him.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha and Aarun, saying:
“Take a census of the sons of Kuhath from among the children of La'uy, by their families, by their fathers’ house,
from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, all who enter the service to do the work in the tabernacle of meeting.
“This is the service of the sons of Kuhath in the tabernacle of meeting, relating to the most Qadash things:
When the camp prepares to journey, Aarun and his sons shall come, and they shall take down the covering veil and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.
Then they shall put on it a covering of badger skins, and spread over that a cloth entirely of blue; and they shall insert its poles.
“On the table of showbread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the pans, the bowls, and the pitchers for pouring; and the showbread shall be on it.
They shall spread over them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of badger skins; and they shall insert its poles.
And they shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand of the light, with its lamps, its wick-trimmers, its trays, and all its oil vessels, with which they service it.
Then they shall put it with all its utensils in a covering of badger skins, and put it on a carrying beam.
“Over the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of badger skins; and they shall insert its poles.
Then they shall take all the utensils of service with which they minister in the sanctuary, put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of badger skins, and put them on a carrying beam.
Also they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth over it.

They shall put on it all its implements with which they minister there, the firepans, the forks, the shovels, the basins, and all the utensils of the altar, and they shall spread on it a covering of badger skins, and insert its poles.

And when Aarun and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furnishings of the sanctuary, when the camp is set to go, then the sons of Kuhath shall come to carry them; but they shall not touch any Qadash thing, lest they die. These are the things in the tabernacle of meeting which the sons of Kuhath are to carry.

“The appointed duty of Alaazar the son of Aarun the Kuhan is the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the daily grain offering, the anointing oil, the oversight of all the tabernacle, of all that is in it, with the sanctuary and its furnishings.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha and Aarun, saying:
“Do not cut off the tribe of the families of the Kuhathites from among the Lauym;
But do this in regard to them, that they may live and not die when they approach the most Qadash things: Aarun and his sons shall go in and appoint each of them to his service and his task.
But they shall not go in to watch while the Qadash things are being covered, lest they die.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“Also take a census of the sons of Garshun, by their fathers’ house, by their families.
From thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, you shall number them, all who enter to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of meeting.
This is the service of the families of the Garshunites, in serving and carrying:
They shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the tabernacle of meeting with its covering, the covering of badger skins that is on it, the screen for the door of the tabernacle of meeting,

The screen for the door of the gate of the court, the hangings of the court which are around the tabernacle and altar, and their cords, all the furnishings for their service and all that is made for these things: so shall they serve.
“Aarun and his sons shall assign all the service of the sons of the Garshunites, all their tasks and all their service. And you shall appoint to them all their tasks as their duty.
This is the service of the families of the sons of Garshun in the tabernacle of meeting. And their duties shall be under the authority of Ithamar the son of Aarun the Kuhan.
“As for the sons of Marari, you shall number them by their families and by their fathers’ house.
From thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, you shall number them, everyone who enters the service to do the work of the tabernacle of meeting.
And this is what they must carry as all their service for the tabernacle of meeting: the boards of the tabernacle, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,
And the pillars around the court with their sockets, pegs, and cords, with all their furnishings and all their service; and you shall assign to each man by name the items he must carry.
This is the service of the families of the sons of Marari, as all their service for the tabernacle of meeting, under the authority of Ithamar the son of Aarun the Kuhan.”
And Musha, Aarun, and the leaders of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kuhathites by their families and by their fathers’ house,
from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for work in the tabernacle of meeting;
and those who were numbered by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

These were the ones who were numbered of the families of the Kuhathites, all who might serve in the tabernacle of meeting, whom Musha and Aarun numbered according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by the hand of Musha.
And those who were numbered of the sons of Garshun, by their families and by their fathers’ house,
from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for work in the tabernacle of meeting
Those who were numbered by their families, by their fathers’ house, were two thousand six hundred and thirty.

These are the ones who were numbered of the families of the sons of Garshun, of all who might serve in the tabernacle of meeting, whom Musha and Aarun numbered according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Those of the families of the sons of Marari who were numbered, by their families, by their fathers’ house,
from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, everyone who entered the service for work in the tabernacle of meeting
those who were numbered by their families were three thousand two hundred.
These are the ones who were numbered of the families of the sons of Marari, whom Musha and Aarun numbered according to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by the hand of Musha.
All who were numbered of the Lauym, whom Musha, Aarun, and the leaders of Yashar'AL numbered, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,
from thirty years old and above, even to fifty years old, everyone who came to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the tabernacle of meeting,
Those who were numbered were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.

According to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH they were numbered by the hand of Musha, each according to his service and according to his task; thus were they numbered by him, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“Command the children of Yashar'AL that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever becomes defiled by a corpse.
You shall put out both male and female; you shall put them outside the camp, that they may not defile their camps in the midst of which I dwell.”
And the children of Yashar'AL did so, and put them outside the camp; as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, so the children of Yashar'AL did.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying,
“Speak to the children of Yashar'AL: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit in unfaithfulness against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and that person is guilty,
Then he shall confess the sin which he has committed, he shall make restitution for his trespass in full, plus one-fifth of it, and give it to the one he has wronged.

But if the man has no relative to whom restitution may be made for the wrong, the restitution for the wrong must go to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for the Kuhan, in addition to the ram of the atonement with which atonement is made for him.
Every offering of all the Qadash things of the children of Yashar'AL, which they bring to the Kuhan, shall be his.
And every man’s Qadash things shall be his; whatever any man gives the Kuhan shall be his.’ ”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying
“Speak to the children of Yashar'AL, and say to them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and behaves unfaithfully toward him,
And a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and it is concealed that she has defiled herself, and there was no witness against her, nor was she caught

If the ruach of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, who has defiled herself; or if the ruach of jealousy comes upon him and he becomes jealous of his wife, although she has not defiled herself

Then the man shall bring his wife to the Kuhan, he shall bring the offering required for her, one-tenth of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil on it and put no frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering of jealousy, an offering for remembering, for bringing iniquity to remembrance.
‘And the Kuhan shall bring her near, and set her before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The Kuhan shall take Qadash water in an earthen vessel, and take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

Then the Kuhan shall stand the woman before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering for remembering in her hands, which is the grain offering of jealousy, and the Kuhan shall have in his hand the bitter water that brings a curse.

And the Kuhan shall put her under oath, and say to the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you have not gone astray to uncleanness while under your husband’s authority, be free from this bitter water that brings a curse.
But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority, and if you have defiled yourself and some man other than your husband has lain with you”

Then the Kuhan shall put the woman under the oath of the curse, and he shall say to the woman, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make you a curse and an oath among your people, when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH makes your thigh rot and your belly swell;
And may this water that causes the curse go into your stomach, and make your belly swell and your thigh rot. Then the woman shall say, “So be it, so be it.”
‘Then the Kuhan shall write these curses in a book, and he shall scrape them off into the bitter water.
And he shall make the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and the water that brings the curse shall enter her to become bitter.
Then the Kuhan shall take the grain offering of jealousy from the woman’s hand, and wave the offering before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and bring it to the altar;
And the Kuhan shall take a handful of the offering, as its memorial portion, burn it on the altar, and afterward make the woman drink the water.

When the Kuhan has made her drink the water, then it shall be, if she has defiled herself and behaved unfaithfully toward her husband, that the water that brings a curse will enter her and become bitter, and her belly will swell, her thigh will rot, and the woman will become a curse among her people.
But if the woman has not defiled herself, and is clean, then she shall be free and may conceive children.
‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, while under her husband’s authority, goes astray and defiles herself,
Or when the spirit of jealousy comes upon a man, and he becomes jealous of his wife; then he shall stand the woman before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and the Kuhan shall execute all this law upon her.
Then the man shall be free from iniquity, but that woman shall bear her guilt.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying,
“Speak to the children of Yashar'AL, that when either a man or woman consecrates an offering to take the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,

he shall separate himself from wine and similar drink; he shall drink neither vinegar made from wine nor vinegar made from similar drink; neither shall he drink any grape juice, nor eat fresh grapes or raisins.
All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is produced by the grapevine, from seed to skin.

‘All the days of the vow of his separation no razor shall come upon his head; until the days are fulfilled for which he separated himself to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, he shall be Qadash, and he shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
All the days that he separates himself to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH he shall not go near a dead body.
He shall not make himself unclean even for his father or his mother, for his brother or his sister, when they die, because his separation to 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is on his head.
All the days of his separation he shall be Qadash to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
‘And if anyone dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles his consecrated head, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he shall shave it.
Then on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the Kuhan, to the door of the tabernacle of meeting;
And the Kuhan shall offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned in regard to the corpse; and he shall sanctify his head that same day.
He shall consecrate to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the days of his separation, and bring a male lamb in its first year as a trespass offering; but the former days shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
‘Now this is the law of the Nazirite: When the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the tabernacle of meeting.

And he shall present his offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: one male lamb in its first year without blemish as a burnt offering, one ewe lamb in its first year without blemish as a sin offering, one ram without blemish as a Shalum offering,
A basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their grain offering with their drink offerings.
Then the Kuhan shall bring them before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and offer his sin offering and his burnt offering;
And he shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of a Shalum offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, with the basket of unleavened bread; the Kuhan shall also offer its grain offering and its drink offering.

Then the Nazirite shall shave his consecrated head at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and shall take the hair from his consecrated head and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of the Shalum offering.

‘And the Kuhan shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them upon the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved his consecrated hair,

And the Kuhan shall wave them as a wave offering before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; they are Qadash for the Kuhan, together with the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.’

“This is the law of the Nazirite who vows to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the offering for his separation, and besides that, whatever else his hand is able to provide; according to the vow which he takes, so he must do according to the law of his separation.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying
“Speak to Aarun and his sons, saying, This is the way you shall Barak the children of Yashar'AL. Say to them:
YAHUAH_𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 Barak you and keep you;
YAHUAH_𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 make His face shine upon you, and be Favourable to you;
YAHUAH_𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 lift up His countenance upon you, and give you Shalum.” ’
“So they shall put My Name 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on the children of Yashar'AL, and I will Barak them.”

Now it came to pass, when Musha had finished setting up the tabernacle, that he anointed it and consecrated it and all its furnishings, and the altar and all its utensils; so he anointed them and consecrated them.

So Musha took the carts and the oxen, and gave them to the Lauym.

one gold pan of ten shekels, full of incense;
one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb in its first year, as a burnt offering;

Now when Musha went into the tabernacle of meeting to speak with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Musha heard the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two charubim; thus 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke to Musha.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha,
“Give Aarun the following instructions: When you set up the seven lamps in the lampstand, place them so their light shines forward in front of the lampstand.”
So Aarun did this, he set up the seven lamps so they reflected their light forward, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had commanded Musha.
The entire lampstand, from its base to its decorative blossoms, was made of beaten gold. It was built according to the exact design 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had shown Musha.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha,
“Now set the Lauym apart from the rest of the people of Yashar'AL and make them ceremonially clean.
Do this by sprinkling them with the water of purification, and have them shave their entire body and wash their clothing. Then they will be ceremonially clean.
Have them bring a young bull and a grain offering of choice flour moistened with olive oil, along with a second young bull for a sin offering.
Then assemble the whole community of Yashar'AL, and present the Lauym at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
When you present the Lauym before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the people of Yashar'AL must lay their hands on them.
Raising his hands, Aarun must then present the Lauym to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as a special offering from the people of Yashar'AL, thus dedicating them to the service of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“Next the Lauym will lay their hands on the heads of the young bulls. Present one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to purify the Lauym and make them right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Then have the Lauym stand in front of Aarun and his sons, and raise your hands and present them as a special offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
In this way, you will set the Lauym apart from the rest of the people of Yashar'AL, and the Lauym will belong to ME.
After this, they may go into the Tabernacle to do their work, because you have purified them and presented them as a special offering.
“Of all the people of Yashar'AL, the Lauym are reserved for ME. I have claimed them for Myself in place of all the firstborn sons of the Yasharalym; I have taken the Lauym as their substitutes.
For all the firstborn males among the people of Yashar'AL are Mine, both of people and of animals. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn sons of the Mitzraym.
Yes, I have claimed the Lauym in place of all the firstborn sons of Yashar'AL.

And of all the Yasharalym, I have assigned the Lauym to Aarun and his sons. They will serve in the Tabernacle on behalf of the Yasharalym and make sacrifices to purify the people so no plague will strike them when they approach the sanctuary.”
So Musha, Aarun, and the whole community of Yashar'AL dedicated the Lauym, carefully following all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s instructions to Musha.

The Lauym purified themselves from sin and washed their clothes, and Aarun lifted them up and presented them to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as a special offering, he then offered a sacrifice to purify them and make them right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
After that the Lauym went into the Tabernacle to perform their duties, assisting Aarun and his sons, so they carried out all the commands that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave Musha concerning the Lauym.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH instructed Musha,
“This is the rule the Lauym must follow: They must begin serving in the Tabernacle at the age of twenty-five,
and they must retire at the age of fifty.
After retirement they may assist their fellow Lauym by serving as guards at the Tabernacle, but they may not officiate in the service. This is how you must assign duties to the Lauym.”
A year after Yashar'AL’s departure from Mitzraym, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha in the wilderness of Sinai. In the first month of that year He said,
“Tell the Yasharalym to celebrate the Pasakh (Passover) at the prescribed time,
at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. Be sure to follow all my decrees and regulations concerning this celebration.”
So Musha told the people to celebrate the Pasakh (Passover)
in the wilderness of Sinai as twilight fell on the fourteenth day of the month. And they celebrated the festival there, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had commanded Musha.
But some of the men had been ceremonially defiled by touching a dead body, so they could not celebrate the Pasakh that day. They came to Musha and Aarun that day
and said, “We have become ceremonially unclean by touching a dead body. But why should we be prevented from presenting offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH at the proper time with the rest of the Yasharalym?”
Musha answered, “Wait here until I have received instructions for you from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s reply to Musha.

“Give the following instructions to the people of Yashar'AL: If any of the people now or in future generations are ceremonially unclean at Pasakh (Passover) time because of touching a dead body, or if they are on a journey and cannot be present at the ceremony, they may still celebrate 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Pasakh (Passover).

They must offer the Pasakh sacrifice one month later, at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They must eat the Pasakh lamb at that time with bitter salad greens and bread made without yeast.
They must not leave any of the lamb until the next morning, and they must not break any of its bones. They must follow all the normal regulations concerning the Pasakh.

“But those who neglect to celebrate the Pasakh at the regular time, even though they are ceremonially clean and not away on a trip, will be cut off from the community of Yashar'AL. If they fail to present offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH at the proper time, they will suffer the consequences of their guilt.

And if foreigners living among you want to celebrate the Pasakh to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they must follow these same decrees and regulations, the same laws apply both to native-born Yasharalym and to the foreigners living among you.”
On the day the Tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered it. But from evening until morning the cloud over the Tabernacle looked like a pillar of fire.
This was the regular pattern at night the cloud that covered the Tabernacle had the appearance of fire.
Whenever the cloud lifted from over the sacred tent, the people of Yashar'AL would break camp and follow it. And wherever the cloud settled, the people of Yashar'AL would set up camp.
In this way, they traveled and camped at 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s command wherever He told them to go. Then they remained in their camp as long as the cloud stayed over the Tabernacle.
If the cloud remained over the Tabernacle for a long time, the Yasharalym stayed and performed their duty to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Sometimes the cloud would stay over the Tabernacle for only a few days, so the people would stay for only a few days, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded. Then at 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s command they would break camp and move on.
Sometimes the cloud stayed only overnight and lifted the next morning. But day or night, when the cloud lifted, the people broke camp and moved on.
Whether the cloud stayed above the Tabernacle for two days, a month, or a year, the people of Yashar'AL stayed in camp and did not move on. But as soon as it lifted, they broke camp and moved on.
So they camped or traveled at 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s command, and they did whatever 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH told them through Musha.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha,
“Make two trumpets of hammered silver for calling the community to assemble and for signaling the breaking of camp.
When both trumpets are blown, everyone must gather before you at the entrance of the Tabernacle.
But if only one trumpet is blown, then only the leaders, the heads of the clans of Yashar'AL must present themselves to you.
“When you sound the signal to move on, the tribes camped on the east side of the Tabernacle must break camp and move forward.
When you sound the signal a second time, the tribes camped on the south will follow. You must sound short blasts as the signal for moving on.
But when you call the people to an assembly, blow the trumpets with a different signal.
Only the Kuhanym, Aarun’s descendants, are allowed to blow the trumpets, this is a permanent law for you, to be observed from generation to generation.

“When you arrive in your own land and go to war against your enemies who attack you, sound the alarm with the trumpets. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will remember you and rescue you from your enemies.

Blow the trumpets in times of gladness, too, sounding them at your annual festivals and at the beginning of each month. And blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and Shalum offerings. The trumpets will remind your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of HIS covenant with you. I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.”
In the second year after Yashar'AL’s departure from Mitzraym on the twentieth day of the second month the cloud lifted from the Tabernacle of the Covenant.
So the Yasharalym set out from the wilderness of Sinai and traveled on from place to place until the cloud stopped in the wilderness of Paran.
When the people set out for the first time, following the instructions 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had given through Musha,
Yahudah’s troops led the way. They marched behind their banner, and their leader was Nahshun son of Amminadab.
They were joined by the troops of the tribe of Issachar, led by Nathanial son of Zuar,
and the troops of the tribe of Zabulun, led by Aliab son of Halun.
Then the Tabernacle was taken down, and the Garshunites and Mararite divisions of the Lauym were next in the line of march, carrying the Tabernacle with them.
Rauban’s troops went next, marching behind their banner. Their leader was Alizur son of Shadaur.
They were joined by the troops of the tribe of Simaun, led by Shalumial son of Zurishaddah,
and the troops of the tribe of Gad, led by Aliasaph son of Daual.
Next came the Kuhathite division of the Lauym, carrying the sacred objects from the Tabernacle. Before they arrived at the next camp, the Tabernacle would already be set up at its new location.
Alphraim’s troops went next, marching behind their banner. Their leader was Alishama son of Ammihud.
They were joined by the troops of the tribe of Manassah, led by Gamalial son of Padahzur,
and the troops of the tribe of Banyamin, led by Abidan son of Gidauni.
Dan’s troops went last, marching behind their banner and serving as the rear guard for all the tribal camps. Their leader was Ahiazer son of Ammishaddah.
They were joined by the troops of the tribe of Ashar, led by Pagial son of Ucran,
and the troops of the tribe of Naphtali, led by Ahira son of Anan.
This was the order in which the Yasharalym marched, division by division.

One day Musha said to his brother-in-law, Hubab son of Raual the Midianite, “We are on our way to the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH promised us, for he said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us and we will treat you well, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised wonderful Barakah for Yashar'AL!”
But Hubab replied, “No, I will not go. I must return to my own land and family.”
“Please don’t leave us,” Musha pleaded. “You know the places in the wilderness where we should camp. Come, be our guide.
If you do, we’ll share with you all the Barakah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives us.”
They marched for three days after leaving the mountain of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, with the Ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Covenant moving ahead of them to show them where to stop and rest.
As they moved on each day, the cloud of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hovered over them.
And whenever the Ark set out, Musha would shout, “Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and let your enemies be scattered! Let them flee before you!”
And when the Ark was set down, Musha would say, “Return, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to the countless thousands of Yashar'AL!”

Soon the people began to complain about their hardship, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heard everything they said. Then the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH blazed against them, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent a fire to rage among them, and he destroyed some of the people in the outskirts of the camp.
Then the people screamed to Musha for help, and when Musha prayed to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the fire stopped.
After that, the area was known as Tabarah (which means “the place of burning”), because fire from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had burned among them there.
Then the foreign rabble who were traveling with the Yasharalym began to crave the good things of Mitzraym, and the people of Yashar'AL also began to complain. “Oh, for some meat!” they exclaimed.
“We remember the fish we used to eat for free in Mitzraym, and we had all the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic we wanted.
But now our appetites are gone. All we ever see is this manna!”
The manna looked like small coriander seeds, and it was pale yellow like gum resin.

The people would go out and gather it from the ground. They made flour by grinding it with hand mills or pounding it in mortars. Then they boiled it in a pot and made it into flat cakes. These cakes tasted like pastries baked with olive oil.
The manna came down on the camp with the dew during the night.
Musha heard all the families standing in the doorways of their tents whining, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH became extremely angry. Musha was also very aggravated.
And Musha said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Why are you treating me, your servant, so harshly? Have mercy on me! What did I do to deserve the burden of all these people?

Did I give birth to them? Did I bring them into the world? Why did you tell me to carry them in my arms like a mother carries a nursing baby? How can I carry them to the land you swore to give their ancestors?
Where am I supposed to get meat for all these people? They keep whining to me, saying, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
I can’t carry all these people by myself! The load is far too heavy!
If this is how you intend to treat me, just go ahead and kill me. Do me a favor and spare me this misery!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, “Gather before me seventy men who are recognized as elders and leaders of Yashar'AL. Bring them to the Tabernacle to stand there with you.

I will come down and talk to you there. I will take some of the Ruach that is upon you, and I will put the Ruach upon them also. They will bear the burden of the people along with you, so you will not have to carry it alone.

“And say to the people, ‘Purify yourselves, for tomorrow you will have meat to eat. You were whining, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heard you when you cried, “Oh, for some meat! We were better off in Mitzraym!” Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give you meat, and you will have to eat it.
And it will not be for just a day or two, or for five or ten or even twenty.
You will eat it for a whole month until you gag and are sick of it. For you have rejected 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who is here among you, and you have whined to him, saying, “Why did we ever leave Mitzraym?”
But Musha responded to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “There are six hundred thousand foot soldiers here with me, and yet you say, ‘I will give them meat for a whole month!’
Even if we butchered all our flocks and herds, would that satisfy them? Even if we caught all the fish in the sea, would that be enough?”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, “Has my arm lost its power? Now you will see whether or not my word comes true!”
So Musha went out and reported the words of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to the people. Musha gathered the seventy elders and stationed them around the Tabernacle.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came down in the cloud and Dabar to Musha. Then he gave the seventy elders the same Ruach that was upon Musha. And when the Ruach rested upon them, they prophesied. But this never happened again.

Two men, Aldad and Madad, had stayed behind in the camp. They were listed among the elders, but they had not gone out to the Tabernacle. Yet the Ruach rested upon them as well, so they prophesied there in the camp.
A young man ran and reported to Musha, “Aldad and Madad are prophesying in the camp!”
Yahusha son of Nun, who had been Musha’ assistant since his youth, protested, “Musha, my master, make them stop!”
But Musha replied, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH were Nabym (prophets) and that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would put his Ruach upon them all!”
Then Musha returned to the camp with the elders of Yashar'AL.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent a wind that brought quail from the sea and let them fall all around the camp. For miles in every direction there were quail flying about three feet above the ground.
So the people went out and caught quail all that day and throughout the night and all the next day, too. No one gathered less than fifty bushels! They spread the quail all around the camp to dry.
But while they were gorging themselves on the meat, while it was still in their mouths, the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH blazed against the people, and HE struck them with a severe plague.
So that place was called Kibruth-hattaabah (which means “graves of gluttony”) because there they buried the people who had craved meat from Mitzraym.
From Kibruth-hattaabah the Yasharalym traveled to Hazaruth, where they stayed for some time.
While they were at Hazaruth, Miriam and Aarun criticized Musha because he had married a Cushite woman.
They said, “Has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoken only through Musha? Has He not spoken through us, too?” But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heard them.
Now Musha was very humble, more humble than any other person on the Arath
So immediately 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called to Musha, Aarun, and Miriam and said, “Go out to the Tabernacle, all three of you!” So the three of them went to the Tabernacle.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH descended in the pillar of cloud and stood at the entrance of the Tabernacle, and He called “Aarun and Miriam!” and they stepped forward.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to them, “Now listen to what I say: “If there were Nabym among you, I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, would reveal Myself in visions. I would speak to them in dreams.
But not with my servant Musha. Of all my house, Musha is the one I trust.
I speak to him face to face, clearly, and not in riddles! He sees 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as He is, so why were you not afraid to criticize my servant Musha?”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was very angry with them, and he departed.
As the cloud moved from above the Tabernacle, there stood Miriam, her skin as white as snow from leprosy. When Aarun saw what had happened to her,
he cried out to Musha, “Oh, my master! Please do not punish us for this sin we have so foolishly committed.
Do not let Miriam be like a stillborn baby, already decayed at birth.”
So Musha cried out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I beg you, please heal her!”

But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, “If her father had done nothing more than spit in her face, would she not be defiled for seven days? So keep her outside the camp for seven days, and after that she may be accepted back.”
So Miriam was kept outside the camp for seven days, and the people waited until she was brought back before they traveled again.
Then they left Hazaruth and camped in the wilderness of Paran.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying,
“Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I AM giving to the children of Yashar'AL; from each tribe of their fathers you shall send a man, every one a leader among them.”
So Musha sent them from the Wilderness of Paran according to the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all of them men who were heads of the children of Yashar'AL.
Now these were their names: from the tribe of Rauban, Shammua the son of Zaccur;
from the tribe of Simaun, Shaphat the son of Huri;
from the tribe of Yahudah, Calab the son of Yaphunnah;
from the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Ya'asaf;
from the tribe of Alphraim, Yahusha the son of Nun;
from the tribe of Banyamin, Palti the son of Raphu;
from the tribe of Zabulun, Gaddial the son of Sudi;
from the tribe of Ya'asaf, that is, from the tribe of Manassah, Gaddi the son of Susi;
from the tribe of Dan, Ammial the son of Gamalli;
from the tribe of Ashar, Sathur the son of Michaal;
from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vuphsi;
from the tribe of Gad, Gaual the son of Machi.
These are the names of the men whom Musha sent to spy out the land. And called Husha the son of Nun, Yahusha.
Then Musha sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way into the South, and go up to the mountains,
and see what the land is like: whether the people who dwell in it are strong or weak, few or many;
whether the land they dwell in is good or bad; whether the cities they inhabit are like camps or strongholds;
whether the land is rich or poor; and whether there are forests there or not. Be of good courage. And bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the season of the first ripe grapes.
So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rahub, near the entrance of Hamath.
And they went up through the South and came to Habrun; Ahiman, Shashai, and Talmai, the descendants of Anak, were there. (Now Habrun was built seven years before Zuan in Mitzraym.)
Then they came to the Valley of Ashcul, and there cut down a branch with one cluster of grapes; they carried it between two of them on a pole. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.
The place was called the Valley of Ashcul, because of the cluster which the men of Yashar'AL cut down there.
And they returned from spying out the land after forty days.

Now they departed and came back to Musha and Aarun and all the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL in the Wilderness of Paran, at Kadash; they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
Then they told him, and said: “We went to the land where you sent us. It truly flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
Nevertheless the people who dwell in the land are strong; the cities are fortified and very large; moreover we saw the descendants of Anak there.
The Amalakites dwell in the land of the South; the Hittites, the Yabusites, and the Amurites dwell in the mountains; and the Canaanites dwell by the sea and along the banks of the Yurdan.”
Then Calab quieted the people before Musha, and said, “Let us go up at once and take possession, for we are well able to overcome it.”
But the men who had gone up with him said, “We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we.”

And they gave the children of Yashar'AL a bad report of the land which they had spied out, saying, “The land through which we have gone as spies is a land that devours its inhabitants, and all the people whom we saw in it are men of great stature.
There we saw the giants the descendants of Anak came from the giants; and we were like grasshoppers in our own sight, and so we were in their sight.”
So all the congregation lifted up their voices and cried, and the people wept that night.
And all the children of Yashar'AL complained against Musha and Aarun, and the whole congregation said to them, “If only we had died in the land of Mitzraym! Or if only we had died in this wilderness!
Why has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought us to this land to fall by the sword, that our wives and children should become victims? Would it not be better for us to return to Mitzraym?”
So they said to one another, “Let us select a leader and return to Mitzraym.”
Then Musha and Aarun fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL.
But Yahusha Ba'Nun and Calab the son of Yaphunnah, who were among those who had spied out the land, tore their clothes;
and they spoke to all the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL, saying: “The land we passed through to spy out is an exceedingly good land.
If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH delights in us, then He will bring us into this land and give it to us, ‘a land which flows with milk and honey.’
Only do not rebel against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, nor fear the people of the land, for they are our bread; their protection has departed from them, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is with us. Do not fear them.”
And all the congregation said to stone them with stones. Now the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH appeared in the tabernacle of meeting before all the children of Yashar'AL.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha: “How long will these people reject Me? And how long will they not believe Me, with all the signs which I have performed among them?
I will strike them with the pestilence and disinherit them, and I will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”
And Musha said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “Then the Mitzraym will hear it, for by Your might You brought these people up from among them,

and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that You, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, are among these people; that You, are seen face to face and Your cloud stands above them, and You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.
Now if You kill these people as one man, then the nations which have heard of Your fame will speak, saying,
‘Because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was not able to bring this people to the land which He swore to give them, therefore He killed them in the wilderness.’
And now, I pray, let the power of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH be great, just as You have spoken, saying,

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is longsuffering and abundant in mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression; but He by no means clears the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation.’
Pardon the iniquity of this people, I pray, according to the greatness of Your mercy, just as You have forgiven this people, from Mitzraym even until now.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “I have pardoned, according to your word;
but truly, as I live, all the Arath shall be filled with the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
because all these men who have seen My Kabad and the signs which I did in Mitzraym and in the wilderness, and have put Me to the test now these ten times, and have not heeded My voice,
they certainly shall not see the land of which I swore to their fathers, nor shall any of those who rejected Me see it.
But My servant Calab, because he has a different ruach in him and has followed Me fully, I will bring him into the land where he went, and his descendants shall inherit it.
Now the Amalakites and the Canaanites dwell in the valley; tomorrow turn and move out into the wilderness by the Way of the Red Sea.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke to Musha and Aarun, saying,
“How long shall I bear with this evil congregation who complain against Me? I have heard the complaints which the children of Yashar'AL make against Me.
Say to them, ‘As I live,’ says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, ‘just as you have spoken in My hearing, so I will do to you:
The carcasses of you who have complained against Me shall fall in this wilderness, all of you who were numbered, according to your entire number, from twenty years old and above.
Except for Calab the son of Yaphunnah and Yahusha the son of Nun, you shall by no means enter the land which I swore I would make you dwell in.
But your little ones, whom you said would be victims, I will bring in, and they shall know the land which you have despised.
But as for you, your carcasses shall fall in this wilderness.
And your sons shall be shepherds in the wilderness forty years, and bear the brunt of your infidelity, until your carcasses are consumed in the wilderness.
According to the number of the days in which you spied out the land, forty days, for each day you shall bear your guilt one year, namely forty years, and you shall know My rejection.
I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken this. I will surely do so to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against Me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.’ ”
Now the men whom Musha sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation complain against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by bringing a bad report of the land,
those very men who brought the evil report about the land, died by the plague before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But Yahusha the son of Nun and Calab the son of Yaphunnah remained alive, of the men who went to spy out the land.
Then Musha told these words to all the children of Yashar'AL, and the people mourned greatly.
And they rose early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Here we are, and we will go up to the place which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised, for we have sinned!”
And Musha said, “Now why do you transgress the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? For this will not succeed.
Do not go up lest you be defeated by your enemies, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not among you
For the Amalakites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you shall fall by the sword; because you have turned away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not be with you.”
But they presumed to go up to the mountaintop. Nevertheless, neither the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH nor Musha departed from the camp.
Then the Amalakites and the Canaanites who dwelt in that mountain came down and attacked them, and drove them back as far as Hurmah.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying,
“Speak to the children of Yashar'AL, and say to them: When you have come into the land you are to inhabit, which I AM giving to you,

and you make an offering by fire to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering or in your appointed feasts, to make a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, from the herd or the flock,
then he who presents his offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shall bring a grain offering of one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of oil;
and one-fourth of a hin of wine as a drink offering you shall prepare with the burnt offering or the sacrifice, for each lamb.
Or for a ram you shall prepare as a grain offering two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one-third of a hin of oil;
and as a drink offering you shall offer one-third of a hin of wine as a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And when you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering, or as a sacrifice to fulfill a vow, or as a Shalum offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
then shall be offered with the young bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
and you shall bring as the drink offering half a hin of wine as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
‘Thus it shall be done for each young bull, for each ram, or for each lamb or young goat.
According to the number that you prepare, so you shall do with everyone according to their number.
All who are native-born shall do these things in this manner, in presenting an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And if a stranger dwells with you, or whoever is among you throughout your generations, and would present an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, just as you do, so shall he do.
One ordinance shall be for you of the assembly and for the stranger who dwells with you, an ordinance forever throughout your generations; as you are, so shall the stranger be before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
One law and one custom shall be for you and for the stranger who dwells with you.’ ”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying,
“Speak to the children of Yashar'AL, and say to them: ‘When you come into the land to which I bring you,
then it will be, when you eat of the bread of the land, that you shall offer up a heave offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You shall offer up a cake of the first of your ground meal as a heave offering; as a heave offering of the threshing floor, so shall you offer it up.
Of the first of your ground meal you shall give to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH a heave offering throughout your generations.
‘If you sin unintentionally, and do not observe all these commandments which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken to Musha
For all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has commanded you by the hand of Musha, from the day 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave commandment and onward throughout your generations

then it will be, if it is unintentionally committed, without the knowledge of the congregation, that the whole congregation shall offer one young bull as a burnt offering, as a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, with its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one kid of the goats as a sin offering.
