So the Kuhan shall make atonement for the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'AL, and it shall be forgiven them, for it was unintentional; they shall bring their offering, an offering made by fire to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and their sin offering before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for their unintended sin.
It shall be forgiven the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'AL and the stranger who dwells among them, because all the people did it unintentionally.
‘And if a person sins unintentionally, then he shall bring a female goat in its first year as a sin offering.
So the Kuhan shall make atonement for the person who sins unintentionally, when he sins unintentionally before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to make atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
You shall have one law for him who sins unintentionally, for him who is native-born among the children of Yashar'AL and for the stranger who dwells among them.
‘But the person who does anything presumptuously, whether he is native-born or a stranger, that one brings reproach on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and he shall be cut off from among his people.
Because he has despised the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and has broken the commandment of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that person shall be completely cut off; his guilt shall be upon him.’
Now while the children of Yashar'AL were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Shabbat day.
And those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Musha and Aarun, and to all the congregation.
They put him under guard, because it had not been explained what should be done to him.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, “The man must surely be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp.”
So, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha, all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him with stones, and he died.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying
“Speak to the children of Yashar'AL: Tell them to make tassels on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and to put a blue thread in the tassels of the corners.

And you shall have the tassel, that you may look upon it and remember all the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and do them, and that you may not follow the harlotry to which your own heart and your own eyes are inclined,
and that you may remember and do all My commandments, and be Qadash for your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who brought you out of the land of Mitzraym, to be your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH: I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.”
Now Kurah the son of Izhar, the son of Kuhath, the son of La'uy, with Dathan and Abiram the sons of Aliab, and Un the son of Palath, sons of Rauban, took men;
and they rose up before Musha with some of the children of Yashar'AL, two hundred and fifty leaders of the congregation, representatives of the congregation, men of renown.

They gathered together against Musha and Aarun, and said to them, “You take too much upon yourselves, for all the congregation is Qadash, every one of them, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is among them. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?”
So when Musha heard it, he fell on his face;

and Musha spoke to Kurah and all his company, saying, “Tomorrow morning 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will show us who belongs to Him and who is Qadash, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will allow those He chose to come near to Him, in His presence
Do this: Take cansars, Kurah and all your company;
put fire in them and put incense in them before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH tomorrow, and it shall be that the man whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chooses is the Qadash one. You take too much upon yourselves, you sons of La'uy!”
Then Musha said to Kurah, “Hear now, you sons of La'uy:

Is it a small thing to you that the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL has separated you from the congregation of Yashar'AL, to bring you near to Himself, to do the work of the tabernacle of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and to stand before the congregation to serve them;
and that He has brought you near to Himself, you and all your brethren, the sons of La'uy, with you? And are you seeking the Kuhanym also?
Therefore you and all your company are gathered together against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And what is Aarun that you complain against him?”
And Musha sent to call Dathan and Abiram the sons of Aliab, but they said, “We will not come up!
Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, that you should keep acting like a prince over us?
Moreover you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up!”
Then Musha was very angry, and said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Do not respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, nor have I hurt one of them.”
And Musha said to Kurah, “Tomorrow, you and all your company be present before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH you and they, as well as Aarun.
Let each take his censer and put incense in it, and each of you bring his censer before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, two hundred and fifty censers; both you and Aarun, each with his censer.”
So every man took his censer, put fire in it, laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the tabernacle of meeting with Musha and Aarun.
And Kurah gathered all the congregation against them at the door of the tabernacle of meeting. Then the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH appeared to all the congregation.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha and Aarun, saying,
“Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.”
Then they fell on their faces, and said, “O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of the Ruach of all flesh, shall one man sin, and You be angry with all the congregation?”
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying,
“Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from the tents of Kurah, Dathan, and Abiram.’ ”
Then Musha rose and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Yashar'AL followed him.
And he spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart now from the tents of these wicked men! Touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins.”
So they got away from around the tents of Kurah, Dathan, and Abiram; and Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the door of their tents, with their wives, their sons, and their little children.
And Musha said: “By this you shall know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sent me to do all these works, for I have not done them of my own will.
If these men die naturally like all men, or if they are visited by the common fate of all men, then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not sent me.

But if 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH creates a new thing, and the Arath opens its mouth and swallows them up with all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into the pit, then you will understand that these men have rejected 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Now it came to pass, as he finished speaking all these words, that the ground split apart under them,
and the Arath opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households and all the men with Kurah, with all their goods.
So they and all those with them went down alive into the pit; the Arath (earth) closed over them, and they perished from among the assembly.
Then all Yashar'AL who were around them fled at their cry, for they said, “Lest the Arath swallow us up also!”
And a fire came out from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and consumed the two hundred and fifty men who were offering incense.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying
“Tell Alaazar, the son of Aarun the Kuhan, to pick up the censers out of the blaze, for they are Qadash, and scatter the fire some distance away.

The censers of these men who sinned against their own souls, let them be made into hammered plates as a covering for the altar. Because they presented them before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, therefore they are Qadash; and they shall be a sign to the children of Yashar'AL.”
So Alaazar the Kuhan took the bronze censers, which those who were burned up had presented, and they were hammered out as a covering on the altar,

to be a memorial to the children of Yashar'AL that no outsider, who is not a descendant of Aarun, should come near to offer incense before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that he might not become like Kurah and his companions, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had said to him through Musha.
On the next day all the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL complained against Musha and Aarun, saying, “You have killed the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Now it happened, when the congregation had gathered against Musha and Aarun, that they turned toward the tabernacle of meeting; and suddenly the cloud covered it, and the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH appeared.
Then Musha and Aarun came before the tabernacle of meeting.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying
“Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment,” and they fell on their faces.

So Musha said to Aarun, “Take a censer and put fire in it from the altar, put incense on it, and take it quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. The plague has begun.”
Then Aarun took it as Musha commanded, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and already the plague had begun among the people. So he put in the incense and made atonement for the people.
And he stood between the dead and the living; so the plague was stopped.
Now those who died in the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died in the Kurah incident.
So Aarun returned to Musha at the door of the tabernacle of meeting, for the plague had stopped.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying:
“Speak to the children of Yashar'AL, and get from them a rod from each father’s house, all their leaders according to their fathers’ houses—twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.
And you shall write Aarun’s name on the rod of La'uy. For there shall be one rod for the head of each father’s house.
Then you shall place them in the tabernacle of meeting before the Testimony, where I meet with you.
And it shall be that the rod of the man whom I choose will blossom; thus I will rid Myself of the complaints of the children of Yashar'AL, which they make against you.”

So Musha spoke to the children of Yashar'AL, and each of their leaders gave him a rod apiece, for each leader according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods; and the rod of Aarun was among their rods.
And Musha placed the rods before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the tabernacle of witness.

Now it came to pass on the next day that Musha went into the tabernacle of witness, and behold, the rod of Aarun, of the house of La'uy, had sprouted and put forth buds, had produced blossoms and yielded ripe almonds.
Then Musha brought out all the rods from before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to all the children of Yashar'AL; and they looked, and each man took his rod.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, Bring Aarun’s rod back before the Testimony, to be kept as a sign against the rebels, that you may put their complaints away from Me, lest they die.”
Thus did Musha; just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had commanded him, so he did.
So the children of Yashar'AL spoke to Musha, saying, “Surely we die, we perish, we all perish!
Whoever even comes near the tabernacle of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 _YAHUAH must die. Shall we all utterly die?”

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Aarun: “You and your sons and your father’s house with you shall bear the iniquity related to the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity associated with your Kuhanhood.

Also bring with you your brethren of the tribe of La'uy, the tribe of your father, that they may be joined with you and serve you while you and your sons are with you before the tabernacle of witness.
They shall attend to your needs and all the needs of the tabernacle; but they shall not come near the articles of the sanctuary and the altar, lest they die.
They shall be joined with you and attend to the needs of the tabernacle of meeting, for all the work of the tabernacle; but an outsider shall not come near you.
And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary and the duties of the altar, that there may be no more wrath on the children of Yashar'AL.
Behold, I Myself have taken your brethren the Lauym from among the children of Yashar'AL; they are a gift to you, given by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to do the work of the tabernacle of meeting.

Therefore you and your sons with you shall attend to your Kuhanhood for everything at the altar and behind the veil; and you shall serve. I give your Kuhanhood to you as a gift for service, but the outsider who comes near shall be put to death.”

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Aarun: “Here, I Myself have also given you charge of My heave offerings, all the Qadash gifts of the children of Yashar'AL; I have given them as a portion to you and your sons, as an ordinance forever.

This shall be yours of the most Qadash things reserved from the fire: every offering of theirs, every grain offering and every sin offering and every trespass offering which they render to Me, shall be most Qadash for you and your sons.
In a most Qadash place you shall eat it; every male shall eat it. It shall be Qadash to you.

“This also is yours: the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Yashar'AL; I have given them to you, and your sons and daughters with you, as an ordinance forever. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
“All the best of the oil, all the best of the new wine and the grain, their firstfruits which they offer to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I have given them to you.
Whatever first ripe fruit is in their land, which they bring to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
“Every devoted thing in YASHAR'AL shall be yours.

“Everything that first opens the womb of all flesh, which they bring to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, whether man or beast, shall be yours; nevertheless the firstborn of man you shall surely redeem, and the firstborn of unclean animals you shall redeem.

And those redeemed of the devoted things you shall redeem when one month old, according to your valuation, for five shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

But the firstborn of a cow, the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat you shall not redeem; they are Qadash. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and burn their fat as an offering made by fire for a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And their flesh shall be yours, just as the wave breast and the right thigh are yours.

“All the heave offerings of the Qadash things, which the children of Yashar'AL offer to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I have given to you and your sons and daughters with you as an ordinance forever; it is a covenant of salt forever before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with you and your descendants with you.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Aarun: “You shall have no inheritance in their land, nor shall you have any portion among them; I AM your portion and your inheritance among the children of Yashar'AL.
“Behold, I have given the children of La'uy all the tithes in Yashar'AL as an inheritance in return for the work which they perform, the work of the tabernacle of meeting.
Hereafter the children of Yashar'AL shall not come near the tabernacle of meeting, lest they bear sin and die.

But the Lauym shall perform the work of the tabernacle of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity; it shall be a statute forever, throughout your generations, that among the children of Yashar'AL they shall have no inheritance.

For the tithes of the children of Yashar'AL, which they offer up as a heave offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I have given to the Lauym as an inheritance; therefore I have said to them, ‘among the children of Yashar'AL they shall have no inheritance.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying

“Speak thus to the La'uym, and say to them: ‘When you take from the children of Yashar'AL the tithes which I have given you from them as your inheritance, then you shall offer up a heave offering of it to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, a tenth of the tithe.
And your heave offering shall be reckoned to you as though it were the grain of the threshing floor and as the fullness of the winepress.

Thus you shall also offer a heave offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from all your tithes which you receive from the children of Yashar'AL, and you shall give 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s heave offering from it to Aarun the Kuhan.
Of all your gifts you shall offer up every heave offering due to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, from all the best of them, the consecrated part of them.’
Therefore you shall say to them: ‘When you have lifted up the best of it, then the rest shall be accounted to the Lauym as the produce of the threshing floor and as the produce of the winepress.
You may eat it in any place, you and your households, for it is your reward for your work in the tabernacle of meeting.
And you shall bear no sin because of it, when you have lifted up the best of it. But you shall not profane the Qadash gifts of the children of Yashar'AL, lest you die.’
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha and Aarun, saying,

“This is the ordinance of the law which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has commanded, saying: ‘Speak to the children of Yashar'AL, that they bring you a red heifer without blemish, in which there is no defect and on which a yoke has never come.
You shall give it to Alaazar the Kuhan, that he may take it outside the camp, and it shall be slaughtered before him;
and Alaazar the Kuhan shall take some of its blood with his finger, and sprinkle some of its blood seven times directly in front of the tabernacle of meeting.
Then the heifer shall be burned in his sight: its hide, its flesh, its blood, and its offal shall be burned.
And the Kuhan shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet, and cast them into the midst of the fire burning the heifer.
Then the Kuhan shall wash his clothes, he shall bathe in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp; the Kuhan shall be unclean until evening.
And the one who burns it shall wash his clothes in water, bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.

Then a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and store them outside the camp in a clean place; and they shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL for the water of purification; it is for purifying from sin.

And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until evening. It shall be a statute forever to the children of Yashar'AL and to the stranger who dwells among them.
‘He who touches the dead body of anyone shall be unclean seven days.
He shall purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.

Whoever touches the body of anyone who has died, and does not purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. That person shall be cut off from Yashar'AL. He shall be unclean, because the water of purification was not sprinkled on him; his uncleanness is still on him.
‘This is the law when a man dies in a tent: All who come into the tent and all who are in the tent shall be unclean seven days;
and every open vessel, which has no cover fastened on it, is unclean.
Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain by a sword or who has died, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
‘And for an unclean person they shall take some of the ashes of the heifer burnt for purification from sin, and running water shall be put on them in a vessel.

A clean person shall take hyssop and dip it in the water, sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, or on the one who touched a bone, the slain, the dead, or a grave.

The clean person shall sprinkle the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day; and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, wash his clothes, and bathe in water; and at evening he shall be clean.

‘But the man who is unclean and does not purify himself, that person shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.
It shall be a perpetual statute for them. He who sprinkles the water of purification shall wash his clothes; and he who touches the water of purification shall be unclean until evening.
Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the person who touches it shall be unclean until evening.’
Then the children of Yashar'AL, the whole congregation, came into the Wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people stayed in Kadash; and Miriam died there and was buried there.
Now there was no water for the congregation; so they gathered together against Musha and Aarun.
And the people contended with Musha and spoke, saying: “If only we had died when our brethren died before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Why have you brought up the assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH into this wilderness, that we and our animals should die here?
And why have you made us come up out of Mitzraym, to bring us to this evil place? It is not a place of grain or figs or vines or pomegranates; nor is there any water to drink.
So Musha and Aarun went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the tabernacle of meeting, and they fell on their faces. And the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH appeared to them.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying

Take the staff rod; then you and your brother Aarun should gather the congregation together. And Speak to the rock before their eyes, and the rock will yield its water; and you shall bring water for them out of the rock, for the congregation and their animals to drink.”
So Musha took the rod according to what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded him.
And Musha and Aarun gathered the assembly together before the rock; and Musha said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Must we bring water for you out of this rock?”
Then Musha lifted his hand and struck the rock twice with his rod; and water came out abundantly, and the congregation and their animals drank.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha and Aarun, Because you did not obey my command for you to speak to the rock, to exalt ME in the eyes of the children of Yashar'AL, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”
This was the water of Maribah, because the children of Yashar'AL contended with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and HE was Esteemed among them.
Now Musha sent messengers from Kadash to the king of Adum. “Thus says your brother Yashar'AL: ‘You know all the hardship that has befallen us,
how our fathers went down to Mitzraym, and we dwelt in Mitzraym a long time, and the Mitzraym afflicted us and our fathers.
When we cried out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He heard our voice and sent the Malak and brought us up out of Mitzraym; now here we are in Kadash, a city on the edge of your border.

Please let us pass through your country. We will not pass through fields or vineyards, nor will we drink water from wells; we will go along the King’s Highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand or to the left until we have passed through your territory.’ ”
Then Adum said to him, “You shall not pass through my land, lest I come out against you with the sword.”
So the children of Yashar'AL said to him, “We will go by the Highway, and if I or my livestock drink any of your water, then I will pay for it; let me only pass through on foot, nothing more.”
Then he said, “You shall not pass through.” So Adum came out against them with many men and with a strong hand.
Thus Adum refused to give Yashar'AL passage through his territory; so Yashar'AL turned away from them.
Now the children of Yashar'AL, the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadash and came to Mount Hur.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha and Aarun in Mount Hur by the border of the land of Adum, saying:
“Aarun shall be gathered to his people, for he shall not enter the land which I have given to the children of Yashar'AL, because you rebelled against My Dabar at the water of Maribah.
Take Aarun and Alaazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hur;
and strip Aarun of his garments and put them on Alaazar his son; for Aarun shall be gathered to his people and die there.
So Musha did just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded, and they went up to Mount Hur in the sight of all the congregation.
Musha stripped Aarun of his garments and put them on Alaazar his son; and Aarun died there on the top of the mountain. Then Musha and Alaazar came down from the mountain.
When all the congregation saw that Aarun was dead, all the house of Yashar'AL mourned for Aarun thirty days.
The king of Arad, the Canaanite, who dwelt in the South, heard that Yashar'AL was coming on the road to Atharim. Then he fought against Yashar'AL and took some of them prisoners.
So Yashar'AL made a vow to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and said, “If You will indeed deliver this people into our hand, then we will utterly destroy their cities.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH listened to the voice of Yashar'AL and delivered up the Canaanites, and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. So the name of that place was called Hurmah.
Then they journeyed from Mount Hur by the Way of the Red Sea, to go around the land of Adum; and the soul of the people became very discouraged on the way.

And the people spoke against 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and against Musha, Why have you brought us up out of Mitzraym to die in the wilderness? For there is no food and no water, and our soul loathes this worthless bread.”
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many of the people of Yashar'AL died.

Therefore the people came to Musha, and said, “We have sinned, for we have spoken against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and against you; pray to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that He take away the serpents from us.” So Musha prayed for the people.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, “Make a fiery serpent, and set it on a pole; and it shall be that everyone who is bitten, when he looks at it, shall live.”
So Musha made a bronze serpent, and put it on a pole; and so it was, if a serpent had bitten anyone, when he looked at the bronze serpent, he lived.
Now the children of Yashar'AL moved on and camped in Ubuth.
And they journeyed from Ubuth and camped at Iya Abarim, in the wilderness which is east of Muab, toward the sunrise.
From there they moved and camped in the Valley of Zarad.

From there they moved and camped on the other side of the Arnun, which is in the wilderness that extends from the border of the Amurites; for the Arnun is the border of Muab, between Muab and the Amurites.
Therefore it is said in the Book of the Wars of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: Wahab in Suphah,The brooks of the Arnun,
And the slope of the brooks That reaches to the dwelling of Ar, And lies on the border of Muab.”
From there they went to Baar, which is the well where 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to Musha, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”
Then Yashar'AL sang this song: “Spring up, O well! All of you sing to it
The well the leaders sank, Dug by the nation’s nobles, By the lawgiver, with their staves, and from the wilderness they went to Mattanah,
from Mattanah to Nahalial, from Nahalial to Bamuth,
and from Bamuth, in the valley that is in the country of Muab, to the top of Pisgah which looks down on the wasteland.
Then Yashar'AL sent messengers to Sihun king of the Amurites, saying,
“Let me pass through your land. We will not turn aside into fields or vineyards; we will not drink water from wells. We will go by the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory.”

But Sihun would not allow Yashar'AL to pass through his territory. So Sihun gathered all his people together and went out against Yashar'AL in the wilderness, and he came to Yahaz and fought against Yashar'AL.

Then Yashar'AL defeated him with the edge of the sword, and took possession of his land from the Arnun to the Yabbuk, as far as the people of Ammun; for the border of the people of Ammun was fortified.
So Yashar'AL took all these cities, and Yashar'AL dwelt in all the cities of the Amurites, in Hashbun and in all its villages.
For Hashbun was the city of Sihun king of the Amurites, who had fought against the former king of Muab, and had taken all his land from his hand as far as the Arnun.
Therefore those who speak in proverbs say: “Come to Hashbun, let it be built; Let the city of Sihun be repaired.
“For fire went out from Hashbun, A flame from the city of Sihun; It consumed Ar of Muab, The leader of the heights of the Arnun.
Woe to you, Muab! You have perished, O people of Chamush! He has given his sons as fugitives, And his daughters into captivity, To Sihun king of the Amurites.
“But we have shot at them; Hashbun has perished as far as Dibun. Then we laid waste as far as Nuphah, Which reaches to Madaba.”
Thus Yashar'AL dwelt in the land of the Amurites.
Then Musha sent to spy out Yazar; and they took its villages and drove out the Amurites who were there.
And they turned and went up by the way to Bashan. So Ug king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Adrai.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, “Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people and his land; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihun king of the Amurites, who dwelt at Hashbun.”
So they defeated him, his sons, and all his people, until there was no survivor left him; and they took possession of his land.
Then the children of Yashar'AL moved, and camped in the plains of Muab on the side of the Yurdan across from Yarichu.
Now Balak the son of Zippur saw all that Yashar'AL had done to the Amurites.
And Muab was exceedingly afraid of the people because they were many, and Muab was sick with dread because of the children of Yashar'AL.
So Muab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this company will lick up everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field, and Balak the son of Zippur was king of the Muabites at that time.

Then he sent messengers to Balaam the son of Baur at Pathur, which is near the River in the land of the sons of his people, to call him, saying: “Look, a people has come from Mitzraym. See, they cover the face of the Arath, and are settling next to me!

Therefore please come at once, curse this people for me, for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land, for I know that he whom you Barak is Baraked, and he whom you curse is cursed.”
So the elders of Muab and the elders of Midian departed with the diviner’s fee in their hand, and they came to Balaam and spoke to him the words of Balak.
And he said to them, “Lodge here tonight, and I will bring back word to you, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH speaks to me.” So the princes of Muab stayed with Balaam.
Then 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH came to Balaam and said, “Who are these men with you?”
So Balaam said to 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, “Balak the son of Zippur, king of Muab, has sent to me, saying,
Look, a people has come out of Mitzraym, and they cover the face of the Arath (earth). Come now, curse them for me; perhaps I shall be able to overpower them and drive them out.
And 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them; you shall not curse the people, for they are Baraked.”
So Balaam rose in the morning and said to the princes of Balak, “Go back to your land, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has refused to give me permission to go with you.”
And the princes of Muab rose and went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”
Then Balak again sent princes, more numerous and more honorable than they.
And they came to Balaam and said to him, “Thus says Balak the son of Zippur: ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me;
for I will certainly honor you greatly, and I will do whatever you say to me. Therefore please come, curse this people for me.’ ”

Then Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, “Though Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, to do less or more.
Now therefore, please, you also stay here tonight, that I may know what more 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will say to me.”
And 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH came to Balaam at night and said to him, “If the men come to call you, rise and go with them; but only the Dabar which I speak to you—that you shall do.”
So Balaam rose in the morning, saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Muab.

Then 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH’s anger was aroused because he went, and the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH took His stand in the way as an adversary against him. And he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

Now the donkey saw the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand, and the donkey turned aside out of the way and went into the field. So Balaam struck the donkey to turn her back onto the road.
Then the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, with a wall on this side and a wall on that side.
And when the donkey saw the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, she pushed herself against the wall and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall; so he struck her again.
Then the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH went further, and stood in a narrow place where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
And when the donkey saw the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, she lay down under Balaam; so Balaam’s anger was aroused, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”
And Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have abused me. I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would kill you!”
So the donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey on which you have ridden, ever since I became yours, to this day? Was I ever disposed to do this to you? And he said, “No.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH opened Balaam’s eyes, and he saw the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH standing in the way with His drawn sword in His hand; and he bowed his head and fell flat on his face.
And the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to him, Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out to stand against you, because your way is perverse before Me.
The donkey saw Me and turned aside from Me these three times. If she had not turned aside from Me, surely I would also have killed you by now, and let her live.”
And Balaam said to the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I have sinned, for I did not know You stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases You, I will turn back.”
Then the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to Balaam, “Go with the men, but only the word that I speak to you, that you shall speak.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
Now when Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at the city of Muab, which is on the border at the Arnun, the boundary of the territory.
Then Balak said to Balaam, “Did I not earnestly send to you, calling for you? Why did you not come to me? Am I not able to honor you?”
And Balaam said to Balak, “Look, I have come to you! Now, have I any power at all to say anything? The Dabar that 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH puts in my mouth, that I must speak.”
So Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiryath Huzuth.
Then Balak offered oxen and sheep, and he sent some to Balaam and to the princes who were with him.
So it was, the next day, that Balak took Balaam and brought him up to the high places of Baal, that from there he might observe the extent of the people.
Then Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams.”
And Balak did just as Balaam had spoken, and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
Then Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go; perhaps 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will come to meet me, and whatever He shows me I will tell you.” So he went to a desolate height.
And 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH met Balaam, and Balaam said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered on each altar a bull and a ram.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
So Balaam returned to Balak, and there he was, standing by his burnt offering, he and all the princes of Muab.
And he took up his oracle and said, Balak the king of Muab has brought me from Aram, From the mountains of the east. Come, curse Ya'aqub for me, and come, denounce Yashar'AL!’
“How shall I curse whom 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has not cursed? And how shall I denounce whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not denounced?
For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him; There! A people dwelling alone, Not reckoning itself among the nations.
“Who can count the dust of Ya'aqub, Or number one-fourth of Yashar'AL? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my end be like his!”
Then Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and look, you have Baraked them bountifully!”
So Balaam answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has put in my mouth?”
Then Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place from which you may see them; you shall see only the outer part of them, and shall not see them all; curse them for me from there.”
So he brought him to the field of Zuphim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
And Balaam said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering while I meet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH over there.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Go back to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
So he came to him, and there he was, standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Muab were with him. And Balak said to him, “What has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoken?”
Then he took up his oracle and said: “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, son of Zippur!
For 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is not a man, that He should lie, Nor a son of man, that He should repent. Has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said, and will He not do? Or has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoken, and will He not make it good?
Behold, I have received a command to barak Yashar'AL, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has Baraked them, and I cannot reverse it.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not observed iniquity in Ya'aqub, Nor has He seen wickedness in Yashar'AL, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is with him, and the shout of a King is among them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brings them out of Mitzraym; He has strength like a wild ox.
“For there is no sorcery against Ya'aqub, Nor any divination against Yashar'AL. It now must be said of Ya'aqub And of Yashar'AL, ‘Oh, what 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has done!’
Look, a people rises like a lioness, And lifts itself up like a lion; It shall not lie down until it devours the prey, And drinks the blood of the slain.”
Then Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor Barak them at all!”
So Balaam answered and said to Balak, “Did I not tell you, saying, ‘All that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH speaks, that I must do’?”
Then Balak said to Balaam, “Please come, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH that you may curse them for me from there.”
So Balak took Balaam to the top of Paur, that overlooks the wasteland.
Then Balaam said to Balak, “Build for me here seven altars, and prepare for me here seven bulls and seven rams.”
And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bull and a ram on every altar.
Now when Balaam saw that it pleased 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to Barak Yashar'AL, he did not go as at other times, to seek to use sorcery, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
And Balaam raised his eyes, and saw Yashar'AL encamped according to their tribes; and the Ruach of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH came upon him.
Then he took up his oracle and said: “The utterance of Balaam the son of Baur, the utterance of the man whose eyes are opened,
The utterance of him who hears the Dabar of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who sees the vision of the Almighty, Who falls down, with eyes wide open:
“How lovely are your tents, O Ya'aqub! Your dwellings, O Yashar'AL!
Like valleys that stretch out, Like gardens by the riverside, Like aloes planted by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Like cedars beside the waters.
He shall pour water from his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters. “His king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brings Yashar'AL out of Mitzraym; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has strength like a wild ox; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shall consume the nations, His enemies; He shall break their bones and pierce them with His arrows.
‘He bows down, He lies down as a lion; and as a lion, who shall rouse him? “barak is he who Baraked you, and cursed is he who curses you.”

Then Balak’s anger was aroused against Balaam, and he struck his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and look, you have bountifully Baraked them these three times!
Now therefore, flee to your place. I said I would greatly honor you, but in fact, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has kept you back from honor.”
So Balaam said to Balak, “Did I not also speak to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
‘If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to do good or bad of my own will. What 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, that I must speak’?
And now, indeed, I am going to my people. Come, I will advise you what this people will do to your people in the latter days.”
So he took up his oracle and said: The utterance of Balaam the son of Baur, and the utterance of the man whose eyes are opened;
The utterance of him who hears the Dabar of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and has the knowledge of the Most High, Who sees the vision of the Almighty, Who falls down with eyes wide open:
“I see Him, but not now; I behold Him, but not near; A Star shall come out of Ya'aqub; A Scepter shall rise out of Yashar'AL, and batter the brow of Muab, and destroy all the sons of tumult.
“And Adum shall be a possession; Sair also, his enemies, shall be a possession, While Yashar'AL does valiantly.
Out of Ya'aqub One shall have dominion, and destroy the remains of the city.”
Then he looked on Amalak, and he took up his oracle and said: “Amalak was first among the nations, But shall be last until he perishes.”
Then he looked on the Kanites, and he took up his oracle and said: “Firm is your dwelling place, and your nest is set in the rock;
Nevertheless Kain shall be burned. How long until Asshur carries you away captive?”
Then he took up his oracle and said: Alas! Who shall live when 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH does this?
But ships shall come from the coasts of Cyprus, and they shall afflict Asshur and afflict Abar, and so shall Amalak, until he perishes.”
So Balaam rose and departed and returned to his place; Balak also went his way.
Now YASHAR'AL remained in Acacia Gruve, and the people began to commit harlotry with the women of Muab.
They invited the people to the sacrifices of their idols, and the people ate and bowed down to their idols.
So Yashar'AL was joined to Baal of Paur, and the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was aroused against Yashar'AL.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, “Take all the leaders of the people and hang the offenders before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 YAHUAH, out in the sun, that the fierce anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH may turn away from Yashar'AL.”
So Musha said to the judges of Yashar'AL, “Every one of you kill his men who were joined to Baal of Paur.”

And indeed, one of the children of Yashar'AL came and presented to his brethren a Midianite woman in the sight of Musha and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL, who were weeping at the door of the tabernacle of meeting.
Now when Phinahas the son of Alaazar, the son of Aarun the Kuhan, saw it, he rose from among the congregation and took a javelin in his hand;
and he went after the man of Yashar'AL into the tent and thrust both of them through, the man of Yashar'AL, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Yashar'AL.
And those who died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:

“Phinahas the son of Alaazar, the son of Aarun the Kuhan, has turned back My wrath from the children of Yashar'AL, because he was zealous with My zeal among them, so that I did not consume the children of Yashar'AL in My zeal.
Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him My covenant of Shalum;
and it shall be to him and his descendants after him a covenant of an everlasting Kuhanthood, because he was zealous for his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and made atonement for the children of Yashar'AL.’ ”
Now the name of the Yasharalym who was killed, who was killed with the Midianite woman, was Zimri the son of Salu, a leader of a father’s house among the Simaunites.
And the name of the Midianite woman who was killed was Cuzbi the daughter of Zur; he was head of the people of a father’s house in Midian.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“Harass the Midianites, and attack them;

for they harassed you with their schemes by which they seduced you in the matter of Paur and in the matter of Cuzbi, the daughter of a leader of Midian, their sister, who was killed in the day of the plague because of Paur.”
And it came to pass, after the plague, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha and Alaazar the son of Aarun the Kuhan, saying:
“Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL from twenty years old and above, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go to war in Yashar'AL.”
So Musha and Alaazar the Kuhan spoke with them in the plains of Muab by the Yurdan, across from Yarichu, saying:
“Take a census of the people from twenty years old and above, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha and the children of Yashar'AL who came out of the land of Mitzraym.”
Rauban was the firstborn of Yashar'AL. The children of Rauban were: of Hanuch, the family of the Hanuchites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
of Hazrun, the family of the Habrunites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
These are the families of the Raubanites: those who were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred and thirty.
And the son of Pallu was Aliab.

The sons of Aliab were Namual, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the Dathan and Abiram, representatives of the congregation, who contended against Musha and Aarun in the company of Kurah, when they contended against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH;
and the Arath (earth) opened its mouth and swallowed them up together with Kurah when that company died, when the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men; and they became a sign.
Nevertheless the children of Kurah did not die.
The sons of Simaun according to their families were: of Namual, the family of the Namualites; of Yamin, the family of the Yaminites; of Yachin, the family of the Yachinites;
of Zarah, the family of the Zarhites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
These are the families of the Simaunites: twenty-two thousand two hundred.
The sons of Gad according to their families were: of Zaphun, the family of the Zaphunites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;
of Uzni, the family of the Uznites; of Ari, the family of the Arites;
of Arud, the family of the Arudites; of Arali, the family of the Aralites.
These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were numbered of them: forty thousand five hundred.
The sons of Yahudah were Ar and Unan; and Ar and Unan died in the land of Canaan.
And the sons of Yahudah according to their families were: of Shalah, the family of the Shalanites; of Paraz, the family of the Parazites; of Zarah, the family of the Zarahites.
And the sons of Paraz were: of Habrun, the family of the Habrunites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
These are the families of Yahudah according to those who were numbered of them: seventy-six thousand five hundred.
The sons of Issachar according to their families were: of Tula, the family of the Tulaites; of Puah, the family of the Punites;
of Yashub, the family of the Yashubites; of Shimrun, the family of the Shimrunites.
These are the families of Issachar according to those who were numbered of them: sixty-four thousand three hundred.
The sons of Zabulun according to their families were: of Sarad, the family of the Saradites; of Alun, the family of the Alunites; of Yahlaal, the family of the Yahlaalites.
These are the families of the Zabulunites according to those who were numbered of them: sixty thousand five hundred.
The sons of Ya'asaf according to their families, by Manassah and Alphraim, were:
The sons of Manassah: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir begot Gilaad; of Gilaad, the family of the Gilaadites.
These are the sons of Gilaad: of Yaazar, the family of the Yaazarites; of Halak, the family of the Halakites;
of Asrial, the family of the Asrialites; of Shacham, the family of the Shachamites;
of Shamida, the family of the Shamidaites; of Haphar, the family of the Hapharites.
Now Zaluphahad the son of Haphar had no sons, but daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zaluphahad were Mahlah, Nuah, Huglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
These are the sons of Alphraim according to their families: of Shuthalah, the family of the Shuthalhites; of Bachar, the family of the Bachrites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
And these are the sons of Shuthalah: of Aran, the family of the Aranites.
These are the families of the sons of Alphraim according to those who were numbered of them: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Ya'asaf according to their families.
The sons of Banyamin according to their families were: of Bala, the family of the Balaites; of Ashbal, the family of the Ashbalites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;
of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
And the sons of Bala were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
These are the sons of Banyamin according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
These are the sons of Dan according to their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan according to their families.
All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.
The sons of Ashar according to their families were: of Yimna, the family of the Yimnites; of Yasui, the family of the Yasuites; of Baryahu, the family of the Baryites.
Of the sons of Baryahu: of Habar, the family of the Habarites; of Malchial, the family of the Malchialites.
And the name of the daughter of Ashar was Sarah.
These are the families of the sons of Ashar according to those who were numbered of them: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
The sons of Naphtali according to their families were: of Yahzaal, the family of the Yahzaalites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
of Yazar, the family of the Yazarites; of Shillam, the family of the Shillamites.
These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
These are those who were numbered of the children of Yashar'AL: six hundred and one thousand seven hundred and thirty.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“To these the land shall be divided as an inheritance, according to the number of names.
To a large tribe you shall give a larger inheritance, and to a small tribe you shall give a smaller inheritance. Each shall be given its inheritance according to those who were numbered of them.
But the land shall be divided by lot; they shall inherit according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.
According to the lot their inheritance shall be divided between the larger and the smaller.”

And these are those who were numbered of the La'uym according to their families: of Garshun, the family of the Garshunites; of Kuhath, the family of the Kuhathites; of Marari, the family of the Mararites.

These are the families of the Lauym: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Habrunites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Kurathites. And Kuhath begot Amram.
The name of Amram’s wife was Yuchabad the daughter of La'uy, who was born to La'uy in Mitzraym; and to Amram she bore Aarun and Musha and their sister Miriam.
To Aarun were born Nadab and Abihu, Alaazar and Ithamar.
And Nadab and Abihu died when they offered profane fire before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Now those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and above; for they were not numbered among the other children of Yashar'AL, because there was no inheritance given to them among the children of Yashar'AL.
These are those who were numbered by Musha and Alaazar the Kuhan, who numbered the children of Yashar'AL in the plains of Muab by the Yurdan, across from Yarichu.
But among these there was not a man of those who were numbered by Musha and Aarun the Kuhan when they numbered the children of Yashar'AL in the Wilderness of Sinai.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” So there was not left a man of them, except Calab the son of Yaphunnah and Yahusha the son of Nun.

Then came the daughters of Zaluphahad the son of Haphar, the son of Gilaad, the son of Machir, the son of Manassah, from the families of Manassah the son of Ya'asaf; and these were the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Nuah, Huglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
And they stood before Musha, before Alaazar the Kuhan, and before the leaders and all the congregation, by the doorway of the tabernacle of meeting, saying:
“Our father died in the wilderness; but he was not in the company of those who gathered together against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, in company with Kurah, but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.
Why should the name of our father be removed from among his family because he had no son? Give us a possession among our father’s brothers.”
So Musha brought their case before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“The daughters of Zaluphahad speak what is right; you shall surely give them a possession of inheritance among their father’s brothers, and cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.
And you shall speak to the children of Yashar'AL, saying: ‘If a man dies and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.
If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to the relative closest to him in his family, and he shall possess it.’ And it shall be to the children of Yashar'AL a statute of judgment, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha: “Go up into this Mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Yashar'AL
And when you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aarun your brother was gathered.

For in the Wilderness of Zin, during the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against My command to Esteemed Me at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Maribah, at Kadash in the Wilderness of Zin.)
Then Musha spoke to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, saying:
“Let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of the ruach of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
who may go out before them and go in before them, who may lead them out and bring them in, that the congregation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH may not be like sheep which have no shepherd.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha: “Take Yahusha the son of Nun with you, a man in whom is the Ruach, and lay your hand on him;
Set him before Alaazar the Kuhan and before all the congregation, and inaugurate him in their sight.
And you shall give some of your authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL may be obedient.

He shall stand before Alaazar the Kuhan, who shall inquire before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for him by the judgment of the Urim. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, he and all the children of Yashar'AL with him all the congregation.”
So Musha did as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded him. He took Yahusha Ba'Nun and set him before Alaazar the Kuhan and before all the congregation.
And he laid his hands on him and inaugurated him, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded by the hand of Musha.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying,
“Command the children of Yashar'AL, and say to them, ‘My offering, My food for My offerings made by fire as a sweet aroma to Me, you shall be careful to offer to Me at their appointed time.’
“And you shall say to them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: two male lambs in their first year without blemish, day by day, as a regular burnt offering.
The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, the other lamb you shall offer in the evening,
and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering mixed with one-fourth of a hin of pressed oil.
It is a regular burnt offering which was ordained at Mount Sinai for a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And its drink offering shall be one-fourth of a hin for each lamb; in a Qadash place you shall pour out the drink to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as an offering.
The other lamb you shall offer in the evening; as the morning grain offering and its drink offering, you shall offer it as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
‘And on the Shabbat day two lambs in their first year, without blemish, and two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, with its drink offering,
this is the burnt offering for every Shabbat, besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering.
‘At the beginnings of your Moons (months) you shall present a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without blemish;
three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour, mixed with oil, as a grain offering for each lamb, as a burnt offering of sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Their drink offering shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, one-third of a hin for a ram, and one-fourth of a hin for a lamb; this is the burnt offering for each Moon throughout the Moons (months) of the year.
Also one kid of the goats as a sin offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shall be offered, besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
‘On the fourteenth day of the first Moon (month) is the Pasakh (Passover) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And on the fifteenth day of this Moon (month) is the feast; unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.
On the first day you shall have a Qadash convocation. You shall do no customary work.
And you shall present an offering made by fire as a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.
Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah you shall offer for a bull, and two-tenths for a ram;
you shall offer one-tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs;
also one goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a regular burnt offering.

In this manner you shall offer the food of the offering made by fire daily for seven days, as a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; it shall be offered besides the regular burnt offering and its drink offering.
And on the seventh day you shall have a Qadash convocation. You shall do no customary work.
‘Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you bring a new grain offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH at your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a Qadash convocation. You shall do no customary work.
You shall present a burnt offering as a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: two young bulls, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year,
with their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;
also one kid of the goats, to make atonement for you.
Be sure they are without blemish. You shall present them with their drink offerings, besides the regular burnt offering with its grain offering.
‘And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a Qadash convocation. You shall do no customary work. For you it is a day of blowing the trumpets.
You shall offer a burnt offering as a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year, without blemish.
Their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths for the ram,
and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;
also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

besides the burnt offering with its grain offering for the New Moon, the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, as a sweet aroma, an offering made by fire to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
‘On the tenth day of this seventh Moon (month) you shall have a Qadash convocation. You shall afflict your souls; you shall not do any work.
You shall present a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as a sweet aroma: one young bull, one ram, and seven lambs in their first year. Be sure they are without blemish.
Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram,
and one-tenth for each of the seven lambs;
also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the sin offering for atonement, the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh Moon (month) you shall have a Qadash convocation. You shall do no customary work, and you shall keep a feast to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH seven days.
You shall present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire as a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year. They shall be without blemish.
Their grain offering shall be of fine flour mixed with oil: three-tenths of an ephah for each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths for each of the two rams,
and one-tenth for each of the fourteen lambs;
also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
‘On the second day present twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering with its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
‘On the third day present eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
‘On the fourth day present ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year, without blemish,
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
also one kid of the goats as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
‘On the fifth day present nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
‘On the sixth day present eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
‘On the seventh day present seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen lambs in their first year without blemish,
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
‘On the eighth day you shall have a sacred assembly. You shall do no customary work.
You shall present a burnt offering, an offering made by fire as a sweet aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: one bull, one ram, seven lambs in their first year without blemish,
and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, by their number, according to the ordinance;
also one goat as a sin offering, besides the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.

‘These you shall present to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH at your appointed feasts besides your vowed offerings and your freewill offerings as your burnt offerings and your grain offerings, as your drink offerings and your Shalum offerings.’
So Musha told the children of Yashar'AL everything, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded him.
Then Musha spoke to the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Yashar'AL, saying, “This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has commanded:
If a man makes a vow to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, or swears an oath to bind himself by some agreement, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
“Or if a woman makes a vow to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and binds herself by some agreement while in her father’s house in her youth,

and her father hears her vow and the agreement by which she has bound herself, and her father holds his Shalum, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement with which she has bound herself shall stand.

But if her father overrules her on the day that he hears, then none of her vows nor her agreements by which she has bound herself shall stand; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will release her, because her father overruled her.
“If indeed she takes a husband, while bound by her vows or by a rash utterance from her lips by which she bound herself,
and her husband hears it, and makes no response to her on the day that he hears, then her vows shall stand, and her agreements by which she bound herself shall stand.

But if her husband overrules her on the day that he hears it, he shall make void her vow which she took and what she uttered with her lips, by which she bound herself, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will release her.
“Also any vow of a widow or a divorced woman, by which she has bound herself, shall stand against her.
“If she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound herself by an agreement with an oath,
and her husband heard it, and made no response to her and did not overrule her, then all her vows shall stand, and every agreement by which she bound herself shall stand.

But if her husband truly made them void on the day he heard them, then whatever proceeded from her lips concerning her vows or concerning the agreement binding her, it shall not stand; her husband has made them void, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will release her.
Every vow and every binding oath to afflict her soul, her husband may confirm it, or her husband may make it void.

Now if her husband makes no response whatever to her from day to day, then he confirms all her vows or all the agreements that bind her; he confirms them, because he made no response to her on the day that he heard them.
But if he does make them void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her guilt.”
These are the statutes which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha, between a man and his wife, and between a father and his daughter in her youth in her father’s house.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“Take vengeance on the Midianites for the children of Yashar'AL. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”
So Musha spoke to the people, saying, “Arm some of yourselves for war, and let them go against the Midianites to take vengeance for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on Midian.
A thousand from each tribe of all the tribes of Yashar'AL you shall send to the war.”
So there were recruited from the divisions of Yashar'AL one thousand from each tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
Then Musha sent them to the war, one thousand from each tribe; he sent them to the war with Phinahas the son of Alaazar the Kuhan, with the Qadash articles and the signal trumpets in his hand.
And they warred against the Midianites, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha, and they killed all the males.
They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of those who were killed, Abi, Rakam, Zur, Hur, and Raba, the five kings of Midian. Balaam the son of Baur they also killed with the sword.
And the children of Yashar'AL took the women of Midian captive, with their little ones, and took as spoil all their cattle, all their flocks, and all their goods.
They also burned with fire all the cities where they dwelt, and all their forts.
And they took all the spoil and all the booty of man and beast.

Then they brought the captives, the booty, and the spoil to Musha, to Alaazar the Kuhan, and to the congregation of the children of Yashar'AL, to the camp in the plains of Muab by the Yurdan, across from Yarichu.
And Musha, Alaazar the Kuhan, and all the leaders of the congregation, went to meet them outside the camp.
But Musha was angry with the officers of the army, with the captains over thousands and captains over hundreds, who had come from the battle.
And Musha said to them: “Have you kept all the women alive?

Look, these women caused the children of Yashar'AL, through the counsel of Balaam, to trespass against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the incident of Paur, and there was a plague among the congregation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Now therefore, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known a man intimately.
But keep alive for yourselves all the young girls who have not known a man intimately.
And as for you, remain outside the camp seven days; whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves and your captives on the third day and on the seventh day.
Purify every garment, everything made of leather, everything woven of goats’ hair, and everything made of wood.”
Then Alaazar the Kuhan said to the men of war who had gone to the battle, “This is the ordinance of the law which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha:
Only the gold, the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

everything that can endure fire, you shall put through the fire, and it shall be clean; and it shall be purified with the water of purification. But all that cannot endure fire you shall put through water.
And you shall wash your clothes on the seventh day and be clean, and afterward you may come into the camp.”
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying:
“Count up the plunder that was taken of man and beast you and Alaazar the Kuhan and the chief fathers of the congregation;
and divide the plunder into two parts, between those who took part in the war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.
And La'uy a tribute for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on the men of war who went out to battle: one of every five hundred of the persons, the cattle, the donkeys, and the sheep;
take it from their half, and give it to Alaazar the Kuhan as a heave offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

And from the children of Yashar'AL’s half you shall take one of every fifty, drawn from the persons, the cattle, the donkeys, and the sheep, from all the livestock, and give them to the Lauym who keep charge of the tabernacle of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
So Musha and Alaazar the Kuhan did as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha.
The booty remaining from the plunder, which the men of war had taken, was six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,
seventy-two thousand cattle,
sixty-one thousand donkeys,
and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of women who had not known a man intimately.
And the half, the portion for those who had gone out to war, was in number three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;
and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred and seventy-five.
The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s tribute was seventy two.
The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s tribute was sixty one.
The persons were sixteen thousand, of which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s tribute was thirty two persons.
So Musha gave the tribute which was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s heave offering to Alaazar the Kuhan, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha.
And from the children of Yashar'AL’s half, which Musha separated from the men who fought
now the half belonging to the congregation was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
thirty-six thousand cattle,
thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
and sixteen thousand persons,

and from the children of Yashar'AL’s half Musha took one of every fifty, drawn from man and beast, and gave them to the Lauym, who kept charge of the tabernacle of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha.
Then the officers who were over thousands of the army, the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, came near to Musha;
and they said to Musha, “Your servants have taken a count of the men of war who are under our command, and not a man of us is missing.

Therefore we have brought an offering for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, what every man found of ornaments of gold: armlets and bracelets and signet rings and earrings and necklaces, to make atonement for ourselves before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
So Musha and Alaazar the Kuhan received the gold from them, all the fashioned ornaments.
And all the gold of the offering that they offered to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, from the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
The men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.

And Musha and Alaazar the Kuhan received the gold from the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of meeting as a memorial for the children of Yashar'AL before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Now the children of Rauban and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock; and when they saw the land of Yazar and the land of Gilaad, that indeed the region was a place for livestock,
the children of Gad and the children of Rauban came and spoke to Musha, to Alaazar the Kuhan, and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,
“Ataruth, Dibun, Yazar, Nimrah, Hashbun, Alaalah, Shabam, Nabu, and Baun,
the country which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH defeated before the congregation of Yashar'AL, is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock.”
Therefore they said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not take us over the Yurdan.”
And Musha said to the children of Gad and to the children of Rauban: “Shall your brethren go to war while you sit here?
Now why will you discourage the heart of the children of Yashar'AL from going over into the land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given them?
Thus your fathers did when I sent them away from Kadash Barnaa to see the land.
For when they went up to the Valley of Ashcul and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Yashar'AL, so that they did not go into the land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had given them.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s anger was aroused on that day, and He swore an oath, saying,
‘Surely none of the men who came up from Mitzraym, from twenty years old and above, shall see the land of which I swore to Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub, because they have not wholly followed Me,
except Calab the son of Yaphunnah, the Kanizzite, and Yahusha the son of Nun, for they have wholly followed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s anger was aroused against Yashar'AL, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation that had done evil in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was gone.
And look! You have risen in your fathers’ place, a brood of sinful men, to increase still more the fierce anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH against Yashar'AL.
For if you turn away from following 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He will once again leave them in the wilderness, and you will destroy all these people.”
Then they came near to Musha and said: “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones,

but we ourselves will be armed, ready to go before the children of Yashar'AL until we have brought them to their place; and our little ones will dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
We will not return to our homes until every one of the children of Yashar'AL has received his inheritance.
For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Yurdan and beyond, because our inheritance has fallen to us on this eastern side of the Yurdan.”
Then Musha said to them: “If you do this thing, if you arm yourselves before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for the war,
and all your armed men cross over the Yurdan before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH until He has driven out His enemies from before Him,
and the land is subdued before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, then afterward you may return and be blameless before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and before Yashar'AL; and this land shall be your possession before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But if you do not do so, then take note, you have sinned against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and be sure your sin will find you out.
Build cities for your little ones and folds for your sheep, and do what has proceeded out of your mouth.”
And the children of Gad and the children of Rauban spoke to Musha, saying: “Your servants will do as you commands.
Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock will be there in the cities of Gilaad;
but your servants will cross over, every man armed for war, before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to battle, just as my master says.”
So Musha gave command concerning them to Alaazar the Kuhan, to Yahusha the son of Nun, and to the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Yashar'AL.

And Musha said to them: “If the children of Gad and the children of Rauban cross over the Yurdan with you, every man armed for battle before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilaad as a possession.
But if they do not cross over armed with you, then they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
Then the children of Gad and the children of Rauban answered saying as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has said to your servants, so we will do.
We will cross over armed before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH into the land of Canaan, but the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us on this side of the Yurdan.”

So Musha gave to the children of Gad, to the children of Rauban, and to half the tribe of Manassah the son of Ya'asaf, the kingdom of Sihun king of the Amurites and the kingdom of Ug king of Bashan, the land with its cities within the borders, the cities of the surrounding country.
And the children of Gad built Dibun and Ataruth and Aruar,
Atruth and Shuphan and Yazar and Yugbahah,
Bath Nimrah and Bath Haran, fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
And the children of Rauban built Hashbun and Alaalah and Kiryathaim,
Nabu and Baal Maun (their names being changed) and Shibmah; and they gave other names to the cities which they built.
And the children of Machir the son of Manassah went to Gilaad and took it, and dispossessed the Amurites who were in it.
So Musha gave Gilaad to Machir the son of Manassah, and he dwelt in it.
Also Yair the son of Manassah went and took its small towns, and called them Habuth Yair.
Then Nubah went and took Kanath and its villages, and he called it Nubah, after his own name.
This is the route the Yasharalym followed as they marched out of Mitzraym under the leadership of Musha and Aarun.
At 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s direction, Musha kept a written record of their progress. These are the stages of their march, identified by the different places where they stopped along the way.
