They set out from the city of Ramasas in early spring, on the fifteenth day of the first Moon (month) on the morning after the first Pasakh (Passover) celebration. The people of Yashar'AL left defiantly, in full view of all the Mitzraym.
Meanwhile, the Mitzraym were burying all their firstborn sons, whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had killed the night before, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had defeated the idols of Mitzraym that night with great acts of judgment!
After leaving Ramasas, the Yasharalym set up camp at Succuth.
Then they left Succuth and camped at Atham on the edge of the wilderness.
They left Atham and turned back toward Pihahiruth, opposite Baal-zaphun, and camped near Migdul.
They left Pi-hahiruth and crossed the Red Sea into the wilderness beyond. Then they traveled for three days into the Atham wilderness and camped at Marah.
They left Marah and camped at Alim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees.
They left Alim and camped beside the Red Sea.
They left the Red Sea and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
They left the wilderness of Sin and camped at Duphkah.
They left Duphkah and camped at Alush.
They left Alush and camped at Raphidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.
They left Raphidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.
They left the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibruth-hattaabah.
They left Kibruth-hattaabah and camped at Hazaruth.
They left Hazaruth and camped at Rithmah.
They left Rithmah and camped at Rimmun-paraz.
They left Rimmun-paraz and camped at Libnah.
They left Libnah and camped at Rissah.
They left Rissah and camped at Kahalathah.
They left Kahalathah and camped at Mount Shaphar.
They left Mount Shaphar and camped at Haradah.
They left Haradah and camped at Makhaluth.
They left Makhaluth and camped at Tahath.
They left Tahath and camped at Tarah.
They left Tarah and camped at Mithcah.
They left Mithcah and camped at Hashmunah.
They left Hashmunah and camped at Musaruth.
They left Mosaruth and camped at Bana-Yaakan.
They left Bana-Yaakan and camped at Hur-haggidgad.
They left Hur-haggidgad and camped at Yutbathah.
They left Yutbathah and camped at Abrunah.
They left Abrunah and camped at Aziun-gabar.
They left Aziun-gabar and camped at Kadash in the wilderness of Zin.
They left Kadash and camped at Mount Hur, at the border of Adum.

While they were at the foot of Mount Hur, Aarun the Kuhan was directed by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to go up the mountain, and there he died. This happened in midsummer, on the first day of the fifth Moon (month) of the fortieth year after Yashar'AL’s departure from Mitzraym.
Aarun was 123 years old when he died there on Mount Hur.
At that time the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Nagab in the land of Canaan, heard that the people of Yashar'AL were approaching his land.
Meanwhile, the Yasharalym left Mount Hur and camped at Zalmunah.
Then they left Zalmunah and camped at Punun.
They left Punun and camped at Ubuth.
They left Ubuth and camped at Iya-abarim on the border of Muab.
They left Iya-abarim and camped at Dibun-gad.
They left Dibun-gad and camped at Almun-diblathaim.
They left Almun-diblathaim and camped in the mountains east of the river, near Mount Nabu.
They left the mountains east of the river and camped on the plains of Muab beside the Yurdan River, across from Yarichu.
Along the Yurdan River they camped from Bath-Yashimuth as far as the meadows of Acacia on the plains of Muab.
While they were camped near the Yurdan River on the plains of Muab opposite Yarichu, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha,
“Give the following instructions to the people of Yashar'AL: When you cross the Yurdan River into the land of Canaan,
you must drive out all the people living there. You must destroy all their carved and molten images and demolish all their pagan shrines.
Take possession of the land and settle in it, because I have given it to you to occupy.

You must distribute the land among the clans by sacred lot and in proportion to their size. A larger portion of land will be allotted to each of the larger clans, and a smaller portion will be allotted to each of the smaller clans. The decision of the sacred lot is final. In this way, the portions of land will be divided among your ancestral tribes.
But if you fail to drive out the people who live in the land, those who remain will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your sides, they will harass you in the land where you live.
And I will do to you what I had planned to do to them.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, saying
“Command the children of Yashar'AL, and say to them: ‘When you come into the land of Canaan, this is the land that shall fall to you as an inheritance, the land of Canaan to its boundaries.
Your southern border shall be from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Adum; then your southern border shall extend eastward to the end of the Salt Sea;
your border shall turn from the southern side of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and be on the south of Kadash Barnaa; then it shall go on to Hazar Addar, and continue to Azmun;
the border shall turn from Azmun to the Brook of Mitzraym, and it shall end at the Sea.
‘As for the western border, you shall have the Great Sea for a border; this shall be your western border.
‘And this shall be your northern border: From the Great Sea you shall mark out your border line to Mount Hur;
from Mount Hur you shall mark out your border to the entrance of Hamath; then the direction of the border shall be toward Zadad;
the border shall proceed to Ziphrun, and it shall end at Hazar Anan. This shall be your northern border.
‘You shall mark out your eastern border from Hazar Anan to Shapham;
the border shall go down from Shapham to Riblah on the east side of Ain; the border shall go down and reach to the eastern side of the Sea of Chinnarath;
the border shall go down along the Yurdan, and it shall end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land with its surrounding boundaries.’ ”
Then Musha commanded the children of Yashar'AL, saying: “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half-tribe.

For the tribe of the children of Rauban according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and the half-tribe of Manassah has received its inheritance.
The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance on this side of the Yurdan, across from Yarichu eastward, toward the sunrise.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying
“These are the names of the men who shall divide the land among you as an inheritance: Alaazar the Kuhan and Yahusha the son of Nun.
And you shall take one leader of every tribe to divide the land for the inheritance.
These are the names of the men: from the tribe of Yahudah, Calab the son of Yaphunnah;
from the tribe of the children of Simaun, Shamual the son of Ammihud;
from the tribe of Banyamin, Alidad the son of Chislun;
a leader from the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Yugli;
from the sons of Ya'asaf: a leader from the tribe of the children of Manassah, Hannial the son of Aphud,
and a leader from the tribe of the children of Alphraim, Kamual the son of Shiphtan;
a leader from the tribe of the children of Zabulun, Alizaphan the son of Parnach;
a leader from the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltial the son of Azzan;
a leader from the tribe of the children of Ashar, Ahihud the son of Shalumi;
and a leader from the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Padahal the son of Ammihud.”
These are the ones 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded to divide the inheritance among the children of Yashar'AL in the land of Canaan.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha in the plains of Muab by the Yurdan across from Yarichu, saying:
“Command the children of Yashar'AL that they give the Lauym cities to dwell in from the inheritance of their possession, and you shall also give the Lauym common-land around the cities.
They shall have the cities to dwell in; and their common-land shall be for their cattle, for their herds, and for all their animals.
The common-land of the cities which you will give the Lauym shall extend from the wall of the city outward a thousand cubits all around.

And you shall measure outside the city on the east side two thousand cubits, on the south side two thousand cubits, on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits. The city shall be in the middle. This shall belong to them as common-land for the cities.
“Now among the cities which you will give to the Lauym you shall appoint six cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee, and to these you shall add forty-two cities.
So all the cities you will give to the Lauym shall be forty-eight; these you shall give with their common-land.

And the cities which you will give shall be from the possession of the children of Yashar'AL; from the larger tribe you shall give many, from the smaller you shall give few. Each shall give some of its cities to the Lauym, in proportion to the inheritance that each receives.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha saying
“Speak to the children of Yashar'AL, and say to them: ‘When you cross the Yurdan into the land of Canaan,
then you shall appoint cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer who kills any person accidentally may flee there.
They shall be cities of refuge for you from the avenger, that the manslayer may not die until he stands before the congregation in judgment.
And of the cities which you give, you shall have six cities of refuge.
You shall appoint three cities on this side of the Yurdan, and three cities you shall appoint in the land of Canaan, which will be cities of refuge.
These six cities shall be for refuge for the children of Yashar'AL, for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them, that anyone who kills a person accidentally may flee there.
‘But if he strikes him with an iron implement, so that he dies, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.
And if he strikes him with a stone in the hand, by which one could die, and he does die, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.
Or if he strikes him with a wooden hand weapon, by which one could die, and he does die, he is a murderer; the murderer shall surely be put to death.
The avenger of blood himself shall put the murderer to death; when he meets him, he shall put him to death.
If he pushes him out of hatred or, while lying in wait, hurls something at him so that he dies,

or in enmity he strikes him with his hand so that he dies, the one who struck him shall surely be put to death, he is a murderer, the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.
‘However, if he pushes him suddenly without enmity, or throws anything at him without lying in wait,
or uses a stone, by which a man could die, throwing it at him without seeing him, so that he dies, while he was not his enemy or seeking his harm,
then the congregation shall judge between the manslayer and the avenger of blood according to these judgments.

So the congregation shall deliver the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall return him to the city of refuge where he had fled, and he shall remain there until the death of the high Kuhan who was anointed with the Qadash oil.
But if the manslayer at any time goes outside the limits of the city of refuge where he fled,
and the avenger of blood finds him outside the limits of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the manslayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,
because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high Kuhan. But after the death of the high Kuhan the manslayer may return to the land of his possession.
‘And these things shall be a statute of judgment to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
Whoever kills a person, the murderer shall be put to death on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness is not sufficient testimony against a person for the death penalty.
Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death, but he shall surely be put to death.
And you shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may return to dwell in the land before the death of the Kuhan.
So you shall not pollute the land where you are; for blood defiles the land, and no atonement can be made for the land, for the blood that is shed on it, except by the blood of him who shed it.
Therefore do not defile the land which you inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell; for I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH dwell among the children of Yashar'AL.’

Now the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilaad the son of Machir, the son of Manassah, of the families of the sons of Ya'asaf, came near and spoke before Musha and before the leaders, the chief fathers of the children of Yashar'AL.

And they said: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded my master Musha to give the land as an inheritance by lot to the children of Yashar'AL, and my master was commanded by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to give the inheritance of our brother Zaluphahad to his daughters.

Now if they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Yashar'AL, then their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and it will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry; so it will be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

And when the Yubalym of the children of Yashar'AL comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry; so their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”
Then Musha commanded the children of Yashar'AL according to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, saying: “What the tribe of the sons of Ya'asaf speaks is right.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commands concerning the daughters of Zaluphahad, saying, ‘Let them marry whom they think best, but they may marry only within the family of their father’s tribe.’
So the inheritance of the children of Yashar'AL shall not change hands from tribe to tribe, for every one of the children of Yashar'AL shall keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

And every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Yashar'AL shall be the wife of one of the family of her father’s tribe, so that the children of Yashar'AL each may possess the inheritance of his fathers.
Thus no inheritance shall change hands from one tribe to another, but every tribe of the children of Yashar'AL shall keep its own inheritance.”
Just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha, so did the daughters of Zaluphahad;
for Mahlah, Tirzah, Huglah, Milcah, and Nuah, the daughters of Zaluphahad, were married to the sons of their father’s brothers.
They were married into the families of the children of Manassah the son of Ya'asaf, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of their father’s family.
These are the commandments and the judgments which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded the children of Yashar'AL by the hand of Musha in the plains of Muab by the Yurdan, across from Yarichu.

books.name: Deuteronomy
chapters: These are the words that Musha spoke to all the people of Yashar'AL while they were in the wilderness east of the Yurdan River. They were camped in the Yurdan Valley near Suph, between Paran on one side and Tuphal, Laban, Hazaruth, and Di-zahab on the other.
Normally it takes only eleven days to travel from Mount Sinai to Kadash-barnaa, going by way of Mount Sair.
But forty years after the Yasharalym left Mitzraym, on the first day of the eleventh month, Musha addressed the people of Yashar'AL, telling them everything 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had commanded him to say.
This took place after he had defeated King Sihun of the Amurites, who ruled in Hashbun, and at Adrai had defeated King Ug of Bashan, who ruled in Ashtaruth.
While the Yasharalym were in the land of Muab east of the Yurdan River, Musha carefully explained the instructions of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as follows.
“When we were at Mount Sinai, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH said to us, ‘You have stayed at this mountain long enough.

It is time to break camp and move on. Go to the hill country of the Amurites and to all the neighboring regions, the Yurdan Valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Nagab, and the coastal plain. Go to the land of the Canaanites and to Labanun, and all the way to the great Euphrates River.
Look, I Am giving all this land to you! Go in and occupy it, for it is the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore to give to your ancestors Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub, and to all their descendants.’”
Musha continued, “At that time I told you, ‘You are too great a burden for me to carry all by myself.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has increased your population, making you as numerous as the stars!
And may 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of your ancestors, multiply you a thousand times more and barak you as he promised!
But you are such a heavy load to carry! How can I deal with all your problems and bickering?
Choose some well-respected men from each tribe who are known for their wisdom and understanding, and I will appoint them as your leaders.’
“Then you responded, ‘Your plan is a good one.’

So I took the wise and respected men you had selected from your tribes and appointed them to serve as judges and officials over you. Some were responsible for a thousand people, some for a hundred, some for fifty, and some for ten.
“At that time I instructed the judges, ‘You must hear the cases of your fellow Yasharalym and the foreigners living among you. Be perfectly fair in your decisions

and impartial in your judgments. Hear the cases of those who are poor as well as those who are rich. Don’t be afraid of anyone’s anger, for the decision you make is 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH’s decision. Bring me any cases that are too difficult for you, and I will handle them.’
“At that time I gave you instructions about everything you were to do.

Then, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH commanded us, we left Mount Sinai and traveled through the great and terrifying wilderness, as you yourselves remember, and headed toward the hill country of the Amurites. When we arrived at Kadash-barnaa,
I said to you, ‘You have now reached the hill country of the Amurites that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving us.
Look! He has placed the land in front of you. Go and occupy it as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of your ancestors, has promised you. Do not be afraid! Do not be discouraged!’
“But you all came to me and said, ‘First, let us send out scouts to explore the land for us. They will advise us on the best route to take and which towns we should enter.’
“This seemed like a good idea to me, so I chose twelve scouts, one from each of your tribes.
They headed for the hill country and came to the valley of Ashcul and explored it.
They picked some of its fruit and brought it back to us. And they reported, ‘The land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has given us is indeed a good land.’
“But you rebelled against the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and refused to go in.
You complained in your tents and said, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must hate us. That’s why he has brought us here from Mitzraym to hand us over to the Amurites to be slaughtered.

Where can we go? Our brothers have demoralized us with their report, they tell us, “the people of the land are taller and more powerful than we are, and their towns are large, with walls rising high into the sky! We even saw giants there, the descendants of Anak!”’
“But I said to you, ‘Do not be shocked or afraid of them!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is going ahead of you, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will fight for you, just as you saw Him do in Mitzraym.

And you saw how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH cared for you all along the way as you traveled through the wilderness, just as a father cares for his child. Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has brought you to this place.’
“But even after all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did, you refused to trust 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH,
who goes before you looking for the best places to camp, guiding you with a pillar of fire by night and a pillar of cloud by day.
“When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heard your complaining, He became very angry. So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH solemnly swore,
‘Not one of you from this wicked generation will live to see the good land He swore to give your ancestors,

except Calab son of Yaphunnah, he will see this land because he has followed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH completely, I will give to him and his descendants some of the very land he explored during his scouting mission.’
“And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was also angry with me because of you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to me, ‘Musha, not even you will enter the Promised Land!
Instead, your assistant, Yahusha Ba'Nun (son of Nun), will lead the people into the land. Encourage him, for he will lead Yashar'AL as they take possession of it.
I will give the land to your little ones, your innocent children. You were afraid they would be captured, but they will be the ones who occupy it.
As for you, turn around now and go on back through the wilderness toward the Red Sea.’

“Then you confessed, ‘We have sinned against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! We will go into the land and fight for it, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has commanded us.’ So your men strapped on their weapons, thinking it would be easy to attack the hill country.
“But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH told me to tell you, ‘Do not attack, for I Am not with you. If you go ahead on your own, you will be crushed by your enemies.’
“This is what I told you, but you would not listen. Instead, you again rebelled against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s command and arrogantly went into the hill country to fight.
But the Amurites who lived there came out against you like a swarm of bees. They chased and battered you all the way from Sair to Hurmah.
Then you returned and wept before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but he refused to listen.
So you stayed there at Kadash for a long time.
“Then we turned around and headed back across the wilderness toward the Red Sea, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had instructed me, and we wandered around in the region of Mount Seir for a long time.
“Then at last 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me,
‘You have been wandering around in this hill country long enough; turn to the north.

Give these orders to the people: “You will pass through the country belonging to your relatives the Adumites, the descendants of Asau, who live in Seir. The Adumites will feel threatened, so be careful.
Do not bother them, for I have given them all the hill country around Mount Seir as their property, and I will not give you even one square foot of their land.
If you need food to eat or water to drink, pay them for it.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has Baraked you in everything you have done. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has watched your every step through this great wilderness. During these forty years, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has been with you, and you have lacked nothing.

“So we bypassed the territory of our relatives, the descendants of Asau, who live in Sair. We avoided the road through the Arabah Valley that comes up from Alath and Aziun-gabar. “Then as we turned north along the desert route through Muab,
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH warned us, ‘Do not bother the Muabites, the descendants of Lut, or start a war with them. I have given them Ar as their property, and I will not give you any of their land.’”
A race of giants called the Amites had once lived in the area of Ar. They were as strong and numerous and tall as the Anakites, another race of giants.
Both the Amites and the Anakites are also known as the Raphaites, though the Muabites call them Amites.

In earlier times the Hurites had lived in Sair, but they were driven out and displaced by the descendants of Asau, just as Yashar'AL drove out the people of Canaan when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave Yashar'AL their land.
Musha continued, then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to us, Get moving. Cross the Zarad Brook.’ So we crossed the brook.

“Thirty-eight years passed from the time we first left Kadash-barnaa until we finally crossed the Zarad Brook! By then, all the men old enough to fight in battle had died in the wilderness, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had vowed would happen.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH struck them down until they had all been eliminated from the community.
“When all the men of fighting age had died,
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me,
‘Today you will cross the border of Muab at Ar

and enter the land of the Ammunites, the descendants of Lut. But do not bother them or start a war with them. I have given the land of Ammun to them as their property, and I will not give you any of their land.’”
That area was once considered the land of the Raphaites, who had lived there, though the Ammunites call them Zamzummites.
They were also as strong and numerous and tall as the Anakites. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroyed them so the Ammunites could occupy their land.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had done the same for the descendants of Asau who lived in Seir, for he destroyed the Hurites so they could settle there in their place. The descendants of Asau live there to this day.
A similar thing happened when the Caphturites from Crata invaded and destroyed the Abbites, who had lived in villages in the area of Gaza.

Musha continued, “Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, ‘Now get moving! Cross the Arnun Gurge. Look, I will hand over to you Sihun the Amurite, king of Hashbun, and I will give you his land. Attack him and begin to occupy the land.
Beginning today I will make people throughout the Arath terrified because of you. When they hear reports about you, they will tremble with dread and fear.’”
Musha continued, “From the wilderness of Kadamuth I sent ambassadors to King Sihun of Hashbun with this proposal of Shalum:
‘Let us travel through your land. We will stay on the main road and will not turn off into the fields on either side.
Sell us food to eat and water to drink, and we will pay for it. All we want is permission to pass through your land.

The descendants of Asau who live in Sair allowed us to go through their country, and so did the Muabites, who live in Ar. Let us pass through until we cross the Yurdan into the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving us.’
“But King Sihun of Hashbun refused to allow us to pass through, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH made Sihun stubborn and defiant so he could help you defeat him, as He has now done.
“Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, ‘Look, I have begun to hand King Sihun and his land over to you. Begin now to conquer and occupy his land.’
“Then King Sihun declared war on us and mobilized his forces at Yahaz.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH handed him over to us, and we crushed him, his sons, and all his people.
We conquered all his towns and completely destroyed everyone men, women, and children, not a single person was spared.
We took all the livestock as plunder for ourselves, along with anything of value from the towns we ransacked.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH also helped us conquer Aruar on the edge of the Arnun Gurge, and the town in the gurge, and the whole area as far as Gilaad, no town had walls too strong for us.
However, we avoided the land of the Ammunites all along the Yabbuk River and the towns in the hill country, all the places 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH had commanded us to leave alone.
“Next we turned and headed for the land of Bashan, where King Ug and his entire army attacked us at Adrai.

But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH told me, ‘do not be afraid of him, for I have given you victory over Ug and his entire army, and I will give you all his land. Treat him just as you treated King Sihun of the Amurites, who ruled in Hashbun.’
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH handed King Ug and all his people over to us, and we killed them all. Not a single person survived.
We conquered all sixty of his towns, the entire Argub region in his kingdom of Bashan. Not a single town escaped our conquest.
These towns were all fortified with high walls and barred gates. We also took many unwalled villages at the same time.
We completely destroyed the kingdom of Bashan, just as we had destroyed King Sihun of Hashbun. We destroyed all the people in every town we conquered men, women, and children alike.
But we kept all the livestock for ourselves and took plunder from all the towns.
“So we took the land of the two Amurite kings east of the Yurdan River, all the way from the Arnun Gurge to Mount Harmun.
Mount Harmun is called Siriun by the Sidunians, and the Amurites call it Sanir.
We had now conquered all the cities on the Plataau and all Gilaad and Bashan, as far as the towns of Salacah and Adrai, which were part of Ug’s kingdom in Bashan.
King Ug of Bashan was the last survivor of the giant Rephaites. His bed was made of iron and was more than thirteen feet long and six feet wide. It can still be seen in the Ammunite city of Rabbah.
“When we took possession of this land, I gave to the tribes of Ra'uban and Gad the territory beyond Aruar along the Arnun Gurge, plus half of the hill country of Gilead with its towns.
Then I gave the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan Ug’s former kingdom, to the half-tribe of Manassah. This entire Argub region of Bashan used to be known as the land of the Raphaites.

Yair, a leader from the tribe of Manassah, conquered the whole Argub region in Bashan, all the way to the border of the Gashurites and Maacathites. Yair renamed this region after himself, calling it the Towns of Yair, as it is still known today.
I gave Gilaad to the clan of Makir.
But I also gave part of Gilead to the tribes of Rauban and Gad. The area I gave them extended from the middle of the Arnun Gurge in the south to the Yabbuk River on the Ammunite frontier.
They also received the Yurdan Valley, all the way from the Sea of Galily down to the Dead Sea, with the Yurdan River serving as the western boundary. To the east were the slopes of Pisgah.

“At that time I gave this command to the tribes that would live east of the Yurdan: ‘Although 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has given you this land as your property, all your fighting men must cross the Yurdan ahead of your Yasharalym relatives, armed and ready to assist them.
Your wives, children, and numerous livestock, however, may stay behind in the towns I have given you.

When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given security to the rest of the Yasharalym, as he has to you, and when they occupy the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving them across the Yurdan River, then you may all return here to the land I have given you.’

“At that time I gave Yahusha Ba'Nun this charge: You have seen for yourself everything 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has done to these two kings. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will do the same to all the kingdoms on the west side of the Yurdan.
Do not be afraid of the nations there, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will fight for you.
“At that time I pleaded with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and said,

‘O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, you have only begun to show your greatness and the strength of your hand to me, your servant. Is there any mighty ones in Shamaym or on Arath who can perform such great and mighty deeds as you do?
Please let me cross the Yurdan to see the wonderful land on the other side, the beautiful hill country and the Labanun mountains.’
“But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was angry with me because of you, and he would not listen to me. ‘That’s enough!’ 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH declared. ‘Speak of it no more.
But go up to Pisgah Peak, and look over the land in every direction. Take a good look, but you may not cross the Yurdan River.
Instead, commission Yahusha Ba'Nun and encourage and strengthen him, for he will lead the people across the Yurdan, he will give them all the land you now see before you as their possession.’
So we stayed in the valley near Bath-paur.

“And now, Yashar'AL, listen carefully to these decrees and regulations that I am about to teach you. Obey them so that you may live, so you may enter and occupy the land that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of your ancestors, is giving you.
You must not add to or remove from the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH which i am giving you today O Yashar'AL, You must obey the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH that I am giving you.
“You saw for yourself what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did to you at Baal-paur. There 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH destroyed everyone who had worshiped Baal, the idol of Paur. .
But all of you who were faithful to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH are still alive today, every one of you.
“Look, I now teach you these decrees and regulations just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH commanded me, so that you may obey them in the land you are about to enter and occupy.

Obey them completely, and you will display your wisdom and intelligence among the surrounding nations. When they hear all these decrees, they will exclaim, ‘How wise and prudent are the people of this great nation!’
For what great nation has an 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH as near to them as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is near to us whenever we call on Him?
And what great nation has decrees and regulations as righteous and fair as this body of instructions that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me to give you today?

“But watch out! Be careful never to forget what you yourself have seen. Do not let these memories escape from your mind as long as you live! And be sure to pass them on to your children and grandchildren.

Never forget the day when you stood before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH at Mount Sinai, where 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH told me, that I should Gather the people before Him, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to you and said, I will let them hear Me speak with them and then they will learn to fear Me as long as they live, and they will teach their children to fear Me also says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’
“You came near and stood at the foot of the mountain, while flames from the mountain shot into the sky. The mountain was shrouded in black clouds and deep darkness.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to you from the heart of the fire. You heard the sound of the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH talking to you all, but you did not see the form of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; there was only a Voice.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH proclaimed His covenant, The Ten Commandments, which He commanded you to keep, and which He wrote on two stone tablets.
It was at that time that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded me to teach you His decrees and regulations so you would obey them in the land you are about to enter and occupy.
“You should be very careful! For you did not see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s form on the day 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke to you from the heart of the fire at Mount Sinai.
So be careful! Do not sin and destroy yourselves by making images or statues in the shape of any living thing, do not make an idol that looks like a man or a woman,
or like an animal on the Arath, or like a bird that flies in the sky.
And do not make an idol that looks like anything that crawls on the ground or like a fish in the Yam (sea).

And be careful when you look up to the sky and see the sun, the moon, the stars and all the many things in the sky. Be careful that you are not tempted to worship and serve them, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH have only allowed the other people in the world do this, you are the set apart ones of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Remember that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rescued you from the iron-smelting furnace of Mitzraym in order to make you his very own people and his special possession, which is what you are today.
“But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was angry with me because of you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH vowed that I would not cross the Yurdan River into the good land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you as your special possession.
You will cross the Yurdan to occupy the land, but I will not. Instead, I will die here on the east side of the river.
So be careful not to break the covenant 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has made with you. Do not make idols of any shape or form, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has forbidden this.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is a devouring fire; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is a jealous 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

“In the future, when you have children and grandchildren and have lived in the land a long time, do not corrupt yourselves by making idols of any kind. This is evil in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and will arouse His the anger.

“Today I call on Shamaym and Arath as witnesses against you. If you break this covenant 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me to give you, You will quickly disappear from the land you are crossing the Yurdan to occupy. You will live there only a short time; then you will be utterly be destroyed.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will scatter you among the nations, where only a few of you will survive.
There, in a foreign land, you will worship idols made from wood and stone that neither see nor hear nor eat nor smell.
But from there you will search again for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. And if you search for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with all your heart and soul, you will find Him.
“In the distant future, when you are suffering all these things, you will finally return to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and listen to what He tells you.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is a merciful 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH; He will not abandon you or destroy you or forget the solemn covenant He made with your ancestors.

“Now search all of history, from the time 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH created people on the Arath until now, and search from one end of the Shamaym to the other. Has anything as great as this ever been seen or heard before?
Has any nation ever heard the voice of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH speaking from fire as you did and survived?

Has any other carved idol dared to take a nation for himself out of another nation by means of trials, miraculous signs, wonders, war, a strong hand, a powerful arm, and terrifying acts? Yet that is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH did for you in Mitzraym, right before your eyes.
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed you these things so you would know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the only 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and there is no other.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH let you hear His voice from Shamaym so He could instruct you, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH let you see His great fire here on the Arath so He could speak to you from it.
Because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loved your ancestors, He chose to barak their descendants, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH personally brought you out of Mitzraym with a great display of power.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH drove out nations far greater than you, so He could bring you in and give you their land as your special possession, as it is today.
“So remember this and keep it firmly in mind: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH both in Shamaym and on Arath, and there is no other.

If you obey all the decrees and commandments 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me to give you today, all will be well with you and your children. I am giving you these instructions so you will enjoy a long life in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you for all time.”
Then Musha set apart three cities of refuge east of the Yurdan River.
Anyone who killed another person unintentionally, without previous hostility, could flee there to live in safety.
These were the cities: Bazar on the wilderness plataau for the tribe of Rauban; Ramuth in Gilaad for the tribe of Gad; Gulan in Bashan for the tribe of Manassah.
This is the body of instruction that Musha presented to the Yasharalym.
These are the laws, decrees, and regulations that Musha gave to the people of Yashar'AL when they left Mitzraym,

and as they camped in the valley near Bath-paur east of the Yurdan River. (This land was formerly occupied by the Amurites under King Sihun, who ruled from Hashbun. But Musha and the Yasharalym destroyed him and his people when they came up from Mitzraym.
Yashar'AL took possession of his land and that of King Ug of Bashan the two Amurite kings east of the Yurdan.
So Yashar'AL conquered the entire area from Aruar at the edge of the Arnun Gurge all the way to Mount Siriun, also called Mount Harmun.
And they conquered the eastern bank of the Yurdan River as far south as the Dead Sea, below the slopes of Pisgah.)
And Musha called all Yashar'AL, and said to them: “Hear, O Yashar'AL, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your hearing today, that you may learn them and be careful to observe them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH made a covenant with us in Hurab.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, those who are here today, all of us who are alive.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH talked with you face to face on the mountain from the midst of the fire.
I stood between 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and you at that time, to declare to you the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; for you were afraid because of the fire, and you did not go up the mountain. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar:
I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who brought you out of the land of Mitzraym, out of the house of bondage. 7 ‘You must not have and serve other aluahym (mighty ones) before Me.

‘You must not make for yourself a carved image any likeness of anything that is in Shamaym above, or that is in the Arath beneath, or that is in the water under the Arath; 9 you must not bow down to them nor serve them. For I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I AM a jealous 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children to the third and fourth generations of those who hate Me, 10 But I lavish unfailing love for a thousand generations on those who love me and obey my commandments.
“You must not misuse the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not let you go unpunished if you misuse his Name.

Remember to observe the Shabbat day by keeping it Set Apart, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has commanded you. 13 That you have six days each week for your ordinary work, 14 but the seventh day is a Shabbat day of rest dedicated to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. On that day no one in your household may do any work. This includes you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, your oxen and donkeys and other livestock, and any foreigners living among you. All your male and female servants must rest as you do. 15 Remember that you were once slaves in Mitzraym, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH brought you out with his strong hand and powerful arm. That is why 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has commanded you to rest on the Shabbat day.
“Honor your father and your mother, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH commanded you. Then you will live a long, full life in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has giving you..
“You must not murder.
“You must not commit adultery.
“You must not steal.
“You must not testify falsely against your neighbor.
“You must not covet your neighbor’s wife. You must not covet your neighbor’s house or land, male or female servant, ox or donkey, or anything else that belongs to your neighbor.

“Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar these words to all of you assembled there at the foot of the mountain. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar with a loud voice from the heart of the fire, surrounded by clouds and deep darkness. This was all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said at that time, and he wrote HIS Dabarym (words) on two stone tablets and gave them to me.
“But when you heard the voice from the heart of the darkness, while the mountain was blazing with fire, all your tribal leaders and elders came to me.

They said, ‘Look, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has shown us HIS Kabad and greatness, and we have heard HIS voice from the heart of the fire. Today we have seen that 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH can speak to us, and yet we live!
But now, why should we risk death again? If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH Dabar to us again, we will certainly die and be consumed by this awesome fire.
Can any living thing hear the voice of the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH from the heart of the fire as we did and yet survive?
Go yourself and listen to what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH Dabar. Then come and tell us everything he tells you, and we will listen and obey.’
“Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heard the request you made to me. And HE said, ‘I have heard what the people said to you, and they are right.
Oh, that they would always have hearts like this, that they might fear ME and obey all My commandments! If they did, they and their descendants would prosper forever.
Go and tell them, “Return to your tents.”

But you Musha stand here with ME so I can give you all my Commandments, decrees, and regulations. You must teach them to the people so they can obey them in the land I am giving them as their possession.’”
So Musha told the people, “You must be careful to obey all the Commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, following His instructions in every detail.
Stay on the path that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has commanded you to follow. Then you will live long and prosperous lives in the land you are about to enter and occupy.
“These are the Commandments, decrees, and regulations that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH commanded me to teach you. You must obey them in the land you are about to enter and occupy,
You and your children and grand children must fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH as long as you live. If you obey all his decrees and commands, you will enjoy a long life.

Listen closely, Yashar'AL, and be careful to obey. Then all will go well with you, and you will have many children in the land flowing with milk and honey, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of your ancestors, promised you.
Listen, O Yashar'AL, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is One.
And you must love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength.
And you must commit yourselves wholeheartedly to these commands that I am giving you today.
Repeat them again and again to your children. Talk about them when you are at home and when you are on the road, when you are going to bed and when you are getting up.
Tie them to your hands and wear them on your forehead as reminders.
Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will soon bring you into the land he swore to give you when he made a vow to your fathers, to Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub. It is a land with large, prosperous cities that you did not build.

The houses will be richly stocked with goods you did not produce. You will draw water from cisterns you did not dig, and you will eat from vineyards and olive trees you did not plant. When you have eaten your fill in this land,
be careful not to forget 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who rescued you from slavery in the land of Mitzraym.
You must fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and serve Him. When you take an oath, you must only use the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“You must not worship any idols of neighboring nations,
"For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who lives among you, is a jealous 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. His anger will flare up against you, and He will wipe you from the face of the Arath.
You must not test 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH as you did when you complained at Massah.
You must diligently obey the commands of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and all the laws and decrees he has given you.
Do what is right and good in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so all will go well with you. Then you will enter and occupy the good land that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore to give your ancestors.
You will drive out all the enemies living in the land, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said you would.
“In the future your children will ask you, ‘What is the meaning of these laws, decrees, and regulations that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has commanded us to obey?’
“Then you must tell them, ‘We were Phar'uh’s slaves in Mitzraym, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought us out of Mitzraym with his strong hand.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did miraculous signs and wonders before our eyes, dealing terrifying blows against Mitzraym and Phar'uh and all his people.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought us out of Mitzraym so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH could give us this land He had sworn to give our ancestors.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH commanded us to obey all these decrees and to fear Him so He can continue to barak us and preserve our lives, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done to this day.
For we will be counted as righteous when we obey all the commandments 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has given us.’

“When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH brings you into the land which you will go to possess, and has cast out many nations before you, the Hittites and the Girgashites and the Amurites and the Canaanites and the Parizzites and the Hibites and the Yabusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you,
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH delivers them over to you, you must conquer them and utterly destroy them. You must not make any covenant with them nor show mercy to them.
Nor shall you make marriages with them. You shall not give your daughter to their son, nor take their daughter for your son.
For they will turn your sons away from following Me, to serve idols made with man's hands; so the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be aroused against you and destroy you suddenly.
But thus you shall deal with them: you shall destroy their altars, and break down their sacred pillars, and cut down their wooden images, and burn their carved images with fire.
“For you are a Qadash people to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has chosen you to be a people for Himself, a special treasure above all the peoples on the face of the Arath.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not set His love on you nor choose you because you were more in number than any other people, for you were the least of all peoples;

But because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves you, and because He would keep the oath which He swore to your fathers, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you from the house of bondage, from the hand of Phar'uh king of Mitzraym.

“Therefore know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, HE is the only 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the faithful 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who keeps covenant and mercy for a thousand generations with those who love Him and keep His commandments;
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH repays those who hate Him to their face, to destroy them. HE will not be slack with those who hate Him; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will repay them to their face.
Therefore you shall keep the commandment, the statutes, and the judgments which I command you today, to observe them.

“Then it shall come to pass, because you listen to these judgments, and keep and do them, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will keep with you the covenant and the mercy which He swore to your fathers.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will love you and barak you and multiply you; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will also barak the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your cattle and the offspring of your flock, in the land of which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore to your fathers to give you.
You shall be Baraked above all people; there shall not be a male or female barren among you or among your livestock.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will take away from you all sickness, and will afflict you with none of the terrible diseases of Mitzraym which you have known, but will lay them on all those who hate you.
Also you shall destroy all the people whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH delivers over to you; your eye shall have no pity on them; nor shall you serve their idols, for that will be a snare to you.
“If you should say in your heart, ‘These nations are greater than I; how can I dispossess them?’
you shall not be afraid of them, but you shall remember what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH did to Phar'uh and to all Mitzraym:

the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs and the wonders, the mighty hand and the outstretched arm, by which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH brought you out. So shall 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH do to all the peoples of whom you are afraid.
Moreover 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will send terror among them until those who are left, who hide themselves from you, are destroyed.
You shall not be terrified of them; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the great and awesome 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, is among you.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will drive those nations out ahead of you little by little. You will not clear them away all at once, otherwise the wild animals would multiply too quickly for you.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will hand them over to you. He will throw them into complete confusion until they are destroyed.
He will put their kings in your power, and you will erase their names from the face of the Arath (earth). No one will be able to stand against you, and you will destroy them all.

“You must burn their idols in fire, and you must not covet the silver or gold that covers them. You must not take it or it will become a trap to you, for it is detestable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Do not bring any detestable objects into your home, for then you will be destroyed, just like them. You must utterly detest such things, for they are set apart for destruction.
“Be careful to obey all the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH I am giving you today. Then you will live and multiply, and you will enter and occupy the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore to give your ancestors.

Remember how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH led you through the wilderness for these forty years, humbling you and testing you to prove your character, and to find out whether or not you would obey his Commandments.

Yes, he humbled you by letting you go hungry and then feeding you with manna, a food previously unknown to you and your ancestors. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did it to teach you that man must not live by bread alone; rather, we live by every Dabar that comes from the mouth of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For all these forty years your clothes did not wear out, and your feet did not blister or swell.
Think about it: Just as a parent disciplines a child, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH disciplines you for your own good.
“So obey the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH by walking in the ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and by fearing only 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is bringing you into a good land of flowing streams and pools of water, with fountains and springs that gush out in the valleys and hills.
It is a land of wheat and barley; of grapevines, fig trees, and pomegranates; of olive oil and honey.
It is a land where food is plentiful and nothing is lacking. It is a land where iron is as common as stone, and copper is abundant in the hills.
When you have eaten your fill, be sure to Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH for the good land He has given you.

“But that is the time to be careful! Beware that in time of your abundance you do not forget 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and disobey the commandments and regulations of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and the decrees that I am giving you today.
For when you have become full and prosperous and have built fine homes to live in,
And when your flocks and herds have become very large and your silver and gold have multiplied along with everything else, be careful!
Do not become proud at that time and forget 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who rescued you from slavery in the land of Mitzraym.
Do not forget that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH led you through the great and terrifying wilderness with its poisonous snakes and scorpions, where it was so hot and dry. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave you water from the rock!
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH fed you with manna in the wilderness, a food unknown to your ancestors. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did this to humble you and test you for your own good.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did all this so you would never say to yourself, ‘I have achieved this wealth with my own strength and energy.’
Remember 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the one who gives you power to be successful, in order to fulfill the covenant He confirmed to your ancestors with an oath.
“But I assure you of this: If you ever forget 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and follow idols, worshiping images and bowing down to them, you will certainly be destroyed.
Just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has destroyed other nations in your path, you also will be destroyed if you refuse to obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

“Listen, O Yashar'AL! Today you are about to cross the Yurdan River to take over the land belonging to nations much greater and more powerful than you. They live in cities with walls that reach to the sky!
The people are strong and tall, descendants of the famous Anakite giants. You have heard the saying, who can stand up to the Anakites?’

But recognize today that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is the one who will cross over ahead of you like a devouring fire to destroy them. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will subdue them so that you will quickly conquer them and drive them out, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised.

After 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has done this for you, do not say in your hearts, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us this land because we are such good people!’ No, it is because of the wickedness of the other nations that he is pushing them out of your way.

It is not because you are so good or have such integrity that you are about to occupy their land. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will drive these nations out ahead of you only because of their wickedness, and to fulfill the oath he swore to your ancestors Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub.
You must recognize that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is not giving you this good land because you are good, for you are not, you are a stubborn people.
Remember and never forget how angry you made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH out in the wilderness. From the day you left Mitzraym until now, you have been constantly rebelling against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Even at Mount Sinai you made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH so angry, He was ready to destroy you.

This happened when I was on the mountain receiving the tablets of stone inscribed with the Dabar of the covenant that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had made with you. I was there for forty days and forty nights, and all that time I ate no food and drank no water.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me the two tablets on which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had written with his own finger all the Dabar 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had spoken to you from the heart of the fire when you were assembled at the mountain.
“At the end of the forty days and nights, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH handed me the two stone tablets inscribed with the Dabar of the covenant.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, ‘Get up! Go down immediately, for the people you brought out of Mitzraym have corrupted themselves. How quickly they have turned away from the way I commanded them to live! They have melted gold and made an idol for themselves!’
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also Dabar to me, I have seen how stubborn and rebellious these people are.
Leave me alone so I may destroy them and erase their name from under Shamaym. Then I will make a mighty nation of your descendants, a nation larger and more powerful than they are.’
“So while the mountain was blazing with fire I turned and came down, holding in my hands the two stone tablets inscribed with the terms of the covenant.

There below me I could see that you had sinned against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. You had melted gold and made a calf idol for yourselves. How quickly you had turned away from the path 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had commanded you to follow!
So I took the stone tablets and threw them to the ground, smashing them before your eyes.

“Then, as before, I threw myself down before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for forty days and nights. I ate no bread and drank no water because of the great sin you had committed by doing what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hated, provoking 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to anger.
I feared that the furious anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, which turned him against you, would drive him to destroy you. But again 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH listened to me.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was so angry with Aarun that he wanted to destroy Aarun too. But I prayed for Aarun, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spared him.
I took your sin, the calf you had made and I melted it down in the fire and ground it into fine dust. Then I threw the dust into the stream that flows down the mountain.
“You also made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH angry at Tabarah, Massah, and Kibruth-hattaabah.

And at Kadash-barnaa 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent you out with this command: ‘Go up and take over the land I have given you.’ But you rebelled against the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and refused to put your trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH or obey Him.
Yes, you have been rebelling against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as long as I have known you.
“That is why I threw myself down before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for forty days and nights, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said He would destroy you.

I prayed to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and said, ‘O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, do not destroy them. They are your own people, they are your special possession, whom you redeemed from Mitzraym by your mighty power and your strong hand.
Please overlook the stubbornness and the awful sin of these people, and remember instead your servants Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub.

If you destroy these people, the Mitzraym will say, “The Yasharalym died because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was not able to bring them to the land He had promised to give them.” Or they might say, “He destroyed them because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hated them; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH deliberately took them into the wilderness to slaughter them.”
But they are your people and your special possession, whom you brought out of Mitzraym by your great strength and powerful arm.’
“At that time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to me, ‘Chisel out two stone tablets like the first ones. Also make a wooden Ark a sacred chest to store them in. Come up to me on the mountain,
and I will write on the tablets the same words that were on the ones you smashed. Then place the tablets in the Ark.’
“So I made an Ark of acacia wood and cut two stone tablets like the first two. Then I went up the mountain with the tablets in my hand.

Once again 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wrote the Ten Commandments on the tablets and gave them to me. They were the same Dabarym (words) 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had spoken to you from the heart of the fire on the day you were assembled at the foot of the mountain.
Then I turned and came down the mountain and placed the tablets in the Ark of the Covenant, which I had made, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded me. And the tablets are still there in the Ark.”
Then the people of Yashar'AL set out from the wells of the people of Yaakan and traveled to Musarah, where Aarun died and was buried. His son Alaazar ministered as high Kuhan in his place.
Then they journeyed to Gudgudah, and from there to Yutbathah, a land with many brooks and streams.

At that time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH set apart the tribe of Lauy to carry the Ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Covenant, and to stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as His ministers, and to pronounce Barakah in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, These are their duties to this day.
That is why the Lauym have no share of property or possession of land among the other Yasharalym tribes. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself is their special possession, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH told them.
“As for me, I stayed on the mountain in 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH’s presence for forty days and nights, as I had done the first time. And once again 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH listened to my pleas and agreed not to destroy you.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, ‘Get up and resume the journey, and lead the people to the land I swore to give to their ancestors, so they may take possession of it.’

“And now, Yashar'AL, what does 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, require of you? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH requires only that you fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and live in a way that pleases Him, and love Him and serve Him with all your heart and soul.
And you must always obey the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and decrees that I am giving you today for your own good.
“Look, the highest Shamaym and the Arath and everything in it all belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Yet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose your ancestors as the objects of HIS Ahaba (love). And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose you, their descendants, above all other nations, as is evident today.
Therefore, change your hearts and stop being stubborn.
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all Aluahym. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the great 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the mighty and awesome 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who shows no partiality and cannot be bribed.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH ensures that orphans and widows receive justice. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shows love to the foreigners living among you and gives them food and clothing.
So you, too, must show love to foreigners, for you yourselves were once foreigners in the land of Mitzraym.
You must fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and worship him and cling to him. Your oaths must be in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH alone.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH alone is your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the only One who is worthy of your Yadah, the one who has done these mighty miracles that you have seen with your own eyes.
When your ancestors went down into Mitzraym, there were only seventy of them. But now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky!
You must love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and always obey HIS requirements, decrees, regulations, and Commandments.
Keep in mind that I am not talking now to your children, who have never experienced the discipline of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH or seen His greatness and His strong hand and powerful arm.
They did not see the miraculous signs and wonders 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH performed in Mitzraym against Phar'uh and all his land.

They did not see what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did to the armies of Mitzraym and to their horses and chariots, how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH drowned them in the Red Sea as they were chasing you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroyed them, and they have not recovered to this very day!
“Your children did not see how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH cared for you in the wilderness until you arrived here.

They did not see what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did to Dathan and Abiram (the sons of Aliab, a descendant of Rauban) when the Arath opened its mouth in the Yasharalym camp and swallowed them, along with their households and tents and every living thing that belonged to them.
But you have seen 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH perform all these mighty deeds with your own eyes!
“Therefore, be careful to obey every command I am giving you today, so you may have strength to go in and take over the land you are about to enter.
If you obey, you will enjoy a long life in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore to give to your ancestors and to you, their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey!

For the land you are about to enter and take over is not like the land of Mitzraym from which you came, where you planted your seed and made irrigation ditches with your foot as in a vegetable garden.
Rather, the land you will soon take over is a land of hills and valleys with plenty of rain,
A land that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH cares for. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH watches over it through each season of the year!
“If you carefully obey the commands I am giving you today, and if you love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and serve Him with all your heart and soul,
Then He will send the rains in their proper seasons the early and late rains so you can bring in your harvests of grain, new wine, and olive oil.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give you lush pastureland for your livestock, and you yourselves will have all you want to eat.
“But be careful. Do not let your heart be deceived so that you turn away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and serve and worship idols.

If you do, the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will burn against you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will shut up the sky and hold back the rain, and the ground will fail to produce its harvests. Then you will quickly die in that good land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had giving you.
“So commit yourselves wholeheartedly to these Dabarym (words) of mine. Tie them to your hands and wear them on your forehead as reminders.
Teach the Commandments and Laws of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to your children, Talk about them when you are at home and when you are on the road, when you are going to bed and when you are getting up.
Write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates,
so that as long as the sky remains above the Arath, you and your children may flourish in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore to give your ancestors.
“Be careful to obey all these commands I am giving you. Show love to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH by walking in His ways and holding tightly to Him.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will drive out all the nations ahead of you, though they are much greater and stronger than you, and you will take over their land.

Wherever you set your foot, that land will be yours. Your frontiers will stretch from the wilderness in the south to Labanun in the north, and from the Euphrates River in the east to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
No one will be able to stand against you, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will cause the people to fear and dread you, as He promised, wherever you go in the whole land.
“Look, today I am giving you the choice between a Barakah and a curse!
You will be Baraked if you obey the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH that I am giving you today.
But you will be cursed if you reject the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and turn away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and worship idols you have not known before.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH brings you into the land and helps you take possession of it, you must pronounce the Barakah at Mount Garizim and the curse at Mount Abal.
These two mountains are west of the Yurdan River in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Yurdan Valley, near the town of Gilgal, not far from the oaks of Murah.
For you are about to cross the Yurdan River to take over the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you. When you take that land and are living in it,
you must be careful to obey all the decrees and regulations I am giving you today.
“These are the decrees and regulations you must be careful to obey when you live in the land that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of your ancestors, is giving you. You must obey them as long as you live.
“When you drive out the nations that live there, you must destroy all the places where they worship their idols high on the mountains, up on the hills, and under every green tree.
Break down their altars and smash their sacred pillars. Burn their Asherah poles and cut down their carved idols. Completely erase the names of their pagan deities!
Do not worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH in the way these pagan peoples worship their idols.
Rather, you must seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH at the place of worship He Himself will choose from among all the tribes the place where HIS Name will be honored.

There you will bring your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, your sacred offerings, your offerings to fulfill a vow, your voluntary offerings, and your offerings of the firstborn animals of your herds and flocks.
There you and your families will feast in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and you will rejoice in all you have accomplished because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has Baraked you.
“Your pattern of worship will change. Today all of you are doing as you please,
Because you have not yet arrived at the place of rest, the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you as your special possession.
But you will soon cross the Yurdan River and live in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you. When he gives you rest from all your enemies and you are living safely in the land,

you must bring everything I command you, your burnt offerings, your sacrifices, your tithes, your sacred offerings, and your offerings to fulfill a vow, to the designated place of worship, the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chooses for His Name to be honored.

“You must celebrate there in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH with your sons and daughters and all your servants. And remember to include the Lauym who live in your towns, for they will receive no allotment of land among you.
Be careful not to sacrifice your burnt offerings just anywhere you like.
You may do so only at the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will choose within one of your tribal territories. There you must offer your burnt offerings and do everything I command you.

“But you may butcher your animals and eat their meat in any town whenever you want. You may freely eat the animals with which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH Baraked you. All of you, whether ceremonially clean or unclean, you may eat that meat, just as you now eat gazelle and deer.
But you must not consume the blood. You must pour it out on the ground like water.

“But you may not eat your offerings in your hometown, neither the tithe of your grain and new wine and olive oil, nor the firstborn of your flocks and herds, nor any offering to fulfill a vow, nor your voluntary offerings, nor your sacred offerings.

You must eat these in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH at the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will choose. Eat them there with your children, your servants, and the Lauym who live in your towns, celebrating in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH in all you do.
And be very careful never to neglect the Lauym as long as you live in your land.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH expands your territory as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised, and you have the urge to eat meat, you may freely eat meat whenever you want.

It might happen that the designated place of worship, the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH chooses for HIS Name to be honored, is a long way from your home. If so, you may butcher any of the cattle, sheep, or goats 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given you, and you may freely eat the meat in your hometown, as I have commanded you.
Anyone, whether ceremonially clean or unclean, may eat that meat, just as you do now with gazelle and deer.
But never consume the blood, for the blood is the life, and you must not consume the lifeblood with the meat.
Instead, pour out the blood on the ground like water.
Do not consume the blood, so that all may go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Take your sacred gifts and your offerings given to fulfill a vow to the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chooses.

You must offer the meat and blood of your burnt offerings on the altar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. The blood of your other sacrifices must be poured out on the altar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, but you may eat the meat.
Be careful to obey all my commands, so that all will go well with you and your children after you, because you will be doing what is good and pleasing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH goes ahead of you and destroys the nations and you drive them out and live in their land,

do not fall into the trap of following their customs and worshiping their idols. Do not inquire about their pagan deities, saying, ‘How do these nations worship their idols? I want to follow their example.’

You must not worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH the way the other nations worship their deities, for they perform to their deities every detestable act that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hates. They even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices to their deities.
“So be careful to obey all the commands I give you. You must not add anything to them or subtract anything from them.
“Suppose there are Nabym among you or those who dream dreams about the future, and they promise you signs or miracles,
And the predicted signs or miracles occur. If they then say, ‘Come, let us worship idols’ of the pagan deities
Do not listen to them. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is testing you to see if you truly love Him with all your heart and soul.
Serve only 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and fear Him alone. Obey HIS Commandments, listen to the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and cling to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH only.

The false Nabym or visionaries who try to lead you astray must be put to death, for they encourage rebellion against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who redeemed you from slavery and brought you out of the land of Mitzraym. Since they try to lead you astray from the way 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH commanded you to live, you must put them to death. In this way you will purge the evil from among you.

“Suppose someone secretly entices you, even your brother, your son or daughter, your beloved wife, or your closest friend, and says ‘Let us go worship other nations pagan deities’, idols made with man's hands that neither you nor your ancestors have known.
They might suggest that you worship the idols of peoples who live nearby or who come from the ends of the Arath.
But do not give in or listen. Have no pity, and do not spare or protect them.
You must put them to death! Strike the first blow yourself, and then all the people must join in.
Stone the guilty ones to death because they have tried to draw you away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who rescued you from the land of Mitzraym, the place of slavery.
Then all Yashar'AL will hear about it and be afraid, and no one will act so wickedly again.
“When you begin living in the towns 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you, you may hear
That scoundrels among you are leading their fellow citizens astray by saying, ‘Let us go worship other nations idols made with man's hands.
In such cases, you must examine the facts carefully. If you find that the report is true and such a detestable act has been committed among you,
you must attack that town and completely destroy all its inhabitants, as well as all the livestock.

Then you must pile all the plunder in the middle of the open square and burn it. Burn the entire town as a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. That town must remain a ruin forever; it may never be rebuilt.

Keep none of the plunder that has been set apart for destruction. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will turn from HIS fierce anger and be merciful to you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will have compassion on you and make you a large nation, just as He swore to your ancestors.
“Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will be merciful only if you listen to His Dabar and keep all the commands that I am giving you today, doing what pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH only.
“Since you are the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, never cut yourselves or shave the hair above your foreheads in mourning for the dead.
You have been set apart as Qadash to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen you from all the nations of the Arath to be His own special treasure.
“You must not eat any detestable animals that are ceremonially unclean.
These are the animals you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,
The deer, the gazelle, the roe deer, the wild goat, the addax, the antelope, and the mountain sheep.
“You may eat any animal that has completely split hooves and chews the cud,

But if the animal does not have both, it may not be eaten. So you may not eat the camel, the hare, or the hyrax. They chew the cud but do not have split hooves, so they are ceremonially unclean for you.
And you may not eat the pig. It has split hooves but does not chew the cud, so it is ceremonially unclean for you. You may not eat the meat of these animals or even touch their carcasses.
“Of all the marine animals, you may eat whatever has both fins and scales.
You may not, however, eat marine animals that do not have both fins and scales. They are ceremonially unclean for you.
“You may eat any bird that is ceremonially clean.
These are the birds you may not eat: the griffon vulture, the bearded vulture, the black vulture,
the kite, the falcon, buzzards of all kinds,
ravens of all kinds,
the eagle owl, the short-eared owl, the seagull, hawks of all kinds,
the little owl, the great owl, the barn owl,
the desert owl, the Mitzraym vulture, the cormorant,
the stork, herons of all kinds, the hoopoe, and the bat.
“All winged insects that walk along the ground are ceremonially unclean for you and may not be eaten.
But you may eat any winged bird or insect that is ceremonially clean.

“You must not eat anything that has died a natural death. You may give it to a foreigner living in your town, or you may sell it to a stranger. But do not eat it yourselves, for you are set apart as Qadash to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. You must not cook a young goat in its mother’s milk.
“You must set aside a tithe of your crops one-tenth of all the crops you harvest each year.

Bring this tithe to the designated place of worship, the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH chooses for HIS Name to be honored, and eat it there in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. This applies to your tithes of grain, new wine, olive oil, and the firstborn males of your flocks and herds. Doing this will teach you always to fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“Now when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH Baraked you with a good harvest, the place of worship He chooses for HIS Name to be honored might be too far for you to bring the tithe.
If so, you may sell the tithe portion of your crops and herds, put the money in a pouch, and go to the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has chosen.
