When you arrive, you may use the money to buy any kind of food you want—cattle, sheep, goats, wine, or other alcoholic drink. Then feast there in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and celebrate with your household.
And do not neglect the Lauym in your town, for they will receive no allotment of land among you.
“At the end of every third year, bring the entire tithe of that year’s harvest and store it in the nearest town.

Give it to the Lauym, who will receive no allotment of land among you, as well as to the foreigners living among you, the orphans, and the widows in your towns, so they can eat and be satisfied. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will barak you in all your work.
“At the end of every seventh year you must cancel the debts of everyone who owes you money.

This is how it must be done. Everyone must cancel the loans they have made to their fellow Yasharalym. They must not demand payment from their neighbors or relatives, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s time of release has arrived.
This release from debt, however, applies only to your fellow Yasharalym, not to the foreigners living among you.
There should be no poor among you, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will greatly barak you in the land He will give you as a special possession.
You will receive this Barakah if you are careful to obey all the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH that I am giving you today.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will barak you as He had promised. You will lend money to many nations but will never need to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they will not rule over you.
“But if there are any poor Yasharalym in your towns when you arrive in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will give you, do not be hard-hearted or tightfisted toward the poor.
Instead, be generous and lend them whatever they need.

Do not be mean and refuse someone a loan because the year for canceling debts is close at hand. If you refuse to make the loan and the needy person cries out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you will be considered guilty of sin.
Give generously to the poor, not grudgingly, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will barak you in everything you do.
There will always be some in the land who are poor. That is why I am commanding you to share freely with the poor and with other Yasharalym in need.
“If a fellow Yasharalym sells himself or herself to be your servant and serves you for six years, in the seventh year you must set that servant free.
“When you release a male servant, do not send him away empty-handed.
Give him a generous farewell gift from your flock, your threshing floor, and your winepress. Share with him some of the bounty with which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has Baraked you.
Remember that you were once slaves in the land of Mitzraym and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH redeemed you! That is why I am giving you this command.
“But suppose your servant says, ‘I will not leave you,’ because he loves you and your family, and he had done well with you.
In that case, take an awl and push it through his earlobe into the door. After that, he will be your servant for life. And do the same for your female servants.

“You must not consider it a hardship when you release your servants. Remember that for six years they have given you services worth double the wages of hired workers, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will barak you in all you do.

“You must set aside for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH all the firstborn males from your flocks and herds. Do not use the firstborn of your herds to work your fields, and do not shear the firstborn of your flocks.
Instead, you and your family must eat these animals in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH each year at the place He chooses.
But if this firstborn animal has any defect, such as lameness or blindness, or if anything else is wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Instead, use it for food for your family in your hometown. Anyone, whether ceremonially clean or unclean, may eat it, just as anyone may eat a gazelle or deer.
But you must not consume the blood. You must pour it out on the ground like water.

In honor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, celebrate the Pasakh (Passover) each year in the early spring, in the month of Abib, for that was the month in which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH brought you out of Mitzraym by night.

Your Pasakh sacrifice may be from either the flock or the herd, and it must be sacrificed to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH at the designated place of worship, the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chooses for his Name to be honored.

Eat it with bread made without yeast. For seven days the bread you eat must be made without yeast, as when you escaped from Mitzraym in such a hurry. Eat this bread, the bread of suffering so that as long as you live you will remember the day you departed from Mitzraym.

Let no yeast be found in any house throughout your land for those seven days. And when you sacrifice the Pasakh lamb on the evening of the first day, do not let any of the meat remain until the next morning.
You may not sacrifice the Pasakh in just any of the towns that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will give you.

You must offer it only at the designated place of worship, the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH chooses for his name to be honored. Sacrifice it there in the evening as the sun goes down on the anniversary of your exodus from Mitzraym.
Roast the lamb and eat it in the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH chooses. Then you may go back to your tents the next morning.
For the next six days you may not eat any bread made with yeast. On the seventh day proclaim another Qadash day in honor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and no work may be done on that day.
“Count off seven weeks from when you first begin to cut the grain at the time of harvest.
Then celebrate the Festival of Harvest to honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. Bring him a voluntary offering in proportion to the Barakah you have received from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

This is a time to celebrate before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH at the designated place of worship he will choose for His Name to be honored. Celebrate with your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, the Lauym from your towns, and the foreigners, orphans, and widows who live among you.
Remember that you were once slaves in Mitzraym, so be careful to obey all these decrees.
“You must observe the Festival of Shelters for seven days at the end of the harvest season, after the grain has been threshed and the grapes have been pressed.
This festival will be a happy time of celebrating with your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Lauym, foreigners, orphans, and widows from your towns.

For seven days you must celebrate this festival to honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH at the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chooses, for it is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who barak you with bountiful harvests and gives you success in all your work. This festival will be a time of great joy for all.

“Each year every man in Yashar'AL must celebrate these three festivals: the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the Festival of Harvest, and the Festival of Shelters. On each of these occasions, all men must appear before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH at the place HE chooses, but they must not appear before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH without a gift for Him.
All must give as they are able, according to the Barakah given to them by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“Appoint judges and officials for yourselves from each of your tribes in all the towns 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you. They must judge the people fairly.
You must never twist justice or show partiality. Never accept a bribe, for bribes blind the eyes of the wise and corrupt the decisions of the righteous.
Let true justice prevail, so you may live and occupy the land that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you.
“You must never set up a wooden Asharah pole beside the altar you build for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
And never set up sacred pillars for worship, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH hates them.
Never sacrifice sick or defective cattle, sheep, or goats to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for He detests such gifts.
“When you begin living in the towns 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH have giving you, a man or woman among you might do evil in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and violate the covenant.
For instance, they might serve other nations pagan deities or worship the sun, the moon, or any of the stars the forces of Shamaym which I have not command you.
When you hear about it, investigate the matter thoroughly. If it is true that this detestable thing has been done in Yashar'AL,
then the man or woman who has committed such an evil act must be taken to the gates of the town and stoned to death.
But never put a person to death on the testimony of only one witness. There must always be two or three witnesses.
The witnesses must throw the first stones, and then all the people may join in. In this way, you will purge the evil from among you.

“Suppose a case arises in a local court that is too hard for you to decide for instance, whether someone is guilty of murder or only of manslaughter, or a difficult lawsuit, or a case involving different kinds of assault. Take such legal cases to the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will choose,
and present them to the Lauym and Kuhanym (priests) or the judge on duty at that time. They will hear the case and declare the verdict.
You must carry out the verdict they announce and the sentence they prescribe at the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chooses. You must do exactly what they say.
After they have interpreted the law and declared their verdict, the sentence they impose must be fully executed; do not modify it in any way.
Anyone arrogant enough to reject the verdict of the judge or of the Kuhan who represents 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH must die. In this way you will purge the evil from Yashar'AL.
Then everyone else will hear about it and be afraid to act so arrogantly.

“You are about to enter the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you. When you take it over and settle there, you may think, ‘We should select a king to rule over us like the other nations around us.’
If this happens, be sure to select as king the man 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH chooses. You must appoint a fellow Yasharalym; he shall not be a foreigner.
“The king must not build up a large stable of horses for himself or send his people to Mitzraym to buy horses, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has told you, ‘You must never return to Mitzraym.’
The king must not take many wives for himself, because they will turn his heart away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And he must not accumulate large amounts of wealth in silver and gold for himself.
“When he sits on the throne as king, he must copy for himself this body of instruction on a scroll in the presence of the Lauym and the Kuhanym (priests).
He must always keep that copy with him and read it daily as long as he lives. That way he will learn to fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH by obeying all the terms of these instructions and decrees.

This regular reading will prevent him from becoming proud and acting as if he is above his fellow citizens. It will also prevent him from turning away from these commands in the smallest way. And it will ensure that he and his descendants will reign for many generations in Yashar'AL.

“Remember that the Lauym and the Kuhanym, that is, the whole tribe of Lauy, will receive no allotment of land among the other tribes in Yashar'AL. Instead, the Kuhanhood and Lauym will eat from the special gifts given to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for that is their share.
They will have no land of their own among the Yasharalym. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Himself is their special possession, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH promised them.
“These are the parts the Kuhanym may claim as their share from the cattle, sheep, and goats that the people bring as offerings: the shoulder, the cheeks, and the stomach.
You must also give to the Kuhanym the first share of the grain, the new wine, the olive oil, and the wool at shearing time.
“𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH chose the tribe of Lauy out of all your tribes to minister in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever.
“Suppose a Lauym chooses to move from his town in Yashar'AL, wherever he is living, to the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chooses for worship.
He may minister there in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, just like all his fellow Lauym who are serving 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH there.
He may eat his share of the sacrifices and offerings, even if he also receives support from his family.
When you enter the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you, be very careful not to imitate the detestable customs of the nations living there.
For example, never sacrifice your son or daughter as a burnt offering. And do not let your people practice fortune-telling, or use sorcery, or interpret omens, or engage in witchcraft,
or cast spells, or function as mediums or psychics, or call forth the spirits of the dead.
Anyone who does these things is detestable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. It is because the other nations have done these detestable things that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will drive them out ahead of you.
But you must be blameless before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
The nations you are about to displace consult sorcerers and fortune tellers, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH forbids you to do such things.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will raise up for you a Nabym like me from among your fellow Yasharalym. You must listen to him.

For this is what you yourselves requested of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH when you were assembled at Mount Sinai. You said, ‘Do not let us hear the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH anymore or see this blazing fire, for we will die.’
“Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, ‘What they have said is right.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, will raise up a Nabym like you Musha from among their fellow Yasharalym. I will put my Dabar in his mouth, and he will tell the people everything I command him.
I will personally deal with anyone who will not listen to the messages the Nabym proclaims on my behalf.
But any Nabym who falsely claims to speak in my Name or who speaks in the name of other mighty ones, must die.’
“But you may wonder, ‘How will we know whether or not a Nabym is from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?’

If the Nabym speaks in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but his prediction does not happen or come true, you will know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not give that message. That Nabym has spoken without the authority of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and need not be feared.
“When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH destroys the nations whose land HE is giving you, you will take over their land and settle in their towns and homes.
Then you must set apart three cities of refuge in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will give you.

Survey the territory, and divide the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will give you, into three districts, with one of these cities in each district. Then anyone who has killed someone can flee to one of the cities of refuge for safety.
“If someone kills another person unintentionally, without previous hostility, the slayer may flee to any of these cities to live in safety.

For example, suppose someone goes into the forest with a neighbor to cut wood. And suppose one of them swings an ax to chop down a tree, and the ax head flies off the handle, killing the other person. In such cases, the slayer may flee to one of the cities of refuge to live in safety.

“If the distance to the nearest city of refuge is too far, an enraged avenger might be able to chase down and kill the person who caused the death. Then the slayer would die unfairly, since he had never shown hostility toward the person who died.
That is why I am commanding you to set aside three cities of refuge.
“And if 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH enlarges your territory, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore to your ancestors, and gives you all the land He promised them,

you must designate three additional cities of refuge. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give you this land if you are careful to obey all the commands I have given you, if you always love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and walk in HIS ways.

That way you will prevent the death of innocent people in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you as your special possession. You will not be held responsible for the death of innocent people.
“But suppose someone is hostile toward a neighbor and deliberately ambushes and murders him and then flees to one of the cities of refuge.
In that case, the elders of the murderer’s hometown must send agents to the city of refuge to bring him back and hand him over to the dead person’s avenger to be put to death.
Do not feel sorry for that murderer! Purge from Yashar'AL the guilt of murdering innocent people; then all will go well with you.

When you arrive in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will give you as your special possession, you must never steal anyone’s land by moving the boundary markers your ancestors set up to mark their property.
“You must not convict anyone of a crime on the testimony of only one witness. The facts of the case must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.
“If a malicious witness comes forward and accuses someone of a crime,
then both the accuser and accused must appear before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by coming to the Kuhanym and judges in office at that time.
The judges must investigate the case thoroughly. If the accuser has brought false charges against his fellow Yasharalym,
you must impose on the accuser the sentence he intended for the other person. In this way, you will purge such evil from among you.
Then the rest of the people will hear about it and be afraid to do such an evil thing.
You must show no pity for the guilty! Your rule should be life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

“When you go out to fight your enemies and you face horses and chariots and an army greater than your own, do not be afraid. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who brought you out of the land of Mitzraym, is with you!
When you prepare for battle, the high Kuhan must come forward to speak to the troops.
He will say to them, ‘Listen to me, all you men of Yashar'AL! Do not be afraid as you go out to fight your enemies today! Do not lose heart or panic or tremble before them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is going with you! HE will fight for you against your enemies, and HE will give you victory!’

“Then the officers of the army must address the troops and say, ‘Has anyone here just built a new house but not yet dedicated it? If so, you may go home! You might be killed in the battle, and someone else would dedicate your house.
Has anyone here just planted a vineyard but not yet eaten any of its fruit? If so, you may go home! You might die in battle, and someone else would eat the first fruit.
Has anyone here just become engaged to a woman but not yet married her? Well, you may go home and get married! You might die in the battle, and someone else would marry her.’
“Then the officers will also say, ‘Is anyone here afraid or worried? If you are, you may go home before you frighten anyone else.’
When the officers have finished speaking to their troops, they will appoint the unit commanders.
“As you approach a town to attack it, you must first offer its people terms for Shalum.
If they accept your terms and open the gates to you, then all the people inside will serve you in forced labor.
But if they refuse to make Shalum and prepare to fight, you must attack the town.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH hands the town over to you, use your swords to kill every man in the town.
But you may keep for yourselves all the women, children, livestock, and other plunder. You may enjoy the plunder from your enemies that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has given you.
“But these instructions apply only to distant towns, not to the towns of the nations in the land you will enter.
In those towns that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will give you as a special possession, destroy every living thing.
You must completely destroy the Hittites, Amurites, Canaanites, Parizzites, Hibites, and Yabusites, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has commanded you.
This will prevent the people of the land from teaching you to imitate their detestable customs in the worship of their idols, which would cause you to sin deeply against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

“When you are attacking a town and the war drags on, you must not cut down the trees with your axes. You may eat the fruit, but do not cut down the trees. Are the trees your enemies, that you should attack them?
You may only cut down trees that you know are not valuable for food. Use them to make the equipment you need to attack the enemy town until it falls.
“When you are in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has give you, someone may be found murdered in a field, and you do not know who committed the murder.
In such a case, your elders and judges must measure the distance from the site of the crime to the nearby towns.
When the nearest town has been determined, that town’s elders must select from the herd a heifer that has never been trained or yoked to a plow.
They must lead it down to a valley that has not been plowed or planted and that has a stream running through it. There in the valley they must break the heifer’s neck.

Then the Lauym and Kuhanym (priests) must step forward, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has chosen them to minister before him and to pronounce Barakah in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. They are to decide all legal and criminal cases.
“The elders of the town must wash their hands over the heifer whose neck was broken.
Then they must say, ‘Our hands did not shed this person’s blood, nor did we see it happen.

O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, forgive your people Yashar'AL whom you have redeemed. Do not charge your people with the guilt of murdering an innocent person.’ Then they will be absolved of the guilt of this person’s blood.
By following these instructions, you will do what is right in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s sight and will cleanse the guilt of murder from your community.
“Suppose you go out to war against your enemies and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH hands them over to you, and you take some of them as captives.
And suppose you see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you are attracted to her and want to marry her.
If this happens, you may take her to your home, where she must shave her head, cut her nails,

and change the clothes she was wearing when she was captured. She will stay in your home, but let her mourn for her father and mother for a full month. Then you may marry her, and you will be her husband and she will be your wife.
But if you marry her and she does not please you, you must let her go free. You may not sell her or treat her as a slave, for you have humiliated her.
“Suppose a man has two wives, but he loves one and not the other, and both have given him sons. And suppose the firstborn son is the son of the wife he does not love.
When the man divides his inheritance, he may not give the larger inheritance to his younger son, the son of the wife he loves, as if he were the firstborn son.

He must recognize the rights of his oldest son, the son of the wife he does not love, by giving him a double portion. He is the first son of his father’s virility, and the rights of the firstborn belong to him.
“Suppose a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who will not obey his father or mother, even though they discipline him.
In such a case, the father and mother must take the son to the elders as they hold court at the town gate.
The parents must say to the elders, ‘This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious and refuses to obey us, he is a glutton and a drunkard.’
Then all the men of his town must stone him to death, in this way, you will purge this evil from among you, and all Yashar'AL will hear about it and be afraid.
“If someone has committed a crime worthy of death and is executed and hung on a tree,

the body must not remain hanging from the tree overnight. You must bury the body that same day, for anyone who is hung is cursed in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. In this way, you will prevent the defilement of the land your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH had giving you as your special possession.
“If you see your neighbor’s ox or sheep or goat wandering away, don’t ignore your responsibility. Take it back to its owner.
If its owner does not live nearby or you do not know who the owner is, take it to your place and keep it until the owner comes looking for it. Then you must return it.
Do the same if you find your neighbor’s donkey, clothing, or anything else your neighbor loses, do not ignore your responsibility.
“If you see that your neighbor’s donkey or ox has collapsed on the road, do not look the other way. Go and help your neighbor get it back on its feet!
“A woman must not put on men’s clothing, and a man must not wear women’s clothing. Anyone who does this is detestable in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“If you happen to find a bird’s nest in a tree or on the ground, and there are young ones or eggs in it with the mother sitting in the nest, do not take the mother with the young.
You may take the young, but let the mother go, so that you may prosper and enjoy a long life.

“When you build a new house, you must build a railing (guardrail) around the edge of its flat rooftop. That way you will not be considered guilty of murder and you will prevent anyone from falling off and bringing guilt to both the house and its owner.
“You must not plant any other crop between the rows of your vineyard. If you do, you are forbidden to use either the grapes from the vineyard or the other crop.
“You must not plow with an ox and a donkey harnessed together.
“You must not wear clothing made of wool and linen woven together.
“You must put four tassels on the hem of the cloak with which you cover yourself, on the front, back, and sides.
“Suppose a man marries a woman, but after sleeping with her, he turns against her
and publicly accuses her of shameful conduct, saying, ‘When I married this woman, I discovered she was not a virgin.’
Then the woman’s father and mother must bring the proof of her virginity to the elders as they hold court at the town gate.
Her father must say to them, ‘I gave my daughter to this man to be his wife, and now he has turned against her.

He has accused her of shameful conduct, saying, “I discovered that your daughter was not a virgin.” But here is the proof of my daughter’s virginity.’ Then they must spread her bed sheet before the elders.
The elders must then take the man and punish him.

They must also fine him 100 pieces of silver, which he must pay to the woman’s father because he publicly accused a virgin of Yashar'AL of shameful conduct. The woman will then remain the man’s wife, and he may never divorce her.
“But suppose the man’s accusations are true, and he can show that she was not a virgin.

The woman must be taken to the door of her father’s home, and there the men of the town must stone her to death, for she has committed a shameful crime in Yashar'AL by being promiscuous while living in her parents’ home. In this way, you will purge this evil from among you.
“If a man is discovered committing adultery, both he and the woman must die. In this way, you will purge Yashar'AL of such evil.
“Suppose a man meets a young woman, a virgin who is engaged to be married, and he has sexual intercourse with her. If this happens within a town,

you must take both of them to the gates of that town and stone them to death. The woman is guilty because she did not scream for help. The man must die because he violated another man’s wife. In this way, you will purge this evil from among you.
“But if the man meets the engaged woman out in the country, and he rapes her, then only the man must die.
Do nothing to the young woman; she has committed no crime worthy of death. She is as innocent as a murder victim.
Since the man raped her out in the country, it must be assumed that she screamed, but there was no one to rescue her.
“Suppose a man has intercourse with a young woman who is a virgin but is not engaged to be married. If they are discovered,
he must pay her father fifty pieces of silver. Then he must marry the young woman because he violated her, and he may never divorce her as long as he lives.
“A man must not marry his father’s former wife, for this would violate his father.
“If a man’s testicles are crushed or his penis is cut off, he should not be allowed in the assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“If a person is illegitimate by birth, neither he nor his descendants for ten generations should be allowed to the assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“No Ammunite or Muabite or any of their descendants for ten generations should be allowed to the assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
These nations did not welcome you with food and water when you came out of Mitzraym. Instead, they hired Balaam son of Baur from Pathur in distant Aram-naharaim to curse you.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH refused to listen to Balaam. He turned the intended curse into a Barakah because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH loves you.
As long as you live, you must never promote the welfare and prosperity of the Ammunites or Muabites.
“Do not detest the Adumites or the Mitzraym, because the Adumites are your relatives and you lived as foreigners among the Mitzraym.
The third generation of Adumites and Mitzraym may enter the assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“When you go to war against your enemies, be sure to stay away from anything that is impure.
“Any man who becomes ceremonially defiled because of a nocturnal emission must leave the camp and stay away all day.
Toward evening he must bathe himself, and at sunset he may return to the camp.
“You must have a designated area outside the camp where you can go to relieve yourself.
Each of you must have a spade as part of your equipment. Whenever you relieve yourself, dig a hole with the spade and cover the excrement.

The camp must be Qadash, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH moves around in your camp to protect you and to defeat your enemies. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must not see any shameful thing among you, or He will turn away from you.
“If slaves should escape from their masters and take refuge with you, You must not hand them over to their masters.
Let them live among you in any town they choose, and do not oppress them.
“No Yasharalym, whether man or woman, may become a temple prostitute.

When you are bringing an offering to fulfill a vow, you must not bring to the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH any offering from the earnings of a prostitute, whether a man or a woman, for both are detestable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“Do not charge interest on the loans you make to a fellow Yasharalym, whether you loan money, or food, or anything else.

You may charge interest to foreigners, but you may not charge interest to Yasharalym, so that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH may Barak you in everything you do in the land you are about to enter and occupy.

“When you make a vow to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, be prompt in fulfilling whatever you promised Him. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH demands that you promptly fulfill all your vows, or you will be guilty of sin.
However, it is not a sin to refrain from making a vow.
But once you have voluntarily made a vow, be careful to fulfill your promise to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“When you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes, but you must not carry any away in a basket.
And when you enter your neighbor’s field of grain, you may pluck the heads of grain with your hand, but you must not harvest it with a sickle.
“Suppose a man marries a woman but she does not please him. Having discovered something wrong with her, he writes a document of divorce, hands it to her, and sends her away from his house.
When she leaves his house, she is free to marry another man.
But if the second husband also turns against her, writes a document of divorce, hands it to her, and sends her away, or if he dies,

the first husband may not marry her again, for she has been defiled. That would be detestable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH You must not bring guilt upon the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH had give you as a special possession.
“A newly married man must not be drafted into the army or be given any other official responsibilities, he must be free to spend one year at home, bringing happiness to the wife he has married.
“It is wrong to take a set of millstones, or even just the upper millstone, as security for a loan, for the owner uses it to make a living.
“If anyone kidnaps a fellow Yasharalym and treats him as a slave or sells him, the kidnapper must die. In this way, you will purge the evil from among you.
“In all cases involving serious skin diseases, be careful to follow the instructions of the Lauym and Kuhanym (priests); obey all the commands I have given them.
Remember what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH did to Miriam as you were coming from Mitzraym.
“If you lend anything to your neighbor, do not enter his house to pick up the item he is giving as security.
You must wait outside while he goes in and brings it out to you.
If your neighbor is poor and gives you his cloak as security for a loan, do not keep the cloak overnight.
Return the cloak to its owner by sunset so he can stay warm through the night and barak you, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will count you as righteous.
“Never take advantage of poor and destitute laborers, whether they are fellow Yasharalym or foreigners living in your towns.

You must pay them their wages each day before sunset because they are poor and are counting on it. If you do not, they might cry out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH against you, and it would be counted against you as sin.
“Parents must not be put to death for the sins of their children, nor children for the sins of their parents. Those deserving to die must be put to death for their own crimes.
“True justice must be given to foreigners living among you and to orphans, and you must never accept a widow’s garment as security for her debt.
Always remember that you were slaves in Mitzraym and that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH redeemed you from your slavery. That is why I have given you this command.

“When you are harvesting your crops and forget to bring in a bundle of grain from your field, do not go back to get it. Leave it for the foreigners, orphans, and widows. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will barak you in all you do.
When you beat the olives from your olive trees, don’t go over the boughs twice. Leave the remaining olives for the foreigners, orphans, and widows.
When you gather the grapes in your vineyard, do not glean the vines after they are picked. Leave the remaining grapes for the foreigners, orphans, and widows.
Remember that you were slaves in the land of Mitzraym. That is why I am giving you this command.
“Suppose two people take a dispute to court, and the judges declare that one is right and the other is wrong.
If the person in the wrong is sentenced to be flogged, the judge must command him to lie down and be beaten in his presence with the number of lashes appropriate to the crime.
But never give more than forty lashes; more than forty lashes would publicly humiliate your neighbor.
“You must not muzzle an ox to keep it from eating as it treads out the grain.

“If two brothers are living together on the same property and one of them dies without a son, his widow may not be married to anyone from outside the family. Instead, her husband’s brother should marry her and have intercourse with her to fulfill the duties of a brother-in-law.
The first son she bears to him will be considered the son of the dead brother, so that his name will not be forgotten in Yashar'AL.

“But if the man refuses to marry his brother’s widow, she must go to the town gate and say to the elders assembled there, ‘My husband’s brother refuses to preserve his brother’s name in Yashar'AL, he refuses to fulfill the duties of a brother-in-law by marrying me.’
The elders of the town will then summon him and talk with him. If he still refuses and says, ‘I don’t want to marry her,’

the widow must walk over to him in the presence of the elders, pull his sandal from his foot, and spit in his face. Then she must declare, ‘This is what happens to a man who refuses to provide his brother with children.’
Ever afterward in Yashar'AL his family will be referred to as ‘the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off’!
“If two Yasharalym men get into a fight and the wife of one tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the testicles of the other man,
you must cut off her hand. Show her no pity.
“You must use accurate scales when you weigh out merchandise,
and you must use full and honest measures.
Yes, always use honest weights and measures, so that you may enjoy a long life in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is giving you.
All who cheat with dishonest weights and measures are detestable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“Never forget what the Amalakites did to you as you came from Mitzraym.
They attacked you when you were exhausted and weary, and they struck down those who were straggling behind. They had no fear of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

Therefore, when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has given you rest from all your enemies in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had give you as a special possession, you must destroy the Amalekites and erase their memory from under Shamaym. Never forget this!
“When you enter the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will give you as a special possession and you have conquered it and settled there,
put some of the first produce from each crop you harvest into a basket and bring it to the designated place of worship, the place 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH chooses for HIS Name to be honored.
Go to the Kuhan in charge at that time and say to him, ‘With this gift I acknowledge to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH that I have entered the land he swore to our ancestors He would give us.
The Kuhan will then take the basket from your hand and set it before the altar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

“You must then say in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, ‘My ancestor Ya'aqub was a wandering Aramaan who went to live as a foreigner in Mitzraym. His family arrived few in number, but in Mitzraym they became a large and mighty nation.
When the Mitzraym oppressed and humiliated us by making us their slaves,
we cried out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of our ancestors, heard our cries and saw our hardship, toil, and oppression.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought us out of Mitzraym with a strong hand and powerful arm, with overwhelming terror, and with miraculous signs and wonders.
He brought us to this place and gave us this land flowing with milk and honey!

And now, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I have brought you the first portion of the harvest you have given me from the ground.’ Then place the produce before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and bow to the ground in worship before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Afterward you may go and celebrate because of all the good things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has given to you and your household. Remember to include the Lauym and the foreigners living among you in the celebration.

“Every third year you must offer a special tithe of your crops. In this year of the special tithe you must give your tithes to the Lauym, foreigners, orphans, and widows, so that they will have enough to eat in your towns.

Then you must declare in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, ‘I have taken the sacred gift from my house and have given it to the Lauym, foreigners, orphans, and widows, just as you commanded me. I have not violated or forgotten any of your commands.

I have not eaten any of it while in mourning; I have not handled it while I was ceremonially unclean; and I have not offered any of it to the dead, I have obeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and have done everything you commanded me.
Now look down from your Qadash dwelling place in Shamaym and barak your people Yashar'AL and the land you swore to our ancestors to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.’
“Today 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has commanded you to obey all these decrees and regulations. So be careful to obey them wholeheartedly.

You have declared today that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. And you have promised to walk in HIS ways, and to obey HIS decrees, commandments, and regulations, and to do everything 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH tells you.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has declared today that you are HIS people, HIS own special treasure, just as HE promised, and that you must obey all his commands.

And if you do, He will set you high above all the other nations He has made. Then you will receive Yadah, honor, and renown. You will be a nation that is Qadash to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, just as He promised.”
Then Musha and the leaders of Yashar'AL gave this charge to the people: “Obey all these commands that I am giving you today.
When you cross the Yurdan River and enter the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will give you, set up some large stones and coat them with plaster.

Write this whole body of instruction on them when you cross the river to enter the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of your ancestors, promised you.
When you cross the Yurdan, set up these stones at Mount Abal and coat them with plaster, as I am commanding you today.
“Then build an altar there to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, using natural, uncut stones. You must not shape the stones with an iron tool.
Build the altar of uncut stones, and use it to offer burnt offerings to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Also sacrifice Shalum offerings on it, and celebrate by feasting there before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
You must clearly write all these instructions on the stones coated with plaster.”
Then Musha and the Lauym and Kuhanym addressed all Yashar'AL as follows: “O Yashar'AL, be quiet and listen! Today you have become the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
So you must obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH by keeping all these commands and decrees that I am giving you today.”
That same day Musha also gave this charge to the people:
“When you cross the Yurdan River, the tribes of Simaun, Lauy, Yahudah, Issachar, Ya'asaf, and Banyamin must stand on Mount Garizim to proclaim a Barakah over the people.
And the tribes of Rauban, Gad, Ashar, Zabulun, Dan, and Naphtali must stand on Mount Abal to proclaim a curse.
“Then the Lauym will shout to all the people of Yashar'AL:
‘Cursed is anyone who carves or casts an idol and secretly sets it up. These idols, the work of craftsmen, are detestable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And all the people will reply, ‘So be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who dishonors father or mother.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who steals property from a neighbor by moving a boundary marker.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who leads a blind person astray on the road.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who denies justice to foreigners, orphans, or widows.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with one of his father’s wives, for he has violated his father.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with an animal.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with his sister, whether she is the daughter of his father or his mother.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who has sexual intercourse with his mother-in-law.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who attacks a neighbor in secret. And all the people will reply, so be it.
‘Cursed is anyone who accepts payment to kill an innocent person.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’
‘Cursed is anyone who does not affirm and obey the terms of these instructions.’ And all the people will reply, ‘so be it.’

“If you fully obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and carefully keep all the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that I am giving you today, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will set you high above all the nations of the world.
You will experience all these Barakah if you obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH:
Your towns and your fields will be Baraked.
Your children and your crops will be Baraked, offspring of your herds and flocks will be Baraked.
Your fruit baskets and breadboards will be Baraked.
Wherever you go and whatever you do, you will be Baraked.
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will conquer your enemies when they attack you. They will attack you from one direction, but they will scatter from you in seven ways!
“And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will guarantee a Barakah on everything you do and will fill your storehouses with grain. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will barak you in the land He will give you.
“If you obey the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and walk in His ways, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will establish you as HIS Qadash people as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore He would do.
Then all the nations of the world will see that you are a people claimed by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and they will stand in awe of you.
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give you prosperity in the land he swore to your ancestors to give you, for you will be Barakah with many children, numerous livestock, and abundant crops.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will send rain at the proper time from HIS rich treasury in the Shamaym and HE will barak all the work you do. You will lend to many nations, but you will never need to borrow from them.

If you listen to these commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH that I am giving you today, and if you carefully obey them, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make you the head and not the tail, and you will always be on top and never at the bottom.
You must not turn away from any of the commandments I am giving you today, nor follow after idols and worship them.
“But if you refuse to listen to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and do not obey all the commandments and decrees I am giving you today, all these curses will come and overwhelm you:
Your towns and your fields will be cursed.
Your fruit baskets and breadboards will be cursed.
Your children and your crops will be cursed. The offspring of your herds and flocks will be cursed.
Wherever you go and whatever you do, you will be cursed.
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself will send on you curses, confusion, and frustration in everything you do, until at last you are completely destroyed for doing evil and abandoning your ALUAH.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will afflict you with diseases until none of you are left in the land you are about to enter and occupy.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will strike you with wasting diseases, fever, and inflammation, with scorching heat and drought, and with blight and mildew. These disasters will pursue you until you die.
The skies above will be as unyielding as bronze, and the Arath beneath will be as hard as iron.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will change the rain that falls on your land into powder, and dust will pour down from the sky until you are destroyed.

“And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will cause you to be defeated by your enemies. You will attack your enemies from one direction, but you will scatter from them in seven ways! You will be an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the Arath.
Your corpses will be food for all the scavenging birds and wild animals, and no one will be there to chase them away.
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will afflict you with the boils of Mitzraym and with tumors, scurvy, and the itch, from which you cannot be cured.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will strike you with madness, blindness, and panic.
You will grope around in broad daylight like a blind person groping in the darkness, but you will not find your way. You will be oppressed and robbed continually, and no one will come to save you.
“You will be engaged to a woman, but another man will sleep with her. You will build a house, but someone else will live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will never enjoy its fruit.

Your ox will be butchered before your eyes, but you will not eat a single bite of the meat. Your donkey will be taken from you, never to be returned. Your sheep and goats will be given to your enemies, and no one will be there to help you.
You will watch as your sons and daughters are taken away as slaves. Your heart will break for them, but you will not be able to help them.
A foreign nation you have never heard about will eat the crops you worked so hard to grow. You will suffer under constant oppression and harsh treatment.
You will go mad because of all the tragedy you see around you.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will cover your knees and legs with incurable boils. In fact, you will be covered from head to foot.
“Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will exile you and your king to a nation unknown to you and your ancestors. There in exile you will worship idols of wood and stone!
You will become an object of horror, ridicule, and mockery among all the nations to which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sends you.
“You will plant much but harvest little, for locusts will eat your crops.
You will plant vineyards and care for them, but you will not drink the wine or eat the grapes, for worms will destroy the vines.
You will grow olive trees throughout your land, but you will never use the olive oil, for the fruit will drop before it ripens.
You will have sons and daughters, but you will lose them, for they will be led away into captivity.
Swarms of insects will destroy your trees and crops.
“The foreigners living among you will become stronger and stronger, while you will become weaker and weaker.
They will lend money to you, but you will not lend to them. They will be the head, and you will be the tail!

“If you refuse to listen to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and you don't obey the commandments and decrees 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given you, all these curses will pursue and overtake you until you are destroyed.
These horrors will serve as a sign and warning among you and your descendants forever.
If you do not serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH with joy and enthusiasm for the abundant benefits you have received,

you will serve your enemies whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will send against you. You will be left hungry, thirsty, naked, and lacking in everything. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will put an iron yoke on your neck, oppressing you harshly until He has destroyed you.
“And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bring a distant nation against you from the end of the Arath, and it will swoop down on you like a vulture. It is a nation whose language you do not understand,
A fierce and heartless nation that shows no respect for the old and no pity for the young.
Its armies will devour your livestock and crops, and you will be destroyed. They will leave you no grain, new wine, olive oil, calves, or lambs, and you will starve to death.

They will attack your cities until all the fortified walls in your land, the walls you trusted to protect you are knocked down. They will attack all the towns in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has given you.
“The siege and terrible distress of the enemy’s attack will be so severe that you will eat the flesh of your own sons and daughters, whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has given you.
The most tenderhearted man among you will have no compassion for his own brother, his beloved wife, and his surviving children.

He will refuse to share with them the flesh he is devouring, the flesh of one of his own children, because he has nothing else to eat during the siege and terrible distress that your enemy will inflict on all your towns.
The most tender and delicate woman among you, so delicate she would not so much as touch the ground with her foot, she will be selfish toward the husband she loves and toward her own son or daughter.

She will hide from them the afterbirth and the new baby she has borne, so that she herself can secretly eat them. She will have nothing else to eat during the siege and terrible distress that your enemy will inflict on all your towns.
“If you refuse to obey all the Dabar of instruction that are written in this book, and if you do not fear the Esteemed and awesome Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH,
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will overwhelm you and your children with indescribable plagues. These plagues will be intense and without relief, making you miserable and unbearably sick.
He will afflict you with all the diseases of Mitzraym that you feared so much, and you will have no relief.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will afflict you with every sickness and plague there is, even those not mentioned in this Book of Instruction, until you are destroyed.
Though you become as numerous as the stars in the sky, few of you will be left because you would not listen to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

“Just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has found great pleasure in causing you to prosper and multiply you, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will find pleasure in destroying you. You will be torn from the land you are about to enter and occupy.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will scatter you among all the nations from one end of the Arath to the other. There you will worship foreign idols that neither you nor your ancestors have known, idols made of wood and stone!
There among those nations you will find no Shalum or place to rest. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will cause your heart to tremble, your eyesight to fail, and your soul to despair.
Your life will constantly hang in the balance. You will live night and day in fear, unsure if you will survive.
In the morning you will say, ‘If only it were night!’ And in the evening you will say, ‘If only it were morning!’ For you will be terrified by the awful horrors you see around you.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will send you back to Mitzraym in ships, to a destination I promised you would never see again. There you will offer to sell yourselves to your enemies as slaves, but no one will buy you.”
These are the terms of the covenant 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Musha to make with the Yasharalym while they were in the land of Muab, in addition to the covenant he had made with them at Mount Sinai.
Musha summoned all the Yasharalym and said to them, “You have seen with your own eyes everything 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did in the land of Mitzraym to Phar'uh and to all his servants and to his whole country
All the great tests of strength, the miraculous signs, and the amazing wonders.
But to this day 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not given you minds that understand, nor eyes that see, nor ears that hear!
For forty years I led you through the wilderness, yet your clothes and sandals did not wear out.
You ate no bread and drank no wine or other alcoholic drink, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH provided for you so you would know that He is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“When we came here, King Sihun of Hashbun and King Ug of Bashan came out to fight against us, but we defeated them.
We took their land and gave it to the tribes of Rauban and Gad and to the half-tribe of Manassah as their grant of land.
“Therefore, obey the terms of this covenant so that you will prosper in everything you do.
All of you tribal leaders, elders, officers, all the men of Yashar'AL are standing today in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Your little ones and your wives are with you, as well as the foreigners living among you who chop your wood and carry your water.
You are standing here today to enter into the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is making this covenant, including the curses.

By entering into the covenant today, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will establish you as HIS people and confirm that, HE is your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, just as He promised you and as He swore to your ancestors Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub.
“But you are not the only ones with whom I am making this covenant with its curses.
I am making this covenant both with you who stand here today in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and also with the future generations who are not standing here today.
“You remember how we lived in the land of Mitzraym and how we traveled through the lands of enemy nations as we left.
You have seen their detestable practices and their idols made of wood, stone, silver, and gold.

I am making this covenant with you so that no one among you no man, woman, clan, or tribe will turn away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH to worship these idols of other nations, and so that no root among you bears bitter and poisonous fruit.
“Those who hear the warnings of this curse should not congratulate themselves, thinking, ‘I am safe, even though I am following the desires of my own stubborn heart.’ This would lead to utter ruin!

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will never pardon such people. Instead His anger and jealousy will burn against them. All the curses written in this book will come down on them, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will erase their names from under Shamaym.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will separate them from all the tribes of Yashar'AL, to pour out on them all the curses of the covenant recorded in this Book of Instruction.
“Then the generations to come, both your own descendants and the foreigners who come from distant lands, will see the devastation of the land and the diseases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH inflicts on it.

They will exclaim, ‘The whole land is devastated by sulfur and salt. It is a wasteland with nothing planted and nothing growing, not even a blade of grass. It is like the cities of Sudum and Gumurrah, Admah and Zabuiim, which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroyed in HIS intense anger.’
“And all the surrounding nations will ask, ‘Why has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH done this to this land? Why was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH so angry?’

“And the answer will be, ‘This happened because the people of the land abandoned the covenant that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of their ancestors, made with them when he brought them out of the land of Mitzraym.
Instead, they turned away to serve and worship idols they had not known before, idols that were not from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
That is why the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has burned against this land, bringing down on it every curse recorded in this book.
In great anger and fury 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH uprooted His people from their land and banished them to another land, where they still live today!’

“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has secrets known to no one. We are not accountable for them, but we and our children are accountable forever for all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has revealed to us, so that we may obey all the terms of these instructions.

“In the future, when you experience all these Barakah and curses I have listed for you, and when you are living among the nations to which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has exiled you, take to heart all these instructions.
If at that time you and your children return to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and if you obey with all your heart and all your soul all the commands I have given you today,
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will restore your fortunes. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will have mercy on you and gather you back from all the nations where He has scattered you.
Even though you are banished to the ends of the Arath, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will gather you from there and bring you back again.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will return you to the land that belonged to your ancestors, and you will possess that land again. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make you even more prosperous and numerous than your ancestors!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will change your heart and the hearts of all your descendants, so that you will love Him with all your heart and soul and you may live!
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will inflict all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate and persecute you.
Then you will again obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and keep all HIS commandments that I am giving you today.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will then make you successful in everything you do. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give you many children and numerous livestock, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will cause your fields to produce abundant harvests, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will again delight in being good to you as he was to your ancestors.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will delight in you if you obey his voice and keep the commandments and decrees written in this Book of Instruction, and if you turn to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH with all your heart and soul.
“This command I am giving you today is not too difficult for you, and it is not beyond your reach.
It is not kept in Shamaym, so distant that you must ask, ‘Who will go up to Shamaym and bring it down so we can hear it and obey?
It is not kept beyond the sea, so far away that you must ask, ‘Who will cross the sea to bring it to us so we can hear it and obey?’
No, the Dabar is very closely to you; it is on your lips, and in your hearts, so you can obey it.
“Now listen! Today I am giving you a choice between life and death, between prosperity and disaster.

For I command you this day to love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and to keep HIS commandments, decrees, and regulations by walking in the ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, if you do this, you will live and multiply, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will barak you and the land you are about to enter and occupy.
“But if your heart turns away and you refuse to listen, and if you are drawn away to serve and worship other nations idols,
then I warn you now that you will certainly be destroyed. You will not live a long, good life in the land you are crossing the Yurdan to occupy.

“Today I have given you the choice between life and death, between Barakah and curses. Now I call on Shamaym and Arath to witness the choice you make. I hope, that you would choose life, so that you and your descendants might live!

You can make this choice by loving 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, obeying Him, and committing yourself firmly to Him. This is the key to your life. And if you love and obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you will live long in the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore to give your ancestors Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub.”
Then Musha went and spoke these words to all Yashar'AL.
And Musha said to them: “I am one hundred and twenty years old today. I can no longer go out and come in. Also 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has said to me, ‘You shall not cross over this Yurdan.’

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will lead you to the promise land, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall take over their land, and Yahusha Ba'Nun will lead you across the Yurdan river as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has said.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will do to them as He did to Sihun and Ug, the kings of the Amurites and their land, when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroyed them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give them over to you, that you may do to them according to every commandment which I have commanded you.
Be strong and of good courage, do not fear nor be afraid of them; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is the One who goes with you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not leave you nor forsake you.”

Then Musha called Yahusha Ba'Nun and said to him in the sight of all Yashar'AL, “Be strong and of good courage, for you must go with this people to the land which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sworn to their fathers to give them, you will cause them to inherit it.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the One who goes before you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be with you, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not leave you nor forsake you; do not fear nor be dismayed.”
So Musha wrote this law and delivered it to the Kuhanym, the sons of Lauy, who bore the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and to all the elders of Yashar'AL.
And Musha commanded them, saying: “At the end of every seven years, at the appointed time in the year of release, at the Feast of Tabernacles,
when all Yashar'AL comes to appear before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH in the place which He chooses, you shall read this law before all Yashar'AL in their hearing.

Gather the people together, men and women and little ones, and the stranger who is within your gates, that they may hear and that they may learn to fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and carefully observe all the words of this law,
and that their children, who have not known it, may hear and learn to fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH as long as you live in the land which you cross the Yurdan to possess.”

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, “Behold, the days approach when you must die; call Yahusha Ba'Nun, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of meeting, that I may inaugurate him.” So Musha and Yahusha Ba'Nun went and presented themselves in the tabernacle of meeting.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH appeared at the tabernacle in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood above the door of the tabernacle.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha: Behold, you will rest with your fathers; and this people will rise and play the harlot with the idols of the foreigners of the land, where they go to be among them, and they will forsake ME and break My covenant which I have made with them.

Then My anger shall be aroused against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide My face from them, and they shall be devoured. And many evils and troubles shall befall them, so that they will say in that day, ‘Have not these evils come upon us because our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is not among us?’
And I will surely hide My face in that day because of all the evil which they have done, for they have turned to other nations idols.
“Now therefore, write down this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Yashar'AL; put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for Me against the children of Yashar'AL.

When I have brought them to the land flowing with milk and honey, of which I swore to their fathers, and they have eaten and filled themselves and grown fat, then they will turn to idols and serve them; and they will provoke ME and break My covenant.

Then it shall be, when many evils and troubles have come upon them, that this song will testify against them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten in the mouths of their descendants, for I know the inclination of their behavior today, even before I have brought them to the land of which I swore to give them.”
Therefore Musha wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Yashar'AL.

Then he inaugurated Yahusha Ba'Nun (the son of Nun), and said, “Be strong and of good courage; for you shall bring the children of Yashar'AL into the land of which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore to them, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be with you.”
So it was, when Musha had completed writing the words of this law in a book, when they were finished,
that Musha commanded the Lauym, who bore the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, saying:
“Take this Book of the Law, and put it beside the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, that it may be there as a witness against you;
for I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. If today, while I am yet alive with you, You have been rebellious against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, then how much more after my death?
Gather to me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their hearing and call Shamaym and Arath to witness against them.

For I know that after my death you will become utterly corrupt, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you. And evil will befall you in the latter days, because you will do evil in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to provoke Him to anger through the work of your hands.”
Then Musha spoke in the hearing of all the assembly of Yashar'AL the words of this song until they were ended:
“Give ear, O Shamaym, and I will speak; And hear, O Arath, the words of my mouth.
Let my teaching drop as the rain, My speech distill as the dew, as raindrops on the tender herb, and as showers on the grass.
For I proclaim the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: I ascribe greatness to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the Rock, HIS work is perfect; For all HIS ways are justice, An 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of truth and without injustice; Righteous and upright is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“They have corrupted themselves; They are not the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Because of their blemish: A perverse and crooked generation.
Is this the way you repay 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, O foolish and unwise people? Is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH not your ABBA, who bought you? Has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH not made you and established you?
“Remember the days of old, Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; Your elders, and they will tell you:
When the Most High divided their inheritance to the nations, When HE separated the sons of Adam, He set the boundaries of the peoples According to the number of the children of Yashar'AL.
For people of Yashar'AL belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; Ya'aqub is the place of His inheritance.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH found Yashar'AL in a desert land and in the wasteland, a howling wilderness; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH encircled Yashar'AL, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH instructed him and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH kept Yashar'AL as the apple of HIS eye.
As an eagle stirs up its nest, Hovers over its young, Spreading out its wings, taking them up, Carrying them on its wings,
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH alone led Yashar'AL, And there was no foreign idols with him.
“Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made Yashar'AL ride in the heights of the Arath, that he might eat the produce of the fields; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made him draw honey from the rock, and oil from the flinty rock;
Curds from the cattle, and milk of the flock, With fat of lambs; and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, With the choicest wheat; And you drank wine, the blood of the grapes.
“But Yashar'AL grew fat and kicked; You grew fat, you grew thick, You are obese! Then Yashar'AL forsook 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who made him, and dishonored the Rock of his salvation.
They provoked 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to jealousy with foreign idols; With abominations they provoked 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to anger.
They sacrificed to demons, To idols they did not know, To new deities, new arrivals, that your fathers did not fear.
You neglected the Rock who begot you, you are unmindful, and have forgotten the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who fathered you.
And when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saw it, He drew back from them, Because of the provocation of His sons and His daughters.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said: ‘I will hide My face from them, I will see what their end will be, For they are a perverse generation, Children in whom is no Amunah (faith).

They have provoked 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to jealousy by what He hates; They have moved 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to anger by their foolish idols. But I will provoke them to jealousy by those who are not a nation; I will move them to anger by a foolish nation.
For a fire is kindled in My anger, and shall burn to the lowest hell; It shall consume the Arath with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
‘I will heap disasters on them; I will spend My arrows on them.
They shall be wasted with hunger, Devoured by pestilence and bitter destruction; I will also send against them the teeth of beasts, With the poison of serpents of the dust.
The sword shall destroy outside; There shall be terror within, for the young man and virgin, The nursing child with the man of gray hairs.
I would have said, “I will dash them in pieces, I will make the memory of them to cease from among men,”
Had I not feared the wrath of the enemy, Lest their adversaries should misunderstand, Lest they should say, Our hand is high; And it is not 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who has done all this.
“For they are a nation void of counsel, Nor is there any understanding in them.
Oh, that they were wise, that they understood this, That they would consider their latter end!
How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, Unless their Rock had sold them, and their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH had surrendered them?
For their rock is not like our Rock, Even our enemies themselves being judges.
For their vine is of the vine of Sudum And of the fields of Gumurrah; Their grapes are grapes of gall, Their clusters are bitter.
Their wine is the poison of serpents, and the cruel venom of cobras.
‘Is this not laid up in store with Me, Sealed up among My treasures?
Vengeance is Mine, and recompense; Their foot shall slip in due time; For the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things to come hasten upon them.’
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge His people And have compassion on His servants, When He sees that their power is gone, and there is no one remaining, bond or free.
He will say: ‘Where are their idols, The rock in which they sought refuge?
Who ate the fat of their sacrifices, And drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise and help you, and be your refuge.
I, AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and there is no 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH besides Me; I put to death and I give life; I wound and I heal; Nor is there anyone who can deliver from My hand.
For I raise My hand to Shamaym, And say, “As I live forever,
If I whet My glittering sword, and My hand takes hold on judgment, I will render vengeance to My enemies, and repay those who hate Me.
I will make My arrows drunk with blood, and My sword shall devour flesh, With the blood of the slain and the captives, From the heads of the leaders of the enemy.” ’
“Rejoice, O you nations, with His people; For He will avenge the blood of His servants, and render vengeance to His adversaries; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will provide atonement for His land and His people.”
So Musha came with Yahusha Ba'Nun (the son of Nun) and spoke all the words of this song in the hearing of the people.
Musha finished speaking all these words to all Yashar'AL,
and Musha said to them: “Set your hearts on all the words which I testify among you today, which you shall command your children to be careful to observe all the words of this law.
For it is not a futile thing for you, because it is your life, and by this word you shall prolong your days in the land which you cross over the Yurdan to possess.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha that very same day, saying:
“Go up this mountain of the Abarim, Mount Nabu, which is in the land of Muab, across from Yarichu; view the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Yashar'AL as a possession;
and die on the mountain which you ascend, and be gathered to your people, just as Aarun your brother died on Mount Hur and was gathered to his people;
Because you trespassed against Me among the children of Yashar'AL at the waters of Maribah Kadash, in the Wilderness of Zin, because you did not Qadash ME in the midst of the children of Yashar'AL.
Yet you shall see the land before you, though you shall not enter the land which I am giving to the children of Yashar'AL.
This is the Barakah that Musha, the Servant of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, gave to the people of Yashar'AL before his death:
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came from Mount Sinai and dawned upon us from Mount Seir; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shone forth from Mount Paran and came from Maribah-kadash with flaming fire at His right hand.
Indeed, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves HIS people; all HIS Qadash ones are in HIS hands. They follow in HIS steps and accept HIS teaching.
Musha gave us 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s instruction, the special possession of the people of Yashar'AL.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH became ruler in Yashar'AL when the leaders of the people assembled, when the tribes of Yashar'AL gathered as one.”
Musha said this about the tribe of Rauban: “Let the tribe of Rauban live and not die out, though they are few in number.”
Musha said this about the tribe of Yahudah: “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, hear the cry of Yahudah and bring them together as a people. Give them strength to defend their cause; help them against their enemies!”

Musha said this about the tribe of Lauy: “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you have given your Thummim and Urim the sacred lots to your faithful servants the Lauym. You put them to the test at Massah and struggled with them at the waters of Maribah.
The Lauym obeyed your Dabar and guarded your covenant. They were more loyal to you than to their own parents. They ignored their relatives and did not acknowledge their own children.
They teach your regulations to Ya'aqub; they give your instructions to Yashar'AL. They present incense before you and offer whole burnt offerings on the altar.
Barak the ministry of the Lauym, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and accept all the work of their hands. Hit their enemies where it hurts the most; strike down their foes so they never rise again.”

Musha said this about the tribe of Banyamin: “The people of Banyamin are loved by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and live in safety beside Him. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH surrounds them continuously and preserves them from every harm.”
Musha said this about the tribes of Ya'asaf: “May their land be Baraked by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with the precious gift of dew from the Shamaym and water from beneath the Arath;
with the rich fruit that grows in the sun, and the rich harvest produced each month;
with the finest crops of the ancient mountains, and the abundance from the everlasting hills;

with the best gifts of the Arath and its bounty, and the favor of the one who appeared in the burning bush. May these Barakah rest on Ya'asaf’s head, crowning the brow of the prince among his brothers.

Ya'asaf has the majesty of a young bull; he has the horns of a wild ox, he will gore distant nations, even to the ends of the Arath. This is my Barakah for the multitudes of Alphraim and the thousands of Manassah.”
Musha said this about the tribes of Zabulun and Issachar: “May the people of Zabulun prosper in their travels. May the people of Issachar prosper at home in their tents.
They summon the people to the mountain to offer proper sacrifices there. They benefit from the riches of the sea and the hidden treasures in the sand.”
Musha said this about the tribe of Gad: “baraked is the one who enlarges Gad’s territory! Gad is poised there like a lion to tear off an arm or a head.

The people of Gad took the best land for themselves; a leader’s share was assigned to them. When the leaders of the people were assembled, they carried out 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s justice and obeyed His regulations for Yashar'AL.”
Musha said this about the tribe of Dan: “Dan is a lion’s cub, leaping out from Bashan.”
Musha said this about the tribe of Naphtali: “O Naphtali, you are rich in favor and full of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Barakah; may you possess the west and the south.”
Musha said this about the tribe of Ashar: “May Ashar be Baraked above other sons; may he be esteemed by his brothers; may he bathe his feet in olive oil.
May the bolts of your gates be of iron and bronze; may you be secure all your days.”
“There is no one like the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL. He rides across the Shamaym to help you, across the skies in majestic splendor.
The eternal 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is your refuge, and his everlasting arms are under you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will drive out the enemy before you; Musha cries out, ‘Destroy them!’
So Yashar'AL will live in safety, and Ya'aqub will be prosperous in security, in a land of grain and new wine, while the Shamaym drop down dew.

How Baraked you are, O Yashar'AL! Who else is like you, a people saved by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? He is your protecting shield and your triumphant sword! Your enemies will cringe before you, and you will stomp on their backs!”
Then Musha went up to Mount Nabu from the plains of Muab and climbed Pisgah Peak, which is across from Yarichu. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed him the whole land, from Gilaad as far as Dan;
all the land of Naphtali; the land of Alphraim and Manassah; all the land of Yahudah, extending to the Mediterranean Sea;
the Nagab; the Yurdan Valley with Yarichu the city of palms as far as Zuar.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Musha, “This is the land I promised on oath to Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub when I said, ‘I will give it to your descendants.’ I have now allowed you to see it with your own eyes, but you will not enter the land.”
So Musha, the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH died there in the land of Muab, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had said.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH buried Musha in a valley near Bath-paur in Muab, but to this day no one knows the exact place.
Musha was one hundred and twenty years old when he died, yet his eyesight was clear, and he was as strong as ever.
The people of Yashar'AL mourned for Musha on the plains of Muab for thirty days, until the customary period of mourning was over.
Now Yahusha Ba'Nun (son of Nun) was full of the Ruach of wisdom, for Musha had laid his hands on him. So the people of Yashar'AL obeyed him, doing just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had commanded Musha.
There has never been another Nabym in Yashar'AL like Musha, whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knew face to face.
