And Daud inquired of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to Daud, “Go up, for I will deliver them into your hand.”

So they went up to Baal Parazim, and Daud defeated them there. Then Daud said, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has broken through my enemies by my hand like a breakthrough of water.” Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Parazim.
And when they left their idols there, Daud gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
Then the Philistines once again made a raid on the valley.
Therefore Daud inquired again from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to him, “You shall not go up after them; circle around them, and come upon them in front of the mulberry trees.

And it shall be, when you hear a sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then you shall go out to battle, for I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines.”
So Daud did as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded him, and they drove back the army of the Philistines from Gibaun as far as Gazar.
Then the fame of Daud went out into all lands, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought the fear of him upon all nations.
Daud built houses for himself in the City of Daud; and he prepared a place for the Ark of the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL and pitched a tent for it.
Then Daud said, “No one may carry the Ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH but the Lauym, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen Lauym to carry the Ark and to minister before Him forever.”
And Daud gathered all Yashar'AL together at Yahushalam, to bring up the Ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to its place, which he had prepared for it.
Then Daud assembled the children of Aarun and the Lauym:
of the sons of Kuhath, Urial the chief, and one hundred and twenty of his brethren;
of the sons of Marari, Asayahu the chief, and two hundred and twenty of his brethren;
of the sons of Garshum, Yual the chief, and one hundred and thirty of his brethren;
of the sons of Alizaphan, Shamayahu the chief, and two hundred of his brethren;
of the sons of Habrun, Alial the chief, and eighty of his brethren;
of the sons of Uzzial, Amminadab the chief, and one hundred and twelve of his brethren.
And Daud called for Zaduk and Abiathar the Kuhanym, and for the Lauym: for Urial, Asayahu, Yual, Shamayahu, Alial, and Amminadab.

King Daud said to them, “You are the heads of the father's houses of the Lauym; sanctify yourselves, you and your brethren, that you may bring up the ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL to the place I have prepared for it.
For because you did not do it the first time, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH broke out against us, because we did not consult Him about the proper order.”
So the Kuhanym and the Lauym sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL.
And the children of the Lauym bore the ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on their shoulders, by its poles, as Musha had commanded according to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Then Daud spoke to the leaders of the Lauym to appoint their brethren to be the singers accompanied by instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, by raising the voice with resounding joy.
So the Lauym appointed Haman the son of Yual; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Barachyahu; and of their brethren, the sons of Marari, Athan the son of Kushayahu;

and with them their brethren of the second rank: Zacharyahu, Ban, Yaazial, Shamiramuth, Yahial, Unni, Aliab, Banayahu, Maasayahu, Mattithyahu, Aliphalah, Miknayahu, Ubad-Adum, and Yaial, the gatekeepers;
the singers, Haman, Asaph, and Athan, were to sound the cymbals of bronze;
Zacharyahu, Azial, Shamiramuth, Yahial, Unni, Aliab, Maasayahu, and Banayahu, with strings according to Alamuth;
Mattithyahu, Aliphalah, Miknayahu, Ubad-Adum, Yaial, and Azazyahu, to direct with harps on the Shaminith;
Chananyahu, leader of the Lauym, was instructor in charge of the music, because he was skillful;
Barachyahu and Alkanah were doorkeepers for the ark;
Shabanyahu, Yushaphat, Nathanal, Amasai, Zacharyahu, Banayahu, and Aliazar the Kuhanym, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and Ubad-Adum and Yahyahu, doorkeepers for the ark.
So King Daud, the elders of Yashar'AL, and the captains over thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from the house of Ubad-Adum with joy.
And so it was, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH helped the Lauym who bore the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that they offered seven bulls and seven rams.
Daud was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Lauym who bore the ark, the singers, and Chananyahu the music master with the singers. Daud also wore a linen ephod.
Thus all Yashar'AL brought up the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with shouting and with the sound of the horn, with trumpets and with cymbals, making music with stringed instruments and harps.

And it happened, as the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came to the City of Daud, that Michal, Shaul’s daughter, looked through a window and saw King Daud whirling and playing music; and she despised him in her heart.
So they brought the ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and set it in the midst of the tabernacle that Daud had erected for it. Then they offered burnt offerings and Shalum offerings before 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
And when Daud had finished offering the burnt offerings and the Shalum offerings, he Baraked the people in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Then he distributed to everyone of Yashar'AL, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a piece of meat, and a cake of raisins.
And he appointed some of the Lauym to minister before the ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to commemorate, to thank, and to praise 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL:

Asaph the chief, and next to him Zacharyahu, then Yaial, Shamiramuth, Yahial, Mattithyahu, Aliab, Banayahu, and Ubad-Adum: Yaial with stringed instruments and harps, but Asaph made music with cymbals;
Banayahu and Yahazial the Kuhanym regularly blew the trumpets before the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
On that day king Daud first delivered this Yadah into the hand of Asaph and his brethren, to thank 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
Oh, give Tudah (thanks) to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Call upon His Name; Make known His deeds among the people!
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, sing Yadah to Him; Talk of all His wondrous works!
Kabad in His Qadash Name; Let Joy fill the hearts of those who seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and His strength; Seek the face of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for evermore!
Remember the marvelous and wonderful works that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had done, and the judgments of His mouth,
O seed of Yashar'AL His servant, You children of Ya'aqub, His chosen ones!
He is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH; His judgments are in all the Arath.
Remember the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever, and the Dabar which He commanded, for a thousand generations,
The covenant which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made with Abraham, And His oath to Yachaq,
And confirmed it to Ya'aqub for a statute, To Yashar'AL for an everlasting covenant,
Saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan As the allotment of your inheritance,”
When you were few in number, Indeed very few, and strangers in it.
When they went from one nation to another, And from one kingdom to another people,
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH permitted no man to do them wrong; Yes, He rebuked kings for their sakes,
Saying, “Do not touch My anointed ones, And do My Nabym (prophets) no harm.”
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all the Arath; Proclaim the good news of the salvation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from day to day.
Declare His Kabad among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is great and greatly to be Yadah (praised); 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is also to be feared above all.
For all the idols of the peoples are idols, But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made the Shamaym.
Honor and majesty are before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; Strength and gladness are in His place.
Give to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, O Yashar'AL, Give Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with your strength.
Give to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the Kabad due to His Name; Bring an offering, and come before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the beauty of righteousness!
Tremble before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all the Arath. The world also is firmly established, It shall not be moved.
Let the Shamaym rejoice, and let the Arath be glad; And let them say among the nations, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reigns.”
Let the Yam (sea) roar, and all its fullness; Let the field rejoice, and all that is in it.
Then the trees of the woods shall rejoice before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is coming to judge the Arath.
Oh, give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for He is good! For His mercy endures forever.
And say, “Save us, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of our salvation; Gather us together, and deliver us from the other nations, To give thanks to Your Qadash Name, To triumph in Your Yadah.”
Baraked be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL From everlasting to everlasting! And all the people said, So be it, and they Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So king Daud left Asaph and his brothers there before the Ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to minister before the Ark regularly, as every day’s work required;
and Ubad-Adum with his sixty-eight brethren, including Ubad-Adum the son of Yaduthun, and Husah, to be gatekeepers;
and Zaduk the Kuhan and his brethren the Kuhanym, before the tabernacle of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH at the high place that was at Gibaun,

to offer burnt offerings to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on the altar of burnt offering regularly morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the Law of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH which He commanded Yashar'AL;
and with them Haman and Yaduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were designated by name, to give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, because His mercy endures forever;
and with them Haman and Yaduthun, to sound aloud with trumpets and cymbals and the musical instruments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Now the sons of Yaduthun were gatekeepers.
Then all the people departed, every man to his house; and Daud returned to Barak his house.

Now it came to pass, when Daud was dwelling in his house, that Daud said to Nathan the Nabym, “See now, I dwell in a house of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is under tent curtains.”
Then Nathan said to Daud, “Do all that is in your heart, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is with you.”
But it happened that night that the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came to Nathan, saying,
“Go and tell My servant Daud, ‘Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “You shall not build Me a house to dwell in.
For I have not dwelt in a house since the time that I brought up Yashar'AL, even to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.

Wherever I have moved about with all Yashar'AL, have I ever spoken a word to any of the judges of Yashar'AL, whom I commanded to shepherd My people, saying, ‘Why have you not built Me a house of cedar?’ ” ’
Now therefore, thus shall you say to My servant Daud, ‘Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut: “I took you from the sheepfold, from following the sheep, to be ruler over My people Yashar'AL.
And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a name like the name of the great men who are on the Arath.

Moreover I will appoint a place for My people Yashar'AL, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own and move no more; nor shall the sons of wickedness oppress them anymore, as previously,
since the time that I commanded judges to be over My people Yashar'AL. Also I will subdue all your enemies. Furthermore I tell you that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will build you a house.
And it shall be, when your days are fulfilled, when you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your seed after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
He shall build Me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
I will be his ABBA, and he shall be My son; and I will not take My mercy away from him, as I took it from Shaul who was before you.
And I will establish your son in My house and in My kingdom forever; and his throne shall be established forever.”
According to all these words and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to Daud.
Then King Daud went in and sat before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and he said: “Who am I, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH? And what is my house, that You have brought me this far?

And yet this was a small thing in Your sight, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH; and You have also spoken of Your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have regarded me according to the rank of a man of high degree, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
What more can Daud say to You for the honor of Your servant? For You know Your servant.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for Your servant’s sake, and according to Your own heart, You have done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, there is none like You, nor is there any 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH besides You, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

And who is like Your people Yashar'AL, the one nation on the Arath whom 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH went to redeem for Himself as a people, to make for Yourself a name by great and awesome deeds, by driving out nations from before Your people whom You redeemed from Mitzraym?
For You have made Your people Yashar'AL Your very own people forever; and You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have become their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“And now, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the word which You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house, let it be established forever, and do as You have said.

So let it be established, that Your Name may be magnified forever, saying, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, is Yashar'AL’s 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.’ And let the house of Your servant Daud be established before You.
For You, O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, have revealed to Your servant that You will build him a house. Therefore Your servant has found it in his heart to pray before You.
And now, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL have promised this goodness to Your servant.
Now You have been pleased to Barak the house of Your servant, that it may continue before You forever; for You have Baraked it, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and it shall be Baraked forever.”
After this it came to pass that Daud attacked the Philistines, subdued them, and took Gath and its towns from the hand of the Philistines.
Then he defeated Muab, and the Muabites became Daud’s servants, and brought tribute.
And Daud defeated Hadadazar king of Zubah as far as Hamath, as he went to establish his power by the River Euphrates.

Daud took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. Also Daud hamstrung all the chariot horses, except that he spared enough of them for one hundred chariots.
When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadazar king of Zubah, Daud killed twenty-two thousand of the Syrians.
Then Daud put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became Daud’s servants, and brought tribute. So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH preserved Daud wherever he went.
And Daud took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadazar, and brought them to Yahushalam.
Also from Tibhath and from Chun, cities of Hadadazar, Daud brought a large amount of bronze, with which Shalumah made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and the articles of bronze.
Now when Tuu king of Hamath heard that Daud had defeated all the army of Hadadazar king of Zubah,

he sent Haduram his son to King Daud, to greet him and barak him, because he had fought against Hadadazar and defeated him (for Hadadazar had been at war with Tuu); and Haduram brought with him all kinds of articles of gold, silver, and bronze.

King Daud also dedicated these to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, along with the silver and gold that he had brought from all these nations, from Adum, from Muab, from the people of Ammun, from the Philistines, and from Amalak.
Moreover Abishai the son of Zaruyahu killed eighteen thousand Adumites in the Valley of Salt.
He also put garrisons in Adum, and all the Adumites became Daud’s servants. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH preserved Daud wherever he went.
So Daud reigned over all Yashar'AL, and administered judgment and justice to all his people.
Yuab the son of Zaruyahu was over the army; Yahushaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
Zadtuk the son of Ahitub and Abimalach the son of Abiathar were the Kuhanym; Shabsha was the scribe;
Benayahu the son of Yahuiada was over the Charathites and the Palathites; and Daud’s sons were chief ministers at the king’s side.
It happened after this that Nahash the king of the people of Ammun died, and his son reigned in his place.

Then Daud said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So Daud sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And Daud’s servants came to Hanun in the land of the people of Ammun to comfort him.

And the princes of the people of Ammun said to Hanun, “Do you think that Daud really honors your father because he has sent comforters to you? Did his servants not come to you to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land?”
Therefore Hanun took Daud’s servants, and shaved their beard, and cut off their garments in the middle, at their buttocks, and sent them away.
Then someone went and told Daud about the men; and Daud sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, “Wait at Yarichu until your beards have grown before you return.”

When the people of Ammun saw that they had made themselves repulsive to Daud, Hanun and the people of Ammun sent a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Masuputamia, from Syrian Maacah, and from Zubah.

So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, with the king of Maacah and his people, who came and encamped before Madaba. Also the people of Ammun gathered together from their cities, and came to battle.
Now when Daud heard of it, he sent Yuab and all the army of the mighty men.
Then the people of Ammun came out and put themselves in battle array before the gate of the city, and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.
When Yuab saw that the battle line was against him all around, he chose some of Yashar'AL’s best and put them in battle array against the Syrians.
And the rest of the people he put under the command of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in battle array against the people of Ammun.
Then he said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you shall help me; but if the people of Ammun are too strong for you, then I will help you.
Be of good courage, and let us be strong for our people and for the cities of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. And may 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH do what is good in His sight.”
So Yuab and the people who were with him drew near for the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.
When the people of Ammun saw that the Syrians were fleeing, they also fled before Abishai his brother, and entered the city. So Yuab went to Yahushalam.

Now when the Syrians saw that they had been defeated by Yashar'AL, they sent messengers and brought the Syrians who were beyond the River, and Shuphach the commander of Hadadazar’s army went before them.

When they told Daud, he gathered all Yashar'AL, crossed over the Yurdan and came upon them, and set up in battle array against them. So when Daud had set up in battle array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
Then the Syrians fled before Yashar'AL; and Daud killed seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers of the Syrians, and killed Shuphach the commander of the army.
And when the servants of Hadadazar saw that they were defeated by Yashar'AL, they made Shalum with Daud and became his servants. So the Syrians were not willing to help the people of Ammun anymore.

It happened in the spring of the year, at the time kings go out to battle, that Yuab led out the armed forces and ravaged the country of the people of Ammun, and came and besieged Rabbah. But Daud stayed at Yahushalam. And Yuab defeated Rabbah and overthrew it.

Then Daud took their king’s crown from his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. And it was set on Daud’s head. Also he brought out the spoil of the city in great abundance.

And he brought out the people who were in it, and put them to work with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. So king Daud captured the cities and he put all the people of Ammun to work for him. Then Daud and all his men returned to Yahushalam.
Now it happened afterward that war broke out at Gazar with the Philistines, at which time Sibbachai the Hushathite killed Sippai, who was one of the sons of the giant. And they were subdued.
Again there was war with the Philistines, and Alhanan the son of Yair killed Lahmi the brother of Guliath the Gittite, the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.
Yet again there was war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, with twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.
So when he defied Yashar'AL, Yunathan the son of Shimaa, Daud’s brother, killed him.
These were born to the giant in Gath, and they fell by the hand of Daud and by the hand of his servants.
Now ha'shatan stood up against Yashar'AL, and moved king Daud to number Yashar'AL.
So Daud said to Yuab and to the leaders of the people, “Go, number Yashar'AL from Baarshaba to Dan, and bring the number of them to me that I may know it.”

And Yuab answered, “May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH make His people a hundred times more than they are. But, my master the king, the people are all my master’s servants? Why then does my master require this counting? Why should he be a cause of guilt in Yashar'AL?”
Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Yuab. Therefore Yuab departed and went throughout all Yashar'AL and came to Yahushalam.

Then Yuab gave the sum of the number of the people to Daud. All Yashar'AL had one million one hundred thousand men who drew the sword, and Yahudah had four hundred and seventy thousand men who drew the sword.
But he did not count Lauy and Banyamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Yuab.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was displeased with this Daud's actions; therefore 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH struck Yashar'AL.
So Daud said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing; but now, I pray take away the iniquity of Your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke to Gad, Daud’s seer, saying,
“Go and tell Daud, saying, ‘Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “I offer you three things; choose one of them for yourself, that I may do it to you.” ’ ”
So Gad came to Daud and said to him, “Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: ‘Choose for yourself,

either three years of famine, or three months to be defeated by your foes with the sword of your enemies overtaking you, or else for three days the sword of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, which will plague the land, with the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroying throughout all the territory of Yashar'AL.’ Now consider what answer I should take back to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent me.”
And Daud said to Gad, “I am in great distress. Please let me fall into the hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for His mercies are very great; but do not let me fall into the hand of man.”
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent a plague upon Yashar'AL, and seventy thousand men of Yashar'AL fell.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent a Malak to Yahushalam to destroy it. As the Malak was destroying, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH looked and relented of the disaster, and said to the Malak who was destroying, “It is enough; now restrain your hand.” And the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH stood by the threshing floor of Urnan the Yabusite.

Then Daud lifted his eyes and saw the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH standing between Arath and Shamaym, having in his hand a drawn sword stretched out over Yahushalam. So Daud and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

And Daud said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Was it not I who commanded the people to be numbered? I am the one who has sinned and done evil indeed; but these sheep, what have they done? Let Your hand, I pray, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, be against me and my father’s house, but not against Your people that they should be plagued.”
Therefore, the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded Gad to say to Daud that he should go and erect an altar to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on the threshing floor of Urnan the Yabusite.
So Daud went up at the word of Gad, which he had spoken in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH
Now Urnan turned and saw the Malak; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves, but Urnan continued threshing wheat.
So king Daud came to Urnan, and Urnan looked and saw King Daud. And he went out from the threshing floor, and bowed before Daud with his face to the ground.

Then Daud said to Urnan, “Grant me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar on it to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. You shall grant it to me at the full price, that the plague may be withdrawn from the people.”

But Urnan said to king Daud, “Take it to yourself, and let my master the king do what is good in his eyes. Look, I also give you the oxen for burnt offerings, the threshing implements for wood, and the wheat for the grain offering; I give it all.”
Then King Daud said to Urnan, “No, but I will surely buy it for the full price, for I will not take what is yours for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, nor offer burnt offerings with that which costs me nothing.”
So Daud gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.
And Daud built there an altar to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and offered burnt offerings and Shalum offerings, and called on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and He answered him from Shamaym by fire on the altar of burnt offering.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded the Malak, and he returned his sword to its sheath.
At that time, when Daud saw that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had answered him on the threshing floor of Urnan the Yabusite, he sacrificed there.
For the tabernacle of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the altar of the burnt offering, which Musha had made in the wilderness, were at that time at the high place in Gibaun.
But Daud could not go before it to inquire of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for he was afraid of the sword of the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Then Daud said, “This is the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Yashar'AL.”
So Daud commanded to gather the foreigners who were in the land of Yashar'AL; and he appointed masons to cut hewn stones to build the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And Daud prepared iron in abundance for the nails of the doors of the gates and for the joints, and bronze in abundance beyond measure,
and cedar trees in abundance; for the Sidunians and those from Tyra brought much cedar wood to Daud.

Now Daud said, “Shalumah my son is young and inexperienced, and the house to be built for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must be exceedingly magnificent, famous and Esteemed throughout all countries. I will now make preparation for it.” So Daud made abundant preparations before his death.
Then he called for his son Shalumah, and charged him to build a house for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL.
And Daud said to Shalumah: “My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build a house to the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH;

but the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came to me, saying, ‘You have shed much blood and have made great wars; you shall not build a house for My Name, because you have shed much blood on the Arath in My sight.

Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies all around, his name shall be Shalumah, for I will give Shalum and quietness to Yashar'AL in his days.
He shall build a house for My Name, and he shall be My son, and I will be his ABBA; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Yashar'AL forever.’
Now, my son, may 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be with you; and may you prosper, and build the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, as He has said to you.
Only may 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH give you wisdom and understanding, and give you charge concerning Yashar'AL, that you may keep the law of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Then you will prosper, if you take care to fulfill the statutes and judgments with which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH charged Musha concerning Yashar'AL. Be strong and of good courage; do not fear nor be dismayed.

Indeed I have taken much trouble to prepare for the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH one hundred thousand talents of gold and one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron beyond measure, for it is so abundant. I have prepared timber and stone also, and you may add to them.
Moreover there are workmen with you in abundance: woodsmen and stonecutters, and all types of skillful men for every kind of work.
Of gold and silver and bronze and iron there is no limit. Arise and begin working, may 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be with you.”
Daud also commanded all the leaders of Yashar'AL to help Shalumah his son, saying,

“Is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH not with you? And has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH not given you rest on every side? For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand, and the land is subdued before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and before His people.

Now set your heart and your soul to seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. Therefore arise and build the sanctuary of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, to bring the Ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the Qadash articles of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH into the house that is to be built for the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
So when Daud was old and full of days, he made his son Shalumah king over Yashar'AL.
And he gathered together all the leaders of Yashar'AL, with the Kuhanym and the Lauym.
Now the Lauym were numbered from the age of thirty years and above; and the number of individual males was thirty-eight thousand.
Of these, twenty-four thousand were to look after the work of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, six thousand were officers and judges,
four thousand were gatekeepers, and four thousand Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with musical instruments, “which I made,” said Daud, “for giving Yadah.”
Also Daud separated them into divisions among the sons of Lauy: Garshun, Kuhath, and Marari.
Of the Gershunites: Laadan and Shimai.
The sons of Laadan: the first Yahial, then Zatham and Yual, three in all.
The sons of Shimai: Shalumith, Hazial, and Haran, three in all. These were the heads of the fathers’ houses of Laadan.
And the sons of Shimai: Yahath, Zina, Yaush, and Baryahu. These were the four sons of Shimai.
Yahath was the first and Zizah the second. But Yaush and Baryahu did not have many sons; therefore they were assigned as one father’s house.
The sons of Kuhath: Amram, Izhar, Habrun, and Uzzial, four in all.

The sons of Amram: Aarun and Musha; and Aarun was set apart, he and his sons forever, that he should sanctify the most Qadash things, to burn incense before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to minister to Him, and to give the Barakah in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever.
Now the sons of Musha the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH were reckoned to the tribe of Lauy.
The sons of Musha were Garshun and Aliazar.
Of the sons of Garshun, Shabual was the first.
Of the descendants of Aliazar, Rahabyahu was the first. And Aliazer had no other sons, but the sons of Rahabyahu were very many.
Of the sons of Izhar, Shalumith was the first.
Of the sons of Habrun, Yaryahu was the first, Amaryahu the second, Yahazial the third, and Yakamaam the fourth.
Of the sons of Uzzial, Michah was the first and Yasshyahu the second.
The sons of Marari were Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli were Alaazar and Kish.
And Alaazar died, and had no sons, but only daughters; and their brethren, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.
The sons of Mushi were Mahli, Adar, and Yaramuth, three in all.

These were the sons of Lauy by their father's houses, the heads of the father's houses as they were counted individually by the number of their names, who did the work for the service of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, from the age of twenty years and above.
For king Daud said, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL has given rest to His people, that they may dwell in Yahushalam forever”;
and also to the Lauym, “They shall no longer carry the tabernacle, or any of the articles for its service.”
For by the last words of King Daud the Lauym were numbered from twenty years old and above;

because their duty was to help the sons of Aarun in the service of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, in the courts and in the chambers, in the purifying of all Qadash things and the work of the service of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
both with the showbread and the fine flour for the grain offering, with the unleavened cakes and what is baked in the pan, with what is mixed and with all kinds of measures and sizes;
to stand every morning to Tudah and Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and likewise at evening;

and at every presentation of a burnt offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on the Shabbats and on the New Moons and on the set feasts, by number according to the ordinance governing them, regularly before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH;
and that they should attend to the needs of the tabernacle of meeting, the needs of the Qadash place, and the needs of the sons of Aarun their brethren in the work of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aarun. The sons of Aarun were Nadab, Abihu, Alaazar, and Ithamar.
And Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Alaazar and Ithamar ministered as Kuhanym.
Then King Daud with Zaduk of the sons of Aleazar, and Ahimalach of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to the schedule of their service.

There were more leaders found of the sons of Alaazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and thus they were divided. Among the sons of Alaazar were sixteen heads of their fathers’ houses, and eight heads of their fathers’ houses among the sons of Ithamar.
Thus they were divided by lot, one group as another, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, from the sons of Alaazar and from the sons of Ithamar.

And the scribe, Shamayahu the son of Nathanal, one of the Lauym, wrote them down before the king, the leaders, Zaduk the Kuhan, Ahimalach the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Kuhanym and Lauym, one father’s house taken for Alaazar and one for Ithamar.
Now the first lot fell to Yahuiarib, the second to Yadayahu,
the third to Harim, the fourth to Saurim,
the fifth to Malchiyahu, the sixth to Miyamin,
the seventh to Hakkuz, the eighth to Abiyahu,
the ninth to Yashua, the tenth to Shacanyahu,
the eleventh to Aliashib, the twelfth to Yakim,
the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Yashabaab,
the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immar,
the seventeenth to Hazir, the eighteenth to Happizzaz,
the nineteenth to Pethahyahu, the twentieth to Yahazakal,
the twenty-first to Yachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
the twenty-third to Dalayahu, the twenty-fourth to Maazyahu.

This was the schedule of their service for coming into the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH according to their ordinance by the hand of Aarun their father, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL had commanded him.
And the rest of the sons of Lauy: of the sons of Amram, Shubaal; of the sons of Shubaal, Yahdayahu.
Concerning Rahabyahu, of the sons of Rahabyahu, the first was Isshyahu.
Of the Izharites, Shalumuth; of the sons of Shalumuth, Yahath.
Of the sons of Habrun, Yaryahu was the first, Amaryahu the second, Yahazial the third, and Yakamaam the fourth.
Of the sons of Uzzial, Michah; of the sons of Michah, Shamir.
The brother of Michah, Isshyahu; of the sons of Isshyahu, Zachariyah.
The sons of Marari were Mahli and Mushi; the son of Yaazyahu, Banu.
The sons of Marari by Yaazyahu were Banu, Shuham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
Of Mahli: Alaazar, who had no sons.
Of Kish: the son of Kish, Yarahmaal.
Also the sons of Mushi were Mahli, Adar, and Yarimuth. These were the sons of the Lauym according to their fathers’ houses.

These also cast lots just as their brothers the sons of Aarun did, in the presence of King Daud, Zaduk, Ahimalach, and the heads of the Father's houses of the Kuhanym and Lauym. The chief fathers did just as their younger brethren.

Moreover Daud and the captains of the army separated for the service some of the sons of Asaph, of Haman, and of Yaduthun, who should prophesy with harps, stringed instruments, and cymbals. And the number of the skilled men performing their service was:
Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Ya'asaf, Nathanyahu, and Asharalah; the sons of Asaph were under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied according to the order of the king.

Of Yaduthun, the sons of Yaduthun: Gadalyahu, Zari, Yashayahu, Shimai, Hashabyahu, and Mattithyahu, six, under the direction of their father Yaduthun, who prophesied with a harp to give Tudah (thanks) and to Yadah (praise) 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Of Haman, the sons of Haman: Bukkyahu, Mattanyahu, Uzzial, Shabual, Yarimuth, Hananyahu, Hanani, Aliathah, Giddalti, Rumamti-Azar, Yushbakashah, Malluthi, Huthir, and Mahaziuth.
All these were the sons of Haman the king’s seer in the words of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to exalt His horn. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave Hàman fourteen sons and three daughters.

All these were under the direction of their father for the music in the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of the house of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. Asaph, Yaduthun, and Haman were under the authority of the king.
So the number of them, with their brethren who were instructed in the songs of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all who were skillful, was two hundred and eighty-eight.
And they cast lots for their duty, the small as well as the great, the teacher with the student.
Now the first lot for Asaph came out for Ya'asaf; the second for Gadalyahu, him with his brethren and sons, twelve;
the third for Zaccur, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the fourth for Yizri, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the fifth for Nethanyahu, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the sixth for Bukkyahu, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the seventh for Yasharalah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the eighth for Yashayahu, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the ninth for Mattanyahu, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the tenth for Shimai, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the eleventh for Azaral, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the twelfth for Hashabyahu, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the thirteenth for Shubaul, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the fourteenth for Mattithyahu, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the fifteenth for Yaramuth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the sixteenth for Hananyahu, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the seventeenth for Yushbakashah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the eighteenth for Hanani, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the nineteenth for Malluthi, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the twentieth for Aliathah, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the twenty-first for Huthir, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the twenty-second for Giddalti, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the twenty-third for Mahaziuth, his sons and his brethren, twelve;
the twenty-fourth for Rumamti-Azar, his sons and his brethren, twelve.
Concerning the divisions of the gatekeepers: of the Kurahites, Mashalamyahu the son of Kura, of the sons of Asaph.
And the sons of Mashalamiah were Zacharyahu the firstborn, Yadiaal the second, Zabadyahu the third, Yathnial the fourth,
Alam the fifth, Yahuhanan the sixth, Aliahuanai the seventh.
Moreover the sons of Ubad-Adum were Shemaiah the firstborn, Yahuzabad the second, Yuah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanal the fifth,
Ammial the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Paulthai the eighth; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Baraked him.
Also to Shamayahu his son were sons born who governed their fathers’ houses, because they were men of great ability.
The sons of Shamayahu were Uthni, Raphaal, Ubad, and Alzabad, whose brothers Alihu and Samachyahu were able men.
All these were of the sons of Ubad-Adum, they and their sons and their brethren, able men with strength for the work: sixty-two of Ubad-Adum.
And Mashalamyahu had sons and brethren, eighteen able men.
Also Husah, of the children of Marari, had sons: Shimri the first (for though he was not the firstborn, his father made him the first),
Hilkyahu the second, Tabalyahu the third, Zacharyahu the fourth; all the sons and brethren of Husah were thirteen.
Among these were the divisions of the gatekeepers, among the chief men, having duties just like their brethren, to serve in the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And they cast lots for each gate, the small as well as the great, according to their father’s house.
The lot for the East Gate fell to Shalamyahu. Then they cast lots for his son Zacharyahu, a wise counselor, and his lot came out for the North Gate;
to Ubad-Adum the South Gate, and to his sons the storehouse.
To Shuppim and Husah the lot came out for the West Gate, with the Shallachath Gate on the ascending highway, watchman opposite watchman.
On the east were six Lauym, on the north four each day, on the south four each day, and for the storehouse two by two.
As for the Parbar on the west, there were four on the highway and two at the Parbar.
These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the sons of Kurah and among the sons of Marari.
Of the Lauym, Ahiyahu was over the treasuries of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and over the treasuries of the dedicated things.
The sons of Laadan, the descendants of the Garshunites of Laadan, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Laadan the Garshunites: Yahiali.
The sons of Yahiali, Zatham and Yual his brother, were over the treasuries of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Habrunites, and the Uzzialites:
Shabual the son of Garshum, the son of Musha, was overseer of the treasuries.
And his brethren by Aliazar were Rahabyahu his son, Yashayahu his son, Yuram his son, Zichri his son, and Shalumith his son.

This Shalumith and his brethren were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things which King Daud and the heads of fathers’ houses, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.
Some of the spoils won in battles they dedicated to maintain the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And all that Shamu'AL the seer, Shaul the son of Kish, Abnar the son of Nar, and Yuab the son of Zaruyahu had dedicated, every dedicated thing, was under the hand of Shalumith and his brethren.
Of the Izharites, Chananiah and his sons performed duties as officials and judges over Yashar'AL outside Yahushalam.

Of the Habrunites, Hashabyahu and his brethren, one thousand seven hundred able men, had the oversight of Yashar'AL on the west side of the Yurdan for all the business of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and in the service of the king.

Among the Habrunites, Yariyahu was head of the Habrunites according to his genealogy of the fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of King Daud they were sought, and there were found among them capable men at Yazar of Gilaad.

And his brethren were two thousand seven hundred able men, heads of fathers’ houses, whom King Daud made officials over the Raubanites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manassah, for every matter pertaining to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the affairs of the king.

And the children of Yashar'AL, according to their number, the heads of fathers’ houses, the captains of thousands and hundreds and their officers, served the king in every matter of the military divisions. These are the divisions that came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, each division having twenty-four thousand.
Over the first division for the first month was Yashubaam the son of Zabdial, and in his division were twenty-four thousand;
he was of the children of Paraz, and the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
Over the division of the second month was Dudai an Ahuhite, and of his division Mikluth also was the leader; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
The third captain of the army for the third month was Banayahu, the son of Yahuiada the Kuhan, who was chief; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
This was the Banayahu who was mighty among the thirty, and was over the thirty; in his division was Ammizabad his son.
The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahal the brother of Yuab, and Zabadyahu his son after him; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkash the Takuite; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
The seventh captain for the seventh month was Halaz the Palunite, of the children of Aphraim; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbachai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiazar the Anathuthite, of the Banyamites; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Natuphathite, of the Zarhites; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benayahu the Pirathunite, of the children of Aphraim; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Haldai the Netuphathite, of Uthnial; in his division were twenty-four thousand.
Furthermore, over the tribes of Yashar'AL: the officer over the Raubanites was Aliazar the son of Zichri; over the Simaunites, Shaphatyahu the son of Maachah;
over the Lauym, Hashabyahu the son of Kamual; over the Aarunites, Zaduk;
over Yahudah, Alihu, one of Daud’s brothers; over Issachar, Umri the son of Michaal;
over Zebulun, Ishmayahu the son of Ubadyahu; over Naphtali, Yarimuth the son of Azrial;
over the children of Aphraim, Husha the son of Azazyahu; over the half-tribe of Manassah, Yual the son of Padayahu;
over the half-tribe of Manassah in Gilaad, Iddu the son of Zecharyahu; over Banyamin, Yaasial the son of Abnar;
over Dan, Azaral the son of Yaruham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Yashar'AL.
But Daud did not take the number of those twenty years old and under, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had said He would multiply Yashar'AL like the stars of the Shamaym.
Yuab the son of Zaruyahu began a census, but he did not finish, for wrath came upon Yashar'AL because of this census; nor was the number recorded in the account of the chronicles of King Daud.
And Azmabath the son of Adial was over the king’s treasuries; and Yahunathan the son of Uzzyahu was over the storehouses in the field, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses.
Azri the son of Chalub was over those who did the work of the field for tilling the ground.
And Shimai the Ramathite was over the vineyards, and Zabdi the Shiphmite was over the produce of the vineyards for the supply of wine.
Baal-Hanan the Gadarite was over the olive trees and the sycamore trees that were in the lowlands, and Yuash was over the store of oil.
And Shitrai the Sharunite was over the herds that fed in Sharun, and Shaphat the son of Adlai was over the herds that were in the valleys.
Ubil the Ishmaalite was over the camels, Yahdayahu the Marunuthite was over the donkeys,
and Yaziz the Hagrite was over the flocks. All these were the officials over King Daud’s property.
Also Yahunathan, Daud’s uncle, was a counselor, a wise man, and a scribe; and Yahial the son of Hachmuni was with the king’s sons.
Ahithuphal was the king’s counselor, and Hushai the Archite was the king’s companion.
After Ahithuphal was Yahuiada the son of Banayahu, then Abiathar. And the general of the king’s army was Yuab.

Now king Daud assembled at Yahushalam all the leaders of Yashar'AL: the officers of the tribes and the captains of the divisions who served the king, the captains over thousands and captains over hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officials, the valiant men, and all the mighty men of valor.

Then King Daud rose to his feet and said, “Hear me, my brethren and my people: I had it in my heart to build a house of rest for the Ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and for the footstool of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and had made preparations to build it.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for My Name, because you have been a man of war and have shed blood.’

However 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL chose me above all the house of my father to be king over Yashar'AL forever, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen Yahudah to be the ruler. And of the house of Yahudah, the house of my father, and among the sons of my father, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was pleased with me to make me king over all Yashar'AL.
And of all my sons (for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given me many sons) 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen my son Shalumah to sit on the throne of the kingdom over Yashar'AL.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to me, ‘It is your son Shalumah who shall build My house and My courts; for I have chosen him to be My son, and I will be his ABBA.
Moreover I will establish his kingdom forever, if he is steadfast to observe My commandments and My judgments, as it is this day.’

Now therefore, in the sight of all Yashar'AL, the assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and in the hearing of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, be careful to seek out all the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, that you may possess this good land, and leave it as an inheritance for your children after you forever.

“As for you, my son Shalumah, know the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of your father, and serve Him with a loyal heart and with a willing mind; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH searches all hearts and understands all the intent of the thoughts. If you seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He will be found by you; but if you forsake 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He will cast you off forever.
Consider now, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary; be strong, and do it.”
Then Daud gave his son Shalumah the plans for the vestibule, its houses, its treasuries, its upper chambers, its inner chambers, and the place of the mercy seat;

and the plans for all that he had by the Ruach, of the courts and the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, of all the chambers all around, of the treasuries of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and of the treasuries for the dedicated things;
also for the division of the Kuhanym and the Lauym, for all the work of the service of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and for all the articles of service in the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
He gave gold by weight for things of gold, for all articles used in every kind of service; also silver for all articles of silver by weight, for all articles used in every kind of service;

the weight for the lampstands of gold, and their lamps of gold, by weight for each lampstand and its lamps; for the lampstands of silver by weight, for the lampstand and its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand.
And by weight he gave gold for the tables of the showbread, for each table, and silver for the tables of silver;
also pure gold for the forks, the basins, the pitchers of pure gold, and the golden bowls, he gave gold by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls, silver by weight for every bowl;

and refined gold by weight for the altar of incense, and for the construction of the chariot, that is, the gold charubim that spread their wings and overshadowed the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Daud said to Shalumah; All this, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made me understand in writing, by His hand upon me, all the works and of these plans.”

And king Daud said to his son Shalumah, “Be strong and of good courage, and do it accordingly; do not fear nor be dismayed, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will be with you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not leave you nor forsake you, until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Here are the divisions of the Kuhanym and the Lauym for all the service of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and every willing craftsman will be with you for all manner of workmanship, for every kind of service; also the leaders and all the people will be completely at your command.”

Furthermore King Daud said to all the assembly: “My son Shalumah, whom alone 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen, is young and inexperienced; and the work is great, because the temple is not for man but for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

Now for the house of my 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH I have prepared with all my might: gold for things to be made of gold, silver for things of silver, bronze for things of bronze, iron for things of iron, wood for things of wood, onyx stones, stones to be set, glistening stones of various colors, all kinds of precious stones, and marble slabs in abundance.

Moreover, because I have set my affection on the house of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I have given to the house of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, over and above all that I have prepared for the Qadash house, my own special treasure of gold and silver:
three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses;
the gold for things of gold and the silver for things of silver, and for all kinds of work to be done by the hands of craftsmen. Who then is willing to consecrate himself this day to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?”
Then the leaders of the fathers’ houses, leaders of the tribes of Yashar'AL, the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the officers over the king’s work, offered willingly.

They gave for the work of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, ten thousand talents of silver, eighteen thousand talents of bronze, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
And whoever had precious stones gave them to the treasury of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, into the hand of Yahial the Garshunites.
Then the people rejoiced, for they had offered willingly, because with a loyal heart they had offered willingly to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and King Daud also rejoiced greatly.
Therefore Daud Baraked 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH before all the assembly; and Daud said: “barak are You 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, our Abba forever and ever.

Yours, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, is the greatness, The power and the Kabad, The victory and the majesty; For all that is in Shamaym and in Arath is Yours; Yours is the kingdom, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And You are exalted as head over all.
Both riches and honor come from You, And You reign over all. In Your hand is power and might; In Your hand it is to make great And to give strength to all.
“Now therefore, our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, We thank You And Yadah (praise) Your Esteemed Name.
But who am I, and who are my people, That we should be able to offer so willingly as this?For all things come from You, And of Your own we have given You.
For we are visitors and strangers before You, As were all our fathers; Our days on Arath are as a shadow, And without hope.
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, all this abundance that we have prepared to build You a house for Your Qadash Name is from Your hand, and is all Your own.

I know also, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, that You test the heart and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things; and now with joy I have seen Your people, who are present here to offer willingly to You.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Abraham, Yachaq, and Yashar'AL, our fathers, keep this forever in the intent of the thoughts of the heart of Your people, and fix their heart toward You.
And give my son Shalumah a loyal heart to keep Your commandments and Your testimonies and Your statutes, to do all these things, and to build the temple for which I have made provision.”

Then Daud said to all the assembly, “Now barak 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.” So all the assembly Baraked 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of their fathers, and bowed their heads and prostrated themselves before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the king.

And they made sacrifices to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and offered burnt offerings to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on the next day: a thousand bulls, a thousand rams, a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Yashar'AL.

So they ate and drank before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with great gladness on that day. And they made Shalumah the son of Daud king the second time, and anointed him before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to be the leader, and Zaduk to be Kuhan.
Then Shalumah sat on the throne of Yashar'AL as king instead of Daud his father, and prospered; and all Yashar'AL obeyed him.
All the leaders and the mighty men, and also all the sons of King Daud, submitted themselves to King Shalumah.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH exalted Shalumah exceedingly in the sight of all Yashar'AL, and bestowed on him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Yashar'AL.
Thus Daud the son of Yassa reigned over all Yashar'AL.
And the period that he reigned over Yashar'AL was forty years; seven years he reigned in Habrun, and thirty-three years he reigned in Yahushalam.
So he died in a good old age, full of days and riches and honor; and Shalumah his son reigned in his place.
Now the acts of King Daud, first and last, indeed they are written in the book of Shamu'AL the seer, in the book of Nathan the Nabym, and in the book of Gad the seer,
with all his reign and his might, and the events that happened to him, to Yashar'AL, and to all the kingdoms of the lands.

books.name: II Chronicles
chapters: Now Shalumah the son of Daud was strengthened in his kingdom, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH was with him and exalted him exceedingly.
And Shalumah spoke to all Yashar'AL, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, to the judges, and to every leader in all Yashar'AL, the heads of the fathers’ houses.

Then Shalumah, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibaun; for the tabernacle of meeting with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was there, which Musha the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had made in the wilderness.
But Daud had brought up the ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from Kiryath Yaarim to the place Daud had prepared for it, for he had pitched a tent for it at Yahushalam.
Now the bronze altar that Bazalal the son of Uri, the son of Hur had made, he put before the tabernacle of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; Shalumah and the assembly sought 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH there.
And Shalumah went up there to the bronze altar before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, which was at the tabernacle of meeting, and offered a thousand burnt offerings on it.
On that night 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH appeared to Shalumah, and said to him, “Ask! What shall I give you?”
And Shalumah said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “You have shown great mercy to Daud my father, and have made me king in his place.
Now, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, let Your promise to Daud my father be established, for You have made me king over a people like the dust of the Arath in multitude.
Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of Yours?”

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to Shalumah: “Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches or wealth or honor or the life of your enemies, nor have you asked long life, but have asked wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge My people over whom I have made you king
wisdom and knowledge are granted to you; and I will give you riches and wealth and honor, such as none of the kings have had who were before you, nor shall any after you have the like.”
So Shalumah came to Yahushalam from the high place that was at Gibaun, from before the tabernacle of meeting, and reigned over Yashar'AL.
And Shalumah gathered chariots and horsemen; he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king in Yahushalam.
Also the king made silver and gold as common in Yahushalam as stones, and he made cedars as abundant as the sycamores which are in the lowland.
And Shalumah had horses imported from Mitzraym and Kabah; the king’s merchants bought them in Kabah at the current price.

They also acquired and imported from Mitzraym a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred and fifty; thus, through their agents, they exported them to all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Syria.
Then Shalumah determined to build a temple for the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and a royal house for himself.
Shalumah selected seventy thousand men to bear burdens, eighty thousand to quarry stone in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.
Then Shalumah sent to Hiram king of Tyra, saying: As you have dealt with Daud my father, and sent him cedars to build himself a house to dwell in, so deal with me.

Behold, I am building a temple for the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, to dedicate it to Him, to burn before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sweet incense, for the continual showbread, for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Shabbats, on the New Moons, and on the set feasts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. This is an ordinance forever to Yashar'AL.
And the temple which I build will be great, for our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is greater than all.

But who is able to build 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH a temple, since Shamaym and the Shamaym of Shamaym cannot contain 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Who am I then, that I should build 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH a temple, except to burn sacrifice before Him?

Therefore send me at once a man skillful to work in gold and silver, in bronze and iron, in purple and crimson and blue, who has skill to engrave with the skillful men who are with me in Yahudah and Yahushalam, whom Daud my father provided.
Also send me cedar and cypress and algum logs from Labanun, for I know that your servants have skill to cut timber in Labanun; and indeed my servants will be with your servants,
to prepare timber for me in abundance, for the temple which I am about to build shall be great and wonderful.

And indeed I will give to your servants, the woodsmen who cut timber, twenty thousand kors of ground wheat, twenty thousand kors of barley, twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
Then Hiram king of Tyra answered in writing, which he sent to King Shalumah: Because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves His people, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made you king over them.

Hiram also said: Baraked be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, who made Shamaym and Arath, for He has given King Daud a wise son, endowed with prudence and understanding, who will build a temple for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and a royal house for himself!
And now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, Huram my master craftsman

(the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyra), skilled to work in gold and silver, bronze and iron, stone and wood, purple and blue, fine linen and crimson, and to make any engraving and to accomplish any plan which may be given to him, with your skillful men and with the skillful men of my master king Daud your father.
Now therefore, the wheat, the barley, the oil, and the wine which my master has spoken of, let him send to his servants.
And we will cut wood from Labanun, as much as you need; we will bring it to you in rafts by sea to Yuppa, and you will carry it up to Yahushalam.

Then Shalumah numbered all the foreigners who were in the land of Yashar'AL, after the census in which Daud his father had numbered them; and there were found to be one hundred and fifty-three thousand six hundred.
And he made seventy thousand of them bearers of burdens, eighty thousand stonecutters in the mountain, and three thousand six hundred overseers to make the people work.

Now Shalumah began to build the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH at Yahushalam on Mount Muryahu, where 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had appeared to his father Daud, at the place that Daud had prepared on the threshing floor of Urnan the Yabusite.
And he began to build on the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign.
This is the foundation which Shalumah laid for building the house of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH: The length was sixty cubits (by cubits according to the former measure) and the width twenty cubits.
And the vestibule that was in front of the sanctuary was twenty cubits long across the width of the house, and the height was one hundred and twenty, he overlaid the inside with pure gold.
The larger room he paneled with cypress which he overlaid with fine gold, and he carved palm trees and chainwork on it.
And he decorated the house with precious stones for beauty, and the gold was gold from Parbaim.
He also overlaid the house, the beams and doorposts, its walls and doors, with gold; and he carved charubim on the walls.
And he made the Most Qadash Place. Its length was according to the width of the house, twenty cubits, and its width twenty cubits. He overlaid it with six hundred talents of fine gold.
The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold; and he overlaid the upper area with gold.
In the Most Qadash Place he made two charubim, fashioned by carving, and overlaid them with gold.

The wings of the charubim were twenty cubits in overall length: one wing of the one charub was five cubits, touching the wall of the room, and the other wing was five cubits, touching the wing of the other charub;
one wing of the other charub was five cubits, touching the wall of the room, and the other wing also was five cubits, touching the wing of the other charub.
The wings of these charubim spanned twenty cubits overall. They stood on their feet, and they faced inward.
And he made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and wove charubim into it.
Also he made in front of the temple two pillars thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
He made wreaths of chainwork, as in the inner sanctuary, and put them on top of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the wreaths of chainwork.
Then he set up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand and the other on the left; he called the name of the one on the right hand Yachin, and the name of the one on the left Buaz.
Moreover he made a bronze altar: twenty cubits was its length, twenty cubits its width, and ten cubits its height.
Then he made the Sea of cast bronze, ten cubits from one brim to the other; it was completely round. Its height was five cubits, and a line of thirty cubits measured its circumference.
And under it was the likeness of oxen encircling it all around, ten to a cubit, all the way around the Sea. The oxen were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

It stood on twelve oxen: three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; the Sea was set upon them, and all their back parts pointed inward.
It was a handbreadth thick; and its brim was shaped like the brim of a cup, like a lily blossom. It contained three thousand baths.

He also made ten lavers, and put five on the right side and five on the left, to wash in them; such things as they offered for the burnt offering they would wash in them, but the Sea was for the Kuhanym to wash in.
And he made ten lampstands of gold according to their design, and set them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left.
He also made ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made one hundred bowls of gold.
Furthermore he made the court of the Kuhanym, and the great court and doors for the court; and he overlaid these doors with bronze.
He set the Sea on the right side, toward the southeast.
Then Huram made the pots and the shovels and the bowls. So Huram finished doing the work that he was to do for King Shalumah for the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
the two pillars and the bowl-shaped capitals that were on top of the two pillars; the two networks covering the two bowl-shaped capitals which were on top of the pillars;
four hundred pomegranates for the two networks (two rows of pomegranates for each network, to cover the two bowl-shaped capitals that were on the pillars);
he also made carts and the lavers on the carts;
one Sea and twelve oxen under it;
also the pots, the shovels, the forks, and all their articles Huram his master craftsman made of burnished bronze for King Shalumah for the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
In the plain of Yurdan the king had them cast in clay molds, between Succuth and Zaradah.
And Shalumah had all these articles made in such great abundance that the weight of the bronze was not determined.
Thus Shalumah had all the furnishings made for the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: the altar of gold and the tables on which was the showbread;
the lampstands with their lamps of pure gold, to burn in the prescribed manner in front of the inner sanctuary,
with the flowers and the lamps and the wick-trimmers of gold, of purest gold;

the trimmers, the bowls, the ladles, and the censers of pure gold. As for the entry of the sanctuary, its inner doors to the Most Qadash Place, and the doors of the main hall of the temple, were gold.

So all the work that Shalumah had done for the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was finished; and Shalumah brought in the things which his father Daud had dedicated: the silver and the gold and all the furnishings. And he put them in the treasuries of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Now Shalumah assembled the elders of Yashar'AL and all the heads of the tribes, the chief fathers of the children of Yashar'AL, in Yahushalam, that they might bring the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH up from the City of Daud, which is Ziun.
Therefore all the men of Yashar'AL assembled with the king at the feast, which was in the seventh month.
So all the elders of Yashar'AL came, and the Lauym took up the ark.
Then they brought up the ark, the tabernacle of meeting, and all the Qadash furnishings that were in the tabernacle. The Kuhanym and the Lauym brought them up.
Also King Shalumah, and all the congregation of Yashar'AL who were assembled with him before the ark, were sacrificing sheep and oxen that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.
Then the Kuhanym brought in the ark of the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the temple, to the Most Qadash Place, under the wings of the charubim.
For the charubim spread their wings over the place of the ark, and the charubim overshadowed the ark and its poles.

The poles extended so that the ends of the poles of the ark could be seen from the Qadash place, in front of the inner sanctuary; but they could not be seen from outside. And they are there to this day.
Nothing was in the ark except the two tablets which Musha put there at Hurab, when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made a covenant with the children of Yashar'AL, when they had come out of Mitzraym.
And it came to pass when the Kuhanym came out of the Most Qadash Place (for all the Kuhanym who were present had sanctified themselves, without keeping to their divisions),

and the Lauym who were the singers, all those of Asaph and Haman and Yaduthun, with their sons and their brethren, stood at the east end of the altar, clothed in white linen, having cymbals, stringed instruments and harps, and with them one hundred and twenty Kuhanym sounding with trumpets

indeed it came to pass, when the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, saying: “For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good, and His mercy endures forever,” that the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, was filled with a cloud,
so that the Kuhanym could not continue ministering because of the cloud; for the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH filled the house of the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL.
Then Shalumah spoke: “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said He would dwell in the dark cloud.
I have surely built You an exalted house, and a place for You to dwell in forever.”
Then the king turned around and Baraked the whole assembly of Yashar'AL, while all the assembly of Yashar'AL was standing.
And Shalumah said: “baraked be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, who has fulfilled with His hands what He spoke with His mouth to my father Daud, saying,

‘Since the day that I brought My people out of the land of Mitzraym, I have chosen no city from any tribe of Yashar'AL in which to build a house, that My Name might be there, nor did I choose any man to be a ruler over My people Yashar'AL.
Yet I have chosen Yahushalam, that My Name may be there, and I have chosen Daud to be leader over My people Yashar'AL.’
Now it was in the heart of my father Daud to build a temple for the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to my father Daud, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a temple for My name, you did well in that it was in your heart.
Nevertheless you shall not build the temple, but your son who will come from your body, he shall build the temple for My Name.’

So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has fulfilled His word which He spoke, and I have filled the position of my father Daud, and sit on the throne of Yashar'AL, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH promised; and I have built the temple for the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL.
And there I have put the ark, in which is the covenant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH which He made with the children of Yashar'AL.”
Then Shalumah stood before the altar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the presence of all the assembly of Yashar'AL, and spread out his hands

(for Shalumah had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court; and he stood on it, knelt down on his knees before all the assembly of Yashar'AL, and spread out his hands toward Shamaym);

and he said: “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the only 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, there is no 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH in Shamaym or on Arath like You, who keep Your covenant and mercy with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.
You have kept what You promised Your servant Daud my father; You have both spoken with Your mouth and fulfilled it with Your hand, as it is this day.

Therefore, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, now keep what You promised Your servant Daud my father, saying, ‘You shall not fail to have a man sit before Me on the throne of Yashar'AL, only if your sons take heed to their way, that they walk in My Turah (law) as you have walked before Me.’
And now, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, let Your word come true, which You have spoken to Your servant Daud.
“But will 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH indeed dwell with men on the Arath? Behold, Shamaym and the Shamaym of Shamaym cannot contain You. How much less this temple which I have built!
Yet regard the prayer of Your servant and his supplication, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and listen to the cry and the prayer which Your servant is praying before You:
that Your eyes may be open toward this temple day and night, toward the place where You said You would put Your Name, that You may hear the prayer which Your servant makes toward this place.
And may You hear the supplications of Your servant and of Your people Yashar'AL, when they pray toward this place. Hear from Shamaym Your dwelling place, and when You hear, forgive.
“If anyone sins against his neighbor, and is forced to take an oath, and comes and takes an oath before Your altar in this temple,

then hear from Shamaym, and act, and judge Your servants, bringing retribution on the wicked by bringing his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous by giving him according to his righteousness.
“Or if Your people Yashar'AL are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and return and confess Your Name, and pray and make supplication before You in this temple,
then hear from Shamaym and forgive the sin of Your people Yashar'AL, and bring them back to the land which You gave to them and their fathers.
“When the Shamaym are shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against You, when they pray toward this place and confess Your Name, and turn from their sin because You afflict them,

then hear in Shamaym, and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Yashar'AL, that You may teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on Your land which You have given to Your people as an inheritance.
“When there is famine in the land, pestilence or blight or mildew, locusts or grasshoppers; when their enemies besiege them in the land of their cities; whatever plague or whatever sickness there is;
whatever prayer, whatever supplication is made by anyone, or by all Your people Yashar'AL, when each one knows his own burden and his own grief, and spreads out his hands to this temple:
then hear from Shamaym Your dwelling place, and forgive, and give to everyone according to all his ways, whose heart You know (for You alone know the hearts of the sons of men),
that they may fear You, to walk in Your ways as long as they live in the land which You gave to our fathers.

“Moreover, concerning a foreigner, who is not of Your people Yashar'AL, but has come from a far country for the sake of Your great Name and Your mighty hand and Your outstretched arm, when they come and pray in this temple;

then hear from Shamaym Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You, that all peoples of the Arath may know Your Name and fear You, as do Your people Yashar'AL, and that they may know that this temple which I have built is called by Your Name.
“When Your people go out to battle against their enemies, wherever You send them, and when they pray to You toward this city which You have chosen and the temple which I have built for Your name,
then hear from Shamaym their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
“When they sin against You (for there is no one who does not sin), and You become angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, and they take them captive to a land far or near;

yet when they come to themselves in the land where they were carried captive, and repent, and make supplication to You in the land of their captivity, saying, ‘We have sinned, we have done wrong, and have committed wickedness’;

and when they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have been carried captive, and pray toward their land which You gave to their fathers, the city which You have chosen, and toward the temple which I have built for Your Name:
then hear from Shamaym Your dwelling place their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive Your people who have sinned against You.
Now, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I pray, let Your eyes be open and let Your ears be attentive to the prayer made in this place.

“Now therefore, Arise O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, to Your resting place,You and the Ark of Your strength. Let Your Kuhanym, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, be clothed with salvation, And let Your saints rejoice in goodness.
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, do not turn away the face of Your Anointed; Remember the mercies of Your servant Daud.
When Shalumah had finished praying, fire came down from Shamaym and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH filled the temple.
And the Kuhanym could not enter the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, because the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had filled 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s house.

When all the children of Yashar'AL saw how the fire came down, and the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on the temple, they bowed their faces to the ground on the pavement, and worshiped and Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, saying: “For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good, And mercy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH endures forever.”
Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
King Shalumah offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand bulls and one hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

And the Kuhanym attended to their services; the Lauym also with instruments of the music of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, which King Daud had made to Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, saying, “For the mercy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH endures forever,” The Kuhanym sounded trumpets opposite, while all Yashar'AL stood.

Furthermore Shalumah consecrated the middle of the court that was in front of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; for there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the Shalum offerings, because the bronze altar which Shalumah had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, the grain offerings, and the fat.
