By these mighty acts 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH nourishes the people, giving them food in abundance.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH fills His hands with lightning bolts and hurls each at its target.
The thunder announces His presence; the storm announces His indignant anger.
“My heart pounds as I think of this. It trembles within me.
Listen carefully to the thunder of the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as it rolls from His Mouth.
It rolls across the Shamaym, and His lightning flashes in every direction.
Then comes the roaring of the thunder, the tremendous voice of His Majesty. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not restrain it when He Dabar (speaks).
For the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is wonderful in the thunder. We can not even imagine the greatness of His power.
“And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH directs the snow to fall on the Arath and tells the rain to pour down.
Then everyone stops working so they can watch the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The wild animals take cover and stay inside their dens.
The stormy wind comes from its chamber, and the driving winds bring the cold.
And the breath of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH produces ice and it freezes the wide expanses of water.
He loads the clouds with moisture, and they flash with his lightning.
The clouds churn about at His direction. They do whatever He commands throughout the Arath.
He makes these things happen either to punish people or to show his unfailing love.
“Pay attention to this, Ayub. Stop and consider the wonderful miracles of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Do you know how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH controls the storm and causes the lightning to flash from his clouds?
Do you understand how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH moves the clouds with wonderful perfection and skill?
When you are sweltering in your clothes and the south wind dies down and everything is still,
he makes the skies reflect the heat like a bronze mirror. Can you do that?
“So teach the rest of us what to say to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. We are too ignorant to make our own arguments.
Should our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH be notified that I want to speak? Can people even speak when they are confused?
We cannot look at the sun, for it shines brightly in the sky, when the wind clears away the clouds.
So also, golden splendor comes from the mountain of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. He is clothed in dazzling splendor.
We cannot imagine the power of the Almighty; but even though he is just and righteous, he does not destroy us.
No wonder people everywhere fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. All who are wise show Him reverence.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH answered Ayub from the whirlwind:
“Who is this that questions my wisdom with such ignorant words?
Brace yourself like a man, because I have some questions for you, and you must answer them.
“Where were you when I laid the foundations of the Arath? Tell me, if you know so much.
Who determined its dimensions and stretched out the surveying line?
What supports its foundations, and who laid its cornerstone
as the morning stars sang together and all the Malakym shouted for joy?
“Who kept the sea inside its boundaries as it burst from the womb,
and as I clothed it with clouds and wrapped it in thick darkness?
For I locked it behind barred gates, limiting its shores.
I said, ‘This far and no farther will you come. Here your proud waves must stop!’
“Have you ever commanded the morning to appear and caused the dawn to rise in the east?
Have you made daylight spread to the ends of the Arath, to bring an end to the night’s wickedness?
As the light approaches, the Arath takes shape like clay pressed beneath a seal; it is robed in brilliant colors.
The light disturbs the wicked and stops the arm that is raised in violence.
“Have you explored the springs from which the seas come? Have you explored their depths?
Do you know where the gates of death are located? Have you seen the gates of utter gloom?
Do you realize the extent of the Arath? Tell me about it if you know!
“Where does light come from, and where does darkness go?
Can you take each to its home? Do you know how to get there?
But of course you know all this! For you were born before it was all created, and you are so very experienced!
“Have you visited the storehouses of the snow or seen the storehouses of hail?
I have reserved them as weapons for the time of trouble, for the day of battle and war.
Where is the path to the source of light? Where is the home of the east wind?
“Who created a channel for the torrents of rain? Who laid out the path for the lightning?
Who makes the rain fall on barren land, in a desert where no one lives?
Who sends rain to satisfy the parched ground and make the tender grass spring up?
“Does the rain have a father? Who gives birth to the dew?
Who is the mother of the ice? Who gives birth to the frost from the Shamaym?
For the water turns to ice as hard as rock, and the surface of the water freezes.
“Can you direct the movement of the stars, binding the cluster of the Pleiades or loosening the cords of Orion?
Can you direct the constellations through the seasons or guide the Bear with her cubs across the Shamaym?
Do you know the laws of the universe? Can you use them to regulate the Arath?
“Can you shout to the clouds and make it rain?
Can you make lightning appear and cause it to strike as you direct?
Who gives intuition to the heart and instinct to the mind?
Who is wise enough to count all the clouds? Who can tilt the water jars of Shamaym
when the parched ground is dry and the soil has hardened into clods?
“Can you stalk prey for a lioness and satisfy the young lion's appetite
as they lie in their dens or crouch in the thicket?
Who provides food for the ravens when their young cry out to 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and wander about in hunger?
“Do you know when the wild goats give birth? Have you watched as deer are born in the wild?
Do you know how many months they carry their young? Are you aware of the time of their delivery?
They crouch down to give birth to their young and deliver their offspring.
Their young grow up in the open fields, then leave home and never return.
“Who gives the wild donkey its freedom? Who untied its ropes?
I have placed it in the wilderness; its home is the wasteland.
It hates the noise of the city and has no driver to shout at it.
The mountains are its pastureland, where it searches for every blade of grass.
“Will the wild ox consent to being tamed? Will it spend the night in your stall?
Can you hitch a wild ox to a plow? Will it plow a field for you?
Given its strength, can you trust it? Can you leave and trust the ox to do your work?
Can you rely on it to bring home your grain and deliver it to your threshing floor?
“The ostrich flaps her wings grandly, but they are no match for the feathers of the stork.
She lays her eggs on top of the Arath, letting them be warmed in the dust.
She does not worry that a foot might crush them or a wild animal might destroy them.
She is harsh toward her young, as if they were not her own. She does not care if they die.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has deprived her of wisdom. He has given her no understanding.
But whenever she jumps up to run, she passes the swiftest horse with its rider.
“Have you given the horse its strength or clothed its neck with a flowing mane?
Did you give it the ability to leap like a locust? Its majestic snorting is terrifying!
It paws the Arath and rejoices in its strength when it charges out to battle.
It laughs at fear and is unafraid. It does not run from the sword.
The arrows rattle against it, and the spear and javelin flash.
It paws the ground fiercely and rushes forward into battle when the ram’s horn blows.
It snorts at the sound of the horn. It senses the battle in the distance. It quivers at the captain’s commands and the noise of battle.
“Is it your wisdom that makes the hawk soar and spread its wings toward the south?
Is it at your command that the eagle rises to the heights to make its nest?
It lives on the cliffs, making its home on a distant, rocky crag.
From there it hunts its prey, keeping watch with piercing eyes.
Its young gulp down blood. Where there is a carcass, there you will find it.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Ayub,
“Do you still want to argue with the AL'Mighty? You are 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH’s critic, but do you have the answers?”
Then Ayub replied to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
“I am nothing, how could I ever find the answers? I will cover my mouth with my hand.
I have said too much already. I have nothing more to say.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH answered Ayub from the whirlwind:
“Brace yourself like a man, because I have some questions for you, and you must answer them.
“Will you discredit my justice and condemn me just to prove you are right?
Are you as strong as 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH? Can you thunder with a voice like His?
All right, put on your Kabad and splendor, your honor and majesty.
Give vent to your anger. Let it overflow against the proud.
Humiliate the proud with a glance; walk on the wicked where they stand.
Bury them in the dust. Imprison them in the world of the dead.
Then even I would yadah you, for your own strength would save you.
“Take a look at Bahamuth, which I made, just as I made you. It eats grass like an ox.
See its powerful loins and the muscles of its belly.
Its tail is as strong as a cedar. The sinews of its thighs are knit tightly together.
Its bones are tubes of bronze. Its limbs are bars of iron.
It is a prime example of the handiwork of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and only its Creator can threaten it.
The mountains offer it their best food, where all the wild animals play.
It lies under the lotus plants, hidden by the reeds in the marsh.
The lotus plants give it shade among the willows beside the stream.
It is not disturbed by the raging river, not concerned when the swelling Yurdan rushes around it.
No one can catch it off guard or put a ring in its nose and lead it away.
“Can you catch Laviathan with a hook or put a noose around its jaw?
Can you tie it with a rope through the nose or pierce its jaw with a spike?
Will it beg you for mercy or implore you for pity?
Will it agree to work for you, to be your slave for life?
Can you make it a pet like a bird, or give it to your little girls to play with?
Will merchants try to buy it to sell it in their shops?
Will its skin be hurt by spears or its head by a harpoon?
If you lay a hand on it, you will certainly remember the battle that follows. You will not try that again!
No, it is useless to try to capture it. The hunter who attempts it will be knocked down.
And since no one dares to disturb it, who then can stand up to me?
Who has given me anything that I need to pay back? Everything under Shamaym is mine.
“I want to emphasize Laviathan’s limbs and its enormous strength and wonderful form.
Who can strip off its hide, and who can penetrate its double layer of armor?
Who could pry open its jaws? For its teeth are terrible!
The scales on its back are like rows of shields tightly sealed together.
They are so close together that no air can get between them.
Each scale sticks tight to the next. They interlock and cannot be penetrated.
“When it sneezes, it flashes light! Its eyes are like the red of dawn.
Lightning leaps from its mouth; flames of fire flash out.
Smoke streams from its nostrils like steam from a pot heated over burning rushes.
Its breath would kindle coals, for flames shoot from its mouth.
“The tremendous strength in Laviathan’s neck strikes terror wherever it goes.
Its flesh is hard and firm and cannot be penetrated.
Its heart is hard as rock, hard as a millstone.
When it rises, the mighty are afraid, gripped by terror.
No sword can stop it, no spear, dart, or javelin.
Iron is nothing but straw to that creature, and bronze is like rotten wood.
Arrows cannot make it flee. Stones shot from a sling are like bits of grass.
Clubs are like a blade of grass, and it laughs at the swish of javelins.
Its belly is covered with scales as sharp as glass. It plows up the ground as it drags through the mud.
“Laviathan makes the water boil with its commotion. It stirs the depths like a pot of ointment.
The water glistens in its wake, making the sea look white.
Nothing on the Arath is its equal, no other creature so fearless.
Of all the creatures, it is the proudest. It is the king of beasts.”
Then Ayub replied to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“I know that You can do anything, and no one can stop You.
You asked, ‘Who is this that questions my wisdom with such ignorance?’ It is I and I was talking about things I knew nothing about, things far too wonderful for me.
You said, ‘Listen and I will speak! I have some questions for you, and you must answer them.’
I had only heard about you before, but now I have seen you with my own eyes.
I take back everything I said, and I sit in dust and ashes to show my repentance.”

After 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had finished speaking to Ayub, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Aliphaz the Tamanite: “I am angry with you and your two friends, for you have not spoken accurately about me, as my servant Ayub has.

So take seven bulls and seven rams and go to my servant Ayub and offer a burnt offering for yourselves. My servant Ayub will pray for you, and I will accept his prayer on your behalf. I will not treat you as you deserve, for you have not spoken accurately about me, as my servant Ayub has.”
So Aliphaz the Tamanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zuphar the Naamathite did as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded them, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH accepted Ayub’s prayer.
Immediately after Ayub had prayed for his friends, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH restored the fortunes of Ayub. In fact, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave him twice as much as before!

Then all his brothers, sisters, and former friends came and feasted with him in his home. And they consoled Ayub and comforted him because of all the trials 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had brought against him. And each of them brought him a gift of money and a gold ring.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Baraked Ayub in the second half of his life even more than in the beginning. For now he had 14,000 sheep, 6,000 camels, 1,000 teams of oxen, and 1,000 female donkeys.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also gave Ayub seven more sons and three more daughters.
Ayub named his first daughter Yamimah, the second Kazyah, and the third Karan-happuch.
Nowhere in the land where found women as beautiful as the daughters of Ayub. And their father put them into his will along with their brothers.
Ayub lived 140 years after that, living to see four generations of his children and grandchildren.
Then he died, an old man who had lived a long, full life.

books.name: Psalms
chapters: Baraked is the righteous man Who walks not in the counsel of lawlessness, Nor stands in the path of sinners, nor join in with mockers.
But his delight is in the Turah (law) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And he meditates day and night in the law of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This righteous man is like a tree Planted by the rivers of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season, and his leaf does not wither; for whatever he does will prosper.
But the Lawless and wicked men! are like worthless chaff, scattered by the wind.
They will be condemned at the time of judgment. Sinners will have no place among the righteous.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH watches over the path of the righteous, but the path of the wicked leads to eternal destruction.
Why do the nations rage, And the people plot a vain thing?
The kings of the Arath set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and against His Anointed saying,
“Let us break Their bonds in pieces and cast away their cords from us.”
He who sits in the Shamaym shall laugh; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH makes fun of them.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shall speak to them in His wrath, And distress them in His deep displeasure:
“Yet I have set My chosen King On My Qadash hill of Ziun.”
“I will declare the decree: for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has said to Me, You are My Son, Today I have begotten You.
Ask Me, and I will give You The nations for Your inheritance, And the whole Arath (Earth) for Your possession.
You shall break them with a rod of iron; You shall dash them to pieces like a potter’s vessel.’ ”
Now therefore, be wise, O kings; Be instructed, you judges of the Arath.
Serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

Submit to the royal son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, or He will be angry and you will be perish in the way when the wrath of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is kindled but a little, "Baraked are all those who put their trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I have so many enemies; so many are against me.
So many are saying, “his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will never rescue him!”
But You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, are a shield for me, My Kabad and the One who lifts up my head.
I cried to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with my voice, And He heard me from His Qadash hill.
I lay down and slept; and I woke up refreshed, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sustained me.
I will not be afraid of ten thousand people Who have set themselves against me all around.
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; Save me, O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! For You have struck all my enemies on the cheekbone; You have broken the teeth of the unrighteous.
Salvation belongs to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Your Barakah is upon Your people.
Answer me when I call to you, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who declares me innocent. Free me from my troubles. Have mercy on me and hear my prayer.
How long will you people ruin my reputation? How long will you make groundless accusations? How long will you continue your lies?
You can be sure of this: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH set apart the righteous for himself. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will answer when I call to Him.
Do not sin by letting anger control you, think about it overnight and remain silent.
Offer sacrifices in the right spirit, and trust 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
They are many who say, “Who will show us better times?” O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH may the light of your favor smile on us.
You have given me greater joy than those who have abundant harvests of grain and new wine.
In Shalum I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, will keep me safe.
Give ear to my words, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Consider my meditation.
Give attention to my cry for help, My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, For I only pray to You .
My voice You will hear in the morning, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; In the morning I will direct it to You, And I will look up.
For You are not an 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who takes pleasure in wickedness, Nor shall evil dwell with You.
The boastful shall not stand in Your sight; You hate all workers of iniquity.
You shall destroy those who speak falsehood; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
But as for me, I will come into Your house in the multitude of Your mercy; In fear of You I will worship toward Your Qadash temple.
Lead me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; Make Your way straight before my face.
For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is destruction; Their throat is an open tomb; They flatter with their tongue.
Pronounce them guilty, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! Let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions, For they have rebelled against You.
But let all those who put their trust in You rejoice; Let them always shout for joy, because You defend them; Let those who love Your Name Be joyful in You.
For You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, will Barak the righteous; With favor You will surround him with a shield.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, do not rebuke me in Your anger, Nor chasten me in Your hot displeasure.
Have mercy on me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for I am weak; O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, heal me, for my bones are troubled.
My soul also is greatly troubled; How long, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, until you restore me?
Return, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and rescue me. Save me because of your unfailing love.
For in death there is no remembrance of You; In the grave who will give You thanks?
I am weary with my groaning; All night I make my bed swim; I drench my couch with my tears.
My eye wastes away because of grief; It grows old because of all my enemies.
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has heard the voice of my weeping.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has heard my supplication; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will receive my prayer.
Let all my enemies be ashamed and greatly troubled; Let them turn back and be ashamed suddenly.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, in You I put my trust; Save me from all those who persecute me; And deliver me,
Lest they tear me like a lion, Rending me in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, if I have done this: If there is iniquity in my hands,
If I have repaid evil to him who was at Shalum with me, Or have plundered my enemy without cause,
Let the enemy pursue me and overtake me; Yes, let him trample my life to the Arath, And lay my honor in the dust.
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, in Your anger; Lift Yourself up because of the rage of my enemies; Rise up for me to the judgment You have commanded!
So the congregation of the peoples shall surround You; For their sakes, therefore, return on high.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shall judge the people; Judge me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, according to my righteousness, And according to my integrity within me.
Oh, let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, But establish the just; For the righteous 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH tests the hearts and minds.
My defense is of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, Who saves the upright in heart.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is a just judge, And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is angry with the wicked every day.
If a person does not repent, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will sharpen His sword; He bends His bow and makes it ready.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has deadly weapons in store for those who will not change; He gets His flaming arrows ready!
Behold, the wicked brings forth iniquity; Yes, he conceives trouble and brings forth falsehood.
The wicked made a pit and dug it out, And the wicked has fallen into the ditch which he made.
His evil shall return upon his own head, And his violent dealing shall come down on his own crown.
I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH according to His righteousness, And I will sing Yadah to the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH AL'ALYUN.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, How excellent is Your Name in all the Arath, You have set Your Kabad above the Shamaym!
Your strength is spoken about from the mouth of children and nursing infants, for You have silenced your enemies and the avengers.
When I consider Your Shamaym, the work of Your fingers, The moon and the stars, which You have ordained,
What is man that You are mindful of him, And the son of man that You visit him?
For You have made him a little lower than the Malakym, And You have crowned him with Kabad and honor.
You have made him to have dominion over the works of Your hands; You have put all things under his feet,
All sheep and oxen, Even the beasts of the field,
The birds of the air, And the fish of the sea That pass through the paths of the seas.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, How excellent is Your name in all the Arath!
I will Yadah You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, with my whole heart; I will tell of all Your marvelous works.
I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing Yadah to Your name, O AL'ALYUN (Most High).
When my enemies turn back, They shall fall and perish at Your presence.
For You have maintained my right and my cause; You sat on the throne judging in righteousness.
You have rebuked the nations, You have destroyed the wicked; You have blotted out their name forever and ever.
Endless ruin has overtaken my enemies, the cities you uprooted are now forgotten.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reigns forever; He has prepared His throne for judgment.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shall judge the world in righteousness, And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shall administer judgment for the peoples in uprightness.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also will be a refuge for the oppressed, A refuge in times of trouble.
And those who know Your Name will put their trust in You; For You O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have not forsaken those who seek You.
Sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who dwells in Ziun! Declare His deeds among the people.
When He avenges blood, He remembers them; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not forget the cry of the humble.
Have mercy on me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Consider my trouble from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,
That I may tell of all Your Yadah In the gates of the daughter of Ziun. I will rejoice in Your salvation.
The nations have sunk down in the pit which they made; In the net which they hid, their own foot is caught.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is known by the judgment He executes; The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Meditation.
The wicked shall be turned into hell, And all the nations that forget the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all life
For the needy shall not always be forgotten; The expectation of the poor shall not perish forever.
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Do not let man prevail; Let the nations be judged in Your sight.
Put them in fear, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, That the nations may know themselves to be but men.
Why do You stand afar off, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Why do You hide in times of trouble?
The wicked in his pride persecutes the poor; Let them be caught in the plots which they have devised.
For they brag about their evil desires; they praise the greedy and curse 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The wicked in his proud countenance does not seek 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not in his thoughts.
His ways are always prospering; Your judgments are far above, out of his sight; As for all his enemies, he sneers at them.
The wicked has said in his heart, “I shall not be moved; I shall never be in adversity.”
His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression; Under his tongue is trouble and iniquity.
He sits in the lurking places of the villages; In the secret places he murders the innocent; His eyes are secretly fixed on the helpless.
The wicked lies in wait secretly, as a lion in his den; he lies in wait to catch the poor; he catches the poor when he draws him into his net.
So the wicked crouches, and he lies low, That the helpless may fall by his strength.
He has said in his heart, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has forgotten; he hides his face; he will never see.”
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, lift up Your hand! Do not forget the humble.
Why do the wicked renounce 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH? he has said in his heart, “You will not require an account.”
But You have seen, for You observe trouble and grief, To repay it by Your hand, the helpless commits himself to You; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the helper of the fatherless.
Break the arm of the wicked and the evil man; Seek out his wickedness until You find none.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the AL'Mighty ONE forever and ever; The nations have perished out of His land.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, You have heard the desire of the humble; You will prepare their heart; You will cause Your ear to hear,
To do justice to the fatherless and the oppressed, That the men of this Arath may oppress no more.
I trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for protection. So why do you say to me, “Fly like a bird to the mountains for safety!
The wicked are stringing their bows and fitting their arrows on the bowstrings. They shoot from the shadows at those whose hearts are right.
The foundations of law and order have collapsed. What can the righteous do?”
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is in his Qadash Temple; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH still rules from Shamaym and watches everyone closely, examining every person on the Arath.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH examines both the righteous and the wicked. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hates those who love violence.
He will rain down blazing coals and burning sulfur on the wicked, punishing them with scorching winds.
For the righteous 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH loves justice. The virtuous will see his face.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH we need Help, for the righteous man ceases! For the faithful disappear from among the sons of men.
They speak idly everyone with his neighbor; With flattering lips and a double heart they speak.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH cut off all flattering lips, And the tongue that speaks proud things,
Who have said, With our tongue we will prevail; Our lips are our own; Who is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH over us?”
“For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, Now I will arise,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I will set him in the safety for which he yearns.”
The Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are pure Dabar, Like silver tried in a furnace of the Arath, Purified seven times.
You shall keep them, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, You shall preserve them from this generation forever.
The wicked prowl on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, how long will you forget me? How long will you look the other way?
How long must I struggle with anguish in my soul, with sorrow in my heart every day? How long will my enemy have the upper hand?
Turn and answer me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! Restore the sparkle to my eyes, or I will die.
Do not let my enemies rejoice, by saying, “We have defeated him!” Do not let them rejoice at my downfall.
But I trust in your unfailing love. I will rejoice because you have rescued me.
I will sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because He is good to me.
Only fools say in their hearts, “There is no 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. They are corrupt, and their actions are evil; not one of them does good!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH looks down from Shamaym upon the children of men, to see if anyone is truly wise, and seeks 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
But no, all have turned away; all have become corrupt. No one does good, not a single one!
Will those who do evil never learn? They eat up my people like bread and would not think of praying to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Terror will grip them, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is with those who obey Him.
The wicked frustrate the plans of the oppressed, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will protect his people.
Who will come from Mount Ziun to rescue Yashar'AL? When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH restores His people, Ya'aqub will shout with joy, and Yashar'AL will rejoice.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who may dwell in your sanctuary? Who may enter your presence on your qadash hill?
Those who lead blameless lives and do what is right, speaking the truth from sincere hearts.
Those who refuse to gossip or harm their neighbors or speak evil of their friends.
Those who despise sinners, and honor the faithful followers of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and they keep their promises even when it hurts.
Those who lend money without charging interest, and who cannot be bribed to lie about the innocent. Such people will stand firm forever.
Keep me safe, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for I have come to you for refuge.
I said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “You are my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! I have no good beside you.”
The righteous people in the land are my true heroes! I take pleasure in them!
Troubles multiply for those who chase after other nations pagan idols. I will not take part in their sacrifices of blood or even speak the names of their idols.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH you alone are my inheritance, my cup of Barakah. You guard all that is mine.
The land you have given me is a pleasant land. What a wonderful inheritance!
I will barak 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who guides me; even at night my heart instructs me.
I know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is always with me. I will not be shaken, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is right beside me.
No wonder my heart is glad, and I rejoice. My body rests in safety.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not leave my soul among the dead or allow your qadash one to rot in the grave.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will show me the way of life, granting me the joy of His presence and the pleasures of living with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, hear my plea for justice. Listen to my cry for help. Pay attention to my prayer, for it comes from honest lips.
Declare me innocent, for you see those who do right.
You have tested my thoughts and examined my heart in the night. You have scrutinized me and found nothing wrong. I am determined not to sin in what I say.
I have followed your commandments, which keep me from following cruel and evil people.
My steps have stayed on your path; I have not wavered from following you.
I am praying to you because I know you will answer, O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. listen as I pray.
Show me your unfailing Ahaba (love) in wonderful ways. By your mighty power you rescue those who seek refuge from their enemies.
Guard me always, keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me in the shadow of your wings.
Protect me from wicked people who attack me, protect me from murderous enemies who surround me.
They are without pity. Listen to their boasting!
They track me down and surround me, watching for the chance to throw me to the ground.
They are like hungry lions, eager to tear me apart, like young lions hiding in ambush.
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Stand against them, and bring them to their knees! Rescue me from the wicked with your sword!

By the power of your hand, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, destroy those who look to this world for their reward. But satisfy the hunger of your treasured ones. May their children have plenty, leaving an inheritance for their descendants.
Because I am righteous, I will see you. When I am awake, I will see you face to face and be satisfied.
I will love You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, my strength.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer; My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, my strength, in whom I will trust; My shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
I will call upon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who is worthy to be Yadah; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
The pangs of death surrounded me, And the floods of Unrighteousness made me afraid.
The sorrows of hell surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.
In my distress I called upon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And cried out to my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH; He heard my voice from His Qadash house, And my cry came before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, even to His ears.
Then the Arath shook and trembled; The foundations of the hills also quaked and were shaken, Because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was angry.
Smoke went up from His nostrils, And devouring fire came from the mouth of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; Coals were kindled.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH opened the Shamaym also, and came down With darkness under His feet.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rode upon a charub, and flew; He flew upon the wings of the wind.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made darkness His secret place; His canopy around Him was dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
From the brightness before Him, His thick clouds passed with hailstones and coals of fire.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH thundered from Shamaym, And the Voice of the Most High resounded amid the hailstones and coals of fire.
He sent out His arrows and scattered the foe, Lightnings in abundance, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH vanquished them.
Then the channels of the sea were seen, The foundations of the world were uncovered At Your rebuke, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, At the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reached down from above and rescued me; He drew me out of many waters.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH delivered me from my strong enemies, From those who hated me, For they were too strong for me.
They confronted me in the day of my calamity, But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was my support.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also brought me out into a broad place; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH delivered me because He delighted in me.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands He has recompensed me.
For I have kept the ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And have not wickedly departed from my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
For all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's judgements were before me, And I did not put away from me the degrees of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
I was also blameless before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And I kept myself from my iniquity.
Therefore 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
With the merciful You will show Yourself merciful; With a blameless man You will show Yourself blameless;
With the pure You will show Yourself pure; And with the devious You will show Yourself shrewd.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will save the humble people, But will bring down haughty looks.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will light my lamp; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will light up my darkness.
For by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH I can run against a troop, By my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH I can leap over a wall.
As for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, His way is perfect; The Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is proven; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is a shield to all who trust in Him.
For who is 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, except 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? And who is a rock, except our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH?
It is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who arms me with strength, And makes my way perfect.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH makes my feet like the feet of deer, And sets me on my high places.
He teaches my hands to make war, So that my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
You have also given me the shield of Your salvation; Your right hand has held me up, Your gentleness has made me great.
You enlarged my path under me, So my feet did not slip.
I have pursued my enemies and overtaken them; Neither did I turn back again till they were destroyed.
I have wounded them, So that they could not rise; They have fallen under my feet.
For You have armed me with strength for the battle; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has subdued under me those who rose up against me.
You have also given me the necks of my enemies, So that I destroyed those who hated me.
They cried out, but there was none to save; Even to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but He did not answer them.
Then I beat them as fine as the dust before the wind; I cast them out like dirt in the streets.
You have delivered me from the strivings of the people; You have made me the head of the nations; A people I have not known shall serve me.
As soon as they hear of me they obey me; The foreigners submit to me.
The foreigners fade away, And come frightened from their hideouts.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives! Baraked be my Rock! Let the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of my salvation be exalted.
It is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who pays back those who harm me, And subdues them under me;
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH delivers me from my enemies. And also lifted me up above those who rise against me; You have delivered me from the violent man.
Therefore I will give Tudah (thanks) to You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, among the other nations, And sing Yadah to Your Qadash Name.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives great deliverance to His king, And shows mercy to His anointed, To Daud and his descendants forevermore.
The Shamaym declare the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; And the firmament shows the handiworks of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Day after day they continue to speak, And night after night reveals knowledge.
There is no speech nor language Where their voice is not heard.
Their line has gone out through all the Arath, and their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tabernacle for the sun,
Which is like a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, And rejoices like a strong man to run its race.
Its rising is from one end of Shamaym, And its circuit to the other end; And there is nothing hidden from its heat.
The Turah (law) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is perfect, converting the soul; The testimony of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is sure, making wise the simple;
The statutes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are right, rejoicing the heart; The commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are pure, enlightening the eyes;
The fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is clean, enduring forever; The judgments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are true and righteous altogether.
More to be desired are they than gold, Yes, than much fine gold; Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
Moreover by them Your servant is warned, And in keeping them there is great reward.
Who can understand his errors? Cleanse me from secret faults.
Keep back Your servant also from presumptuous sins; Let them not have dominion over me. Then I shall be blameless, And I shall be innocent of great transgression.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Be acceptable in Your sight, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, my strength and my Redeemer.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH answer you in the day of trouble; May the name of the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ya'aqub defend you;
May He send you help from the sanctuary, And strengthen you out of Ziun;
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH remember all your offerings, And accept your burnt sacrifice.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH grant you according to your heart’s desire, And fulfill all your purpose.
We will rejoice in your salvation, And in the name of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH we will set up our banners! May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH fulfill all your petitions.
Now I know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saves His anointed; He will answer him from His Qadash Shamaym with the saving strength of His right hand.
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will remember the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
They have bowed down and fallen; But we have risen and stand upright.
Give victory to our king, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Answer our cry for help.
How the king rejoices in your strength, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! he shouts with joy because you give him victory.
For you have given him his heart’s desire; you have withheld nothing he requested.
You welcomed him back with success and prosperity. You placed a crown of finest gold on his head.
He asked you to preserve his life, and you granted his request. The days of his life stretch on forever.
Your victory brings him great honor, and you have clothed him with splendor and majesty.
You have endowed the king with eternal Barakah and given him the joy of your presence.
For the king trusts in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. The unfailing love of the Most High will keep him from stumbling.
You will capture all your enemies. Your strong right hand will seize all who hate you.
You will throw them in a flaming furnace when you appear. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will consume them in his anger; fire will devour them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will wipe their children from the face of the Arath; they will never have descendants.
Although they plot against you, their evil schemes will never succeed.
For they will turn and run when they see your arrows aimed at them.
Rise up, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, in all your power. With music and singing we celebrate your mighty acts, Tudah Raba 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH
My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, why have You forsaken Me? Why are You so far from helping Me, And from the words of My groaning?
O My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I cry in the daytime, but You do not hear; And in the night season, and am not silent.
But You are Qadash, Enthroned in the Yadah of Yashar'AL.
Our fathers trusted in You; and You delivered them.
They cried to You, and were delivered; They trusted in You, and were not ashamed.
But I am a worm, and no man; A reproach of men, and despised by the people.
All those who see Me ridicule Me; They shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
“He trusted in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, let Him rescue Him; Let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH deliver Him, since He delights in Him!”
But You are the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who took Me out of the womb; You made Me trust while on My mother’s breasts.
I was cast upon You from birth. From My mother’s womb 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has been My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Be not far from Me, For trouble is near; For there is none to help.
Many bulls have surrounded Me; Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled Me.
They gape at Me with their mouths, Like a raging and roaring lion.
I am poured out like water, And all My bones are out of joint; My heart is like wax; It has melted within Me.
My strength is dried up like a potsherd, And My tongue clings to My jaws; You have brought Me to the dust of death.
For dogs have surrounded Me; The congregation of the wicked has enclosed Me. They pierced My hands and My feet;
I can count all My bones. They look and stare at Me.
They divide My garments among them, And for My clothing they cast lots.
But You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, do not be far from Me; O My Strength, hasten to help Me!
Deliver Me from the sword, My precious life from the power of the dog.
Save Me from the lion’s mouth and from the horns of the wild oxen! You have answered Me.
I will declare Your Name to My brethren; In the midst of the assembly I will Yadah You.
You who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! All you descendants of Ya'aqub, Esteemed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And fear Him, all you offspring of Yashar'AL!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; Nor has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hidden His face from Him; But when he cried to Him, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heard.
My Yadah shall be of You in the great assembly; I will pay My vows before those who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The poor shall eat and be satisfied; Those who seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Let your heart live forever!
All the ends of the world Shall remember and turn to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And all the families of the nations Shall worship before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For the kingdom is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s, And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rules over the nations.
Let all the rich of the Arath eat and worship; All those who go down to the dust Shall bow before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Even he who cannot keep himself alive.
Our children will serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And future generations will hear the wonders of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
They will come and declare the righteousness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to a people who will be born, That 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done this wonders.
YAHUAH_𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 is my shepherd; I have all that I need and I am satisfied.
YAHUAH_𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄 makes me to lie down in green pastures; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH leads me beside the still waters.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH restores my soul; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH leads me in the paths of righteousness For His Name’s sake.
Even, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil; For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is with me; His rod and staff protect and comfort me.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH prepared a table for me in the presence of my enemies; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also anointed my head with oil; My cup runs over.
Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me All the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Forever.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH owns the Arath and everything in it, The world and those who dwell in it belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has founded the Arath upon the seas, And established it upon the waters.
Who may ascend into the hill of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Or who may stand in His Qadash place?
He who has clean hands and a pure heart, Who has not lifted up his soul to an idol, Nor sworn deceitfully.
He shall receive Barakah from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And righteousness from the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of his salvation.
This is Ya'aqub, the generation of those who seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Who seek Your face.
Lift up your heads, O you gates! And be lifted up, you everlasting doors! And the King of Kabad shall come in.
Who is this King of Kabad? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH strong and mighty ,𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, O you gates! Lift up, you everlasting doors! And the King of Kabad shall come in.
Who is this King of Kabad? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, He is the King of Kabad. Halalu'YAHUAH

I have a message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in my heart concerning the sinfulness of the wicked: There is no fear of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH before their eyes.

They devise wickedness on their bed; they sets themselves in a way that is not good; they do abhor evil.
Your mercy, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, is in the Shamaym; Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.

Let not the foot of the prideful person come against me and let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, And your justice as the noonday.

the righteous is ever merciful, and helpful; And his descendants are Baraked.

O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your rage!

My wounds fester and stink because of my foolish sins.

for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will preserve you and keep you alive, And you will be Baraked on the Arath; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not deliver you to the will of your enemies.

Baraked be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL From everlasting to everlasting, Halalu'YAHUAH.

my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! Now I am deeply discouraged, but I will remember 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH even from distant Mount Harmun, the source of the Yurdan, from the land of Mount Mizar.

Because of the voice of him who reproaches and reviles, Because of the enemy and the avenger.

Why do You hide Your face, And forget our affliction and our oppression?
For our soul is bowed down to the dust; Our body clings to the ground.
Arise for our help, And redeem us for Your mercies’ sake.
Beautiful words stir my heart. I will recite a lovely poem about the king, for my tongue is like the pen of a skillful poet.
You are the most handsome of all. Awesome words stream from your lips. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself has Baraked you forever.
Put on your sword, O mighty warrior! You are so great, so majestic!
In your majesty, ride out to victory, defending truth, humility, and justice. Go forth to perform awe-inspiring deeds!
Your arrows are sharp, piercing your enemies hearts. The nations fall beneath your feet.
Your throne, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, endures forever and ever. You rule with a scepter of justice.
You love justice and hate evil. Therefore 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, has anointed you, pouring out the oil of joy on you more than on anyone else.
Myrrh, aloes, and cassia perfume your robes. In ivory palaces the music of strings entertains you.
King's daughters are among your noble women. At your right side stands the queen, wearing jewelry of finest gold from Ophir!
Listen to me, O royal daughter; take to heart what I say. Forget your people and your family far away.
For your royal husband delights in your beauty; honor him, for he is your master.
The princess of Tyra will shower you with gifts. The wealthy will beg your favor.
The bride, a princess, looks awesome in her golden gown.
In her beautiful robes, she is led to the king, accompanied by her bridesmaids.
What a joyful and enthusiastic procession as they enter the king’s palace!
Your sons will become kings like their father. You will make them rulers over many lands.
I will bring honor to your Name in every generation. Therefore, the nations will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever and ever.
Yes 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
Therefore we will not fear, Even though the Arath be removed, And though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
Though its waters roar and be troubled, Though the mountains shake with its swelling.
There is a river whose streams shall make glad the city of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, The qadash place of the tabernacle of the Most High.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is in the midst of her, she will not be moved; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will help her, just at the break of dawn.
The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved; He uttered His voice, the Arath melted.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is with us; The 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ya'aqub is our refuge.
Come, behold the works of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Who has made desolations in the Arath.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH makes wars cease to the end of the Arath; He breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH burns the chariot in the fire.
Be still, and know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the Arath!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is with us; the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ya'aqub is our refuge.
Oh, clap your hands, all you peoples! Shout to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with the voice of triumph!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is awesome; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is a great Ruler over all the Arath.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will subdue the people under us, And the nations under our feet.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will choose our inheritance for us, The excellence of Ya'aqub whom He loves.
Yes' 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has gone up with a shout, and with the sound of a trumpet.
Sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Sing Yadah to our Ruler, sing Yadah!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the Ruler of all the Arath; Sing Yadah with understanding.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reigns over the nations; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sits on His Qadash throne.
The princes of the people have gathered together, The people of the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Abraham. For the shields of the Arath belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is greatly exalted.

They shoot from ambush at the innocent, attacking suddenly and fearlessly.
They encourage each other to do evil and plan how to set their traps in secret. “Who will ever notice?” they ask.
As they plot their crimes, they say, “We have devised the perfect plan!” Yes, their heart and mind are cunning.
But my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH himself will shoot them with his arrows, suddenly striking them down.
Their own tongues will ruin them, and all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.
Then everyone will be afraid; they will proclaim the mighty acts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and realize all the amazing things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does.
The righteous will rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and find shelter in Him, and those who do what is right will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Mighty Yadah belongs You O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, in Ziun, We will fulfill our vows to you,
for You answer our prayers. All of us must come to you.
Though we are overwhelmed by our sins, you forgive them all.
Great joy for those you choose to bring near, those who live in your Qadash courts. Great festivities await us inside your qadash house.
You faithfully answer our prayers with awesome deeds, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our savior. You are the hope of everyone on the Arath, even those who sail on distant seas.
You formed the mountains by your power and armed yourself with mighty strength.
You quieted the raging oceans with their pounding waves and silenced the shouting of the nations.
Those who live at the ends of the Arath stand in awe of your wonders. From where the sun rises to where it sets, you inspire shouts of joy.
You take care of the Arath and water it, making it rich and fertile. The river of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has plenty of water; it provides a bountiful harvest of grain, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has ordered it so.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH drench the plowed ground with rain, melting the clods and leveling the ridges. You soften the Arath with showers and barak its abundant crops.
You crown the year with a bountiful harvest; even the hard pathways overflow with abundance.
The grasslands of the wilderness become a lush pasture, and the hillsides blossom with joy.
The meadows are clothed with flocks of sheep, and the valleys are carpeted with grain. They all shout and sing for joy!
Make a joyful shout to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all the Arath!
Sing out the honor of His Name; Make the Yadah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH awesome.
Say to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “How awesome are Your works! Through the greatness of Your power Your enemies shall submit themselves to You.
All the Arath shall worship You And sing to Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; They shall sing Yadah to Your Name.
Come and see the works of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; He is awesome in His doing toward the sons of men.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot. There we will rejoice in Him.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rules by His power forever; the eyes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH observe the nations; Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves.
Oh, barak our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, you peoples! and make the voice of His Yadah to be heard,
Who keeps our soul among the living, and does not allow our feet to be moved.
For You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have tested us; You have refined us as silver is refined.
You brought us into the net; You laid affliction on our backs.
You have caused men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But You brought us out to rich fulfillment.
I will go into Your house with burnt offerings; I will pay You my vows,
Which my lips have uttered and my mouth has spoken when I was in trouble.
I will offer You burnt sacrifices of fat animals, With the sweet aroma of rams; I will offer bulls with goats.
Come and hear, all you who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And I will declare what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done for my soul.
I cried to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with my mouth, And He was extolled with my tongue.
If I regard iniquity in my heart, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not hear.
But certainly my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has heard me; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has attended to the voice of my prayer.
Baraked be my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, Who has not turned away my prayer, Nor His mercy from me!
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be merciful to us and barak us, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shine Your face upon us,
That Your way may be known on the Arath, and your salvation among all nations.
Let the Nations Yadah You 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, yes may all the nations Yadah You.
Oh, let the nations be glad and sing for joy! For You shall judge the people righteously, And govern the nations on the Arath.
Let all the people of all nations Yadah You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Let all the people Yadah You.
Then the Arath shall yield her increase; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our own 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will barak us.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shall barak us, And all the ends of the Arath shall fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Let our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH arise, Let His enemies be scattered; Let those also who hate 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH flee before Him.
As smoke is driven away, So drive them away; As wax melts before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
But let the righteous be glad; Let them rejoice before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; Yes, let them rejoice exceedingly.
Sing to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, sing Yadah to His Name; Exalt Him who rides on the clouds, By His Name 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And rejoice before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
A father of the fatherless, a defender of widows Is 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH in His Qadash habitation.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sets the solitary in families; He brings out those who are bound into prosperity; But the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, when You went out before Your people, When You marched through the wilderness,
The earth shook; The Shamaym also dropped rain at the presence of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH; Sinai itself was moved at the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL.
You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, send a plentiful rain, Whereby You confirmed Your inheritance, When it was weary.
Your congregation dwelt in it; You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, provided from Your goodness for the poor.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had gave His Dabar; and great was the company of those who proclaimed it:
“Kings of armies flee, they flee, and they who remains at home divides the spoil.
Though you lie down among the sheepfolds,You will be like the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.”
When the Almighty scattered kings in it, It was white as snow in Zalmun.
A mountain of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is the mountain of Bashan; A mountain of many peaks is the mountain of Bashan.
Why do you fume with envy, you mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH desires to dwell in; Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will dwell in it forever.
The chariots of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are twenty thousand, Even thousands of thousands; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is among them as in Sinai, in the Qadash Place.
You have ascended on high, You have led captivity captive; You have received gifts among men, even from the rebellious, That 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH might dwell there.
Baraked be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Who daily loads us with benefits, The 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of our salvation!
Our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of salvation; And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH rescued us from death.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will wound the head of His enemies, The hairy scalp of the one who still goes on in his trespasses.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea,
That your foot may crush them in blood, and the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
They have seen Your procession, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, The procession of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, my Ruler, on the sanctuary.
The singers went before the players on instruments followed after; among them were the maidens playing timbrels.
Barak 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the congregations, barak 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from the fountain of Yashar'AL.
There is little Banyamin, their leader, the princes of Yahudah and their company, The princes of Zabulun and the princes of Naphtali.
Your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has commanded your strength; O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, what You have done for us.
Because of Your temple at Yahushalam, Kings will bring presents to You.
Rebuke the beasts of the reeds, The herd of bulls with the calves of the people, Till everyone submits himself with pieces of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
Envoys will come out of Mitzraym; Athiupia will quickly stretch out her hands to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you kingdoms of the Arath; Oh, sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
Sing Yadah To 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who rides on the Shamaym of Shamaym, which were of old! Indeed, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sends out His voice, a mighty voice.
Ascribe strength to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; His excellence is over Yashar'AL, And His strength is in the clouds.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, You are more awesome than Your Qadash places. The 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL is He who gives strength and power to His people. Baraked be our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH!
Deliver me, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, because the waters are up to my neck.
I am sinking in deep mire, and there is no solid ground. I have come into deep water, and the flood overwhelms me.
I am exhausted from calling for help. My throat is parched. My eyes are strained from looking for my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Those who hate me without cause are more than the hairs of my head. My persecutors are mighty, and they want to destroy me, must I be forced to return what I did not steal?
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, you know my sins, and my guilt is not hidden from you.
Do not let those who look up to you be ashamed because of me, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, Let not those who seek you be humiliated because of me, 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL.
I am being mocked because of you. Dishonor overwhelms me.
I am a stranger to my brothers, a foreigner to my mother’s sons.
Zeal for your house consumes me, and the mockeries of those who insult you fall on me.
I weep and fast, and I am mocked for it.
When I am dressed in sackcloth, I became an object of gossip among them.
The prominent people mock me, composing drinking songs.
As for me O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, may my prayer to you come at a favorable time, in the abundance of Your love, answer me with Your sure deliverance.
Rescue me from the mud and do not let me sink. Rescue me from those who hate me, and from the deep waters.
Let neither the floodwaters overwhelm me nor let the deep swallow me up, nor the mouth of the well close over me.
Answer me O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for your love is good; Turn to me in keeping with your great compassion,
and do not ignore your servant, because I am in distress. Hurry to answer me!
Draw near and redeem me; ransom me because of my enemies.
Truly you know my reproach, shame, and dishonor. All my enemies are known to you.
Insults broke my heart. I despaired and looked for sympathy; but there was none, I looked for comforters, but I found none.
They put poison in my food, in my thirst they forced me to drink vinegar.
May their dining tables entrap them, and become a snare for their allies.
May their eyes be blinded and may their bodies tremble continuously.
May you pour out your fury on them. May your burning anger overtake them.
May their camp become desolate and their tents remain unoccupied.
For they persecute those whom you have struck, and they brag about the pain of those you have wounded.
May you punish them for their crimes; may they receive no verdict of innocence from you.
May they be erased from the Book of Life, and their names not be written with the righteous.
As for me, I am afflicted and hurting; O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your deliverance establish me on high.
Let me Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with a song that I may magnify 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with thanksgiving.
That will please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH more than oxen and bulls with horns and hooves.
The afflicted will watch and rejoice. May you who seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH take courage.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH listens to the needy and does not despise those in bondage.
Let the Shamaym and Arath Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, along with the sea and its swarming creatures.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will deliver Ziun and will rebuild the cities of Yahudah so they may live there and possess them.
The descendants of his servants will inherit it, and those who cherish his Name will live there.
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, come to my rescue. O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hurry to help me.
May those who seek to kill me be publicly humiliated. May those who take pleasure in my harm be turned back in humiliation.
May those who say “Aha! Aha!” be turned back because of their shameful deeds.
Let those who seek you greatly rejoice in you. Let those who love your deliverance say, “May 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH be continuously exalted.”
As for me, I am poor and needy, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, come quickly to me. You are my helper and my deliverer. O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH please do not delay.
In you O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH I take refuge; let me never be humiliated.
Rescue and deliver me, because you are righteous. Turn your ear to me and save me.
Be my sheltering refuge where I may go continuously; command my deliverance for you are my rock and fortress.
My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, deliver me from the power of the wicked and the grasp of ruthless practicers of evil.
For you are my hope, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, my security since I was young.
I depended on you since birth, when you brought me from my mother’s womb; I Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH continuously.
I have become an example to many that you are my strong refuge.
My mouth is filled with your Yadah and your splendor daily.
Do not throw me away when I am old; do not abandon me when my strength fails.
For my enemies talk against me; those who seek to kill me plot together
and say, his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has abandoned him, run after him and seize him, because there is no deliverer.”
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, do not be distant from me, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, come quickly to help me.
Let my adversaries be ashamed and consumed; let those who seek my destruction be covered with scorn and shame.
As for me, I will hope continuously and will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH more and more.
I will declare your righteousness and your salvation every day, though I do not fully understand what the outcome will be.
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I will come in the power of your mighty acts, remembering your righteousness, yours alone.
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, you taught me from my youth, so I am still declaring your awesome deeds.
Also, when I reach old age and have gray hair, do not forsake me, until I have declared your power to this generation and your might to the next generation.
Your many righteous deeds are great,
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who can compare to you, who caused me to experience troubles that were numerous and disastrous? You will return to revive me and lift me up from the depths of the Arath.
You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
I also will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with the harp; because of your faithfulness, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with the lyre, Oh Qadash One of Yashar'AL.
My lips will shout for joy when I sing to Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, whose life you have redeemed.
Moreover, my tongue will speak all day about your justice; for those who seek my destruction will be utterly humiliated.
Give your love of justice to the king, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and righteousness to the king’s son.
Help him judge your people in the right way; let the poor always be treated fairly.
May the mountains yield prosperity for all, and may the hills be fruitful.
Help him to defend the poor, to rescue the children of the needy, and to crush their oppressors.
May they fear you as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains in the sky. Yes, forever!
May the king’s rule be refreshing like spring rain on freshly cut grass, like the showers that water the Arath.
May all the righteous flourish during his reign. May there be abundant prosperity until the moon is no more.
May he reign from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates River to the ends of the Arath.
Desert nomads will bow before him; his enemies will fall before him in the dust.
The western kings of Tarshish and other distant lands will bring him tribute. The eastern kings of Shaba and Saba will bring him gifts.
All kings will bow before him, and all nations will serve him.
He will rescue the poor when they cry to him; he will help the oppressed, who have no one to defend them.
He feels pity for the weak and the needy, and he will rescue them.
He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their lives are precious to him.
Long live the king! May the gold of Shaba be given to him. May the people always pray for him and barak him all day long.
May there be abundant grain throughout the land, flourishing even on the hilltops. May the fruit trees flourish like the trees of Labanun, and may the people thrive like grass in a field.
May the king’s name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun shines. May all nations be Baraked through him and bring him praise.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, who alone does such wonderful things.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever! Let the whole Arath be filled with the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. So be it and so be it!
(This ends the prayers of Daud son of Yassa.)
Truly 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good to Yashar'AL, to those whose hearts are pure.
But as for me, I almost lost my footing, my feet were slipping, and I was almost gone.
For I envied the proud when I saw them prosper despite their wickedness.
They seem to live such painless lives; their bodies are so healthy and strong.
They do not have troubles like other people; they are not plagued with problems like everyone else.
They wear pride like a jeweled necklace and clothe themselves with cruelty.
These fat cats have everything their hearts could ever wish for!
They scoff and speak only evil; in their pride they seek to crush others.
They boast against the very Shamaym, and their words strut throughout the Arath.
And so the people are dismayed and confused, drinking in all their words.
“What does 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH know?” they ask. “Does the Most High even know what is happening?”
Look at these wicked people enjoying a life of ease while their riches multiply.
Did I keep my heart pure for nothing? Did I keep myself innocent for no reason?
I get nothing but trouble all day long; every morning brings me pain.
If I had really spoken this way to others, I would have been a traitor to your people.
So I tried to understand why the wicked prosper. But what a difficult task it is!
Then I went into your sanctuary, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and I finally understood the destiny of the wicked.
Truly, you put them on a slippery path and send them sliding over the cliff to destruction.
In an instant they are destroyed, completely swept away by terrors.
When you arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you will laugh at their silly ideas as a person laughs at dreams in the morning.
Then I realized that my heart was bitter, and I was all torn up inside.
I was so foolish and ignorant, I must have seemed like a senseless animal to you.
Yet I still belong to you; O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hold my right hand.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH guide me with His counsel, leading me to a awesome destiny.
Whom have I in Shamaym but you? I desire you more than anything on the Arath.
My health may fail, and my spirit may grow weak, but my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH remains the strength of my heart; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is mine forever.
Those who desert him will perish, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroyed those who abandon Him.
But as for me, how good it is to be near my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! I have made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut my shelter, and I will tell everyone about the wonderful things He does.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, why have you rejected us so long? Why is your anger so intense against the sheep of your own pasture?
Remember that we are the people you chose long ago, the tribe you redeemed as your own special possession! And remember Yahushalam, your home here on the Arath.
Walk through the awful ruins of the city; see how the enemy has destroyed your sanctuary.
There your enemies shouted their victorious battle cries; there they set up their battle standards.
They swung their axes like woodcutters in a forest.
With axes and picks, they smashed the carved paneling.
They burned your sanctuary to the ground. They defiled the place that bears your Name.
Then they thought, Let us destroy everything so they burned down all the places where 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was worshiped.
We no longer see your miraculous signs. All the Nabyms are gone, and no one can tell us when it will end.
How long, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, will you allow our enemies to insult you? Will you let them dishonor your Name forever?
Why do you hold back your strong right hand? Unleash your powerful fist and destroy them.
You, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, are my king from ages past, bringing salvation to the Arath.
You split the sea by your strength and smashed the heads of the sea monsters.
You crushed the heads of Laviathan and let the desert animals eat him.
You caused the springs and streams to gush forth, and you dried up rivers that never run dry.
Both day and night belong to you; you made the starlight and the sun.
You set the boundaries of the Arath, and you made both summer and winter.
See how these enemies insult you 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. A foolish nation has dishonored your Name.
Do not let these wild beasts destroy your turtledoves. Do not forget your people who are suffering forever.
Remember your covenant promises, for the land is full of darkness and violence!
Do not let the downtrodden be humiliated again. Instead, let the poor and needy Yadah your Name.
Arise, O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and defend your cause. Remember how these fools insult you all day long.
Do not overlook what your enemies have said or their growing uproar.
We Tudah Raba, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! We give Tudah because you are near. People everywhere tell of your wonderful deeds.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “At the time I have planned, I will bring justice against the wicked.
When the Arath quakes and its people live in turmoil, I am the one who keeps its foundations firm.
“I warned the proud, ‘Stop your boasting!’ I told the wicked, ‘Do not raise your fists!
Do not lift your horns against shamaym in defiance or speak with such arrogance.’”
For no one on the Arath, from east or west, or even from the wilderness, should raise a defiant fist.
It is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who judges; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH decides who will rise and who will fall.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH holds a cup in His hand that is full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours out the wine in judgment, and all the wicked must drink it, draining it to the dregs.
But as for me, I will always proclaim what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done; I will sing Yadah to the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ya'aqub.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I will break the strength of the wicked, but I will increase the power of the righteous.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is honored in Yahudah; and His Name is great in Yashar'AL.
Yahushalam is where 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives; Mount Ziun is His home.
There He has broken the fiery arrows of the enemy, the shields and swords and weapons of war.
You are Esteemed and more majestic than the everlasting mountains.
Our boldest enemies have been plundered. They lie before us in the sleep of death. No warrior could lift a hand against us.
At the blast of your breath, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ya'aqub, their horses and chariots lay still.
No wonder you are greatly feared! Who can stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH when His anger explodes?
From Shamaym you sentenced your enemies; the Arath trembled and stood silent before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You stand up to judge those who do evil, and to rescue the oppressed of the Arath.
Man's defiance only enhances your Kabad, for You use it as a weapon.
Make vows to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and keep them. Let everyone bring tribute to the Awesome One.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH breaks the pride of princes, and the kings of the Arath fear him.
I cry out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; yes, I shout. Oh, that my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH would listen to me!
When I was in deep trouble, I searched for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. All night long I prayed, with hands lifted toward Shamaym, but my soul was not comforted.
I think of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and I moan, overwhelmed with longing for His help.
You do not let me sleep. I am too distressed even to pray!
I think of the good old days, long since ended,
when my nights were filled with joyful songs. I search my soul and ponder the difference now.
Has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rejected me forever? Will He never again be kind to me?
Is His unfailing love gone forever? Has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH promises permanently failed?
Has my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH forgotten to be kind? has He slammed the door on his compassion?
And I said, “This is my fate; the Most High has turned his hand against me.”
But then I recall all you have done, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I remember your wonderful deeds of long ago.
They are constantly in my thoughts. I cannot stop thinking about the mighty works of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, your ways are Qadash. Is there any deities as mighty as you?
You are the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of great wonders! You demonstrate your awesome power among the nations.
By your strong arm, you redeemed your people, the descendants of Ya'aqub and Ya'asaf.
When the Red Sea saw You, its waters looked and trembled! The sea quaked to its very depths.
The clouds poured down rain; the thunder rumbled in the sky. Your arrows of lightning flashed.
Your thunder roared from the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world! The Arath trembled and shook.
Your road led through the sea, your pathway through the mighty waters, a pathway no one knew was there!
You led your people along that road like a flock of sheep, with Musha and Aarun as their shepherds.
O my people, listen to my instructions. Open your ears to what I am saying,
for I will speak to you in a parable. I will teach you hidden lessons from our past
stories we have heard and known, stories our ancestors handed down to us.

We will not hide these truths from our children; we will tell the next generation about the awesome deeds of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, we will also tell our children about the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and His mighty wonders.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH issued His laws to Ya'aqub; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave his instructions to Yashar'AL, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded our ancestors to teach them to their children,
so the next generation might know them, even the children not yet born, and they in turn will teach their own children.
So each generation should set its hope anew on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, not forgetting his awesome miracles and obeying his commandments.
Then they will not be like their ancestors, stubborn, rebellious, and unfaithful, refusing to give their hearts to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The warriors of Aphraim, though armed with bows, turned their backs and fled on the day of battle.
They did not keep the covenant 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and refused to live by His instructions.
They forgot what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had done the great wonders He had shown them,
the miracles 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did for their ancestors on the plain of Zuan in the land of Mitzraym.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH divided the sea and led them through, making the water stand up like walls!
In the daytime 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH led them by a cloud, and in the night by a pillar of fire.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH split open the rocks in the wilderness to give them water, as from a gushing spring.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made streams pour from the rock, making the waters flow down like a river!
Yet they sinned even more against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they kept rebelling against the Most High 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the desert.
They stubbornly tested 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in their hearts, demanding the foods they craved.
They even spoke against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself, saying, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH cannot give us food in the wilderness.
Yes, He can strike a rock so water gushes out, but he cannot give his people bread and meat.”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heard them, he was furious. The fire of his wrath burned against Ya'aqub. Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's anger rose against Yashar'AL,
For they did not believe 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH or trust Him to care for them.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded the skies to open; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH opened the doors of Shamaym.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rained down manna for them to eat; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave them bread from Shamaym.
They ate the food of Malakym! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave them all they could hold.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH released the east wind in the Shamaym and guided the south wind by His mighty power.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rained down meat as thick as dust, birds as plentiful as the sand on the seashore!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH caused the birds to fall within their camp and all around their tents.
The people ate their fill. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave them what they craved.
But before they satisfied their craving, while the meat was yet in their mouths,
the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rose against them, and he killed their strongest men. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH struck down the finest of Yashar'AL’s young men.
But in spite of this, the people kept living in sin, Despite 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's wonders, they refused to trust Him.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH ended their lives in failure, their years in terror.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH began killing them, they finally sought him. They repented and took their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH seriously.
Then they remembered that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was their rock, that the Most High was their redeemer.
But all they gave him was lip service; they lied to Him with their tongues.
Their hearts were not loyal to Him. They did not keep 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's covenant.
Yet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was merciful and forgave their sins and did not destroy them all. Many times He held back his anger and did not unleash his fury!
For He remembered that they were merely mortal, gone like a breath of wind that never returns.
Oh, how often they rebelled against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the wilderness and grieved His heart in that dry wasteland.
Again and again they tested the patience of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and provoked the Qadash One of Yashar'AL.
They did not remember the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rescued them from their enemies.
