They did not remember the miraculous signs of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in Mitzraym, and His wonders on the plain of Zuan.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turned their rivers into blood, so no one could drink from the streams.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent vast swarms of flies to consume them and hordes of frogs to ruin them.
He gave their crops to caterpillars; their harvest was consumed by locusts.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroyed their grapevines with hail and shattered their sycamore-figs with sleet.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH abandoned their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loosed on them His fierce anger, all his fury, rage, and hostility. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH dispatched against them a band of destroying Malakym.
He turned his anger against them; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not spare the lives of the Mitzraym but ravaged them with the plague.
He killed the oldest sons of each family in Mitzraym, the flower of youth throughout the land of Mitzraym.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH led His own people like a flock of sheep, guiding them safely through the wilderness.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH kept them safe so they were not afraid; but the sea covered their enemies.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought them to the border of his Qadash land, to this land of hills he had won for them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH drove out the nations before them; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave them their inheritance by lot. He settled the tribes of Yashar'AL into their homes.
But they kept testing and rebelling against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut. They did not obey the Turah (laws).
They turned back and were as faithless as their parents. They were as undependable as a crooked bow.
They angered 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by building shrines to other nations idols; they made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH jealous with their idols.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heard them, he was very angry, and he completely rejected Yashar'AL.
Then he abandoned his dwelling at Shiluh, the Tabernacle where he had lived among the people.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH allowed the Ark of His might to be captured; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH surrendered His Kabad into the enemies hands.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave his people over to be butchered by the sword, because He was so angry with His own people, His special possession.
Their young men were killed by fire; their young women died before singing their wedding songs.
Their Kuhanym were slaughtered, and their widows could not mourn their deaths.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rose up as though waking from sleep, like a warrior aroused from a drunken stupor.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH routed His enemies and sent them to eternal shame.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rejected Ya'asaf’s descendants; He did not choose the tribe of Aphraim.
He chose instead the tribe of Yahudah, and Mount Ziun, which he loved.
There 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH built his sanctuary as high as the Shamaym, as solid and enduring as the Arath.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose his servant Daud, calling him from the sheep pens.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH took Daud from tending the ewes and lambs and made him the shepherd of Ya'aqub’s descendants, His own people, Yashar'AL.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH cared for them with a true heart and led them with skillful hands.
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, pagan nations have conquered your land, your special possession. They have defiled your qadash Temple and made Yahushalam a heap of ruins.
They have left the bodies of your servants as food for the birds of Shamaym. The flesh of your righteous ones has become food for the wild animals.
Blood has flowed like water all around Yahushalam; no one is left to bury the dead.
We are mocked by our neighbors, an object of scorn and derision to those around us.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, how long will you be angry with us? Forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?
Pour out your wrath on the nations that refuse to acknowledge you, on kingdoms that do not call upon your Name.
For they have devoured your people Yashar'AL, making the land a desolate wilderness.
Do not hold us guilty for the sins of our fathers! Let your compassion quickly meet our needs, for we are on the brink of despair.
Help us, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of our salvation! Help us for the Kabad of your Name. Save us and forgive our sins for the honor of your name.
Why should pagan nations be allowed to scoff, asking, “Where is their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH? ”Show us your vengeance against the nations, for they have spilled the blood of your servants.
Listen to the moaning of the prisoners. Demonstrate your great power by saving those condemned to die.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, pay back our neighbors seven times for the scorn they have hurled at you.
Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will thank you forever and ever, we will Yadah your greatness from generation to generation.
Please listen, O Shepherd of Yashar'AL, you who lead Ya'asaf like a flock. O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, enthroned above the charubim, display your radiant Kabad
to Aphraim, Banyamin, and Manassah. Show us your mighty power. Come to rescue us!
Turn us again to yourself, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Make your face shine down upon us. Only then will we be saved.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, how long will you be angry with our prayers?
You have fed us with sorrow and made us drink tears by the bucketful.
You have made us the scorn of neighboring nations. Our enemies treat us as a joke.
Turn us to yourself again, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, make your face shine down upon us. Only then will we be saved.
You brought us from Mitzraym like a grapevine; you drove away the pagan nations and transplanted us into your land.
You cleared the ground for us, and we took root and filled the land.
Our shade covered the mountains; our branches covered the mighty cedars.
We spread our branches west to the Mediterranean Sea; our shoots spread east to the Euphrates River.
But now, why have you broken down our walls so that all who pass by may steal our fruit?
The wild boar from the forest devours it, and the wild animals feed on it.
Come back, we beg you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut. Look down from Shamaym and see our plight. Take care of this grapevine
that you yourself have planted, this son you have raised for yourself.
For we are chopped up and burned by our enemies. May they perish at the sight of your frown.
Strengthen the man you love, the son of your choice.
Then we will never abandon you again. Revive us so we can call on your Name once again.
Turn us again to yourself, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut. Make your face shine down upon us. Only then will we be saved.
Sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, our strength. Sing to the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ya'aqub.
Sing! Beat the tambourine. Play the sweet lyre and the harp.
Blow the ram’s horn at new moon, and again at full moon to call a festival!
For this is required by the decrees of Yashar'AL; it is a regulation of the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ya'aqub.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made it a law in Yashar'AL when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH attacked Mitzraym to set us free. I heard an unknown voice say,
“Now I will take the load from your shoulders; I will free your hands from their heavy tasks.
You cried to me in trouble, and I saved you; I answered out of the thundercloud and tested your Amunah (faith) when there was no water at Meribah.
“Listen to me, O my people, while I give you stern warnings. O Yashar'AL, if you would only listen to me!
You must never have a foreign deity; you must not bow down before any idols.
For it was I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who rescued you from the land of Mitzraym, Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it with good things.
“But no, my people would not listen. Yashar'AL did not want me around.
So I let them follow their own stubborn desires, living according to their own ideas.
Oh, that my people would listen to me! Oh, that Yashar'AL would follow me, walking in my paths!
How quickly I would then subdue their enemies! How soon my hands would be upon their foes!
Those who hate 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would cringe before him; they would be doomed forever.
But I would feed you with the finest wheat. I would satisfy you with wild honey from the rock.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH presides over the court of Shamaym, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH pronounces judgment on the mighty ones:
“How long will you hand down unjust decisions by favoring the wicked?
“Give justice to the poor and the orphan; uphold the rights of the oppressed and the destitute.
Rescue the poor and helpless; deliver them from the grasp of evil people.
They know not, neither will they understand; they are so ignorant! They wander about in darkness, while the whole world is shaken to the core.
I say, ‘You are all Aluahym; you are all children of the AL'ALYUN (Most High).
But you will die like mere mortals and fall like every other ruler.’”
Rise up, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and judge the Arath, for all the nations belong to you.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, do not be silent! Do not be deaf. Do not be quiet, O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Do you not hear the uproar of your enemies? Do you not see that your arrogant enemies are rising up?
They devise crafty schemes against your people; they conspire against your precious ones.
“Come, they say, “let us wipe out Yashar'AL as a nation. We will destroy the very memory of its existence.”
Yes, this was their unanimous decision. They signed a treaty as allies against you
these Adumites and Ishmaalite; Muabites and Hagrites;
Gabalites, Ammunites, and Amalakites; and people from Philistia and Tyra.
Assyria has joined them too, and is allied with the descendants of Lut.
Do to them as you did to the Midianites and as you did to Sisara and Yabin at the Kishun River.
They were destroyed at Andur, and their decaying corpses fertilized the soil.
Let their mighty nobles die as Urab and Zaab did, let all their princes die like Zabah and Zalmunna,
for they said, “Let us seize for our own use these pasturelands of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!”
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, scatter them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind!
As a fire burns a forest and as a flame sets mountains ablaze,
chase them with your fierce storm; terrify them with your tempest.
Utterly dishonor them until they submit to your Name, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Let them be ashamed and terrified forever. Let them die in shame.
Then they will learn that you alone are called 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that you alone are the Most High, supreme over all the Arath (earth).
How lovely is your dwelling place, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
I long, yes, I faint with longing to enter the courts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. With my whole being, body and soul, I will shout joyfully to the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Even the sparrow finds a home, and the swallow builds her nest and raises her young at a place near your altar, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH!
What joy for those who can live in your house, always singing your Yadah.
What joy for those whose strength comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who have set their heart and minds on Ziun.
When they walk through the Valley of Weeping, it will become a place of refreshing springs. The autumn rains will clothe it with Barakah.
They will continue to grow stronger, and each of them will appear before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in Yahushalam.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, hear my prayer. Listen, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ya'aqub.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, look with favor upon the king, our shield! Show favor to the one you have anointed.
A single day in your courts is better than a thousand anywhere else! I would rather be a gatekeeper in the house of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH than live the good life in the homes of the wicked.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is our sun and our shield, and He gives us favors and Kabad, He will not withhold good things from those who do what is right.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, there is joy for those who trust in you.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you poured out Barakah to your land! You restored the fortunes of Yashar'AL.
You forgave the guilt of your people yes, you covered all their sins.
You held back your fury. You kept back your blazing anger.
Now restore us again, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of our salvation. Put aside your anger against us once more.
Will you be angry with us always? Will you prolong your wrath to all generations?
Will you not revive us again, so your people can rejoice in you?
Show us your unfailing love, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and grant us your salvation.
I listen carefully to what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is saying, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH speaks Shalum to his faithful people. But let them not return to their foolish ways.
Surely his salvation is near to those who fear him, so our land will be filled with his Kabad.
Unfailing love and truth have met together. Righteousness and Shalum have kissed!
Truth springs up from the Arath, and righteousness smiles down from Shamaym.
Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH pours down his Barakah. Our land will yield its bountiful harvest.
Righteousness goes before Him, preparing us in the way for His steps.
Bend down Your ear, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, hear me; For I am poor and needy.
Preserve my life, for I am qadash; You are my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH; Save Your servant who trusts in You!
Be merciful to me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, For I cry to You all day long.
Give Joy to the soul of Your servant, For to You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I lift up my soul.
For You, are good, and ready to forgive, and abundant in mercy to all those who call upon You.
Give ear, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to my prayer; And attend to the voice of my supplications.
In the day of my trouble I will call upon You, For You will answer me.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, there is none like You, Nor are there any works like Your works.
All nations whom You have made Shall come and worship before You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and they will Esteemed Your Qadash Name.
For You are great, and do wondrous things; You alone are 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Teach me Your way, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I will walk in Your truth; Unite my heart to fear Your Name.
I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, with all my heart, And I will Esteemed Your name forevermore.
For great is Your mercy toward me, and You have delivered my soul from the depths of everlasting destruction.
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the proud have risen against me, And a mob of violent men have sought my life, And have not set You before them.
But You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you are our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH full of compassion, and Favors, Longsuffering and abundant in mercy and truth.
Oh, turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give Your strength to Your servant, And save the son of Your maidservant.
Show me a sign for good, That those who hate me may see it and be ashamed, Because You have helped me and comforted me.
The city founded by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Stands on the Qadash mountain.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves the city of Yahushalam more than any other city in Yashar'AL.
O city of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, what awesome things are said of you!
I will count Mitzraym and Babylun among those who know me also Philistia and Tyra, and even distant Athiupia, they have all become citizens of Yahushalam!
Regarding Yahushalam it will be said, “Everyone enjoys the rights of citizenship there.” And the Most High 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will personally Barak this city.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH registers the nations, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will say, “They have all become citizens of Yahushalam.”
The people will play flutes and sing, The source of my life springs from Yahushalam!”
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of my salvation, I cry out to you by day. I come to you at night.
Now hear my prayer; listen to my cry.
For my life is full of troubles, and death draws near.
I am as good as dead, like a strong man with no strength left.
They have left me among the dead, and I lie like a corpse in a grave. I am forgotten, cut off from your care.
You have thrown me into the lowest pit, into the darkest depths.
Your anger weighs me down; with wave after wave you have engulfed me.
You have driven my friends away by making me repulsive to them. I am in a trap with no way of escape.
My eyes are blinded by my tears. Each day I beg for your help, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I lift my hands to you for mercy.
Are your wonderful deeds of any use to the dead? Do the dead rise up and Yadah you?
Can those in the grave declare your unfailing love? Can they proclaim your faithfulness in the place of destruction?
Can the darkness speak of your wonderful deeds? Can anyone in the land of forgetfulness talk about your righteousness?
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I cry out to you. I will keep on pleading day by day.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, why do you reject me? Why do you turn your face from me?
I have been sick and close to death since my youth. I stand helpless and desperate before your terrors.
Your fierce anger has overwhelmed me. Your terrors have paralyzed me.
They swirl around me like floodwaters all day long. They have engulfed me completely.
You have taken away my companions and loved ones. Darkness is my closest friend.
I will sing of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s unfailing love forever! Young and old will hear of your faithfulness.
Your unfailing love will last forever. Your faithfulness is as enduring as the Shamaym.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I have made a covenant with Daud, my chosen servant. I have sworn this oath to him:
‘I will establish your descendants as kings forever; they will sit on your throne from now until eternity.’”
All Shamaym will Yadah your great wonders; myriads of Malakym will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for His faithfulness.
For who in all of Shamaym can compare with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Which mightiest Malakym is anything like 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
The powers of the highest Malakym stand in awe of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. He is far more awesome than all who surround his throne.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut! Where is there anyone as mighty as you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? You are entirely faithful.
You rule the oceans. You subdue their storm-tossed waves.
You crushed the great sea monster. You scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
The Shamaym are yours, and the Arath is yours; everything in the world is yours, you created it all.
You created north and south. Mount Tabur and Mount Harmun, Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Powerful is your arm! Strong is your hand! Your right hand is lifted high in awesome strength.
Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Unfailing love and truth walk before you as attendants.
Happy are those who hear the joyful call to worship, for they will walk in the light of your presence, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
They rejoice all day long in your wonderful reputation. They exult in your righteousness.
You are their awesome strength, it pleases you to make us strong.
Yes, our protection comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the Qadash One of Yashar'AL, has given us our king.
Long ago you spoke in a vision to your faithful people. You said, “I have raised up a warrior. I have selected him from the common people to be king.
I have found my servant Daud. I have anointed him with my Qadash oil.
I will steady him with my hand; with my powerful arm I will make him strong.
His enemies will not defeat him, nor will the wicked overpower him.
I will beat down his adversaries before him and destroy those who hate him.
My faithfulness and unfailing love will be with Daud, and by my authority he will grow in power.
I will extend his rule over the sea, his dominion over the rivers.
And he will call out to me, ‘You are my ABBA, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and the Rock of my salvation.’
I will make him my firstborn son, the mightiest king on the Arath.
I will love him and be kind to him forever; my covenant with him will never end.
I will preserve an heir for him; his throne will be as endless as the days of Shamaym.
But if his descendants forsake my instructions and fail to obey my regulations,
if they do not obey my decrees and fail to keep my commandments,
then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their disobedience with beating.
But I will never stop loving him nor fail to keep my promise to him.
No, I will not break my covenant; I will not take back a single word I said.
I have sworn an oath to Daud, and in my qadashym I cannot lie:
Daud's dynasty will go on forever; his kingdom will endure as the sun.
It will be as eternal as the moon, my faithful witness in the sky!”
But now you have rejected him and cast him off. You are angry with your anointed king.
You have renounced your covenant with him; you have thrown his crown in the dust.
You have broken down the walls protecting him and ruined every fort defending him.
Everyone who comes along has robbed him, and he has become a joke to his neighbors.
You have strengthened his enemies and made them all rejoice.
You have made his sword useless and refused to help him in battle.
You have ended his splendor and overturned his throne.
You have made him old before his time and publicly dishonored him.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, how long will this go on? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your anger burn like fire?
Remember how short this life is, this man's existence is empty and futile!
No one can live forever; all will die, No one can escape the power of the grave.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, where is your unfailing love? You promised it to Daud with a faithful pledge.
Consider, how your servants are in shame! I carry in my heart the insults of so many people.
Your enemies have mocked me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; they mock your anointed king wherever he goes.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever! Tudah Raba 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, You have been our dwelling place in all generations.
Before the mountains were brought forth, or before You had formed the world and the Arath, Even from everlasting to everlasting, You are the only 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
You turn man to destruction, And say, “Return, O children of men.”
For a thousand years in Your sight Are like yesterday when it is past, And like a watch in the night.
You carry them away like a flood; They are like a sleep. In the morning they are like grass which grows up:
In the morning it flourishes and grows up; In the evening it is cut down and withers.
For we have been consumed by Your anger, And by Your wrath we are terrified.
You have set our iniquities before You, Our secret sins in the light of Your countenance.
For all our days have passed away in Your wrath; We finish our years like a sigh.
The days of our lives are seventy years; And if by reason of strength they are eighty years, Yet their boast is only labor and sorrow; For it will soon cut off, and we fly away.
Who knows the power of Your anger? For as the fear of You, so is Your wrath.
So teach us to number our days, That we may gain a heart of wisdom.
Return, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! come back to us! How long will You delay? have compassion on Your servants.
Oh, satisfy us early with Your mercy, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days!
Make us glad according to the days in which You have afflicted us, replace the evil years with good.
Let Your work appear to us Your servants again, and Your Kabad to our children.
And let the beauty of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH be upon us, and establish the work of our hands for us; Yes establish the work of our hands.
Those who live in the shelter of the Most High 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will find rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
This I declare about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: He alone is my refuge, my place of safety; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and I trust Him.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will rescue me from every trap and protect me from deadly disease.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will cover me with His feathers, and He will shelter me with His wings. His Truth are my armor and protection.
I am not afraid of the terrors of the night, nor the arrow that flies in the day.
I am not dread of the disease that stalks in darkness, nor the disaster that strikes at midday.
Though a thousand fall at my side, though ten thousand are dying around me, these evils will not touch me.
Just open your eyes and see how the wicked are punished.
I have made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my refuge, I have made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my shelter,
no evil will conquer me; no plague will come near my home.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will order his Malakym to protect me wherever I go.
The Malakym will hold me up with their hands so I won’t even hurt my foot on a stone.
I will trample upon lions and cobras; I will crush fierce lions and serpents under my feet!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar (says), “I will rescue those who love me. I will protect those who trust in my Name.
When they call on my Name, I will answer them; I will be with them in trouble, I will rescue and honor them.
I will reward them with a long life and give them my salvation Says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
It is good to give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to sing Yadah to the Most High.
It is good to proclaim Your unfailing Ahaba (love) in the morning, and your faithfulness in the evening,
accompanied by a ten-stringed instrument, a harp, and the melody of a lyre.
You thrill me, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, with all You have done for me! I sing for joy because of what you have done.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, what great works you do! And how deep are your thoughts.
Only a simpleton would not know, and only a fool would not understand this:
Though the wicked sprout like weeds and evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.
But you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be exalted forever.
Your enemies will surely perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
But You have made me as strong as a wild ox. You have anointed me with the finest oil.
My eyes have seen the downfall of my enemies; my ears have heard the defeat of my wicked opponents.
But the righteous will flourish like palm trees and grow strong like the cedars of Labanun.
Those who are planted in the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Shall flourish in the courts of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
They shall still bear fruit in old age;
They will declare, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is just! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my Rock! And there is no evil in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reigns! He is clothed in majesty. Indeed, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is clothed in majesty and armed with strength. The world stands firm and cannot be shaken.
Your throne, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, has stood from time immemorial. You are from the everlasting.
The floods have risen up, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. The floods have roared like thunder; the floods have lifted their pounding waves.
But mightier than the violent raging of the seas, mightier than the breakers on the shore, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH above is mightier than these!
Your royal laws cannot be changed. Your reign, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is Qadash forever and ever.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of vengeance, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of vengeance, let your awesome justice shine forth!
Arise, O Judge of the Arath. Give the proud what they deserve.
How long, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? How long will the wicked be allowed to gloat?
How long will they speak with arrogance? How long will these evil people boast?
They crush your people O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, hurting those you claim as your own.
They kill widows and foreigners and murder orphans.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not looking,” they say, “and besides, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL does not care.”
Think again, you fools! When will you finally catch on?
Is He deaf, the one who made your ears? Is he blind, the one who formed your eyes?
He punishes the nations, will He not also punish you? He knows everything, does He not also know what you are doing?
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows the thoughts all men; he knows they are worthless!
Joyful and Baraked are those you discipline, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, those You teach your Turah and instructions.
You give them relief from troubled times until a pit is dug to capture the wicked.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not reject His people; He will not abandon His special possession.
Judgment will again be founded on justice, and those with virtuous hearts will pursue it.
Who will protect me from the wicked? Who will stand up for me against evildoers?
Unless 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had helped me, I would soon have settled in the silence of the grave.
I cried out, “I am slipping!” but your unfailing love, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, supported me.
When doubts filled my mind, your comfort gave me renewed hope and cheer.
Can unjust leaders claim that 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is on their side, leaders whose decrees permit injustice?
They gang up against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my fortress; my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is the mighty rock where I hide.
For my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will turn the sins of evil people back on them. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will destroy them for their sins. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will destroy them.
Come, let us sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Let us shout joyfully to the Rock of our salvation.
Let us come to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with thanksgiving. Let us sing Tahalym of Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the only 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the only great Ruler above all.
He holds in his hands the depths of the Arath and the mightiest mountains.
The sea belongs to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for He made it, the hands of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH formed the dry land, too.
Come, let us worship and bow down. Let us kneel before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our maker,
for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. We are the people He watches over, the flock under his care. If only you would listen to the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH today!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Do not harden your hearts as Yashar'AL did at Meribah, as they did at Massah in the wilderness.
For there your ancestors tested and tried my patience, even though they saw everything I did.
For forty years I was angry with them, and I said, ‘They are a people whose hearts turn away from me. They refuse to do what I tell them.’
So in my anger I took an oath: ‘They will never enter my place of rest.’”
Sing a new song to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Let the whole Arath sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Each day proclaim the good news that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saves.
Publish the marvelous deeds of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH among the nations. Tell everyone about the amazing things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does.
Great is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! He is most worthy of Yadah! For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is to be feared above all else.
The deities of other nations are mere idols, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made the Shamaym!
Honor and majesty surround 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; strength and beauty fill the sanctuary of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
O nations of the world, recognize 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; recognize that He is awesome and strong.
Give to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the Kabad He deserves! Bring your offering and come into the courts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in all His Qadash splendor. Let all the Arath tremble before Him.
Tell all the nations, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reigns!” The world stands firm and cannot be shaken. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge all men fairly.
Let the Shamaym be glad, and the Arath rejoice! Let the sea and everything in it shout and Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Let the fields and their crops burst out with joy! Let the trees of the forest sing for joy
before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for He is coming! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is coming to judge the Arath. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge the world with justice, and the nations with His Truth.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the Ruler! Let the Arath rejoice! Let the farthest coastlands be glad.
Dark clouds surround Him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.
Fire spreads ahead of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and burns up all his foes.
For the lightning of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH flashes out across the world, and the Arath sees it and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all the Arath.
The Shamaym proclaim the Righteousness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; every nation sees the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Those who worship idols are put to shame, all who brag about their worthless deities must bow to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yahushalam has heard and rejoiced, and all the towns of Yahudah are glad because of your justice, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
For you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is supreme over all the Arath; you are exalted far above all.
You who love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, hate evil! For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH protects the lives of his righteous people and rescues them from the power of the wicked.
Light shines on the righteous, and joy on those whose hearts are right.
May all who are righteous rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Sing a new song to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for He has done wonderful deeds, the right hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has won a mighty victory; His Qadash arm has shown His saving power!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has announced His victory and has revealed His righteousness to every nation!
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has remembered His promise to love and be faithful to Yashar'AL. The ends of the Arath have seen the victory of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Shout to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all the Arath; break out in Yadah and sing for joy!
Sing your Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with the harp, and melodious song,
with trumpets and the sound of the ram’s horn. Make a joyful symphony before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the Ruler of all!
Let the sea and everything in it shout to Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Let the Arath and all living things join in.
Let the rivers clap their hands in glee! Let the hills sing out their songs of joy
before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for He is coming to judge the Arath. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge the world with justice, and the nations with fairness.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Rules over all! Let the nations tremble! For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sits on His throne between the charubim. Let the whole Arath quake!
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sits in majesty in Yahushalam, exalted above all the nations.
Let them Yadah your great and awesome Name. Your Name is Qadash!
Mighty Ruler, lover of justice, you have established fairness. You have acted with justice and righteousness throughout Yashar'AL.
Exalt 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! Bow low before his feet, for he is Qadash!
Musha and Aarun were among his Kuhanym; Shamu'AL also called on his name. They cried to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for help, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH answered them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke to Yashar'AL from the pillar of cloud, and they followed the laws and decrees He gave them.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, you answered them. You were a forgiving 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH to them, but you punished them when they went wrong.
Exalt 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and worship at His Qadash mountain in Yahushalam, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is Qadash!
Shout with joy to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all the Arath!
Worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with gladness. Come before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, singing with joy.
Acknowledge that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the only 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH!, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made us, and we are His people, the sheep of His pasture.
Enter the gates of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with Tudah (thanksgiving); go into the courts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with Yadah. Give Tudah and Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good. His unfailing Ahaba (love) continues forever, and the faithfulness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH continues to each generation.
I will sing of your love and justice, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with songs.
I will be careful to live a blameless life, when will you come to help me? I will lead a life of integrity in my own home.
I will refuse to look at anything vile and vulgar. I hate all who deal crookedly; I will have nothing to do with them.
I will reject perverse ideas and stay away from every evil.
I will not tolerate people who slander their neighbors. I will not endure conceit and pride.
I will search for faithful people to be my companions. Only those who are above reproach will be allowed to serve me.
I will not allow deceivers to serve in my house, and liars will not stay in my presence.
My daily task will be to ferret out the wicked and free the city of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from their grip.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, hear my prayer! Listen to my plea!
Do not turn away from me in my time of distress. Open your hear and listen, answer me quickly when I call to you.
For my days disappear like smoke, and my bones burn like red-hot coals.
My heart is sick, withered like grass, and I have lost my appetite.
Because of my groaning, I am reduced to skin and bones.
I am like an owl in the desert, like a little owl in a far-off wilderness.
I lie awake, lonely as a solitary bird on the roof.
My enemies taunt me day after day. They mock and curse me.
I eat ashes for food. My tears run down into my drink
because of Your anger and wrath, You have picked me up and thrown me out.
My life passes as swiftly as the evening shadows. I am withering away like grass.
But you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, will sit on your throne forever. Your fame will endure to every generation.
You will arise and have mercy on Ziun and now is the time to favor her, Yes the set time, has come.
For your people love every stone in her walls and cherish even the dust in her streets.
Then the nations will tremble before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. The Kings of the Arath will tremble before his Kabad.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will rebuild Yahushalam. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will appear in His Kabad.
He will listen to the prayers of the destitute. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not reject their pleas.
Let this be recorded for future generations, so that a people not yet born will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Tell them 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH looked down from his Shamaym, He looked down to the Arath from Shamaym,
to hear the groans of the prisoners, to release those condemned to die.
And so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s fame will be celebrated in Ziun, and His Yadah in Yahushalam,
when multitudes gather together and kingdoms come to worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH broke my strength in midlife, cutting short my days.
But I cried to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who lives forever, do not take my life while I am so young!
Long ago you laid the foundation of the Arath and made the Shamaym with your hands.
They will perish, but you remain forever; they will wear out like old clothing. You will change them like a garment and discard them.
But you are always the same; for You O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will live forever.
The children of your people will live in security. Their children’s children will thrive in your presence.”
With my whole being I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; with my whole heart and Soul, I will Yadah His Qadash Name.
With my all I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; may I never forget the good things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does for me.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forgives all my sins and heals all my diseases.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH redeems me from death and crowns me with love and tender mercies.
The AL'Mighty fills my life with good things. My youth is renewed like the eagle’s!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives righteousness and justice to all who are treated unfairly.
He revealed his character to Musha and his deeds to the people of Yashar'AL.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is compassionate and merciful, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not constantly accuse us, nor remain angry forever.
He does not punish us for all our sins; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not deal harshly with us, as we deserve.
For the unfailing Ahaba (love) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH toward those who fear Him is as great as the height of the Shamaym above the Arath.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has removed our sins far from us as the east is from the west.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is like a father to his children, tender and compassionate to those who fear him.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows how weak we are; he remembers we are only dust.
Our days on Arath are like grass; like wildflowers, we bloom and die.
The wind blows, and we are gone, as though we had never been here.
But the love of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH remains forever with those who fear him. The salvation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH extends to the children’s children
of those who are faithful to his covenant, and of those who obey his commandments!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made the Shamaym his throne; from there He rules over everything.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you Malakym, you mighty ones who carry out the plans of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, listening for each of his commands.
Yes, Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you armies of Malakym who serve Him and do His will!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, everything He has created, everything in all His kingdom. Let all that I am Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Barak 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, O my soul! O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, You are very great: You are clothed with honor and majesty,
And You covered Yourself with light as with a garment, You stretched out the Shamaym like a curtain.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lays the beams of His upper chambers in the waters, and makes the clouds His chariot, and walks on the wings of the wind,
The winds are your messengers; flames of fire are Your servants.
You placed the world on its foundation so it would never be moved.
You clothed the Arath with floods of water, water that covered even the mountains.
At your command, the water fled; at the sound of your thunder, it hurried away.
Mountains rose and valleys sank to the levels you decreed.
Then you set a firm boundary for the seas, so they would never again cover the Arath.
You make springs pour water into the ravines, so streams gush down from the mountains.
They provide water for all the animals, and the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
The birds nest beside the streams and sing among the branches of the trees.
You send rain on the mountains from Shamaym, and you fill the Arath with the fruit of your labor.
You cause grass to grow for the livestock and plants for people to use. You allow them to produce food from the Arath
Wine to make them glad, olive oil to soothe their skin, and bread to give them strength.
The trees of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are well cared for, the cedars of Labanun that He planted.
There the birds make their nests, and the storks make their homes in the cypresses.
The high hills in the mountains are for the wild goats, and the rocks form a refuge for the hyraxes.
You made the moon to mark the seasons, and the sun knows when to set.
You send the darkness, and it becomes night, when all the forest animals prowl about.
Then the young lions roar for their prey, stalking the food provided by 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
At dawn they slink back into their dens to rest.
Then people go off to their work, where they labor until evening.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, what a variety of things you have made! In wisdom you have made them all. The Arath is full of your creatures.
Here is the ocean, vast and wide, teeming with life of every kind, both large and small.
See the ships sailing along, and Laviathan, which you made to play in the sea.
They all depend on you to give them food as they need it.
When you supply it, they gather it. You open your hand to feed them, and they are richly satisfied.
But if you turn away from them, they panic. When you take away their breath, they die and turn again to dust.
When you give them your breath, life is created, and you renew the face of the Arath.
May the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH continue forever! For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH takes pleasure in all He has made!
The Arath trembles at His glance; the mountains smoke at his touch.
I will sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as long as I live. I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH to my last breath!
May all my thoughts be pleasing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for I rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Let all sinners vanish from the face of the Arath; let the wicked disappear forever, let all that I am Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Tudah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and proclaim His greatness. Let the whole world know what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done.
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; yes, sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Tell everyone about His wonderful deeds.
Exult his Qadash Name; rejoice, you who worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Search for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and for His strength continually, seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Remember the wonders 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has performed, His miracles, and the rulings 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given,
you children of His servant Abraham, you descendants of Ya'aqub, His chosen one.
He is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. His justice is seen throughout the land.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH always stands by His covenant, the commitment He made to a thousand generations.
This is the covenant He made with Abraham and the oath he swore to Yachaq.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH confirmed it to Ya'aqub as a decree, and to the people of Yashar'AL as a never-ending covenant:
“I will give you the land of Canaan as your special possession.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said this when they were few in number, a tiny group of strangers in Canaan.
They wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
Yet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not let anyone oppress them. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH warned kings on their behalf:
“Do not touch my chosen people, and do not hurt my Nabyms.”
He called for a famine on the land of Canaan, cutting off its food supply.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent someone to Mitzraym ahead of them, Ya'asaf who was sold as a slave.
They bruised his feet with fetters and placed his neck in an iron collar.
Until the time came to fulfill his dreams, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH tested Ya'asaf’s character.
Then Phar'uh sent for him and set him free; the ruler of the nation opened his prison door.
Ya'asaf was put in charge of all the king’s household; he became ruler over all the king’s possessions.
He could instruct the king’s aides as he pleased and teach the king’s advisers.
Then Yashar'AL arrived in Mitzraym; Ya'aqub lived as a foreigner in the land of Ham.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH multiplied the people of Yashar'AL until they became too mighty for their enemies.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turned the Mitzraym against the Yasharalym, and they plotted against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent His servant Musha, along with Aarun, whom he had chosen.
They performed miraculous signs among the Mitzraym, and wonders in the land of Ham.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH blanketed Mitzraym in darkness, for they had defied his commands to let his people go.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turned their water into blood, poisoning all the fish.
Then frogs overran the land and even invaded the king’s bedrooms.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke, flies descended on the Mitzraym, and gnats swarmed across Mitzraym.
He sent them hail instead of rain, and lightning flashed over the land.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH ruined their grapevines and fig trees and shattered all the trees.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke and hordes of locusts came, young locusts beyond number.
They ate up everything green in the land, destroying all the crops in their fields.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH killed the oldest sons in each home of the Mitzraym, the pride and joy of each family.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought his people out of Mitzraym, loaded with silver and gold; and not one among the tribes of Yashar'AL even stumbled.
Mitzraym was glad when they were gone, for they feared them greatly.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spread a cloud above them as a covering and gave them a great fire to light the darkness.
They asked for meat, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent them quail; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH satisfied their hunger with manna, bread from Shamaym.
He split open a rock, and water gushed out to form a river through the dry wasteland.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH remembered his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
So he brought his people out of Mitzraym with joy, His chosen ones with rejoicing.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave his people the lands of pagan nations, and they harvested crops that others had planted.
All this happened so they would follow His decrees and obey His instructions.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! and give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for He is good! His mercy endures forever.
Who can list the awesome miracles of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Who can ever Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH enough?
There is joy for those who deal justly with others and always do what is right.
Remember me O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, when you show favor to your people; come near and rescue me.
Let me share in the prosperity of your chosen ones. Let me rejoice in the joy of your people; let me Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with those who are your heritage.
Like our fathers, we have sinned. We have done wrong! We have acted wickedly!
Our fathers in Mitzraym were not impressed by the miraculous deeds of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they soon forgot His many acts of kindness to them. Instead, they rebelled against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH at the Red Sea.
Even so, he saved them, to defend the honor of his Name and to demonstrate His mighty power.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded the Red Sea to dry up. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH led Yashar'AL across the sea as if it were a desert.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rescued them from their enemies and redeemed them from their foes.
Then the water returned and covered their enemies; not one of them survived.
Then His people believed His promises. Then they sang His Yadah.
Yet how quickly they forgot what he had done! They did not wait for His counsel!
In the wilderness their desires ran wild, and they tested the patience of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in that dry wasteland.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave them what they asked for, but he sent a plague along with it.
The people in the camp were jealous of Musha and envious of Aarun, His Qadash Kuhan.
Because of this, the Arath opened up; it swallowed Dathan and buried Abiram and the other rebels.
Fire fell upon their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.
The people made a calf at Mount Sinai; they bowed before an image made of gold.
They traded their awesome 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH for a statue of a grass-eating bull.
They forgot 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their savior, who had done such great things in Mitzraym
such wonderful things in the land of Ham, such awesome deeds at the Red Sea.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH declared He would destroy them. But Musha His chosen one, stepped between 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the people. Musha begged 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to turn from his anger and not destroy them.
The people refused to enter the pleasant land, for they did not believe 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's promise to care for them.
Instead, they grumbled in their tents and refused to obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Therefore, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH solemnly swore that He would kill them in the wilderness,
that He would scatter their descendants among the nations, exiling them to distant lands.
Then our fathers joined in the worship of Baal at Paur; they even ate sacrifices offered to the dead!
They angered 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with all these things, so a plague broke out among them.
But Phinahas had the courage to intervene, and the plague was stopped.
So Phinahas has been regarded as a righteous man ever since that time.
At Maribah too, they angered 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, causing Musha serious trouble.
They made Musha angry, and he spoke foolishly.
Yashar'AL failed to destroy the nations in the land, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had commanded them.
Instead, they mingled among the pagans and adopted their evil customs.
They worshiped their idols, which led to their downfall.
They even sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons.
They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters. By sacrificing them to the idols of Canaan, they polluted the land with murder.
They defiled themselves by their evil deeds, and their love of idols was adultery in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s sight.
That is why the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH burned against His people, and He abhorred His own special possession.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH handed them over to pagan nations, and they were ruled by those who hated them.
Their enemies crushed them and brought them under their cruel power.
Again and again 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rescued them, but they chose to rebel against Him, and they were finally destroyed by their sin.
Even so, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH pitied them in their distress and listened to their cries.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH remembered His covenant with them and relented because of his unfailing love.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH even caused their captors to treat them with kindness.
Save us, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! Gather us back from among the nations, so we can Tudah your qadash Name and rejoice and Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, who lives from everlasting to everlasting! Let all the people say, “So be it!”
Oh give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for He is good! and His mercy endures forever.
Has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH redeemed you? Then speak out! Tell others He has redeemed you from your enemies.
For He has gathered the exiles from many lands, from east and west, from north and south.
Some wandered in the wilderness, lost and homeless.
Hungry and thirsty, they nearly died.
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, help!” they cried in their trouble, and He rescued them from their distress.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH led them straight to safety, to a city where they could live.
Let them Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for His great love and for the wonderful things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done for them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
Some sat in darkness and deepest gloom, imprisoned in iron chains of misery.
They rebelled against the Dabar of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, scorning the counsel of the Most High.
That is why 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH broke them with hard labor; they fell, and no one was there to help them.
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, help!” they cried in their trouble, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saved them from their distress.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH led them from the darkness and deepest gloom; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH snapped their chains.
Let them Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for His great love and for the wonderful things he has done for them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH broke down their prison gates of bronze; and He cut apart their bars of iron.
Some were fools; they rebelled and suffered for their sins.
They could not stand the thought of food, and they were knocking on death’s door.
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, help!” they cried in their trouble, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saved them from their distress.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent out His Dabar and healed them, snatching them from the door of death.
Let them Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for his great love and for the wonderful things He has done for them.
Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and sing joyfully about His awesome acts.
Some went off to sea in ships, plying the trade routes of the world.
They too, observed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s power in action, His impressive works on the deepest seas.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, and the winds rose, stirring up the waves.
Their ships were tossed to the Shamaym and plunged again to the depths; the sailors cringed in terror.
They reeled and staggered like drunkards and were at their wits’ end.
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, help!” they cried in their trouble, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saved them from their distress.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH calmed the storm to a whisper and stilled the waves.
What a Barakah was the stillness as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought them safely into harbor!
Let them Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for his great love and for the wonderful things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done for them.
Let them exalt 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH publicly before the congregation and before the leaders of the nation.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH changes rivers into deserts, and springs of water into dry, thirsty land.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turns the fruitful land into salty wastelands, because of the wickedness of those who live there.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also turns deserts into pools of water, the dry land into springs of water.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brings the hungry to settle there and to build their cities.
They sow their fields, plant their vineyards, and harvest their bumper crops.
How 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH barak them! They raise large families there, and their herds of livestock increase.
When they decrease in number and become impoverished through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH pours contempt on their princes, causing them to wander in trackless wastelands.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rescues the poor from trouble and increases their families like flocks of sheep.
The righteous will see these things and be glad, while the wicked are struck silent.
Those who are wise will take all this to heart; they will see in our history the mercy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
My heart is confident in you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; no wonder I can sing your Yadah with all my heart!
Wake up, lyre and harp! I will wake the dawn with my song.
I will Tudah Rabah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, among all the people. I will sing your Yadah among the nations.
For your unfailing love is higher than the Shamaym. Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Be exalted, O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, above the highest Shamaym. May your Kabad shine over all the Arath.
Now rescue your beloved people. Answer and save us by your power.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had promised this by His Qadashym:“ I will divide up Shacham with joy. I will measure out the valley of Succuth.
Gilead is mine, and Manassah too, Aphraim, my helmet, will produce my warriors, and Yahudah, my scepter, will produce my kings.
But Muab, my washbasin, will become my servant, and I will wipe my feet on Adum and shout in triumph over Philistia.”
Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will bring me victory over Adum?
Have you rejected us, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH? Will you no longer march with our armies?
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, please help us against our enemies, for all the help from mankind is useless.
With the help of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, we will do mighty things, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will trample down our foes.
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, whom I Yadah, do not stand silent
while the wicked slander me and tell lies about me.
They surround me with hateful words and fight against me for no reason.
I love them, but they try to destroy me with accusations, even as I am praying for them!
They repay me with evil for my good, and hatred for my love.
They say, “Get an evil person to turn against him. Send an accuser to bring him to trial.
When his case comes up for judgment, let him be pronounced guilty. Count his prayers as sins.
Let his years be few; let someone else take his position.
May his children become fatherless, and his wife a widow.
May his children wander as beggars and be driven from their ruined homes.
May creditors seize his entire estate, and strangers take all he has earned.
Let no one be kind to him; let no one pity his fatherless children.
May all his offspring die. May his family's name be blotted out in the next generation.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH never forget the sins of his fathers; may his mother’s sins never be erased from the record.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH always remember these sins, and may HIS Name disappear from man's memory.
For he refused all kindness to others; he persecuted the poor and needy, and he hounded the brokenhearted to death.
He loved to curse others; now You curse him, he never Baraked others; now don’t you barak him.
Cursing is as natural to him as his clothing, or the water he drinks, or the rich food he eats.
Now may his curses return and cling to him like clothing; may they be tied around him like a belt.”
May those curses become 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s punishment for my accusers who speak evil of me.
But deal well with me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for the sake of your own reputation! Rescue me because you are so faithful and good.
For I am poor and needy, and my heart is full of pain.
I am fading like a shadow at dusk; I am brushed off like a locust.
My knees are weak from fasting, and I am skin and bones.
I am a joke to people everywhere; when they see me, they shake their heads in scorn.
Help me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! Save me because of your unfailing love.
Let them see that this is Your doing, that You have done it.
Then let them curse me if they like, but you will barak me! When they attack me, they will be put to shame! But I, your servant, will go right on rejoicing!
May my accusers be clothed with shame; may their humiliation cover them like a cloak.
But I will give repeated Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to everyone.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH stands beside the needy, ready to save them from those who condemn them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to my Master, “Sit in the place of honor at my right hand until I humble your enemies, making them a footstool under your feet.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will extend your powerful kingdom from Yahushalam; you will rule over your enemies.
When you go to war, your people will serve you willingly. You are arrayed in qadash garments, and your strength will be renewed each day like the morning dew.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has taken an oath and will not break His vow: “You are a Kuhan forever in the order of Malchizadak.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH stands at your right hand to protect you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will strike down many kings when His anger erupts.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will punish the nations and fill their lands with corpses; He will shatter heads over the whole Arath.
The king will drink from the stream by the road, and strengthened, he will stand victorious.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! I will give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with all my heart as I meet with His righteous people.
How amazing are the deeds of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! All who delight in Him should ponder them.
Everything 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does reveals His Kabad and majesty. His righteousness never fails.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH causes us to remember His wonderful works. How awesome and merciful is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
He gives food to those who fear Him; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH always remembers his covenant.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has shown His great power to his people by giving them the lands of other nations.
All 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does is just and good, and all his commandments are trustworthy.
They are forever true, to be obeyed faithfully and with integrity.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has paid a full ransom for his people. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has guaranteed His covenant with them forever. What a Qadash, awe-inspiring Name 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has!
The fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the foundation of true wisdom. All who obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's commandments will grow in wisdom. Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever!
Sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! How joyful are those who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and delight in obeying the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Their children will be successful everywhere; an entire generation of righteous people will be Baraked.
They themselves will be wealthy, and their good deeds will last forever.
Light shines in the darkness for the righteous ones. They are generous, compassionate, and righteous.
Good comes to those who lend money generously and conduct their business fairly.
Such people will not be overcome by evil. Those who are righteous will be long remembered.
They do not fear bad news; they confidently trust 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to care for them.
They are confident and fearless and can face their foes triumphantly.
They share freely and give generously to those in need. Their good deeds will be remembered forever. They will have influence and honor.
The wicked will see this and be infuriated. They will grind their teeth in anger; they will slink away, their hopes thwarted.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Yes, give Yadah, O servants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Yadah the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Baraked be the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH now and forever.
Everywhere from east to west, Yadah the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is high above the nations; and the kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is higher than the Shamaym.
Who can be compared with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who is enthroned on high?
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH humbled himself to look down from Shamaym on the Arath.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lifts the poor from the dust and the needy from the garbage dump.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sets them among princes, even the princes of his own people!
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives the childless woman a family, making her a happy mother.
When the Yasharalym escaped from Mitzraym, when the family of Ya'aqub left that foreign land
the land of Yahudah became the sanctuary of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and Yashar'AL became His kingdom.
The Red Sea saw them coming and hurried out of their way! The water of the Yurdan River turned away.
The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs!
What is wrong O Red Sea, that made you hurry out of their way? What happened O Yurdan River, that you turned away?
Why O mountains, did you skip like rams? Why O hills, like lambs?
Tremble, O Arath, at the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, at the presence of the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ya'aqub.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turned the rock into a pool of water; yes, a spring of water flowed from solid rock.
Not to us, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, not to us, but to your Name goes all the Kabad for your unfailing love and faithfulness.
Why let the nations say, “Where is their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH?”
Our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is in the Shamaym, and He does as He wishes.
Their idols are merely things of silver and gold, shaped by man's hands.
They have mouths but cannot speak, and eyes but cannot see.
They have ears but cannot hear, and noses but cannot smell.
They have hands but cannot feel, and feet but cannot walk, and throats but cannot make a sound.
And those who make idols are just like them, as are all who trust in them.
O Yashar'AL, trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! He is your helper and your shield.
O Kuhanym, descendants of Aarun, trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! He is your helper and your shield.
All you who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! He is your helper and your shield.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH remembers us and will barak us. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will barak the people of Yashar'AL and barak the Kuhanym, the descendants of Aarun.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will Barak those who fear Him, both great and lowly.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH richly Barak both you and your children.
May you be Baraked by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who made the Shamaym and the Arath.
The Shamaym belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but He has given the Arath to all mankind.
The dead cannot sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for they have gone into the silence of the grave.
But we can Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH both now and forever! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
I Ahaba 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because He hears my voice and my prayer for mercy.
Because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives attention to listen, I will pray as long as I have breath!
Death wrapped its ropes around me; the terrors of the grave overtook me. I saw only trouble and sorrow.
Then I called on the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “Please, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, save me!”
How kind 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is! How good 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is! So merciful, this 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of ours!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH protects those of childlike faith; I was facing death, and he saved me.
Let my soul be at rest again, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has been good to me.
He has saved me from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
And so I walk in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as I live here on the Arath!
I believed in You, so I said, “I am deeply troubled, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
In my anxiety I cried out to You, “These people are all liars!”
What can I offer 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for all He has done for me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation and Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Name for saving me.
I will keep my promises to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the presence of all his people.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH cares deeply when His loved ones die.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I am your servant; yes, I am your servant, born into your household; You have freed me from my chains.
I will offer you a sacrifice of Tudah (Thanksgiving) and call on the name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I will fulfill my vows to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the presence of all his people
in the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and in the heart of Yahushalam. Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all you nations. Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all you people of the Arath.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH unfailing love for us is powerful; For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Truth endures forever. Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for he is good! His merciful love endures forever.
Let all Yashar'AL repeat: “His merciful love endures forever.”
Let Aarun’s descendants, the Kuhanym, repeat: “His merciful love endures forever.”
Let all who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH repeat: His merciful love endures forever.”
In my distress I prayed to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH answered me and set me free.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is on my side, so I will have no fear. What can mere man do to me?
Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is for me; He will help me. I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
It is better to take refuge in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH than to trust in people.
It is better to take refuge in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH than to trust in princes.
Though hostile nations surrounded me, I destroyed them all with the authority of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yes, they surrounded and attacked me, but I destroyed them all with the authority of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
They swarmed around me like bees; they blazed against me like a crackling fire. But I destroyed them all with the authority of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
My enemies did their best to kill me, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rescued me.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my strength and my song; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given me victory.
Songs of joy and victory are sung in the camp of the righteous. The strong right arm of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done awesome things!
The strong right arm of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is raised in triumph. The strong right arm of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done awesome things!
I will not die; instead, I will live to tell what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has punished me severely, but He did not let me die.
Open for me the gates where the righteous enter, and I will go in and give Tudah (thank) to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
These gates lead to the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and the righteous enter there.
I thank You for answering my prayer and giving me victory!
The stone that the builders rejected has now become the cornerstone.
This is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s doing, and it is wonderful to see.
This is the day 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it.
Please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, please save us. Please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, please give us success.
Barak is the one who comes in the name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. We Barak you from the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, is shining upon us. Take the sacrifice and bind it with cords on the altar.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and I will exalt you! O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Give Tudah (thanks) to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for He is good! His merciful love endures forever.
Barak are people of integrity, who follow the instructions of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Joyful are those who obey the laws of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and search for Him with all their hearts.
They do not compromise with evil, and they walk only in the path of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You have charged us to keep your commandments carefully.
Oh, that my actions would consistently reflect your decrees!
Then I will not be ashamed when I compare my life with your commandments.
As I learn your righteous regulations, I will thank you by living as I should!
I will obey your decrees. Please do not give up on me.
How can a young person stay pure? By obeying your Dabar (word).
I have tried hard to find you, do not let me wander from your commandments.
I have hidden your Dabar in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
I Yadah you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; teach me your decrees.
I have recited aloud all the regulations you have given us.
I have rejoiced in your laws as much as in riches.
I will study your commandments and reflect on your ways.
I will delight in your decrees and not forget your Dabar (word).
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Be good to your servant, that I may live and obey your Dabar (word).
Open my eyes to see the wonderful truths in your instructions.
I am only a foreigner in the land. Do not hide your commandments from me!
I am always overwhelmed with a desire for your regulations.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rebuke the arrogant; those who wander from your commands are cursed.
Do not let them scorn and insult me, for I have obeyed your laws.
Even princes sit and speak against me, but I will meditate on your decrees.
Your laws please me; they give me wise advice.
I lie in the dust; revive me by your Dabar (word).
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I told you my plans, and you answered. Now teach me your decrees.
Help me understand the meaning of your commandments, and I will meditate on your wonderful deeds.
I weep with sorrow; encourage me by your Dabar (word).
Keep me from lying to myself; give me the privilege of knowing your instructions.
I have chosen to be faithful; I have determined to live by your regulations.
I cling to your laws. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH do not let me be put to shame!
I will pursue your commands, for you expand my understanding.
Teach me your decrees, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I will keep them to the end.
Give me understanding and I will obey your instructions; I will put them into practice with all my heart.
Make me walk along the path of your commands, for that is where my happiness is found.
Give me an eagerness for your laws rather than a love for money!
Turn my eyes from worthless things, and give me life through your Dabar (Word).
Reassure me of your promise, made to those who fear you.
Help me abandon my shameful ways; for your regulations are good.
I long to obey your commandments! Renew my life with your goodness.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, give me your unfailing love, the salvation that you promised me.
Then I can answer those who taunt me, for I trust in your Dabar (word).
Do not snatch your Dabar of truth from me, for your regulations are my only hope.
I will keep on obeying your instructions forever and ever.
I will walk in freedom, for I have devoted myself to your commandments.
I will speak to kings about your laws, and I will not be ashamed.
How I delight in your commandments, How I love them!
I honor and love your Commandments. I meditate on your decrees.
Remember your promise to me; it is my only hope.
Your promise revives me; it comforts me in all my troubles.
The proud hold me in utter contempt, but I do not turn away from your instructions.
I meditate on your age-old regulations; O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they comfort me.
I become furious with the wicked, because they reject your instructions.
Your decrees have been the theme of my songs wherever I have lived.
I reflect at night on who you are, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; therefore, I obey your instructions.
This is how I spend my life: obeying your commandments.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you are mine! I promise to obey your Dabar (words)!
With all my heart I want your Barakah. Be merciful as you promised.
I pondered the direction of my life, and I turned to follow your laws.
I will hurry, without delay, to obey your commandments.
Evil people try to drag me into sin, but I am firmly anchored to your instructions.
I rise at midnight to thank you for your just regulations.
I am a friend to anyone who fears 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and anyone who obeys your commandments.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, your unfailing love fills the Arath; teach me your decrees.
You have done many good things for me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, just as you promised.
I believe in your commandments; now teach me good judgment and knowledge.
I used to wander off until you disciplined me; but now I closely follow your Dabar (word).
You are good and do only good; teach me your decrees.
Arrogant people smear me with lies, but in truth I obey your commandments with all my heart.
Their hearts are dull and stupid, but I delight in your instructions.
My suffering was good for me, for it taught me to pay attention to your decrees.
Your instructions are more valuable to me than millions in gold and silver.
You made me; you created me. Now give me the sense to follow your commandments.
May all who fear you find in me a cause for joy, for I have put my hope in your Dabar.
I know, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that your regulations are fair; you disciplined me because I needed it.
Now let your unfailing love comfort me, just as you promised me, your servant.
Surround me with your tender mercies so I may live, for your instructions are my delight.
Bring dishonor upon the arrogant people who lied about me; meanwhile, I will concentrate on your commandments.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Let me be united with all who fear you, with those who know your laws.
May I be blameless in keeping your decrees; then I will never be ashamed to Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH
I am worn out waiting for your rescue, but I have put my hope in your Dabar.
My eyes are straining to see your promises come true. When will you comfort me?
I am shriveled like a wineskin in the smoke, but I have not forgotten to obey your decrees.
How long must I wait? When will you punish those who persecute me?
These arrogant people who hate your instructions have dug deep pits to trap me.
All your commandments are trustworthy. Protect me from those who hunt me down without cause.
They almost finished me off, but I refused to abandon your commandments.
In your unfailing love, spare my life; then I can continue to obey your laws. Halalu'YAHUAH
Your eternal Dabar (word), O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, stands firm in Shamaym.
Your faithfulness extends to every generation, as enduring as the Arath you created.
Your regulations remain true to this day, for everything serves your plans.
If your instructions had not sustained me with joy, I would have died in my misery.
I will never forget your commandments, for by them you give me life.
I am yours; rescue me! For I have worked hard at obeying your commandments.
Though the wicked hide along the way to kill me, I will quietly keep my mind on your laws.
Even perfection has its limits, but your commandments have no limit. Halalu'YAHUAH
Oh, how I love your instructions, I think about them all day long.
Your Turah and commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are my constant guide.
Yes, I have more insight than my teachers, for I am always thinking of your laws.
I am even wiser than my elders, for I have kept your Turah and commandments.
I have refused to walk on any evil path, so that I may remain obedient to your Dabar.
I have not turned away from your regulations, for you have taught me well.
How sweet your Dabar taste to me; they are sweeter than honey. Tudah Raba YAHUAH
Your Turah and commandments give me understanding; no wonder I hate every false way of life. Yadah YAHUAH
The Dabar (word) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is a lamp to guide my feet and a light for my path way.
I have promised it once, and I will promise it again: I will obey your righteous regulations.
I have suffered much, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; restore my life again as you promised.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, accept my offering of Yadah, and teach me your regulations.
My life constantly hangs in the balance, but I will not stop obeying your instructions.
The wicked have set their traps for me, but I will not turn from your commandments.
Your laws are my treasure; they are my heart’s delight.
I am determined to keep your decrees to the very end. Tudah Raba YAHUAH.
I hate those with divided loyalties, but I love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's instructions.
You are my refuge and my shield; your Dabar (word) is my source of hope.
Get out of my life, you evil-minded people, for I intend to obey the commands of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, sustain me as you promised, that I may live! Do not let my hope be crushed.
Sustain me, and I will be rescued; then I will meditate continually on your decrees.
But you have rejected all who stray from your decrees. They are only fooling themselves.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH put away all the wicked of the Arath like dross; no wonder I love to obey your laws!
I tremble in fear of you; I stand in awe of your regulations. Yadah YAHUAH.
Do not leave me to the mercy of my enemies, for I have done what is just and right.
Please guarantee a Barakah for me. Do not let the arrogant oppress me!
My eyes strain to see your rescue, to see the truth of your promise fulfilled.
I am your servant; deal with me in unfailing love, and teach me your decrees.
Give discernment to me, your servant; then I will understand your laws.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, it is time for you to act, for these evil people have violated your instructions.
Truly, I love your Commandments more than gold, even the finest gold.
Each of your commandments is right. That is why I hate every false way. Halalu'YAHUAH
Your laws are wonderful. No wonder I obey them!
The learning of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's Dabar (word) gives light, so even the simple can understand.
I pant with expectation, longing for your commandments.
Come and show me your mercy, as you do for all who love your Name.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Guide my steps by your Dabar (word), so I will not be overcome by evil
Ransom me from the oppression of evil people; then I can obey your commandments.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; Look upon me with Ahaba (love); teach me your decrees.
Rivers of tears gush from my eyes because people disobey your instructions.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you are righteous, and your regulations are fair.
Your laws are perfect and completely trustworthy.
I am overwhelmed with indignation, for my enemies have disregarded your Dabar (words).
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Your promises have been thoroughly tested; that is why I love them so much.
I am insignificant and despised, but I do not forget your commandments.
For the justice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is eternal, and Your instructions are perfectly true.
As pressure and stress bear down on me, I find joy in Your commandments.
Your laws are always right; help me to understand them so I may live.
I pray with all my heart; answer me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! I will obey your decrees.
I cry out to you; rescue me, that I may obey your laws.
I rise early, before the sun is up; I cry out for help and put my hope in your Dabar (words).
I stay awake through the night, thinking about your promise.
In your merciful love, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, hear my cry; let me be revived by following your regulations.
Lawless people are coming to attack me; they live far from your instructions.
But you are near, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and all your commandments are true.
I have known from my earliest days that your laws will last forever.
Look upon my suffering and rescue me, for I have not forgotten your instructions.
Argue my case; take my side! Protect my life as you promised.
The wicked are far from rescue, for they do not bother with your decrees.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, how great is your mercy; let me be revived by following your regulations.
Many persecute and trouble me, yet I have not swerved from your laws.
Seeing these traitors makes me sick at heart, because they care nothing for your Dabar (word).
See how I love your commandments, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Give back my life because of your unfailing love.
The very essence of your Dabar (words) is truth; all your just regulations will stand forever.
Powerful people harass me without cause, but my heart trembles only at your Dabar.
