I rejoice in your Dabar (word) like one who discovers a great treasure.
I hate and abhor all falsehood, but I love your instructions.
I will Yadah (praise) you seven times a day because all your regulations are just.
Those who love your instructions have great Shalum and do not stumble.
I long for your rescue, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so I have obeyed your commands.
I have obeyed your laws, for I love them very much.
Yes, I obey your commandments and laws because you know everything I do.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, listen to my cry; give me the discerning mind you promised.
Listen to my prayer; rescue me as you promised.
Let Yadah flow from my lips, for you have taught me your decrees.
Let my tongue sing about your Dabar (word), for all your commandments are right.
Give me a helping hand, for I have chosen to follow your commandments.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I have longed for your rescue, and your instructions are my delight.
Let me live so I can sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and may Your regulations help me.
I have wandered away like a lost sheep; come and find me, for I have not forgotten your commandments.
I took my troubles to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I cried out to Him, and he answered my prayer.
Rescue me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, from liars and from all deceitful people.
O deceptive tongue, what will 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH do to you? How will he increase your punishment?
You will be pierced with sharp arrows and burned with glowing coals.
How I suffer in far-off Mashach. It pains me to live in distant Kadar.
I am tired of living among people who hate Shalum.
I search for Shalum; but when I speak of Shalum, they want war!
I lift up my eyes to the mountains, does my help come from there?
My help comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who made Shamaym and Arath!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not let you stumble; the one who watches over you will not slumber.
Indeed, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who watches over Yashar'AL never slumbers or sleeps.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself watches over you! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH stands beside you as your protective shade.
The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon at night.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH keeps you from all harm and watches over your life.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH keeps watch over you, in your going out and in your coming in, both now and forever.
I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
And now here we are, standing inside your gates, O Yahushalam.
Yahushalam is a well-built city; its seamless walls cannot be breached.
All the tribes of Yashar'AL, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people, make their pilgrimage here. They come to give thanks to the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as the law requires of Yashar'AL.
Here stand the thrones where judgment is given, the thrones of the dynasty of Daud.
Pray for Shalum in Yahushalam. May all who love this city prosper.
O Yahushalam, may there be Shalum within your walls and prosperity in your palaces.
For the sake of my family and friends, I will say, “May you have Shalum.”
For the sake of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I will seek what is best for you, O Yahushalam.
I lift my eyes to you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, enthroned in Shamaym.
We keep looking to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH for his mercy, just as servants keep their eyes on their master, as a slave girl watches her mistress for the slightest signal.
Have mercy on us, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have mercy, for we have had our fill of contempt.
We have had more than our fill of the scoffing of the proud and the contempt of the arrogant.
What if 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had not been on our side Let all Yashar'AL repeat:
What if 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had not been on our side when people attacked us?
They would have swallowed us alive in their burning anger.
The waters would have engulfed us; a torrent would have overwhelmed us.
Yes, the raging waters of their fury would have overwhelmed our very lives.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who did not let their teeth tear us apart!
We escaped like a bird from a hunter’s trap. The trap is broken, and we are free!
Our help is from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who made the Shamaym and the Arath.
Those who trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are as secure as Mount Zion; they will not be defeated but will endure forever.
Just as the mountains surround Yahushalam, so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH surrounds his people, both now and forever.
The wicked will not rule the land of the righteous, for then the righteous might be tempted to do wrong.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, do good to those who are good, whose hearts are in tune with you.
But banish those who turn to crooked ways, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Take them away with those who do evil, May Yashar'AL have Shalum.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought back his exiles to Yahushalam, it was like a dream!
We were filled with laughter, and we sang for joy. And the other nations said, “What amazing things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done for them.”
Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done amazing things for us! What a joy!
Restore our fortunes, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as streams renew the desert.
Those who plant in tears will harvest with shouts of joy.
They weep as they go to plant their seed, but they will be joyful, singing as they return with their harvest.
Unless 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH builds a house, the work of the builders is wasted. Unless 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH protects a city, guarding it with sentries will do no good.
It is useless for you to work so hard from early morning until late at night, anxiously working for food to eat; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives rest to his loved ones.
Children are a gift from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; they are a reward from Him.
Children born to a young man are like arrows in a warrior’s hands.
How joyful is the man whose quiver is full of them! He will not be put to shame when he confronts his accusers at the city gates.
How joyful are those who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all who follow His ways!
You will enjoy the fruit of your labor. How joyful and prosperous you will be!
Your wife will be like a fruitful grapevine, flourishing within your home, your children will be like vigorous young olive trees as they sit around your table.
That is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Barakah for those who fear Him.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH continually Barak you from Ziun. May you see Yahushalam prosper as long as you live.
May you live to enjoy your grandchildren. May Yashar'AL have Shalum!
From my earliest youth my enemies have persecuted me. Let all Yashar'AL repeat this:
From my earliest youth my enemies have persecuted me, but they have never defeated me.
My back is covered with cuts, as if a farmer had plowed long furrows.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has cut me free from the ropes of the unrighteous.
May all who hate Yahushalam be turned back in shameful defeat.
May they be as useless as grass on a rooftop, turning yellow when only half grown,
ignored by the harvester, despised by the binder.
And may those who pass by refuse to give them this Barakah: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH barak you; we Barak you in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
From the depths of despair, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I call for your help.
Hear my cry, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Pay attention to my prayer.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, if you kept a record of our sins, who could ever survive?
But you offer forgiveness, that we might learn to fear you.
I am counting on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; yes, I am counting on Him. I have put my hope in the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I long for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH more than sentries long for the dawn, yes, more than sentries long for the dawn.
O Yashar'AL, hope in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; for with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH there is unfailing love, and the redemption of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH overflows.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself will redeem Yashar'AL from every kind of sin.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, my heart is not proud; my eyes are not haughty. I do not concern myself with matters too great or too awesome for me to grasp.
Instead, I have calmed and quieted myself, like a weaned child who no longer cries for its mother’s milk. Yes, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
O Yashar'AL, put your hope in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, now and always.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, remember Daud and all that he suffered.
He made a solemn promise to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, he vowed to the AL'Mighty One of Yashar'AL,
“I will not go home; I will not let myself rest.
I will not let my eyes sleep nor close my eyelids in slumber
until I find a place to build a house for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, a sanctuary for the AL'Mighty One of Yashar'AL.”
We heard that the Ark was in Aphrathah; then we found it in the distant countryside of Yaar.
Let us go to the sanctuary of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; let us worship at the footstool of the throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Arise, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and enter your resting place, along with the Ark, the symbol of your power.
May your Kuhanym be clothed in righteousness; may your loyal servants sing for joy.
For the sake of your servant Daud, do not reject the king you have anointed.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH swore an oath to Daud with a promise He will never take back: “I will place one of your descendants on your throne.
If your descendants obey the terms of my covenant and the laws that I teach them, then your royal line will continue forever and ever.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen Yahushalam; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has desired it for his home.
“This is my resting place forever,” and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar. “I will live here, for this is the home I desired.
I will barak this city and make it prosperous; I will satisfy its poor with food.
I will clothe its Kuhanym with righteousness; its faithful servants will sing for joy.
Here I will increase the power of Daud; my anointed one will be a light for my people.
I will clothe his enemies with shame, but Daud will be an esteemed king.”
How wonderful and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
For harmony is as precious as the anointing oil that was poured over Aarun’s head, that ran down his beard into the border of his robe.
Harmony is as refreshing as the dew from Mount Harmun that falls on the mountains of Zion. And there 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has pronounced his Barakah, even life everlasting.
Oh, Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all you servants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you who serve at night in the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Lift your hands toward the sanctuary, and Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who made Shamaym and Arath, barak you from Yahushalam.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Yadah the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you who serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
you who serve in the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, in the courts of the house of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good; celebrate his lovely Name with music.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen Ya'aqub for Himself, and Yashar'AL for his own special treasure.
I know the greatness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is greater than all.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does whatever pleases Him throughout all Shamaym and the Arath, and on the seas and in their depths.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH causes the clouds to rise over the whole Arath. He sends the lightning with the rain and releases the wind from his storehouses.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroyed the firstborn in each Mitzraym home, both people and animals.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH performed miraculous signs and wonders in Mitzraym against Phar'uh and all his people.
He struck down great nations and slaughtered mighty kings
Sihun king of the Amurites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave their land as an inheritance, a special possession to his people Yashar'AL.
Your Name, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, endures forever; your fame, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, is known to every generation.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give justice to his people and have compassion on his servants.
The idols of the other nations are merely things of silver and gold, shaped by man's hands.
They have mouths but cannot speak, and eyes but cannot see.
They have ears but cannot hear, and mouths but cannot breathe.
And those who make idols are just like them, as are all who trust in them.
O Yashar'AL, Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! O Kuhanym, descendants of Aarun, Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
O Lauym, Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! All you who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from Ziun, for He lives here in Yahushalam. Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Give Tudah (thanks) to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for He is good! and His merciful love endures forever.
Give Tudah to the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all Aluahym, for His merciful love endures forever.
Give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the maker of Kings, for His faithful love endures forever.
Give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who alone does mighty miracles, and His faithful love endures forever.
Give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who made the Shamaym so skillfully, for His faithful love endures forever.
Give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who placed the Arath among the waters, for His faithful love endures forever.
Give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who made the lights of Shamaym, for His faithful love endures forever.
the sun to rule the day, for His faithful love endures forever.
and the moon and stars to rule the night, for His faithful love endures forever.
Give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who killed the firstborn of Mitzraym, for His faithful love endures forever.
He brought Yashar'AL out of Mitzraym, for His faithful love endures forever.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH acted with a strong hand and powerful arm, for His faithful love endures forever.
Give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who parted the Red Sea, for His faithful love endures forever.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH led Yashar'AL safely through, for His faithful love endures forever.
but he hurled Phar'uh and his army into the Red Sea, for His faithful love endures forever.
Give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who led his people through the wilderness, for His faithful love endures forever.
Give thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who struck down mighty kings, for His faithful love endures forever.
He killed powerful kings, for His faithful love endures forever.
Sihun king of the Amurites, for His faithful love endures forever.
and Ug king of Bashan, for His faithful love endures forever.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave the land of these kings as an inheritance, for His faithful love endures forever.
a special possession to his servant Yashar'AL, for His faithful love endures forever.
He remembered us in our weakness, for His faithful love endures forever.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saved us from our enemies, for His faithful love endures forever.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives food to every living thing, for His faithful love endures forever.
Give thanks to the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shamaym. For His faithful love endures forever.
Beside the rivers of Babylun, we sat and wept as we thought of Yahushalam.
We put away our harps, hanging them on the branches of poplar trees.
For our captors demanded a song from us. Our tormentors insisted on a joyful hymn: “Sing us one of those songs of Yahushalam!”
But how can we sing the songs of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH while in a pagan land?
If I forget you, O Yahushalam, let my right hand forget how to play the harp.
May my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I fail to remember you, if I don’t make Yahushalam my greatest joy.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, remember what the Adumites did on the day the armies of Babylun captured Yahushalam. “Destroy it!” they yelled. “Level it to the ground!”
O Babylun, you will be destroyed. Happy is the one who pays you back for what you have done to us.
Happy is the one who takes your babies and smashes them against the rocks!
I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, with all my heart; I will sing songs of Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH before the pagan idols.
I bow before your qadash Temple as I worship. I Yadah your Name for your unfailing love and faithfulness; for your promises are backed by all the honor of your Name.
As soon as I pray, you answer me; you encourage me by giving me strength.
Every king in all the Arath will thank you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for all of them will hear your Dabar.
Yes, they will sing about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s ways, for the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is very great.
Though 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is great, He cares for the humble, but he keeps his distance from the proud.
Though I am surrounded by troubles, You will protect me from the anger of my enemies. You reach out your hand, and the power of your right hand saves me.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will work out his plans for my life, for your faithful love, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, endures forever. Do not abandon me, for you made me.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you have examined my heart and know everything about me.
You know when I sit down or stand up. You know my thoughts even when I am far away.
You see me when I travel and when I rest at home, You know everything I do.
You know what I am going to say even before I say it, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You go before me and follow me. You place your hand of Barakah on my head.
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, and too great for me to understand!
I can never escape from your Ruach! I can never get away from your presence!
If I go up to Shamaym, you are there; if I go down to the grave, you are there.
If I ride the wings of the morning, if I dwell by the farthest oceans,
even there your hand will guide me, and your strength will support me.
I could ask the darkness to hide me and the light around me to become night
but even in darkness I cannot hide from you, To you the night shines as bright as day. Darkness and light are the same to you.
You made all the delicate, inner parts of my body and knit me together in my mother’s womb.
Tudah Raba 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for making me so wonderfully complex! Your workmanship is marvelous, how well I know it.
You watched me as I was being formed in utter seclusion, as I was woven together in the dark of the womb.
You saw me before I was born, Every day of my life was recorded in your book, Every moment was laid out before a single day had passed.
How precious are your thoughts about me, O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, They cannot be numbered!
I cannot even count them; they outnumber the grains of sand! And when I wake up, you are still with me!
O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, if only you would destroy the wicked! Get out of my life, you murderers!
They blaspheme you; your enemies misuse your Name.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, should I not hate those who hate you? Should I not despise those who oppose you?
Yes, I hate them with total hatred, for your enemies are my enemies.
Search me, O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.
Point out anything in me that offends you, and lead me along the path of everlasting life.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, rescue me from evil people. Protect me from those who are violent,
those who plot evil in their hearts and stir up trouble all day long.
Their tongues sting like a snake; the venom of a viper drips from their lips.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, keep me out of the hands of the wicked. Protect me from those who are violent, for they are plotting against me.
The proud have set a trap to catch me; they have stretched out a net; they have placed traps all along the way.
I said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “You are my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH!” Listen, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to my cries for mercy!
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the strong one who rescued me, you protected me on the day of battle.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, do not let evil people have their way. Do not let their evil schemes succeed, or they will become proud.
Let my enemies be destroyed by the very evil they have planned for me.
Let burning coals fall down on their heads. Let them be thrown into the fire or into watery pits from which they can not escape.
Do not let liars prosper here in our land. Cause great disasters to fall on the violent.
But I know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will help those they persecute; He will give justice to the poor.
Surely righteous people are praising your Name; the righteous will live in your presence.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I am calling to you. Please hurry! Listen when I cry to you for help!
Accept my prayer as incense offered to you, and the lifting up of my hands as an evening sacrifice.
Take control of what I say, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and guard my lips.
Do not let me drift toward evil or take part in acts of wickedness. Do not let me share in the delicacies of those who do wrong.
Let the righteous strike me! It will be a kindness! If they correct me, it is soothing medicine. Do not let me refuse it, But I pray constantly against the wicked and their deeds.
When their leaders are thrown down from a cliff, the wicked will listen to my words and find them true.
Like rocks brought up by a plow, the bones of the wicked will lie scattered without burial.
I look to you for help, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, You are my refuge; do not let them kill me.
Keep me from the traps they have set for me, from the snares of those who do wrong.
Let the wicked fall into their own nets, but let me escape.
I cry out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I plead for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s mercy.
I pour out my complaints before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and tell Him all my troubles.
When I am overwhelmed, you alone know the way I should turn. Wherever I go, my enemies have set traps for me.
I look for someone to come and help me, but no one gives me a passing thought! No one will help me; no one cares a bit about what happens to me.
Then I pray to you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I say, “You are my place of refuge. You are all I really want in life.
Hear my cry, for I am very low. Rescue me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.
Bring me out of prison so I can thank you, The righteous will crowd around me, for you are good to me.”
Hear my prayer, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; listen to my plea! Answer me because you are faithful and righteous.
Do not put your servant on trial, for no one is innocent before you.
My enemy has chased me, he has knocked me to the ground and forces me to live in darkness like those in the grave.
I am losing all hope I am paralyzed with fear.
I remember the days of old, I ponder all your great works and think about what you have done.
I lift my hands to you in prayer. I thirst for you as parched land thirsts for rain.
Come quickly, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and answer me, for my depression deepens, Do not turn away from me, or I will die.
Let me hear of your unfailing love each morning, for I am trusting you. Show me where to walk, for I give myself to you.
Rescue me from my enemies, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I run to you to hide me.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, May your awesome Ruach lead me forward on a firm footing.
For the Kabad of your Name, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, preserve my life, Because of your faithfulness, bring me out of this distress.
In your unfailing love, silence all my enemies and destroy all my foes, for I am your servant.
I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who is my rock. He trains my hands for war and gives my fingers skill for battle.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my loving ally and my fortress, my tower of safety, my rescuer. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my shield, and I will take refuge in Him, for He makes the nations submit to me.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, what are mankind that you should notice them, mere mortals that you should think about them?
For they are like a breath of air; their days are like a passing shadow.
Open the Shamaym, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and come down. Touch the mountains so they billow smoke.
Hurl your lightning bolts and scatter your enemies! Shoot your arrows and confuse them!
Reach down from Shamaym and rescue me; rescue me from deep waters, from the power of my enemies.
Their mouths are full of lies; they swear to tell the truth, but they lie instead.
I will sing a new song to you, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! I will sing your Yadah with a ten-stringed harp.
For you grant victory to kings! You rescued your servant Daud from the fatal sword.
Save me! Rescue me from the power of my enemies, Their mouths are full of lies; they swear to tell the truth, but they lie instead.
May our sons flourish in their youth like well-nurtured plants. May our daughters be like beautiful pillars, carved to beautify a palace.
May our barns be filled with crops of every kind, May the flocks in our fields multiply by the thousands, even tens of thousands,
and may our oxen be loaded down with produce, May there be no enemy breaking through our walls, no going into captivity, no cries of alarm in our town squares.
Yes, joyful are those who live like this! Joyful indeed are those whose 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I will exalt you, my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and I will Yadah your Name forever and ever.
I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH every day; yes, I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever.
Great is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! He is most worthy of Yadah! No one can measure the greatness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Let each generation tell its children the mighty acts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; let them proclaim the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I will meditate on the majestic, awesome splendor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and His wonderful miracles.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH awe-inspiring deeds will be on every tongue; I will proclaim the greatness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Everyone will share the story of Your wonderful goodness; they will sing with joy about Your righteousness.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is merciful and compassionate, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good to everyone, He showers compassion on all his creation.
All of your works will give Tudah You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and your faithful followers will Yadah your Name.
They will speak of the Kabad of your kingdom; they will give examples of your power.
They will tell about Your mighty deeds and about the majesty and Kabad of your reign.
For your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, You rule throughout all generations, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH always keeps his promises; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is awesome in all He does.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH helps the fallen and lifts those bent beneath their loads.
The eyes of all look to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in hope; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives them their food as they need it.
When you open your hand, you satisfy the hunger and thirst of every living thing.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is righteous in everything He does; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is filled with kindness.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is close to all who call on Him, yes, to all who call on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in truth.
He grants the desires of those who fear Him; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hears their cries for help and rescues them.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH protects all those who love Him, but He destroys the wicked.
I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and may everyone on the Arath barak His Qadash Name forever and ever.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Let all that I am Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as long as I live. I will sing Yadah to my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH with my dying breath.
Do not put your confidence in powerful people; there is no help for you there.
When they breathe their last, they return to the earth, and all their plans die with them.
But joyful are those who have the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL as their helper, whose hope is in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made Shamaym and the Arath, the sea, and everything in them. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH keeps every promise forever.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives justice to the oppressed and food to the hungry, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH frees the prisoners.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH opens the eyes of the blind, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lifts up those who are weighed down, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves the righteous.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH protects the foreigners among us. He cares for the orphans and widows, but He frustrates the plans of the wicked.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will reign forever. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, O Yahushalam, throughout the generations, sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! How good to sing Yadah to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! How delightful and how fitting!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is rebuilding Yahushalam and bringing the exiles back to Yashar'AL.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heals the brokenhearted and bandages their wounds.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH counts the stars and calls them all by name.
How great is our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! His power is absolute! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's understanding is beyond comprehension!
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH supports the humble, but he brings the wicked down into the dust.
Sing out your Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; sing Yadah to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH with a harp.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH covers the Shamaym with clouds, provides rain for the Arath, and makes the grass grow in mountain pastures.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives food to the wild animals and feeds the young ravens when they cry.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH takes no pleasure in the strength of a horse or in man's might.
No, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s delight is in those who fear him, those who put their hope in his unfailing love.
Worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, O Yahushalam! Yadah your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, O Ziun!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has strengthened the bars of your gates and Baraked your children within your walls.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sends Shalum across your nation and satisfies your hunger with the finest wheat.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sends his orders to the world, how swiftly his word flies!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sends the snow like white wool; he scatters frost upon the ground like ashes.
He hurls the hail like stones. Who can stand against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's freezing cold?
Then, at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, it all melts, He sends his winds, and the ice thaws.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has revealed His Dabar to Ya'aqub, and His decrees and regulations to Yashar'AL.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not done this for any other nation; they do not know his regulations. Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
Sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from the Shamaym! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from the skies!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all His Malakym! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all the armies of Shamaym!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, sun and moon! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all you twinkling stars!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, skies above! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, vapors high above the clouds!
Let every created thing give Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH issued His commands, and all creations came into being.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH set them in place forever and ever, and the decrees of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut will never be revoked.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from the Arath, you creatures of the ocean depths,
fire and hail, snow and clouds, wind and weather that obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
wild animals and all livestock, small scurrying animals and birds,
kings of the Arath and all people, rulers and judges of the Arath,
young men and young women, old men and children.
Let them all Yadah the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For His Name is very great; His Kabad is all over the Arath and Shamaym!
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made His people strong, honoring His faithful ones, the people of Yashar'AL who are close to Him.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH a new song. Sing his Yadah in the assembly of the faithful.
O Yashar'AL, rejoice in your Maker. O people of Yahushalam, exult in your ruler.
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with dancing, accompanied by tambourine and harp.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH delights in His people; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH crowns the humble with victory.
Let the faithful rejoice that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH honors them. Let them sing for joy as they lie on their beds.
Let the Yadah of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH be in their mouths, and a sharp sword in their hands,
to execute vengeance on the nations and punishment on the people,
to bind their kings with shackles and their leaders with iron chains,
to execute the judgment written against them. This is the awesome privilege of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's faithful ones.
Sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Yadah our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH in His Qadash house; Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in His mighty Shamaym!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for His mighty works; Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for His awesome greatness!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with a blast of the ram’s horn; Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with the lyre and harp!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with the tambourine and dancing; Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with strings and flutes!
Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with a clash of cymbals; Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with loud clanging cymbals.
Let everything that breathes sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!

books.name: Proverbs
chapters: These are the proverbs of Shalumah, Daud’s son, king of Yashar'AL.
Their purpose is to teach people wisdom and discipline, to help them understand the insights of the wise.
Their purpose is to teach people to live disciplined and successful lives, to help them do what is right, just, and fair.
These proverbs will give insight to the simple, knowledge and discernment to the young.
Let the wise listen to these proverbs and become even wiser. Let those with understanding receive guidance
by exploring the meaning in these proverbs and parables, the words of the wise and their riddles.
The fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the foundation of true knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
My child, listen when your father corrects you. Do not neglect your mother’s instruction.
What you learn from them will crown you with Favors and be a chain of honor around your neck.
My child, if sinners entice you, turn your back on them!
They may say, “Come and join us. Let us hide and kill someone! Just for fun, let us ambush the innocent!
Let us swallow them alive, like the grave; let us swallow them whole, like those who go down to the pit of death.
Think of the great things we will get! We will fill our houses with all the stuff we take.
Come, throw in your lot with us; we will all share the loot.”
My child, do not go along with them! Stay far away from their paths.
They rush to commit evil deeds. They hurry to commit murder.
If a bird sees a trap being set, it knows to stay away.
But these people set an ambush for themselves; they are trying to get themselves killed.
Such is the fate of all who are greedy for money; it robs them of life.
Wisdom shouts in the streets. She cries out in the public square.
She calls to the crowds along the main street, to those gathered in front of the city gate:
“How long you simple ones, will insist on being simpleminded? How long will you mockers relish your mocking? How long will you fools hate knowledge?
Come and listen to my counsel. I will share my heart with you and make you wise.
“I called you so often, but you would not come. I reached out to you, but you paid no attention.
You ignored my advice and rejected the correction I offered.
So I will laugh when you are in trouble! I will mock you when disaster overtakes you
when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when disaster engulfs you like a cyclone and anguish and distress overwhelm you.
“When they cry for help, I will not answer. Though they anxiously search for me, they will not find me.
For they hated knowledge and chose not to fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
They rejected my advice and paid no attention when I corrected them.
Therefore, they must eat the bitter fruit of living their own way, choking on their own schemes.
For simpletons turn away from me to death. Fools are destroyed by their own complacency.
But all who listen to me will live in Shalum, untroubled by fear of harm.”
My child, listen to what I say, and treasure my commands.
Tune your ears to wisdom, and concentrate on understanding.
Cry out for insight, and ask for understanding.
Search for them as you would for silver; seek them like hidden treasures.
Then you will understand what it means to fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and you will gain knowledge of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH grants wisdom! And from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH grants a treasure of common sense to the honest. He is a shield to those who walk with integrity.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH guards the paths of the just and protects those who are faithful to him.
Then you will understand what is right, just, and fair, and you will find the right way to go.
For wisdom will enter your heart, and knowledge will fill you with joy.
Wise choices will watch over you. Understanding will keep you safe.
Wisdom will save you from evil people, from those whose words are twisted.
These men turn from the right way to walk down dark paths.
They take pleasure in doing wrong, and they enjoy the twisted ways of evil.
Their actions are crooked, and their ways are wrong.
Wisdom will save you from the immoral woman, from the seductive words of the promiscuous woman.
She has abandoned her husband and ignores the covenant she made before her 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Entering her house leads to death; it is the road to the grave.
The man who visits her is doomed. He will never reach the paths of life.
Follow the steps of good men instead, and stay on the paths of the righteous.
For only the righteous will live in the land, and those with integrity will remain in it.
But the wicked will be removed from the land, and the treacherous will be uprooted.
My child, never forget the things I have taught you. Store my Commands in your heart.
If you do this, you will live many years, and your life will be satisfying.
Never let loyalty and kindness leave you! Tie them around your neck as a reminder, Write them deep within your heart.
Then you will find favor with both 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and man, and you will earn a good reputation.
Trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with all your heart; do not depend on your own understanding.
Seek the WILL of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in all you do, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will show you which path to take.
Do not be impressed with your own wisdom. Instead, fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and turn away from evil.
Then you will have healing for your body and strength for your bones.
Honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with your wealth and with the best part of everything you produce.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will fill your barns with grain, and your vats will overflow with good wine.
My child, do not reject the discipline of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and do not be upset when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH corrects you.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH corrects those he loves, just as a father corrects a child in whom he delights.
Joyful is the person who finds wisdom, the one who gains understanding.
For wisdom is more profitable than silver, and her wages are better than gold.
Wisdom is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.
She offers you long life in her right hand, and riches and honor in her left.
She will guide you down to delightful paths; all her ways are satisfying.
Wisdom is a tree of life to those who embrace her; happy are those who hold her tightly.
By wisdom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH founded the Arath; by understanding he created the Shamaym.
By His knowledge the deep fountains of the Arath burst forth, and the dew settles beneath the night sky.
My child, do not lose sight of common sense and discernment. Hang on to them,
for they will refresh your soul. They are like jewels on a necklace.
They keep you safe on your way, and your feet will not stumble.
You can go to bed without fear; you will lie down and sleep soundly.
You need not be afraid of sudden disaster or the destruction that comes upon the wicked,
for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is your security. He will keep your foot from being caught in a trap.
Do not withhold good from those who deserve it when it is in your power to help them.
If you can help your neighbor now, do not say, Come back tomorrow, and then I will help you.”
Do not plot harm against your neighbor, for those who live nearby trust you.
Do not pick a fight without reason, when no one has done you harm.
Do not envy violent people or copy their ways.
Such wicked people are detestable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH offers His friendship to the righteous.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH curses the house of the wicked, but He Barak's the home of the upright.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH mocks the mockers but He is favorable to the humble.
The wise inherit honor, but fools are put to shame!
My children, listen when your father corrects you. Pay attention and learn good judgment,
for I am giving you good guidance. Do not turn away from my instructions.
For I, too, was once my father’s son, tenderly loved as my mother’s only child.
My father taught me, “Take my words to heart. Follow my commands, and you will live.
Get wisdom; develop good judgment. Do not forget my words or turn away from them.
Do not turn your back on wisdom, for she will protect you. Love her, and she will guard you.
Wisdom is the principal thing; Therefore get wisdom, and in all your getting, get understanding.
If you prize wisdom, she will make you great. Embrace her, and she will honor you.
She will place a lovely wreath on your head; she will present you with a beautiful crown.”
My child, listen to me and do as I say, and you will have a long, good life.
I will teach you the ways of wisdom and lead you in straight paths.
When you walk, you will not be held back; when you run, you will not stumble.
Take hold of my instructions; do not let them go. Guard them, for they are the key to life.
Do not do as the wicked do, and do not follow the path of evildoers.
Do not even think about it; do not go that way. Turn away and keep moving.
For evil people can not sleep until they have done their evil deed for the day. They can not rest until they have caused someone to stumble.
They eat the food of wickedness and drink the wine of violence!
The Part of the righteous is like the Shining Light (new dawn), which shines ever brighter until the perfect day (full light of day).
But the way of the wicked is like total darkness, They have no idea what they are stumbling over.
My child, pay attention to what I say. Listen carefully to my words.
Do not lose sight of them. Let them penetrate deep into your heart,
for they bring life to those who find them, and healing to their whole body.
Guard your heart above all else, for it determines the course of your life.
Avoid all perverse talk; stay away from corrupt speech.
Look straight ahead, and fix your eyes on what lies before you.
Mark out a straight path for your feet; stay on the safe path.
Do not get sidetracked; keep your feet from following evil.
My son, pay attention to my wisdom; listen carefully to my wise counsel.
Then you will show discernment, and your lips will express what you have learned.
For the lips of an immoral woman are as sweet as honey, and her mouth is smoother than oil.
But in the end she is as bitter as poison, as dangerous as a double-edged sword.
Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to the grave.
She cares for nothing about the path to life, She staggers down a crooked trail and does not realize it.
So now, my sons, listen to me, Never stray from what I am about to say:
Stay away from her! Do not go near the door of her house!
If you do, you will lose your honor and will lose to merciless people all you have achieved.
Strangers will consume your wealth, and someone else will enjoy the fruit of your labor.
In the end you will groan in anguish when disease consumes your body.
You will say, “How I hated discipline! If only I had not ignored all the warnings!
Oh, why did I not listen to my teachers? Why did I not pay attention to my instructors?
I have come to the brink of utter ruin, and now I must face public Shame.”
Drink water from your own well, share your love only with your wife.
Why spill the water of your springs in the streets, having sex with just anyone?
You should reserve it for yourselves. Never share it with strangers.
Let your wife be a fountain of Barakah for you. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.
She is a loving deer, a favored doe. Let her breasts satisfy you always. May you always be captivated by her love.
Why be captivated, my son, by an immoral woman, or fondle the breasts of a promiscuous woman?
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sees clearly what a man does, and examining every path he takes.
An evil man is held captive by his own sins; they are ropes that catch and hold him.
He will die for lack of self-control; he will be lost because of his great foolishness.
My child, if you have put up security for a friend’s debt or agreed to guarantee the debt of a stranger
if you have trapped yourself by your agreement and are caught by what you said
follow my advice and save yourself, for you have placed yourself at your friend’s mercy. Now swallow your pride; go and beg to have your name erased.
Do not put it off; do it now! Do not rest until you do.
Save yourself like a gazelle escaping from a hunter, like a bird fleeing from a net.
Take a lesson from the ants, you lazybones. Learn from their ways and become wise!
Though they have no prince or governor or ruler to make them work,
they labor hard all summer, gathering food for the winter.
But you, lazybones, how long will you sleep? When will you wake up?
A little extra sleep, a little more slumber, a little folding of the hands to rest
then poverty will pounce on you like a bandit; scarcity will attack you like an armed robber.
What are worthless and wicked people like? They are constant liars,
signaling their deceit with a wink of the eye, a nudge of the foot, or the wiggle of fingers.
Their perverted hearts plot evil, and they constantly stir up trouble.
But they will be destroyed suddenly, broken in an instant beyond all hope of healing.
There are six things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hates, no, seven things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests:
haughty eyes, a lying tongue, hands that kill the innocent,
a heart that plots evil, feet that race to do wrong,
a false witness who pours out lies, a person who sows discord in a family.
My son, obey your father’s commands, and do not neglect your mother’s instruction.
Keep their words always in your heart, Tie them around your neck.
When you walk, their counsel will lead you. When you sleep, they will protect you. When you wake up, they will advise you.
For the commandments is a lamp and the instruction (Law) is a light; and the corrective discipline is the way to life.
It will keep you from the immoral woman, from the smooth tongue of a promiscuous woman.
Do not lust for her beauty. Do not let her coy glances seduce you.
For a prostitute will bring you to poverty, but sleeping with another man’s wife will cost you your life.
Can a man scoop a flame into his lap and not have his clothes catch on fire?
Can he walk on hot coals and not blister his feet?
So it is with the man who sleeps with another man’s wife. He who embraces her will not go unpunished.
Excuses might be found for a thief who steals because he is starving.
But if he is caught, he must pay back seven times what he stole, even if he has to sell everything in his house.
But the man who commits adultery is an utter fool, for he destroys himself.
He will be wounded and shamed, his shame will never be erased.
For the woman’s jealous husband will be furious, and he will show no mercy when he takes revenge.
He will accept no compensation, nor be satisfied with a payoff of any size.
Follow my advice, my son; always treasure my commands.
Obey my commands and live! Guard my instructions as you guard your own eyes.
Tie them on your fingers as a reminder. Write them deep within your heart.
Love wisdom like a sister; make insight a beloved member of your family.
Let them protect you from an affair with an immoral woman, from listening to the flattery of a promiscuous woman.
While I was at the window of my house, looking through the curtain,
I saw some naive young men, and one in particular who lacked common sense.
He was crossing the street near the house of an immoral woman, strolling down the path by her house.
It was at twilight, in the evening, as deep darkness fell.
The woman approached him, seductively dressed and sly of heart.
She was the brash, rebellious type, never content to stay at home.
She is often in the streets and markets, soliciting at every corner.
She threw her arms around him and kissed him, and with a brazen look she said,
“I have just made my Shalum offerings and fulfilled my vows.
You are the one I was looking for! I came out to find you, and here you are!
My bed is spread with beautiful blankets, with colored sheets of Mitzraym linen.
I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
Come, let us drink our fill of love until morning. Let us enjoy each other’s caresses,
for my husband is not home. He is away on a long trip.
He has taken a wallet full of money with him and will not return until later this month.”
So she seduced him with her pretty speech and enticed him with her flattery.
He followed her at once, like an ox going to the slaughter, he was like a stag caught in a trap,
awaiting the arrow that would pierce its heart, he was like a bird flying into a snare, little did he know it would cost him his life.
So listen to me, my sons, and pay attention to my words.
Do not let your hearts stray away toward her. Do not wander down her wayward path.
For she has been the ruin of many; many men have been her victims.
Her house is the road to the grave, her bedroom is the den of death.
Does wisdom not cry out, and understanding lift up her voice?
She takes her stand on the top of the high hill, Beside the way, where the paths meet.
She cries out by the gates, at the entry of the city, At the entrance of the doors:
“To you, O men, I call, and my voice is to the sons of men.
O you simple ones, understand prudence, And you fools, be of an understanding heart.
Listen, for I will speak of excellent things, And from the opening of my lips will come right things;
For my mouth will speak truth; Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
All the words of my mouth are with righteousness; Nothing crooked or perverse is in them.
They are all plain to him who understands, And right to those who find knowledge.
Receive my instruction, and not silver, And knowledge rather than choice gold;
For wisdom is better than rubies, And all the things one may desire cannot be compared with her.
“I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge and discretion.
The fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is to hate evil; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests Pride and arrogance and all evil ways and the perverse mouth.
Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom; I am understanding, I have strength.
By Me kings reign, And rulers decree justice.
By Me princes rule, and nobles, All the judges of the Arath.
I love those who love Me, and those who seek me diligently will find me.
Riches and honor are with Me, Enduring riches and righteousness.
My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, And my revenue than choice silver.
I traverse the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice,
That I may cause those who love me to inherit wealth, That I may fill their treasuries.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH possessed me at the beginning of His way, Before His works of old.
I have been established from everlasting, From the beginning, before there was ever an Arath.
When there were no depths I was brought forth, When there were no fountains abounding with water.
Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills, I was brought forth;
While as yet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had not made the Arath or the fields, Or the primal dust of the world.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH prepared the Shamaym, I was there, When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH drew a circle on the face of the deep,
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH established the clouds above, When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH strengthened the fountains of the deep,
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH assigned to the sea its limit, So that the waters would not transgress His command, When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH marked out the foundations of the Arath,
Then I was beside 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as a master craftsman; And I was daily His delight, Rejoicing always before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
Rejoicing in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's inhabited world, And my delight was with the sons of men.
“Now therefore, listen to me, my children, For Baraked are those who keep my ways.
Hear instruction and be wise, And do not disdain it.
Baraked is the man who listens to me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.
For whoever finds me finds life, And obtains favor from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH;
But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul; All those who hate me love death.”
Wisdom has built her house, She has hewn out her seven pillars;
She has slaughtered her meat, She has mixed her wine, wisdom has also furnished her table.
Wisdom has sent out her maidens, She cries out from the highest places of the city,
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!”As for him who lacks understanding, wisdom says to him,
“Come, eat of my bread And drink of the wine I have mixed.
Forsake foolishness and live, and go in the way of understanding.
“He who corrects a scoffer gets shame for himself, And he who rebukes a wicked man only harms himself.
Do not correct a scoffer, lest he hate you; Rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.
Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be still wiser; Teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
“The fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Qadash One is understanding.
For by me your days will be multiplied, And years of life will be added to you.
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself, and if you scoff, you will bear it alone.”
A foolish woman is clamorous; She is simple, and knows nothing.
For she sits at the door of her house, On a seat by the highest places of the city,
To call to those who pass by, who go straight on their way:
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here”; and as for him who lacks understanding, she says to him,
“Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.”
But he does not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of hell.
The proverbs of Shalumah: a wise son makes a glad father, But a foolish son is the grief of his mother.
Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, But righteousness delivers from death.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not allow the righteous soul to famish, But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH casts away the desire of the wicked.
He who has a slack hand becomes poor, But the hand of the diligent makes rich.
He who gathers in summer is a wise son; He who sleeps in harvest is a son who causes shame.
Barakah are on the head of the righteous, But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
The memory of the righteous is Baraked, But the name of the wicked will rot.
The wise in heart will receive commands, But a prating fool will fall.
He who walks with integrity walks securely, But he who perverts his ways will become known.
He who winks with the eye causes trouble, But a prating fool will fall.
The mouth of the righteous is a well of life, But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
Hatred stirs up strife, But love covers all sins.
Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has understanding, But a rod is for the back of him who is devoid of understanding.
Wise people store up knowledge, But the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
The rich man’s wealth is his strong city; The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
The labor of the righteous leads to life, The wages of the wicked to sin.
He who keeps instruction is in the way of life, But he who refuses correction goes astray.
Whoever hides hatred has lying lips, And whoever spreads slander is a fool.
In the multitude of words sin is not lacking, But he who restrains his lips is wise.
The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; The heart of the wicked is worth little.
The lips of the righteous feed many, But fools die for lack of wisdom.
The Barakah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH makes one rich, and He adds no sorrow with it.
To do evil is like sport to a fool, But a man of understanding has wisdom.
The fear of the wicked will come upon him, And the desire of the righteous will be granted.
When the whirlwind passes by, the wicked is no more, But the righteous has an everlasting foundation.
As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, So is the lazy man to those who send him.
The fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH prolongs days, But the years of the wicked will be shortened.
The hope of the righteous will be gladness, But the expectation of the wicked will perish.
The way of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is strength for the upright, But destruction will come to the workers of iniquity.
The righteous will never be removed, But the wicked will not inhabit the Arath.
The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, But the perverse tongue will be cut out.
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked speaks perverse words.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests the use of dishonest scales, but He delights in accurate weights.
Pride leads to dishonor, but with humility comes wisdom.
Honesty guides good people; dishonesty destroys treacherous people.
Riches will not help you on the day of judgment, but right living can save you from death.
The righteous are directed by honesty; the wicked fall beneath their load of sin.
The Righteousness of good people rescues them; the ambition of treacherous people traps them.
When the wicked die, their hopes die with them, for they rely on their own feeble strength.
The righteous are rescued from trouble, and it falls on the wicked instead.
With their words, the wicked destroy their friends, but knowledge will rescue the righteous.
The whole city celebrates when the righteous succeed; they shout for joy when the wicked die.
Upright citizens are good for a city and make it prosper, but the talk of the wicked tears it apart.
It is foolish to belittle your neighbor; a sensible person keeps quiet.
A gossip goes around telling secrets, but those who are trustworthy can keep a confidence.
Without wise leadership, a nation falls; there is safety in having many advisers.
There is danger in putting up security for a stranger’s debt; it is safer not to guarantee another person’s debt.
A kind-hearted woman gains respect, but ruthless men gain only wealth.
Your kindness will reward you, but your cruelty will destroy you.
Evil people get rich for the moment, but the reward of the righteous will last.
Righteous people find life; evil people find death.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests people with crooked hearts, but he delights in those with integrity.
Evil people will surely be punished, but the children of the righteous will go free.
A beautiful woman who lacks discretion is like a gold ring in a pig’s snout.
The righteous can look forward to a reward, while the wicked can expect only judgment.
Give freely and become more wealthy; be stingy and lose everything.
The generous man will prosper; those who refresh others will themselves be refreshed.
People curse those who hoard their grain, but they Barak the one who sells in time of need.
If you search for good, you will find favor; but if you search for evil, the evil will find you!
When you trust in your money, you will go down! But the righteous flourish like leaves in the spring.
Those who bring trouble on their families inherit the wind. The fool will be a servant to the wise.
The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, and he who wins souls is wise.
If the righteous are rewarded here on Arath, what will happen to wicked sinners?
To learn, you must love discipline; it is stupid to hate correction.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH approves of those who are good, but he condemns those who plan wickedness.
Wickedness never brings stability, but the righteous have deep roots.
A worthy wife is a crown for her husband, but a shameful woman is like cancer in his bones.
The plans of the righteous are just; the advice of the wicked is treacherous.
The words of the wicked are like a murderous ambush, but the words of the righteous save lives.
The wicked die and disappear, but the family of the righteous stands firm.
A sensible person wins admiration, but a warped mind is despised.
Better to be an ordinary person with a servant than to be self-important but have no food.
The righteous care for their animals, but the wicked are always cruel.
A hard worker has plenty of food, but a person who chases fantasies has no sense.
Thieves are jealous of each other’s loot, but the righteous are well rooted and bear their own fruit.
The wicked are trapped by their own words, but the righteous escape such trouble.
Wise words bring many benefits, and hard work brings rewards.
Fools think their own way is right, but the wise listen to others.
A fool is quick-tempered, but a wise person stays calm when insulted.
An honest witness tells the truth; a false witness tells lies.
Some people make cutting remarks, but the words of the wise bring healing.
Truthful words stand the test of time, but lies are soon exposed.
Deceit fills hearts that are plotting evil; joy fills hearts that are planning Shalum!
No harm comes to the righteous, but the wicked have their fill of trouble.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests lying lips, but He delights in those who tell the truth.
The wise do not make a show of their knowledge, but fools broadcast their foolishness.
Work hard and become a leader; be lazy and become a slave.
Worry weighs a person down; an encouraging word cheers a person up.
The righteous give good advice to their friends; the wicked lead them astray.
Lazy people do not even cook the game they catch, but the diligent make use of everything they find.
The Part of the righteous leads to life; and in his pathway there is no death.
A wise child accepts the discipline of his parents; a mocker refuses to listen to correction.
Wise words will win you a good meal, but treacherous people have an appetite for violence.
Those who control their tongue will have a long life; opening your mouth can ruin everything.
Lazy people want much but get little, but those who work hard will prosper.
The righteous hate lies; the wicked cause shame and misfortune.
Righteousness guards the path of the blameless, but the evil are misled by sin.
Some who are poor pretend to be rich; others who are rich pretend to be poor.
The rich can pay a ransom for their lives, but the poor will not even get threatened.
The life of the righteous is full of light and joy, but the light of the wicked will be snuffed out.
Pride leads to conflict; those who take advice are wise.
Wealth from get-rich-quick schemes quickly disappears; wealth from hard work grows over time.
Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but a dream fulfilled is a tree of life.
People who despise advice are asking for trouble; those who respect a command will succeed.
The instruction of the wise is like a life-giving fountain; those who accept it avoid the snares of death.
A person with good sense is respected; a treacherous person is headed for destruction.
Wise people think before they act; fools do not think, they even brag about their foolishness.
An unreliable messenger stumbles into trouble, but a reliable messenger brings healing.
If you ignore criticism, you will end in poverty and dishonor; if you accept correction, you will be honored.
It is pleasant to see dreams come true, but fools refuse to turn from evil to attain them.
Walk with the wise and become wise; associate with fools and get in trouble.
Trouble chases sinners, while Barakah reward the righteous.
Good people leave an inheritance to their grandchildren, but the sinner’s wealth passes to the righteous.
A poor person’s farm may produce much food, but injustice sweeps it all away.
Those who spare the rod of discipline hate their children. Those who love their children care enough to discipline them.
The righteous eat to their hearts’ content, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
A wise woman builds her home, but a foolish woman tears it down with her own hands.
Those who follow the right path fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; those who take the wrong path despise 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
A fool’s proud talk becomes a rod that beats him, but the words of the wise keep them safe.
Without oxen a stable stays clean, but you need a strong ox for a large harvest.
An honest witness does not lie; a false witness breathes lies.
A mocker seeks wisdom and never finds it, but knowledge comes easily to those with understanding.
Stay away from fools, for you will not find knowledge on their lips.
The prudent understand where they are going, but fools deceive themselves.
Fools make fun of guilt, but the righteous acknowledge it and seek reconciliation.
Each heart knows its own bitterness, and no one else can fully share its joy.
The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the righteous will flourish.
There is a path before each person that seems right, but it ends in death.
Laughter can conceal a heavy heart, but when the laughter ends, the grief remains.
Backsliders get what they deserve; good people receive their reward.
Only simpletons believe everything they are told! The prudent carefully consider their steps.
The wise are cautious and avoid danger; fools plunge ahead with reckless confidence.
Short-tempered people do foolish things, and schemers are hated.
Simpletons are clothed with foolishness, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
Evil people will bow before good people; the wicked will bow at the gates of the righteous.
The poor are despised even by their neighbors, while the rich have many “friends.”
It is a sin to belittle one’s neighbor; Baraked are those who help the poor.
If you plan to do evil, you will be lost; if you plan to do good, you will receive unfailing love and faithfulness.
Work brings profit, but mere talk leads to poverty!
Wealth is a crown for the wise; the effort of fools yields only foolishness.
A truthful witness saves lives, but a false witness is a traitor.
Those who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are secured; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be a refuge for their children.
The fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is a life-giving fountain; it offers escape from the snares of death.
A growing population is a king’s Kabad; a prince without subjects has nothing.
People with understanding control their anger; a hot temper shows great foolishness.
A Shalum heart leads to a healthy body; jealousy is like cancer in the bones.
Those who oppress the poor insult their Maker, but helping the poor honors 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The wicked are crushed by disaster, but the righteous have a refuge when they die.
Wisdom is enshrined in an understanding heart; wisdom is not found among fools.
Righteousness makes a nation great, but sin is a dishonor to any people.
A king rejoices in wise servants but is angry with those who dishonor him.
A gentle answer deflects anger, but harsh words make tempers flare.
The tongue of the wise makes knowledge appealing, but the mouth of a fool belches out foolishness.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is watching everywhere, keeping his eye on both the evil and the good.
Gentle words are a tree of life; a deceitful tongue crushes the spirit.
Only a fool despises a parent’s discipline; whoever learns from correction is wise.
There is treasure in the house of the righteous, but the earnings of the wicked bring trouble.
The lips of the wise give good advice; the heart of a fool has none to give.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests the sacrifice of the wicked, but he delights in the prayers of the upright.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests the way of the wicked, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH love's those who pursue Righteousness.
Whoever abandons the right path will be severely disciplined; whoever hates correction will die.
Even Death and Destruction hold no secrets from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. How much more the hearts of men!
Mockers hate to be corrected, so they stay away from the wise.
A glad heart makes a happy face; a broken heart crushes the spirit.
A wise person is hungry for knowledge, while the fool feeds on trash.
For the despondent, every day brings trouble; for the happy heart, life is a continual feast.
Better to have little, with fear for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, than to have great treasure and inner turmoil.
A bowl of vegetables with someone you love is better than steak with someone you hate.
A hot-tempered person starts fights; a cool-tempered person stops them.
A lazy person’s way is blocked with briers, but the path of the upright is an open highway.
Sensible children bring joy to their father; foolish children despise their mother.
Foolishness brings joy to those with no sense; a sensible person stays on the right path.
Plans go wrong for lack of advice; many advisers bring success.
Everyone enjoys a fitting reply; it is wonderful to say the right thing at the right time!
The path of life leads upward for the wise; they leave the grave behind.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH tears down the house of the proud, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH protects the property of widows.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests evil plans, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH delights in pure words.
Greed brings grief to the whole family, but those who hate bribes will live.
The heart of the righteous thinks carefully before speaking; the mouth of the wicked overflows with evil words.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is far from the wicked, but He hears the prayers of the righteous.
A cheerful look brings joy to the heart; good news makes good health.
If you listen to constructive criticism, you will be at home among the wise.
If you reject discipline, you only harm yourself; but if you listen to correction, you grow in understanding.
The fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH teaches wisdom; humility precedes honor.
We can make our own plans, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives the right answer.
People may be pure in their own eyes, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH examines their motives.
Commit your actions to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and your plans will succeed.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made everything for His own purposes, even the wicked for a day of disaster.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests the proud; they will surely be punished.
Unfailing love and faithfulness make atonement for sin. By fearing 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, people avoid evil.
When people’s lives please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, even their enemies are at Shalum with them.
Better to have little, with Righteousness, than to be rich and dishonest.
We can make our plans, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH determines our steps.
The king speaks with divine wisdom; he must never judge unfairly.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH demands accurate scales and balances; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sets the standards for fairness.
A king detests wrongdoing, for his rule is built on justice.
The king is pleased with words from righteous lips; he loves those who speak honestly.
The anger of the king is a deadly threat; the wise will try to appease it.
When the king smiles, there is life; his favor refreshes like a spring rain.
It is much better to get wisdom than gold, and good judgment than silver!
The path of the righteous leads him from evil; whoever follows that path is safe.
Pride goes before destruction, and haughtiness before a fall.
Better to live humbly with the poor than to share plunder with the proud.
Those who listen to instruction will prosper; those who trust 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be joyful.
The wise are known for their understanding, and pleasant words are persuasive.
Discretion is a life-giving fountain to those who possess it, but discipline is wasted on fools.
From a wise mind comes wise speech; the words of the wise are persuasive.
Kind words are like honey, sweet to the soul and healthy for the body.
There is a path before each person that seems right, but it ends in death.
It is good for workers to have an appetite; an empty stomach drives them on.
Evil people creates trouble; their words are a destructive blaze.
A troublemaker plants seeds of strife; gossip separates the best of friends.
Violent people mislead their companions, leading them down a harmful path.
With narrowed eyes, people plot evil; with a smirk, they plan their mischief.
Gray hair is a crown of kabad; it is gained by living a righteous life.
Better to be patient than powerful; better to have self-control than to conquer a city.
We may throw the dice, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH determines how they fall.
Better a dry morsel eaten in Shalum than a house filled with feasting and conflict.
A wise servant will rule over the master’s shameful son and will share the inheritance of the master’s children.
Fire tests the purity of silver and gold, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH tests the heart.
Wrongdoers eagerly listen to gossip; liars pay close attention to slander.
Those who mock the poor insult their Maker; those who rejoice at the misfortune of others will be punished.
Grandchildren are the crowning Kabad of the aged; parents are the pride of their children.
Eloquent words are not fitting for a fool; even less are lies fitting for a ruler.
A present is a prescious stone; whoever gives one will prosper!
Love prospers when a fault is forgiven, but dwelling on it separates close friends.
A single rebuke does more for a person of understanding than a hundred lashes on the back of a fool.
Evil people are eager for rebellion, but they will be severely punished.
It is safer to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than to confront a fool caught in foolishness.
If you repay good with evil, evil will never leave your house.
Starting a quarrel is like opening a floodgate, so stop before a dispute breaks out.
Acquitting the guilty and condemning the innocent, both are detestable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
It is senseless to pay to educate a fool, since he has no heart for learning.
A friend is always loyal, and a brother is born to help in time of need.
It is poor judgment to guarantee another person’s debt or put up security for a friend.
Anyone who loves to quarrel loves sin; anyone who trusts in high walls invites disaster.
The crooked heart will not prosper; the lying tongue tumbles into trouble.
It is painful to be the parent of a fool; there is no joy for the father of a rebel.
A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a broken spirit saps a person’s strength.
The wicked take secret bribes to pervert the course of justice.
Sensible people keep their eyes glued on wisdom, but a fool’s eyes wander to the ends of the Arath.
Foolish children bring grief to their father and bitterness to the one who gave them birth.
It is wrong to punish the righteous for being good or to flog leaders for being honest.
A truly wise person uses few words; a person with understanding is even-tempered.
Even fools are counted to be wise when they keep silent; with their mouths shut, they seem intelligent.
Unfriendly people care only about themselves; they lash out at common sense.
Fools have no interest in understanding; they only want to air their own opinions.
Doing wrong leads to shame, and scandalous behavior brings contempt.
Wise words are like deep waters; wisdom flows from the wise like a bubbling brook.
It is not right to acquit the guilty or deny justice to the innocent.
The words of fools get them into constant quarrels; they are asking for a beating.
The mouths of fools are their ruin; they trap themselves with their lips.
Rumors are dainty morsels that sink deep into one’s heart.
A lazy person is as bad as someone who destroys things.
The Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is a strong fortress; the righteous run to it and they are safe.
The rich think of their wealth as a strong defense; they imagine it to be a high wall of safety.
Haughtiness goes before destruction; humility precedes honor.
Spouting off before listening to the facts is both shameful and foolish.
The spirit of man can endure a sick body, but who can bear a crushed spirit?
Intelligent people are always ready to learn, their ears are open for knowledge.
Giving a gift can open doors; it gives access to important people!
The first to speak in court sounds right, until the cross-examination begins.
Flipping a coin can end arguments; it settles disputes between powerful opponents.
An offended friend is harder to win back than a fortified city. Arguments separate friends like a gate locked with bars.
Wise words satisfy like a good meal; the right words bring satisfaction.
The tongue can bring death or life; those who love to talk will reap the consequences.
The man who finds a good wife finds a treasure, and he receives favor from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The poor plead for mercy; the rich answer with insults.
There are “friends” who destroy each other, but a real friend sticks closer than a brother.
Better to be poor and honest than to be dishonest and a fool.
Enthusiasm without knowledge is no good; haste makes mistakes.
People ruin their lives by their own foolishness and then are angry at 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Wealth makes many “friends”; poverty drives them all away.
A false witness will not go unpunished, nor will a liar escape.
Many seek favors from a ruler; everyone is the friend of a person who gives gifts!
The relatives of the poor despise them; how much more will their friends avoid them! Though the poor plead with them, their friends are gone.
To acquire wisdom is to love yourself; people who cherish understanding will prosper.
A false witness will not go unpunished, and a liar will be destroyed.
It is not right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule over princes!
Sensible people control their temper; they earn respect by overlooking wrongs.
The king’s anger is like a lion’s roar, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
A foolish child is a calamity to a father; a quarrelsome wife is as annoying as constant dripping.
Fathers can give their sons an inheritance of houses and wealth, but only 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH can give an understanding wife.
Lazy people sleep soundly, but idleness leaves them hungry.
Keep the commandments and keep your life; despising the commandments leads to death.
If you help the poor, you are lending to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and He will repay you!
Discipline your children while there is hope, otherwise you will ruin their lives.
Hot-tempered people must pay the penalty. If you rescue them once, you will have to do it again.
Get all the advice and instruction you can, so you will be wise the rest of your life.
You can make many plans, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s purpose will prevail.
Loyalty makes a person attractive. It is better to be poor than dishonest.
The fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH leads to life, bringing security and protection from harm.
Lazy people take food in their hand but do not even lift it to their mouth.
If you punish a mocker, the simpleminded will learn a lesson; if you correct the wise, they will be all wiser.
Children who mistreat their father or chase away their mother, they are embarrassment and a public shame.
If you stop listening to instruction, my child, you will turn your back on knowledge.
A corrupt witness makes a mockery of justice; the mouth of the wicked gulps down evil.
Punishment is made for mockers, and the backs of fools are made to be beaten.
Wine produces mockers; alcohol leads to brawls. Those led astray by drink cannot be wise.
The king’s fury is like a lion’s roar; to rouse his anger is to risk your life.
Avoiding a fight is a mark of honor; only fools insist on quarreling.
Those too lazy to plow in the right season will have no food at the harvest.
Though good advice lies deep within the heart, a person with understanding will draw it out.
Many will say they are loyal friends, but who can find one who is truly reliable?
The righteous walk with integrity; Baraked are their children who follow them.
When a king sits in judgment, he weighs all the evidence, distinguishing the bad from the good.
Who can say, “I have cleansed my heart; I am pure and free from sin”?
False weights and unequal measures, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests double standards of every kind.
Even children are known by the way they act, whether their conduct is pure, and whether it is right.
Ears to hear and eyes to see, both are gifts from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
If you love sleep, you will end in poverty. Keep your eyes open, and there will be plenty to eat!
The buyer haggles over the price, saying, “It’s worthless,” then brags about getting a bargain!
Wise words are more valuable than much gold and many rubies.
Get security from someone who guarantees a stranger’s debt. Get a deposit if he does it for foreigners.
Stolen bread tastes sweet, but it turns to gravel in the mouth.
Plans succeed through good counsel; do not go to war without wise advice.
A gossip goes around telling secrets, so do not hang around with chatterers.
If you insult your father or mother, your light will be snuffed out in total darkness.
An inheritance obtained too early in life is not a Barakah in the end.
Do not say, “I will get even for this wrong.” Wait for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to handle the matter.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH detests double standards; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not pleased by dishonest scales.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH directs our steps, so why try to understand everything along the way?
Do not trap yourself by making a rash promise to your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and only later counting the cost.
A wise king scatters the wicked like wheat, then runs his threshing wheel over them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s light penetrates the spirit of man, exposing every hidden motive.
Unfailing love and faithfulness protect the king; his throne is made secure through love.
The Kabad of the young is their strength; the gray hair of experience is the splendor of the old.
Physical punishment cleanses away evil; such discipline purifies the heart.
The king’s heart is like a stream of water directed by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; He guides it wherever He pleases.
People may be right in their own eyes, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH examines their heart.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is more pleased when we do what is right and just than when we offer him sacrifices.
Haughty eyes, a proud heart, and evil actions are all sin.
Good planning and hard work lead to prosperity, but hasty shortcuts lead to poverty.
Wealth created by a lying tongue is a vanishing mist and a deadly trap.
The violence of the wicked sweeps them away, because they refuse to do what is just.
The guilty walk a crooked path; the innocent travel a straight road.
