The sword of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is drenched with blood and covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of rams prepared for sacrifice, Yes 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will offer a sacrifice in the city of Buzrah, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make a mighty slaughter in Adum.
Even men as strong as wild oxen will die, the young men alongside the veterans, the land will be soaked with blood and the soil enriched with fat.
For it is the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s revenge, the year when Adum will be paid back for all it did to Yashar'AL.
The streams of Adum will be filled with burning pitch, and the ground will be covered with fire.
This judgment on Adum will never end; the smoke of its burning will rise forever, the land will lie deserted from generation to generation. No one will live there anymore.
It will be haunted by the desert owl and the screech owl, the great owl and the raven, For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will measure that land carefully; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will measure it for chaos and destruction.
It will be called the Land of Nothing, and all its nobles will soon be gone.
Thorns will overrun its palaces; nettles and thistles will grow in its forts, the ruins will become a haunt for jackals and a home for owls.
Desert animals will mingle there with hyenas, their howls filling the night, Wild goats will bleat at one another among the ruins, and night creatures will come there to rest.
There the owl will make her nest and lay her eggs, She will hatch her young and cover them with her wings, and the buzzards will come, each one with its mate.

Search the book of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and see what he will do, Not one of these birds and animals will be missing, and none will lack a mate, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised this, and His RUACH will make it all come true.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has surveyed and divided the land and deeded it over to those creatures, they will possess it forever, from generation to generation.
Even the wilderness and desert will be glad in those days, The wasteland will rejoice and blossom with spring crocuses.

Yes, there will be an abundance of flowers and singing and joy! The deserts will become as green as the mountains of Labanun, as lovely as Mount Carmel or the plain of Sharun, There 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will display His Kabad, the splendor of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
With this news, strengthen those who have tired hands, and encourage those who have weak knees.
Say to those with fearful hearts, “Be strong, and do not fear, for your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is coming to destroy your enemies, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is coming to save you.”
And when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH comes, He will open the eyes of the blind and unplug the ears of the deaf.
The lame will leap like a deer, and those who cannot speak will sing for joy! Springs will gush forth in the wilderness, and streams will water the wasteland.
The parched ground will become a pool, and springs of water will satisfy the thirsty land, Marsh grass and reeds and rushes will flourish where desert jackals once lived.

And a great road will go through that once deserted land, It will be named the Highway of qadashym, Evil-minded people will never travel on it, It will be only for those who walk in the ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; fools will never walk there.
Lions will not lurk along its course, nor any other ferocious beasts, there will be no other dangers, Only the redeemed will walk on it.

Those who have been ransomed by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will return, They will enter Yahushalam singing, crowned with everlasting joy, Sorrow and mourning will disappear, and they will be filled with joy and gladness.
In the fourteenth year of King Hazakyahu’s reign, King Sannacharib of Assyria came to attack the fortified towns of Yahudah and conquered them.

Then the king of Assyria sent his chief of staff from Lachish with a huge army to confront King Hazakyahu in Yahushalam, The Assyrians took up a position beside the aqueduct that feeds water into the upper pool, near the road leading to the field where cloth is washed.
These are the officials who went out to meet with them: Aliakim son of Hilkyahu, the palace administrator; Shabna the court secretary; and Yuah son of Asaph, the royal historian.
Then the Assyrian king’s chief of staff told them to give this message to Hazakyahu: “This is what the great king of Assyria says: What are you trusting in that makes you so confident?
Do you think that mere words can substitute for military skill and strength? Who are you counting on, that you have rebelled against me?
On Mitzraym? If you lean on Mitzraym, it will be like a reed that splinters beneath your weight and pierces your hand, Phar'uh, the king of Mitzraym, is completely unreliable!

“But perhaps you will say to me, ‘We are trusting in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH!’ But is He not the one who was insulted by Hazakyahu? Did Hazakyahu not tear down his shrines and altars and make everyone in Yahudah and Yahushalam worship only at the altar here in Yahushalam?
“I will tell you what! Strike a bargain with my master, the king of Assyria. I will give you 2,000 horses if you can find that many men to ride on them!
With your tiny army, how can you think of challenging even the weakest contingent of my master’s troops, even with the help of Mitzraym’s chariots and charioteers?
What’s more, do you think we have invaded your land without 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s direction? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself told us, ‘Attack this land and destroy it!’”
Then Aliakim, Shabna, and Yuah said to the Assyrian chief of staff, “Please speak to us in Aramaic, for we understand it well. Do not speak in Abaryt (Hebrew), for the people on the wall will hear.”

But Sannacharib’s chief of staff replied, “Do you think my master sent this message only to you and your master? He wants all the people to hear it, for when we put this city under siege, they will suffer along with you, they will be so hungry and thirsty that they will eat their own dung and drink their own urine.”
Then the chief of staff stood and shouted in Abaryt (Hebrew) to the people on the wall, “Listen to this message from the great king of Assyria!
This is what the king says: Do not let Hazakyahu deceive you, he will never be able to rescue you.
Do not let him fool you into trusting in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by saying, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will surely rescue us, this city will never fall into the hands of the Assyrian king!’

“Do not listen to Hazakyahu! These are the terms the king of Assyria is offering: Make Shalum with me, open the gates and come out, then each of you can continue eating from your own grapevine and fig tree and drinking from your own well.
Then I will arrange to take you to another land like this one, a land of grain and new wine, bread and vineyards.
“Do not let Hazakyahu mislead you by saying, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will rescue us!’ Have the deities of any other nations ever saved their people from the king of Assyria?
What happened to the idols of Hamath and Arpad? And what about the idols of Sapharbaym? Did any idols rescue Samaria from my power?
What idols of any nation has ever been able to save its people from my power? So what makes you think that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH can rescue Yahushalam from me?”
But the people were silent and did not utter a word because Hazakyahu had commanded them, “Do not answer him.”

Then Aliakim son of Hilkyahu, the palace administrator; Shabna the court secretary; and Yuah son of Asaph, the royal historian, went back to Hazakyahu, they tore their clothes in despair, and they went in to see the king and told him what the Assyrian chief of staff had said.
When King Hazakyahu heard their report, he tore his clothes and put on burlap and went into the Haykal (Temple) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And he sent Aliakim the palace administrator, Shabna the court secretary, and the leading Kuhanym, all dressed in burlap, to the Nabym Yashayahu son of Amuz.
They told him, “This is what King Hazakyahu says: Today is a day of trouble, insults, and shame, It is like when a child is ready to be born, but the mother has no strength to deliver the baby.

But perhaps 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has heard the Assyrian chief of staff, sent by the king to defy the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and will punish him for his words. Oh, pray for those of us who are left!”
After King Hazakyahu’s officials delivered the king’s message to Yashayahu,
the Nabym replied, “Say to your master, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Do not be disturbed by this blasphemous speech against me from the Assyrian king’s messengers.
Listen! I myself will move against him, and the king will receive a message that he is needed at home. So he will return to his land, where I will have him killed with a sword.’”
Meanwhile, the Assyrian chief of staff left Yahushalam and went to consult the king of Assyria, who had left Lachish and was attacking Libnah.

Soon afterward King Sannacharib received word that King Tirhakah of Athiupia was leading an army to fight against him, Before leaving to meet the attack, he sent messengers back to Hazakyahu in Yahushalam with this message:
“This message is for King Hazakyahu of Yahudah, Do not let your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, in whom you trust, deceive you with promises that Yahushalam will not be captured by the king of Assyria.
You know perfectly well what the kings of Assyria have done wherever they have gone. They have completely destroyed everyone who stood in their way! Why should you be any different?
Have the idols of other nations rescued them, such nations as Guzan, Haran, Razaph, and the people of Adan who were in Tal-assar? My predecessors destroyed them all!
What happened to the king of Hamath and the king of Arpad? What happened to the kings of Sapharbaym, Hana, and Ibbah?”
After Hazakyahu received the letter from the messengers and read it, he went up to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple and spread it out before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And Hazakyahu prayed this prayer before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, you are enthroned between the mighty charubim! You alone are 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all the kingdoms of the Arath. You alone created the Shamaym and the Arath.
Bend, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and listen! Open your eyes, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and see! Listen to Sannacherib’s words of defiance against the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“It is true 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that the kings of Assyria have destroyed all these nations.
And they have thrown the deities of these nations into the fire and burned them, But of course the Assyrians could destroy them! They were only idols of wood and stone shaped by the hands of men.
Now, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, rescue us from his power; then all the kingdoms of the Arath will know that you alone, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, are 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.”
Then Yashayahu son of Amuz sent this message to Hazakyahu: “This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, says: Because you prayed about King Sannacherib of Assyria,
Listen, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has Dabar this words against Sannacharib: “The virgin daughter of Ziun despises you and laughs at you, the daughter of Yahushalam shakes her head in derision as you flee.
“Whom have you been defying and ridiculing? Against whom did you raise your voice? At whom did you look with such haughty eyes? It was the Qadash One of Yashar'AL!

By your messengers you have defied 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, You have said, ‘With my many chariots I have conquered the highest mountains yes, the remotest peaks of Labanun. I have cut down its tallest cedars and its finest cypress trees, I have reached its farthest heights and explored its deepest forests.
I have dug wells in many foreign lands and refreshed myself with their water, With the sole of my foot, I stopped up all the rivers of Mitzraym!’
“But have you not heard? I decided this long ago, long ago I planned it, and now I am making it happen. I planned for you to crush fortified cities into heaps of rubble.

That is why their people have so little power and are so frightened and confused, they are as weak as grass, as easily trampled as tender green shoots, they are like grass sprouting on a housetop, scorched before it can grow lush and tall.
“But I know you well, where you stay and when you come and go, I know the way you have raged against me.

And because of your raging against me and your arrogance, which I have heard for myself, I will put my hook in your nose and my bit in your mouth, I will make you return by the same road on which you came.”

Then Yashayahu said to Hazakyahu, “Here is the proof that what I say is true: “This year you will eat only what grows up by itself, and next year you will eat what springs up from that, But in the third year you will plant crops and harvest them; you will tend vineyards and eat their fruit.
And you who are left in Yahudah, who have escaped the ravages of the siege, will put roots down in your own soil and grow up and flourish.
For a remnant of my people will spread out from Yahushalam, a group of survivors from Mount Ziun. The passionate commitment of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut will make this happen!

“And this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar about the king of Assyria, his armies will not enter Yahushalam. they will not even shoot an arrow at it, they will not march outside its gates with their shields nor build banks of earth against its walls.
The king will return to his own country by the same road on which he came, he will not enter this city,’ says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
‘For my own honor and for the sake of my servant Daud, I will defend this city and protect it.’”
That night the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH went out to the Assyrian camp and killed 185,000 Assyrian soldiers, When the surviving Assyrians woke up the next morning, they found corpses everywhere.
Then King Sannacharib of Assyria broke camp and returned to his own land, he went home to his capital of Ninabah and stayed there.

One day while he was worshiping in the temple of his idol Nisruch, his sons Adrammalach and Sharazar killed him with their swords, they then escaped to the land of Ararat, and another son, Asarhaddun, became the next king of Assyria.

About that time Hazakyah became deathly ill, and the Nabym Yashayahu son of Amuz went to visit him, he gave the king this message: “This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘Set your affairs in order, for you are going to die, You will not recover from this illness.’”
When Hazakyahu heard this, he turned his face to the wall and prayed to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
“Remember, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, how I have always been faithful to you and have served you single-mindedly, always doing what pleases you.” Then he broke down and wept bitterly.
Then this message came to Yashayahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Go back to Hazakyahu and tell him, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of your ancestor Daud, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears, I will add fifteen years to your life,
and I will rescue you and this city from the king of Assyria, Yes I will defend this city.
“‘And this is the sign from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to prove that He will do as He promised:
I will cause the sun’s shadow to move ten steps backward on the sundial of Ahaz!’” So the shadow on the sundial moved backward ten steps.
When King Hazakyahu was well again, he wrote this poem:
I said, “In the prime of my life, must I now enter the place of the dead? Am I to be robbed of the rest of my years?”
I said, “Never again will I see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH while still in the land of the living, Never again will I see my friends or be with those who live in this world.
My life has been blown away like a shepherd’s tent in a storm, It has been cut short, as when a weaver cuts cloth from a loom, Suddenly my life was over.
I waited patiently all night, but I was torn apart as though by lions, suddenly my life was over.
Delirious, I chattered like a swallow or a crane, and then I moaned like a mourning dove, My eyes grew tired of looking to Shamaym for help, I am in trouble, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Help me!”
But what could I say? For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself sent this sickness, Now I will walk humbly through out my years because of this anguish I have felt.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, your discipline is good, for it leads to life and health, You restore my health and allow me to live!
Yes, this anguish was good for me, for you have rescued me from death and forgiven all my sins.
For the dead cannot sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; they cannot raise their voices in Yadah, those who go down to the grave can no longer hope in your faithfulness.
Only the living can sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as I do today, Each generation tells of your faithfulness to the next.
Think of it 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is ready to heal me! I will sing his Yadah with instruments every day of my life in the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yashayahu had said to Hazakyahu’s servants, “Make an ointment from figs and spread it over the boil, and Hazakyahu will recover.”
And Hazakyahu had asked, “What sign will prove that I will go to the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?”
Soon after this, Marudach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylun, sent Hazakyah his best wishes and a gift. He had heard that Hazakyahu had been very sick and that he had recovered.

Hazakyahu was delighted with the Babylunian envoys and showed them everything in his treasure houses, the silver, the gold, the spices, and the aromatic oils. He also took them to see his armory and showed them everything in his royal treasuries! There was nothing in his palace or kingdom that Hazakyahu did not show them.
Then Yashayahu the Nabym went to King Hazakyahu and asked him, “What did those men want? Where were they from?” Hazakyahu replied, “They came from the distant land of Babylun.”
“What did they see in your palace?” asked Yashayahu. “They saw everything,” Hazakyahu replied. “I showed them everything I own, all my royal treasuries.”
Then Yashayahu said to Hazakyahu, “Listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut:
‘The time is coming when everything in your palace, all the treasures stored up by your ancestors until now, will be carried off to Babylun. Nothing will be left,’ says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
‘Some of your very own sons will be taken away into exile. They will become eunuchs who will serve in the palace of Babylun’s king.’”
Then Hazakyahu said to Yashayahu, “This message you have given me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good.” For the king was thinking, “At least there will be Shalum and security during my lifetime.”
“Comfort, yes, comfort my people,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Speak tenderly to Yahushalam, Tell her that her sad days are gone and her sins are pardoned, Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has punished her twice over for all her sins.”
Listen! It’s the voice of someone shouting, “Clear the way through the wilderness for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Make a straight highway through the wasteland for our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH!
Fill in the valleys, and level the mountains and hills, Straighten the curves, and smooth out the rough places.
Then the kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be revealed, and all people will see it together. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken!”
A voice said, “Shout!” I asked, “What should I shout? “Shout that people are like the grass. Their beauty fades as quickly as the flowers in a field.
The grass withers and the flowers fade beneath the breath of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, And so it is with people.
The grass withers and the flowers fade, but the Dabar of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH stands forever.”
O Ziun, messenger of good news, shout from the mountain tops! Shout it louder, O Yahushalam Shout, and do not be afraid, tell the towns of Yahudah, “Your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is coming!”
Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is coming in power, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will rule with a powerful arm, See, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brings His reward with Him as He comes.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will feed his flock like a shepherd, He will carry the lambs in His arms, holding them close to His heart. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will gently lead the mother sheep with their young.
Who else has held the oceans in his hand? Who has measured off the Shamaym with his fingers? Who else knows the weight of the Arath or has weighed the mountains and hills on a scale?
Who is able to advise the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Who knows enough to give Him advice or teach Him?
Has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH ever needed anyone’s advice? Does 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH need instruction about what is good? Did someone teach Him what is right or show Him the path of justice?
No, for all the nations of the world are but a drop in the bucket, They are nothing more than dust on the scales, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH picks up the whole Arath as though it were a grain of sand.
All the wood in Labanun’s forests and all Labanun’s animals would not be enough to make a burnt offering worthy of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
The nations of the world are worth nothing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, In His eyes they count for less than nothing, mere emptiness and froth.
To whom can you compare 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? What image can you find to resemble 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
Can 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be compared to an idol formed in a mold, overlaid with gold, and decorated with silver chains?
Or if people are too poor for that, they might at least choose wood that will not decay and a skilled craftsman to carve an image that will not fall down!
Have you not heard? Do you not understand? Are you deaf to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the Dabar that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave before the world began? Are you so ignorant?
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sits above the circle of the Arath, The people below seem like grasshoppers to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! He spreads out the Shamaym like a curtain and makes His tent from them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH judges the great people of the world and brings them all to nothing.
They hardly get started, barely taking root, when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH blows on them and they wither. The wind carries them off like chaff.
“To whom will you compare me? Who is my equal?” asks the Qadash One.

Look up into the Shamaym, Who created all the stars? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brings them out like an army, one after another, calling each by its name, Because of the great power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and incomparable strength, not a single one is missing.
O Ya'aqub, how can you say 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not see your troubles? O Yashar'AL, how can you say your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH ignores your rights?

Have you never heard? Have you never understood? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the everlasting 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the Creator of all the Arath, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH never grows weak or weary, No one can measure the depths of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's understanding.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives power to the weak and strength to the powerless.
Even youths will become weak and tired, and young men will fall in exhaustion.
But those who trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will find new strength, They will soar high on wings like eagles, They will run and not grow weary, They will walk and not faint.
“Listen in silence before me, you lands beyond the Yam (sea). Bring your strongest arguments, Come now and speak, The court is ready for your case.

“Who has stirred up this king from the east, rightly calling him to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s service? Who gives this man victory over many nations and permits him to trample their kings underfoot? With his sword, he reduces armies to dust, With his bow, he scatters them like chaff before the wind.
He chases them away and goes on safely, though he is walking over unfamiliar ground.
Who has done such mighty deeds, summoning each new generation from the beginning of time? It is I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the First and the Last, I alone am He.”
The lands beyond the sea watch in fear. Remote lands tremble and mobilize for war.
The idol makers encourage one another, saying to each other, “Be strong!”

The carver encourages the goldsmith, and the molder helps at the anvil. “Good,” they say. “It’s coming along fine.”Carefully they join the parts together, then fasten the thing in place so it won’t fall over.
“But as for you, Yashar'AL my servant, Ya'aqub my chosen one, descended from Abraham my friend,
I have called you back from the ends of the Arath, saying, ‘You are my servant. ’For I have chosen you and will not throw you away.
Do not be afraid, for I am with you, Do not be discouraged, for I am your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I will strengthen you and help you, I will hold you up with my victorious right hand.
“See, all your angry enemies lie there, confused and humiliated, anyone who opposes you will die and come to nothing.
You will look in vain for those who tried to conquer you, Those who attack you will come to nothing.
For I hold you by your right hand, I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and I say to you, ‘Do not be afraid, I am here to help you.
Though you are a lowly worm, O Ya'aqub, do not be afraid, people of Yashar'AL, for I will help you, I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your Redeemer, I am the Qadash One of Yashar'AL.’
You will be a new threshing instrument with many sharp teeth, you will tear your enemies apart, making chaff of mountains.
You will toss them into the air, and the wind will blow them all away; a whirlwind will scatter them, then you will rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you will kabad in the Qadash One of Yashar'AL.
“When the poor and needy search for water and there is none, and their tongues are parched from thirst, then I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will answer them, I the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, will never abandon them.

I will open up rivers for them on the high plateaus, I will give them fountains of water in the valleys, I will fill the desert with pools of water, Rivers fed by springs will flow across the parched ground.
I will plant trees in the barren desert cedar, acacia, myrtle, olive, cypress, fir, and pine.
I am doing this so all who see this miracle will understand what it means, that it is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who has done this, the Qadash One of Yashar'AL who created it.
“Present the case for your idols,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. “Let them show what they can do,” says the Ruler of Yashar'AL.
“Let them try to tell us what happened long ago so that we may consider the evidence, Or let them tell us what the future holds, so we can know what’s going to happen.
Yes, tell us what will occur in the days ahead, Then we will know you are mighty ones, In fact, do anything, good or bad! Do something that will amaze and frighten us.
But no! You are less than nothing and can do nothing at all, Those who choose you pollute themselves.

“But I have stirred up a leader who will approach from the north, From the east he will call on my Name, I will give him victory over kings and princes, he will trample them as a potter treads on clay.
“Who told you from the beginning that this would happen? Who predicted this, making you admit that he was right? No one said a word!
I was the first to tell Ziun, ‘Look! Help is on the way! I will send Yahushalam a messenger with good news.
Not one of your idols told you this, Not one gave any answer when I asked.
See, they are all foolish, worthless things. All your idols are as empty as the wind.
“Look at my servant, whom I strengthen, he is my chosen one, who pleases me, I have put my RUACH upon him, he will bring justice to the nations.
He will not shout or raise his voice in public.
He will not crush the weakest reed or put out a flickering candle, he will bring justice to all who have been wronged.
He will not falter or lose heart until justice prevails throughout the Arath, Even distant lands beyond the sea will wait for his instruction.”

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, created the Shamaym and stretched them out, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH created the Arath and everything in it, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives breath to everyone and life to everyone who walks the Arath, and it is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who says,

“I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who have called you to demonstrate my righteousness, I will take you by the hand and guard you, and I will keep You and give You as a covenant to the people, as a light to the other nations,
You will open the eyes of the blind, you will free the captives from prison, releasing those who sit in dark dungeons.
“I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; that is my Name! I will not give my Kabad (Esteem) to anyone else, nor share my Yadah (Praise) with carved idols.
Everything I prophesied has come true, and now I will prophesy again, I will tell you the future before it happens.”
Sing a new song to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Sing His Yadah from the ends of the Arath! Sing, all you who sail the seas, all you who live in distant coastlands.
Join in the chorus, you desert towns; let the villages of Kadar rejoice! Let the people of Sala sing for joy; shout Yadah from the mountaintops!
Let the whole world Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; let the Arath sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will march forth like a mighty hero; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will come out like a warrior, full of fury, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will shout His battle cry and crush all His enemies.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will say, “I have long been silent; yes, I have restrained myself, But now, like a woman in labor, I will cry and groan and pant.
I will lay waste the mountains and hills, And dry up all their vegetation; I will make the rivers Coast lands, and I will dry up the pools.

I will lead blind Yashar'AL down a new path, guiding them along an unfamiliar way, I will brighten the darkness before them and smooth out the road ahead of them, Yes I will indeed do these things; I will not forsake them.
But those who trust in idols, who say, ‘idols are their mighty ones,’ will be turned away in shame.
“Listen, you who are deaf! Look and see, you blind!
Who is as blind as my own people, my servant? Who is as deaf as my messenger?Who is as blind as my chosen people, the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
You see and recognize what is right but refuse to act on it, you hear with your ears, but you do not really listen.”
Because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is righteous, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has exalted His Esteemed law.
But His own people have been robbed and plundered, enslaved, imprisoned, and trapped, they are fair game for anyone and have no one to protect them, no one to take them back home.
Who will hear these lessons from the past and see the ruin that awaits you in the future?
Who allowed Yashar'AL to be robbed and hurt? It was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, against whom we sinned, for the people would not walk in the path of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, nor would they obey the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Therefore, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH poured out His fury on them and destroyed them in battle, they were enveloped in flames, but they still refused to understand, they were consumed by fire, but they did not learn their lesson.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, who created you O Ya'aqub, and He who formed you, O Yashar'AL, Fear not for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your Name; You are Mine.

When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; when you go through the rivers, they shall not overflow you, When you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned, Nor shall the flame scorch you.
For I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, The Qadash One of Yashar'AL, your Savior; I gave Mitzraym for your ransom, Athiupia and Saba in your place.
Since you were precious in My sight, You have been honored, And I have loved you; Therefore I will give men for you, And people for your life.
Fear not, for I am with you; I will bring your descendants from the east, and gather you from the west;
I will say to the north, ‘Give them up! ’And to the south, ‘Do not keep them back! ’Bring My sons from afar, And My daughters from the ends of the Arath
Everyone who is called by My Name, Whom I have created for My kabad; I have formed him, yes I have made him.”
Bring out the blind people who have eyes, And the deaf who have ears.

Let all the nations be gathered together, And let the people be assembled, Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring out their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear and say, “It is truth.”

“You are My witnesses,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “And My servant whom I have chosen, that you may know and believe Me, and understand that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Before Me there was no 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH formed, Nor shall there be after Me.
I, even I, Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and besides Me there is no savior.
First I predicted your rescue, then I saved you and proclaimed it to the world, No foreign deities has ever done this, You are witnesses that I am the only 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“From eternity to eternity I Am 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, No one can snatch anyone out of my hand, No one can undo what I have done.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, I Am your Redeemer, The Qadash One of Yashar'AL: “For your sake I will send to Babylun, and bring them all down as fugitives, The Chaldaans who rejoice in their ships.
I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, your Qadash One, the Creator of Yashar'AL, your Ruler.”
Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the mighty waters,
Who brings forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power (They shall lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinguished, they are quenched like a wick):
“Do not remember the former things, or consider the things of old.
Behold, I will do a new thing, Now it shall spring forth; Shall you not know it? I will even make a road in the wilderness and rivers in the desert.
The beast of the field will honor Me, The jackals and the ostriches, Because I give waters in the wilderness And rivers in the desert, to give drink to My people, My chosen.
This people I have formed for Myself; They shall declare My Yadah.
“But you have not called upon Me, O Ya'aqub; and you have been weary of Me, O Yashar'AL.
You have not brought Me the sheep for your burnt offerings, or have you honored Me with your sacrifices I have not caused you to serve with grain offerings, or wearied you with incense.
You have bought Me no sweet cane with money, or have you satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices; But you have burdened Me with your sins, You have wearied Me with your iniquities.
“I, even I, Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who blots out your transgressions for My own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
Put Me in remembrance; Let us contend together; State your case, that you may be acquitted.
Your first father sinned, and your mediators have transgressed against Me.
Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; I will give Ya'aqub to the curse, and Yashar'AL to reproaches.
“Yet hear now, O Ya'aqub My servant, and Yashar'AL whom I have chosen.
Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who made you and formed you from the womb, who will help you: ‘Fear not, O Ya'aqub My servant; And you Yashar'AL, whom I have chosen.
For I will pour water on him who is thirsty, and floods on the dry ground; I will pour My RUACH on your descendants, and My Barakah on your offspring;
They will spring up among the grass like willows by the watercourses.’
One will say, ‘I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s own, another will call himself by the name of Ya'aqub; Another will write with his hand, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s, ’and name himself by the name of Yashar'AL.
“Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the RULER of Yashar'AL, And his Redeemer, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut: ‘I Am the First and I Am the Last; Besides Me there is no 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
And who can proclaim as I do? Then let him declare it and set it in order for Me, Since I appointed the ancient people, and the things that are coming and shall come, Let them show these to them.
Do not fear, nor be afraid; Have I not told you from that time, and declared it? You are My witnesses, Is there an 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH besides Me? Indeed there is no other Rock; I know not one.’ ”
Those who make an image, all of them are useless, and their precious things shall not profit; They are their own witnesses; they neither see or know, that they may be ashamed.
Who would form an idol or mold an image that profits him nothing?
Surely all his companions would be ashamed; and the workmen, they are mere men, Let them all be gathered together, Let them stand up; Yet they shall fear, they shall be ashamed together.

The blacksmith with the tongs works one in the coals, Fashions it with hammers, And works it with the strength of his arms, Even so he is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water and is faint.

The craftsman stretches out his rule, he marks one out with chalk; he fashions it with a plane, he marks it out with the compass, and makes it like the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man, that it may remain in the house.
He cuts down cedars for himself, And takes the cypress and the oak; he secures it for himself among the trees of the forest he plants a pine, and the rain nourishes it.

Then it shall be for a man to burn, for he will take some of it and warm himself; Yes, he kindles it and bakes bread; Indeed he makes a idol and worships it; he makes it a carved image, and falls down to it.
He burns half of it in the fire; with this half he eats meat; he roasts a roast, and is satisfied, he even warms himself and says,“Ah! I am warm, I have seen the fire.”
And the rest of it he makes into a idol, His carved image, he falls down before it and worships it, Prays to it and says,“Deliver me, for you are my deity!”
They do not know or understand; For he has shut their eyes, so that they cannot see, and their hearts, so that they cannot understand.

And no one considers in his heart, or is there knowledge nor understanding to say, “I have burned half of it in the fire, Yes, I have also baked bread on its coals; I have roasted meat and eaten it; and shall I make the rest of it an abomination? Shall I fall down before a block of wood?”
He feeds on ashes; A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he cannot deliver his soul, or say, “Is there not a lie in my right hand?”
“Remember these, O Ya'aqub and Yashar'AL, for you are My servant; I have formed you, you are My servant; O Yashar'AL, you will not be forgotten by Me!
I have blotted out, like a thick cloud, your transgressions, and like a cloud, your sins, Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.”

Sing, O Shamaym, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done it! Shout, you lower parts of the Arath; Break forth into singing, you mountains, O forest, and every tree in it! For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has redeemed Ya'aqub, and Esteemed Himself in Yashar'AL.
Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, your Redeemer, and He who formed you from the womb: “I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who makes all things, I stretched out the Shamaym all alone, I spreads abroad the Arath by Myself;
I frustrated the signs of the babblers, and drives diviners mad; I turn wise men backward, and makes their knowledge foolishness;

Who confirms the word of His servant, and performs the counsel of His messengers; Who says to Yahushalam, ‘You shall be inhabited, ’to the cities of Yahudah, ‘you shall be built, ’and I will raise up her waste places;
Who says to the deep, ‘Be dry, and I will dry up your rivers’;
Who says of Cyrus, ‘He is My shepherd, And he shall perform all My pleasure, Saying to Yahushalam, “You shall be built, ”and to the temple, “Your foundation shall be laid.” ’

“Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to His anointed, To Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him, and loose the armor of kings, to open before him the double doors, So that the gates will not be shut:
‘I will go before you, and make the crooked places straight; I will break in pieces the gates of bronze and cut the bars of iron.
I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Who called you by your name, I Am the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL.
For Ya'aqub My servant’s sake, and Yashar'AL My elect, I have even called you by your name; I have named you, though you have not known Me.
I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and there is no other; There is no 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH besides Me, I will gird you, though you have not known Me,
That they may know from the rising of the sun to its setting that there is none besides Me, I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and there is no other;
I form the light and create darkness, I make Shalum and create calamity; I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, do all these things.’

“Rain down, you Shamaym, from above, And let the skies pour down righteousness; Let the Arath open, let them bring forth salvation, And let righteousness spring up together, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I have created it.

“Woe to him who strives with his Maker! Let the pots herd strive with the pots herds of the earth! Shall the clay say to him who forms it, ‘What are you making?’ Or shall your handiwork say, ‘He has no hands’?
Woe to him who says to his father, ‘What are you begetting?’ or to the woman, ‘What have you brought forth?’ ”
Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, The Qadash One of Yashar'AL, and his Maker: “Ask Me of things to come concerning My sons; and concerning the work of My hands, you command Me.
I have made the Arath, and created man on it, My hands stretched out the Shamaym, and all their host I have commanded.
I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways; he shall build My city and let My people in exiles go free, not for price or reward,” Says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.

Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “The labor of Mitzraym and merchandise of Cush and of the Sabeans, men of stature, Shall come over to you, and they shall be yours; they shall walk behind you, they shall come over in chains; and they shall bow down to you, they will make supplication to you, saying, ‘Surely 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is in you, and there is no other; There is no other 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.’ ”
Truly You are 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who hide Yourself, O 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, the Savior!
They shall be ashamed and also disgraced, all of them; they shall go in confusion together, Who are makers of idols.
But Yashar'AL shall be saved by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH With an everlasting salvation; You shall not be ashamed or dishonor Forever and ever.

For thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Who created the Shamaym, I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH Who formed the Arath and made it, Who has established it, Who did not create it in vain, Who formed it to be inhabited:“ I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and there is no other.
I have not spoken in secret, In a dark place of the Arath; I did not say to the seed of Ya'aqub, ‘Seek Me in vain’; I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
“Assemble yourselves and come; Draw near together, You who have escaped from the nations, they have no knowledge, Who carry the wood of their carved image, and pray to a idol that cannot save.

Tell and bring forth your case; Yes, let them take counsel together, Who has declared this from ancient time? Who has told it from that time? Have not I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? And there is no other 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH besides Me, a just 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and a Savior; There is none besides Me.
“Look to Me, and be saved, All you ends of the Arath! For I am 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and there is no other.
I have sworn by Myself; The Dabar has gone out of My mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, that to Me every knee shall bow, Every tongue shall take an oath.
The people will declare, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the source of all their righteousness and strength.” and all who were angry with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will come to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and be ashamed.
In 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH all the generations of Yashar'AL will be justified, and in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH they will boast.
Bal and Nabu, the idols of Babylun, bow as they are lowered to the ground, they are being hauled away on ox carts, The poor beasts stagger under the weight.
Both the idols and their owners are bowed down, the idols cannot protect the people, and the people cannot protect the idols, they go off into captivity together.
“Listen to me, descendants of Ya'aqub, all you who remain in Yashar'AL, I have cared for you since you were born, Yes I carried you before you were born.
Even to your old age, I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and even to gray hairs I will carry you! I have made and I will bear; Even I will carry, and will deliver you.
“To whom will you liken Me, and make Me equal and compare Me, that we should be alike?
They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver on the scales; They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it an idol deity; They prostrate themselves, yes they worship.
They bear it on the shoulder, they carry it and set it in its place, and it stands; From its place it shall not move, Though one cries out to it, yet it cannot answer or save him out of his trouble.
“Remember this, and show yourselves men; Recall to mind, O you transgressors.
Remember the former things of old, For I Am 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and there is no other; I Am 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and there is none like Me,
Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done, Saying ‘My counsel shall stand, and I will do all My pleasure,’
Calling a bird of prey from the east, the man who executes My counsel, from a far country, Indeed I have spoken it; I will also bring it to pass, I have purposed it; I will also do it.
“Listen to Me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness:
I bring My righteousness near, it shall not be far off; My salvation shall not linger, and I will place salvation in Ziun, for Yashar'AL My Kabad.
“Come down and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylun; Sit on the ground without a throne, O daughter of the Chaldaans! For you shall no more be called Tender and delicate.
Take the millstones and grind meal, remove your veil, take off the skirt, Uncover the thigh, Pass through the rivers.
Your nakedness shall be uncovered, Yes, your shame will be seen; I will take vengeance, and I will not arbitrate with a man.”
As for our Redeemer 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is His Name, The Qadash One of Yashar'AL.
“Sit in silence, and go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldaans; For you shall no longer be called The Lady of Kingdoms.
I was angry with My people; I have profaned My inheritance, and given them into your hand, you showed them no mercy; on the elderly you laid your yoke very heavily.
And you said, ‘I shall be a lady forever, ’So that you did not take these things to heart, Nor remember the latter end of them.

“Therefore hear this now, you who are given to pleasures, Who dwell securely, who say in your heart, ‘I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and there is no one else besides me; I shall not sit as a widow, Nor shall I know the loss of children’;

But these two things shall come to you In a moment, in one day: The loss of children, and widowhood, they shall come upon you in their fullness because of the multitude of your sorceries, for the great abundance of your enchantments.

“For you have trusted in your wickedness; you have said, ‘No one sees me’; your wisdom and your knowledge have warped you; and you have said in your heart, ‘I am, and there is no one else besides me.’

Therefore evil shall come upon you; and you shall not know from where it arises, and trouble shall fall upon you; and you will not be able to put it off, and desolation shall come upon you suddenly, Which you shall not know.
“Stand now with your enchantments and the multitude of your sorceries, In which you have labored from your youth, Perhaps you will be able to profit, Perhaps you will prevail.
You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels; Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, and the monthly prognosticators Stand up and save you from what shall come upon you.
Behold, they shall be as stubble, The fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame; It shall not be a coal to be warmed by, Nor a fire to sit before!
Thus shall they be to you with whom you have labored, Your merchants from your youth; they shall wander each one to his quarter, no one shall save you.

“Hear this, O house of Ya'aqub, who are called by the name of Yashar'AL, and have come forth from the wellsprings of Yahudah; Who swear by the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and make mention of the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, But not in truth or in righteousness;
For they call themselves after the Qadash city, and lean on the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is His Name:
“I have declared the former things from the beginning; they went forth from My mouth, and I caused them to hear it, Suddenly I did them, and they came to pass.
Because I knew that you were obstinate, and your neck was an iron sinew, and your brow bronze,

Even from the beginning I have declared it to you; Before it came to pass I proclaimed it to you, else you would say, ‘My idol has done them, and my carved image and my molded image have commanded them.’
“You have heard; See all this, and will you not declare it? I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have made you hear new things from this time, Even hidden things, and you did not know them.
They are created now and not from the beginning; and before this day you have not heard them, Lest you should say, ‘Of course I knew them.’
Surely you did not hear, Surely you did not know; Surely from long ago your ear was not opened, For I knew that you would deal very treacherously, and were called a transgressor from the womb.
“For My Name’s sake I will defer My anger, and for My Yadah I will restrain it from you, So that I do not cut you off.
Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
For My own sake, I will do it; For how should My Name be profaned? and I will not give My Kabad to another.
“Listen to Me, O Ya'aqub, and Yashar'AL, My called out ones: I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I Am the First, I Am also the Last.
Indeed My hand has laid the foundation of the Arath (earth), and My right hand has stretched out the Shamaym; When I call to them, they stand up together.

Have any of your idols ever told you this? Come all of you, and listen: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen Cyrus as his ally. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will use him to put an end to the empire of Babylun and to destroy the Babylunian armies.
“I have said it: I am calling Cyrus! I will send him on this errand and will help him succeed.
Come closer, and listen to this, From the beginning I have told you plainly what would happen.” And now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut and His RUACH have sent me with this message.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, your Redeemer, the Qadash One of Yashar'AL: “I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who teaches you what is good for you and leads you along the paths you should follow.
Oh, that you had listened to my commands! Then you would have had Shalum flowing like a gentle river and righteousness rolling over you like waves in the sea.
Your descendants would have been like the sands along the seashore, too many to count! There would have been no need for your destruction, or for cutting off your family name.”
Yet even now, be free from your captivity! Leave Babylun and the Babylunians. Sing out this message! Shout it to the ends of the Arath! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has redeemed His servants, the people of Yashar'AL.
They were not thirsty when He led them through the desert, He divided the rock, and water gushed out for them to drink.
“But there is no Shalum for the wicked,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Listen me O coast lands, and take heed, you people from afar! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has called Me from the womb; From the matrix of My mother, He has made mention of My name.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made my mouth like a sharp sword; In the shadow of His hand, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has hidden me and made me a polished shaft; In His quiver 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has hidden Me.”
“And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, ‘You are My servant O Yashar'AL, In whom I will be Esteemed.’
Then I said, ‘I have labored in vain, I have spent my strength for nothing and in vain; Yet surely my just reward is with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and my work is with my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.’ ”

And now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, the one who formed me in my mother’s womb to be His servant, who commissioned me to bring Yashar'AL back to Him, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has honored me, and my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has given me strength.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH says, “You will do more than restore the people of Yashar'AL to me, I will make you a light to the Gentiles, and you will bring my salvation to the ends of the Arath.”

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the Redeemer and Qadash One of Yashar'AL, says to the one who is despised and rejected by the nations, to the one who is the servant of rulers, kings will stand at attention when you pass by, Princes will also bow low because of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the faithful One, and the Qadash One of Yashar'AL, who has chosen you.”

Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH“ In an acceptable time I have heard you, and in the day of salvation I have helped You; I will preserve You and give You as a covenant to the people, to restore the Arath, to cause them to inherit the desolate heritages;
That You may say to the prisoners, ‘Go forth, ’To those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves.’ They shall feed along the roads, and their pastures shall be on all desolate heights.
They shall neither hunger nor thirst, Neither heat nor sun shall strike them; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who has mercy on them will lead them, even by the springs of water 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will guide them.
I will make each of My mountains a road, and My highways shall be elevated.
Surely these shall come from afar; Look! Those from the north and the west, and these from the land of Sinim.”
Sing, O Shamaym! Be joyful, O Arath, and break out in singing, O mountains! For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has comforted His people, and will have mercy on His afflicted.
But Ziun said, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has forsaken me, and my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has forgotten me.”
“Can a woman forget her nursing child, and not have compassion on the son of her womb? Surely they may forget, yet I will not forget you.
See, I have inscribed you on the palms of My hands; your walls are continually before Me.
Your sons shall make haste; your destroyers and those who laid you waste shall go away from you.

Lift up your eyes, look around and see; All these gather together and come to you, as I live,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “You shall surely clothe yourselves with them all as an ornament, and bind them on you as a bride does.
“For your waste and desolate places, and the land of your destruction, Will even now be too small for the inhabitants; and those who swallowed you up will be far away.
The children you will have after you have lost the others, Will say again in your ears, ‘The place is too small for me; Give me a place where I may dwell.’

Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has begotten these for me, Since I have lost my children and am desolate, a captive, and wandering to and fro? And who has brought these up? There I was left alone; But these, where were they?’ ”

This what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Behold, I will lift My hand in an oath to the nations, and set up My standard for the people's; they shall bring your sons in their arms, and your daughters shall be carried on their shoulders;

Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers; they shall bow down to you with their faces to the earth, and lick up the dust of your feet, then you will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for those who wait for Me shall not be ashamed.”
Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, Or the captives of the righteous be delivered?

But thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible be delivered; For I will contend with him who contends with you, and I will save your children.

I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh, and they shall be drunk with their own blood as with sweet wine, all flesh shall know that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I AM your Savior, and your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Ya'aqub.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Where is the certificate of your mother’s divorce, Whom I have put away? Or which of My creditors is it to whom I have sold you? For your iniquities you have sold yourselves, and for your transgressions your mother has been put away.

Why, when I came, was there no man?Why, when I called, was there none to answer? Is My hand shortened at all that it cannot redeem? Or have I no power to deliver? Indeed with My rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness; their fish stink because there is no water, and die of thirst.
I clothe the Shamaym with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.”

“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given Me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him who is weary, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH awakens Me morning by morning, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH awakens My ear to hear as the learned.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has opened My ear; I was not rebellious, or did I turn away.
I gave My back to those who struck Me, and My cheeks to those who plucked out the beard; I did not hide My face from shame and spitting.
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will help Me; therefore I will not be put to shame; Therefore I have set My face like a flint, and I know that I will not be ashamed.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is near who justifies Me; who will contend with Me? Let us stand together, who is my adversary? Let him come near Me.
Surely 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will help Me; who is he who will condemn Me? Indeed they will all grow old like a garment; The moth will eat them up.
“Who among you fears 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Who obeys the voice of the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Who walks in darkness and has no light? Let him trust in the name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and rely upon his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

Look, all you who kindle a fire, who encircle yourselves with sparks: Walk in the light of your fire and in the sparks you have kindled, This you shall have from My hand, you shall lie down in torment.
“Listen to me, all who hope for deliverance, all who seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Consider the rock from which you were cut, the quarry from which you were mined.
Yes, think about Abraham, your father, and Sarah, who gave birth to your nation, Abraham was only one man when I called him. But when I baraked him, he became a great nation.”

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will comfort Yashar'AL again and have pity on her ruins, Her desert will blossom like Adan, her barren wilderness like the garden of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Joy and gladness will be found there, Songs of thanksgiving will fill the air.
“Listen to me, my people, Hear me Yashar'AL, for my law will be proclaimed, and my justice will become a light to the nations.
My mercy and justice are coming soon, My salvation is on the way, My strong arm will bring justice to the nations, All distant lands will look to me and wait in hope for my powerful arm.

Look up to the skies above, and gaze down on the Arath below, for the skies will disappear like smoke, and the Arath will wear out like a piece of clothing, the people of the Arath will die like flies, but my salvation lasts forever, My righteous rule will never end!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, Listen to me, you who know right from wrong, you who cherish my law in your hearts, Do not be afraid of people’s scorn, nor fear their insults.
For the moth will devour them as it devours clothing, The worm will eat at them as it eats wool, but my righteousness will last forever, My salvation will continue from generation to generation.”
Wake up, wake up, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Clothe yourself with strength! Flex your mighty right arm! Rouse yourself as in the days of old when you slew Mitzraym, the dragon of the Nile.
Are you not the same today, the one who dried up the sea, making a path of escape through the depths so that your people could cross over?

Those who have been ransomed by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will return, They will enter Yahushalam singing, crowned with everlasting joy. Sorrow and mourning will disappear, and they will be filled with joy and gladness.
“Yes, I am the one who comforts you, So why are you afraid of mere man, who wither like the grass and disappear?

Yet you have forgotten 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, your Creator, the one who stretched out the sky like a canopy and laid the foundations of the Arath, will you remain in constant dread of man's oppressors? Will you continue to fear the anger of your enemies? Where is their fury and anger now? It is gone!
Soon all you captives will be released! Imprisonment, starvation, and death will not be your fate!
For I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who stirs up the sea, causing its waves to roar, My Name is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.

And I have put my Dabar in your mouth and hidden you safely in my hand, I stretched out the sky like a canopy and laid the foundations of the Arath, I Am the One who says to Yashar'AL, ‘You are my people!’”
Wake up, wake up, O Yahushalam! You have drunk in the cup of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s fury, you have drunk in the cup of terror, tipping out its last drops.
Not one of your children is left alive to take your hand and guide you.
These two calamities have fallen on you: desolation and destruction, famine and war, and who is left to sympathize with you? who is left to comfort you?
For your children have fainted and lie in the streets, helpless as antelopes caught in a net, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has poured out his fury; their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has rebuked them.
But now listen to this, you afflicted ones who sit in a drunken stupor, though not from drinking wine.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and Defender Dabar: See, I have taken the terrible cup from your hands. You will drink no more of my fury.
Instead, I will hand that cup to your tormentors, those who said, ‘We will trample you into the dust and walk on your backs.’”
Wake up, wake up, O Ziun! Clothe yourself with strength, Put on your beautiful clothes, O Qadash city of Yahushalam, for unclean and unrighteous people will enter your gates no longer.
Rise from the dust, O Yahushalam, Sit in a place of honor remove the chains of slavery from your neck, O captive daughter of Ziun,
For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “When I sold you into exile, I received no payment, now I can redeem you without having to pay for you.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Long ago my people chose to live in Mitzraym, Now they are oppressed by Assyria.
What is this?” asks 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Why are my people enslaved again? Those who rule them shout in exultation, My name is blasphemed all day long.
But I will reveal my Name to my people, and they will come to know its power, then at last they will recognize that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who speaks to them.”
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of the messenger who brings good news, the good news of Shalum and salvation, the news that the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL reigns!
The watchmen shout and sing with joy, for before their very eyes they see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH returning to Yahushalam.
Let the ruins of Yahushalam break into joyful song, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has comforted his people, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has redeemed Yahushalam.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has demonstrated His Qadash power before the eyes of all the nations, all the ends of the Arath will see the victory of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Get out! Get out and leave your captivity, where everything you touch is unclean, Get out of there and purify yourselves, you who carry home the sacred objects of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You will not leave in a hurry, running for your lives, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will go ahead of you; yes, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL will protect you from behind.
See, my servant will prosper; he will be highly exalted.
But many were amazed when they saw him, his face was so disfigured he seemed hardly recognized, and from his appearance, one would scarcely know he was a man.
And he will startle many nations, Kings will stand speechless in his presence, for they will see what they had not been told; they will understand what they had not heard about.
Who has believed our message? To whom has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH revealed his powerful arm?
My servant grew up in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s presence like a tender green shoot, like a root in dry ground, there was nothing beautiful or majestic about his appearance, nothing to attract us to him.
He was despised and rejected, a man of sorrows, acquainted with deepest grief, we turned our backs on him and looked the other way, he was despised, and we did not care.
Yet it was our weaknesses he carried; it was our sorrows that weighed him down, and we thought his troubles were a punishment from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, a punishment for his own sins
But he was pierced for our rebellion, crushed for our sins, he was beaten so we could be whole, he was whipped so we could be healed.
All of us, like sheep, have strayed away. We have left 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH’s paths to follow our own, yet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH laid on him the sins of us all.
He was oppressed and treated harshly, yet he never said a word, He was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep is silent before the shearers, he did not open his mouth.
Unjustly condemned, he was led away, No one cared that he died without descendants, that his life was cut short in midstream, but he was struck down for the rebellion of my people.
He had done no wrong and had never deceived anyone, but he was buried like a criminal; he was put in a rich man’s grave.

But it was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s good plan to crush him and cause him grief, yet when his life is made an offering for sin, he will have many descendants, He will enjoy a long life, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s good plan will prosper in his hands.

When he sees all that is accomplished by his anguish, he will be satisfied, and because of his experience, my righteous servant will make it possible for many to be counted righteous, for he will bear all their sins.
I will give him the honors of a victorious soldier, because he exposed himself to death, He was counted among the rebels, He bore the sins of many and interceded for rebels.

“Sing, O childless woman, you who have never given birth! Break into loud and joyful song, O Yahushalam, you who have never been in labor, For the desolate woman now has more children than the woman who lives with her husband,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Enlarge your house; build an addition, Spread out your home, and spare no expense!
For you will soon be bursting at the seams, Your descendants will occupy other nations and resettle the ruined cities.
“Fear not; you will no longer live in shame, Do not be afraid; there is no more shame for you, You will no longer remember the shame of your youth and the sorrows of widowhood.
For your Creator will be your husband; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is His Name! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is your Redeemer, the Qadash One of Yashar'AL, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all the Arath.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has called you back from your grief, as though you were a young wife abandoned by her husband,” says your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“For a brief moment I abandoned you, but with great compassion I will take you back.
In a burst of anger I turned my face away for a little while, But with everlasting love I will have compassion on you, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your Redeemer.
“Just as I swore in the time of Nuah that I would never again let a flood cover the Arath, so now I swear that I will never again be angry and punish you.
For the mountains may move and the hills disappear, but even then my faithful love for you will remain, My covenant of Barakah will never be broken,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who has mercy on you.
“O storm-battered city, troubled and desolate! I will rebuild you with precious jewels and make your foundations from lapis lazuli.
I will make your towers of sparkling rubies, your gates of shining gems, and your walls of precious stones.
I will teach all your children, and they will enjoy great Shalum.
You will be secure under a government that is just and fair, Your enemies will stay far away, You will live in Shalum, and terror will not come near.
If any nation comes to fight you, it is not because I sent them, Whoever attacks you will go down in defeat.
“I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals beneath the forge and makes the weapons of destruction, and I have created the armies that destroy.

But in that coming day no weapon turned against you will succeed, You will silence every voice raised up to accuse you, these benefits are enjoyed by the servants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; their vindication will come from me, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“Is anyone thirsty? Come and drink, even if you have no money! Come take your choice of wine or milk it is all free!
Why spend your money on food that does not give you strength? Why pay for food that does you no good? Listen to me, and you will eat what is good, You will enjoy the finest food.
“Come to me with your ears wide open. Listen, and you will find life, I will make an everlasting covenant with you, I will give you all the unfailing love I promised to Daud.
See how I used Daud to display my power among the people, I made him a leader among the nations.
You also will command nations you do not know, and peoples unknown to you will come running to obey, because I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the Qadash One of Yashar'AL have made you great.”
Seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH while you can find him, Call on him now while He is near.

Let the wicked change their ways and banish the very thought of doing wrong, let them turn to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that He may have mercy on them, Yes turn to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will forgive you generously.
“My thoughts are nothing like your thoughts,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “And my ways are far beyond anything you could imagine.
For just as the Shamaym are higher than the Arath, so my ways are higher than your ways and my thoughts higher than your thoughts.
“The rain and snow come down from the Shamaym and stay on the ground to water the Arath, they cause the grain to grow, producing seed for the farmer and bread for the hungry.
It is the same with my Dabar (word), I send my Dabar out, and it always produces fruit, It will accomplish all I want it to accomplish, and it will prosper everywhere I send it.
You will live in joy and Shalum, The mountains and hills will burst into song, and the trees of the field will clap their hands!

Where once there were thorns, cypress trees will grow, Where nettles grew, myrtles will sprout up, these events will bring great honor to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Name; they will be an everlasting sign of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's power and love.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Be just and fair to all, do what is right and good, for I am coming soon to rescue you and to display my righteousness among you.
Baraked are all those who are careful to do this, baraked are those who honor my Shabbat days of rest and keep themselves from doing wrong.

“Do not let foreigners who commit themselves to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH say, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will never let me be part of his people, and do not let the eunuchs say, ‘I’m a dried-up tree with no children and no future.’
For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, I will barak those eunuchs who keep my Shabbat days Qadash and who choose to do what pleases me and commit their lives to me.
I will give them within the walls of my house a memorial and a name far greater than sons and daughters could give, For the name I give them is an everlasting one, It will never disappear!

“I will also barak the foreigners who commit themselves to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and love His Name, who worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and do not desecrate the Shabbat day of rest, and who hold fast to my covenant.

I will bring them to my Qadash mountain of Yahushalam and will fill them with joy in my house of prayer, I will accept their burnt offerings and sacrifices, because my Temple will be called a house of prayer for all nations.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, who brings back the outcasts of Yashar'AL, says, I will bring others too, besides my people Yashar'AL.”
Come, wild animals of the field! Come, wild animals of the forest! Come and devour my people!

For the leaders of my people, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s watchmen, His shepherds are blind and ignorant, they are like silent watchdogs that give no warning when danger comes, they love to lie around, sleeping and dreaming.
Like greedy dogs, they are never satisfied, they are ignorant shepherds, all following their own path and intent on personal gain.
“Come,” they say, “let’s get some wine and have a party, Let us all get drunk, then tomorrow we will do it again and have an even bigger party!”
Good people pass away; the righteous often die before their time, But no one seems to care or wonder why, no one seems to understand that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is protecting them from the evil to come.
For those who follow righteous paths will rest in Shalum when they die.
“But you, come here you children of witches, you offspring of adulterers and prostitutes!
Whom do you mock, making faces and sticking out your tongues? You children of sinners and liars!
You worship your idols with great passion beneath the oaks and under every green tree, you sacrifice your children down in the valleys, among the jagged rocks in the cliffs.
Your idol deities are the smooth stones in the valleys, you worship them with liquid offerings and grain offerings, they, not I, are your inheritance, do you think all this makes me happy?
You have committed adultery on every high mountain, there you have worshiped idols and have been unfaithful to me.

You have put pagan symbols on your doorposts and behind your doors, you have left me and climbed into bed with these detestable idols, you have committed yourselves to them, you love to look at their naked bodies.
You have gone to Mulach with olive oil and many perfumes, sending your agents far and wide, even to the world of the dead.
You grew weary in your search, but you never gave up, You strengthened yourself and went on.
“Are you afraid of these idols? Do they terrify you? Is that why you have lied to me and forgotten me and my Dabar? Is it because of my long silence that you no longer fear me?
Now I will expose your so-called good deeds, None of them will help you.

Let us see if your idols can save you when you cry to them for help, why a puff of wind can knock them down! If you just breathe on them, they fall over! But whoever trusts in Me will inherit the land and possess my Qadash mountain.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Rebuild the road! Clear away the rocks and stones so my people can return from captivity.”

The high and Exalted one who lives in eternity, the Qadash One, says this: “I live in the high and Qadash place with those whose ruach are contrite and humble, I restore the crushed ruach of the humble and revive the courage of those with repentant hearts.
For I will not fight against you forever; I will not always be angry, If I were, all people would pass away, all the souls I have made.
I was angry, so I punished these greedy people, I withdrew from them, but they kept going on their own stubborn way.
I have seen what they do, but I will heal them anyway! I will lead them, I will comfort those who mourn,
bringing words of Yadah to their lips, May they have abundant Shalum, both near and far,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who heals them.
“But those who still reject ME are like the restless sea, which is never still but continually churns up mud and dirt.
There is no Shalum for the wicked,” says my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“Shout with the voice of a trumpet blast, Shout aloud! Do not be timid, tell my people Yashar'AL of their sins!

Yet they act so pious (religious)! They come to the Haykal (Temple) every day and seem delighted to learn all about me, They act like a righteous nation that would never abandon the laws of its 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, they ask me to take action on their behalf, pretending they want to be near me.
‘We have fasted before you!’ they say. ‘Why are you not impressed? We have been very hard on ourselves, and you do not even notice it!’ I will tell you why!”
What good is fasting when you keep on fighting and quarreling? This kind of fasting will never get you anywhere with me.

You humble yourselves by going through the motions of penance, bowing your heads like reeds bending in the wind, You dress in burlap and cover yourselves with ashes, Is this what you call fasting? Do you really think this will please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
“No, this is the kind of fasting I want: Free those who are wrongly imprisoned; lighten the burden of those who work for you, Let the oppressed go free, and remove the chains that bind people.
Share your food with the hungry, and give shelter to the homeless, Give clothes to those who need them, and do not hide from relatives who need your help.
“Then your salvation will come like the dawn, and your wounds will quickly heal, your righteousness will lead you forward, and the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will protect you from behind.
Then when you call, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will answer, ‘Yes, I am here,’ He will quickly reply, “Remove the heavy yoke of oppression. Stop pointing your finger and spreading vicious rumors!
Feed the hungry, and help those in trouble, then your light will shine out from the darkness, and the darkness around you will be as bright as noon.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will guide you continually, giving you water when you are dry and restoring your strength, you will be like a well-watered garden, like an ever-flowing spring.
Some of you will rebuild the deserted ruins of your cities, Then you will be known as a rebuilder of walls and a restorer of homes.

“Keep the Shabbat day Qadash, Do not pursue your own interests on the Shabbat day, but enjoy the Shabbat and speak of it with delight as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Qadash day, Honor the Shabbat in everything you do on that day, and do not follow your own desires or talk idly.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be your delight, I will give you great honor and satisfy you with the inheritance I promised to your ancestor Ya'aqub, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Listen! the arm of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not too weak to save you, nor is His ear too deaf to hear you call.
It is your sins that have cut you off from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Because of your sins, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has turned away and will not listen anymore.
Your hands are the hands of murderers, and your fingers are filthy with sin, your lips are full of lies, and your mouth spews corruption.
No one cares about being fair and honest. The people’s lawsuits are based on lies, They conceive evil deeds and then give birth to sin.
They hatch deadly snakes and weave spiders’ webs, Whoever eats their eggs will die; whoever cracks them will hatch a viper.
Their webs cannot be made into clothing, and nothing they do is productive, all their activity is filled with sin, and violence is their trademark.
Their feet run to do evil, and they rush to commit murder, they think only about sinning. Misery and destruction always follow them.
They do not know where to find Shalum or what it means to be just and good, they have mapped out crooked roads, and no one who follows them knows a moments of Shalum.
So there is no justice among us, and we know nothing about right living, we look for light but find only darkness, We look for bright skies but walk in gloom.
We grope like the blind along a wall, feeling our way like people without eyes, even at brightest noontime, we stumble as though it were dark among the living, we are like the dead.
We growl like hungry bears; we moan like mournful doves, we look for justice, but it never comes, We look for rescue, but it is far away from us.
For our sins are piled up before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and it testify against us, yes we know what sinners we are.
We know we have rebelled and have denied 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, We have turned our backs on our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, we know how unfair and oppressive we have been, carefully planning our deceitful lies.
Our courts oppose the righteous, and justice is nowhere to be found, truth stumbles in the streets, and honesty has been outlawed.
Yes, truth is gone, and anyone who renounces evil is attacked, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH looked and was displeased to find there was no justice.
He was amazed to see that no one intervened to help the oppressed, so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself stepped in to save them with His strong arm, and His justice sustained him.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH put on righteousness as His body armor and placed the helmet of salvation on His head, He clothed himself with a robe of vengeance and wrapped himself in a cloak of divine passion.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will repay His enemies for their evil deeds, and the fury of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will fall on His foes, He will pay them back even to the ends of the Arath.
In the west, people will respect the name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; in the east they will Esteem 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will come like a raging flood tide driven by His breath.
“The Redeemer will come to Yahushalam to buy back those in Yashar'AL who have turned from their sins,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“And this is my covenant with them,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “My Ruach will not leave them, and neither will these Dabar I have given you, They will be on your lips and on the lips of your children and your children’s children forever, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
O Yahushalam; Arise and shine, for your light has come, and the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has risen upon you.
See, darkness covers the Arath and thick darkness is over the people, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will arise over you and the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be seen over you.
