Nations will come to your light, and kings will come to the brightness of your risen.
“Lift up your eyes and see around you, all assemble and come to you; your sons come from afar, and your daughters are nursed at your side.
Then you will look and be radiant, your heart will throb and swell with joy; the wealth on the Yam (seas) will be brought to you and the riches of the nations will come to you.
Herds of camels will cover your land, young camels of Midian and Aphah, and all from Shaba will come, bearing gold and incense and proclaiming the Yadah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
All Kadar’s flocks will be gathered to you, the rams of Nabaiuth will serve you; they will be accepted as offerings on my altar, and I will adorn my Esteemed temple.
“Who are these that fly along like clouds, like doves to their nests?

Surely the islands look to me; in the lead are the ships of Tarshish, bringing your children from afar, with their silver and gold, to the honor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the Qadash One of Yashar'AL, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has endowed you with splendor.
“Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you, Though in anger I struck you, in favor I will show you compassion.
Your gates will always stand open, they will never be shut, day or night, so that people may bring you the wealth of the nations, their kings led in triumphal procession.
For the nation or kingdom that will not serve you will perish; it will be utterly ruined.
“The Kabad of Labanun will come to you, the Yunipar, the fir and the cypress together, to adorn my sanctuary; and I will magnify the place for my feet.
The children of your oppressors will come bowing before you; all who despise you will bow down at your feet and will call you the City of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Ziun of the Qadash One of Yashar'AL.
“Although you have been forsaken and hated, with no one traveling through, I will make you the everlasting pride and the joy of all generations.
You will drink the milk of nations and be nursed at royal breasts, Then you will know that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I Am your Savior your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Ya'aqub.
Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, and silver in place of iron, Instead of wood I will bring you bronze, and iron in place of stones, I will make Shalum your governor and well-being your ruler.
No longer will violence be heard in your land, nor ruin or destruction within your borders, but you will call your walls Salvation and your gates Yadah.
The sun will no more be your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon shine on you, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be your everlasting light, and your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will be your Kabad.
Your sun will never set again, and your moon will wane no more; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will end.
All your people will be righteous, They will possess their land forever, for I will plant them there with my own hands in order to bring myself Kabad.
The smallest family will become a thousand people, and the tiniest group will become a mighty nation, At the right time, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make it happen.”

The RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is on me, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sent me to bind up the broken-hearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release the prisoners from darkness,
to proclaim the year of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s favor and the day of vengeance of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, to comfort all who mourn,

and provide for those who grieve in Ziun, to bestow on them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, a garment of Yadah, instead of a spirit of despair, they will be called oaks of righteousness, a planting of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for the display of His splendor.
They will rebuild the ancient ruins and restore the places long devastated; they will renew the ruined cities that have been devastated for generations.
Strangers will shepherd your flocks; foreigners will work your fields and vineyards.
And you will be called Kuhanym of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you will be named ministers of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, You will feed on the wealth of nations, and in their riches you will boast.

Instead of your shame you will receive a double portion, and instead of dishonor you will rejoice in your inheritance, and so you will inherit a double portion in your land, and everlasting joy will be yours.
“For I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH love justice; I hate robbery and wrongdoing, In my faithfulness I will reward my people and make an everlasting covenant with them.
Their descendants will be known among the nations and their offspring among the people, all who see them will acknowledge that they are people 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has baraked.”

I delight greatly in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; my soul rejoices in my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has clothed me with garments of salvation and arrayed me in a robe of His righteousness, as a bridegroom adorns his head like a kuhan, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
For as the soil makes the sprout come up and a garden causes seeds to grow, so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut will make righteousness and Yadah spring up before all nations.
For Ziun’s sake I will not keep silent, for Yahushalam’s sake I will not remain quiet, till her vindication shines out like the dawn, her salvation like a blazing torch.
The nations will see your vindication, and all kings will see your Kabad; you will be called by a new name that the mouth of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bestow.
You will be a crown of splendor in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s hand, a royal diadem in the hand of your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

Never again will you be called “The Forsaken City” or “The Desolate Land.” Your new name will be “The City of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH’s Delight” and “the Bride of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH,” for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH delights in you and will claim you as his bride.
As a young man marries a young woman, so will your Builder marry you; as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride, so will your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH rejoice over you.
I have posted watchmen on your walls, Yahushalam; they will never be silent day or night, You who call on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, give yourselves no rest,
and give Him no rest till He establishes Yahushalam and makes her the Yadah of the Arath.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sworn by His right Hand and by His mighty arm: “Never again will I give your grain as food for your enemies, and never again will foreigners drink the new wine for which you have toiled;
but those who harvest it will eat it and sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and those who gather the grapes will drink it in the courts of my sanctuary.”
Pass through, pass through the gates! Prepare the way for the people, Build up, build up the highway! Remove the stones, Raise a banner for the nations.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made proclamation to the ends of the Arath: “Say to Daughter Ziun, ‘See, your Savior comes! See 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reward is with Him, and His recompense accompanies Him.
They will be called the Qadash People, the Redeemed of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and you will be called Sought After, the City No Longer Deserted.

Who is this coming from Adum, from the city of Buzrah, with his clothing stained red? Who is this in royal robes, marching in His great strength? “It is I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, announcing your salvation! It is I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who has the power to save!”
Why are your clothes so red, as if you have been treading out grapes?
“I have trodden the winepress alone; from the nations no one was with me, I trampled them in my anger and trod them down in my wrath; their blood spattered my garments, and I stained all my clothing.
It was for me the day of vengeance; the year for me to redeem had come.
I looked, but there was no one to help, I was appalled that no one gave support; so my own arm achieved salvation for me, and my own wrath sustained me.
I trampled the nations in my anger; in my wrath I made them drunk and poured their blood on the ground.”

I will tell of the kindnesses of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the deeds for which He is to be Yadah, according to all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done for us, yes the many good things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done for Yashar'AL, according to His compassion and many kindnesses.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Surely they are my people, children who will be true to me”; and so He became their Savior.

In all their distress 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH too was distressed, and the Malak of His presence saved them, in the love and mercy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He redeemed them; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
Yet they rebelled against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and grieved the RUACH Ha'Qadash, so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turned and became their enemy and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself fought against them.

Then the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, recalled the days of old, the days of Musha and his people, where is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who brought them through the Yam (sea), with the shepherd of his flock? Where is he who set 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's RUACH Ha'Qadash among them,
who sent his awesome arm of power to be at Musha’ right hand, who divided the waters before them, to gain for Himself everlasting renown,
who led them through the depths? Like a horse in open country, they did not stumble;
like cattle that go down to the plain, they were given rest by the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, this is how you guided your people to make for yourself a Esteemed Name.
Look down from Shamaym and see, from your lofty throne, Qadash and awesome, Where is your zeal and your might? Your tenderness and compassion are withheld from us.
But you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us or does Yashar'AL acknowledge us; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH you would still be our ABBA, our Redeemer from of old is Your Name.
Why, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH do you make us wander from your ways and harden our hearts so we do not revere you? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes that are your inheritance.
For a little while your people possessed your Qadash place, but now our enemies have trampled down your sanctuary.
We are yours from of old; but you have not ruled over them, they have not been called by your Name.
Oh, that you would burst from the Shamaym and come down! How the mountains would quake in your presence!
As fire causes wood to burn and water to boil, your coming would make the nations tremble, then your enemies would learn the reason for your fame!
When you came down long ago, you did awesome deeds beyond our highest expectations, and oh how the mountains quaked!
For since the world began, no ear has heard and no eye has seen an 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH like 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who works for those who wait for Him!
You welcome those who gladly do good, who follow righteous ways, but you have been very angry with us, for we are not righteous, We are constant sinners; how can people like us be saved?
We are all infected and impure with sin. When we display our righteous deeds, they are nothing but filthy rags, like autumn leaves, we wither and fall, and our sins sweep us away like the wind.
Yet no one calls on your Name or pleads with you for mercy, therefore, you have turned away from us and turned us over to our sins.
And yet, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH you are our Father, We are the clay, and you are the potter, We all are formed by your hand.
Do not be so angry with us O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Please do not remember our sins forever, look at us, we pray, and see that we are all your people.
Your Qadash cities are destroyed, Ziun is a wilderness; yes Yahushalam is a desolate ruin.
The Qadash and beautiful Temple where our fathers sing Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has been burned down, and all the things of beauty are destroyed.
After all this, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must you still refuse to help us? Will you continue to be silent and punish us?

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I was ready to respond, but no one asked for help, I was ready to be found, but no one was looking for me, I said, ‘Here I Am, here I Am!’ to a nation that did not call on my Name.
All day long I opened my arms to a rebellious people, But they follow their own evil paths and their own crooked schemes.
All day long they insult me to my face by worshiping idols in their sacred gardens. They burn incense on pagan altars.
At night they go out among the graves, worshiping the dead, they eat the flesh of pigs and make stews with other forbidden foods.
Yet they say to each other, ‘Do not come too close or you will defile me! I am more qadash than you!’ These people are a stench in my nostrils, an acrid smell that never goes away.
“Look, my decree is written out in front of me: I will not stand silent; I will repay them in full! Yes, I will repay them
both for their own sins and for those of their fathers,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. “For they also burned incense on the mountains and insulted me on the hills, I will pay them back in full!

“But I will not destroy them all,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. “For just as good grapes are found among a cluster of bad ones (and someone will say, ‘Do not throw them all away, some of those grapes are good!’), so I will not destroy all Yashar'AL, For I still have true servants there.
I will preserve a remnant of the people of Yashar'AL and of Yahudah to possess my land, those I choose will inherit it, and my servants will live there.
The plain of Sharun will again be filled with flocks for my people who have searched for me, and the valley of Achur will be a place to pasture herds.

“But because the rest of you have forsaken 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and have forgotten His Haykal (Temple), and because you have prepared feasts to honor the idol deity of Fate and have offered mixed wine to the idol deity of Destiny,

now I will ‘destine’ you for the sword, all of you will bow down before the executioner, for when I called, you did not answer, when I spoke, you did not listen, You deliberately sinned before my very eyes and chose to do what you know I despise.”

Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar, “My servants will eat, but you will starve, My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty, My servants will rejoice, but you will be sad and ashamed.
My servants will sing for joy, but you will cry in sorrow and despair.
Your name will be a curse word among my people, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut will destroy you and will call His true servants by another name.
All who invoke a Barakah or take an oath will do so by the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of truth, for I will put aside my anger and forget the evil of earlier days.
“Look! I am creating new Shamaym and a new Arath, and no one will even think about the old ones anymore.
Be glad; rejoice forever in my creation! And look! I will create Yahushalam as a place of happines, Her people will be a source of joy.
I will rejoice over Yahushalam and delight in my people, and they will no more hear the sound of weeping and crying.

“No longer will babies die when only a few days old, No longer will adults die before they have lived a full life, No longer will people be considered old at one hundred! Only the cursed will die that young!
In those days people will live in the houses they build and eat the fruit of their own vineyards.
Unlike the past, invaders will not take their houses and confiscate their vineyards, For my people will live as long as trees, and my chosen ones will have time to enjoy their hard-won gains.
They will not work in vain, and their children will not be doomed to misfortune, for they are people baraked by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and their children, too, will be baraked.
I will answer them before they even call to me, While they are still talking about their needs, I will go ahead and answer their prayers!

The wolf and the lamb will feed together, The lion will eat hay like a cow, But the snakes will eat dust, In those days no one will be hurt or destroyed on my Qadash mountain, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, Shamaym is my throne, and the Arath is my footstool, Could you build me a temple as good as that? Could you build me such a resting place?
My hands have made both Shamaym and the Arath; they and everything in them are mine. I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken! “I will barak those who have humble and contrite hearts, who tremble at my Dabar.

But those who choose their own ways, delighting in their detestable sins, will not have their offerings accepted, when such people sacrifice a bull, it is no more acceptable than a man's sacrifice, When they sacrifice a lamb, it is as though they had sacrificed a dog! When they bring an offering of grain, they might as well offer the blood of a pig, When they burn frankincense, it is as if they had baraked an idol.

I will send them great trouble, all the things they feared, For when I called, they did not answer, when I spoke, they did not listen, They deliberately sinned before my very eyes and chose to do what they know I despise.”

Hear this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all you who tremble at His Dabar: “Your own people hate you and throw you out for the sake of my Name, ‘Let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be honored!’ they scoff at you, do not mind them, ‘Keep being joyful in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!’ But they that laugh at you will be put to shame.
What is all the commotion in the city? What is that terrible noise from the Temple? It is the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH taking vengeance against His enemies.
“Before the birth pains even begin, Yahushalam gives birth to a son.

Who has ever seen anything as strange as this? Who ever heard of such a thing? Has a nation ever been born in a single day? Has a country ever come forth in a mere moment? But by the time Yahushalam’s birth pains begin, her children will be born.
Would I ever bring this nation to the point of birth and then not deliver it?” 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is asking.“ No! I would never keep this nation from being born,” says your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“Rejoice with Yahushalam! Be glad with her, all you who love her and all you who mourn for her.
Drink deeply of her Kabad even as an infant drinks at its mother’s comforting breasts.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “I will give Yahushalam a river of Shalum and prosperity, the wealth of the nations will flow to her, Her children will be nursed at her breasts, carried in her arms, and held on her lap.
I will comfort you there in Yahushalam as a mother comforts her child.”

When you see these things, your heart will rejoice, You will flourish like the grass! Everyone will see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s hand of Barakah on His servants, and the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH against His enemies.
See, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is coming with fire, and His swift chariots roar like a whirlwind, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bring punishment with the fury of his anger and the flaming fire of His hot rebuke.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will punish the world by fire and by His sword, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge the Arath, and many will be killed by Him.
“Those who ‘consecrate’ and ‘purify’ themselves in a sacred garden with its idol in the center, feasting on pork and rats and other detestable meats will come to a terrible end,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“I can see what they are doing, and I know what they are thinking, So I will gather all nations and peoples together, and they will see my Kabad.

I will perform a sign among them, and I will send those who survive to be messengers to the nations, to Tarshish, to the Libyans and Lydians (who are famous as archers), to Tubal and Greece, and to all the lands beyond the sea that have not heard of my fame or seen my Kabad, there they will declare my Kabad to the nations.

They will bring the remnant of your people back from every nation, They will bring them to my Qadash mountain in Yahushalam as an offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, They will ride on horses, in chariots and wagons, and on mules and camels,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“And I will appoint some of them to be my Kuhanym and Lauym. I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
For as the new Shamaym and the new Arath, Which I will make shall remain before Me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “the same way your descendants and your name remain with me.
“All mankind will come to worship me from Shabbat to Shabbat and from New Moon to New moon says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

And as they go out, they will see the dead bodies of those who have rebelled against me, For the worms that devour them will never die, and the fire that burns them will never go out, all who pass by will view them with utter horror.”

books.name: Jeremiah
chapters: These are the words of Yaramyahu son of Hilkyahu, one of the Kuhanym from the town of Anathuth in the land of Banyamin.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH first gave messages to Yaramyahu during the thirteenth year of the reign of Yusyahu son of Amun, king of Yahudah.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s messages continued throughout the reign of King Yahuiakim, Yusyahu’s son, until the eleventh year of the reign of King Zadakyahu, another of Yusyahu’s sons, that same year the people of Yahushalam were taken away as captives.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me this message:
“I knew you before I formed you in your mother’s womb, Before you were born I set you apart and appointed you as my Nabym to the nations.”
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut,” I said, “I cannot speak for you! I’m too young!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH replied, “Do not say, ‘I am too young,’ for you must go wherever I send you and say whatever I tell you.
And do not be afraid of the people, for I will be with you and will protect you, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reached out and touched my mouth and Dabar, “Look, I have put my Dabar in your mouth!
Today I appoint you to stand up against nations and kingdoms, Some you must uproot and tear down, destroy and overthrow, Others you must build up and plant.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Look, Yaramyahu! What do you see?” and I replied, “I see a branch from an almond tree.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “That’s right, and it means that I am watching, and I will certainly carry out all my plans.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me again and asked, “What do you see now?” and I replied, “I see a pot of boiling water, spilling from the north.”
“Yes,” 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “for terror from the north will boil out on the people of this land.

Listen! I am calling the armies of the kingdoms of the north to come to Yahushalam, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken! “They will set their thrones at the gates of the city, they will attack its walls and all the other towns of Yahudah.
I will pronounce judgment on my people for all their evil, for deserting me and burning incense to other nations idols, Yes they worship idols made with their own hands!
“Get up and prepare for action, Go out and tell them everything I tell you to say, Do not be afraid of them, or I will make you look foolish in front of them.

See, today I have made you strong like a fortified city that cannot be captured, like an iron pillar or a bronze wall, You will stand against the whole land, the kings, officials, Kuhanym, and people of Yahudah.
They will fight you, but they will fail, For I am with you, and I will take care of you, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me another message, He said,

“Go and shout this message to Yahushalam. This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “I remember how eager you were to please Me as a young bride long ago, how you loved Me and followed Me even through the barren wilderness.
In those days Yashar'AL was Qadash to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the first of his children, all who harmed his people were declared guilty, and disaster fell on them, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Listen to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, people of Ya'aqub, all you families of Yashar'AL!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “What did your fathers find wrong with Me that led them to stray so far from Me? They worshiped worthless idols, only to become worthless themselves.

They did not ask, ‘Where is our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who brought us safely out of Mitzraym and led us through the barren wilderness, a land of deserts and pits, a land of drought and death, where no one lives or even travels?’
“And when I brought you into a fruitful land to enjoy its bounty and goodness, you defiled my land and corrupted the possession I had promised you.
The Kuhanym did not ask, ‘Where is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?’ Those who taught my Dabar ignored me, the rulers turned against me, and the Nabym spoke in the name of Baal, wasting their time on worthless idols.
Therefore, I will bring my case against you,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I will even bring charges against your children’s children in the years to come.
“Go west and look in the land of Cyprus; go east and search through the land of Kadar, has anyone ever heard of anything as strange as this?
Has any nation ever traded its idols for new ones, even though they are not mighty at all? Yet my people have exchanged their AL'Mighty 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH for worthless idols!
The Shamaym are shocked at such a thing and shrink back in horror and dismay,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“For my people have done two evil things: They have abandoned me, the fountain of living water, and they have dug for themselves cracked cisterns that can hold no water at all!
“Why has Yashar'AL become a slave? Why has he been carried away as plunder?
Strong lions have roared against him, and the land has been destroyed, the towns are now in ruins, and no one lives in them anymore.
Mitzraym, marching from their cities of Mamphis and Tahpanhas, have destroyed Yashar'AL’s kabad and power.
And you have brought this upon yourselves by rebelling against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, even though 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was leading you on the way!
“What have you gained by your alliances with Mitzraym and your covenants with Assyria? What good to you are the streams of the Nile or the waters of the Euphrates River?

Your wickedness will bring its own punishment, Your turning from me will shame you, and you will see what an evil bitter thing it is to abandon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and not to fear HIM, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, have spoken!

“Long ago I broke the yoke that oppressed you and tore away the chains of your slavery, but still you said, I will not serve you, ’On every hill and under every green tree, you have prostituted yourselves by bowing down to idols.
But I was the one who planted you, choosing a vine of the purest stock, the very best, How did you grow into this corrupt wild vine?
No amount of soap or lye can make you clean, I still see the stain of your guilt, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, have spoken!

“You say, ‘That is not true! I have not worshiped the images of Baal! ’But how can you say that? Go and look in any valley in the land! Face the awful sins you have done, You are like a restless female camel desperately searching for a mate.
You are like a wild donkey, sniffing the wind at mating time, Who can restrain her lust? Those who desire her do not need to search, for she goes running to them!
When will you stop running? When will you stop panting after idols? But you say, ‘Save your breath, I am in love with these foreign idols, and I cannot stop loving them now!’
Yashar'AL is like a thief who feels shame only when he gets caught, they, their kings, officials, Kuhanym, and Nabyms all are alike in this.

To an image carved from a piece of wood they say, ‘You are my father. ’To an idol chiseled from a block of stone they say, ‘You are my mother. ’They turn their backs on me, but in times of trouble they cry out to me, ‘Come and save us!’
But why not call on these idols you have made? When trouble comes, let them save you if they can! For you have as many idol deities as there are towns in Yahudah.
Why do you accuse me of doing wrong? You are the ones who have rebelled,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“I have punished your children, but they did not respond to my discipline, you yourselves have killed your Nabyms as a lion kills its prey.

“O my people, listen to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Have I been like a desert to Yashar'AL? Have I been to them a land of darkness? Why then do my people say, ‘At last we are free from our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! We do not need him anymore!’
Does a young woman forget her jewelry, or a bride her wedding dress? Yet for years my people have forgotten me.
“How you plot and scheme to win your lovers, Even an experienced prostitute could learn from you!
Your clothing is stained with the blood of the innocent and the poor, though you did not catch them breaking into your houses!
And yet you say,‘ I have done nothing wrong, Surely 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not angry with me! ’But now I will punish you severely because you claim you have not sinned.
First here, then there, you flit from one ally to another asking for help, But your new friends in Mitzraym will let you down, just as Assyria did before.
In despair, you will be led into exile with your hands on your heads, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has rejected the nations you trust, they will not help you at all.

“If a man divorces a woman and she goes and marries someone else, he will not take her back again, for that would surely corrupt the land, But you have prostituted yourself with many lovers, so why are you trying to come back to me?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“Look at the shrines on every hilltop, Is there any place you have not been defiled by your adultery with other idols? You sit like a prostitute beside the road waiting for a customer, you sit alone like a nomad in the desert, you have polluted the land with your prostitution and your wickedness.
That is why even the spring rains have failed, For you are a brazen prostitute and completely shameless.
Yet you say to me, ‘Father, you have been my guide since my youth.
Surely you will not be angry forever! Surely you can forget about it! ’So you talk, but you keep on doing all the evil you can.”

During the reign of King Yusyahu, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Have you seen what fickle Yashar'AL has done? Like a wife who commits adultery, Yashar'AL has worshiped other nations idols on every hill and under every green tree.
I thought, ‘After she has done all this, she will return to me.’ But she did not return, and her faithless sister Yahudah saw this.
She saw that I divorced faithless Yashar'AL because of her adultery, But that treacherous sister Yahudah had no fear, and now she, too, has left me and given herself to prostitution.
Yashar'AL treated it all so lightly, she thought nothing of committing adultery by worshiping idols made of wood and stone. So now the land has been polluted.
But despite all this, her faithless sister Yahudah has never sincerely returned to me. She has only pretended to be sorry, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have spoken!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Even faithless Yashar'AL is less guilty than treacherous Yahudah!
Therefore, go and give this message to Yashar'AL, This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “O Yashar'AL, my faithless people, come home to me again, for I am merciful, I will not be angry with you forever.

Only acknowledge your guilt, Admit that you rebelled against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and committed adultery against HIM by worshiping idols under every green tree, Confess that you refused to listen to my voice, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!

“Return home you wayward children,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “for I am your master, I will bring you back to the land of Yashar'AL one from this town and two from that family, from wherever you are scattered.
And I will give you shepherds after my own heart, who will guide you with knowledge and understanding.

“And when your land is once more filled with people,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “you will no longer wish for ‘the good old days’ when you possessed the Ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Covenant, You will not miss those days or even remember them, and there will be no need to rebuild the Ark.
In that day Yahushalam will be known as ‘The Throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’ All nations will come there to honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, They will no longer stubbornly follow their own evil desires.
In those days the people of Yahudah and Yashar'AL will return together from exile in the north, They will return to the land I gave your ancestors as an inheritance forever.

“I thought to myself, ‘I would love to treat you as my own children! ’I wanted nothing more than to give you this beautiful land, the finest possession in the world, I looked forward to you calling me ‘Father,’ and I wanted you never to turn from me.
But you have been unfaithful to me, you people of Yashar'AL! You have been like a faithless wife who leaves her husband, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken.”
Voices are heard high on the wind swept mountains, the weeping and pleading of Yashar'AL’s people, For they have chosen crooked paths and have forgotten 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“My wayward children,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “come back to me, and I will heal your wayward hearts. “Yes, we are coming,” the people reply, “for you are 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Our worship of idols on the hills and our religious orgies on the mountains are a delusion, Only in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will Yashar'AL ever find salvation.
From childhood we have watched as everything our fathers worked for, their flocks and herds, their sons and daughters, was squandered on a delusion.

Let us now lie down in shame and cover ourselves with dishonor, for we and our fathers have sinned against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, From our childhood to this day we have never obeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
“O Yashar'AL,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “if you wanted to return to me, you could, you could throw away your detestable idols and stray away no more.

Then when you swear by my Name, saying, ‘As surely as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives, ’you could do so with truth, justice, and righteousness, then you would be a Barakah to the nations of the world, and all people would come and praise my Name.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to the people of Yahudah and Yahushalam: “Plow up the hard ground of your hearts! Do not waste your good seed among thorns.
O people of Yahudah and Yahushalam, surrender your pride and power, Change your hearts before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, or my anger will burn like an unquenchable fire because of all your sins.
“Shout to Yahudah, and broadcast to Yahushalam! Tell them to sound the alarm throughout the land: ‘Run for your lives! Flee to the fortified cities!’
Raise a signal flag as a warning for Yahushalam: ‘Flee now! Do not delay! ’For I am bringing terrible destruction upon you from the north.”
A lion stalks from its den, a destroyer of nations, It has left its lair and is headed your way, It is going to devastate your land! Your towns will lie in ruins, with no one living in them anymore.
So put on clothes of mourning and weep with broken hearts, for the fierce anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is still upon us.
“In that day,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “the king and the officials will tremble in fear, the Kuhanym will be struck with horror, and the Nabyms will be appalled.”
Then I said, “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the people have been deceived by what you said, for you promised Shalum for Yahushalam. But the sword is held at their throats!”
The time is coming when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will say to the people of Yahushalam, “My dear people, a burning wind is blowing in from the desert, and it is not a gentle breeze useful for winnowing grain.
It is a roaring blast sent by me! Now I will pronounce your destruction!”
Our enemy rushes down on us like storm clouds! his chariots are like whirlwinds, his horses are swifter than eagles, how terrible it will be, for we are doomed!
O Yahushalam, cleanse your heart that you may be saved, How long will you harbor your evil thoughts?
Your destruction has been announced from Dan and the hill country of Aphraim.
“Warn the surrounding nations and announce this to Yahushalam: The enemy is coming from a distant land, raising a battle cry against the towns of Yahudah.
They surround Yahushalam like watchmen around a field, for my people have rebelled against me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Your own actions have brought this upon you, this punishment is bitter, piercing you to the heart!”
My heart, my heart, I writhe in pain! My heart pounds within me! I cannot be still, For I have heard the blast of enemy trumpets and the roar of their battle cries.
Waves of destruction roll over the land, until it lies in complete desolation, suddenly my tents are destroyed; in a moment my shelters are crushed.
How long must I see the battle flags and hear the trumpets of war?
“My people are foolish and do not know me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “They are stupid children who have no understanding, they are clever enough at doing wrong, but they have no idea how to do right!”
I looked at the Arath, and it was empty and formless, I looked at the Shamaym, and there was no light.
I looked at the mountains and hills, and they trembled and shook.
I looked, and all the people were gone, all the birds of the sky had flown away.
I looked, and the fertile fields had become a wilderness, the towns lay in ruins, crushed by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s fierce anger.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “The whole land will be ruined, but I will not destroy it completely.
The Arath will mourn and the Shamaym will be draped in black because of my decree against my people, I have made up my mind and will not change it.”
At the noise of charioteers and archers, the people flee in terror, they hide in the bushes and run for the mountains, all the towns have been abandoned, not a person remains!

What are you doing, you who have been plundered? Why do you dress up in beautiful clothing and put on gold jewelry? Why do you brighten your eyes with mascara? Your primping will do you no good! The allies who were your lovers despise you and seek to kill you.
I hear a cry, like that of a woman in labor, the groans of a woman giving birth to her first child, It is beautiful Yahushalam gasping for breath and crying out, “Help! I am being murdered!”
“Run up and down every street in Yahushalam,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Look high and low; search throughout the city! If you can find even one just and honest person, I will not destroy the city.
But even when they are under oath, saying, ‘As surely as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives,’ they are still telling lies!”

O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you are searching for honesty, You struck your people, but they paid no attention, You crushed them, but they refused to be corrected, they are determined, with faces set like stone; they have refused to repent.
Then I said, “But what can we expect from the poor? They are ignorant, they do not know the ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, They do not understand 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s laws.

So I will go and speak to their leaders. Surely they know the ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and understand 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s laws.”But the leaders, too, as one man, had thrown off 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH’s yoke and broken His chains.

So now a lion from the forest will attack them; a wolf from the desert will pounce on them, a leopard will lurk near their towns, tearing apart any who dare to venture out, for their rebellion is great, and their sins are many.

“How can I pardon you? For even your children have turned from me, they have sworn by idols that are not alive at all! I fed my people until they were full, But they thanked me by committing adultery and lining up at the brothels.
They are well-fed, lusty stallions, each neighing for his neighbor’s wife.
Should I not punish them for this?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Should I not avenge myself against such a nation?
“Go down the rows of the vineyards and destroy the grapevines, leaving a scattered few alive, Strip the branches from the vines, for these people do not belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The people of Yashar'AL and Yahudah are full of treachery against me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“They have lied about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and said, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not bother us! No disasters will come upon us, there will be no war or famine.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Nabyms are all wind bags who do not really speak for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Let their predictions of disaster fall on themselves!’”
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: “Because the people are talking like this, my messages will flame out and burn the people like kindling wood.
O Yashar'AL, I will bring a distant nation against you,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. “It is a mighty nation, an ancient nation, a people whose language you do not know, whose speech you cannot understand.
Their weapons are deadly; their warriors are mighty.

They will devour the food of your harvest; they will devour your sons and daughters, they will devour your flocks and herds; they will devour your grapes and figs, and they will destroy your fortified towns, which you think are so safe.
“Yet even in those days I will not blot you out completely,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“And when your people ask, ‘Why did 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH do all this to us?’ you must reply, ‘you rejected Him and gave yourselves to foreign idols in your own land, Now you will serve foreigners in a land that is not your own.’
“Make this announcement to Yashar'AL, and say this to Yahudah:
Listen, you foolish and senseless people, with eyes that do not see and ears that do not hear.

Have you no respect for me? Why do you not tremble in my presence? I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH define the ocean’s sandy shoreline as an everlasting boundary that the waters cannot cross, the waves may toss and roar, but they can never pass the boundaries I set.
But my people have stubborn and rebellious hearts, they have turned away and abandoned me.
They do not say from the heart, ‘Let us live in awe of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for He gives us rain each spring and fall, assuring us of a harvest when the time is right.’
Your wickedness has deprived you of these wonderful Barakah, Your sin has robbed you of all these good things.
“Among my people are wicked men who lie in wait for victims like a hunter hiding in a blind, they continually set traps to catch people.
Like a cage filled with birds, their homes are filled with evil plots, and now they are great and rich.
They are fat and sleek, and there is no limit to their wicked deeds, they refuse to provide justice to orphans and deny the rights of the poor.
Should I not punish them for this?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Should I not avenge myself against such a nation?
A horrible and shocking thing has happened in this land,
the Nabyms give false prophecies, and the Kuhanym rule with an iron hand, Worse yet, my people like it that way! But what will you do when the end comes?

“Run for your lives, you people of Banyamin! Get out of Yahushalam! Sound the alarm in Takua! Send up a signal at Beth-hakkaram! A powerful army is coming from the north, coming with disaster and destruction.
O Yahushalam, you are my beautiful and delicate daughter, but I will destroy you!
Enemies will surround you, like shepherds camped around the city, Each chooses a place for his troops to devour.
They shout, ‘Prepare for battle! Attack at noon!’ ‘No, it’s too late; the day is fading, and the evening shadows are falling.’
‘Well then, let’s attack at night and destroy her palaces!’”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar, “Cut down the trees for battering rams, Build siege ramps against the walls of Yahushalam, this is the city to be punished, for she is wicked through and through.
She spouts evil like a fountain, Her streets echo with the sounds of violence and destruction, I always see her sickness and sores.
Listen to this warning, Yahushalam, or I will turn from you in disgust, Listen, or I will turn you into a heap of ruins, a land where no one lives.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: “Even the few who remain in Yashar'AL will be picked over again, as when a harvester checks each vine a second time to pick the grapes that were missed.”
To whom can I give warning? Who will listen when I speak? Their ears are closed, and they cannot hear, they scorn the word of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH They do not want to listen at all

So now I am filled with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s fury, Yes, I am tired of holding it in! “I will pour out my fury on children playing in the streets and on gatherings of young men, on husbands and wives and on those who are old and gray.
Their homes will be turned over to their enemies, as will their fields and their wives, for I will raise my powerful fist against the people of this land, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“From the least to the greatest, their lives are ruled by greed, from Nabyms to Kuhanym, they are all frauds.
They offer superficial treatments for my people’s mortal wound, they give assurances of Shalum when there is no Shalum.

Are they ashamed of their disgusting actions? Not at all, they do not even know how to behave! Therefore, they will lie among the slaughtered, They will be brought down when I punish them,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Stop at the crossroads and look around, Ask for the old righteous way, and walk in it, Travel its path, and you will find rest for your souls. But you reply, ‘No, that’s not the road we want!’
I posted watchmen over you who said, ‘Listen for the sound of the alarm.’ But you replied, ‘No! We will not pay attention!’
“Therefore, listen to this, all you nations. Take note of my people’s situation.
Listen, all the Arath! I will bring disaster on my people, It is the fruit of their own schemes, because they refuse to listen to me. They have rejected my Dabar.
There’s no use offering me sweet frankincense from Shaba, Keep your fragrant imported from distant lands! I will not accept your burnt offerings, Your sacrifices have no pleasing aroma for me.”
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “I will put obstacles in my people’s path, Fathers and sons will both fall over them, Neighbors and friends will die together.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Look! A great army coming from the north! a great nation is rising against you from far-off lands.

They are armed with bows and spears. They are cruel and show no mercy, they sound like a roaring sea as they ride forward on horses, they are coming in battle formation, planning to destroy you, beautiful Yahushalam.”
We have heard reports about the enemy, and we wring our hands in fright, Pangs of anguish have gripped us, like those of a woman in labor.
Do not go out to the fields! Do not travel on the roads! The enemy’s sword is everywhere and terrorizes us at every turn!
Oh, my people, dress yourselves in burlap and sit among the ashes, Mourn and weep bitterly, as for the loss of an only son, For suddenly the destroying armies will be upon you!
Yaramyahu, I have made you a tester of metals, that you may determine the quality of my people.
They are the worst kind of rebel, full of slander, they are as hard as bronze and iron, and they lead others into corruption.
The bellows fiercely fan the flames to burn out the corruption, but it does not purify them, for the wickedness remains.
I will label them ‘Rejected Silver,’ for I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I Am discarding them.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave another message to Yaramyahu, He said,
“Go to the entrance of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple, and give this message to the people: ‘O Yahudah, listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Listen to it, all of you who worship here!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: ‘Even now, if you quit your evil ways, I will let you stay in your own land.
But do not be fooled by those who promise you safety simply because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple is here, They chant, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple is here! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple is here!”
But I will be merciful only if you stop your evil thoughts and deeds and start treating each other with justice;
only if you stop exploiting foreigners, orphans, and widows; only if you stop your murdering; and only if you stop harming yourselves by worshiping idols.
Then I will let you stay in this land that I gave to your fathers to keep forever.
“‘Do not be fooled into thinking that you will never suffer because the Haykal (Temple) is here. It’s a lie!
Do you really think you can steal, murder, commit adultery, lie, and burn incense to Baal and all those other new idols of yours,
and then come here and stand before me in my Haykal (temple) and chant, “We are safe!” only to go right back to all those evils again?
Do you not admit that this Haykal which bears my Name, has become a den of thieves? Surely I see all the evil going on there. I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have spoken!
“‘Go now to the place at Shiluh where I once put the Tabernacle that bore my Name. See what I did there because of all the wickedness of my people, the Yasharalym.
While you were doing these wicked things, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I spoke to you about it repeatedly, but you would not listen. I called out to you, but you refused to answer.
So just as I destroyed Shiluh, I will now destroy this Temple that bears my Name, this Temple that you trust in for help, this place that I gave to you and your fathers.
And I will send you out of my sight into exile, just as I did your relatives, the people of Yashar'AL.’
Pray no more for these people Yaramyahu, do not weep or pray for them, and do not beg me to help them, for I will not listen to you.
Do you not see what they are doing through out the towns of Yahudah and in the streets of Yahushalam?

No wonder I am so angry! Watch how the children gather wood and the fathers build sacrificial fires, See how the women knead dough and make cakes to offer to the Queen of deity, and they pour out liquid offerings to their other idol deities!
Am I the one they are hurting?” asks 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Most of all, they hurt themselves, to their own shame.”
So this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “I will pour out my terrible fury on this place, Its people, animals, trees, and crops will be consumed by the unquenchable fire of my anger.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: “Take your burnt offerings and your other sacrifices and eat them yourselves!
When I led your fathers out of Mitzraym, it was not burnt offerings and sacrifices I wanted from them.
This is what I told them: ‘Obey me, and I will be your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and you will be my people. Do everything as I say, and all will be well!’
“But my people would not listen to me. They kept doing whatever they wanted, following the stubborn desires of their evil hearts. They went backward instead of forward.
From the day your ancestors left Mitzraym until now, I have continued to send my servants, the Nabyms, day in and day out.
But my people have not listened to me or even tried to hear, They have been stubborn and sinful, even worse than their ancestors.
“Tell them all this, but do not expect them to listen. Shout out your warnings, but do not expect them to respond.
Say to them, ‘This is the nation whose people will not obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and who refuse to be taught. Truth has vanished from among them; it is no longer heard on their lips.
Shave your head in mourning, and weep alone on the mountains. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has rejected and forsaken this generation that has provoked his fury.’
“The people of Yahudah have sinned before my very eyes,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “They have set up their abominable idols right in the Temple that bears my Name, defiling it.

They have built pagan shrines at Tuphath, the garbage dump in the valley of Ban-Hinnum, and there they burn their sons and daughters in the fire. I have never commanded such a horrible deed; it never even crossed my mind to command such a thing!

So beware, for the time is coming,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “when that garbage dump will no longer be called Tuphath or the valley of Ban-Hinnum, but the Valley of Slaughter. They will bury the bodies in Tuphath until there is no more room for them.
The bodies of my people will be food for the vultures and wild animals, and no one will be left to scare them away.

I will put an end to the happy singing and laughter in the streets of Yahushalam. The joyful voices of bridegrooms and brides will no longer be heard in the towns of Yahudah. The land will lie in complete desolation.
“In that day,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “the enemy will break open the graves of the kings and officials of Yahudah, and the graves of the Kuhanym, Nabym, and common people of Yahushalam.

They will spread out their bones on the ground before the sun, moon, and stars, the idols they have loved, served, and worshiped, Their bones will not be gathered up again or buried, but will be scattered on the ground like manure.
And the people of this evil nation who survive will wish to die rather than live where I will send them, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, have spoken!
Yaramyahu, say to the people, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘When people fall down, do they not get up again? When they discover they are on the wrong road, do they not turn back?
Then why do these people stay on their self destructive path? Why do the people of Yahushalam refuse to turn back? They cling tightly to their lies and will not turn around.

I listen to their conversations and do not hear a word of truth, Is anyone sorry for doing wrong? Does anyone say, “What a terrible thing I have done”? No! All are running down the path of sin as swiftly as a horse galloping into battle!

Even the stork that flies across the sky knows the time of her migration, as do the turtledove, the swallow, and the crane, They all return at the proper time each year, But not my people! They do not know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s laws.
“‘How can you say, “We are wise because we have the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,” when your teachers have twisted it by writing lies?
These wise teachers will fall into the trap of their own foolishness, for they have rejected the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Are they really so wise as they think?
I will give their wives to others and their farms to strangers, From the least to the greatest, their lives are ruled by greed, Yes, even my Nabyms and Kuhanym are like that. They are all frauds.
They offer superficial treatments for my people’s mortal wound, they give assurances of Shalum when there is no Shalum.

Are they ashamed of these disgusting actions? Not at all, they do not even know how to behave themselves! Therefore, they will lie among the slaughtered, They will be brought down when I punish them, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I will surely consume them, There will be no more harvests of figs and grapes, their fruit trees will all die, Whatever I gave them will soon be gone, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have spoken!’

“Then the people will say, ‘Why should we wait here to die? Come, let’s go to the fortified towns and die there, For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has decreed our destruction and has given us a cup of poison to drink because we sinned against Him.
We hoped for Shalum, but no Shalum came. We hoped for a time of healing, but found only terror.’

“The snorting of the enemies’ warhorses can be heard all the way from the land of Dan in the north! The neighing of their stallions makes the whole land tremble, They are coming to devour the land and everything in it, cities and people alike.
I will send these enemy troops among you like poisonous snakes you cannot charm, they will bite you, and you will die, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
My grief is beyond healing; my heart is broken.

Listen to the weeping of my people; it can be heard all across the land. “Has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH abandoned Yahushalam?” the people ask, “Is her King no longer there? “Oh, why have they provoked my anger with their carved idols and their worthless foreign idols?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“The harvest is finished, and the summer is gone,” the people cry, “yet we are not saved!”
I am hurt with the hurt of my people, I mourn and am overcome with grief.
Is there no medicine in Gilaad? Is there no physician there? Why is there no healing for the wounds of my people
If only my head were a pool of water and my eyes a fountain of tears, I would weep day and night for all my people who have been slaughtered.
Oh, that I could go away and forget my people and live in a travelers’ shack in the desert, For they are all adulterers, a pack of treacherous liars.
“My people bend their tongues like bows to shoot out lies, they refuse to stand up for the truth, They only go from bad to worse, They do not know me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Beware of your neighbor! Do not even trust your brother! For brother takes advantage of brother, and friend slanders friend.
They all fool and defraud each other; no one tells the truth, With practiced tongues they tell lies; they wear themselves out with all their sinning.
They pile lie upon lie and utterly refuse to acknowledge me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: “See, I will melt them down in a crucible and test them like metal, What else can I do with my people?
For their tongues shoot lies like poisoned arrows, they speak friendly words to their neighbors while scheming in their heart to kill them.
Should I not punish them for this?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Should I not avenge myself against such a nation?”
I will weep for the mountains and wail for the wilderness pastures, For they are desolate and empty of life; the lowing of cattle is heard no more; the birds and wild animals have all fled.
“I will make Yahushalam into a heap of ruins,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “It will be a place haunted by jackals, the towns of Yahudah will be ghost towns, with no one living in them.”
Who is wise enough to understand all this? Who has been instructed by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and can explain it to others? Why has the land been so ruined that no one dares to travel through it?
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH replies, “This has happened because my people have abandoned my instructions; they have refused to obey what I said.
Instead, they have stubbornly followed their own desires and worshiped the images of Baal, as their ancestors taught them.
So now, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, Dabar: Look! I will feed them with bitterness and give them poison to drink.
I will scatter them around the world, in places they and their ancestors never heard of, and even there I will chase them with the sword until I have destroyed them completely.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: “Consider all this, and call for the mourners, Send for the women who mourn at funerals.
Quick! Begin your weeping! Let the tears flow from your eyes.
Hear the people of Yahushalam crying in despair, ‘We are ruined! We are completely humiliated! We must leave our land, because our homes have been torn down.’”
Listen, you women, to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; open your ears to what He has to say, Teach your daughters to wail; teach one another how to lament.

For death has crept in through our windows and has entered our mansions, It has killed off the flower of our youth: Children no longer play in the streets, and young men no longer gather in the squares.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Bodies will be scattered across the fields like clumps of manure, like bundles of grain after the harvest, No one will be left to bury them.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Do not let the wise boast in their wisdom, or the powerful boast in their power, or the rich boast in their riches.

But those who wish to boast should boast in this alone, that they truly know me and understand that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who demonstrates unfailing love and who brings justice and righteousness to the Arath, and that I delight in these things, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“A time is coming, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, when I will punish all those who are circumcised in body but not in heart (ruach)

the Mitzraym, Adumites, Ammunites, Muabites, the people who live in the desert in remote places, and yes, even the people of Yahudah, and like all these pagan nations, the people of Yashar'AL also have uncircumcised hearts.”
Hear the Dabar that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH speaks to you, O Yashar'AL!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Do not act like the other nations, who try to read their future in the stars, Do not be afraid of their predictions, even though other nations are terrified by them.
Their ways are futile and foolish, they cut down a tree, and a craftsman carves an idol.
They decorate it with gold and silver and then fasten it securely with hammer and nails so it will not fall over.

Their idols are like helpless scarecrows in a cucumber field! They cannot speak, and they need to be carried because they cannot walk, Do not be afraid of such idol deities, for they can neither harm you nor do you any good.”
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, there is no one like you! for You are great, and your Name is full of power.
Who would not fear you, O Ruler of nations? That title belongs to you alone! Among all the wise people of the Arath and in all the kingdoms of the world, there is no one like You.
People who worship idols are stupid and foolish, The things they worship are made of wood!

They bring beaten sheets of silver from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz, and they give these materials to skillful craftsmen who make their idols, then they dress these idols in royal blue and purple robes made by expert tailors.

But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the only true 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and the everlasting Ruler! The whole Arath trembles at the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, The nations cannot stand up to the wrath of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Say this to those who worship other nations idols: “Your so-called deities, who did not make the Shamaym and the Arath, will vanish from the Arath and from under the Shamaym.”
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made the Arath by His power, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH preserves it by His wisdom, With His own understanding He stretched out the Shamaym.

When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH speaks in the thunder, the Shamaym roar with rain, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH causes the clouds to rise over the Arath, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sends the lightning with the rain and releases the wind from His storehouses.
The whole of man's race is foolish and has no knowledge! The craftsmen are dishonor by the idols they make, for their carefully shaped works are a fraud, these idols have no breath or power.
Idols are worthless; they are ridiculous lies! On the day of reckoning they will all be destroyed.
But the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL is no idol! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the Creator of everything that exists, including Yashar'AL, His own special possession, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is His Name!
Pack your bags and prepare to leave; the siege is about to begin.
For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Suddenly, I will fling out all you who live in this land, I will pour great troubles upon you, and at last you will feel my anger.”
Woe to you for your hurt! for you will say to yourself, My wound is severe, and my grief is great, My sickness is incurable, but I must bear it.
My home is gone, and no one is left to help me rebuild it, my children have been taken away, and I will never see them again.
The shepherds of my people have lost their senses, they no longer seek wisdom from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, therefore, they fail completely, and their flocks are scattered.
Listen! Hear the terrifying roar of great armies as they roll down from the north, The towns of Yahudah will be destroyed and become a haunt for jackals.
I know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that our lives are not our own, we are not able to plan our own course.
So correct me 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but please be gentle, do not correct me in anger, for I would die.

Pour out your wrath on the nations that refuse to acknowledge you and on the people that do not call upon your Name, For they have devoured your people Yashar'AL, they have devoured and consumed them, making the land a desolate wilderness.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave another message to Yaramyahu, He said,
“Remind the people of Yahudah and Yahushalam about the terms of my covenant with them.
Say to them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: Cursed is anyone who does not obey the terms of my covenant!

For I said to your ancestors when I brought them out of the iron-smelting furnace of Mitzraym, “If you obey me and do whatever I command you, then you will be my people, and I will be your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.”
I said this so I could keep my promise to your ancestors to give you a land flowing with milk and honey, the land you live in today.’ Then I replied, “so be it 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! May it be so.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Broadcast this message in the streets of Yahushalam, Go from town to town throughout the land and say, ‘Remember the ancient covenant, and do everything it requires.
For I solemnly warned your ancestors when I brought them out of Mitzraym, “Obey me!” I have repeated this warning over and over to this day,

but your ancestors did not listen or even pay attention, Instead, they stubbornly followed their own evil desires, and because they refused to obey, I brought upon them all the curses described in this covenant.’”
Again 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke to me and said, “I have discovered a conspiracy against me among the people of Yahudah and Yahushalam.

They have returned to the sins of their ancestors, they have refused to listen to me and are worshiping other nations idols, Yashar'AL and Yahudah have both broken the covenant I made with their ancestors.
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, I am going to bring calamity upon them, and they will not escape, though they beg for mercy, I will not listen to their cries.
Then the people of Yahudah and Yahushalam will pray to their idols and burn incense before them, but the idols will not save them when disaster strikes!
Look now, people of Yahudah; you have as many idols as you have towns, You have as many altars of shame, altars for burning incense to your deity Baal as there are streets in Yahushalam.
“Pray no more for these people, Yaramyahu do not weep or pray for them, for I will not listen to them when they cry out to me in distress.
“What right do my beloved people have to come to my Temple, when they have done so many immoral things? Can their vows and sacrifices prevent their destruction? They actually rejoice in doing evil!
I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, once called them a thriving olive tree, beautiful to see and full of good fruit, But now I have sent the fury of their enemies to burn them with fire, leaving them charred and broken.
“I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, who planted this olive tree, have ordered it destroyed, For the people of Yashar'AL and Yahudah have done evil, arousing my anger by burning incense to Baal.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH told me about the plots my enemies were making against me.

I was like a lamb being led to the slaughter. I had no idea that they were planning to kill me! “Let us destroy this man and all his words,” they said. “Let us cut him down, so his name will be forgotten forever.”
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, You make righteous judgments, and you examine the deepest thoughts and secrets, Let me see your vengeance against them, for I have committed my cause to you.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar about the men of Anathuth who wanted me dead, they had said, “We will kill you if you do not stop prophesying in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
So this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar about them: “I will punish them! Their young men will die in battle, and their boys and girls will starve to death.
Not one of these plotters from Anathuth will survive, for I will bring disaster upon them when their time of punishment comes.”
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you always give me justice when I bring a case before you, So let me bring you this complaint: Why are the wicked so prosperous? Why are evil people so happy?
You have planted them, and they have gotten root and prospered, Your Name is on their lips, but you are far from their hearts.
But as for me, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH you know my heart, You see me and test my thoughts, Drag these people away like sheep to be butchered! Set them aside to be slaughtered!

How long must this land mourn? Even the grass in the fields has withered, the wild animals and birds have disappeared because of the evil in the land, For the people have said, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not see what is ahead for us!”
“If racing against mere men makes you tired, how will you race against horses? If you stumble and fall on open ground, what will you do in the thickets near the Yurdan?
Even your brothers, members of your own family, have turned against you, they plot and raise complaints against you, do not trust them, no matter how pleasantly they speak.
“I have abandoned my people, my special possession, I have surrendered my dearest ones to their enemies.
My chosen people have roared at me like a lion of the forest, so I have treated them with contempt.
My chosen people act like speckled vultures, but they themselves are surrounded by vultures, bring on the wild animals to pick their corpses clean!
“Many rulers have ravaged my vineyard, trampling down the vines and turning all its beauty into a barren wilderness.
They have made it an empty wasteland; I hear its mournful cry, the whole land is desolate, and no one even cares.
On all the bare hilltops, destroying armies can be seen, the sword of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH devours people from one end of the nation to the other, No one will escape!
My people have planted wheat but are harvesting thorns, they have worn themselves out, but it has done them no good they will harvest a crop of shame because of the fierce anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Now this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “I will uproot from their land all the evil nations reaching out for the possession I gave my people Yashar'AL, And I will uproot Yahudah from among them.
But afterward I will return and have compassion on all of them, I will bring them home to their own lands again, each nation to its own possession.

And if these nations truly learn the ways of my people, and if they learn to swear by my Name, saying, ‘As surely as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives’ (just as they taught my people to swear by the name of Baal), then they will be given a place among my people.
But any nation who refuses to obey me will be uprooted and destroyed. I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me: “Go and buy a linen loincloth and put it on, but do not wash it.”
So I bought the loincloth as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH directed me, and I put it on.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me another message:
“Take the linen loincloth you are wearing, and go to the Euphrates River. Hide it there in a hole in the rocks.”
So I went and hid it by the Euphrates as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had instructed me.
A long time afterward 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Go back to the Euphrates and get the loincloth I told you to hide there.”
So I went to the Euphrates and dug it out of the hole where I had hidden it. But now it was rotting and falling apart. The loincloth was good for nothing.
Then I received this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: This shows how I will rot away the pride of Yahudah and Yahushalam.
These wicked people refuse to listen to me, They stubbornly follow their own desires and worship other nations idols, therefore, they will become like this loincloth, good for nothing!

As a loincloth clings to a man’s waist, so I created Yahudah and Yashar'AL to cling to me, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, They were to be my people, my pride, my Kabad, an honor to my Name, But they would not listen to me.
“So tell them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: May all your jars be filled with wine.’ And they will reply, ‘Of course! Jars are made to be filled with wine!’

“Then tell them, ‘No, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH means: I will fill everyone in this land with drunkenness, from the king sitting on Daud’s throne to the Kuhanym and the Nabyms, right down to the common people of Yahushalam.
I will smash them against each other, even parents against children, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH I will not let my pity or mercy or compassion keep me from destroying them.’”
Listen and pay attention! Do not be arrogant, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken.

Give Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH before it is too late, Acknowledge 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH before He brings darkness upon you, causing you to stumble and fall on the darkening mountains, For then when you look for light, you will find only terrible darkness and gloom.
And if you still refuse to listen, I will weep alone because of your pride, My eyes will overflow with tears, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s flock will be led away into exile.
Say to the king and his mother, “Come down from your thrones and sit in the dust, for your royal crowns will soon be snatched from your heads.”
The towns of the Nagab will close their gates, and no one will be able to open them, the people of Yahudah will be taken away as captives, all will be carried into exile.
Open up your eyes and see the armies marching down from the north! Where is your flock, your beautiful flock, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave you to care for?
What will you say when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH takes the allies you have cultivated and appoints them as your rulers? Pangs of anguish will grip you, like those of a woman in labor!
You may ask yourself, “Why is all this happening to me?” It is because of your many sins! That is why you have been stripped and raped by invading armies.
Can an Athiupian change the color of his skin? Can a leopard take away its spots Neither can you start doing good, for you have always done evil.
“I will scatter you like chaff that is blown away by the desert winds.
This is your allotment, the portion I have assigned to you,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “for you have forgotten me, putting your trust in false idol deities.
I myself will strip you and expose you to shame.
I have seen your adultery and lust, and your disgusting idol worship out in the fields and on the hills, What sorrow awaits you, Yahushalam, How long before you are pure?”
This message came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, explaining why He was holding back the rain:
“Yahudah languish; commerce at the city gates grinds to a halt, all the people sit on the ground in mourning, and a great cry rises from Yahushalam.
The nobles send servants to get water, but all the wells are dry, the servants return with empty pitchers, confused and desperate, covering their heads in grief.
The ground is parched and cracked for lack of rain, the farmers are deeply troubled; they, too, cover their heads.
Even the deer abandons her newborn fawn because there is no grass in the field.
The wild donkeys stand on the bare hills panting like thirsty jackals, they strain their eyes looking for grass, but there is none to be found.”
The people say, “Our wickedness has caught up with us, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH help us for the sake of your own reputation, We have turned away from you and sinned against you again and again.
O Hope of Yashar'AL, our Savior in times of trouble, why are you like a stranger to us? why are you like a traveler passing through the land, stopping only for the night?
Are you also confused? Is our champion helpless to save us? You are right here among us, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH We are known as your people, Please do not abandon us now!”

So this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to His people: “You love to wander far from me and do not restrain yourselves, therefore, I will no longer accept you as my people, Now I will remember all your wickedness and will punish you for your sins.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Do not pray for these people anymore.
When they fast, I will pay no attention. When they present their burnt offerings and grain offerings to me, I will not accept them. Instead, I will devour them with war, famine, and disease.”
Then I said, “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, their prophets are telling them, ‘all is well, no war or famine will come. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will surely send you Shalum.’”

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “These prophets are telling lies in my Name, I did not send them or tell them to speak, I did not give them any messages, They prophesy of visions and revelations they have never seen or heard, they speak foolishness made up in their own lying hearts.

Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will punish these lying prophets, for they have spoken in my Name even though I never sent them. They say that no war or famine will come, but they themselves will die by war and famine!

As for the people to whom they prophesy, their bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Yahushalam as victims of famine and war, there will be no one left to bury them, husbands, wives, sons, and daughters, all will be gone, For I will pour out their own wickedness on them.
Now, Yaramyahu, say this to them: “Night and day my eyes overflow with tears. I cannot stop weeping, for my virgin daughter, my precious people has been struck down and lies mortally wounded.

If I go out into the fields, I see the bodies of people slaughtered by the enemy, If I walk the city streets, I see people who have died of starvation, the prophets and priests continue with their work, but they do not know what they are doing.”

O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have you completely rejected Yahudah? Do you really hate Yahushalam? Why have you wounded us past all hope of healing? We hoped for Shalum, but no Shalum came, We hoped for a time of healing, but found only terror.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, we confess our wickedness and that of our ancestors. We all have sinned against you.
For the sake of your reputation, do not abandon us, Do not dishonor your own Esteemed throne, Please remember us O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and do not break your covenant with us.

Can any of the worthless foreign idols send us rain? Does it fall from the sky by itself? No, you are the one, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! Only you can do such things, So we will wait for you to help us.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Even if Musha and Shamual stood before me pleading for these people, I will not help them, away with them! Get them out of my sight!

And if they say to you, ‘But where can we go?’ tell them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘Those who are destined for death, will die; those who are destined for war, will go to war; those who are destined for famine, will stay in famine; those who are destined for captivity, will be in captivity.’
“I will send four kinds of destroyers against them,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. “I will send the sword to kill, the dogs to drag away, the vultures to devour, and the wild animals to finish up what is left.
Because of the wicked things Manassah son of Hazakyahu king of Yahudah did in Yahushalam, I will make my people an object of horror to all the kingdoms of the Arath.
“Who will feel sorry for you, Yahushalam? Who will weep for you? Who will even bother to ask how you are?
You have abandoned me and turned your back on me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Therefore I will raise my fist to destroy you, I Am tired of always giving you another chance.
I will winnow you like grain at the gates of your cities and take away the children you hold dear, I will destroy my own people, because they refuse to change their evil ways.
There will be more widows than the grains of sand on the seashore, at noontime I will bring a destroyer against the mothers of young men, I will cause anguish and terror to come upon them suddenly.

The mother of seven grows faint and gasps for breath; her sun has gone down while it is still day, she sits childless now, shame and humiliated, and I will hand over those who are left to be killed by the enemy, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”

Then I said, “What sorrow is mine, my mother, Oh, that I had died at birth! I am hated everywhere I go, I am neither a lender who threatens to foreclose nor a borrower who refuses to pay, yet they all curse me.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH replied, “I will take care of you Yaramyahu, Your enemies will ask you to plead on their behalf in times of trouble and distress.
Can a man break a bar of iron from the north, or a bar of bronze?
At no cost to them, I will hand over your wealth and treasures as plunder to your enemies, for sin runs rampant in your land.
I will tell your enemies to take you as captives to a foreign land, for My anger blazes like a fire that will burn forever.”
Then I said, “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you know what’s happening to me, Please step in and help me Punish my persecutors! Please give me time; do not let me die young, It is for your sake that I am suffering.
When I discovered your Dabar, I devoured them, they are my joy and my heart’s delight, for I bear your Name, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
I never joined the people in their merry feasts, I sat alone because your hand was on me, I was filled with indignation at their sins.
Why then does my suffering continue? Why is my wound so incurable? Your help seems as uncertain as a seasonal brook, like a spring that has gone dry.”

This is how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH responds: “If you return to me, I will restore you so you can continue to serve me, If you speak good words rather than worthless ones, you will be my spokesman, you must influence them; do not let them influence you!
