They will fight against you like an attacking army, but I will make you as secure as a fortified wall of bronze, they will not conquer you, for I am with you to protect and rescue you, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have spoken!
Yes, I will certainly keep you safe from these wicked men, I will rescue you from their cruel hands.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me another message, He said,
“Do not get married or have children in this place.
For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar about the children born here in this city and about their mothers and fathers:

They will die from terrible diseases, No one will mourn for them or bury them, and they will lie scattered on the ground like manure. They will die from war and famine, and their bodies will be food for the vultures and wild animals.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Do not go to funerals to mourn and show sympathy for these people, for I have removed my protection and Shalum from them, I have taken away my unfailing love and my mercy.
Both the great and the lowly will die in this land, No one will bury them or mourn for them, their friends will not cut themselves in sorrow or shave their heads in sadness.
No one will offer a meal to comfort those who mourn for the dead, not even at the death of a mother or father. No one will send a cup of wine to console them.
“And do not go to their feasts and parties. Do not eat and drink with them at all.

For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: In your own lifetime, before your very eyes, I will put an end to the happy singing and laughter in this land, The joyful voices of bridegrooms and brides will no longer be heard.

“When you tell the people all these things, they will ask, ‘Why has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH decreed such terrible things against us? What have we done to deserve such treatment? What is our sin against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH?’
“Then you will give them 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s reply: ‘It is because your ancestors were unfaithful to me, They worshiped other nations idols and served them, they abandoned me and did not obey my Dabar.
And you are even worse than your ancestors! You stubbornly follow your own evil desires and refuse to listen to me.
So I will throw you out of this land and send you into a foreign land where you and your ancestors have never been, There you can worship idols day and night, and I will grant you no favors!’
“But the time is coming,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “when people who are taking an oath will no longer say, ‘As surely as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives, who rescued the people of Yashar'AL from the land of Mitzraym.’

Instead, they will say, ‘As surely as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives, who brought the people of Yashar'AL back to their own land from the land of the north and from all the countries to which he had exiled them.’ For I will bring them back to this land that I gave their ancestors.
“But now I am sending for many fishermen who will catch them,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I Am sending for hunters who will hunt them down in the mountains, hills, and caves.
I Am watching them closely, and I see every sin. They cannot hope to hide from me.
I will double their punishment for all their sins, because they have defiled my land with lifeless images of their detestable deities and have filled my territory with their evil deeds.”

O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you are my strength and fortress, my refuge in the day of trouble! Nations from around the world will come to You and say, “Our ancestors left us a foolish heritage, for they worshiped worthless idols.
Can people make their own mighty ones? These are not real mighty ones at all!”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, Now I will show them my power; now I will show them my Might, at last they will know and understand that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“The sin of Yahudah is inscribed with an iron chisel, engraved with a diamond point on their stony hearts and on the corners of their altars.
Even their children go to worship at their pagan altars and Asharah poles, beneath every green tree and on every high hill.
So I will hand over my Qadash mountain, along with all your wealth and treasures and your pagan shrines as plunder to your enemies, for sin runs rampant in your land.

The wonderful possession I have reserved for you will slip from your hands, I will tell your enemies to take you as captives to a foreign land, for My anger blazes like a fire that will burn forever.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Cursed are those who put their trust in mere man, who rely on man's strength and turn their hearts away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
They are like stunted shrubs in the desert, with no hope for the future, they will live in the barren wilderness, in an uninhabited salty land.
“But baraked are those who trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and have made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their hope and confidence.

They are like trees planted along a riverbank, with roots that reach deep into the water, Such trees are not bothered by the heat or worried by long months of drought, Their leaves stay green, and they never stop producing fruit.
“The heart of man is the most deceitful of all things, and desperately wicked, Who really knows how bad it is?
But I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH search all hearts and examine secret motives, I give all men their due rewards, according to what their actions deserve.”
Like a partridge that hatches eggs she has not laid, so are those who get their wealth by unjust means, at midlife they will lose their riches; in the end, they will become poor old fools.
But we worship at your throne, eternal, high, and Esteemed!
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the hope of Yashar'AL, all who turn away from you will be put to shame, They will be buried in the dust of the Arath, for they have abandoned 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the fountain of living water.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, if you heal me, I will be truly healed; if you save me, I will be truly saved, My Yadah are for you alone!
People scoff at me and say, “What is this ‘message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH you talk about? Why do your predictions not come true?”
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I have not abandoned my job as a shepherd for your people, I have not urged you to send disaster, You have heard everything I have said.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, do not terrorize me! You alone are my hope in the day of disaster.
Bring shame and dismay on all who persecute me, but do not let me experience shame and dismay, Bring a day of terror on them, Yes, bring double destruction upon them!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me: “Go and stand in the gates of Yahushalam, first in the gate where the king goes in and out, and then in each of the other gates.
Say to all the people, ‘Listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you kings of Yahudah and all you people of Yahudah and everyone living in Yahushalam.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, Listen to my warning! Stop carrying on your trade at Yahushalam’s gates on the Shabbat day.
Do not do your work on the Shabbat, but make it a Qadash (Set Apart) day, I gave this command to your ancestors,
but they did not listen or obey, They stubbornly refused to pay attention or accept my discipline.
‘But if you obey me, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and do not carry on your trade at the gates or work on the Shabbat day, and if you keep it Qadash,

then kings and their officials will go in and out of these gates forever, There will always be a descendant of Daud sitting on the throne here in Yahushalam. Kings and their officials will always ride in and out among the people of Yahudah in chariots and on horses, and this city will remain forever.

And from all around Yahushalam, from the towns of Yahudah and Banyamin, from the western foothills and the hill country and the Nagab, the people will come with their burnt offerings and sacrifices. They will bring their grain offerings, frankincense, and thanksgiving offerings to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple.

“‘But if you do not listen to me and refuse to keep the Shabbat Qadash, and if on the Shabbat day you bring loads of merchandise through the gates of Yahushalam just as on other days, then I will set fire to these gates. The fire will spread to the palaces, and no one will be able to put out the roaring flames.’”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave another message to Yaramyahu, He said,
“Go down to the potter’s shop, and I will speak to you there.”
So I did as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH told me and found the potter working at his wheel.
But the jar he was making did not turn out as he had hoped, so he crushed it into a lump of clay again and started over.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me this message:
“O Yashar'AL, can I not do to you as this potter has done to his clay? As the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand.
If I announce that a certain nation or kingdom is to be uprooted, torn down, and destroyed,
but then that nation renounces its evil ways, I will not destroy it as I had planned.
And if I announce that I will plant and build up a certain nation or kingdom,
but then that nation turns to evil and refuses to obey me, I will not barak it as I said I would.

“Therefore, Yaramyahu, go and warn all Yahudah and Yahushalam. Say to them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I am planning disaster for you instead of good. So turn from your evil ways, each of you, and do what is right.’”
But the people replied, “Do not waste your breath. We will continue to live as we want to, stubbornly following our own evil desires.”
So this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Has anyone ever heard of such a thing, even among the pagan nations? My virgin daughter Yashar'AL has done something terrible!
Does the snow ever disappear from the mountaintops of Labanun? Do the cold streams flowing from those distant mountains ever run dry?
But my people are not so reliable, for they have deserted me; they burn incense to worthless idols, they have stumbled off the ancient highways and walk in muddy paths.
Therefore, their land will become desolate, a monument to their stupidity, all who pass by will be astonished and will shake their heads in amazement.
I will scatter my people before their enemies as the east wind scatters dust, and in all their trouble I will turn my back on them and refuse to notice their distress.”

Then the people said, “Come on, let’s plot a way to stop Yaramyahu, We have plenty of Kuhanym and wise men and Nabym, We do not need him to teach the word and give us advice and prophecies, Let us spread rumors about him and ignore what he says.”
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, hear me and help me! Listen to what my enemies are saying.
Should they repay evil for good? They have dug a pit to kill me, though I pleaded for them and tried to protect them from your anger.
So let their children starve! Let them die by the sword! Let their wives become childless widows, Let their old men die in a plague, and let their young men be killed in battle!
Let screaming be heard from their homes as warriors come suddenly upon them, For they have dug a pit for me and have hidden traps along my path.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you know all about their murderous plots against me, Do not forgive their crimes and blot out their sins, Let them die before you, Deal with them in your anger.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me: “Go and buy a clay jar, Then ask some of the leaders of the people and of the Kuhanym to follow you.
Go out through the Gate of Broken Pots to the garbage dump in the valley of Ban-Hinnum, and give them this message.

Say to them, ‘Listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you kings of Yahudah and citizens of Yahushalam! This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL says: I will bring a terrible disaster on this place, and the ears of those who hear about it will ring!

‘For Yashar'AL has forsaken me and turned this valley into a place of wickedness, the people burn incense to foreign nations idols, never before acknowledged by this generation, by their ancestors, or by the kings of Yahudah, and they have filled this place with the blood of innocent children.
They have built pagan shrines to Baal, and there they burn their sons as sacrifices to Baal, I have never commanded such a horrible deed; it never even crossed my mind to command such a thing!
So beware, for the time is coming, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, when this garbage dump will no longer be called Topheth or the valley of Ban-Hinnum, but the Valley of Slaughter.

‘For I will upset the careful plans of Yahudah and Yahushalam, I will allow the people to be slaughtered by invading armies, and I will leave their dead bodies as food for the vultures and wild animals.
I will reduce Yahushalam to ruins, making it a monument to their stupidity, all who pass by will be astonished and will gasp at the destruction they see there.

I will see to it that your enemies lay siege to the city until all the food is gone, then those trapped inside will eat their own sons and daughters and friends, they will be driven to utter despair.’
“As these men watch you, Yaramyahu, smash the jar you brought.

Then say to them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: As this jar lies shattered, so I will shatter the people of Yahudah and Yahushalam beyond all hope of repair, They will bury the bodies here in Tuphath, the garbage dump, until there is no more room for them.
This is what I will do to this place and its people, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will cause this city to become defiled like Tuphath.

Yes, all the houses in Yahushalam, including the palace of Yahudah’s kings, will become like Tuphath, all the houses where you burned incense on the rooftops to your star idols, and where liquid offerings were poured out to your idols.’”
Then Yaramyahu returned from Tuphath, the garbage dump where he had delivered this message, and he stopped in front of the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, he said to the people there,

“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar to them: ‘I will bring disaster upon this city and its surrounding towns as I promised, because you have stubbornly refused to listen to me.’”
Now Pashhur son of Immar, the Kuhan in charge of the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, heard what Yaramyahu was prophesying.
So he arrested Yaramyahu the Nabym and had him whipped and put in stocks at the Banyamin Gate of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple.
The next day, when Pashhur finally released him, Yaramyahu said, “Pashhur, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has changed your name, From now on you are to be called ‘The Man Who Lives in Terror.’

For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘I will send terror upon you and all your friends, and you will watch as they are slaughtered by the swords of the enemy, I will hand the people of Yahudah over to the king of Babylun, he will take them captive to Babylun or run them through with the sword.
And I will let your enemies plunder Yahushalam, all the famed treasures of the city, the precious jewels and gold and silver of your kings, will be carried off to Babylun.
As for you, Pashhur, you and all your household will go as captives to Babylun. There you will die and be buried, you and all your friends to whom you prophesied that everything would be all right.’”
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you misled me, and I allowed myself to be misled, You are stronger than I am, and you overpowered me, now I am mocked every day; everyone laughs at me.
When I speak, the words burst out, “Violence and destruction!” I shout, so these messages from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have made me a household joke.

But if I say I will never mention, or speak in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, then the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will burns in my heart like a fire, It is like a fire in my bones! I am worn out trying to hold it in! I cannot do it!

I have heard the many rumors about me. They call me “The Man Who Lives in terror, they threaten, “If you say anything, we will report it.” Even my old friends are watching me, waiting for a fatal slip, “he will trap himself,” they say, “and then we will get our revenge on him.”

But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH stands beside me like a great warrior, Before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my persecutors will stumble, they cannot defeat me, they will fail and be thoroughly humiliated. their dishonor will never be forgotten.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, You test those who are righteous, and you examine the deepest thoughts and secrets, let me see your vengeance against them, for I have committed my cause to you.
Sing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! For though I was poor and needy, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rescued me from my oppressors.
Yet I curse the day I was born! May no one celebrate the day of my birth.
I curse the messenger who told my father, “Good news, you have a son!”
Let him be destroyed like the cities of old that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH overthrew without mercy, terrify him all day long with battle shouts,
because he did not kill me at birth, Oh, that I had died in my mother’s womb, that her body had been my grave!
Why was I ever born? My entire life has been filled with trouble, sorrow, and shame
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke through Yaramyahu when King Zadakyahu sent Pashhur son of Malkyahu and ZaphanYahu son of Maasayahu, the Kuhan, to speak with him. They begged Yaramyahu,

“Please speak to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for us and ask him to help us, King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun is attacking Yahudah, Perhaps 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be merciful and do a mighty miracle as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done in the past. Perhaps 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will force Nabuchadnazzar to withdraw his armies.”
Yaramyahu replied, “Go back to King Zadakyahu and tell him,

‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar to him: I will make your weapons useless against the king of Babylun and the Babylunians who are outside your walls attacking you, In fact, I will bring your enemies right into the heart of this city.
I myself will fight against you with a strong hand and a powerful arm, for I am very angry, you have made me furious!
I will send a terrible plague upon this city, and both people and animals will die.

And after all that, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will hand over King Zadakyahu, his staff, and everyone else in the city who survives the disease, war, and famine. I will hand them over to King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun and to their other enemies he will slaughter them and show them no mercy, pity, or compassion.’
“Tell all the people, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to them: Take your choice of life or death!
Everyone who stays in Yahushalam will die from war, famine, or disease, but those who go out and surrender to the Babylunians will live, Their reward will be life!
For I have decided to bring disaster and not good upon this city, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, It will be handed over to the king of Babylun, and he will reduce it to ashes.’
“Say to the royal family of Yahudah, ‘Listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to the dynasty of Daud: “Give justice each morning to the people you judge! Help those who have been robbed; rescue them from their oppressors, otherwise, my anger will burn like an unquenchable fire because of all your sins.
I will personally fight against the people in Yahushalam, that mighty fortress, the people who boast, “No one can touch us here, No one can break in here.”
And I Myself will punish you for your sinfulness, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will light a fire in your forests that will burn up everything around you.’”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me: “Go over and speak directly to the king of Yahudah. Say to him,
‘Listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you king of Yahudah, sitting on Daud’s throne. Let your attendants and your people listen, too.

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Be fair-minded and just. Do what is right! Help those who have been robbed; rescue them from their oppressors. Quit your evil deeds! Do not mistreat foreigners, orphans, and widows, Stop murdering the innocent!

If you obey me, there will always be a descendant of Daud sitting on the throne here in Yahushalam, the king will ride through the palace gates in chariots and on horses, with his parade of attendants and subjects.
But if you refuse to pay attention to this warning, I swear by my own Name, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that this palace will become a pile of rubble.’”

Now this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar concerning Yahudah’s royal palace: “I love you as much as fruitful Gilead and the green forests of Labanun, But I will turn you into a desert, with no one living within your walls.
I will call for wreckers, who will bring out their tools to dismantle you, they will tear out all your fine cedar beams and throw them on the fire.
“People from many nations will pass by the ruins of this city and say to one another, ‘Why did 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroy such a great city?
And the answer will be, ‘Because they violated their covenant with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH by worshiping other nations idols.’”
Do not weep for the dead king or mourn his loss, Instead, weep for the captive king being led away! For he will never return to see his native land again.
For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar about Yahuahaz, who succeeded his father, King Yusyahu, and was taken away as a captive: “He will never return.
He will die in a distant land and will never again see his own country.”

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “What sorrow awaits Yahuiakim, who builds his palace with forced labor, he builds injustice into its walls, for he makes his neighbors work for nothing, he does not pay them for their labor.
He says, ‘I will build a magnificent palace with huge rooms and many windows, I will panel it throughout with fragrant cedar and paint it a lovely red.’
But a beautiful cedar palace does not make a great king! Your father, Yusyahu, also had plenty to eat and drink, but he was just and right in all his dealings, that is why 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH baraked him.
He gave justice and help to the poor and needy, and everything went well for him, is that not what it means to know me?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“But you! You have eyes only for greed and dishonesty! you murder the innocent, oppress the poor, and reign ruthlessly.”

Therefore this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar about Yahuiakim, son of King Yusyahu: “The people will not mourn for him, crying to one another, ‘Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister! ’his subjects will not mourn for him, crying, ‘Alas, our master is dead! Alas, his splendor is gone!’
He will be buried like a dead donkey, dragged out of Yahushalam and dumped outside the gates!
Weep for your allies in Labanun, Shout for them in Bashan, search for them in the regions east of the river, See, they are all destroyed, Not one is left to help you.
I warned you when you were prosperous, but you replied, ‘Do not bother me, ’You have been that way since childhood, you simply will not obey me!
And now the wind will blow away your allies, All your friends will be taken away as captives, Surely then you will see your wickedness and be ashamed.
It may be nice to live in a beautiful palace paneled with wood from the cedars of Labanun, but soon you will groan with pangs of anguish, anguish like that of a woman in labor.
“As surely as I live,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I will abandon you, Yahuiachin son of Yahuiakim, king of Yahudah. Even if you were the signet ring on my right hand, I would pull you off.
I will hand you over to those who seek to kill you, those you so desperately fear, to King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun and the mighty Babylunian army.
I will expel you and your mother from this land, and you will die in a foreign country, not in your native land.
You will never again return to the land you yearn for.
“Why is this man Yahuiachin like a discarded, broken jar? Why is he and his children to be exiled to a foreign land?
O Arath, Arath, Arath! Listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, Let the record show that this man Yahuiachin was childless, he is a failure, for none of his children will succeed him on the throne of Daud to rule over Yahudah.’
“What sorrow awaits the leaders of my people, the shepherds of my sheep, for they have destroyed and scattered the very ones they were expected to care for,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar to these shepherds: “Instead of caring for my flock and leading them to safety, you have deserted them and driven them to destruction, Now I will pour out judgment on you for the evil you have done to them.
But I will gather together the remnant of my flock from the countries where I have driven them. I will bring them back to their own sheepfold, and they will be fruitful and increase in number.
Then I will appoint responsible shepherds who will care for them, and they will never be afraid again, Not a single one will be lost or missing. I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!

“For the time is coming,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH “when I will raise up a righteous descendant from King Daud’s line, he will be a King who rules with wisdom, he will do what is just and right throughout the land.
And this will be his name: ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Is Our Righteousness.’ In that day Yahudah will be saved, and Yashar'AL will live in safety.
“In that day,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “when people are taking an oath, they will no longer say, ‘As surely as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives, who rescued the people of Yashar'AL from the land of Mitzraym.’

Instead, they will say, ‘As surely as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives, who brought the people of Yashar'AL back to their own land from the land of the north and from all the countries to which he had exiled them.’ Then they will live in their own land.”
My heart is broken because of the false prophets, and my bones tremble, I stagger like a drunkard, like someone overcome by wine, because of the qadash Dabar 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken against them.
For the land is full of adultery, and it lies under a curse, the land itself is in mourning, its wilderness pastures are dried up, for they all do evil and abuse what power they have.
“Even the Kuhanym and Nabyms are unrighteous, wicked men, I have seen their despicable acts right here in my own Temple,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“Therefore, the paths they take will become slippery, they will be chased through the dark, and there they will fall, For I will bring disaster upon them at the time fixed for their punishment, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“I saw that the prophets of Samaria were terribly evil, for they prophesied in the name of Baal and led my people of Yashar'AL into sin.

But now I see that the prophets of Yahushalam are even worse! They commit adultery and love dishonesty, they encourage those who are doing evil so that no one turns away from their sins, these prophets are as wicked as the people of Sudum and Gumurrah once were.”

Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar concerning the prophets: I will feed them with bitterness and give them poison to drink, for it is because of Yahushalam’s prophets that wickedness has filled this land.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar to his people: “Do not listen to these prophets when they prophesy to you, filling you with futile hopes, they are making up everything they say. They do not speak for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!

They keep saying to those who despise my Dabar (word), ‘Do not worry! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH says you will have Shalum! ’and to those who stubbornly follow their own desires, they say, ‘No harm will come your way!’
“Have any of these prophets been in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s presence to hear what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is really saying? Has even one of them cared enough to listen?
Look! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s anger bursts out like a storm, a whirlwind that swirls down on the heads of the wicked.
The anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not diminish until it has finished all he has planned, In the days to come you will understand all this very clearly.
“I have not sent these prophets, yet they run around claiming to speak for me, I have given them no message, yet they go on prophesying.
If they had stood before me and listened to me, they would have spoken my Dabar, and they would have turned my people from their evil ways and deeds.
Am I an 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who is only close at hand?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “No, I am far away at the same time.
Can anyone hide from me in a secret place? Am I not everywhere in all the Shamaym and Arath?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“I have heard what the prophets have said who prophesy lies in My name, saying, ‘I have dreamed, I have dreamed!’
How long will this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies? Indeed they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart,
who try to make My people forget My name 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, by their dreams which everyone tells his neighbor, as their fathers forgot My name 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for Baal.
“Let these false prophet tell their dreams, but let my true messengers faithfully proclaim my every Dabar, there is a difference between straw and grain!
Does my Dabar not burn like fire?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. “Is it not like a mighty hammer that smashes a rock to pieces?
“Therefore,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I Am against these prophets who steal messages from each other and claim they are from me.
I am against these smooth-tongued prophets who say, ‘This prophecy is from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!’

I am against these false prophets, Their imaginary dreams are flagrant lies that lead my people into sin, I did not send or appoint them, and they have no message at all for my people, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have spoken!
“Suppose one of the people or one of the Nabym or Kuhanym asks you, ‘What prophecy has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH burdened you with now?’ You must reply, ‘You are the burden! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH says He will abandon you!’
“If any Nabym, Kuhanym, or anyone else says, ‘I have a prophecy from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,’ I will punish that person along with his entire family.
You should keep asking each other, ‘What is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s answer?’ or ‘What is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saying?’

But stop using this phrase, ‘prophecy from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’ For people are using it to give authority to their own ideas, turning upside down the Dabar of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, His Name is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
“This is what you should say to the prophets: ‘What is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s answer?’ or ‘What is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saying?’

But suppose they respond, ‘This is a prophecy from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!’ Then you should say, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH says: Because you have used this phrase, prophecy from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,” even though I warned you not to use it,
I will forget you completely, I will expel you from my presence, along with this city that I gave to you and your ancestors.
And I will make you an object of ridicule, and your name will be infamous throughout the ages.’”

After King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylon exiled Yahuiachin son of Yahuiakim, king of Yahudah, to Babylun along with the officials of Yahudah and all the craftsmen and artisans, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me this vision. I saw two baskets of figs placed in front of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple in Yahushalam.
One basket was filled with fresh, ripe figs, while the other was filled with bad figs that were too rotten to eat.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “What do you see, Yaramyahu?” I replied, “Figs, some very good and some very bad, too rotten to eat.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me this message:
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: The good figs represent the exiles I sent from Yahudah to the land of the Babylunians.
I will watch over and care for them, and I will bring them back here again, I will build them up and not tear them down, I will plant them and not uproot them.
I will give them hearts that recognize me as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, They will be my people, and I will be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for they will return to me wholeheartedly.

“But the bad figs,” 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, represent King Zadakyahu of Yahudah, his officials, all the people left in Yahushalam, and those who live in Mitzraym, I will treat them like bad figs, too rotten to eat.
I will make them an object of horror and a symbol of evil to every nation on the Arath, they will be put to shame and mocked, taunted and cursed, wherever I scatter them.
And I will send war, famine, and disease until they have vanished from the land of Yashar'AL, which I gave to them and their ancestors.”

This message for all the people of Yahudah came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH during the fourth year of Yahuiakim’s reign over Yahudah, This was the year when King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun began his reign.
Yaramyahu the Nabym said to all the people in Yahudah and Yahushalam,

“For the past twenty-three years, from the thirteenth year of the reign of Yusyahu son of Amun, king of Yahudah, until now, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has been giving me His messages, I have faithfully passed them on to you, but you have not listened.
“Again and again 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sent you His servants, the Nabyms, but you have not listened or even paid attention.

Each time the message was this: ‘Turn from the evil road you are traveling and from the evil things you are doing, Only then will I let you live in this land that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave to you and your ancestors forever.
Do not provoke my anger by worshiping idols you made with your own hands, Then I will not harm you.’
“But you would not listen to me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “You made me furious by worshiping idols you made with your own hands, bringing on yourselves all the disasters you now suffer.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: Because you have not listened to me,

I will gather together all the armies of the north under King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun, whom I have appointed as my servant, I will bring them all against this land and its people and against the surrounding nations, I will completely destroy you and make you an object of horror and contempt and ruin forever.
I will take away your happy singing and laughter, the joyful voices of bridegrooms and brides will no longer be heard, Your millstones will fall silent, and the lights in your homes will go out.
This entire land will become a desolate wasteland, Yashar'AL and her neighboring lands will serve the king of Babylun for seventy years.

“Then, after the seventy years of captivity are over, I will punish the king of Babylun and his people for their sins, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I will make the country of the Babylunians a wasteland forever.
I will bring upon them all the terrors I have promised in this book, all the penalties announced by Yaramyahu against the nations.
Many nations and great kings will enslave the Babylunians, just as they enslaved my people, I will punish them in proportion to the suffering they cause my people.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar to me: “Take from my hand this cup filled to the brim with my anger, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink from it.
When they drink from it, they will stagger, crazed by the warfare I will send against them.”
So I took the cup of anger from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and made all the nations drink from it, every nation to which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent me.

I went to Yahushalam and the other towns of Yahudah, and their kings and officials drank from the cup, From that day until this, they have been a desolate ruin, an object of horror, contempt, and cursing.
I gave the cup to Phar'uh, king of Mitzraym, his attendants, his officials, and all his people,
along with all the foreigners living in that land, I also gave it to all the kings of the land of Uz and the kings of the Philistine cities of Ashkalun, Gaza, Akrun, and what remains of Ashdud.
Then I gave the cup to the nations of Adum, Muab, and Ammun,
and the kings of Tyra and Sidun, and the kings of the regions across the sea.
I gave it to Dadan, Tama, and Buz, and to the people who live in distant places.
I gave it to the kings of Arabia, the kings of the nomadic tribes of the desert,
and to the kings of Zimri, Alam, and Madia.

And I gave it to the kings of the northern countries, far and near, one after the other, all the kingdoms of the world, And finally, the king of Babylun himself drank from the cup of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s anger.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Now tell them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, Dabar: Drink from this cup of my anger. Get drunk and vomit; fall to rise no more, for I am sending terrible wars against you.’
And if they refuse to accept the cup, tell them, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: You have no choice but to drink from it.

I have begun to punish Yahushalam, the city that bears my Name, now should I let you go unpunished? No, you will not escape disaster, I will call for war against all the nations of the Arath, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut have spoken!’

“Now prophesy all these things, and say to them, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will roar against his own land from his Qadash dwelling in Shamaym, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will shout like those who tread grapes; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will shout against everyone on Arath.

The shout of judgment will reach the ends of the Arath, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bring His case against all the nations, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge all the people of the Arath, slaughtering the wicked with the sword, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar, Look! Disaster will fall upon nation after nation! a great whirlwind of fury is rising from the most distant corners of the Arath!”

In that day those 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has slaughtered will fill the Arath from one end to the other, no one will mourn for them or gather up their bodies to bury them, they will be scattered on the ground like manure.
Weep and moan, you evil shepherds! Roll in the dust, you leaders of the flock! The time of your slaughter has arrived, you will fall and shatter like a fragile vase.
You will find no place to hide; there will be no way to escape.
Listen to the frantic cries of the shepherds, the leaders of the flock are wailing in despair, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is ruining their pastures.
Shalum meadows will be turned into a wasteland by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s fierce anger.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has left His den like a strong lion seeking its prey, and their land will be made desolate by the sword of the enemy and the fierce and of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This message came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH early in the reign of Yahuiakim son of Yusyahu, king of Yahudah.

“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Stand in the courtyard in front of the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and make an announcement to the people who have come there to worship from all over Yahudah, give them my entire message; include every word.
Perhaps they will listen and turn from their evil ways, then I will change my mind about the disaster I am ready to pour out on them because of their sins.
“Say to them, ‘this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: If you will not listen to me and obey My Dabar that I have given you,
and if you will not listen to my servants, the Nabym, for I sent them again and again to warn you, but you would not listen to them
then I will destroy this Temple as I destroyed Shiluh, the place where the Tabernacle was located, and I will make Yahushalam an object of cursing in every nation on the Arath.’”
The Kuhanym, the Nabym, and all the people listened to Yaramyahu as he spoke in front of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple.
But when Yaramyahu had finished his message, saying everything 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had told him to say, the Kuhanym and Nabyms and all the people at the Temple mobbed him. “Kill him!” they shouted.

“What right do you have to prophesy in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s name that this Temple will be destroyed like Shiluh? What do you mean, saying that Yahushalam will be destroyed and left with no inhabitants?” and all the people threatened him as he stood in front of the Temple.
When the officials of Yahudah heard what was happening, they rushed over from the palace and sat down at the New Gate of the Temple to hold court.

The Kuhanym and Nabyms presented their accusations to the officials and the people. “this man should die!” they said. “You have heard with your own ears what a traitor he is, for he has prophesied against this city.”

Then Yaramyahu spoke to the officials and the people in his own defense, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent me to prophesy against this Temple and this city,” he said, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me every word that I have spoken.
But if you stop your sinning and begin to obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, He will change His mind about this disaster that He has announced against you.
As for me, I am in your hands, do with me as you think best.

But if you kill me, rest assured that you will be killing an innocent man! The responsibility for such a deed will lie on you, on this city, and on every person living in it, for it is absolutely true that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent me to speak every word you have heard.”
Then the officials and the people said to the Kuhanym and Nabyms, “This man does not deserve the death sentence, for he has spoken to us in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.”
Then some of the wise old men stood and spoke to all the people assembled there.

They said, “Remember when Micah of Murashath prophesied during the reign of King Hazakyahu of Yahudah, he told the people of Yahudah, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar, Mount Ziun will be plowed like an open field; Yahushalam will be reduced to ruins! A thicket will grow on the heights where the Temple now stands.’

But did King Hazakyahu and the people kill him for saying this? No, they turned from their sins and worshiped 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they begged him for mercy, Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH changed His mind about the terrible disaster He had pronounced against them. So we are about to do ourselves great harm.”
At this time Uryahu son of Shemayahu from Kiriath-yaarim was also prophesying for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and he predicted the same terrible disaster against the city and nation as Yaramyahu did.
When King Yahuiakim and the army officers and officials heard what he was saying, the king sent someone to kill him, but Uryahu heard about the plan and escaped in fear to Mitzraym.
Then King Yahuiakim sent Alnathan son of Acbur to Mitzraym along with several other men to capture Uryahu.
They took him prisoner and brought him back to King Yahuiakim, the king then killed Uryahu with a sword and had him buried in an unmarked grave.
Nevertheless, Ahikam son of Shaphan stood up for Yaramyahu and persuaded the court not to turn him over to the mob to be killed.
This message came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH early in the reign of Zadakyahu son of Yusyahu, king of Yahudah.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me: “Make a yoke, and fasten it on your neck with leather straps.
Then send messages to the kings of Adum, Muab, Ammun, Tyra, and Sidun through their ambassadors who have come to see King Zadakyahu in Yahushalam.
Give them this message for their masters: ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar:
With my great strength and powerful arm I made the Arath and all its people and every animal, I can give these things of mine to anyone I choose.
Now I will give your countries to King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun, who is my servant, I have put everything, even the wild animals, under his control.
All the nations will serve him, his son, and his grandson until his time is up, then many nations and great kings will conquer and rule over Babylun.

So you must submit to Babylun’s king and serve him; put your neck under Babylun’s yoke! I will punish any nation that refuses to be his slave, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I will send war, famine, and disease upon that nation until Babylun has conquered it.
“‘Do not listen to your false prophets, fortune-tellers, interpreters of dreams, mediums, and sorcerers who say, “The king of Babylun will not conquer you.”
They are all liars, and their lies will lead to your being driven out of your land, I will drive you out and send you far away to die.
But the people of any nation that submits to the king of Babylun will be allowed to stay in their own country to farm the land as usual. I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!’”
Then I repeated this same message to King Zadakyahu of Yahudah. “If you want to live, submit to the yoke of the king of Babylun and his people.
Why do you insist on dying, you and your people? Why should you choose war, famine, and disease, which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bring against every nation that refuses to submit to Babylun’s king?
Do not listen to the false prophets who keep telling you, ‘the king of Babylun will not conquer you.’ they are liars.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘I have not sent these prophets! They are telling you lies in my Name, so I will drive you from this land, you will all die, you and all these prophets, too.’”

Then I spoke to the Kuhanym and the people and said, “This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘do not listen to your prophets who claim that soon the gold articles taken from my Temple will be returned from Babylun, It is all a lie!
Do not listen to them. Surrender to the king of Babylun, and you will live, why should this whole city be destroyed?

If they really are Nabyms and speak 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s messages, let them pray to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, Let them pray that the articles remaining in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple and in the king’s palace and in the palaces of Yahushalam will not be carried away to Babylun!’
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut has spoken about the pillars in front of the Temple, the great bronze basin called the Sea, the water carts, and all the other ceremonial articles.
King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun left them here when he exiled Yahuiachin son of Yahuiakim, king of Yahudah, to Babylun, along with all the other nobles of Yahudah and Yahushalam.
Yes, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar about the precious things still in the Temple, in the palace of Yahudah’s king, and in Yahushalam:
‘They will all be carried away to Babylun and will stay there until I send for them,’ says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, ‘then I will bring them back to Yahushalam again.’”

One day in late summer of that same year, the fourth year of the reign of Zadakyahu, king of Yahudah, Hananyahu son of Azzur, a Nabym from Gibaun, addressed me publicly in the Temple while all the Kuhanym and people listened, he said,
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: ‘I will remove the yoke of the king of Babylun from your necks.
Within two years I will bring back all the Temple treasures that King Nabuchadnazzar carried off to Babylun.

And I will bring back Yahuiachin son of Yahuiakim, king of Yahudah, and all the other captives that were taken to Babylun, I will surely break the yoke that the king of Babylun has put on your necks, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!’”
Yaramyahu responded to Hananyahu as they stood in front of all the Kuhanym and people at the Temple.
He said, “So be it! May your prophecies come true! I hope 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does everything you say, I hope he does bring back from Babylun the treasures of this Temple and all the captives.
But listen now to the solemn words I speak to you in the presence of all these people.
The ancient Nabyms who preceded you and me spoke against many nations, always warning of war, disaster, and disease.
So a Nabym who predicts Shalum must show he is right, Only when his predictions come true can we know that he is really from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Then Hananyahu the Nabym took the yoke off Yaramyahu’s neck and broke it in pieces.

And Hananyahu said again to the crowd that had gathered, “This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘Just as this yoke has been broken, within two years I will break the yoke of oppression from all the nations now subject to King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun,” With that, Yaramyahu left the Temple area.
Soon after this confrontation with Hananyahu, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave this message to Yaramyahu:
“Go and tell Hananyahu, ‘this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: you have broken a wooden yoke, but you have replaced it with a yoke of iron.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: I have put a yoke of iron on the necks of all these nations, forcing them into slavery under King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun, I have put everything, even the wild animals, under his control.’”
Then Yaramyahu the Nabym said to Hananyahu, “Listen, Hananyahu! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not sent you, but the people believe your lies.
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘You must die, Your life will end this very year because you have rebelled against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’”
Two months later the prophet Hananyahu died.
Yaramyahu wrote a letter from Yahushalam to the elders, Kuhanym, Nabyms, and all the people who had been exiled to Babylun by King Nabuchadnazzar.
This was after King Yahuiachin, the queen mother, the court officials, the other officials of Yahudah, and all the craftsmen and artisans had been deported from Yahushalam.
He sent the letter with Alasah son of Shaphan and Gamaryahu son of Hilkyahu when they went to Babylun as King Zadakyahu’s ambassadors to Nabuchadnazzar, this is what Yaramyahu’s letter said:
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar to all the captives he has exiled to Babylun from Yahushalam:
“Build homes, and plan to stay, plant gardens, and eat the food they produce.
Marry and have children, then find spouses for them so that you may have many grandchildren, Multiply! do not dwindle away!
And work for the Shalum and prosperity of the city where I sent you into exile, Pray to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for it, for its welfare will determine your welfare.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: “do not let your Nabyms and fortune-tellers who are with you in the land of Babylun trick you, do not listen to their dreams,
because they are telling you lies in my Name, I have not sent them,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “You will be in Babylun for seventy years, But then I will come and do for you all the good things I have promised, and I will bring you home again.
For I know the plans I have for you,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “They are plans for good and not for disaster, to give you a future and a hope.
In those days when you pray, I will listen.
If you look for me wholeheartedly, you will find me.
I will be found by you, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I will end your captivity and restore your fortunes, I will gather you out of the nations where I sent you and will bring you home again to your own land.”
You claim that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has raised up Nabyms for you in Babylun.
But this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar about the king who sits on Daud’s throne and all those still living here in Yahushalam, your relatives who were not exiled to Babylun.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: “I will send war, famine, and disease upon them and make them like bad figs, too rotten to eat.

Yes, I will pursue them with war, famine, and disease, and I will scatter them around the world, In every nation where I send them, I will make them an object of damnation, horror, contempt, and mockery.
For they refuse to listen to me, though I have spoken to them repeatedly through the Nabyms I sent, and you who are in exile have not listened either,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Therefore, listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all you captives there in Babylun.

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar about your Nabym, Ahab son of Kulayahu and Zadakyahu son of Maasayahu, who are telling you lies in my Name: “I will turn them over to Nabuchadnazzar for execution before your eyes.
Their terrible fate will become proverbial, so that the Yahudym exiles will curse someone by saying, ‘May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH make you like Zadakyahu and Ahab, whom the king of Babylun burned alive!’

For these men have done terrible things among my people, they have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives and have lied in my Name, saying things I did not command, I am a witness to this, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent this message to Shamayahu the Nahalamite in Babylun:

“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar, You wrote a letter on your own authority to Zaphanyahu son of Maasayahu, the Kuhan, and you sent copies to the other Kuhanym and people in Yahushalam, You wrote to Zaphanyahu,

“That 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has appointed you to replace Yahuiada as the Kuhan in charge of the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, You are responsible to put into stocks and neck irons any crazy man who claims to be a Nabym.
So why have you done nothing to stop Yaramyahu from Anathuth, who pretends to be a Nabym among you?
Yaramyahu sent a letter here to Babylun, predicting that our captivity will be a long one, he said, ‘Build homes, and plan to stay. Plant gardens, and eat the food they produce.’”
But when Zaphanyahu the Kuhan received Shamayahu’s letter, he took it to Yaramyahu and read it to him.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave this message to Yaramyahu:

“Send an open letter to all the exiles in Babylun, Tell them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar concerning Shamayahu the Nahalamite: Since he has prophesied to you when I did not send him and has tricked you into believing his lies,
I will punish him and his family, None of his descendants will see the good things I will do for my people, for he has incited you to rebel against me, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!’”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave another message to Yaramyahu, he said,
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: Write down for the record everything I have Dabar to you Yaramyahu.

For the time is coming when I will restore the fortunes of my people of Yashar'AL and Yahudah, I will bring them home to this land that I gave to their ancestors, and they will possess it again, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
This is the message 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave concerning Yashar'AL and Yahudah.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “I hear cries of fear; there is terror and no Shalum.
Now let me ask you a question: do men give birth to babies? Then why do they stand there, ashen-faced, hands pressed against their sides like a woman in labor?
In all history there has never been such a time of terror, It will be a time of trouble for my people Yashar'AL, Yet in the end they will be saved!
For in that day,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, “I will break the yoke from their necks and snap their chains, foreigners will no longer be their masters.
For my people will serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and their king descended from Daud, the king I will raise up for them.

“So do not be afraid, Ya'aqub, my servant; do not be dismayed, Yashar'AL says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “For I will bring you home again from distant lands, and your children will return from their exile, Yashar'AL will return to a life of Shalum and quiet, and no one will terrorize them.

For I am with you and will save you, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,“I will completely destroy the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not completely destroy you, I will discipline you, but with justice; I cannot let you go unpunished.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Your injury is incurable, a terrible wound.
There is no one to help you or to bind up your injury, No medicine can heal you.
All your lovers, your allies have left you and do not care about you anymore, I have wounded you cruelly, as though I were your enemy, for your sins are many, and your guilt is great.
Why do you protest your punishment, this wound that has no cure? I have had to punish you because your sins are many and your guilt is great.
“But all who devour you will be devoured, and all your enemies will be sent into exile, all who plunder you will be plundered, and all who attack you will be attacked.
I will give you back your health and heal your wounds,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “For you are called an outcast, Yahushalam for whom no one cares.’”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “When I bring Yashar'AL home again from captivity and restore their fortunes, Yahushalam will be rebuilt on its ruins, and the palace reconstructed as before.
There will be joy and songs of thanksgiving, and I will multiply my people, not diminish them; I will honor them, not despise them.
Their children will prosper as they did long ago, I will establish them as a nation before me, and I will punish anyone who hurts them.
They will have their own ruler again, and he will come from their own people, I will invite him to approach me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH “for who would dare to come unless invited?
You will be my people, and I will be your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.”
Look! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s anger bursts out like a storm, a driving wind that swirls down on the heads of the wicked.
The fierce anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not diminish until it has finished all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has planned, In the days to come you will understand all this.
“In that day,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I will be the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all the families of Yashar'AL, and they will be my people.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Those who survive the coming destruction will find Barakah even in the barren land, for I will give rest to the people of Yashar'AL.”
Long ago 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Yashar'AL: “I have loved you, my people, with an everlasting love, With unfailing love I have drawn you to myself.
I will rebuild you, my virgin Yashar'AL, You will again be happy and dance merrily with your tambourines.
Again you will plant your vineyards on the mountains of Samaria and eat from your own gardens there.
The day will come when watchmen will shout from the hill country of Aphraim, ‘Come, let us go up to Yahushalam to worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.’”
Now this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Sing with joy for Yashar'AL, Shout for the greatest of nations! Shout out with Yadah and joy: ‘Save your people, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the remnant of Yashar'AL!’
For I will bring them from the north and from the distant corners of the Arath, I will not forget the blind and lame, the expectant mothers and women in labor, a great company will return!

Tears of joy will stream down their faces, and I will lead them home with great care, They will walk beside quiet streams and on smooth paths where they will not stumble, For I am Yashar'AL’s ABBA, and Aphraim is my first son.

“Listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you nations of the world; proclaim it in distant coastlands: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who scattered His people, will gather them and watch over them as a shepherd does his flock.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has redeemed Yashar'AL from those too strong for them.

They will come home and sing songs of joy on the heights of Yahushalam, They will be radiant because of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s good gifts, the abundant crops of grain, new wine, and olive oil, and the healthy flocks and herds, their life will be like a watered garden, and all their sorrows will be gone.
The young women will dance for joy, and the men old and young will join in the celebration, I will turn their mourning into joy. I will comfort them and exchange their sorrow for rejoicing.
The Kuhanym will enjoy abundance, and my people will feast on my good gifts, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have spoken!”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “A cry is heard in Ramah, deep anguish and bitter weeping, Rachal weeps for her children, refusing to be comforted, for her children are gone.”
But now this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “do not weep any longer, for I will reward you,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. “Your children will come back to you from the distant land of the enemy.
There is hope for your future,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Your children will come again to their own land.
I have heard Yashar'AL saying,‘You disciplined me severely, like a calf that needs training for the yoke, Turn me again to you and restore me, for you are 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
I turned away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but then I was sorry, I kicked myself for my stupidity! I was thoroughly ashamed of all I did in my younger days.’
“Is not Yashar'AL still my son, my darling child?” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I often have to punish him, but I still love him, That is why I long for him and surely will have mercy on him.
Set up road signs; put up guideposts, Mark well the path by which you came, Come back again, my virgin Yashar'AL return to your towns here.
How long will you wander, my wayward daughter? For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will cause something new to happen, Yashar'AL will embrace her 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: “When I bring them back from captivity, the people of Yahudah and its towns will again say, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH barak you, O righteous home, O Qadash mountain!’
Towns people and farmers and shepherds alike will live together in Shalum and happiness.
For I have given rest to the weary and joy to the sorrowing.”
At this, I woke up and looked around, My sleep had been very sweet.
“The day is coming,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “when I will greatly increase the population and the number of animals here in Yashar'AL and Yahudah.

In the past I deliberately uprooted and tore down this nation, I overthrew it, destroyed it, and brought disaster upon it, But in the future I will just as deliberately plant it and build it up, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“The people will no longer quote this proverb: ‘The parents have eaten sour grapes, but their children’s mouths pucker at the taste.’
All people will die for their own sins, those who eat the sour grapes will be the ones whose mouths will pucker.
The day is coming, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, When I will make a renewed covenant with the people of Yashar'AL and Yahudah.

This covenant will not be like the one I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and brought them out of the land of Mitzraym, they broke that covenant, though I loved them as a husband loves his wife,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“But this is the Renewed covenant I will make with the house of Yashar'AL after those days,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I will put My law and instructions deep in their Mind, and I will write them on their hearts, and I will be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and they will be my people.

And they will not need to teach their neighbors, nor will they need to teach their relatives, saying, ‘You should know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’ For everyone, from the least to the greatest, will know me already,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “and I will forgive their wickedness, and I will never again remember their sins.”

It is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who provides the sun to light the day and the moon and stars to light the night, and who stirs the sea into roaring waves, His name is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut and this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar:
“I Am as likely to reject my people Yashar'AL, as I Am to abolish the laws of nature!”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Just as the Shamaym cannot be measured and the foundations of the Arath cannot be explored, so I will not consider casting them away for the evil they have done, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“The day is coming,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “when all Yahushalam will be rebuilt for me, from the Tower of Hananal to the Corner Gate.
A measuring line will be stretched out over the hill of Garab and across to Guah.

And the entire area, including the graveyard and ash dump in the valley, and all the fields out to the Kidrun Valley on the east as far as the Horse Gate, will be Qadash to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the city will never again be captured or destroyed.”
The following message came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the tenth year of the reign of Zadakyahu, king of Yahudah, this was also the eighteenth year of the reign of King Nabuchadnazzar.
Yahushalam was then under siege from the Babylunian army, and Yaramyahu was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard in the royal palace.
King Zadakyahu had put him there, asking why he kept giving this prophecy: “This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘I am about to hand this city over to the king of Babylun, and he will take it.
King Zadakyahu will be captured by the Babylunians and taken to meet the king of Babylun face to face.
He will take Zadakyahu to Babylun, and I will deal with him there,’ says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, ‘If you fight against the Babylunians, you will never succeed.’”
At that time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent me a message, He said,
“Your cousin Hanamal son of Shallum will come and say to you, ‘Buy my field at Anathuth, by law you have the right to buy it before it is offered to anyone else.’”

Then, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had said he would, my cousin Hanamal came and visited me in the prison, he said, “Please buy my field at Anathuth in the land of Banyamin, by law you have the right to buy it before it is offered to anyone else, so buy it for yourself.” Then I knew that the message I had heard was from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So I bought the field at Anathuth, paying Hanamal seventeen pieces of silver for it.
I signed and sealed the deed of purchase before witnesses, weighed out the silver, and paid him.
Then I took the sealed deed and an unsealed copy of the deed, which contained the terms and conditions of the purchase,

and I handed them to Baruch son of Naryahu and grandson of Maasayahu. I did all this in the presence of my cousin Hanamal, the witnesses who had signed the deed, and all the men of Yahudah who were there in the courtyard of the guardhouse.
Then I said to Baruch as they all listened,
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: ‘Take both this sealed deed and the unsealed copy, and put them into a pottery jar to preserve them for a long time.’
For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: ‘Someday people will again own property here in this land and will buy and sell houses and vineyards and fields.’”
Then after I had given the papers to Baruch, I prayed to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut! You made the Shamaym and the Arath by your strong hand and powerful arm, Nothing is too hard for you!
You show unfailing love to thousands, but you also bring the consequences of one generation’s sin upon the next, You are the great and powerful 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
You have all wisdom and do great and mighty miracles, You see the conduct of all people, and you give them what they deserve.

You performed miraculous signs and wonders in the land of Mitzraym, things still remembered to this day! and You have continued to do great miracles in Yashar'AL and all around the world, You have made your Name famous to this day.
“You brought Yashar'AL out of Mitzraym with mighty signs and wonders, with a strong hand and powerful arm, and with overwhelming terror.
You gave the people of Yashar'AL this land that you had promised their ancestors long before, a land flowing with milk and honey.

Our ancestors came and conquered it and lived in it, but they refused to obey you or follow your Dabar, they have not done anything you commanded, that is why you have sent this terrible disaster upon them.

“See how the siege ramps have been built against the city walls! Through war, famine, and disease, the city will be handed over to the Babylunians, who will conquer it. Everything has happened just as you Dabar.
And yet, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, you have told me to buy the field, paying good money for it before these witnesses, even though the city will soon be handed over to the Babylunians.”
Then this message came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all Life in the world, Is anything too hard for me?
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will hand this city over to the Babylunians and to Nabuchadnazzar, king of Babylun, and he will capture it.

The Babylunians outside the walls will come in and set fire to the city, they will burn down all these houses where the people provoked my anger by burning incense to Baal on the rooftops and by pouring out liquid offerings to other nations idols.
Yashar'AL and Yahudah have done nothing but wrong since their earliest days, They have infuriated me with all their evil deeds,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“From the time this city was built until now, it has done nothing but anger me, so I am determined to get rid of it.
“The sins of Yashar'AL and Yahudah, the sins of the people of Yahushalam, the kings, the officials, the Kuhanym, and the Nabyms, have stirred up my anger.
My people have turned their backs on me and have refused to return, even though I diligently taught them, they would not receive instruction or obey.
They have set up their abominable idols right in my own Temple, defiling it.

They have built pagan shrines to Baal in the valley of Ban-Hinnum, and there they sacrifice their sons and daughters to Mulach. I have never commanded such a horrible deed; it never even crossed my mind to command such a thing. What an incredible evil, causing Yahudah to sin so greatly!

“Now I want to say something more about this city, You have been saying, ‘It will fall to the king of Babylun through war, famine, and disease.’ But this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar:
I will certainly bring my people back again from all the countries where I will scatter them in my fury. I will bring them back to this very city and let them live in Shalum and safety.
They will be my people, and I will be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
And I will give them one heart and one purpose: to worship me forever, for their own good and for the good of all their descendants.
And I will make an everlasting covenant with them: I will never stop doing good for them. I will put a desire in their hearts to worship me, and they will never leave me.
I will find joy doing good for them and will faithfully and wholeheartedly replant them in this land.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Just as I have brought all these calamities on them, so I will do all the good I have promised them.
Fields will again be bought and sold in this land about which you now say, ‘It has been ravaged by the Babylunians, a desolate land where people and animals have all disappeared.’

Yes, fields will once again be bought and sold, deeds signed and sealed and witnessed, in the land of Banyamin and here in Yahushalam, in the towns of Yahudah and in the hill country, in the foothills of Yahudah and in the Nagab too, For someday I will restore prosperity to them, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
While Yaramyahu was still confined in the courtyard of the guard, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave him this second message:
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I Am the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who made the Arath, who formed and established it, whose Name is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
Ask me and I will tell you remarkable secrets you do not know about things to come.

For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: You have torn down the houses of this city and even the king’s palace to get materials to strengthen the walls against the siege ramps and swords of the enemy.

You expect to fight the Babylunians, but the men of this city are already as good as dead, for I have determined to destroy them in my terrible anger. I have abandoned them because of all their wickedness.
“Nevertheless, the time will come when I will heal Yahushalam’s wounds and give it prosperity and true Shalum.
I will restore the fortunes of Yahudah and Yashar'AL and rebuild their towns.
I will cleanse them of their sins against Me and forgive all their sins of rebellion.

Then this city will bring me joy, Kabad, and honor before all the nations of the Arath! The people of the world will see all the good I do for my people, and they will tremble with awe at the Shalum and prosperity I provide for them.

“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: You have said, ‘This is a desolate land where people and animals have all disappeared.’ Yet in the empty streets of Yahushalam and Yahudah, other towns there will be heard once more

the sounds of joy and laughter, The joyful voices of bridegrooms and brides will be heard again, along with the joyous songs of people bringing thanksgiving offerings to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, They will sing, ‘Tudah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good, His faithful love endures forever!’ For I will restore the prosperity of this land to what it was in the past, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: This land though it is now desolate and has no people and animals, will once more have pastures where shepherds can lead their flocks.

Once again shepherds will count their flocks in the towns of the hill country, the foothills of Yahudah, the Nagab, the land of Banyamin, the vicinity of Yahushalam, and all the towns of Yahudah, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“The day will come, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, when I will do for Yashar'AL and Yahudah all the good things I have promised them.
“In those days and at that time I will raise up a righteous descendant from King Daud’s line, he will do what is just and right throughout the land.
In that day Yahudah will be saved, and Yahushalam will live in safety, and this will be its name: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Is Our Righteousness.’
For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Daud will have a descendant sitting on the throne of Yashar'AL forever.
And there will always be Lauym Kuhanym to offer burnt offerings and grain offerings and sacrifices to me.”
Then this message came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: If you can break my covenant with the day and the night so that one does not follow the other,

only then will my covenant with my servant Daud be broken, Only then will he no longer have a descendant to reign on his throne, the same is true for my covenant with the Lauym Kuhanym who minister before me.
And as the stars of the sky cannot be counted and the sand on the seashore cannot be measured, so I will multiply the descendants of my servant Daud and the Lauym Kuhanym who minister before me.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave another message to Yaramyahu, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said,
“Have you noticed what people are saying? ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose Yahudah and Yashar'AL and then abandoned them!’ They are sneering and saying that Yashar'AL is not worthy to be counted as a nation.
But this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I would no more reject my people than I would change my laws that govern night and day, Arath and sky.

I will never abandon the descendants of Ya'aqub or Daud my servant, or change the plan that Daud’s descendants will rule the descendants of Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub, Instead, I will restore them to their land and have mercy on them.”

King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun came with all the armies from the kingdoms he ruled, and he fought against Yahushalam and the towns of Yahudah, at that time this message came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Go to King Zadakyahu of Yahudah, and tell him, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: I am about to hand this city over to the king of Babylun, and he will burn it down.
You will not escape his grasp but will be captured and taken to meet the king of Babylun face to face, Then you will be exiled to Babylun.
“‘But listen to this promise from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, O Zadakyahu, king of Yahudah. This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: You will not be killed in war

but will die in Shalum, People will burn incense in your memory, just as they did for your ancestors, the kings who preceded you. They will mourn for you, crying, “Alas, our master is dead!” This I have decreed, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’”
So Yaramyahu the Nabym delivered the message to King Zadakyahu of Yahudah.
At this time the Babylunian army was besieging Yahushalam, Lachish, and Azakah, the only fortified cities of Yahudah not yet captured.
This message came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH after King Zadakyahu made a covenant with the people, proclaiming freedom for the slaves.
He had ordered all the people to free their Abaryt (Hebrew) slaves both men and women, no one was to keep a fellow Yahudym in bondage.
The officials and all the people had obeyed the king’s command,
but later they changed their minds, they took back the men and women they had freed, forcing them to be slaves again.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave them this message through Yaramyahu:
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: I made a covenant with your ancestors long ago when I rescued them from their slavery in Mitzraym.
I told them that every Abaryt slave must be freed after serving six years, But your ancestors paid no attention to me.
Recently you repented and did what was right, following my command, You freed your slaves and made a solemn covenant with me in the Temple that bears my Name.
But now you have shrugged off your oath and defiled my Name by taking back the men and women you had freed, forcing them to be slaves once again.

“Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Since you have not obeyed me by setting your countrymen free, I will set you free to be destroyed by war, disease, and famine, you will be an object of horror to all the nations of the Arath.
Because you have broken the terms of our covenant, I will cut you apart just as you cut apart the calf when you walked between its halves to solemnize your vows.
Yes, I will cut you apart, whether you are officials of Yahudah or Yahushalam, court officials, Kuhanym, or common people, for you have broken your oath.
I will give you to your enemies, and they will kill you, your bodies will be food for the vultures and wild animals.
“I will hand over King Zadakyahu of Yahudah and his officials to the army of the king of Babylun, and although they have left Yahushalam for a while,

I will call the Babylunian armies back again, they will fight against this city and will capture it and burn it down, I will see to it that all the towns of Yahudah are destroyed, with no one living there.”
This is the message 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave Yaramyahu when Yahuiakim son of Yusyahu was king of Yahudah:
“Go to the settlement where the families of the Racabites live, and invite them to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple, take them into one of the inner rooms, and offer them some wine.”
So I went to see Yaazanyahu son of Yaramyahu and grandson of Habazzinyah and all his brothers and sons representing all the Racabite families.

I took them to the Temple, and we went into the room assigned to the sons of Hanan son of Igdalyahu, a servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, this room was located next to the one used by the Temple officials, directly above the room of Maasayahu son of Shallum, the Temple gatekeeper.
I set cups and jugs of wine before them and invited them to have a drink,
but they refused. “No,” they said, “we do not drink wine, because our ancestor Yahunadab son of Racab gave us this command: ‘you and your descendants must never drink wine.
And do not build houses or plant crops or vineyards, but always live in tents, If you follow these commands, you will live long, good lives in the land.’
So we have obeyed him in all these things. We have never had a drink of wine to this day, nor have our wives, our sons, or our daughters.
We have not built houses or owned vineyards or farms or planted crops.
We have lived in tents and have fully obeyed all the commands of Yahunadab, our ancestor.
But when King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun attacked this country, we were afraid of the Babylunians and Syrians armies, So we decided to move to Yahushalam, that is why we are here.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave this message to Yaramyahu:
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar Go and say to the people in Yahudah and Yahushalam, ‘Come and learn a lesson about how to obey me.
The Racabites do not drink wine to this day because their ancestor Yahunadab told them not to, But I have spoken to you again and again, and you refuse to obey me.

Time after time I sent you Nabyms, who told you, “Turn from your wicked ways, and start doing things right, Stop worshiping other nations idols so that you might live in Shalum here in the land I have given to you and your ancestors.” But you would not listen to me or obey me.
The descendants of Yahunadab son of Racab have obeyed their ancestor completely, but you have refused to listen to me.’

“Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: ‘Because you refuse to listen or answer when I call, I will send upon Yahudah and Yahushalam all the disasters I have pronounced.’”

Then Yaramyahu turned to the Racabites and said, “this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: ‘You have obeyed your ancestor Yahunadab in every respect, following all his instructions.’
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL Dabar: ‘Yahunadab son of Racab will always have descendants who serve me.’”
Now it came to pass in the fourth year of Yahuiakim the son of Yusyahu, king of Yahudah, that this word came to Yaramyahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saying:

“Take a scroll of a book and write on it all the Dabar that I have spoken to you against Yashar'AL, against Yahudah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Yusyahu even to this day.
