for when I brought them into the land I had promised them, they offered sacrifices on every high hill and under every green tree they saw! They roused my fury as they offered up sacrifices to their idols. They brought their perfumes and incense and poured out their liquid offerings to them.
I said to them, ‘What is this high place where you are going?’ (This kind of pagan shrine has been called Bamah—‘high place’—ever since.)

“Therefore, give the people of Yashar'AL this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: Do you plan to pollute yourselves just as your ancestors did? Do you intend to keep prostituting yourselves by worshiping vile images?

For when you offer gifts to them and give your little children to be burned as sacrifices, you continue to pollute yourselves with idols to this day. Should I allow you to ask for a message from me, O people of Yashar'AL? As surely as I live says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will tell you nothing.
“You say, ‘We want to be like the nations all around us, who serve idols of wood and stone.’ But what you have in mind will never happen.
As surely as I live says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will rule over you with an iron fist in great anger and with awesome power.
And in anger I will reach out with my strong hand and powerful arm, and I will bring you back from the lands where you are scattered.
I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, and there I will judge you face to face.
I will judge you there just as I did your ancestors in the wilderness after bringing them out of Mitzraym, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I will examine you carefully and hold you to the terms of the covenant.

I will purge you of all those who rebel and revolt against me. I will bring them out of the countries where they are in exile, but they will never enter the land of Yashar'AL. Then you will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“As for you, O people of Yashar'AL, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Go right ahead and worship your idols, but sooner or later you will obey me and will stop bringing shame on my Qadash Name by worshiping idols.

For on my Qadash mountain, the great mountain of Yashar'AL, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the people of Yashar'AL will someday worship me, and I will accept them. There I will require that you bring Me all your offerings and choice gifts and sacrifices.
When I bring you home from exile, you will be like a pleasing sacrifice to me. And I will display my Qadashym through you as all the nations watch.
Then when I have brought you home to the land I promised with a solemn oath to give to your ancestors, you will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You will look back on all the ways you defiled yourselves and will hate yourselves because of the evil you have done.
You will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, O people of Yashar'AL, when I have honored my Name by treating you mercifully in spite of your wickedness, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, turn and face the south and speak out against it; prophesy against the brushlands of the Nagab.

Tell the southern wilderness, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will set you on fire, and every tree, both green and dry, will be burned. The terrible flames will not be quenched and will scorch everything from south to north.
And everyone in the world will see that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have set this fire, It will not be put out.’”
Then I said, “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they are saying of me, ‘he only talks in riddles!’
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, turn and face Yahushalam and prophesy against Yashar'AL and her sanctuaries.
‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I am your enemy, O Yashar'AL, and I am about to unsheath my sword to destroy your people, the righteous and the wicked alike.
Yes, I will cut off both the righteous and the wicked! I will draw my sword against everyone in the land from south to north.
Everyone in the world will know that I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, My sword is in my hand, and it will not return to its sheath until its work is finished.’
“Son of man, groan before the people! Groan before them with bitter anguish and a broken heart.

When they ask why you are groaning, tell them, ‘I groan because of the terrifying news I have heard. When it comes true, the boldest heart will melt with fear; all strength will disappear. Every spirit will faint; strong knees will become as weak as water. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: It is coming! It is on its way!’”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me,
“Son of man, give the people this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “A sword is being sharpened and polished.
It is sharpened for terrible slaughter and polished to flash like lightning! Now will you laugh? Those far stronger than you have fallen beneath its power!
Yes, the sword is now being sharpened and polished; it is being prepared for the executioner.
“Son of man, cry out and wail; pound your thighs in anguish, for that sword will slaughter my people and their leaders, everyone will die!
And it will put them all to the test, what chance do they have? says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Son of man, prophesy to them and clap your hands, then take the sword and brandish it twice, even three times, to symbolize the great massacre, the great massacre facing them on every side.
Let their hearts melt with terror, for the sword glitters at every gate, It flashes like lightning and is polished for slaughter!
O sword, slash to the right, then slash to the left, wherever you will, wherever you want.
I, too, will clap my hands, and I will satisfy my fury, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, make a map and trace two routes on it for the sword of Babylun’s king to follow. Put a signpost on the road that comes out of Babylun where the road forks into two
one road going to Ammun and its capital, Rabbah, and the other to Yahudah and fortified Yahushalam.

The king of Babylun now stands at the fork, uncertain whether to attack Yahushalam or Rabbah, he calls his magicians to look for omens. They cast lots by shaking arrows from the quiver. They inspect the livers of animal sacrifices.
The omen in his right hand says, Yahushalam!’ With battering rams his soldiers will go against the gates, shouting for the kill. They will put up siege towers and build ramps against the walls.

The people of Yahushalam will think it is a false omen, because of their treaty with the Babylunians. But the king of Babylun will remind the people of their rebellion. Then he will attack and capture them.

“Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Again and again you remind me of your sin and your guilt. You do not even try to hide it! In everything you do, your sins are obvious for all to see. So now the time of your punishment has come!
“O you corrupt and wicked prince of Yashar'AL, your final day of reckoning is here!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “Take off your jeweled crown, for the old order changes, now the lowly will be exalted, and the mighty will be brought down.
Destruction! Destruction! I will surely destroy the kingdom, and it will not be restored until the one appears who has the right to judge it. Then I will hand it over to him.

“And now, son of man, prophesy concerning the Ammunites and their mockery. Give them this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “A sword is drawn for your slaughter, It is polished to destroy, flashing like lightning!
Your prophets have given false visions, and your fortune-tellers have told lies, the sword will fall on the necks of the wicked for whom the day of final reckoning has come.
“Now return the sword to its sheath, for in your own country, the land of your birth, I will pass judgment upon you.
I will pour out my fury on you and blow on you with the fire of my anger, I will hand you over to cruel men who are skilled in destruction.
You will be fuel for the fire, and your blood will be spilled in your own land, you will be utterly wiped out, your memory lost to history, for I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Now this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, are you ready to judge Yahushalam? Are you ready to judge this city of murderers? Publicly denounce her detestable sins,
And give her this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut: O city of murderers, doomed and damned, city of idols, filthy and foul.

you are guilty because of the blood you have shed. You are defiled because of the idols you have made. Your day of destruction has come! You have reached the end of your years. I will make you an object of mockery throughout the world.
O infamous city, filled with confusion, you will be mocked by people far and near.
“Every leader in Yashar'AL who lives within your walls is bent on murder.
Fathers and mothers are treated with contempt. Foreigners are forced to pay for protection. Orphans and widows are wronged and oppressed among you.
You despise my Qadash things and violate my Shabbat days of rest.
You accuse others falsely and send them to their death, you are filled with idol worshipers and people who do obscene things.
Men sleep with their fathers’ wives and force themselves on women who are menstruating.
Within your walls live men who commit adultery with their neighbors’ wives, who defile their daughters-in-law, or who rape their own sisters.
There are hired murderers, loan racketeers, and extortioners everywhere. They never even think of Me and My commands, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“But now I clap My hands in indignation over your dishonest gain and bloodshed.
How strong and courageous will you be in my day of reckoning? I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken, and I will do what I Dabar.
I will scatter you among the nations and purge you of your wickedness.
And when you have been defiled among the nations, you will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, the people of Yashar'AL are the worthless slag that remains after silver is smelted. They are the dross that is left over—a useless mixture of copper, tin, iron, and lead.
So tell them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Because you are all worthless slag, I will bring you to my crucible in Yahushalam.
Just as silver, copper, iron, lead, and tin are melted down in a furnace, I will melt you down in the heat of my fury.
I will gather you together and blow the fire of my anger upon you,
and you will melt like silver in fierce heat. Then you will know that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have poured out my fury on you.’”
Again a message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, give the people of Yashar'AL this message: In the day of my indignation, you will be like a polluted land, a land without rain.
Your princes plot conspiracies just as lions stalk their prey, they devour innocent people, seizing treasures and extorting wealth, they make many widows in the land.

Your Kuhanym have violated my instructions and defiled my Qadash things. They make no distinction between what is Qadash and what is not, and they do not teach my people the difference between what is ceremonially clean and unclean. They disregard my Shabbat days so that I Am dishonored among them.
Your leaders are like wolves who tear apart their victims. They actually destroy people’s lives for money!
And your Nabyms cover up for them by announcing false visions and making lying predictions. They say, ‘My message is from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,’ when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not spoken a single word to them.
Even common people oppress the poor, rob the needy, and deprive foreigners of justice.

“I looked for someone who might rebuild the wall of righteousness that guards the land. I searched for someone to stand in the gap in the wall so I would not have to destroy the land, but I found no one.
So now I will pour out my fury on them, consuming them with the fire of my anger. I will heap on their heads the full penalty for all their sins. I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
This message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, once there were two sisters who were daughters of the same mother.
They became prostitutes in Mitzraym, Even as young girls, they allowed men to fondle their breasts.

The older girl was named Uhulah, and her sister was Uhulibah, I married them, and they bore me sons and daughters. I am speaking of Samaria and Yahushalam, for Uhulah is Samaria and Uhulibah is Yahushalam.
“Then Uhulah lusted after other lovers instead of me, and she gave her love to the Assyrian officers.
They were all attractive young men, captains and commanders dressed in handsome blue, charioteers driving their horses.
And so she prostituted herself with the most desirable men of Assyria, worshiping their idols and defiling herself.

For when she left Mitzraym, she did not leave her spirit of prostitution behind. She was still as indecent as in her youth, when the Mitzraym slept with her, fondled her breasts, and used her as a prostitute.
“And so I handed her over to her Assyrian lovers, whom she desired so much.
They stripped her, took away her children as their slaves, and then killed her. After she received her punishment, her reputation was known to every woman in the land.
“Yet even though Uhulibah saw what had happened to Uhulah, her sister, she followed right in her footsteps. And she was even more depraved, abandoning herself to her lust and prostitution.
She fawned over all the Assyrian officers, those captains and commanders in handsome uniforms, those charioteers driving their horses, all of them attractive young men.
I saw the way she was going, defiling herself just like her older sister.
“Then she carried her prostitution even further. She fell in love with pictures that were painted on a wall, pictures of Babylunian military officers, outfitted in striking red uniforms.
Handsome belts encircled their waists, and flowing turbans crowned their heads. They were dressed like chariot officers from the land of Babylunian.
When she saw these paintings, she longed to give herself to them, so she sent messengers to Babylunian to invite them to come to her.
So they came and committed adultery with her, defiling her in the bed of love. After being defiled, however, she rejected them in disgust.
“In the same way, I became disgusted with Uhulibah and rejected her, just as I had rejected her sister, because she flaunted herself before them and gave herself to satisfy their lusts.
Yet she turned to even greater prostitution, remembering her youth when she was a prostitute in Mitzraym.
She lusted after lovers with genitals as large as a donkey’s and emissions like those of a horse.
And so, Uhulibah, you relived your former days as a young girl in Mitzraym, when you first allowed your breasts to be fondled.
“Therefore, Uhulibah, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will send your lovers against you from every direction, those very nations from which you turned away in disgust.

For the Babylunians will come with all the Chaldaans from Pakud and Shua and Kua. And all the Assyrians will come with them, handsome young captains, commanders, chariot officers, and other high-ranking officers, all riding their horses.

They will all come against you from the north with chariots, wagons, and a great army prepared for attack. They will take up positions on every side, surrounding you with men armed with shields and helmets. And I will hand you over to them for punishment so they can do with you as they please.

I will turn my jealous anger against you, and they will deal harshly with you. They will cut off your nose and ears, and any survivors will then be slaughtered by the sword. Your children will be taken away as captives, and everything that is left will be burned.
They will strip you of your beautiful clothes and jewels.
In this way, I will put a stop to the indecency and prostitution you brought from Mitzraym. You will never again cast longing eyes on those things or fondly remember your time in Mitzraym.
“For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will surely hand you over to your enemies, to those you loathe, those you rejected.
They will treat you with hatred and rob you of all you own, leaving you stark naked. The shame of your prostitution will be exposed to all the world.
You brought all this on yourself by prostituting yourself to other nations, defiling yourself with all their idols.
Because you have followed in your sister’s footsteps, I will force you to drink the same cup of terror she drank.
“Yes, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “You will drink from your sister’s cup of terror, a cup that is large and deep, It is filled to the brim with scorn and derision.
Drunkenness and anguish will fill you, for your cup is filled to the brim with distress and desolation, the same cup your sister Samaria drank.
You will drain that cup of terror to the very bottom, then you will smash it to pieces and beat your breast in anguish, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“And because you have forgotten me and turned your back on me, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: You must bear the consequences of all your indecency and prostitution.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Son of man, you must accuse Uhulah and Uhulibah of all their detestable sins.
They have committed both adultery and murder, adultery by worshiping idols and murder by burning as sacrifices the children they bore to me.
Furthermore, they have defiled my Temple and violated my Shabbat day!
On the very day that they sacrificed their children to their idols, they boldly came into my Temple to worship! They came in and defiled my house.
“You sisters sent messengers to distant lands to get men. Then when they arrived, you bathed yourselves, painted your eyelids, and put on your finest jewels for them.
You sat with them on a beautifully embroidered couch and put my incense and my special oil on a table that was spread before you.
From your room came the sound of many men carousing. They were lustful men and drunkards from the wilderness, who put bracelets on your wrists and beautiful crowns on your heads.
Then I said, ‘If they really want to have sex with old worn-out prostitutes like these, let them!’
And that is what they did. They had sex with Uhulah and Uhulibah, these shameless prostitutes.
But righteous people will judge these sister cities for what they really are, adulterers and murderers.
Now this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Bring an army against them and hand them over to be terrorized and plundered.
For their enemies will stone them and kill them with swords. They will butcher their sons and daughters and burn their homes.
In this way, I will put an end to indecency and idolatry in the land, and my judgment will be a warning to all women not to follow your wicked example.
You will be fully repaid for all your prostitution, your worship of idols, Yes, you will suffer the full penalty. Then you will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.”
During the ninth year of King Yahuiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, write down today’s date, because on this very day the king of Babylun is beginning his attack against Yahushalam.
Then give these rebels an illustration with this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “Put a pot on the fire, and pour in some water.
Fill it with choice pieces of meat, the rump and the shoulder and all the most tender cuts.
Use only the best sheep from the flock, and heap fuel on the fire beneath the pot, Bring the pot to boil and cook the bones along with the meat.

“Now this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar; what sorrow awaits Yahushalam the city of murderers! She is a cooking pot whose corruption cannot be cleaned out, take the meat out in random order, for no piece is better than another.
For the blood of her murders is splashed on the rocks, it isn’t even spilled on the ground, where the dust could cover it!
So I will splash her blood on a rock for all to see, an expression of my anger and vengeance against her.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, what sorrow awaits Yahushalam the city of murderers! I myself will pile up the fuel beneath her.
Yes, heap on the wood! Let the fire roar to make the pot boil, Cook the meat with many spices, and afterward burn the bones.
Now set the empty pot on the coals, Heat it red hot! Burn away the filth and corruption.
But it’s hopeless; the corruption cannot be cleaned out, So throw it into the fire.
Your impurity is your indecency and the corruption of your idolatry, I tried to cleanse you, but you refused, so now you will remain in your filth until my fury against you have been satisfied.

“I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken! The time has come, and I will not hold back, I will not change my mind, and I will have no pity on you, for you will be judged on the basis of all your wicked actions, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, with one blow I will take away your dearest treasure. Yet you must not show any sorrow at her death, Do not weep; let there be no tears.

Groan silently, but let there be no wailing at her grave, Do not uncover your head or take off your sandals. Do not perform the usual rituals of mourning or accept any food brought to you by consoling friends.”
So I proclaimed this to the people the next morning, and in the evening my wife died, The next morning I did everything I had been told to do.
Then the people asked, “What does all this mean? What are you trying to tell us?”
So I said to them, “A message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,

and I was told to give this message to the people of Yashar'AL. This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will defile my Temple, the source of your security and pride, the place your heart delights in. Your sons and daughters whom you left behind in Yahudah will be slaughtered by the sword.
Then you will do as Azakyal has done. You will not mourn in public or console yourselves by eating the food brought by friends.

Your heads will remain covered, and your sandals will not be taken off. You will not mourn or weep, but you will waste away because of your sins. You will groan among yourselves for all the evil you have done.
Azakyal is an example for you; you will do just as he has done. And when that time comes you will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Son of man, on the day I take away their stronghold, their joy and kabad, their heart’s desire, their dearest treasure, I will also take away their sons and daughters.
And on that day a survivor from Yahushalam will come to you in Babylun and tell you what has happened.
And when he arrives, your voice will suddenly return so you can talk to him, and you will be a symbol for these people, then they will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, turn and face the land of Ammun and prophesy against its people.

Give the Ammunites this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: Hear the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Because you cheered when my Temple was defiled, mocked Yashar'AL in her desolation, and laughed at Yahudah as she went away into exile,

I will allow nomads from the eastern deserts to overrun your country. They will set up their camps among you and pitch their tents on your land. They will harvest all your fruit and drink the milk from your livestock.
And I will turn the city of Rabbah into a pasture for camels, and all the land of the Ammunites into a resting place for sheep and goats. Then you will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Because you clapped and danced and cheered with glee at the destruction of my people,
I will raise my fist of judgment against you. I will give you as plunder to many nations. I will cut you off from being a nation and destroy you completely. Then you will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Because the people of Muab have said that Yahudah is just like all the other nations,
I will open up their eastern flank and wipe out their esteem frontier towns Bath-Yashimuth, Baal-maun, and Kiriathaim.
And I will hand Muab over to nomads from the eastern deserts, just as I handed over Ammun. Yes, the Ammunites will no longer be counted among the nations.
In the same way, I will bring my judgment down on the Muabites. Then they will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: The people of Adum have sinned greatly by avenging themselves against the people of Yahudah.
Therefore, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will raise my fist of judgment against Adum. I will wipe out its people and animals with the sword. I will make a wasteland of everything from Taman to Dadan.
I will accomplish this by the hand of My people of Yashar'AL. They will carry out my vengeance with anger, and Adum will know that this vengeance is from me, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: The people of Philistia have acted against Yahudah out of bitter revenge and long-standing contempt.
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will raise my fist of judgment against the land of the Philistines. I will wipe out the Karathites and utterly destroy the people who live by the sea.
I will execute terrible vengeance against them to punish them for what they have done. And when I have inflicted my revenge, they will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.”
During the twelfth year of King Yahuiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

“Son of man, Tyra has rejoiced over the fall of Yahushalam, saying, ‘Ha! She who was the gateway to the rich trade routes to the east has been broken, and I am the heir! Because she has been made desolate, I will become wealthy!’
“Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I am your enemy, O Tyra, and I will bring many nations against you, like the waves of the sea crashing against your shoreline.
They will destroy the walls of Tyra and tear down its towers. I will scrape away its soil and make it a bare rock!
It will be just a rock in the sea, a place for fishermen to spread their nets, for I have spoken, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Tyra will become the prey of many nations,
and its mainland villages will be destroyed by the sword. Then they will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: From the north I will bring King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun against Tyra, he is king of kings and brings his horses, chariots, charioteers, and great army.
First he will destroy your mainland villages. Then he will attack you by building a siege wall, constructing a ramp, and raising a roof of shields against you.
He will pound your walls with battering rams and demolish your towers with sledgehammers.
The hooves of his horses will choke the city with dust, and the noise of the charioteers and chariot wheels will shake your walls as they storm through your broken gates.
His horsemen will trample through every street in the city, they will butcher your people, and your strong pillars will topple.
“They will plunder all your riches and merchandise and break down your walls. They will destroy your lovely homes and dump your stones and timbers and even your dust into the sea.
I will stop the music of your songs. No more will the sound of harps be heard among your people.
I will make your island a bare rock, a place for fishermen to spread their nets. You will never be rebuilt, for I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken, yes, the AL'Mighty 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken!
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Tyra: The whole coastline will tremble at the sound of your fall, as the screams of the wounded echo in the continuing slaughter.
All the seaport rulers will step down from their thrones and take off their royal robes and beautiful clothing. They will sit on the ground trembling with horror at your destruction.

Then they will wail for you, singing this funeral song: “O famous island city, once ruler of the Yam (sea), how you have been destroyed! Your people, with their naval power, once spread fear around the world.
Now the coastlands tremble at your fall. The islands are dismayed as you disappear.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will make Tyra an uninhabited ruin, like many others. I will bury you beneath the terrible waves of enemy attack, great seas will swallow you.

I will send you to the pit to join those who descended there long ago, your city will lie in ruins, buried beneath the Arath, like those in the pit who have entered the world of the dead, you will have no place of respect here in the land of the living.
I will bring you to a terrible end, and you will exist no more. You will be looked for, but you will never again be found, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, sing a funeral song for Tyra,
that mighty gateway to the sea, the trading center of the world. Give Tyra this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut: “You boasted, O Tyra, ‘My beauty is perfect!’
You extended your boundaries into the sea. Your builders made your beauty perfect.
You were like a great ship built of the finest cypress from Senir, they took a cedar from Labanun to make a mast for you.
They carved your oars from the oaks of Bashan, your deck of pine from the coasts of Cyprus and was inlaid with ivory.
Your sails were made of Mitzraym’s finest linen, and they flew as a banner above you, and you stood beneath blue and purple awnings made bright with dyes from the coasts of Alishah.
Your oarsmen came from Sidun and Arbad; your helmsmen were skilled men from Tyra itself.
Wise old craftsmen from Gabal did the caulking, Ships from every land came with goods to barter for your trade.
“Men from distant Parsia, Lydia, and Libya served in your great army, they hung their shields and helmets on your walls, giving you great honor.
Men from Arbad and Halach stood on your walls. Your towers were manned by men from Gammad. Their shields hung on your walls, completing your beauty.
“Tarshish sent merchants to buy your wares in exchange for silver, iron, tin, and lead.
Merchants from Grysce, Tubal, and Mashach brought slaves and articles of bronze to trade with you.
“From Bath-tugarmah came riding horses, chariot horses, and mules, all in exchange for your goods.
Merchants came to you from Dadan. Numerous coastlands were your captive markets; they brought payment in ivory tusks and ebony wood.
“Syria sent merchants to buy your rich variety of goods. They traded turquoise, purple dyes, embroidery, fine linen, and jewelry of coral and rubies.
Yahudah and Yashar'AL traded for your wares, offering wheat from Minnith, figs, honey, olive oil, and balm.
“Damascus sent merchants to buy your rich variety of goods, bringing wine from Halbun and white wool from Zahar.
Gryks from Uzal came to trade for your merchandise. Wrought iron, cassia, and fragrant calamus were bartered for your wares.
“Dadan sent merchants to trade their expensive saddle blankets with you.
The Arabians and the princes of Kadar sent merchants to trade lambs and rams and male goats in exchange for your goods.
The merchants of Shaba and Raamah came with all kinds of spices, jewels, and gold in exchange for your wares.
“Haran, Cannah, Adan, Shaba, Asshur, and Kilmad came with their merchandise, too.
They brought choice fabrics to trade—blue cloth, embroidery, and multicolored carpets rolled up and bound with cords.
The ships of Tarshish were your ocean caravans. Your island warehouse was filled to the brim!
“But look! Your oarsmen have taken you into stormy seas! A mighty eastern gale has wrecked you in the heart of the sea!
Everything is lost, your riches and wares, your sailors and pilots, your ship builders, merchants, and warriors, On the day of your ruin, everyone on board sinks into the depths of the sea.
Your cities by the sea tremble as your pilots cry out in terror.
All the oarsmen abandon their ships; the sailors and pilots stand on the shore.
They cry aloud over you and weep bitterly, they throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes.
They shave their heads in grief for you and dress themselves in burlap, they weep for you with bitter anguish and deep mourning.
As they wail and mourn over you, they sing this sad funeral song: ‘Was there ever such a city as Tyra, now silent at the bottom of the sea?
The merchandise you traded satisfied the desires of many nations, Kings at the ends of the Arath were enriched by your trade.
Now you are a wrecked ship, broken at the bottom of the sea, all your merchandise and crew have gone down with you.
All who live along the coastlands are appalled at your terrible fate, their kings are filled with horror and look on with twisted faces.
The merchants among the nations shake their heads at the sight of you, for you have come to a horrible end and will exist no more.’”
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

“Son of man, give the prince of Tyra this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “In your great pride you claim, ‘I am a deity! I sit on a divine throne in the heart of the sea.’ But you are only a man and not mighty, though you boast that you are a deity.
You regard yourself as wiser than Danyal and think no secret is hidden from you.
With your wisdom and understanding you have amassed great wealth, gold and silver for your treasuries.
Yes, your wisdom has made you very rich, and your riches have made you very proud.
“Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Because you think you are wise,
I will now bring against you a foreign army, the terror of the nations, they will draw their swords against your marvelous wisdom and defile your splendor!
They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die in the heart of the sea, pierced with many wounds.
Will you then boast, ‘I am a deity!’ to those who kill you? To them you will be no deity but merely a man!
You will die like an outcast at the hands of foreigners, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Then this further message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, sing this funeral song for the king of Tyra. Give him this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “You were the model of perfection, full of wisdom and exquisite in beauty.

You were in Adan, the garden of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Your clothing was adorned with every precious stone, red carnelian, pale-green peridot, white moonstone, blue-green beryl, onyx, green jasper, blue lapis lazuli, turquoise, and emerald, all beautifully crafted for you and set in the finest gold, they were given to you on the day you were created.
I ordained and anointed you as charub, you had access to the Qadash mountain of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and walked among the fiery stones.
“You were blameless in all you did from the day you were created until the day evil was found in you.
Your rich commerce led you to violence, and you sinned, So I banished you in shame from the mountain of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I expelled you, O mighty guardian, from your place among the fiery stones.
Your heart was filled with pride because of all your beauty, your wisdom was corrupted by your love of splendor, so I threw you to the ground and exposed you to the curious gaze of kings.

You defiled your sanctuaries with your many sins and your dishonest trade, so I brought fire out from within you, and it consumed you, I reduced you to ashes on the ground in the sight of all who were watching.
All who knew you are appalled at your fate. You have come to a terrible end, and you will exist no more.”
Then another message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, turn and face the city of Sidun and prophesy against it.

Give the people of Sidun this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “I Am your enemy, O Sidun, and I will reveal my Kabad by what I do to you, when I bring judgment against you and reveal my qadashym among you, everyone watching will know that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.

I will send a plague against you, and blood will be spilled in your streets, the attack will come from every direction, and your people will lie slaughtered within your walls, then everyone will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
No longer will Yashar'AL’s scornful neighbors prick and tear at her like briers and thorns, for then they will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: The people of Yashar'AL will again live in their own land, the land I gave my servant Ya'aqub, For I will gather them from the distant lands where I have scattered them, I will reveal to the nations of the world My qadashym among my people.

They will live safely in Yashar'AL and build homes and plant vineyards, and when I punish the neighboring nations that treated them with contempt, they will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.”
During the tenth year of King Yahuiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, turn and face Mitzraym and prophesy against Phar'uh the king and all the people of Mitzraym.

Give them this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “I Am your enemy, O Phar'uh, king of Mitzraym you great monster, lurking in the streams of the Nile, for you have said, ‘The Nile River is mine; I made it for myself.’
I will put hooks in your jaws and drag you out on the land with fish sticking to your scales.
I will leave you and all your fish stranded in the wilderness to die, you will lie unburied on the open ground, for I have given you as food to the wild animals and birds.
All the people of Mitzraym will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for to Yashar'AL you were just a staff made of reeds.
When Yashar'AL leaned on you, you splintered and broke and stabbed her in the armpit, when she put her weight on you, you collapsed, and her legs gave way.
“Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will bring an army against you, O Mitzraym, and destroy both people and animals.
The land of Mitzraym will become a desolate wasteland, and the Mitzraym will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Because you said, ‘The Nile River is mine; I made it,’
I Am now the enemy of both you and your river, I will make the land of Mitzraym a totally desolate wasteland, from Migdul to Aswan, as far south as the border of Athiupia.
For forty years not a soul will pass that way, neither people nor animals, It will be completely uninhabited.

I will make Mitzraym desolate, and it will be surrounded by other desolate nations, Its cities will be empty and desolate for forty years, surrounded by other ruined cities, I will scatter the Mitzraym to distant lands.
“But this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also Dabar: At the end of the forty years I will bring the Mitzraym home again from the nations to which they have been scattered.
I will restore the prosperity of Mitzraym and bring its people back to the land of Pathrus in southern Mitzraym from which they came, But Mitzraym will remain an unimportant, minor kingdom.
It will be the lowliest of all the nations, never again great enough to rise above its neighbors.

“Then Yashar'AL will no longer be tempted to trust in Mitzraym for help, Mitzraym’s shattered condition will remind Yashar'AL of how sinful she was to trust Mitzraym in earlier days. Then Yashar'AL will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.”
First day of the new year, during the twenty-seventh year of King Yahuiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

“Son of man, the army of King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun fought so hard against Tyra that the warriors’ heads were rubbed bare and their shoulders were raw and blistered, Yet Nabuchadnazzar and his army won no plunder to compensate them for all their work.
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will give the land of Mitzraym to Nabuchadnazzar, king of Babylun, he will carry off its wealth, plundering everything it has so he can pay his army.
Yes, I have given him the land of Mitzraym as a reward for his work, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, because he was working for me when he destroyed Tyra.
“And the day will come when I will cause the ancient Kabad of Yashar'AL to revive, and then Azakyal your words will be respected. Then they will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.”
This is another message that came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, prophesy and give this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut: Weep and wail for that day,
for the terrible day is almost here, the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! It is a day of clouds and gloom, a day of despair for the nations.
A sword will come against Mitzraym and those who are slaughtered will cover the ground, its wealth will be carried away and its foundations destroyed, the land of Athiupia will be ravished.
Athiupia, Libya, Lydia, all Arabia, and all their other allies will be destroyed in that war.

“For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: All of Mitzraym’s allies will fall, and the pride of her power will end, from Migdul to Aswan they will be slaughtered by the sword, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.
Mitzraym will be desolate, surrounded by desolate nations, and its cities will be in ruins, surrounded by other ruined cities.
And the people of Mitzraym will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, when I have set Mitzraym on fire and destroyed all their allies.
At that time I will send swift messengers in ships to terrify the complacent Athiupians, Great panic will come upon them on that day of Mitzraym certain destruction, watch for it! It is sure to come!
“For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: By the power of King Nabuchadnazzar of Babylun, I will destroy the hordes of Mitzraym.
He and his armies, the most ruthless of all will be sent to demolish the land, they will make war against Mitzraym until the slaughtered Mitzraym cover the ground.
I will dry up the Nile River and sell the land to wicked men, I will destroy the land of Mitzraym and everything in it by the hands of foreigners, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will smash the idols of Mitzraym and the images at Mamphis, there will be no rulers left in Mitzraym; terror will sweep the land.
I will destroy southern Mitzraym, set fire to Zuan, and bring judgment against Thabas.
I will pour out my fury on Pelusium, the strongest fortress of Mitzraym, and I will stamp out the hordes of Thabas.
Yes, I will set fire to all Mitzraym, Palusium will be racked with pain; Thabas will be torn apart; Mamphis will live in constant terror.
The young men of Haliupulis and Bubastis will die in battle, and the women will be taken away as slaves.
When I come to break the proud strength of Mitzraym, it will be a dark day for Tahpanhas too, a dark cloud will cover Tahpanhas, and its daughters will be led away as captives.
And so I will greatly punish Mitzraym and they will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.”
During the eleventh year of King Yahuiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

“Son of man, I have broken the arm of Phar'uh, the king of Mitzraym, his arm has not been put in a cast so that it may heal, Neither has it been bound up with a splint to make it strong enough to hold a sword.

Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I am the enemy of Phar'uh, the king of Mitzraym! I will break both of his arms, the good arm along with the broken one, and I will make his sword clatter to the ground.
I will scatter the Mitzraym to many lands throughout the world.
I will strengthen the arms of Babylun’s king and put my sword in his hand, But I will break the arms of Phar'uh king of Mitzraym, and he will lie there mortally wounded, groaning in pain.

I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylun, while the arms of Phar'uh fall useless to his sides, and when I put my sword in the hand of Babylun’s king and he brings it against the land of Mitzraym, then Mitzraym will know that I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
I will scatter the Mitzraym among the nations, dispersing them throughout the Arath, then they will know that I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.”
During the eleventh year of King Yahuiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, give this message to Phar'uh, king of Mitzraym, and all his hordes: To whom would you compare your greatness?
You are like mighty Assyria, which was once like a cedar of Labanun, with beautiful branches that cast deep forest shade and with its top high among the clouds.
Deep springs watered it and helped it to grow tall and luxuriant, the water flowed around it like a river, streaming to all the trees nearby.
This great tree towered high, higher than all the other trees around it. It prospered and grew long thick branches because of all the water at its roots.
The birds nested in its branches, and in its shade all the wild animals gave birth, all the great nations of the world lived in its shadow.
It was strong and beautiful, with wide spreading branches, for its roots went deep into abundant water.
No other cedar in the garden of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH could rival it, No cypress had branches to equal it; no plane tree had boughs to compare, No tree in the garden of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came close to it in beauty.
Because I made this tree so beautiful, and gave it such magnificent foliage, it was the envy of all the other trees of Adan, the garden of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Because Mitzraym became proud and arrogant, and because it set itself so high above the others, with its top reaching to the clouds,
I will hand it over to a mighty nation that will destroy it as its wickedness deserves, I have already discarded it.

A foreign army, the terror of the nations has cut it down and left it fallen on the ground. Its branches are scattered across the mountains and valleys and ravines of the land. All those who lived in its shadow have gone away and left it lying there.
“The birds roost on its fallen trunk, and the wild animals lie among its branches.

Let the tree of no other nation proudly exult in its own prosperity, though it be higher than the clouds and it be watered from the depths, for all are doomed to die, to go down to the depths of the Arath. They will land in the pit along with everyone else on the Arath.

“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: When Assyria went down to the grave, I made the deep springs mourn, I stopped its rivers and dried up its abundant water, I clothed Labanun in black and caused the trees of the field to wilt.

I made the nations shake with fear at the sound of its fall, for I sent it down to the grave with all the others who descend to the pit. And all the other proud trees of Adan, the most beautiful and the best of Labanun, the ones whose roots went deep into the water, took comfort to find it there with them in the depths of the Arath.
Its allies too, were all destroyed and had passed away, They had gone down to the grave, all those nations that had lived in its shade.

“O Mitzraym, to which of the trees of Adan will you compare your strength and kabad? You too, will be brought down to the depths with all these other nations, You will lie there among the outcasts who have died by the sword, This will be the fate of Phar'uh and all his hordes, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
During the twelfth year of King Yahuiachin’s captivity, this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

“Son of man, mourn for Phar'uh, king of Mitzraym, and give him this message: “You think of yourself as a strong young lion among the nations, but you are really just a sea monster, heaving around in your own rivers, stirring up mud with your feet.
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will send many people to catch you in my net and haul you out of the water.
I will leave you stranded on the land to die. All the birds of the Shamaym will land on you, and the wild animals of the whole Arath will gorge themselves on you.
I will scatter your flesh on the hills and fill the valleys with your bones.
I will drench the Arath with your gushing blood all the way to the mountains, filling the ravines to the brim.
When I blot you out, I will veil the Shamaym and darken the stars, I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give you its light.
I will darken the bright stars overhead and cover your land in darkness, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!
“I will disturb many hearts when I bring news of your downfall to distant nations you have never seen.
Yes, I will shock many lands, and their kings will be terrified at your fate. They will shudder in fear for their lives as I brandish my sword before them on the day of your fall.
For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar:" The sword of the king of Babylun will come against you.
I will destroy your hordes with the swords of mighty warriors, the terror of the nations, they will shatter the pride of Mitzraym and all its hordes will be destroyed.
I will destroy all your flocks and herds that graze beside the streams, never again will people or animals muddy those waters with their feet.
Then I will let the waters of Mitzraym become calm again, and they will flow as smoothly as olive oil, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And when I destroy Mitzraym and strip you of everything you own and strike down all your people, then you will know that I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yes, this is the funeral song they will sing for Mitzraym, let all the nations mourn, let them mourn for Mitzraym and its hordes, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
During the twelfth year, another message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, weep for the hordes of Mitzraym and for the other mighty nations. For I will send them down to the world below in company with those who descend to the pit.
Say to them, ‘O Mitzraym, are you lovelier than the other nations? No! So go down to the pit and lie there among the outcasts.’
Mitzraym will fall with the many who have died by the sword, for the sword is drawn against them, Mitzraym and its hordes will be dragged away to their judgment.
Down in the grave mighty leaders will mockingly welcome Mitzraym and its allies, saying, ‘They have come down; they lie among the outcasts, hordes slaughtered by the sword.’
“Assyria lies there surrounded by the graves of its army, those who were slaughtered by the sword.
Their graves are in the depths of the pit, and they are surrounded by their allies, they struck terror in the hearts of people everywhere, but now they have been slaughtered by the sword.

“Alam lies there surrounded by the graves of all its hordes, those who were slaughtered by the sword. They struck terror in the hearts of people everywhere, but now they have descended as outcasts to the world below. Now they lie in the pit and share the shame of those who have gone before them.

They have a resting place among the slaughtered, surrounded by the graves of all their hordes. Yes, they terrorized the nations while they lived, but now they lie in shame with others in the pit, all of them outcasts, slaughtered by the sword.
“Mashach and Tubal are there, surrounded by the graves of all their hordes. They once struck terror in the hearts of people everywhere. But now they are outcasts, all slaughtered by the sword.

They are not buried in honor like their fallen heroes, who went down to the grave with their weapons, their shields covering their bodies and their swords beneath their heads. Their guilt rests upon them because they brought terror to everyone while they were still alive.
“You too, Mitzraym, will lie crushed and broken among the outcasts, all slaughtered by the sword.
“Adum is there with its kings and princes. Mighty as they were, they also lie among those slaughtered by the sword, with the outcasts who have gone down to the pit.

“All the princes of the north and the Sidunians are there with others who have died, once a terror, they have been put to shame. They lie there as outcasts with others who were slaughtered by the sword. They share the shame of all who have descended to the pit.
“When Phar'uh and his entire army arrive, he will take comfort that he is not alone in having his hordes killed, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Although I have caused his terror to fall upon all the living, Phar'uh and his hordes will lie there among the outcasts who were slaughtered by the sword. I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut have spoken!”
Once again a message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, give your people this message: ‘When I bring an army against a country, the people of that land choose one of their own to be a watchman.
When the watchman sees the enemy coming, he sounds the alarm to warn the people.
Then if those who hear the alarm refuse to take action, it is their own fault if they die.
They heard the alarm but ignored it, so the responsibility is theirs. If they had listened to the warning, they could have saved their lives.

But if the watchman sees the enemy coming and does not sound the alarm to warn the people, he is responsible for their captivity. They will die in their sins, but I will hold the watchman responsible for their deaths.’
“Now, son of man, I am making you a watchman for the people of Yashar'AL, therefore listen to what I say and warn them for Me.
If I announce that some wicked people are sure to die and you fail to tell them to change their ways, then they will die in their sins, and I will hold you responsible for their deaths.
But if you warn them to repent and they do not repent, they will die in their sins, but you will have saved yourself.
“Son of man, give the people of Yashar'AL this message: You are saying, ‘Our sins are heavy upon us; we are wasting away! How can we survive?’

As surely as I live, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I take no pleasure in the death of wicked people, I only want them to turn from their wicked ways so they can live, Turn! Turn from your wickedness, O people of Yashar'AL! Why should you die?

“Son of man, give your people this message: The righteous behavior of righteous people will not save them if they turn to sin, nor will the wicked behavior of wicked people destroy them if they repent and turn from their sins.

When I tell righteous people that they will live, but then they sin, expecting their past righteousness to save them, then none of their righteous acts will be remembered. I will destroy them for their sins.
And suppose I tell some wicked people that they will surely die, but then they turn from their sins and do what is just and right.

For instance, they might give back a debtor’s security, return what they have stolen, and obey my life-giving laws, no longer doing what is evil. If they do this, then they will surely live and not die.
None of their past sins will be brought up again, for they have done what is just and right, and they will surely live.
“Your people are saying, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not doing what is right,’ but it is they who are not doing what is right.
For again I say, when righteous people turn away from their righteous behavior and turn to evil, they will die.
But if wicked people turn from their wickedness and do what is just and right, they will live.
O people of Yashar'AL, you are saying, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not doing what is right.’ But I judge each of you according to your deeds.”
During the twelfth year of our captivity, a survivor from Yahushalam came to me and said, “The city has fallen!”
The previous evening 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had taken hold of me and given me back my voice. So I was able to speak when this man arrived the next morning.
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

“Son of man, the scattered remnants of Yashar'AL living among the ruined cities keep saying, ‘Abraham was only one man, yet he gained possession of the entire land we are many; surely the land has been given to us as a possession.’
So tell these people, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: You eat meat with blood in it, you worship idols, and you murder the innocent. Do you really think the land should be yours?
Murderers! Idolaters! Adulterers! Should the land belong to you?’

“Say to them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: As surely as I live, those living in the ruins will die by the sword, and I will send wild animals to eat those living in the open fields. Those hiding in the forts and caves will die of disease.
I will completely destroy the land and demolish her pride. Her arrogant power will come to an end, the mountains of Yashar'AL will be so desolate that no one will even travel through them.
When I have completely destroyed the land because of their detestable sins, then they will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’
“Son of man, your people talk about you in their houses and whisper about you at the doors, they say to each other, ‘Come on, let us go hear the Nabym tell us what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is saying!’

So my people come pretending to be sincere and sit before you, they listen to your words, but they have no intention of doing what you say. Their mouths are full of lustful words, and their hearts seek only after money.
You are very entertaining to them, like someone who sings love songs with a beautiful voice or plays fine music on an instrument, they hear what you say, but they do not act on it!
But when all these terrible things happen to them, as they certainly will, then they will know a Nabym has been among them.”
Then this message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

“Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds, the leaders of Yashar'AL, give them this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: What sorrow awaits you shepherds who feed yourselves instead of your flocks, should the shepherds not feed their sheep?
You drink the milk, wear the wool, and butcher the best animals, but you let your flocks starve.

You have not taken care of the weak, you have not tended the sick or bound up the injured, you have not gone looking for those who have wandered away and are lost. Instead, you have ruled them with harshness and cruelty.
So my sheep have been scattered without a shepherd, and they are easy prey for any wild animal.
They have wandered through all the mountains and all the hills, across the face of the Arath, yet no one has gone to search for them.
“Therefore, you shepherds, hear the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

As surely as I live, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you abandoned my flock and left them to be attacked by every wild animal, and though you were my shepherds, you did not search for my sheep when they were lost. You took care of yourselves and left the sheep to starve.
Therefore, you shepherds, hear the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I now consider these shepherds my enemies, and I will hold them responsible for what has happened to my flock, I will take away their right to feed the flock, and I will stop them from feeding themselves, I will rescue my flock from their mouths; the sheep will no longer be their prey.
“For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I myself will search and find my sheep.
I will be like a shepherd looking for his scattered flock, I will find my sheep and rescue them from all the places where they were scattered on that dark and cloudy day.

I will bring them back home to their own land of Yashar'AL from among the peoples and nations, I will feed them on the mountains of Yashar'AL and by the rivers and in all the places where people live.
Yes, I will give them good pasture land on the high hills of Yashar'AL, There they will lie down in pleasant places and feed in the lush pastures of the hills.
I myself will tend my sheep and give them a place to lie down in Shalum, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.

I will search for my lost ones who strayed away, and I will bring them safely home again. I will bandage the injured and strengthen the weak, but I will destroy those who are fat and powerful, I will feed them, yes feed them justice!
“And as for you, my flock, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to His people: I will judge between one animal of the flock and another, separating the sheep from the goats.

Is it not enough for you to keep the best of the pastures for yourselves? Must you also trample down the rest? Is it not enough for you to drink clear water for yourselves? Must you also muddy the rest with your feet?
Why must my flock eat what you have trampled down and drink water you have fouled?
“Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will surely judge between the fat sheep and the scrawny sheep.
For you fat sheep pushed and butted and crowded my sick and hungry flock until you scattered them to distant lands.
So I will rescue my flock, and they will no longer be abused, I will judge between one animal of the flock and another.
And I will set over them one shepherd, my servant Daud, he will feed them and be a shepherd to them.
And I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and my servant Daud will be a prince among my people, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have spoken!
“I will make a covenant of Shalum with my people and drive away the dangerous animals from the land, then they will be able to camp safely in the wildest places and sleep in the woods without fear.
I will barak my people and their homes around my Qadash hill, and in the proper season I will send the showers they need. There will be showers of Barakah.

The orchards and fields of my people will yield bumper crops, and everyone will live in safety, When I have broken their chains of slavery and rescued them from those who enslaved them, then they will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
They will no longer be prey for other nations, and wild animals will no longer devour them, They will live in safety, and no one will frighten them.
“And I will make their land famous for its crops, so my people will never again suffer from famines or the insults of foreign nations.
In this way, they will know that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, Am with them, and they will know that they, the people of Yashar'AL, are My people, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.
You are my flock, the sheep of my pasture. You are my people, and I am your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, »I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Again a message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, turn and face Mount Sair, and prophesy against its people.
Give them this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “I Am your enemy, O Mount Sair, and I will raise my fist against you to destroy you completely.
I will demolish your cities and make you desolate, then you will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.
“Your eternal hatred for the people of Yashar'AL led you to butcher them when they were helpless, when I had already punished them for all their sins.
As surely as I live, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, since you show no distaste for blood, I will give you a bloodbath of your own, your turn has come!
I will make Mount Sair utterly desolate, killing off all who try to escape and any who return.
I will fill your mountains with the dead, your hills, your valleys, and your ravines will be filled with people slaughtered by the sword.
I will make you desolate forever your cities will never be rebuilt, then you will know that I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.
“For you said, ‘The lands of Yashar'AL and Yahudah will be ours, we will take possession of them, what do we care that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is there!’

Therefore, as surely as I live, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will pay back your angry deeds with my own, I will punish you for all your acts of anger, envy, and hatred, and I will make Myself known to Yashar'AL by what I do to you.
Then you will know that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have heard every contemptuous word you spoke against the mountains of Yashar'AL, For you said, ‘They are desolate; they have been given to us as food to eat!’
In saying that, you boasted proudly against me, and I have heard it all!
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: The whole world will rejoice when I make you desolate.

You rejoiced at the desolation of Yashar'AL’s territory, now I will rejoice at yours! You will be wiped out, you people of Mount Sair and all who live in Adum! Then you will know that I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
“Son of man, prophesy to Yashar'AL’s mountains, Give them this message: O mountains of Yashar'AL, hear the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Your enemies have taunted you, saying, ‘Aha! Now the ancient heights belong to us!’

Therefore, son of man, give the mountains of Yashar'AL this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut: Your enemies have attacked you from all directions, making you the property of many nations and the object of much mocking and slander.

Therefore, O mountains of Yashar'AL, hear the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. He speaks to the hills and mountains, ravines and valleys, and to ruined wastes and long deserted cities that have been destroyed and mocked by the surrounding nations.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: My jealous anger burns against these nations, especially Adum, because they have shown utter contempt for me by gleefully taking my land for themselves as plunder.
“Therefore, prophesy to the hills and mountains, the ravines and valleys of Yashar'AL, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I am furious that you have suffered shame before the surrounding nations.
Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I have taken a solemn oath that those nations will soon have their own shame to endure.
“But the mountains of Yashar'AL will produce heavy crops of fruit for my people, for they will be coming home again soon!
See, I care about you, and I will pay attention to you, your ground will be plowed and your crops planted.
I will greatly increase the population of Yashar'AL, and the ruined cities will be rebuilt and filled with people.

I will increase not only the people, but also your animals. O mountains of Yashar'AL, I will bring people to live on you once again, I will make you even more prosperous than you were before, then you will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.
I will cause my people to walk on you once again, and you will be their territory. You will never again rob them of their children.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: The other nations taunt you, saying, Yashar'AL is a land that devours its own people and robs them of their children!’
But you will never again devour your people or rob them of their children, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I will not let you hear those other nations insult you, and you will no longer be mocked by them, you will not be a land that causes its nation to fall, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.”
Then this further message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, when the people of Yashar'AL were living in their own land, they defiled it by the evil way they lived, to me their conduct was as unclean as a woman’s menstrual cloth.
They polluted the land with murder and the worship of idols, so I poured out my fury on them.
I scattered them to many lands to punish them for the evil way they had lived.
But when they were scattered among the nations, they brought shame on my Qadash Name. For the nations said, ‘These are the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but He could not keep them safe in his own land!’
Then I was concerned for my Qadash Name, on which my people brought shame among the nations.

“Therefore, give the people of Yashar'AL this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: I AM bringing you back, but not because you deserve it. I am doing it to protect my Qadash Name, on which you brought shame while you were scattered among the nations.

I will show how Qadash my great Name is, the Name on which you brought shame among the nations, and when I reveal my Qadash Name through you before their very eyes, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, then the nations will know that I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
For I will gather you up from all the nations and bring you home again to your land.
“Then I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean, your filth will be washed away, and you will no longer worship idols.
And I will give you a new heart, and I will put a new ruach in you. I will take out your stony, stubborn heart and give you a tender, responsive heart.
And I will put my RUACH in you so that you will follow my decrees and be careful to obey my regulations.
“And you will live in Yashar'AL, the land I gave your ancestors long ago, You will be my people, and I will be your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
I will cleanse you of your filthy behavior, I will give you good crops of grain, and I will send no more famines on the land.
I will give you great harvests from your fruit trees and fields, and never again will the surrounding nations be able to scoff at your land for its famines.
Then you will remember your past sins and despise yourselves for all the detestable things you did.
But remember, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I AM not doing this because you deserve it, O my people of Yashar'AL, you should be utterly ashamed of all you have done!
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: When I cleanse you from your sins, I will repopulate your cities, and the ruins will be rebuilt.
The fields that used to lie empty and desolate in plain view of everyone will again be farmed.
And when I bring you back, people will say, ‘This former wasteland is now like the Garden of Adan! The abandoned and ruined cities now have strong walls and are filled with people!’
Then the surrounding nations that survive will know that I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have rebuilt the ruins and replanted the wasteland. For I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken, and I will do what I Dabar.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I Am ready to hear Yashar'AL’s prayers and to increase their numbers like a flock.

They will be as numerous as the sacred flocks that fill Yahushalam’s streets at the time of her festivals, the ruined cities will be crowded with people once more, and everyone will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH took hold of me, and I was carried away by the RUACH Ha'Qadash of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to a valley filled with bones.
He led me all around among the bones that covered the valley floor, they were scattered everywhere across the ground and were completely dried out.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH asked me, “Son of man, can these bones become living people again?” “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,” I replied, “you alone know the answer to that.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Speak a prophetic message to these bones and say, ‘Dry bones, listen to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Look! I am going to put breath into you and make you live again!
I will put flesh and muscles on you and cover you with skin, I will put breath into you, and you will come to life, then you will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.’”

So I spoke this message, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH told me, suddenly as I spoke, there was a rattling noise all across the valley, the bones of each body came together and attached themselves as complete skeletons.
Then as I watched, muscles and flesh formed over the bones, then skin formed to cover their bodies, but they still had no breath in them.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Speak a prophetic message to the winds, son of man. Speak a prophetic message and say, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Come, O breath, from the four winds! Breathe into these dead bodies so they may live again.’”
So I spoke the message as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commanded me, and breath came into their bodies. They all came to life and stood up on their feet, a great army.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Son of man, these bones represent the people of Yashar'AL, They are saying, ‘We have become old, dry bones, all hope is gone. Our nation is finished.’
Therefore, prophesy to them and say, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: O my people, I will open your graves of exile and cause you to rise again. Then I will bring you back to the land of Yashar'AL.
When this happens, O my people, you will know that I am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
I will put my RUACH in you, and you will live again and return home to your own land. Then you will know that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken, and I have done what I Dabar. Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken!’”
Again a message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:

“Son of man, take a piece of wood and carve on it these words: ‘This represents Yahudah and its allied tribes.’ Then take another piece and carve these words on it: ‘This represents Aphraim and the northern tribes of Yashar'AL.’
Now hold them together in your hand as if they were one piece of wood.
When your people ask you what your actions mean,
say to them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I will take Aphraim and the northern tribes and join them to Yahudah, I will make them one piece of wood in my hand.’
“Then hold out the pieces of wood you have inscribed, so the people can see them.
And give them this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: I will gather the people of Yashar'AL from among the nations. I will bring them home to their own land from the places where they have been scattered.
I will unify them into one nation on the mountains of Yashar'AL. One king will rule them all; no longer will they be divided into two nations or into two kingdoms.

They will never again pollute themselves with their idols and vile images and rebellion, for I will save them from their sinful apostasy. I will cleanse them. Then they will truly be My people, and I will be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“My servant Daud will be their king, and they will have only one shepherd, they will obey My regulations and be careful to keep my decrees.

They will live in the land I gave my servant Ya'aqub, the land where their ancestors lived. They and their children and their grandchildren after them will live there forever, generation after generation, and My servant Daud will be their prince forever.
And I will make a covenant of Shalum with them, an everlasting covenant, I will give them their land and increase their numbers, and I will put My Temple among them forever.
I will make my home among them, I will be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and they will be My people.
And when My Temple is among them forever, the nations will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who makes Yashar'AL Qadash.”
This is another message that came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Son of man, turn and face Gug of the land of Magug, the prince who rules over the nations of Mashach and Tubal, and prophesy against him.
Give him this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: Gug, I am your enemy!
I will turn you around and put hooks in your jaws to lead you out with your whole army, your horses and charioteers in full armor and a great horde armed with shields and swords.
Persia, Athiupia, and Libya will join you, too, with all their weapons.
Gumar and all its armies will also join you, along with the armies of Bath-togarmah from the distant north, and many others.
“Get ready; be prepared! Keep all the armies around you mobilized, and take command of them.

A long time from now you will be called into action. In the distant future you will swoop down on the land of Mitzraym, which will be enjoying Shalum after recovering from war and after its people have returned from many lands to the mountains of Yashar'AL.
You and all your allies, a vast and awesome army, will roll down on them like a storm and cover the land like a cloud.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: At that time evil thoughts will come to your mind, and you will devise a wicked scheme.
You will say, Yashar'AL is an unprotected land filled with unwalled villages! I will march against her and destroy these people who live in such confidence!

I will go to those formerly desolate cities that are now filled with people who have returned from exile in many nations. I will capture vast amounts of plunder, for the people are rich with livestock and other possessions now. They think the whole world revolves around them!’

But Shaba and Dadan and the merchants of Tarshish will ask, ‘Do you really think the armies you have gathered can rob them of silver and gold? Do you think you can drive away their livestock and seize their goods and carry off plunder?’
“Therefore, son of man, prophesy against Gug, give him this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut: When my people are living in Shalum in their land, then you will rouse yourself.
You will come from your homeland in the distant north with your vast cavalry and your mighty army,

And you will attack my people Yashar'AL, covering their land like a cloud. At that time in the distant future, I will bring you against my land as everyone watches, and my Qadash Kabad will be displayed by what happens to you, Gug. Then all the nations will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Are you the one I was talking about long ago, when I announced through Yashar'AL’s Nabyms that in the future I would bring you against my people?
But this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: When Gug invades the land of Yashar'AL, My fury will boil over!
In My jealousy and blazing anger, I promise a mighty shaking in the land of Yashar'AL on that day.

All living things, the fish in the Yam (sea), the birds of the sky, the animals of the field, the small animals that scurry along the ground, and all the people on the Arath will quake in terror at my presence. Mountains will be thrown down; cliffs will crumble; walls will fall to the Arath.
I will summon the sword against you on all the hills of Yashar'AL, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Your men will turn their swords against each other.
I will punish you and your armies with disease and bloodshed; I will send torrential rain, hailstones, fire, and burning sulfur!
In this way, I will show my greatness and Qadash Kabad, and I will make myself known to all the nations of the world, then they will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the AL'Mighty One.
“Son of man, prophesy against Gug, give him this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: I AM your enemy, O Gug, ruler of the nations of Mashach and Tubal.
I will turn you around and drive you toward the mountains of Yashar'AL, bringing you from the distant north.
I will knock the bow from your left hand and the arrows from your right hand, and I will leave you helpless.
You and your army and your allies will all die on the mountains. I will feed you to the vultures and wild animals.
You will fall in the open fields, for I have spoken, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And I will rain down fire on Magug and on all your allies who live safely on the coasts, Then they will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“In this way, I will make known my Qadash Name among My people of Yashar'AL, I will not let anyone bring shame on My Name, and the nations too, will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the Qadash One of Yashar'AL.
That day of judgment will come, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Everything will happen just as I have declared it.

“Then the people in the towns of Yashar'AL will go out and pick up your small and large shields, bows and arrows, javelins and spears, and they will use them for fuel, there will be enough to last them seven years!

They won’t need to cut wood from the fields or forests, for these weapons will give them all the fuel they need. They will plunder those who planned to plunder them, and they will rob those who planned to rob them, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.

“And I will make a vast graveyard for Gug and his hordes in the Valley of the Travelers, east of the Dead Sea. It will block the way of those who travel there, and they will change the name of the place to the Valley of Gug’s Hordes.
It will take seven months for the people of Yashar'AL to bury the bodies and cleanse the land.
Everyone in Yashar'AL will help, for it will be a awesome victory for Yashar'AL when I demonstrate my Kabad on that day, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“After seven months, teams of men will be appointed to search the land for skeletons to bury, so the land will be made clean again.
Whenever bones are found, a marker will be set up so the burial crews will take them to be buried in the Valley of Gug’s Hordes.
There will be a town there named Hamunah, and so the land will finally be cleansed.

“And now, son of man, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Call all the birds and wild animals. Say to them: Gather together for my great sacrificial feast. Come from far and near to the mountains of Yashar'AL, and there eat flesh and drink blood!
Eat the flesh of mighty men and drink the blood of princes as though they were rams, lambs, goats, and bulls, all fattened animals from Bashan!
Gorge yourselves with flesh until you are glutted; drink blood until you are drunk. This is the sacrificial feast I have prepared for you.
Feast at my banquet table, feast on horses and charioteers, on mighty men and all kinds of valiant warriors, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“In this way, I will demonstrate my Kabad to the nations, everyone will see the punishment I have inflicted on them and the power of my fist when I strike.
And from that time on the people of Yashar'AL will know that I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
