Then I lifted my eyes and saw, and there, standing beside the river, was a ram which had two horns, and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher one came up last.
I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward, so that no animal could withstand him; nor was there any that could deliver from his hand, but he did according to his will and became great.
And as I was considering, suddenly a male goat came from the west, across the surface of the whole Arath, without touching the ground; and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
Then the goat came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing beside the river, and ran at the ram with furious power.

And I saw the goat confronting the ram; the goat was moved with rage against the ram and attacked the ram, and broke the ram's two horns, There was no power in the ram to withstand the goat, but the goat cast the ram down to the ground and trampled the ram; and there was no one that could deliver the ram from the goat's hand.
Therefore the male goat grew very great; but when the goat became strong, the large horn was broken, and in place of it four notable horns came up toward the four winds of Shamaym.
And out of one of them came a little horn which grew exceedingly great toward the south, toward the east, and toward the Esteemed Land.
And the horn grew up to the host of Shamaym; and it cast down some of the host and some of the stars to the ground, and trampled them.
He even exalted himself as high as the Prince of the host; and by him the daily sacrifices were taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
Because of transgression, an army was given over to the horn to oppose the daily sacrifices; and he cast truth down to the ground, he did all this and prospered.

Then I heard a Qadash one speaking; and another Qadash one said to that certain one who was speaking, “How long will the vision be, concerning the daily sacrifices and the transgression of desolation, the giving of both the sanctuary and the host to be trampled underfoot?”
And he said to me, “For two thousand three hundred days; then the sanctuary shall be cleansed.”
Then it happened, when I Danyal, had seen the vision and was seeking the meaning, that suddenly there stood before me one having the appearance of a man.
And I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, who called, and said, “Gabri'AL, make this man understand the vision.”
So Gabri'AL came near where I stood, and when he came I was afraid and fell on my face; but Gabri'AL said to me, “Understand, son of man, that the vision refers to the time of the end.”
Now, as Gabri'AL was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep with my face to the ground; but he touched me, and stood me upright.
And Gabri'AL said, “Look, I am making known to you what shall happen in the latter time of the indignation; for at the appointed time the end shall be.
The ram which you saw, having the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.
And the male goat is the kingdom of Greece, The large horn that is between its eyes is the first king.
The four prominent horns that replaced the one large horn show that the Greek Empire will break into four kingdoms, but none as great as the first, which is Greece.
“At the end of their rule, when their sin is at its height, a fierce king, a master of intrigue, will rise to power.

He will become very strong, but not by his own power, he will cause a shocking amount of destruction and succeed in everything he does, he will destroy powerful leaders and devastate the Qadash people.

He will be a master of deception and will become arrogant; he will destroy many without warning, he will even take on the Prince of princes in battle, but he will be broken, though not by man's power.
“This vision about the 2,300 evenings and mornings is true, but none of these things will happen now, it is for the future time, so keep this vision a secret.”
Then I Danyal was overcome and lay sick for several days, afterward I got up and performed my duties for the king, but I was greatly troubled by the vision and could not understand it.
It was the first year of the reign of Darius the Madas, the son of Ahasuarus, who became king of the Babylunians.
During the first year of his reign, I Danyal, learned from reading the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as revealed to Yaramyahu the Nabym, that Yahushalam must lie desolate for seventy years.
So I turned to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and pleaded with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in prayer and fasting, I also wore rough burlap and sprinkled myself with ashes.

I prayed to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and confessed: “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you are a great and awesome 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! You always fulfill your covenant and keep your promises of unfailing love to those who love you and obey your commandments.
But we have sinned and done wrong, we have rebelled against you and scorned your commands and regulations.
We have refused to listen to your servants the Nabyms, who spoke on your authority to our kings and princes and ancestors and to all the people of the land.

“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you are in the right; but as you see, our faces are covered with shame, this is true of all of us, including the people of Yahudah and Yahushalam and all Yashar'AL, scattered near and far, wherever you have driven us because of our disloyalty to you.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, we and our kings, princes, and ancestors are covered with shame because we have sinned against you.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against HIM.
We have not obeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for we have not followed the instructions 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave us through His servants the Nabyms.

All Yashar'AL has disobeyed your instruction and turned away, refusing to listen to your voice, “So now the solemn curses and judgments written in the Law of Musha, the servant of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, has been poured down on us because of our sin.
You have kept your Dabar (word) and done to us and our rulers exactly as you warned, never has there been such a disaster as this in Yahushalam.
Every curse written against us in the Law of Musha has come true, yet we have refused to seek mercy from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH by turning from our sins and recognizing His Truth.
Therefore, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has brought upon us the disaster He prepared, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH was right to do all of these things, for we did not obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, you brought lasting honor to your Name by rescuing your people from Mitzraym in a great display of power, but we have sinned and are full of wickedness.

In view of all your faithful mercies, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, please turn your furious anger away from your city Yahushalam, your Qadash mountain, all the neighboring nations mock Yahushalam and your people because of our sins and the sins of our ancestors.
“O our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, hear your servant’s prayer! Listen as I plead, for your own sake, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, smile again on your desolate sanctuary.

“O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, be merciful and listen to my prayers, Open your eyes and see our despair, See how your city, the city that bears your Name lies in ruins, we make this plea, not because we deserve help, but because of your mercy.
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hear, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forgive, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH listen and act! For your own sake, do not delay, O my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for your people and your city bear your Name.”
I went on praying and confessing my sin and the sin of my people, pleading with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH for Yahushalam, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's Qadash mountain.
As I was praying, Gabri'AL, whom I had seen in the earlier vision, came swiftly to me at the time of the evening sacrifice.
Gabri'AL explained to me, “Danyal, I have come here to give you insight and understanding.

The moment you began praying, a command was given, and now I am here to tell you what it was, for you are very precious to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Listen carefully so that you can understand the meaning of your vision.

“A period of seventy sets of seven has been decreed for your people and your Qadash city to finish their rebellion, to put an end to their sin, to atone for their guilt, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to confirm the prophetic vision, and to anoint the Most Qadash Place.

Now listen and understand! Seven sets of seven plus sixty-two sets of seven will pass from the time the command is given to rebuild Yahushalam until a ruler, the Anointed_One comes, Yahushalam will be rebuilt with streets and strong defenses, despite the perilous times.

“After this period of sixty-two sets of seven, the Anointed_One will be killed, appearing to have accomplished nothing, and a ruler will arise whose armies will destroy the city and the Temple, the end will come with a flood, and war and its miseries are decreed from that time to the very end.

The ruler will make a treaty with the people for a period of one set of seven, but after half this time, he will put an end to the sacrifices and offerings, and as a climax to all his terrible deeds, he will set up a sacrilegious object that causes desecration, until the fate decreed for this defiler is finally poured out on him.”

In the third year of the reign of King Cyrus of Parsia, Danyal (also known as Baltashazzar) had another vision, he understood that the vision concerned events certain to happen in the future times of war and great hardship.
When this vision came to me, I Danyal, had been in mourning for three whole weeks.
All that time I had eaten no rich food, no meat or wine crossed my lips, and I used no fragrant lotions until those three weeks had passed.
I was standing on the bank of the great Tigris River,
I looked up and saw a man dressed in linen clothing, with a belt of pure gold around his waist.

His body looked like a precious gem, his face flashed like lightning, and his eyes flamed like torches, his arms and feet shone like polished bronze, and his voice roared like a vast multitude of people.
Only I Danyal, saw this vision, the men with me saw nothing, but they were suddenly terrified and ran away to hide.
So I was left there all alone to see this amazing vision, my strength left me, my face grew deathly pale, and I felt very weak.
Then I heard the man speak, and when I heard the sound of his voice, I fainted and lay there with my face to the ground.
Just then a hand touched me and lifted me, still trembling, to my hands and knees.

And the man said to me, “Danyal, you are very precious to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so listen carefully to what I have to say to you, stand up, for I have been sent to you.” When he said this to me, I stood up, still trembling.

Then he said, “Do not be afraid, Danyal. Since the first day you began to pray for understanding and to humble yourself before your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, your request has been heard in Shamaym, I have come in answer to your prayer.

But for twenty-one days the spirit prince of the kingdom of Persia blocked my way, then Maky'AL one of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's great Malak, came to help me, and I left him there with the spirit prince of the kingdom of Persia.
Now I am here to explain what will happen to your people in the future, for this vision concerns a time yet to come.”
While he was speaking to me, I looked down at the ground, unable to say a word.

Then the one who looked like a man touched my lips, and I opened my mouth and began to speak, I said to the one standing in front of me, “I am filled with anguish because of the vision I have seen my master and I am very weak.
How can someone like me, your servant, talk to you my master? My strength is gone, and I can hardly breathe.”
Then the one who looked like a man touched me again, and I felt my strength returning.

“Do not be afraid,” he said, “for you are very precious to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Shalum! Be encouraged! Be strong!” As he spoke these words to me, I suddenly felt stronger and said to him, “Please speak to me my master, for you have strengthened me.”
He replied, “Do you know why I have come? Soon I must return to fight against the spirit prince of the kingdom of Parsia, and after that the spirit prince of the kingdom of Greece will come.
Meanwhile, I will tell you what is written in the Book of Truth. No one helps me against these spirit princes except Maky'AL your prince.
“During the first year that Darius the Madas was king, I stood up to support the great Malak Maky'AL in his fight against the prince of Parsia.

“Now then, I will reveal the truth to you. Three more Parsian kings will reign, to be succeeded by a fourth far richer than the others, he will use his wealth to stir up everyone to fight against the kingdom of Greece.
“Then a mighty king will rise to power who will rule with great authority and accomplish everything he sets out to do.

But at the height of his power, his kingdom will be broken apart and divided into four parts. It will not be ruled by the king’s descendants, nor will the kingdom hold the authority it once had. For his empire will be uprooted and given to others.
“The king of the south will increase in power, but one of his own officials will become more powerful than he and will rule his kingdom with great strength.

“Some years later an alliance will be formed between the king of the north and the king of the south, the daughter of the king of the south will be given in marriage to the king of the north to secure the alliance, but she will lose her influence over him, and so will her father. She will be abandoned along with her supporters.
But when one of her relatives becomes king of the south, he will raise an army and enter the fortress of the king of the north and defeat him.
When he returns to Mitzraym, he will carry back their idols with him, along with priceless articles of gold and silver. For some years afterward he will leave the king of the north alone.
“Later the king of the north will invade the realm of the king of the south but will soon return to his own land.
However, the sons of the king of the north will assemble a mighty army that will advance like a flood and carry the battle as far as the enemy’s fortress.
“Then, in a rage, the king of the south will rally against the vast forces assembled by the king of the north and will defeat them.
After the enemy army is swept away, the king of the south will be filled with pride and will execute many thousands of his enemies. But his success will be short lived.
“A few years later the king of the north will return with a fully equipped army far greater than before.
At that time there will be a general uprising against the king of the south. Violent men among your own people will join them in fulfillment of this vision, but they will not succeed.
Then the king of the north will come and lay siege to a fortified city and capture it. The best troops of the south will not be able to stand in the face of the onslaught.
“The king of the north will march onward unopposed; none will be able to stop him. He will pause in the Esteemed land of Yashar'AL, intent on destroying it.

He will make plans to come with the might of his entire kingdom and will form an alliance with the king of the south, he will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom from within, but his plan will fail.
“After this, he will turn his attention to the coastland and conquer many cities, but a commander from another land will put an end to his insolence and cause him to retreat in shame.
He will take refuge in his own fortresses but will stumble and fall and be seen no more.
“His successor will send out a tax collector to maintain the royal splendor. But after a very brief reign, he will die, though not from anger or in battle.
“The next to come to power will be a despicable man who is not in line for royal succession, he will slip in when least expected and take over the kingdom by flattery and intrigue.
Before him great armies will be swept away, including a covenant prince.
With deceitful promises, he will make various alliances, he will become strong despite having only a handful of followers.

Without warning he will enter the richest areas of the land, then he will distribute among his followers the plunder and wealth of the rich, something his predecessors had never done, he will plot the overthrow of strongholds, but this will last for only a short while.

“Then he will stir up his courage and raise a great army against the king of the south. The king of the south will go to battle with a mighty army, but to no avail, for there will be plots against him.
His own household will cause his downfall, his army will be swept away, and many will be killed.

Seeking nothing but each other’s harm, these kings will plot against each other at the conference table, attempting to deceive each other, but it will make no difference, for the end will come at the appointed time.
“The king of the north will then return home with great riches, on the way he will set himself against the people of the Qadash covenant, doing much damage before continuing his journey.
“Then at the appointed time he will once again invade the south, but this time the result will be different.

For warships from western coastlands will scare him off, and he will withdraw and return home, but he will vent his anger against the people of the Qadash covenant and reward those who forsake the covenant.
“His army will take over the Temple fortress, pollute the sanctuary, put a stop to the daily sacrifices, and set up the sacrilegious object that causes desecration.
He will flatter and win over those who have violated the covenant, but the people who know their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will be strong and will resist him.
“Wise leaders will give instruction to many, but these teachers will die by fire and sword, or they will be jailed and robbed.
During these persecutions, little help will arrive, and many who join them will not be sincere.
And some of the wise will fall victim to persecution, in this way, they will be refined and cleansed and made pure until the time of the end, for the appointed time is still to come.

“The king will do as he pleases, exalting himself and claiming to be greater than every deity, even blaspheming the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who created all Life, he will succeed, but only until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been determined will surely take place.
He will have no respect for the deities of his ancestors, or for the idol deity loved by women, or for any other deity, for he will boast that he is greater than them all.
Instead of these, he will worship the idol of fortresses, a idol his ancestors never knew, and lavish on the idol gold, silver, precious stones, and expensive gifts.

Claiming this foreign idol’s help, he will attack the strongest fortresses, he will honor those who submit to him, appointing them to positions of authority and dividing the land among them as their reward.

“Then at the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the king of the north, the king of the north will storm out with chariots, charioteers, and a vast navy, he will invade various lands and sweep through them like a flood.
He will enter the Esteemed land of Yashar'AL, and many nations will fall, but Muab, Adum, and the best part of Ammun will escape.
He will conquer many countries, and even Mitzraym will not escape.
He will gain control over the gold, silver, and treasures of Mitzraym, and the Libyans and Athiupians will be his servants.
“But then news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will set out in great anger to destroy and obliterate many.
He will stop between the Esteemed Qadash mountain and the Yam (sea) and will pitch his royal tents, but while he is there, his time will suddenly run out, and no one will help him.

“At that time Maky'AL the great Malak who stands guard over your nation Yashar'AL, will arise, then there will be a time of anguish greater than any since nations first came into existence, but at that time every one of your people whose name is written in the book will be rescued.
Many of those whose bodies lie dead and buried will rise up, some to everlasting life and some to shame and everlasting dishonored.
Those who are wise will shine as bright as the sky (firmament), and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever.
But you, Danyal, keep this prophecy a secret; seal up the book until the time of the end, when many will rush here and there, and knowledge will increase.”
Then I Danyal, looked and saw two others standing on opposite banks of the river.
One of them asked the man dressed in linen, who was now standing above the river, “How long will it be until these shocking events are over?”

The man dressed in linen, who was standing above the river, raised both his hands toward Shamaym and took a solemn oath by the One who lives forever, saying, “It will go on for a time, times, and half a time, when the shattering of the Qadash people has finally come to an end, all these things will have happened.”
I heard what he said, but I did not understand what he meant, so I asked, “How will all this finally end, my master?”
But he said, “Go now, Danyal, for what I have said is kept secret and sealed until the time of the end.
Many will be purified, cleansed, and refined by these trials, but the wicked will continue in their wickedness, and none of them will understand, only those who are wise will know what it means.
“And from the time that the daily sacrifice is taken away, and the abomination of desolation is set up, there shall be one thousand two hundred and ninety days.
Baraked is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred and thirty-five days.
“As for you, go your way until the end, you will rest, and then at the end of the days, you will rise again to receive the inheritance set aside for you.”

books.name: Hosea
chapters: Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave this message to Husha son of Baari during the years when Uzzyahu, Yutham, Ahaz, and Hazakyahu were kings of Yahudah, and Yarubuam son of Yahuash was king of Yashar'AL.

When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH first began speaking to Yashar'AL through Husha, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to him, “Go and marry a prostitute, so that some of her children will be conceived in prostitution, this will illustrate how Yashar'AL has acted like a prostitute by turning against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and worshiping idols.”
So Husha married Gumar, the daughter of Diblaim, and she became pregnant and gave Husha a son.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Name the child Yazraal, for I am about to punish King Yahu’s dynasty to avenge the murders he committed at Yazraal, in fact I will bring an end to Yashar'AL’s independence.
I will break its military power in the Yazraal Valley.”

Soon Gumar became pregnant again and gave birth to a daughter, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Husha, “Name your daughter Lu-ruhamah, ‘Not loved’, for I will no longer show love to the people of Yashar'AL or forgive them.
But I will show love to the people of Yahudah, I will free them from their enemies, not with weapons and armies or horses and charioteers, but by my power as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
After Gumar had weaned Lu-ruhamah, she again became pregnant and gave birth to a second son.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Name him Lu-ammi, ‘Not my people’—for Yashar'AL is not my people, and I am not their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

“Yet the time will come when Yashar'AL’s people will be like the sands of the seashore, too many to count! Then, at the place where they were told, ‘You are not my people,’ it will be said, ‘You are children of the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.’

Then the people of Yahudah and Yashar'AL will unite together, they will choose one leader for themselves, and they will return from exile together, what a day that will be, the day of Yazraal when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will again plant his people in his land.
“In that day you will call your brothers Ammi ‘My people.’ And you will call your sisters Ruhamah ‘The ones I love.’

“But now bring charges against Yashar'AL your mother for she is no longer my wife, and I am no longer her husband, tell her to remove the prostitute’s makeup from her face and the clothing that exposes her breasts.
Otherwise, I will strip her as naked as she was on the day she was born, I will leave her to die of thirst, as in a dry and barren wilderness.
And I will not love her children, for they were conceived in prostitution.

Their mother is a shameless prostitute and became pregnant in a shameful way, she said, ‘I will run after other lovers and sell myself to them for food and water, for clothing of wool and linen, and for olive oil and drinks.’
“For this reason I will fence her in with thornbushes, I will block her path with a wall to make her lose her way.

When she runs after her lovers, she won’t be able to catch them, she will search for them but not find them, then she will think, ‘I might as well return to my husband, for I was better off with him than I am now.’
She does not realize it was I who gave her everything she has, the grain, the new wine, the olive oil; I even gave her silver and gold. But she gave all my gifts to Baal.
“But now I will take back the ripened grain and new wine I generously provided each harvest season, I will take away the wool and linen clothing I gave her to cover her nakedness.
I will strip her naked in public, while all her lovers look on, No one will be able to rescue her from my hands.
I will put an end to her annual festivals, her new moon celebrations, and her Shabbat days, all her appointed festivals.
I will destroy her grapevines and fig trees, things she claims her lovers gave her, I will let them grow into tangled thickets, where only wild animals will eat the fruit.

I will punish her for all those times when she burned incense to her images of Baal, when she put on her earrings and jewels and went out to look for her lovers but forgot all about me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“But then I will win her back once again, I will lead her into the desert and speak tenderly to her there.

I will return her vineyards to her and transform the Valley of Trouble into a gateway of hope, She will give herself to me there, as she did long ago when she was young, when I freed her from her captivity in Mitzraym.
When that day comes,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “you will call me ‘my husband’ instead of ‘my Baal.’
O Yashar'AL, I will wipe the many names of Baal from your lips, and you will never mention them again.

On that day I will make a covenant with all the wild animals and the birds of the sky and the animals that scurry along the ground so they will not harm you, I will remove all weapons of war from the land, all swords and bows, so you can live unafraid in Shalum and safety.
I will make you my wife forever, showing you righteousness and justice, unfailing love and compassion.
I will be faithful to you and make you mine, and you will finally know me as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“In that day I will answer you says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I will answer the sky as it pleads for clouds, and the sky will answer the Arath with rain.
Then the Arath will answer the thirsty cries of the grain, the grapevines, and the olive trees, and they in turn will answer, ‘Yazraal’ the plant of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.’

Then I will sow her for Myself in the Arath, And I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; then I will say to those who were not My people, ‘You are My people!’ and they shall say, ‘You are our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH!’ ”

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Go and love your wife again, even though she commits adultery with another lover, this will illustrate that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH still loves Yashar'AL, even though the people have turned to idols and love to worship them.”
So I bought her back for fifteen pieces of silver and five bushels of barley and a measure of wine.
Then I said to her, “You must live in my house for many days and stop your prostitution, during this time, you will not have sexual relations with anyone, not even with me.”
This shows that Yashar'AL will go a long time without a king or prince, and without sacrifices, sacred pillars, priests, or even idols!

But afterward the people will return and devote themselves to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and to Daud’s descendant, their king, In the last days, they will tremble in awe of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and of His goodness.
Hear the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, O people of Yashar'AL, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has brought charges against you, saying: “There is no faithfulness, no kindness, no knowledge of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH in your land.
You make vows and break them; you kill and steal and commit adultery, there is violence everywhere, one murder after another.
That is why your land is in mourning, and everyone is wasting away, even the wild animals, the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea are disappearing.
“Do not point your finger at someone else and try to pass the blame! My complaint is with your priests.
So you will stumble in broad daylight, and your false prophets will fall with you in the night, and I will destroy Yashar'AL, your mother.

My people are being destroyed because they do not have the knowledge of Me their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, since you Kuhanym (Priests) refuse to know me, I refuse to recognize you as my Kuhanym, since you have forgotten the laws of your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, I will forget to barak your children.
The more Kuhanym there are, the more they sin against me, they have exchanged the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for the shame of idols.
“When the people bring their sin offerings, the Kuhanym (priests) get fed, So the Kuhanym are glad when the people sin!
‘And what the Kuhanym do, the people also do.’ So now I will punish both Kuhanym and the people for their wicked deeds.
They will eat and still be hungry, they will play the prostitute and gain nothing from it, for they have deserted 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
to worship idols, “Wine has robbed my people of their understanding.

They ask a piece of wood for advice! They think a stick can tell them the future! Longing after idols has made them foolish, they have played the prostitute, serving idols and deserting their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

They offer sacrifices to idols on the mountaintops, They go up into the hills to burn incense in the pleasant shade of oaks, poplars, and terebinth trees, “That is why your daughters turn to prostitution, and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.

But why should I punish them for their prostitution and adultery? For your men are doing the same thing, sinning with whores and shrine prostitutes, O foolish people! You refuse to understand, so you will be destroyed.
“Though you, Yashar'AL, are a prostitute, may Yahudah not be guilty of such things, do not join the false worship at Gilgal or Bath-aban, and do not take oaths there in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s name.
Yashar'AL is stubborn, like a stubborn heifer, So should 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH feed her like a lamb in a lush pasture?
Leave Yashar'AL alone, because she is married to idolatry.
When the rulers of Yashar'AL finish their drinking, off they go to find some prostitutes., they love shame more than honor.
So a mighty wind will sweep them away. Their sacrifices to idols will bring them shame.

“Hear this, you Kuhanym, Pay attention, you leaders of Yashar'AL, Listen, you members of the royal family, Judgment has been handed down against you, for you have led the people into a snare by worshiping the idols at Mizpah and Tabor.
You have dug a deep pit to trap them at Acacia Grube, But I will settle with you for what you have done.
I know what you are like, O Aphraim, You cannot hide yourself from me, O Yashar'AL, you have left me as a prostitute leaves her husband; you are utterly defiled.
Your deeds won’t let you return to your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, You are a prostitute through and through, and you do not know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“The arrogance of Yashar'AL testifies against her; Yashar'AL and Aphraim will stumble under their load of guilt, Yahudah, too, will fall with them.
When they come with their flocks and herds to offer sacrifices to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they will not find him, because he has withdrawn from them.
They have betrayed the honor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, bearing children that are not for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Now their false religion will devour them along with their wealth.
“Sound the alarm in Gibaah! Blow the trumpet in Ramah! Raise the battle cry in Bath-aban! Lead on into battle, O warriors of Banyamin!
One thing is certain, Yashar'AL On your day of punishment, you will become a heap of rubble.
“The leaders of Yahudah have become like thieves, So I will pour my anger on them like a waterfall.
The people of Yashar'AL will be crushed and broken by my judgment because they are determined to worship idols.
I will destroy Yashar'AL as a moth consumes wool, I will make Yahudah as weak as rotten wood.
“When Yashar'AL and Yahudah saw how sick they were, Yashar'AL turned to Assyria to the great king there, but he could neither help nor cure them.
I will be like a lion to Yashar'AL, like a strong young lion to Yahudah, I will tear them to pieces! I will carry them off, and no one will be left to rescue them.
Then I will return to my place until they admit their guilt and turn to me, For as soon as trouble comes, they will earnestly search for me.”
“Come, let us return to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has torn us to pieces; now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will heal us, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has injured us; now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bandage our wounds.
In just a short time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will restore us, so that we may live in His presence.
Oh, that we might know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Let us press on to know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He will respond to us as surely as the arrival of dawn or the coming of rains in early spring.”
“O Yashar'AL and Yahudah, what should I do with you?” asks 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. “For your love vanishes like the morning mist and disappears like dew in the sunlight.
I sent my Nabyms to cut you to pieces to slaughter you with my Dabar, with judgments as in escapable as light.
I want you to show Ahaba (love), not offer sacrifices, I want you to know me more than I want burnt offerings.
But like Adam, you broke my covenant and betrayed my trust.
“Gilaad is a city of sinners, tracked with footprints of blood.
Kuhanym form bands of robbers, waiting in ambush for their victims, they murder travelers along the road to Shacham and practice every kind of sin.
Yes, I have seen something horrible in Aphraim and Yashar'AL, My people are defiled by prostituting themselves with idols!
“O Yahudah, a harvest of punishment is also waiting for you, though I wanted to restore the fortunes of my people.
“I want to heal Yashar'AL, but its sins are too great, Samaria is filled with liars, thieves are on the inside and bandits on the outside!
Its people don’t realize that I am watching them, their sinful deeds are all around them, and I see them all.
“The people entertain the king with their wickedness, and the princes laugh at their lies.
They are all adulterers, always aflame with lust, they are like an oven that is kept hot while the baker is kneading the dough.
On royal holidays, the princes get drunk with wine, carousing with those who mock them.
Their hearts are like an oven blazing with intrigue, their plot smolders through the night, and in the morning it breaks out like a raging fire.
Burning like an oven, they consume their leaders, they kill their kings one after another, and no one cries to me for help.
“The people of Yashar'AL mingle with unrighteous foreigners, making themselves as worthless as a half-baked cake!
Worshiping of foreign nations idols has sapped their strength, but they don’t even know it, their hair is gray, but they don’t realize they are old and weak.
Their arrogance testifies against them, yet they do not return to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH or even try to find 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“The people of Yashar'AL have become like silly, witless doves, first calling to Mitzraym, then flying to Assyria for help.
But as they fly about, I will throw my net over them and bring them down like a bird from the sky, I will punish them for all the evil they do.
“What sorrow awaits those who have deserted me! Let them die, for they have rebelled against me, I wanted to redeem them, but they have told lies about me.
They do not cry out to me with sincere hearts, Instead, they sit on their couches and wail, they cut themselves, begging foreign nations idols for grain and new wine, and they turn away from me.
I trained them and made them strong, yet now they plot evil against me.

They look everywhere except to AL'ALYUN (The Most High), They are as useless as a crooked bow.Their leaders will be killed by their enemies because of their insolence toward Me. Then the people of Mitzraym will laugh at them.
“Sound the alarm! The enemy descends like an eagle on the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for they have broken my covenant and revolted against my law.
Now Yashar'AL pleads with me, ‘Help us, for you are our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH!’
But it is too late, the people of Yashar'AL have rejected what is good, and now their enemies will chase after them.
The people have appointed kings without my consent, and princes without my approval, By making idols for themselves from their silver and gold, they have brought about their own destruction.
“O Samaria, I reject this calf, this idol you have made, my fury burns against you, how long will you be incapable of innocence?
This calf you worship, O Yashar'AL, was crafted by your own hands! It is not mighty therefore, it must be smashed to bits.
“They have planted the wind and will harvest the whirlwind, the stalks of grain wither and produce nothing to eat, and even if there is any grain, foreigners will eat it.
The people of Yashar'AL have been swallowed up; they lie among the nations like an old discarded pot.
Like a wild donkey looking for a mate, they have gone up to Assyria, the people of Yashar'AL have sold themselves to many lovers.
But though they have sold themselves to many allies, I will now gather them together for judgment, then they will writhe under the burden of the great king.
“Yashar'AL has built many altars to take away sin, but these very altars became places for sinning!
Even though I gave them all my laws, they act as if those laws do not apply to them.

The people love to offer sacrifices to me, feasting on the meat, but I do not accept their sacrifices, I will hold my people accountable for their sins, and I will punish them, they will return to Mitzraym.
Yashar'AL has forgotten its Maker and built great palaces, and Yahudah has fortified its cities, therefore, I will send down fire on their cities and will burn up their fortresses.”
O people of Yashar'AL, do not rejoice as other nations do, for you have been unfaithful to your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, hiring yourselves out like prostitutes, worshiping idols on every threshing floor.
So now your harvests will be too small to feed you, there will be no grapes for making new wine.
You may no longer stay here in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s land, Instead, you will return to Mitzraym, and in Assyria you will eat food that is ceremonially unclean.

There you will make no offerings of wine to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, None of your sacrifices there will please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they will be unclean, like food touched by a person in mourning, All who present such sacrifices will be defiled, they may eat this food themselves, but they may not offer it to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
What then will you do on festival days? How will you observe 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s festivals?
Even if you escape destruction from Assyria, Mitzraym will conquer you, and Mamphis will bury you. Nettles will take over your treasures of silver; thistles will invade your ruined homes.

The time of Yashar'AL’s punishment has come; the day of payment is here, Soon Yashar'AL will know this all too well, Because of your great sin and hostility, you say, “The Nabyms are crazy and the inspired men are fools!”
The Nabym is a watchman over Yashar'AL for my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, yet traps are laid for him wherever he goes, He faces hostility even in the house of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
The things my people do are as depraved as what they did in Gibaah long ago, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not forget, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will surely punish them for their sins.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “O Yashar'AL, when I first found you, it was like finding fresh grapes in the desert, when I saw your ancestors, it was like seeing the first ripe figs of the season, but then they deserted me for Baal-paur, giving themselves to that shameful idol, soon they became vile, as vile as the idols they worshiped.
The kaby of Yashar'AL will fly away like a bird, for your children will not be bornor grow in the womb or even be conceived.
Even if you do have children who grow up, I will take them from you, it will be a terrible day when I turn away and leave you alone.
I have watched Yashar'AL become as beautiful as Tyra, But now Yashar'AL will bring out her children for slaughter.”
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, what should I request for your people? I will ask for wombs that do not give birth and breasts that give no milk.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “All their wickedness began at Gilgal; there I began to hate them, I will drive them from my land because of their evil actions, I will love them no more because all their leaders are rebels.
The people of Yashar'AL are struck down. Their roots are dried up, and they will bear no more fruit, and if they give birth, I will slaughter their beloved children.”
My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will reject the people of Yashar'AL because they will not listen or obey, they will be wanderers, homeless among the nations.

Yashar'AL is prosperous, with a luxuriant vine loaded with fruit, but the richer the people get, the more pagan altars they build, the more bountiful their harvests, the more beautiful their sacred pillars.
The hearts of the people are fickle; they are guilty and must be punished, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will break down their altars and smash their sacred pillars.
Then they will say, “We have no king because we did not fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but even if we had a king, what could he do for us anyway?”
They spout empty words and make covenants they do not intend to keep, so injustice springs up among them like poisonous weeds in a farmer’s field.
The people of Samaria tremble in fear for their calf idol at Bath-aban, and they mourn for it, though its priests rejoice over it, its kabad will be stripped away.
This idol will be carted away to Assyria, a gift to the great king there, Aphraim will be ridiculed and Yashar'AL will be shamed, because its people have trusted in this idol.
Samaria and its king will be cut off; they will float away like driftwood on an ocean wave.

And the pagan shrines of aban, the place of Yashar'AL’s sin, will crumble, Thorns and thistles will grow up around their altars, they will beg the mountains, “Bury us!” and plead with the hills, “Fall on us!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “O Yashar'AL, ever since Gibaah, there has been only sin and more sin! You have made no progress whatsoever, Was it not right that the wicked men of Gibaah were attacked?
Now whenever it fits my plan, I will attack you, too, I will call out the armies of the nations to punish you for your multiplied sins.

“Yashar'AL is like a trained heifer treading out the grain, an easy job she loves, But I will put a heavy yoke on her tender neck, I will force Yahudah to pull the plow and Yashar'AL to break up the hard ground.

I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to you, ‘Plant the good seeds of righteousness, and you will harvest a crop of love, plow up the hard ground of your hearts, for now is the time to seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH may come and shower righteousness upon you.’
“But you have cultivated wickedness and harvested a thriving crop of sins, you have eaten the fruit of lies, trusting in your military might, believing that great armies could make your nation safe.
Now the terrors of war will rise among your people, all your fortifications will fall, just as when Shalman destroyed Bath-arbal, even mothers and children were dashed to death there.
You will share that fate in Bathal, because of your great wickedness, when the day of judgment dawns, the king of Yashar'AL will be completely destroyed.
“When Yashar'AL was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Mitzraym.
But the more I called to him, the farther he moved from me, offering sacrifices to the images of Baal and burning incense to idols.
I myself taught Yashar'AL how to walk, leading him along by the hand, but he doesn’t know or even care that it was I who took care of him.
I led Yashar'AL along with my ropes of kindness and love, I lifted the yoke from his neck, and I myself stooped to feed him.
“But since my people refuse to return to me, they will return to Mitzraym and will be forced to serve Assyria.
War will swirl through their cities; their enemies will crash through their gates, they will destroy them, trapping them in their own evil plans.
For my people are determined to desert me, they call me AL'ALYUN (the Most High), but they don’t truly honor me.
“Oh, how can I give you up, Yashar'AL? How can I let you go? How can I destroy you like Admah or demolish you like Zabuiim? My heart is torn within me, and my compassion overflows.
No, I will not unleash my fierce anger, I will not completely destroy Yashar'AL, for I Am 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and not a mere mortal, I Am the Qadash One living among you, and I will not come to destroy.
For someday the people will follow me, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will roar like a lion, and when I roar, My people will return trembling from the west.
Like a flock of birds, they will come from Mitzraym, Trembling like doves, they will return from Assyria, and I will bring them home again,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yashar'AL surrounds me with lies and deceit, but Yahudah still obeys 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and is faithful to the Qadash One.

The people of Yashar'AL feed on the wind; they chase after the east wind all day long, they pile up lies and violence; they are making an alliance with Assyria while sending olive oil to buy support from Mitzraym.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is bringing charges against Yahudah, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is about to punish Ya'aqub for all his deceitful ways, and pay him back for all he has done.
Even in the womb, Ya'aqub struggled with his brother; when he became a man, he even fought with 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Yes, Ya'aqub wrestled with the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and won, Ya'aqub wept and pleaded for a Barakah from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. There at Bathal he met his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH face to face, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to him
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shamaym’s Armies, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is His Name!
So now, come back to your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, Act with love and justice, and always depend on Him.
But no, the people are like crafty merchants selling from dishonest scales, they love to cheat.
Yashar'AL boasts, “I am rich! I have made a fortune all by myself! No one has caught me cheating! My record is spotless!”
“But I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who rescued you from slavery in Mitzraym, and I will make you live in tents again, as you do each year at the Festival of Shelters.
I sent my Nabyms to warn you with many visions and parables.”
But the people of Gilaad are worthless because of their idol worship, and in Gilgal, too, they sacrifice bulls; their altars are lined up like the heaps of stone along the edges of a plowed field.
Ya'aqub fled to the land of Aram, and there he earned a wife by tending sheep.
Then by a Nabym 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought Ya'aqub’s descendants out of Mitzraym; and by that Nabym they were protected.
But the people of Yashar'AL have bitterly provoked 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will now sentence them to death in payment for their sins.
When the tribe of Aphraim spoke, the people shook with fear, for that tribe was important in Yashar'AL, but the people of Aphraim sinned by worshiping Baal and thus sealed their destruction.
Now they continue to sin by making silver idols, images shaped skillfully with man's hands.“Sacrifice to these,” they cry, “and kiss the calf idols!”
Therefore, they will disappear like the morning mist, like dew in the morning sun, like chaff blown by the wind, like smoke from a chimney.
“I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH ever since I brought you out of Mitzraym, You must SERVE and WORSHIP only ME 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for there is no other SAVIOR.
I took care of you in the wilderness, in that dry and thirsty land.
But when you had eaten and were satisfied, you became proud and forgot me.
So now I will attack you like a lion, like a leopard that lurks along the road.
Like a bear whose cubs have been taken away, I will tear out your heart, I will devour you like a hungry lioness and mangle you like a wild animal.
“You are about to be destroyed, O Yashar'AL yes, by me, your only helper.
Now where is your king? Let him save you! Where are all the leaders of the land, the king and the officials you demanded of me?
In my anger I gave you kings, and in my fury I took them away.
“Aphraim’s guilt has been collected, and his sin has been stored up for punishment.
Pain has come to the people like the pain of childbirth, but they are like a child who resists being born, the moment of birth has arrived, but they stay in the womb!
“Should I ransom them from the grave? Should I redeem them from death? O death, bring on your terrors! O grave, bring on your plagues! For I will not take pity on them.

Aphraim was the most fruitful of all his brothers, but the east wind a blast from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will arise in the desert, all their flowing springs will run dry, and all their wells will disappear, every precious thing they own will be plundered and carried away.

The people of Samaria must bear the consequences of their guilt because they rebelled against their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, they will be killed by an invading army, their little ones dashed to death against the ground, their pregnant women ripped open by swords.”
Return, O Yashar'AL, return to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for your sins have brought you down.
Bring your confessions, and return to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Say to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Forgive all our sins and graciously receive us, so that we may offer you our Yadah.
Assyria cannot save us, nor can our war horses, we will never say to the idols we have made, ‘You are our deity, in you alone O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH do the orphans find mercy.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I will heal you of your faithlessness; My love will know no bounds, for My anger will be gone forever.
I will be to Yashar'AL like a refreshing dew from Shamaym, Yashar'AL will blossom like the lily; it will send roots deep into the soil like the cedars in Labanun.
Its branches will spread out like beautiful olive trees, as fragrant as the cedars of Labanun.
My people will again live under my shade. They will flourish like grain and blossom like grapevines, They will be as fragrant as the wines of Labanun.
“O Yashar'AL, stay away from idols! I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I Am the one who answers your prayers and cares for you, I AM like a tree that is always green; all your fruit comes from me.”

Let those who are wise understand these things, Let those with discernment listen carefully, The paths of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are true and right, and righteous people live by walking in them, But in those paths sinners stumble and fall.

books.name: Joel
chapters: Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave this message to Yual son of Pathual.
Hear this, you leaders of the people, Listen, all who live in the land, in all your history, has anything like this happened before?
Tell your children about it in the years to come, and let your children tell their children. Pass the story down from generation to generation.
After the cutting locusts finished eating the crops, the swarming locusts took what was left! After them came the hopping locusts, and then the stripping locusts, too!
Wake up, you drunkards, and weep! Wail, all you wine-drinkers! All the grapes are ruined, and all your sweet wine is gone.
A vast army of locusts had invaded my land, a terrible army too numerous to count, their teeth are like the teeth of a lion, and their fangs are like those of a lioness.
They destroyed my grapevines and ruined my fig trees, stripping their bark and destroying it, leaving the branches white and bare.
Weep like a bride dressed in black, mourning the death of her husband.
For there is no grain or wine to offer at the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, So the Kuhanym are in mourning, the ministers of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are weeping.
The fields are ruined, the land is stripped bare, the grain is destroyed, the grapes have shriveled, and the olive oil is gone.
Despair, all you farmers! Wail, all you vine growers! Weep, because the wheat and barley, all the crops of the field are ruined.
The grapevines have dried up, and the fig trees have withered, the pomegranate trees, palm trees, and apple trees, all the fruit trees have dried up, and the people’s joy has dried up with them.

Dress yourselves in burlap and weep, you Kuhanym! Wail, you who serve before the altar! Come, spend the night in burlap, you ministers of my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for there is no grain or wine to offer at the Temple of your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Announce a time of fasting; call the people together for a solemn meeting, bring the leaders and all the people of the land into the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and cry out to him there.
The day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is near, the day when destruction comes from the AL'Mighty. How terrible that day will be!
Our food disappears before our very eyes. No joyful celebrations are held in the house of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
The seeds die in the parched ground, and the grain crops fail, the barns stand empty, and granaries are abandoned.
How the animals moan with hunger! The herds of cattle wander about confused, because they have no pasture, The flocks of sheep and goats bleat in misery.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, help us! The fire has consumed the wilderness pastures, and flames have burned up all the trees.
Even the wild animals cry out to you because the streams have dried up, and fire has consumed the wilderness pastures.
Sound the trumpet in Yahushalam! Raise the alarm on my Qadash mountain! Let everyone tremble in fear because the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is upon us.

It is a day of darkness and gloom, a day of thick clouds and deep blackness, suddenly, like dawn spreading across the mountains, a great and mighty army appears, nothing like it has been seen before or will ever be seen again.
Fire burns in front of them, and flames follow after them, ahead of them the land lies as beautiful as the Garden of Adan, behind them is nothing but desolation; not one thing escapes.
They look like horses; they charge forward like warhorses.

Look at them as they leap along the mountain tops, Listen to the noise they make, like the rumbling of chariots, like the roar of fire sweeping across a field of stubble, or like a mighty army moving into battle.
Fear grips all the people; every face grows pale with terror.
The attackers march like warriors and scale city walls like soldiers, straight forward they march, never breaking rank.
They never jostle each other; each moves in exactly the right position, they break through defenses without missing a step.
They swarm over the city and run along its walls, they enter all the houses, climbing like thieves through the windows.
The Arath quakes as they advance, and the Shamaym tremble, the sun and moon grow dark, and the stars no longer shine.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is at the head of the column, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH leads them with a shout, this is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's mighty army, and they follow His orders, the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is an awesome and terrible thing, who can possibly survive?
That is why 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Turn to me now, while there is time, give me your hearts, Come with fasting, weeping, and mourning.

Do not tear your clothing in your grief, but tear your hearts instead, ”Return to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is merciful and compassionate, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is eager to relent and not punish.
Who knows? Perhaps he will give you a reprieve, sending you a Barakah instead of this curse, Perhaps you will be able to offer grain and wine to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH as before.
Blow the ram’s horn in Yahushalam! Announce a time of fasting; call the people together for a solemn meeting.
Gather all the people, the elders, the children, and even the babies, call the bridegroom from his quarters and the bride from her private room.

Let the Kuhanym, who minister in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s presence, stand and weep between the entry room to the Temple and the altar, Let them pray, “Spare your people, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Do not let your special possession become an object of mockery, do not let them become a joke for unbelieving foreigners who say, ‘Has the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL left them?’”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will pity his people and jealously guard the honor of His land.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Look! I AM sending you grain and new wine and olive oil, enough to satisfy your needs, you will no longer be an object of mockery among the surrounding nations.

I will drive away these armies from the north, I will send them into the parched wastelands, those in the front will be driven into the Dead Sea, and those at the rear into the Mediterranean, the stench of their rotting bodies will rise over the land.” Surely 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done great things!
Do not be afraid, O land, be glad now and rejoice, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done great things.
Do not be afraid, you animals of the field, for the wilderness pastures will soon be green, the trees will again be filled with fruit; fig trees and grapevines will be loaded down once more.
Rejoice, you people of Yahushalam! Rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH! For the rain he sends demonstrates his faithfulness. Once more the autumn rains will come, as well as the rains of spring.
The threshing floors will again be piled high with grain, and the presses will overflow with new wine and olive oil.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I will give you back what you lost to the swarming locusts, the hopping locusts, the stripping locusts, and the cutting locusts. It was I who sent this great destroying army against you.
Once again you will have all the food you want, and you will Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who does these miracles for you, Never again will My people be dishonored.
Then you will know that I Am among My people Yashar'AL, that I AM 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and there is no other. Never again will my people be put to shame.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, in the last days, I will pour out my RUACH upon all flesh, your sons and daughters will prophesy, Your old men will dream dreams, and your young men will see visions.
In those days I will pour out my RUACH even on servants, men and women alike.
And I will cause wonders in the Shamaym and on the Arath, blood and fire and columns of smoke.
The sun will become dark, and the moon will turn blood red before that great and terrible day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH arrives.

But anyone who calls on the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be saved, for some on Mount Ziun in Yahushalam will escape, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has Dabar. These will be among the survivors whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has called.
“At the time of those events,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “when I restore the prosperity of Yahudah and Yahushalam,

I will gather the armies of the world into the valley of Yahushaphat, there I will judge them for harming my people, My special possession, for scattering My people among the nations, and for dividing up my land.
They threw dice to decide which of my people would be their slaves, they traded boys to obtain prostitutes and sold girls for enough wine to get drunk.

“What do you have against me, Tyra and Sidun and you cities of Philistia? Are you trying to take revenge on me? If you are, then watch out! I will strike swiftly and pay you back for everything you have done.
You have taken my silver and gold and all my precious treasures, and have carried them off to your pagan temples.
You have sold the people of Yahudah and Yahushalam to the Greeks, so they could take them far from their homeland.
“But I will bring them back from all the places to which you sold them, and I will pay you back for everything you have done.
I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Yahudah, and they will sell them to the people of Arabia, a nation far away,
Say to the nations far and wide: “Get ready for war! Call out your best warriors, Let all your fighting men advance for the attack.
Hammer your plowshares into swords and your pruning hooks into spears, Train even your weaklings to be warriors.
Come quickly, all you nations everywhere. Gather together in the valley.”
“Let the nations be called to arms, Let them march to the valley of Yahushaphat, there I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, will sit to pronounce judgment on them all.
Swing the sickle, for the harvest is ripe, come, tread the grapes, for the winepress is full, the storage vats are overflowing with the wickedness of these people.”
Thousands upon thousands are waiting in the valley of decision, there the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will soon arrive.
The sun and moon will grow dark, and the stars will no longer shine.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s voice will roar from Ziun and thunder from Yahushalam and the Shamaym and the Arath will shake, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be a refuge for His people, a strong fortress for the people of Yashar'AL.
“Then you will know that I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH live in Ziun, my Qadash mountain, Yahushalam will be Qadash forever, and foreign armies will never conquer her again.

In that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine, and the hills will flow with milk, water will fill the stream beds of Yahudah, and a fountain will burst forth from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple, watering the arid valley of acacias.
But Mitzraym will become a wasteland and Adum will become a wilderness, because they attacked the people of Yahudah and killed innocent people in their land.
“But Yahudah will be filled with people forever, and Yahushalam will endure through all generations.
I will pardon My people’s crimes, which I have not yet pardoned; and I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, will make My home in Yahushalam with my people.”

books.name: Amos
chapters: This message was given to Amus, a shepherd from the town of Takua in Yahudah, he received this message in visions two years before the earthquake, when Uzzyahu was king of Yahudah and Yarubuam II, the son of Yahuash, was king of Yashar'AL.
This is what he saw and heard: “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s voice will roar from Ziun and thunder from Yahushalam! The lush pastures of the shepherds will dry up; the grass on Mount Carmel will wither and die.”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “The people of Damascus have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They beat down my people in Gilaad as grain is threshed with iron sledges.
So I will send down fire on King Hazaal’s palace, and the fortresses of King Ban-hadad will be destroyed.
I will break down the gates of Damascus and slaughter the people in the valley of Aban, I will destroy the ruler in Bath-adan, and the people of Aram will go as captives to Kir,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “The people of Gaza have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They sent whole villages into exile, selling them as slaves to Adum.
So I will send down fire on the walls of Gaza, and all its fortresses will be destroyed.
I will slaughter the people of Ashdud and destroy the king of Ashkalun, then I will turn to attack Akrun, and the few Philistines still left will be killed,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “The people of Tyra have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They broke their treaty of brotherhood with Yashar'AL, selling whole villages as slaves to Adum.
So I will send down fire on the walls of Tyra, and all its fortresses will be destroyed.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “The people of Adum have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They chased down their relatives, the Yasharalym, with swords, showing them no mercy, in their rage, they slashed them continually and were unrelenting in their anger.
So I will send down fire on Taman, and the fortresses of Buzrah will be destroyed.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “The people of Ammun have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! When they attacked Gilaad to extend their borders, they ripped open pregnant women with their swords.
So I will send down fire on the walls of Rabbah, and all its fortresses will be destroyed, the battle will come upon them with shouts, like a whirlwind in a mighty storm.
And their king and his princes will go into exile together,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “The people of Muab have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They desecrated the bones of Adum’s king, burning them to ashes.
So I will send down fire on the land of Muab, and all the fortresses in Kariuth will be destroyed, the people will fall in the noise of battle, as the warriors shout and the ram’s horn sounds.
And I will destroy their king and slaughter all their princes,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “The people of Yahudah have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They have rejected the instruction of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, refusing to obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's decrees, they have been led astray by the same lies that deceived their ancestors.
So I will send down fire on Yahudah, and all the fortresses of Yahushalam will be destroyed.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “The people of Yashar'AL have sinned again and again, and I will not let them go unpunished! They sell honorable people for silver and poor people for a pair of sandals.
They trample helpless people in the dust and shove the oppressed out of the way, both father and son sleep with the same woman, corrupting my Qadash Name.
At their religious festivals, they lounge in clothing their debtors put up as security, in the house of their idols, they drink wine bought with unjust fines.
“But as my people watched, I destroyed the Amurites, though they were as tall as cedars and as strong as oaks, I destroyed the fruit on their branches and dug out their roots.
It was I who rescued you from Mitzraym and led you through the desert for forty years, so you could possess the land of the Amurites.
I chose some of your sons to be Nabyms and others to be Nazirites, Can you deny this, my people of Yashar'AL? asks 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“But you caused the Nazirites to sin by making them drink wine, and you commanded the Nabyms, ‘To shut up!’
“So I will make you groan like a wagon loaded down with sheaves of grain.
Your fastest runners will not get away. The strongest among you will become weak, Even mighty warriors will be unable to save themselves.
The archers will not stand their ground, the swiftest runners won’t be fast enough to escape, Even those riding horses won’t be able to save themselves.
On that day the most courageous of your fighting men will drop their weapons and run for their lives,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Listen to this message that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken against you, O people of Yashar'AL, against the entire family I rescued from Mitzraym:
“From among all the families on the Arath, I have been intimate with you alone, that is why I must punish you for all your sins.”
Can two people walk together without agreeing on the direction?
Does a lion ever roar in a thicket without first finding a victim? Does a young lion growl in its den without first catching its prey?
Does a bird ever get caught in a trap that has no bait? Does a trap spring shut when there is nothing to catch?
When the ram’s horn blows a warning, should the people not be alarmed? Does disaster come to a city unless 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has planned it?
Indeed, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut never does anything until he reveals his plans to his servants the Nabyms.
The lion has roared, so who is not frightened? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut has spoken, so who can refuse to proclaim the message of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
Announce this to the leaders of Philistia and to the great ones of Mitzraym: “Take your seats now on the hills around Samaria, and witness the chaos and oppression in Yashar'AL.”
“My people have forgotten how to do right,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Their fortresses are filled with wealth taken by theft and violence.
Therefore,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “an enemy is coming, he will surround them and shatter their defenses, Then he will plunder all their fortresses.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “A shepherd who tries to rescue a sheep from a lion’s mouth will recover only two legs or a piece of an ear, So it will be for the Yasharalym in Samaria lying on luxurious beds, and for the people of Damascus reclining on couches.
“Now listen to this, and announce it throughout all Yashar'AL,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
“On the very day I punish Yashar'AL for its sins, I will destroy the pagan altars at Bathal, the horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.
And I will destroy the beautiful homes of the wealthy, their winter mansions and their summer houses, with all their palaces filled with ivory,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Listen to me, you fat cows living in Samaria, you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy, and who are always calling to your husbands, “Bring us another drink!”
The Sovereign 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sworn this by his Qadash Name: “The time will come when you will be led away with hooks in your noses, every last one of you will be dragged away like a fish on a hook!
You will be led out through the ruins of the wall; you will be thrown from your fortresses,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Go ahead and offer sacrifices to the idols at Bathal, Keep on disobeying at Gilgal, offer sacrifices each morning, and bring your tithes every three days.

Present your bread made with yeast as an offering of thanksgiving, then give your extra voluntary offerings so you can brag about it everywhere! This is the kind of thing you Yasharalym love to do,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“I brought hunger to every city and famine to every town, but still you would not return to me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“I kept the rain from falling when your crops needed it the most, I sent rain on one town but withheld it from another, rain fell on one field, while another field withered away.
People staggered from town to town looking for water, but there was never enough, but still you would not return to me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“I struck your farms and vineyards with blight and mildew, Locusts devoured all your fig and olive trees, but still you would not return to me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“I sent plagues on you like the plagues I sent on Mitzraym long ago, I killed your young men in war and led all your horses away, the stench of death filled the air! But still you would not return to me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“I destroyed some of your cities, as I destroyed Sudum and Gumorrah, those of you who survived were like charred sticks pulled from a fire, but still you would not return to me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Therefore, I will bring upon you all the disasters I have announced, Prepare to meet your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH in judgment, you people of Yashar'AL!”

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the one who shaped the mountains, stirs up the winds, and reveals his thoughts to mankind, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turns the light of dawn into darkness and treads on the heights of the Arath, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is His Name!
Listen, you people of Yashar'AL! Listen to this funeral song I am singing:
“The virgin Yashar'AL has fallen, never to rise again! She lies abandoned on the ground, with no one to help her up.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “When a city sends a thousand men to battle, only a hundred will return, when a town sends a hundred, only ten will come back alive.”
Now this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to the family of Yashar'AL: “Come back to me and live!

Do not worship at the pagan altars at Bathal; do not go to the shrines at Gilgal or Baarshaba, for the people of Gilgal will be dragged off into exile, and the people of Bathal will be reduced to nothing.”
Come back to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and live! Otherwise, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will roar through Yashar'AL like a fire, devouring you completely, your lifeless idols in Bathal can not quench the flames.
You twist justice, making it a bitter pill for the oppressed, You treat the righteous like dirt.

It is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who created the stars, the Pleiades and Orion, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turns darkness into morning and day into night, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH draws up water from the oceans and pours it down as rain on the land. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is His Name!
With blinding speed and power 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH destroys the strong, crushing all their defenses.
How you hate honest judges! How you despise people who tell the truth!

You trample the poor, stealing their grain through taxes and unfair rent, therefore, though you build beautiful stone houses, you will never live in them, though you plant lush vineyards, you will never drink wine from them.
For I know the vast number of your sins and the depth of your rebellions, you oppress good people by taking bribes and deprive the poor of justice in the courts.
So those who are smart keep their mouths shut, for it is an evil time.
Do what is good and run from evil so that you may live! Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will be your helper, just as you have claimed.
Hate evil and love what is good; turn your courts into true halls of justice, perhaps even yet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will have mercy on the remnant of His people.

Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shamaym Armies Dabar: “There will be crying in all the public squares and mourning in every street, call for the farmers to weep with you, and summon professional mourners to wail.
There will be wailing in every vineyard, for I will destroy them all,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
What sorrow awaits you who say, “If only the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH were here! ”You have no idea what you are wishing for, That day will bring darkness, not light.
In that day you will be like a man who runs from a lion, only to meet a bear, escaping from the bear, he leans his hand against a wall in his house and he is bitten by a snake.
Yes, the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be dark and hopeless, without a ray of joy or hope.
“I hate all your shows and pretense the hypocrisy of your festivals and solemn assemblies.
I will not accept your burnt offerings and grain offerings, I won’t even notice all your choice Shalum offerings.
Away with your noisy hymns of Yadah! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
Instead, I want to see a mighty flood of justice, an endless river of righteous living.
“Was it to me you were bringing sacrifices and offerings during the forty years in the wilderness, you Yashar'AL?
No, you served your pagan idols, Sakkuth your king idol and Kaiwan your star idol the images you made for yourselves.
So I will send you into exile, to a land east of Damascus,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
What sorrow awaits you who lounge in luxury in Yahushalam, and you who feel secure in Samaria! You are famous and popular in Yashar'AL, and people go to you for help.
But go over to Calnah and see what happened there, then go to the great city of Hamath and down to the Philistine city of Gath, you are no better than they were, and look at how they were destroyed.
You push away every thought of coming disaster, but your actions only bring the day of judgment closer.
How terrible for you who sprawl on ivory beds and lounge on your couches, eating the meat of tender lambs from the flock and of choice calves fattened in the stall.
You sing trivial songs to the sound of the harp and fancy yourselves to be great musicians like king Daud.
You drink wine by the bowlful and perfume yourselves with fragrant lotions. You care nothing about the ruin of your nation.
Therefore, you will be the first to be led away as captives, suddenly, all your parties will end.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sworn by His own Name, and this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shamaym Armies, Dabar: “I despise the arrogance of Yashar'AL, and I hate their fortresses, I will give this city and everything in it to their enemies.”
If there are ten men left in one house, they will all die.

And when a relative who is responsible to dispose of the dead goes into the house to carry out the bodies, he will ask the last survivor, “Is anyone else with you?” When the person begins to swear, “No,” he will interrupt and say, “Stop! Do not even mention the name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives the command, homes both great and small will be smashed to pieces.
Can horses gallop over boulders? Can oxen be used to plow them? But that is how foolish you are when you turn justice into poison and the sweet fruit of righteousness into bitterness.
And you brag about your conquest of Lu-dabar, you boast, “Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?”

“O people of Yashar'AL, I am about to bring an enemy nation against you,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut. “They will oppress you throughout your land, from Labu-hamath in the north to the Arabah Valley in the south.”

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed me a vision, I saw him preparing to send a vast swarm of locusts over the land, This was after the king’s share had been harvested from the fields and as the main crop was coming up.
In my vision the locusts ate every green plant in sight, Then I said, “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, please forgive us or we will not survive, for Yashar'AL is so small.”
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH relented from this plan, and Dabar, “I will not do it.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed me another vision, I saw him preparing to punish his people with a great fire, the fire had burned up the depths of the sea and was devouring the entire land.
Then I said, “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, please stop or we will not survive, for Yashar'AL is so small.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH relented from this plan, too. And He Dabar, “I will not do that either.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed me another vision, I saw 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH standing beside a wall that had been built using a plumb line, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was using a plumb line to see if it was still straight.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to me, “Amus, what do you see?” I answered, “A plumb line.” And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH replied, “I will test my people with this plumb line, I will no longer ignore all their sins.
The pagan shrines of your ancestors will be ruined, and the temples of Yashar'AL will be destroyed; I will bring the dynasty of King Yarubuam to a sudden end.”
Then Amazyahu, the priest of Bathal, sent a message to Yarubuam, king of Yashar'AL: “Amus is hatching a plot against you right here on your very doorstep! What he is saying is intolerable.
He is saying, ‘Yarubuam will soon be killed, and the people of Yashar'AL will be sent away into exile.’”
Then Amazyahu sent orders to Amus: “Get out of here, you Nabym! Go on back to the land of Yahudah, and earn your living by prophesying there!
Do not bother us with your prophecies here in Bathal. This is the king’s sanctuary and the national place of worship!”
But Amus replied, “I’m not a professional Nabym, and I was never trained to be one. I am just a shepherd, and I take care of sycamore-fig trees.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called me away from my flock and told me, ‘Go and prophesy to my people in Yashar'AL.’
Now then, listen to this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “You say,‘ do not prophesy against Yashar'AL, Stop preaching against my people.’

But this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘Your wife will become a prostitute in this city, and your sons and daughters will be killed, your land will be divided up, and you yourself will die in a foreign land, and the people of Yashar'AL will certainly become captives in exile, far from their homeland.’”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed me another vision, In it I saw a basket filled with ripe fruit.
“What do you see, Amus?” He asked, I replied, “A basket full of ripe fruit.”
In that day the singing in the Temple will turn to wailing, dead bodies will be scattered everywhere, they will be carried out of the city in silence, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have spoken!”
Listen to this, you who rob the poor and trample down the needy!
