You cannot wait for the Shabbat day to be over and the festivals to end so you can get back to cheating the helpless, you measure out grain with dishonest measures and cheat the buyer with dishonest scales.
And you mix the grain you sell with chaff swept from the floor, then you enslave poor people for one piece of silver or a pair of sandals.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sworn this oath by his own Name, the Pride of Yashar'AL: “I will never forget the wicked things you have done!
The earth will tremble for your deeds, and everyone will mourn, the ground will rise like the Nile River at floodtime; it will heave up, then sink again.
“In that day,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I will make the sun go down at noon and darken the Arath while it is still day.

I will turn your celebrations into times of mourning and your singing into weeping, you will wear funeral clothes and shave your heads to show your sorrow, as if your only son had died, How very bitter that day will be!
“The time is surely coming,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH “when I will send a famine on the land, not a famine of bread or water but of hearing the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
People will stagger from sea to sea and wander from border to border searching for the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH but they will not find it.
Beautiful girls and strong young men will grow faint in that day, thirsting for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Dabar.
And those who swear by the shameful idols of Samaria, who take oaths in the Name of the idol of Dan and make vows in the name of the idol of Baarshaba, they will all fall down, never to rise again.”

Then I saw a vision of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH standing beside the altar, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Strike the tops of the Temple's columns, so that the foundation will shake, bring down the roof on the heads of the people below, I will kill with the sword those who survive, No one will escape!
“Even if they dig down to the place of the dead, I will reach down and pull them up, even if they climb up into the Shamaym, I will bring them down.
Even if they hide at the very top of Mount Carmel, I will search them out and capture them, Even if they hide at the bottom of the ocean, I will send the sea serpent after them to bite them.
Even if their enemies drive them into exile, I will command the sword to kill them there, I am determined to bring disaster upon them and not to help them.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, touches the land and it melts, and all its people mourn, the ground rises like the Nile River at floodtime, and then it sinks again.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s home reaches up to the Shamaym, while its foundation is on the Arath, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH draws up water from the oceans and pours it down as rain on the land, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is His Name!
“Are you Yasharalym more important to Me than the Athiupians? “I brought Yashar'AL out of Mitzraym, but I also brought the Philistines from Crata and led the Arameans out of Kir.
“I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Am watching this sinful nation of Yashar'AL, I will destroy it from the face of the Arath, but I will never completely destroy the family of Yashar'AL,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“For I will give the command and will shake Yashar'AL along with the other nations as grain is shaken in a sieve, yet not one true kernel will be lost.
But all the sinners will die by the sword, all those who say, ‘Nothing bad will happen to us.’
“In that day I will restore the fallen house of Daud, I will repair its damaged walls, From the ruins I will rebuild it and restore its former kabad.
And Yashar'AL will possess what is left of Adum and all the nations I have called to be mine, ”𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will do these things.
“The time will come, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “when the grain and grapes will grow faster than they can be harvested, Then the terraced vineyards on the hills of Yashar'AL will drip with sweet wine!

I will bring my exiled people of Yashar'AL back from distant lands, and they will rebuild their ruined cities and live in them again, they will plant vineyards and gardens; they will eat their crops and drink their wine.
I will firmly plant them there in their own land, they will never again be uprooted from the land I have given them,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

books.name: Obadiah
chapters: The vision of Ubadyahu,: Thus says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut concerning Adum (We have heard a report from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and a messenger has been sent among the nations, saying, “Arise, and let us rise up against her for battle”):
“Behold, I will make you small among the nations; You shall be greatly despised.
The pride of your heart has deceived you, For you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, Whose habitation is high; You who say in your heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’
Though you ascend as high as the eagle, and though you set your nest among the stars, From there I will bring you down,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

“If thieves had come to you, If robbers by night, Oh how you will be cut off!, Would they not have stolen till they had enough? If grape-gatherers had come to you, Would they not have left some gleanings?
“Oh, how Ásau shall be searched out! How his hidden treasures shall be sought after!

All the men in your confederacy Shall force you to the border; The men at Shalum with you Shall deceive you and prevail against you. Those who eat your bread shall lay a trap for you, No one is aware of it.
“Will I not in that day,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “Even destroy the wise men from Ádum, and understanding from the mountains of Ásau?
Then your mighty men, O Taman, shall be dismayed, to the end that everyone from the mountains of Ásau may be cut off by slaughter.
“For violence against your brother Ya'aqub, Shame shall cover you, and you shall be cut off forever.
In the day that you stood on the other side, In the day that strangers carried captive his forces, When foreigners entered his gates and cast lots for Yahushalam, Even you were as one of them.

“But you should not have gazed on the day of your brother In the day of his captivity; Nor should you have rejoiced over the children of Yahudah In the day of their destruction; Nor should you have spoken proudly In the day of distress.

You should not have entered the gate of My people In the day of their calamity, Indeed, you should not have gazed on their affliction In the day of their calamity, nor laid hands on their substance In the day of their calamity.
You should not have stood at the cross roads to cut off those among them who escaped; Nor should you have delivered up those among them who remained In the day of distress.
“For the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH upon all the nations is near; as you have done, it shall be done to you; your reprisal shall return upon your own head.
For as you drank on My Qadash mountain, So shall all the nations drink continually; Yes, they shall drink, and swallow, and they shall be as though they had never been.
“But on Mount Ziun there shall be deliverance and there shall be righteousness; The house of Ya'aqub shall possess their possessions.

The house of Ya'aqub shall be a fire, and the house of Ya'asaf a flame; But the house of Ásau shall be stubble; They shall kindle them and devour them, and no survivor shall remain of the house of Ásau, ”For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken.
The South shall possess the mountains of Ásau, and the Low land shall possess Philistia, They shall possess the fields of Àphraim and the fields of Samaria, Banyamin shall possess Gilaad.

And the captives of this host of the children of Yashar'AL Shall possess the land of the Canaanites as far as Zaraphath, the captives of Yahushalam who are in Sapharad Shall possess the cities of the South.
Then saviors shall come to Mount Ziun to judge the mountains of Ásau, and the kingdom shall be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's kingdom.

books.name: Jonah
chapters: Now the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came to Yunah the son of Amittai, saying,
“Arise, go to Ninabah, that great city, and cry out against it; for their wickedness has come up before Me.”

But Yunah arose to flee to Tarshish from the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He went down to Yuppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid the fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent out a great wind on the Yam (sea), and there was a mighty tempest on the sea, so that the ship was about to be broken up.

Then the mariners were afraid; and every man cried out to his idols, and threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea, to lighten the load. But Yunah had gone down into the lowest parts of the ship, and had lain down, and was fast asleep.
So the captain came to him, and said to him, “What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH; perhaps your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will consider us, so that we may not perish.”
And they said to one another, “Come, let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this trouble has come upon us.” So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Yunah.
Then they said to him, “Please tell us! For whose cause is this trouble upon us? What is your occupation? And where do you come from? What is your country? And of what people are you?”
So he said to them, “I am an Abaryt (Hebrew) and I fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shamaym, who made the YAM (sea) and the dry land.”
Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, “Why have you done this?” For the men knew that he fled from the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, because he had told them.
Then they said to Yunah, “What shall we do to you that the sea may be calm for us?” for the sea was growing more tempestuous.
And he said to them, “Pick me up and throw me into the sea; then the sea will become calm for you, For I know that this great tempest is because of me.”
Nevertheless the men rowed hard to return to land, but they could not, for the sea continued to grow more tempestuous against them.

Therefore they cried out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and said, “We pray, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, please do not let us perish for this man’s life, and do not charge us with innocent blood; for You, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, have done as it pleased You.”
So they picked up Yunah and threw him into the sea, and the sea ceased from its raging.
Then the men feared 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and took vows.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had prepared a great fish to swallow Yunah, and Yunah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
Then Yunah prayed to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH from the fish’s belly.
And he said: “I cried out to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, because of my affliction, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH answered me. Out of the belly of grave (hell) I cried, and You heard my voice.
For You cast me into the deep, Into the heart of the seas, and the floods surrounded me; all Your billows and Your waves passed over me.
Then I said, ‘I have been cast out of Your sight; Yet I will look again toward Your Qadash temple.’
The waters surrounded me, even to my soul; The deep closed around me; weeds were wrapped around my head.
I went down to the moorings of the mountains; The Arath with its bars closed behind me forever; Yet You have brought up my life from the pit, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
“When my soul fainted within me, I remembered 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and my prayer went up to You, Into Your Qadash temple.
“Those who regard worthless idols forsake their own Mercy.
But I will sacrifice to You with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay what I have vowed, Salvation is of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to the fish, and it vomited Yunah onto dry land.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke to Yunah a second time:
“Get up and go to the great city of Ninabah, and deliver the message I have given you.”
This time Yunah obeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s command and went to Ninabah, a city so large that it took three days to see it all.
On the day Yunah entered the city, he shouted to the crowds: “Forty days from now Ninabah will be destroyed!”
The people of Ninabah believed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s message, and from the greatest to the least, they declared a fast and put on burlap to show their sorrow.
When the king of Ninabah heard what Yunah was saying, he stepped down from his throne and took off his royal robes, he dressed himself in burlap and sat on a heap of ashes.
Then the king and his nobles sent this decree throughout the city: “No one, not even the animals from your herds and flocks, may eat or drink anything at all.
People and animals alike must wear garments of mourning, and everyone must pray earnestly to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, They must turn from their evil ways and stop all their violence.
Who can tell? Perhaps even yet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will change His mind and hold back his fierce anger from destroying us.”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saw what they had done and how they had put a stop to their evil ways, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH changed His mind and did not carry out the destruction he had threatened.
This change of plans greatly upset Yunah, and he became very angry.

So he complained to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH about it: “Did I not say before I left home that you would do this, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? That is why I ran away to Tarshish! I knew that you are a merciful and compassionate 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love. You are eager to turn back from destroying people.
Just kill me now, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! I would rather be dead than alive if what I predicted will not happen.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH replied, “Is it right for you to be angry about this?”
Then Yunah went out to the east side of the city and made a shelter to sit under as he waited to see what would happen to the city.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH arranged for a leafy plant to grow there, and soon it spread its broad leaves over Yunah’s head, shading him from the sun, this eased his discomfort, and Yunah was very grateful for the plant.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also arranged for a worm! The next morning at dawn the worm ate through the stem of the plant so that it withered away.

And as the sun grew hot, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH arranged for a scorching east wind to blow on Yunah, the sun beat down on his head until he grew faint and wished to die. “Death is certainly better than living like this!” he exclaimed.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Yunah, “Is it right for you to be angry because the plant died? “Yes,” Yunah retorted, “even angry enough to die!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “You feel sorry about the plant, though you did nothing to put it there, it came quickly and died quickly.
But Ninabah has more than one hundred and twenty thousand people living in spiritual darkness, not to mention all the animals. Should I not feel sorry for such a great city?”

books.name: Micah
chapters: Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave this message to Mikayahu of Murashath during the years when Yutham, Ahaz, and Hazakyahu were kings of Yahudah, the visions he saw concerned both Samaria and Yahushalam.
Attention! Let all the people of the world listen! Let the Arath and everything in it hear, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut is making accusations against you; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH speaks from His Qadash Temple.
Look! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is coming! He leaves His throne in Shamaym and tramples the heights of the Arath.
The mountains melt beneath the feet of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and flow into the valleys like wax in a fire, like water pouring down a hill.

And why is this happening? Because of the rebellion of Yashar'AL, yes the sins of the whole nation, who is to blame for Yashar'AL’s rebellion? Samaria, its capital city! Where is the center of idolatry in Yahudah? In Yahushalam its capital!

“So I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make the city of Samaria a heap of ruins, her streets will be plowed up for planting vineyards, I will roll the stones of her walls into the valley below, exposing her foundations.

All her carved images will be smashed, all her sacred treasures will be burned, these things were bought with the money earned by her prostitution, and they will now be carried away to pay prostitutes elsewhere.”
Therefore, I will mourn and lament, I will walk around barefoot and naked, I will howl like a jackal and moan like an owl.
For my people’s wound is too deep to heal, It has reached into Yahudah, even to the gates of Yahushalam.
Do not tell our enemies in Gath; do not weep at all, you people in Bath-laaphrah, roll in the dust to show your despair.
You people in Shaphir, go as captives into exile, naked and ashamed, the people of Zaanan dare not come outside their walls, the people of Bath-azal mourn, for their house has no support.
The people of Maruth anxiously wait for relief, but only bitterness awaits them as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s judgment reaches even to the gates of Yahushalam.
Harness your chariot horses and flee, you people of Lachish, you were the first city in Yahudah to follow Yashar'AL in her rebellion, and you led Yahushalam into sin.
Send farewell gifts to Murashath-gath; there is no hope of saving it, the town of Aczib has deceived the kings of Yashar'AL.
O people of Marashah, I will bring a conqueror to capture your town, and the leaders of Yashar'AL will go to Adullam.
Oh, people of Yahudah, shave your heads in sorrow, for the children you love will be snatched away, make yourselves as bald as a vulture, for your little ones will be exiled to distant lands.
What sorrow awaits you who lie awake at night, thinking up evil plans, you rise at dawn and hurry to carry them out, simply because you have the power to do so.
When you want a piece of land, you find a way to seize it, when you want someone’s house, you take it by fraud and violence, you cheat a man of his property, stealing his family’s inheritance.
For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “I will reward your evil with evil; you won’t be able to pull your neck out of the noose, you will no longer walk around proudly, for it will be a terrible time.”

In that day your enemies will make fun of you by singing this song of despair about you: “We are finished, completely ruined! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has confiscated our land, taking it from us, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given our fields to those who betrayed us.”
Others will set your boundaries then and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people will have no say in how the land is divided.
“Do not say such things,” the people respond. “Do not prophesy like that, Such disasters will never come our way!”
Should you talk that way, O family of Yashar'AL? Will 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s RUACH have patience with such behavior? If you would do what is right, you would find my words comforting.
Yet to this very hour my people rise against me like an enemy! You steal the shirts right off the backs of those who trusted you, making them as ragged as men returning from battle.
You have evicted women from their pleasant homes and forever stripped their children of all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would give them.
Up! Be gone! This is no longer your land and home, for you have filled it with sin and ruined it completely.
Suppose a prophet full of lies would say to you, “I will preach to you the joys of wine and alcohol! ”That’s just the kind of prophet you would like!

“Someday, O Yashar'AL, I will gather you; I will gather the remnant who are left, I will bring you together again like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture, Yes your land will again be filled with noisy crowds!
Your leader will break out and lead you out of exile, out through the gates of the enemy cities, back to your own land, your king will lead you; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself will guide you.”
I said, “Listen, you leaders of Yashar'AL! You are supposed to know right from wrong,
but you are the very ones who hate good and love evil, you skin my people alive and tear the flesh from their bones.
Yes, you eat my people’s flesh, strip off their skin, and break their bones, you chop them up like meat for the cooking pot.
Then you beg 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for help in times of trouble! Do you really expect 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to answer? After all the evil you have done, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH won’t even look at you!”
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar “You false prophets are leading my people astray! you promise Shalum for those who give you food, but you declare war on those who refuse to feed you.
Now the night will close around you, cutting off all your visions, darkness will cover you, putting an end to your predictions, the sun will set for you prophets, and your day will come to an end.
Then you seers will be put to shame, and you fortune-tellers will be dishonored, and you will cover your faces because there is no answer from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
But as for me, I am filled with power, with the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I am filled with justice and strength to boldly declare Yashar'AL’s sin and rebellion.
Listen to me, you leaders of Yashar'AL! You hate justice and twist all that is right.
You are building Yahushalam on a foundation of murder and corruption.

You rulers make decisions based on bribes; you Kuhanym (priests) teach 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s laws only for a price; you prophets won’t prophesy unless you are paid, Yet all of you claim to depend on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “No harm can come to us,” you say, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is here among us.”
Because of you, Mount Ziun will be plowed like an open field; Yahushalam will be reduced to ruins! A thicket will grow on the heights where the Temple now stands.

In the last days, the mountain of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s house will be the highest of all the most important place on Arath, It will be raised above the other hills, and people from all over the world will stream there to worship.

People from many nations will come and say, “Come, let us go up to the mountain of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to the house of Ya'aqub’s 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, There 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will teach us His ways, and we will walk in the path of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.” For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s teaching will go out from Ziun; and the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will go out from Yahushalam.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will mediate between people and will settle disputes between strong nations far away, they will hammer their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks, Nation will no longer fight against nation, nor train for war anymore.
Everyone will live in Shalum and prosperity, enjoying their own grapevines and fig trees, for there will be nothing to fear, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut has made this promise!
Though the nations around us follow their idols, we will follow 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH forever and ever.
“In that coming day,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will gather together those who are lame, those who have been exiles, and those whom I have filled with grief.
Those who are weak will survive as a remnant; those who were exiles will become a strong nation, then I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will rule from Yahushalam as their Ruler forever.”
As for you Yahushalam, the citadel of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people, your royal might and power will come back to you again, the kingship will be restored to my precious Yahushalam.
But why are you now screaming in terror? Have you no king to lead you? Have your wise people all died? Pain has gripped you like a woman in childbirth.

Writhe and groan like a woman in labor, you people of Yahushalam, for now you must leave this city to live in the open country, You will soon be sent in exile to distant Babylun, But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will rescue you there; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will redeem you from the grip of your enemies.
Now many nations have gathered against you, “Let her be desecrated, they say, Let us see the destruction of Yahushalam.”

But they do not know the thoughts or understand the plans of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, these nations do not know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is gathering them together to be beaten and trampled like sheaves of grain on a threshing floor.

“Rise up and crush the nations, O Yahushalam! says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, For I will give you iron horns and bronze hooves, so you can trample many nations to pieces, you will present their stolen riches to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, their wealth to 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all the Arath.”
Mobilize! Marshal your troops! The enemy is laying siege to Yahushalam, they will strike Yashar'AL’s leader in the face with a rod.
But you, O Bathlaham Aphrathah, are only a small village among all the people of Yahudah, yet a ruler of Yashar'AL, whose origins are in the distant past, will come from you on my behalf.
The people of Yashar'AL will be abandoned to their enemies until the woman in labor gives birth, then at last his fellow country men will return from exile to their own land.

And he will stand to lead his flock with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s strength, in the majesty of the name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH his 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, then his people will live there undisturbed, for he will be highly honored around the world.
And he will be the source of Shalum. When the Assyrians invade our land and break through our defenses, we will appoint seven rulers to watch over us, eight princes to lead us.
They will rule Assyria with drawn swords and enter the gates of the land of Nimrud, he will rescue us from the Assyrians when they pour over the borders to invade our land.

Then the remnant left in Yashar'AL will take their place among the nations, they will be like dew sent by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH or like rain falling on the grass, which no one can hold back and no one can restrain.

The remnant left in Yashar'AL will take their place among the nations, they will be like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a strong young lion among flocks of sheep and goats, pouncing and tearing as they go with no rescuer in sight.
The people of Yashar'AL will stand up to their foes, and all their enemies will be wiped out.
“In that day,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will slaughter your horses and destroy your chariots.
I will tear down your walls and demolish your defenses.
I will put an end to all witchcraft, and there will be no more fortune-tellers.
I will destroy all your idols and sacred pillars, so you will never again worship the work of your own hands.
I will abolish your idol shrines with their Asharah poles and destroy your pagan cities.
I will pour out my vengeance on all the nations that refuse to obey me.”
Listen to what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is saying: “Stand up and state your case against me, Let the mountains and hills be called to witness your complaints.
And now, O mountains, listen to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s complaint! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has a case against His people, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bring charges against Yashar'AL.
“O My people, what have I done to you? What have I done to make you tired of me? Answer me!
For I brought you out of Mitzraym and redeemed you from slavery, I sent Musha, Aarun and Miriam to help you.

Do you not remember, how King Balak of Muab tried to have you cursed and how Balaam son of Baur baraked you instead? And remember your journey from Acacia Gruve to Gilgal, when I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did everything I could to teach you about my faithfulness.”
What can we bring to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Should we bring him burnt offerings? Should we bow before AL'ALYUN (the Most High) with offerings of yearling calves?
Should we offer 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH thousands of rams and ten thousand rivers of olive oil Should we sacrifice our firstborn children to pay for our sins?
No O people, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has told you what is good, and this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH requires of you," to do what is right, to love mercy and to walk humbly with your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH if you are wise! The voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH calls to everyone in Yahushalam: “The armies of destruction are coming; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is sending them.
What shall I say about the homes of the wicked filled with treasures gained by cheating? What about the disgusting practice of measuring out grain with dishonest measures?
How can I tolerate your merchants who use dishonest scales and weights?
The rich among you have become wealthy through extortion and violence, your citizens are so used to lying that their tongues can no longer tell the truth.
“Therefore, I will wound you! I will bring you to ruin for all your sins.

You will eat but never have enough, your hunger pangs and emptiness will remain, and though you try to save your money, it will come to nothing in the end, you will save a little, but I will give it to those who conquer you.
You will plant crops but not harvest them, you will press your olives but not get enough oil to anoint yourselves, you will trample the grapes but get no juice to make your wine.

You keep only the laws of evil King Umri; you follow only the example of wicked King Ahab! Therefore, I will make an example of you, bringing you to complete ruin, you will be treated with contempt, mocked by all who see you.”
How miserable I am! I feel like the fruit picker after the harvest who can find nothing to eat, not a cluster of grapes or a single early fig can be found to satisfy my hunger.
The righteous people have all disappeared; not one honest person is left on the Arath, they are all murderers, setting traps even for their own brothers.
Both their hands are equally skilled at doing evil! Officials and judges alike demand bribes, the people with influence get what they want, and together they scheme to twist justice.
Even the best of them is like a brier; the most honest is as dangerous as a hedge of thorns, but your judgment day is coming swiftly now, Your time of punishment is here, a time of confusion.
Do not trust anyone, not your best friend or even your wife!
For the son despises his father, the daughter defies her mother, the daughter-in-law defies her mother-in-law. Your enemies are right in your own household!
As for me, I look to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for help, I wait confidently for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to save me, and my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will certainly hear me.
Do not gloat over me, my enemies! For though I fall, I will rise again, though I sit in darkness, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be my light.

I will be patient as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH punishes me, for I have sinned against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, But after that, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will take up my case and give me justice for all I have suffered from my enemies, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bring me into the light, and I will see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's righteousness.

Then my enemies will see that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is on my side, They will be ashamed that they taunted me, saying, So where is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of yours? ”With my own eyes I will see their downfall; they will be trampled like mud in the streets.
In that day, Yashar'AL, your cities will be rebuilt, and your borders will be extended.
People from many lands will come and honor you, from Assyria all the way to the towns of Mitzraym, from Mitzraym all the way to the Euphrates River, and from distant seas and mountains.
But the land will become empty and desolate because of the wickedness of those who live there.

O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, protect your people with your shepherd’s staff; lead your flock, your special possession, though they live alone in a thicket on the heights of Mount Carmel, let them graze in the fertile pastures of Bashan and Gilaad as they did long ago.
“Yes,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will do mighty miracles for you, like those I did when I rescued you from slavery in Mitzraym.”

All the nations of the world will stand amazed at what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will do for you, they will be embarrassed at their feeble power, they will cover their mouths in silent awe, deaf to everything around them.
Like snakes crawling from their holes, they will come out to meet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, they will fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH greatly, trembling in terror at the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Where is another 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH like you, who pardons the guilt of the remnant, overlooking the sins of His special people?You will not stay angry with your people forever, because you delight in showing unfailing love.
Once again you will have compassion on us, You will trample our sins under your feet and throw them into the depths of the ocean!
You will show us your faithfulness and unfailing love as you promised to our ancestors Abraham and Ya'aqub long ago.

books.name: Nahum
chapters: This message concerning Ninabah came as a vision to Nahun, who lived in Alkush.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is a jealous 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, filled with vengeance and rage, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH takes revenge on all who oppose Him and continues to rage against His enemies!

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is slow to get angry, but the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is great, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH never lets the guilty go unpunished, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH displays His power in the whirlwind and the storm, the billowing clouds are the dust beneath his feet.
At the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the oceans dry up and the rivers disappear, the lush pastures of Bashan and Carmel fade, and the green forests of Labanun wither.
In the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the mountains quake, and the hills melt away; the Arath trembles, and its people are destroyed.

Who can stand before the fierce anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Who can survive the burning fury of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's rage blazes forth like fire, and the mountains crumble to dust in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is good, a strong refuge when trouble comes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is close to those who trust in Him.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will sweep away His enemies in an overwhelming flood, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will pursue his foes into the darkness of night.
Why are you scheming against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will destroy you with one blow; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH won’t need to strike twice! Affliction will not rise up again
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's enemies tangled like thornbushes and staggering like drunks and will be burned up like dry stubble in a field.
Who is this wicked counselor of yours who plots evil against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Though the Assyrians have many allies, they will be destroyed and disappear, O my people, I have punished you before, but I will not punish you again.
Now I will break the yoke of bondage from your neck and tear off the chains of Assyrian oppression.”

And this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar concerning the Assyrians in Ninabah: “You will have no more children to carry on your name. I will destroy all the idols in the temples of your deities. I am preparing a grave for you because you are despicable!”

Look! A messenger is coming over the mountains with good news! He is bringing a message of Shalum, Celebrate your festivals, O people of Yahudah, and fulfill all your vows, for your wicked enemies will never invade your land again, they will be completely destroyed!
An enemy is coming to attack you, so guard the strong places of your city, Watch the road, Get ready for war, Prepare for battle!
Even though the destroyer has destroyed Yahudah, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will restore its honor, Yashar'AL’s vine has been stripped of branches, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will also restore its splendor.
Shields flash red in the sunlight! See the scarlet uniforms of the valiant troops! Watch as their glittering chariots move into position, with a forest of spears waving above them.
The chariots race recklessly along the streets and rush wildly through the squares, they flash like firelight and move as swiftly as lightning.
The king shouts to his officers; they stumble in their haste, rushing to the walls to set up their defenses.
The river gates have been torn open! The palace is about to collapse!
Ninabah’s exile has been decreed, and all the servant girls mourn its capture, they moan like doves and beat their breasts in sorrow.
Ninabah is like a leaking water reservoir! The people are slipping away, “Stop, stop!” someone shouts, but no one even looks back.
Loot the silver! Plunder the gold! There’s no end to Ninabah’s treasures, its vast, uncounted wealth.
Soon the city is plundered, empty, and ruined, Hearts melt and knees shake, the people stand aghast, their faces pale and trembling.
Where now is that great Ninabah, that den filled with young lions? It was a place where people like lions and their cubs walked freely and without fear.
The lion tore up meat for his cubs and strangled prey for his mate, he filled his den with prey, his caverns with his plunder.

“I am your enemy!” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, “Your chariots will soon go up in smoke, Your young men will be killed in battle, never again will you plunder conquered nations, The voices of your proud messengers will be heard no more.”
What sorrow awaits Ninabah, the city of murder and lies! She is crammed with wealth and is never without victims.
Hear the crack of whips, the rumble of wheels! Horses’ hooves pound, and chariots clatter wildly.
See the flashing swords and glittering spears as the charioteers charge past! There are countless casualties, heaps of bodies, so many bodies that people stumble over them.
All this because Ninabah the beautiful and faithless city mistress of deadly charms, enticed the nations with her beauty, she taught them all her magic, enchanting people everywhere.
“I Am your enemy!” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, and now I will lift your skirts and show all the Arath your nakedness and shame.
I will cover you with filth and show the world how vile you really are.
All who see you will shrink back and say, ‘Ninabah lies in ruins, Where are the mourners? Does anyone regret your destruction?”
Are you any better than the city of Thabas, situated on the Nile River, surrounded by water? She was protected by the river on all sides, walled in by water.
Athiupia and the land of Mitzraym gave unlimited assistance, the nations of Put and Libya were among her allies.

Yet Thabas fell, and her people were led away as captives, her babies were dashed to death against the stones of the streets, soldiers threw dice to get Mitzraym officers as servants, all their leaders were bound in chains.
And you, Ninabah, will also stagger like a drunkard, you will hide for fear of the attacking enemy.
All your fortresses will fall, they will be devoured like the ripe figs that fall into the mouths of those who shake the trees.
Your troops will be as weak and helpless as women, the gates of your land will be opened wide to the enemy and set on fire and burned.
Get ready for the siege! Store up water! Strengthen the defenses! Go into the pits to trample clay and pack it into molds, making bricks to repair the walls.
But the fire will devour you; the sword will cut you down, the enemy will consume you like locusts, devouring everything they see. There will be no escape, even if you multiply like swarming locusts.
Your merchants have multiplied until they outnumber the stars, but like a swarm of locusts, they strip the land and fly away.

Your guards and officials are also like swarming locusts that crowd together in the hedges on a cold day, But like locusts that fly away when the sun comes up, all of them will fly away and disappear.
Your shepherds are asleep, O Assyrian king; your princes lie dead in the dust. Your people are scattered across the mountains with no one to gather them together.
There is no healing for your wound; your injury is fatal, all who hear of your destruction will clap their hands for joy, where can anyone be found who has not suffered from your continual cruelty?

books.name: Habakkuk
chapters: This is the message that was given to Habakkuk the Nabym.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I continue to ask for help. When will you listen to me? I cried to you about the violence, but you did nothing!
People are stealing things and hurting others, they are arguing and fighting. Why do you make me look at these terrible things?
The law is weak and not fair to people, evil people win their fights against good people. So the law is no longer fair, and justice does not win anymore.
“Look at the other nations! Watch them, and you will be amazed, I will do something in your lifetime that will amaze you, and you would not believe it even if you were told about it.
I will make the Babylunians a strong nation, they are cruel and powerful fighters, they will march across the Arath, they will take houses and cities that do not belong to them.
The Babylunians will scare the other people. They will do what they want to do and go where they want to go.

Their horses will be faster than leopards and more dangerous than wolves at sunset. Their horse soldiers will come from faraway places, they will attack their enemies quickly, like a hungry eagle swooping down from the sky.
The one thing they all want to do is fight. Their armies will march fast like the wind in the desert, and the Babylunian soldiers will take many prisoners, as many as the grains of sand.

“The Babylunian soldiers will laugh at the kings of other nations, Foreign rulers will be like jokes to them, the Babylunian soldiers will laugh at the cities with tall strong walls. They will simply build dirt roads up to the top of the walls and easily defeat the cities.
Then they will leave like the wind and go on to fight against other places, the only thing the Babylunians worship is their own strength.”
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you are the one who lives forever! You are my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who never dies! O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH you created the Babylunians to do what must be done, our Rock, you created them to punish people.
Your eyes are too good to look at evil, You cannot stand to see people doing wrong, so why do you permit such evil? How can you watch while the wicked destroy people who are so much better?
You made people like fish in the sea, they are like little sea animals without a leader.
The enemy catches all of them with hooks and nets, the enemy catches them in his net and drags them in, and the enemy is very happy with what he caught.
His net helps him live like the rich and enjoy the best food, so the enemy worships his net, he makes sacrifices and burns incense to honor his net.
Will he continue to take riches with his net? Will he continue destroying people without showing mercy?
I will stand like a guard and watch, I will wait to see what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will say to me, I will wait and learn how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH answers my questions.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH answered me, “Write down what I show you. Write it clearly on a sign so that the message will be easy to read.
For the vision is yet for an appointed time; But at the end it will speak, and it will not lie. Though it delay, wait for it; Because it will surely come, It will not tarry.
“Look at the proud, his soul is not upright in him; But the righteous shall live by his Amunah.

“Wine can trick a person. In the same way a strong man’s pride can fool him, but he will not find Shalum, he is like death, he always wants more and more, and, like death he will never be satisfied, he will continue to defeat other nations and to make those people his prisoners.

But soon enough, all those people will laugh at him and tell stories about his defeat, they will laugh and say, ‘It’s too bad that the man who took so many things will not get to keep them! he made himself rich by collecting debts.’

“Strong man, you have taken money from people, One day they will wake up and realize what is happening, and they will stand against you, then they will take things from you, and you will be very afraid.
You have stolen things from many nations, so they will take much from you, you have killed many people and destroyed lands and cities, you have killed all the people there.
“Look at you people! You get rich by cheating people, and it hurts your own family! You build your houses high on the cliffs to protect yourself from danger.
You planned shameful things, and that will bring shame to your own family, you have done wrong, and it will cost you your life.
The stones of the walls will cry out against you, even the wooden rafters in your own house will prove that you are wrong.
“Look at them! They kill people to build their city and do wicked things to make their walled city strong.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut has decided that a fire will destroy everything that those people worked to build, all their work will be for nothing.
Then people everywhere will know about the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, this news will spread just as water spreads out into the sea.
It will be very bad for those who become angry and make other people suffer, Like an angry drunk, they knock others to the ground and strip them naked, just to see their naked bodies.

“But they will know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s anger, it will be like a cup of poison in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s right hand, they will taste that anger, and then they will fall to the ground like drunks. “Evil ruler, you will drink from that cup, you will get shame, not honor.

You hurt many people in Labanun and stole many animals there, so you will be afraid because of the people who died and because of the bad things you did to that country, you will be afraid because of what you did to those cities and to the people who lived there.”
Their idols will not help them, because it is only a statue that someone covered with metal, It is only a statue, so whoever made it cannot expect it to help, that statue cannot even speak!

Look at them! They speak to a wooden statue and tell it, “Get up! Rescue me.” They talk to a stone that cannot speak and say, “Wake up!” Do you not know those things cannot help you? That statue may be covered with gold and silver, but there is no life in it.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is in his Qadash temple, so the whole Arath should be silent in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's presence and show 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH respect.
The prayer of Habakkuk the Nabym.

O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I have heard the news about you, I am amazed, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, at the powerful things you did in the past, now I pray that you will do great things in our time. Please make these things happen in our own days, but in your anger remember to show mercy to us. I pray.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is coming from Taman, the Qadash One is coming from Mount Paran, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's Kabad covers the Shamaym, and the Yadah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH fills the Arath!
Rays of light shine from the hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, a bright, shining light, there is such power hiding in that hand.
The sickness went before Him, and the destroyer followed behind Him.

He stood and judged the Arath, he looked at the people of all the nations, and they shook with fear, for many years the mountains stood strong, but those mountains fell to pieces, those old hills fell down, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has always been able to do that.
I saw that the cities of Cushan were in trouble and that the houses of Midian trembled with fear.
O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, were you angry at the rivers? Were you angry at the streams? Were you angry at the sea? Were you angry when you rode your horses and chariots to victory?
Even then you showed your rainbow, It was proof of your agreement with the families of the Arath, and the dry land split the rivers.
The mountains saw You and shook, the water flowed off the land, the water from the sea made a loud noise as it lost its power over the land.
The sun and the moon lost their brightness. They stopped shining when they saw your bright flashes of lightning, that lightning was like spears and arrows shooting through the air.
In anger you walked on the Arath and punished the nations.
You came to save your people and to lead your chosen king to victory, You killed the leader in every evil family, from the least important person to the most important in the land.
You used Musha’s walking stick to stop the enemy soldiers, those soldiers came like a powerful storm to fight against us, they thought they could defeat us easily, as robbing the poor in secret.
But you marched your horses through the deep water, stirring up the mud.
My whole body shook when I heard the story, My lips trembled, I felt weak deep down in my bones and stood there shaking, but I will wait patiently for destruction to come to those who attack us.

Figs might not grow on the fig trees, and grapes might not grow on the vines. Olives might not grow on the olive trees, and food might not grow in the fields, there might not be any sheep in the pens or cattle in the barns.
But I will still be glad in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and I will rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH my Savior.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my strength, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will help me run fast like a deer and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will lead me safely on the mountains.

books.name: Zephaniah
chapters: This is the message that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave to Zaphanyahu, he received this message during the time that Yusyahu son of Amun was king of Yahudah, Zaphanyahu was the son of Cushi, who was the son of Gadalyahu. Gadalyahu was the son of Amaryahu, who was the son of Hazakyahu.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I will destroy everything on the Arath.

I will destroy all the people and all the animals. I will destroy the birds in the air and the fish in the sea. I will destroy the evil people and everything that makes them sin. I will remove all people from the Arath.” This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar.
“I will punish Yahudah and the people living in Yahushalam, I will remove from this place any signs of Baal worship, No one will remember the priests who serve the idols there.
And those who go up on their roofs and bow down to worship the sun, moon and stars, they claim they worship Me 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but they also use the name of the idol Mulach to make promises.
They have turned away from Me, they have stopped following me. They no longer ask Me, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for help.”

Be silent before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s day for judging the people is coming soon, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has prepared His sacrifice, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has told His invited guests to get ready.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “On 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s day of sacrifice, I will punish the king’s sons and other leaders. I will punish all the people wearing clothes from other countries.
At that time I will punish all the people who jump over the threshold and those who fill their master’s house with lies and violence.”

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also Dabar, “At that time people will be calling for help at Fish Gate in Yahushalam and mourning in the new part of town. They will hear the sound of destruction in the hills around the city.
You people living in the lower part of town will cry, because all the traders and rich merchants will be destroyed.

“At that time I will take a lamp and search through Yahushalam. I will find all those who are satisfied to live their own way. They say, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does nothing, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not help, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not hurt!’ I will find them, and I will punish them.
Then others will take their wealth and destroy their houses. Those who built houses will not live in them, and those who planted vineyards will not drink the wine from the grapes.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s special day of judgement is coming soon! It is near and coming fast, People will hear very sad sounds on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s special day of judgement. Even strong soldiers will cry.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will show His anger at that time. It will be a time of terrible troubles and a time of destruction. It will be a time of darkness, a black, cloudy, and stormy day.
It will be like a time of war when people hear horns and trumpets in the defense towers and protected cities.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I will make life very hard on the people. They will walk around like the blind who do not know where they are going. That will happen because they sinned against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Their blood will be spilled on the ground. Their dead bodies will lie like dung on the ground.

Their gold and silver will not help them! At that time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will become very upset and angry. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will destroy the whole world! And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will completely destroy everyone on the Arath (earth)!”
Shameless people, change your lives

before you become like a dry and dying flower In the heat of day, a flower will wilt and die. You will be like that when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shows His terrible anger. So change your lives before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shows His anger against you!
All you humble people, come to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Obey the laws of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Learn to do good things. Learn to be humble. Maybe then you will be safe when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shows His anger.
No one will be left in Gaza. Ashkalun will be destroyed. By noon, the people will be forced to leave Ashdud. Akrun will be empty.
You Cratans living by the sea, this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is about you. Canaan, land of the Philistines, you will be destroyed, no one will live there!
Your land by the sea will become empty fields for shepherds and their sheep.

Then the land will belong to the survivors from Yahudah, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH will remember the people from Yahudah and restore their fortunes, then they will let their sheep eat the grass in those fields. In the evenings they will lie down in the empty houses of Ashkalun.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I know what the people of Muab and Ammun did. They embarrassed my people, they took their land to make their own countries larger.

So, as surely as I Am alive, Muab and the people of Ammun will be destroyed like Sudum and Gumurrah, I Am 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Yashar'AL, and I promise those countries will be destroyed completely forever, their land will be overgrown with weeds. It will be like the land covered with salt by the Dead Sea, the survivors of my people will take that land and everything left in it.”
This will happen to the people of Muab and Ammun because they were so proud and cruel and humiliated the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
They will be afraid of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will destroy their idols, then everyone in all the faraway lands will worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
People of Athiupia, this also means you! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s sword will kill your people.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will turn north and punish Assyria, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will destroy Ninabah, that city will be like an empty dry desert.

Only sheep and wild animals will live in those ruins. Owls and crows will sit on the columns that are left standing. Their calls will be heard coming through the windows. Crows will sit on the doorsteps. Black birds will make their homes in those empty houses.

Ninabah is so proud now. It is such a happy city. The people think they are safe. They think Ninabah is the greatest place in the world, but it will be destroyed! It will be an empty place where only wild animals go to rest. People who pass by will whistle and shake their heads when they see how badly the city was destroyed.
Yahushalam, your people fought against their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, They hurt other people, and you have been stained with sin.
They did not listen to me or accept my teachings. Yahushalam did not trust 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, Yahushalam did not go to her 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Yahushalam’s leaders are like roaring lions. Her judges are like hungry wolves that come in the evening to attack the sheep and in the morning nothing is left.
Her Nabyms (prophets) are always making secret plans to get more and more, Her priests have treated Qadash things as if they were not Qadash. They have done bad things to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s teachings.

But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is still in that city, and he continues to be good, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not do anything wrong, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH continues to help His people, Morning after morning 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH makes good decisions for them, not a day passes without the justice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH never gives a decision that is crooked or is something to be ashamed of.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I have destroyed whole nations and their defense towers, I destroyed their streets and now no one goes there anymore, their cities are empty, no one lives there anymore.

I tell you this so that you will learn a lesson. I want you to fear and respect me. If you do this, your home will not be destroyed, and I will not have to punish you the way I planned.” But those evil people only wanted to do more of the same evil things they had already done!

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, Therefore, be patient, “Soon I will stand and accuse these evil nations, For I have decided to gather the kingdoms of the Arath and pour out my fiercest anger and fury on them, all the Arath will be devoured by the fire of my jealousy.
“Then I will restore to the people a pure language, that they all may call on the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with one accord.
People will come all the way from the other side of the river in Athiupia, My scattered people will come to me, My worshipers will come and bring their gifts to me.

“Then Yahushalam, you will no longer be ashamed of the wrong things your people do against me, that is because I will remove all the bad people from Yahushalam. I will take away all the proud people. There will not be any of them on my Qadash mountain.
I will let only meek and humble people stay in my city, and they will trust 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Name.
The survivors of Yashar'AL will not do bad things or tell lies. They will not try to trick people with lies. They will be like sheep that eat and lie down in Shalum and no one will bother them.”
Yahushalam, sing and be happy! Yashar'AL, shout for joy! Yahushalam, be happy and have fun!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has stopped your punishment, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has destroyed your enemies strong towers, King of Yashar'AL, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is with you, You do not need to worry about anything bad happening.
At that time Yahushalam will be told, “Be strong, do not be afraid!

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is with you, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is like a powerful soldier, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will save you, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will show how much He loves you and how happy He is with you, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will laugh and be happy about you,
like people at a party, I will take away your shame, I will make them stop hurting you.

At that time I will punish those who hurt you, I will save my hurt people and bring back those who were forced to leave, I will give them yadah and honor everywhere, even in places where they suffered shame.

At that time I will lead you back home, I will bring your people back together, I will cause people everywhere to honor and yadah you. You will see me bring back all the Barakah you once had, This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar.

books.name: Haggai
chapters: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Parsia, Haggayahu received a message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, This message was for Zarubbabal son of Shaaltial and Yashua son of Yahuzadak, Zarubbabal was the governor of Yahudah and Yashua son Yahuzadak was the high Kuhan. This is the message:
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar, “The people are saying it is not yet the right time to build 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple.”
Again Haggayahu received a message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and he said:
“You people think the right time has come for you to live in nice houses, you live in houses with beautiful wooden paneling on the walls, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s house is still in ruins.
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar, ‘Think about what is happening.

You have planted many seeds, but you have gathered only a few crops. You have food to eat, but not enough to get full, You have something to drink, but not enough to get drunk, You have some clothes to wear, but not enough to keep warm. You earn a little money, but you do not know where it all goes. It is as though there is a hole in your pocket!’”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Think about what you are doing.
Go up to the mountains, get the wood, and build the Temple, then I will be pleased with the Temple, and I will be honored, said 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “You people look for a big harvest, but when you go to gather the crop, there is only a little grain. So you bring that grain home, and then I send a wind that blows it all away. Why is this happening? Because my house is still in ruins while each of you runs home to take care of your own house.
That is why the sky holds back its dew and why the Arath holds back its crops.

“I gave the command for the land and the mountains to be dry. The grain, the new wine, the olive oil, and everything the Arath produces will be ruined, all the people and all the animals will become weak.”

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had sent Haggayahu to speak to Zarubbabal son of Shaaltial and to the high Kuhan, Yashua son of Yahuzadak. So these men and all the people listened to the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and to the words of Haggayahu the Nabym. And the people showed their fear and respect for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Then Haggayahu; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s messenger, delivered this message to the people: “I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to you, that I AM with you!’”

Zarubbabal son of Shaaltial was the governor of Yahudah, Yashua son of Yahuzadak was the high Kuhan. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made them and the rest of the people excited about working on the Temple of their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH All-Powerful.
So they began this work on the twenty fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of king Darius.
On the 21st day of the seventh month, this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came to Haggayahu:
“Speak to Zarubbabal son of Shaaltial, the governor of Yahudah, and to Yashua son of Yahuzadak, the high Kuhan, and to all the people. Say this:

‘How many of you people look at this Temple and try to compare it to the beautiful Temple that was destroyed? What do you think? Does this Temple seem like nothing when you compare it with the first Temple?

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Zarubbabal, do not be discouraged! “Yashua son of Yahuzadak, you are the high Kuhan. Do not be discouraged! And all you people who live in the land, do not be discouraged! Continue this work, because I Am with you.” This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH All-Powerful Dabar.
“‘I made an agreement with you when you left Mitzraym, and I have kept my promise. My Ruach is with you, so do not be afraid!’
This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to them, ‘In just a little while, I will once again shake things up. I will shake Shamaym and Arath, and I will shake the sea and the dry land.
I will shake up the nations, and they will come to you with wealth from every nation. And then I will fill this Temple with Kabad.’ says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut!
‘All the silver belongs to me! And all the gold is mine!’ says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, ‘This last Temple will be more beautiful than the first one, and I will bring Shalum to this place.’ Remember, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
On the twenty fourth day of the ninth month in the second year Darius reigns as king of Persia, this message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came to Haggayahu the Nabym:
“For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH commands you to ask the Kuhan what the law says about these things:

‘Suppose a man carries some meat in the fold of his clothes. This meat is part of a sacrifice, so it is Qadash. If his clothes touch some bread, cooked food, wine, oil, or some other food, will the thing the clothes touch become Qadash? the Kuhanym answered No.
Then Haggayahu said, “Whoever touches a dead body will become unclean. Now if they touch anything else, will it also become unclean?” The Kuhanym answered, “Yes, it will become unclean.”

Then Haggayahu said, “This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: ‘This is also true for the people of this nation. They were not pure and Qadash before me. So anything they did with their hands and anything they offered at the altar became unclean.
“‘Think about what has happened to you. Think about how things were before you began working on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple.
People wanted 20 measures of grain, but there were only ten measures in the pile. People wanted to get fifty jars of wine from the wine vat, but there were only twenty.

That was because I punished you. I sent the diseases that killed your plants and the hail that destroyed the things you made with your hands. I did this, but still you did not come to me.’ Says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, ‘Today is the twenty fourth day of the ninth month, you have finished laying the foundation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Temple. So notice what happens from this day forward:
Your seed for planting is still in the barn. And look at the vines, the fig trees, and the pomegranate and olive trees. They have not yet produced any fruit. But beginning today, I will barak you.’”
Another message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came to Haggayahu on the twenty fourth day of the month. This is the message:
“Go to Zarubbabal, the governor of Yahudah and tell him that I will shake Shamaym and Arath.

And I will overthrow many kings and kingdoms and destroy the power of the kingdoms of those other people. I will destroy their chariots and their riders. I will defeat their war horses and riders. These armies are friends now, but they will turn against each other and kill each other with swords.”

This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: “Zarubbabal son of Shaaltial, my servant, I have chosen you, I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, tell you that at that time I will use you like a signet ring to represent My authority!” Says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

books.name: Zechariah
chapters: During the second year of King Darius’s reign, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave this message to the Nabym Zakaryahu son of Barakyahu and grandson of Iddu:
“I 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, was very angry with your ancestors.
Therefore, say to the people, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Return to me, and I will return to you, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.’

Do not be like your ancestors who would not listen or pay attention when the earlier Nabyms said to them, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: Turn from your evil ways, and stop all your evil practices.’
“Where are your ancestors now? They and the Nabyms are long dead.

But everything I Dabar through my servants the Nabyms happened to your ancestors, just as I Dabar. As a result, they repented and said, ‘We have received what we deserved from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done what He Dabar that He would do.’”
Three months later, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent another message to the Nabym Zakaryahu son of Barakyahu and grandson of Iddu.
In a vision during the night, I saw a man sitting on a red horse that was standing among some myrtle trees in a small valley. Behind him were riders on red, brown, and white horses.
I asked the Malak who was talking with me, “My master, what do these horses mean? “I will show you,” the Malak replied.
The rider standing among the myrtle trees then explained, “They are the ones 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sent out to patrol the Arath.”
Then the other riders reported to the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who was standing among the myrtle trees, “We have been patrolling the Arath, and the whole Arath is at Shalum.”

Upon hearing this, the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH prayed this prayer: “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, for seventy years now you have been angry with Yahushalam and the towns of Yahudah, How long until you again show mercy to them?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar kind and comforting Dabar to the Malak who talked with me.
Then the Malak said to me, “Shout this message for all to hear: ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: My love for Yahushalam and Mount Ziun is passionate and strong.
But I am very angry with the other nations that are now enjoying Shalum and security. I was only a little angry with my people, but the nations inflicted harm on them far beyond my intentions.

“‘Therefore, this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I have returned to show mercy to Yahushalam. My Temple will be rebuilt, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, and measurements will be taken for the reconstruction of Yahushalam.’
“Say this also: ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: The towns of Yashar'AL will again overflow with prosperity, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will again comfort Ziun and choose Yahushalam as his own.’”
Then I looked up and saw four animal horns.
“What are these?” I asked the Malak who was talking with me, and he replied, “These horns represent the nations that scattered Yahudah, Yashar'AL and Yahushalam.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed me four blacksmiths.

“What are these men coming to do?” I asked, the Malak replied, “These four horns, these nations scattered and humbled Yahudah, now these blacksmiths have come to terrify those nations and throw them down and destroy them.”
When I looked again, I saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.
“Where are you going?” I asked and he replied, “I am going to measure Yahushalam, to see how wide and how long it is.”
Then the Malak who was with me went to meet with the second Malak who was coming toward him.

The other Malak said, “Hurry, and say to that young man, Yahushalam will someday be so full of people and livestock that there won’t be room enough for everyone! Many will live outside the city walls.
Then I, myself, will be a protective wall of fire around Yahushalam says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and I will be the Kabad inside the city!’”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Come away! Flee from Babylun in the land of the north, for I have scattered you to the four winds.
Come away, people of Ziun, you who are exiled in Babylun!”
After a period of kabad, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut sent me against the nations who plundered you. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “anyone who harms you harms my most precious possession.
I will raise my fist to crush them, and their own slaves will plunder them.” Then you will know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut has sent me.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Shout and rejoice, O beautiful Yahushalam, for I am coming to live among you.

Many nations will join themselves to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on that day, and they too will be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's people and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will live among them, and you will know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut sent me to give you this message.
The land of Yahudah will be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s special possession in the Qadash land, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will once again choose Yahushalam to be His own city.
Be silent before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all mankind, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is springing into action from His Qadash dwelling.”
Then the Malak showed me Yashua the high Kuhan standing before the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, The Accuser, Ha'shatan, was there at the Malak’s right hand, making accusations against Yashua.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to ha'shatan, “I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, reject your accusations, Shatan. Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who has chosen Yahushalam, rebukes you. This man is like a burning stick that has been snatched from the fire.”
Yashua’s clothing was filthy as he stood there before the Malak.
So the Malak said to the others standing there, “Take off Yashua's filthy clothes.” And turning to Yashua he said, “See, I have taken away your sins, and now I am giving you these fine new clothes.”
Then I said, “They should also place a clean turban on his head.” So they put a clean Kuhanly turban on his head and dressed him in new clothes while the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH stood by.
Then the Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke very solemnly to Yashua and said,

“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: If you follow my ways and carefully serve Me, then you will be given authority over my Temple and its courtyards. I will let you walk among these others standing here.
“Listen to me, O Yashua the high Kuhan, and all you other Kuhanym. You are symbols of things to come. Soon I am going to bring my servant, the Branch.

Now look at the jewel I have set before Yashua, a single stone with seven facets. I will engrave an inscription on it, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, and I will remove the sins of this land in a single day.
“And on that day, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, each of you will invite your neighbor to sit with you in Shalum under your own grapevine and fig tree.”
Then the Malak who had been talking with me returned and woke me, as though I had been asleep.
“What do you see now?” he asked.
And I see two olive trees, one on each side of the bowl.”
Then I asked the Malak, “What are these, my master? What do they mean?”
“Do you not know?” the Malak asked.
Then he said to me, “This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to Zarubbabal: “it is Not by your power nor by your might, but by My RUACH,’ Says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.

Nothing, not even a mighty mountain, will stand in Zarubbabal’s way; it will become a level plain before him! And when Zarubbabal sets the final stone of the Temple in place, the people will shout: ‘May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH barak it! May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH barak it!’”
Then another message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Zarubbabal is the one who laid the foundation of this Temple, and he will complete it. Then you will know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut has sent me.

Do not despise these small beginnings, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rejoices to see the work begin, to see the plumb line in Zarubbabal’s hand.” The seven lamps represent the eyes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that search all around the world.
Then I asked the Malak, “What are these two olive trees on each side of the lampstand,
and what are the two olive branches that pour out golden oil through two gold tubes?”
“Do you not know?” he asked. “No, my master, I replied.
Then he said to me, “They represent the two anointed ones who stand in the court of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.”
I looked up again and saw a scroll flying through the air.
“What do you see?” the Malak asked.

Then the Malak said to me, “This scroll contains the curse that is going out over the entire land. One side of the scroll says that those who steal will be banished from the land; the other side says that those who swear falsely will be banished from the land.

And this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: I am sending this curse into the house of every thief and into the house of everyone who swears falsely using my Name, and my curse will remain in that house and completely destroy it, even its timbers and stones.”
Then the Malak who was talking with me came forward and said, “Look up and see what’s coming.”
“What is it?” I asked, he replied, “It is a basket for measuring grain, and it’s filled with the sins of everyone throughout the land.”
Then the heavy lead cover was lifted off the basket, and there was a woman sitting inside it.
The Malak said, “The woman’s name is Wickedness,” and he pushed her back into the basket and closed the heavy lid again.
Then I looked up and saw two women flying toward us, gliding on the wind. They had wings like a stork, and they picked up the basket and flew into the sky.
“And I asked the Malak; Where are they taking the basket?”
He replied, “To the land of Babylunia, where they will build a temple for the basket, and when the temple is ready, they will set the basket there on its pedestal.”
Then I looked up again and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
The first chariot was pulled by red horses, the second by black horses,
the third by white horses, and the fourth by powerful dappled-gray horses.
“And what are these, my master?” I asked the Malak who was talking with me.
The Malak replied, “These are the four Ruach of Shamaym who stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, they are going out to do the work of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The chariot with black horses is going north, the chariot with white horses is going west, and the chariot with dappled gray horses is going south.”
The powerful horses were eager to set out to patrol the Arath, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “Go and patrol the Arath!” So they left at once on their patrol.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH summoned me and said, “Look, those who went north have vented the anger of my RUACH there in the land of the north.”
Then I received another message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“Haldai, Tubiyahu, and Yadayahu will bring gifts of silver and gold from the Yahudym exiled in Babylun. As soon as they arrive, meet them at the home of Yusyahu son of Zaphanyahu.
Accept their gifts, and make a crown from the silver and gold. Then put the crown on the head of Yashua son of Yahuzadak, the high Kuhan.
Tell him, ‘This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: Here is the man called the Branch, he will branch out from where he is and build the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Yes, he will build the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Then he will receive royal honor and will rule as king from his throne. He will also serve as Kuhan from his throne, and there will be perfect harmony between his two roles.’
“The crown will be a memorial in the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to honor those who gave it, Haldai, Tubiyahu, Yadayahu, and Yusyahu son of Zaphanyahu.”

People will come from distant lands to rebuild the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and when this happens, you will know that my messages has been from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, all this will happen if you carefully obey what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH says.
During fourth year of King Darius’s reign, another message came to Zakaryahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The people of Bathal had sent Sharazar and Ragammalach, along with their attendants, to seek 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s favor.

They were to ask this question of the Nabym and the Kuhanym at the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut: “Should we continue to mourn and fast each summer on the anniversary of the Temple’s destruction, as we have done for so many years?”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut sent me this message in reply:
“Say to all your people and your Kuhanym, ‘During these seventy years of exile, when you fasted and mourned in the summer and in early autumn, was it really for me that you were fasting?
And even now in your Qadash festivals, are you not eating and drinking just to please yourselves?

Is this not the same message 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH proclaimed through the Nabyms in years past when Yahushalam and the towns of Yahudah were bustling with people, and the Nagab and the foot hills of Yahudah were well populated?’”
Then this message came to Zakaryahu from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: Judge fairly, and show mercy and kindness to one another.
Do not oppress widows, orphans, foreigners, and the poor, and do not scheme against each other.
“Your ancestors refused to listen to this message. They stubbornly turned away and put their fingers in their ears to keep them from hearing.

They made their hearts as hard as stone, so they could not hear the instructions or the messages that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut had sent them by His RUACH through the earlier Nabyms. That is why 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut was so angry with them.
“Since they refused to listen when I called to them, I would not listen when they called to me, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.

As with a whirlwind, I scattered them among the distant nations, where they lived as strangers. Their land became so desolate that no one even traveled through it. They turned their pleasant land into a desert.”
Then another message came to me from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut:
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: My love for Mount Ziun is passionate and strong; I am consumed with passion for Yahushalam!

“And now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: I am returning to Mount Ziun, and I will live in Yahushalam. Then Yahushalam will be called the Faithful City; the mountain of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut will be called the Qadash Mountain.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Once again old men and women will walk Yahushalam’s streets with their canes and will sit together in the city squares.
And the streets of the city will be filled with boys and girls at play.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: All this may seem impossible to you now, a small remnant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people. But is it impossible for me? says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: You can be sure that I will rescue my people from the east and from the west.
I will bring them home again to live safely in Yahushalam. They will be my people, and I will be faithful and just toward them as their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

“This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: Be strong and finish the task! Ever since the laying of the foundation of the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, you have heard what the Nabyms have been saying about completing the building.

Before the work on the Temple began, there were no jobs and no money to hire people or animals. No traveler was safe from the enemy, for there were enemies on all sides. I had turned everyone against each other.
“But now I will not treat the remnant of my people as I treated them before, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.

For I am planting seeds of Shalum and prosperity among you. The grapevines will be heavy with fruit. The Arath will produce its crops, and the Shamaym will release the dew. Once more I will cause the remnant in Yahudah and Yashar'AL to inherit these Barakah.

Among the other nations, Yahudah and Yashar'AL became symbols of a cursed nation. But no longer! Now I will rescue you and make you both a symbol and a source of Barakah. So do not be afraid. Be strong, and get on with rebuilding the Temple!
“For this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut Dabar: I was determined to punish you when your ancestors angered me, and I did not change my mind, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But now I am determined to barak Yahushalam and the people of Yahudah. So do not be afraid.
But this is what you must do: Tell the truth to each other. Render verdicts in your courts that are just and that lead to Shalum.
