For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is RUACH, so those who worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must worship Him in Ruach and in 𐤀𐤌𐤕_Amat (Truth).”
The woman said, “I know the Messiah is coming, the one who is called Ha'Mashyach. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told her, “I Am Ha'Mashyach!”
Just then His Talmidym came back, they were shocked to find 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA talking to a woman, but none of them had the nerve to ask, “What do you want with her?” or “Why are you talking to her?”
The woman left her water jar beside the well and ran back to the village, telling everyone,
“Come and see a man who told me everything I ever did! Could He possibly be Ha'Mashyach?”
So the people came streaming from the village to see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Meanwhile, the Talmidym were urging 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, “Rabbi, eat something.”
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, I have food to eat of which you do not know.”
“Did someone bring Him food while we were gone?” the Talmidym asked each other.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA explained: “My nourishment comes from doing the WILL of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who sent Me, and from finishing His work.
You know the saying, ‘Four months between planting and harvest.’ But I say, wake up and look around. The fields are already ripe for harvest.
The harvesters are paid good wages, and the fruit they harvest is people brought to eternal life. What joy awaits both the planter and the harvester alike!
You know the saying, ‘One plants and another harvests.’ And it is true.
I sent you to harvest where you did not plant; others had already done the work, and now you will get to gather the harvest.”
Many Samaritans from the village believed in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA because the woman had said, “He told me everything I ever did!”
When they came out to see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, they begged Him to stay in their village. So He stayed for two days more,
And they all heard the message of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and they believed.

Then they said to the woman, “Now we believe, not just because of what you told us, but because we have heard 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA ourselves. Now we know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is indeed the Savior of the world.”
At the end of the two days, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA went on to Galily.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA himself had said that a Nabym is not honored in his own hometown.
Yet the Galilyans welcomed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, for they had been in Yahushalam at the Passover celebration and had seen everything He did there.
As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA traveled through Galily, He came to Cana, where He had turned the water into wine. There was a government official in nearby Capernaum whose son was very sick.
When he heard that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had come from Yahudah to Galily, he went and begged 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to come to Capernaum to heal his son, who was about to die.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA asked, “Will you never believe in me unless you see miraculous signs and wonders?”
The official pleaded, “Master, please come now before my little boy dies.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told him, “Go back home. Your son will live!” And the man believed what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said and started home.
While the man was on his way, some of his servants met him with the news that his son was alive and well.
The man asked them when the boy had begun to get better, and they replied, “Yesterday at the seventh hour his fever suddenly disappeared!”
Then the father realized that was the very time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had told him, “Your son will live.” And he and his entire household believed in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
This was the second miraculous sign 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA did in Galily after coming from Yahudah.
There was a feast of the Yahudym, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA went up to Yahushalam.
Now there is in Yahushalam by the Sheep Gate a pool, which is called in Abarym (Hebrew), Bathasda, having five porches.
In these lay a great multitude of sick people, blind, lame, paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water.
For a Malak went down at a certain time into the pool and stirred up the water; then whoever stepped in first, after the stirring of the water, was made well of whatever disease he had.
Now a certain man was there who had an infirmity thirty-eight years.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA saw him lying there, and knew that he already had been in that condition a long time, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to the sick man, “Do you want to be made well?”
The sick man answered 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, “Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up; but while I am coming, another steps down before me.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to him, “Rise, take up your bed and walk.”
And immediately the man was made well, took up his bed, and walked. And that day was the Shabbat.
The Yahudym therefore said to him who was cured, “It is the Shabbat; it is not lawful for you to carry your bed.”
The healed man answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your bed and walk.’ ”
Then they asked him, “Who is the Man who said that to you?”
But the one who was healed did not know who it was, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had withdrawn, a multitude being in that place.
Afterward 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA found the healed man in the temple, and said to him, “See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.”
The man departed and told the Yahudym that it was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA who had made him well.
For this reason the Yahudym persecuted 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, and sought to kill Him, because He had done these things on the Shabbat.
In His defense 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to them, “My ABBA is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working.”
Therefore the Yahudym sought all the more to kill Him, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA not only broke the Shabbat, but also said that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was His ABBA, making Himself equal with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered and said to them, “Most assuredly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of Himself, but what He sees his ABBA do; for whatever his ABBA does, the Son also does in like manner.
For ABBA loves His Son, and shows Him all things that He Himself does; and ABBA will show His Son greater works than these, that you may marvel.
For as ABBA raises the dead and gives life to them, even so the Son of ABBA gives life to whom He will.
For ABBA judges no one, but has committed all judgment to His Son,
That all should honor His Son just as they honor ABBA. He who does not honor the Son does not honor ABBA who sent His Son.
“Most assuredly, I say to you, he who hears My word and believes in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me has everlasting life, and shall not come into judgment, but has passed from death into life.
Most assuredly, I say to you, the hour is coming, and now is, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; and those who hear will live.
For as ABBA has life in Himself, so He has granted the Son to have life in Himself,
And has given His Son authority to execute judgment also, because He is the Son of Adam.
Do not marvel at this; for the hour is coming in which all who are in the graves will hear the Son's voice
And come forth, those who have done good, to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of condemnation.
I can of Myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and My judgment is righteous, because I do not seek My own Will but the WILL of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me.
“If I bear witness of Myself, My witness is not true.
There is another who bears witness of Me, and I know that the witness which he witnesses of Me is true.
In fact, you sent investigators to listen to Yahukanun the Baptist, and his testimony about me was true.
Yet I do not receive testimony from man, but I say these things that you may be saved.
Yahukanun was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing for a time to rejoice in his light.
But I have a greater witness than Yahukanun’s; for the works which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given Me to finish, the very works that I do bear witness of Me, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sent Me.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Himself, who sent Me, has testified of Me. You have neither heard 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH‘s voice at any time, nor seen His form.
And you do not have 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's Dabar abiding in you, because whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent, Him you do not believe.
You search the Scriptures, for in them you think you have eternal life; and these are they which testify of Me.
But you are not willing to come to Me that you may have life.
“I do not receive honor from men.
But I know you and You do not have the love of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in you.
For I have come to you in my ABBA’s Name, and you have rejected Me. Yet if others come in their own name, you will gladly welcome them.
No wonder you can not believe in Me! For you gladly honor each other, but you do not care about the honor that comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who is the only 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all life.
“Yet it is not I who will accuse you before ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Musha will accuse you! Yes, Musha, in whom you put your hopes.
If you really believed Musha, you would believe me, because Musha wrote about me.
But since you do not believe what Musha wrote, how will you believe what I say?”
After this, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA crossed over to the far side of the Sea of Galily, also known as the Sea of Tibarias.
A huge crowd kept following 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA wherever he went, because they saw His miraculous signs as he healed the sick.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA climbed a hill and sat down with His Talmidym around Him.
(It was nearly time for the Yahudym Passover celebration.)
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA soon saw a huge crowd of people coming to look for him. Turning to Philip, he asked, “Where can we buy bread to feed all these people?”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was testing Philip, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA already knew what He was going to do.
Philip replied, “Even if we worked for months, we would not have enough money to feed them!”
Then Andraw, Simun Kafa’s brother, spoke up.
“There is a young boy here with five barley loaves and two fish. But what good is that with this huge crowd?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “Tell everyone to sit down,” So they all sat down on the grassy slopes. (The men alone numbered about Five thousand)
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA took the loaves, gave Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and distributed them to the people. Afterward 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA did the same with the fish. And they all ate as much as they wanted.
After everyone was full, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told his Talmidym, “Now gather the leftovers, so that nothing is wasted.”
So they picked up the pieces and filled twelve baskets with scraps left by the people who had eaten from the five barley loaves.
When the people saw 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA do this miraculous sign, they exclaimed, “Surely, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is the Nabym we have been expecting!”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA saw that they were ready to force him to be their king, he slipped away into the hills by himself.
That evening 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA’s Talmidym went down to the shore to wait for Him.
But as darkness fell and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA still had not come back, they got into the boat and headed across the lake toward Caparnaum.
Soon a gale swept down upon them, and the sea grew very rough.
They had rowed three or four miles when suddenly they saw 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA walking on the water toward the boat. They were terrified,
but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA called out to them, “Do not be afraid. I Am here!”
Then they were eager to let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA in the boat, and immediately they arrived at their destination!
The next day the crowd that had stayed on the far shore saw that the Talmidym had taken the only boat, and they realized 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had not gone with them.
Several boats from Tibarias landed near the place where 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had Baraked the bread and the people had eaten.
So when the crowd saw that neither 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA nor his Talmidym were there, they got into the boats and went across to Capernaum to look for Him.
They found 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA on the other side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “I tell you the truth, you want to be with me because I fed you, not because you understood the miraculous signs.

But do not be so concerned about perishable things like food. Spend your energy seeking the eternal life that the Son of Adam can give you. For ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given me the seal of His approval.”
They replied, “We want to perform 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s works too. What should we do?”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told them, “This is the only work 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wants from you: Believe in the one He has sent.”
They answered, “Show us a miraculous sign if you want us to believe in you. What can you do?
After all, our ancestors ate manna while they journeyed through the wilderness! The Scriptures say, ‘Musha gave them bread from Shamaym to eat.’”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “I tell you the truth, Musha did not give you bread from Shamaym. My ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did. And now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH offers you the true bread from Shamaym.
The true bread of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the one who comes down from Shamaym and gives life to the world.”
“Sir,” they said, “give us that bread every day.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “I Am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never be hungry again. Whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
But you have not believed in me even though you have seen me.
Those ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given Me will come to Me, and I will never reject them.
For I have come down from Shamaym to do the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent me, not to do my own WILL.
And this is the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that I should not lose even one of all those he has given me, but that I should raise them up at the last day.
For it is my ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s will that all who see His Son and believe in Him should have eternal life. I will raise them up at the last day.”
Then the people began to murmur in disagreement because
They said, “Is this not 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, the son of Ya'asaf? We know his father and mother. How can he say, ‘I came down from Shamaym’?”
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “Stop complaining about what I said.
For no one can come to me unless ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me draws them to Me, and at the last day I will raise them up.
As it is written in the Scriptures, ‘They will all be taught by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’ Everyone who listens to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and learns from Him comes to me.
(Not that anyone has ever seen ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH ; only I, who was sent from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have seen 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.)
“I tell you the truth, anyone who believes has eternal life.
Yes, I am the bread of life!
Your ancestors ate manna in the wilderness, but they all died.
Anyone who eats the bread from Shamaym, however, will never die.
I am the living bread that came down from Shamaym. Anyone who eats this bread will live forever; and this bread, which I will offer so the world may live, is my flesh.”
Then the people began arguing with each other about what He meant. “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?” they asked.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said again, “I tell you the truth, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Adam and drink his blood, you cannot have eternal life within you.
But anyone who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise that person at the last day.
For my flesh is True food, and my blood is true drink.
Anyone who eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in Me, and I in him.
I live because of the living ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent me; in the same way, anyone who feeds on me will live because of Me.
I am the true bread that came down from Shamaym. Anyone who eats this bread will not die as your ancestors died (even though they ate the manna) but anyone who eats this bread will live forever.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said these things while He was teaching in the congregation in Capernaum.
Many of his followers said, “This is very hard to understand. How can anyone accept it?”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was aware that his followers were complaining, so he said to them, “Does this offend you?
Then what will you think if you see the Son of Adam ascend to Shamaym again?
The RUACH alone gives eternal life. man's effort accomplishes nothing. And the very words I have spoken to you are RUACH and Life.
But some of you do not believe Me.” (For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA knew from the beginning which ones did not believe, and He knew who would betray Him.)
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “That is why I said that people cannot come to me unless ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives them to me.”
At this point many of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA's followers turned away and deserted Him.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA turned to the Twelve Talmidym and asked, “Are you also going to leave?”
Simun Kafa replied, “Master, to whom would we go to? You have the Dabarym (words) that gives eternal life.
We believe, and we know you are the Qadash One of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “I chose the twelve of you, but one is a devil.”
He was speaking of Yudas, son of Simun Iscariut, one of the Twelve, who would later betray Him.
After these things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA walked in Galily; for He did not want to walk in Yahudah, because the Yahudym sought to kill Him.
Now the Yahudym’ Feast of Tabernacles was at hand.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA‘s brothers therefore said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, “Depart from here and go into Yahudah, that Your Talmidym also may see the works that You are doing.
For no one does anything in secret while He himself seeks to be known openly. If You do these things, show Yourself to the world.”
For even 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA‘s brothers did not believe in Him.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
The world cannot hate you, but it hates Me because I testify of the world, that its works are evil.
You go up to this feast. I Am not yet going up to this feast, for My time has not yet fully come.”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had said these things to them, He remained in Galily.
But when His brothers had gone to the feast, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA also went up to the feast, not openly, but as it were in secret.
Then the Yahudym sought 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA at the feast, and said, “Where is He?”
And there was much complaining among the people concerning 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA. Some said, “He is good”; others said, “No, on the contrary, He deceives the people.”
However, no one spoke openly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA for fear of the Yahudym.
Now about the middle of the feast 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA went up into the temple and taught.
And the Yahudym marveled, saying, “How does this Man know so much, when He have never studied?”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered them and said, “My message is not my own; it comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me.
Anyone who wants to do the Will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will know whether my teaching is from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH or is merely my own.
Those who speak for themselves want esteemed only for themselves, but a man who seeks to honor the one who sent him speaks truth, not lies.
Musha gave you the law, but none of you obeys it! In fact, you are trying to kill me.”
The people answered and said, “You have a demon. Who is seeking to kill You?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered and said to them, “I did one work, and you all marvel.
Musha therefore gave you circumcision not that it is from Musha, but from ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and you circumcise a man on the Shabbat Yum.
If a man receives circumcision on the Shabbat day, so that the law of Musha should not be broken, why are you angry with Me because I made a man completely well on the Shabbat?
Do not judge according to appearance, but judge with righteous judgment.”
Now some of them from Yahushalam said, “Is this not He whom they seek to kill?
But look! He speaks boldly, and they say nothing to Him. Do the rulers know indeed that this is truly Ha'Mashyach?
However, we know where this Man is from; but when Ha'Mashyach comes, no one knows where He is from.”

Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA cried out, as He taught in the temple, saying, “You both know Me, and you know where I am from; and I have not come of Myself, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me is true, whom you do not know.
But I know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for I Am from Him, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent Me.”
Therefore they sought to take 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA; but they could not lay their hands on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, because His hour has not yet come.
And many of the people believed in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, and said, “When Ha'Mashyach comes, will He do more signs than these which this Man has done?”
The Pharisees heard the crowd murmuring these things concerning 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, and the Pharisees and the chief Kuhanym sent officers to take 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will go to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me.
You will seek Me and not find Me, and where I Am you cannot come.”
Then the Yahudym said among themselves, “Where does He intend to go that we shall not find Him? Does He intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
What is this thing that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, ‘You will seek Me and not find Me, and where I am you cannot come’?”
On the last day, that great day of the feast, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA stood and cried out, saying, “If anyone thirsts, let him come to Me and drink.
He who believes in Me, as the Scripture has said, out of his heart will flow rivers of living water.”
But this 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA spoke concerning the RUACH Ha'Qadash, whom those believing in Him would receive; for the RUACH Ha'Qadash was not yet given, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was not yet Esteemed.
Therefore many from the crowd, when they heard this saying, said, “Truly this is the Nabym.”
Others said, “This is Ha'Mashyach.” But some said, “Will Ha'Mashyach come out of Galily?
The Scripture has said that Ha'Mashyach will come from the seed of king Daud and from the town of Bathlaham, where Daud was”
So there was a division among the people because of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Now some of them wanted to take 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, but they could not lay hands on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Then the officers came to the chief Kuhanym and Pharisees, who said to them, “Why have you not brought 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA?”
The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this Man!”
Then the Pharisees answered them, “Are you also deceived?
Have any of the rulers or the Pharisees believed in Him?
This foolish crowd follows Him, but they are ignorant of the law. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s curse is on them!”
Nicudamus (he who came to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA by night, being one of them) said to them,
“Does our law judge a man before it hears him and knows what he is doing?”
They answered and said to him, “Are you also from Galily? Search and look, for no Nabym has ever come out of Galilee.”
And everyone went to his own house.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA returned to the Mount of Olives,
but early the next morning 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was back again at the Temple. A crowd soon gathered, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA sat down and taught them.
As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was speaking, the teachers of religious law and the Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in the act of adultery. They put her in front of the crowd.
“They said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, Teacher “this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
The law of Musha says to stone her. What do you say?”
They were trying to trap 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA into saying something they could use against Him, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA stooped down and wrote in the dust with his finger.
They kept demanding an answer, so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA stood up again and said, “Let the one who has never sinned throw the first stone!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA stooped down again and wrote in the dust.
When the accusers heard this, they slipped away one by one, beginning with the oldest, until only 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was left with the woman.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA stood up again and said to the woman, “Where are your accusers? Is there no one left to condemn you?
“And she said No, Master,” Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go and sin no more.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA spoke to the people once more and said, “I Am the light of the world. If you follow me, you will not walk in darkness, because you will have the light that leads to life.”
The Pharisees replied, “You are making those claims about yourself! Such testimony is not valid.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told them, “These claims are valid even though I make them about Myself. For I know where I came from and where I am going, but you do not know this about Me.
You judge Me by man's standards, but I do not judge anyone.
And if I did, my judgment would be correct in every respect because I Am not alone. ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me is with Me.
Your own law says that if two people agree about something, their witness is accepted as fact.
I Am one witness, and my ABBA who sent me is the other.”
“Where is your ABBA?” they asked.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA made these statements while He was teaching in the section of the Temple known as the Treasury. But He was not arrested, because His time had not yet come.
Later 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to them again, “I Am going away. You will search for Me but will die in your sin. You cannot come where I Am going.”
The people asked, “Is He planning to commit suicide? What does He mean, ‘You cannot come where I am going’?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA continued, “You are from below; I Am from above. You belong to this world; I do not.
That is why I said that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I Am who I claim to be, you will die in your sins.”
“Who are you?” they demanded. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “The one I have always claimed to be.
I have much to say about you and much to condemn, but I will not. For I say only what I have heard from the One who sent Me, and He is completely truthful.”
But they still did not understand that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was talking about His ABBA.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Adam on the execution stake, then you will understand that I am He. I do nothing on my own but say only what my ABBA taught me.
And the one who sent me is with me He has not deserted me. For I always do what pleases Him.”
Then many who heard 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA say these things believed in Him.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to the people who believed in him, “You are truly my Talmidym if you remain faithful to my teachings.
And you will know the Amat (truth), and the Amat (truth) will set you free.”
“But we are descendants of Abraham,” they said. “We have never been slaves to anyone. What do you mean, ‘You will be set free’?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “I tell you the truth, everyone who sins is a slave of sin.
A slave is not a permanent member of the family, but a son is part of the family forever.
So if the Son sets you free, you are truly free.
Yes, I realize that you are descendants of Abraham. And yet some of you are trying to kill me because there is no room in your hearts for My message.
I Am telling you what I saw when I was with my ABBA. But you are following the advice of your father.”
“Our father is Abraham!” they declared.
Instead, you are trying to kill me because I told you the truth, which I heard from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Abraham never did such a thing.
No, you are imitating your real father.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told them, “If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH were your Abba, you would love Me, because I have come to you from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I Am not here on My own, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent me.
Why can you not understand what I am saying? It is because you cannot even hear Me!

For you are the children of your father ha'shatan, and you love to do the evil things ha'shatan does, ha'shatan was a murderer from the beginning, ha'shatan has always hated the truth, because there is no truth in him. When ha'shatan lies, it is consistent with his character; for ha'shatan is a liar and the father of lies.
So when I tell the truth, you just naturally do not believe me!
Which of you can truthfully accuse Me of sin? And since I am telling you the truth, why do you not believe me?
Anyone who belongs to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH listens gladly to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. But you do not listen because you do not belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
The people retorted, “You Samaritan devil! Did we not say all along that you were possessed by a demon?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “No,” I have no demon in Me. For I honor My ABBA and you dishonor me.
And though I have no wish to honor Myself, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is going to Honor Me. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the true judge.
I tell you the truth, anyone who obeys my teaching will never die!”
The people said, “Now we know you are possessed by a demon. Even Abraham and the Nabyms died, but you say, ‘Anyone who obeys my teaching will never die!’
Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the Nabyms. Who do you think you are?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered, “If I want honor for myself, it does not count. But it is my ABBA who will honor Me. You say, ‘𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH,’
but you do not even know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. But I know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. If I said otherwise, I would be as great a liar as you! But I do know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Your father Abraham rejoiced as he looked forward to my coming. Abraham saw it and was glad.”
The people said, “You are not even fifty years old. How can you say you have seen Abraham?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered, “I tell you the truth, before Abraham was even born, I Am!”
At that point they picked up stones to throw at 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was hidden from them and left the Temple.
As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was walking along, He saw a man who had been blind from birth.
“Rabbi,” the Talmidym asked Him, “why was this man born blind? Was it because of his own sins or his parents’ sins?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered. “It was not because of his sins or his parents’ sins, “This happened so the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH could be seen in him.
I must do the work of the One who sent me while it is day. For the Night is approaching, when no one can work.
As long as I am in the world, I Am the light of the world.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA spit on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and spread the mud over the blind man’s eyes.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told him, “Go wash yourself in the pool of Siluam” (Siluam means “sent”). So the man went and washed and came back seeing!
His neighbors and others who knew him as a blind beggar asked each other, “Is this not the man who used to sit and beg?”
Some said he was, and others said, “No, he just looks like him!” But the beggar kept saying, “Yes, I am the same one!”
They asked, “Who healed you? What happened?”
He told them, “The man they call 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA made mud and spread it over my eyes and told me, ‘Go to the pool of Siluam and wash yourself.’ So I went and washed, and now I can see!”
“Where is He now?” they asked. “I do not know,” he replied.
Then they took the man who had been blind to the Pharisees,
because it was on the Shabbat that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had made the mud and healed him.
The Pharisees asked the man all about it. So he told them, “He put the mud over my eyes, and when I washed it away, I could see!”

Some of the Pharisees said, “This man 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is not from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for he is working on the Shabbat.” Others said, “But how could an ordinary sinner do such miraculous signs?” So there was a deep division of opinion among them.
Then the Pharisees again questioned the man who had been blind and demanded, “What’s your opinion about this man who healed you?” The man replied, “I think He must be a Nabym.”
The Yahudym leaders still refused to believe the man had been blind and could now see, so they called in his parents.
They asked them, “Is this your son? Was he born blind? If so, how can he now see?”
His parents replied, “We know this is our son and that he was born blind,
But we do not know how he can see or who healed him. Ask him. He is old enough to speak for himself.”
His parents said this because they were afraid of the Yahudym leaders, who had announced that anyone saying 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was Ha'Mashyach would be expelled from the congregation.
That is why they said, “He is old enough. Ask him.”
So for the second time they called in the man who had been blind and told him, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH should get the Kabad for this, because we know this man 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is a sinner.”
“I do not know whether he is a sinner,” the man replied. “But I know this: I was blind, and now I can see!”
“But what did he do?” they asked. “How did he heal you?”
“Look!” the man exclaimed. “I told you once. Did you not listen? Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his Talmidym too?”
Then they cursed him and said, “You are his Talmidym, but we are Talmidym of Musha!
We know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke to Musha, but we do not even know where this man comes from.”
“Why, that’s very strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you do not know where He comes from?
We know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not listen to sinners, but He is ready to hear those who worship Him and do His Will.
Ever since the world began, no one has been able to open the eyes of someone born blind.
If this man were not from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, he could not have done it.”
“You were born a total sinner!” they answered. “Are you trying to teach us?” And they threw him out of the congregation.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA heard what had happened, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA found the man and asked, “Do you believe in the Son of Adam?”
The man answered, “Who is He sir? I want to believe in Him.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “You have seen Him,” and He is speaking to you!”
“Yes, Master, I believe!” the man said. And he worshiped 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told him, “I entered this world to render judgment, to give sight to the blind and to show those who think they see that they are blind.”
Some Pharisees who were standing nearby heard Him and asked, “Are you saying we are blind?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied. “If you were blind, you would not be guilty, “But you remain guilty because you claim you can see.
“I tell you the truth, anyone who sneaks over the wall of a sheepfold, rather than going through the gate, must surely be a thief and a robber!
But the one who enters through the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep recognize His voice and come to him. He calls His own sheep by name and leads them out.
After He has gathered His own flock, He walks ahead of them, and they follow him because they know his voice.
They will not follow a stranger; they will run from stranger because they do not know strangers voice.”
Those who heard 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA use this illustration did not understand what he meant,
so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA explained it to them: “I tell you the truth, I Am the gate for the sheep.
All who came before Me were thieves and robbers. But the true sheep did not listen to them.
Yes, I Am the gate. Those who come in through me will be saved. They will come and go freely and will find good pastures.
The thief’s purpose is to steal and kill and destroy. My purpose is to give them a rich and satisfying life.
“I Am the good shepherd. The good shepherd sacrifices his life for the sheep.
A hired hand will run when he sees a wolf coming. He will abandon the sheep because they do not belong to him and he is not their shepherd. And so the wolf attacks them and scatters the flock.
The hired hand runs away because he is working only for the money and does not really care about the sheep.
“I Am the good shepherd; I know my own sheep, and my sheep know me,
just as my ABBA knows me and I know My ABBA. So I sacrifice My life for the sheep.
I have other sheep too, that are not in this sheepfold. I must bring them also. They will listen to My voice, and there will be one flock with one shepherd.
“ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves Me because I sacrifice my life so I may take it back again.
No one can take My life from me. I sacrifice it voluntarily. For I have the authority to lay it down when I want to and also to take it up again. For this is what my ABBA has commanded.”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said these things, the people were again divided in their opinions about Him.
Some said, “He is demon possessed and out of His mind. Why listen to a man like that?”
Others said, “This does not sound like a man possessed by a demon! Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”
It was now winter, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was in Yahushalam at the time of Hanukkah, the Festival of Dedication.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was in the Temple, walking through the section known as Shalumah’s Colonnade.
The people surrounded
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “I have already told you, and you do not believe me. The proof is the work I do in the Name of My ABBA.
But you do not believe me because you are not my sheep.
My sheep know and listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one can snatch them away from me,
for My ABBA who has given them to me, He is more powerful than anyone else. No one can snatch them from ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s hand.
ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and I are one.”
Once again the people picked up stones to kill 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “At my ABBA’s direction I have done many good works. For which one are you going to stone me?”
They replied, “We are stoning you not for any good work, but for blasphemy! You, a mere man, but claim to be 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “It is written in your own Scriptures that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to certain leaders of the people, ‘I say, you are Aluahym (mighty ones)!’
And you know that the Scriptures cannot be altered. So if those people who received 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s message were called ‘Aluahym,’
why do you call it blasphemy when I say, ‘I am the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?‘ After all, Abba 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Qadash me (set Me apart) and sent Me into the world.
If I do not do the works of My ABBA, do not believe Me;

But if I do 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH‘s work, then believe in the evidence of the miraculous works I have done, even if you do not believe me. Then you will know and understand that ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is in me, and I Am in ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Once again they tried to arrest 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, but He got away and left them.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA went beyond the Yurdan River near the place where Yahukanun was first baptizing and stayed there awhile.
And many followed Him. “Yahukanun the Baptist did not perform miraculous signs,” they remarked to one another, “but everything he said about this man has come true.”
And many who were there believed in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
A man named Lazarus was sick. He lived in Bathany with his sisters, Maryam and Martha.
This is the Maryam who later poured the expensive perfume on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA’s feet and wiped them with her hair. Her brother, Lazarus, was sick.
So the two sisters sent a message to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA telling Him, “Master, your dear friend is very sick.”
But when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA heard about it He said, “Lazarus’s sickness will not end in death. No, it happened for the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH so that the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will receive honor from this.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA loved Martha, Maryam and Lazarus,
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA stayed where he was for the next two days.
Finally, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to His Talmidym, “Let us go back to Yahudah.”
But His Talmidym objected. “Rabbi,” they said, “only a few days ago the people in Yahudah were trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “There are twelve hours of daylight every day. During the day people can walk safely. They can see because they have the light of this world.
But at night there is danger of stumbling because they have no light.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but now I will go and wake him up.”
The Talmidym said, “Master, if he is sleeping, he will soon get better!”
They thought 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA meant Lazarus was simply sleeping, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA meant Lazarus had died.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead.
And for your sakes, I am glad I was not there, for now you will really believe. Come, let us go and see him.”
Thomas, who is also called Twin, said to his fellow Talmidym, “Let us go, too and die with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA arrived at Bathany, he was told that Lazarus had already been in his grave for four days.
Bathany was only a few miles down the road from Yahushalam,
And many of the people had come to console Martha and Maryam in their loss.
When Martha got word that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was coming, she went to meet him. But Maryam stayed in the house.
Martha said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, “Master, if only you had been here, my brother would not have died.
But even now I know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give you whatever you ask.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told her, “Your brother will rise again.”
“Yes,” Martha said, “he will rise when everyone else rises, at the last day.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told her, “I Am the resurrection and the life. Anyone who believes in me will live, even after dying.
Everyone who lives in me and believes in me will never ever die. Do you believe this, Martha?”
“Yes, Master,” she told 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA. “I have always believed you are Ha'Mashyach, the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the one who has come into the world from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Then she returned to Maryam. She called Maryam aside from the mourners and told her, “The Teacher is here and wants to see you.”
So Maryam immediately went to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had stayed outside the village, at the place where Martha met Him.
When the people who were at the house consoling Maryam saw her leave so hastily, they assumed she was going to Lazarus’s grave to weep. So they followed her there.
When Maryam arrived and saw 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, she fell at His feet and said, “Master, if only you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA saw her weeping and saw the other people wailing with her, a deep anger welled up within 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, and He was deeply troubled.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA wept.
The people who were standing nearby said, “See how much 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA loved him!”
But some said, “This man healed a blind man. He could have kept Lazarus from dying?”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was still angry as He arrived at the tomb, a cave with a stone rolled across its entrance.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told them. “Roll the stone aside,” But Martha, the dead man’s sister, protested, “Master, he has been dead for four days. The smell will be terrible.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA responded, “Did I not tell you that you would see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Kabad if you believe?”
So they rolled the stone aside. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA looked up to Shamaym and said, “ABBA, thank you for hearing me.
You always hear me, but I said it out loud for the sake of all these people standing here, so that they will believe you sent me.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA shouted, “Lazarus, come out!”
And the dead man came out, his hands and feet bound in graveclothes, his face wrapped in a headcloth. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told them, “Unwrap him and let him go!”
Many of the people who were with Maryam believed in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA when they saw this happen.
But some went to the Pharisees and told them what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had done.
Then the leading Kuhanym and Pharisees called the high council together. “What are we going to do?” they asked each other. “This man certainly performs many miraculous signs.
If we allow him to go on like this, soon everyone will believe in him. Then the Roman army will come and destroy both our Temple and our nation.”
Caiaphas, who was high Kuhan at that time, said, “You do not know what you are talking about!
Do you not realize that it is better for us that one man should die for the people than for the whole nation to be destroyed.”
He did not say this on his own; as high Kuhan at that time he was led to prophesy that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA would die for the entire nation.
And not only for that nation, but to bring together and unite all the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH scattered around the world.
So from that time on, the Yahudym leaders began to plot 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA’s death.
As a result, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA stopped his public ministry among the people and left Yahushalam. He went to a place near the wilderness, to the village of Àphraim, and stayed there with his Talmidym.

It was now almost time for the Yahudym Passakh celebration, and many people from all over the country arrived in Yahushalam several days early so they could go through the purification ceremony before Passakh began.
They kept looking for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, but as they stood around in the Temple, they said to each other, “What do you think? Will He not come for Passakh, will he?”
Meanwhile, the leading Kuhanym and Pharisees had publicly ordered that anyone seeing 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA must report it immediately so they could arrest him.
Then, six days before the Passover, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA came to Bathany, where Lazarus was who had been dead, whom He had raised from the dead.
There they made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA a supper; and Martha served, and Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Then Maryam took a pound of very costly oil of spikenard, and anointed the feet of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, and wiped His feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the oil.
But one of His Talmidym, Yudas Iscariut, Simun’s son, who would betray 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, said,
“Why was this fragrant oil not sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
This he said, not that he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and had the money box; and he used to take what was put in it.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “Let her alone; she has kept this for the day of My burial.
For the poor you have with you always, but Me you do not have always.”
Now a great numbers of the Yahudym knew that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was there; and they came, not for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA’s sake only, but that they might also see Lazarus, whom He had raised from the dead.
But the chief Kuhanym plotted to kill Lazarus also,
because on account of him many of the Yahudym went away and believed in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
The next day a great multitude that had come to the feast, when they heard that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was coming to Yahushalam,
Took branches of palm trees and went out to meet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, and cried out: “Husanna! ‘Baraked is He who comes in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! ’The King of Yashar'AL!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, when He had found a young donkey, sat on it; as it is written:
“Fear not, daughter of Ziun; Behold, your King is coming, Sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

But the Talmidym did not understand these things at first; but when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was Exalted, they remembered that these things were written about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and that they had done these things to Him.
Therefore the people, who were with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA when He called Lazarus out of his tomb and raised him from the dead, bore witness.
For this reason the people also met 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, because they heard that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had done this sign.
The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “You see that you are accomplishing nothing. Look, the world has gone after 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA!”
Now there were certain Greeks among those who came up to worship at the feast.
Then they came to Philip, who was from Bathsaida of Galily, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we wish to see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.”
Philip came and told Andraw, and in turn Andraw and Philip told 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered them, saying, “The hour has come that the Son of Adam should be exalted.
Most assuredly, I say to you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the ground and dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it produces much grain.
He who loves his life will lose it, and he who hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
If anyone serves Me, let him follow Me; and where I Am, there My servant will be also. If anyone serves Me, him My ABBA will honor.
“Now My soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘ABBA, save Me from this hour’? But this is the purpose I came to this Arath.
ABBA, Exalt Your Name.” Then a voice came from Shamaym, saying, “I have Exalted My Name and will Exalt it again.”
Therefore the people who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “A Malak has spoken to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered and said, “This voice did not come because of Me, but for your sake.
Now is the judgment of this world; now the ruler of this world will be cast out.
And I, if I Am lifted up from the Arath, I will draw everyone to Myself.”
What 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, signify by what death He would die.
The people answered Him, “We have heard from the law that Ha'Mashyach remains forever; and how can You say, ‘The Son of Adam must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Adam?”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to them, “A little while longer the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, lest darkness overtake you; he who walks in darkness does not know where he is going.
While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become sons of light.” These things 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA spoke, and departed, and was hidden from them.
But although 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had done so many signs before them, they did not believe in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA,
That the word of Yashayahu the Nabym might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “That everyone who has believed our message, Are those 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will reveal His powerful arm?”
Therefore they could not believe, because Yashayahu said again:
“That 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so that their eyes cannot see, and their hearts cannot understand, and they cannot turn to Me and have Me heal them.”
Yashayahu was referring to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA when he said this, because he saw the future and spoke of Ha'Mashyach’s Kabad.
Many people did believe in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, however, including some of the Yahudym leaders. But they would not admit it for fear that the Pharisees would expel them from the congregation.
For they loved man's praise more than the praise of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA cried out and said, “He who believes in Me, believes not in Me but in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me.
And he who sees Me sees 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me.
I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in Me should not abide in darkness.
And if anyone hears My words and does not believe, I do not judge him; for I did not come to judge the world but to save the world.
He who rejects Me, and does not receive My words, has that which judges him, the word that I have spoken will judge him in the last day.
For I have not spoken on My own authority; but my ABBA who sent Me gave Me a command, what I should say and what I should speak.
And I know that the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is everlasting life. Therefore, whatever I speak, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has told Me, so I speak.”

Before the Passakh celebration, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA knew that his hour had come to leave this world and return to His ABBA. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ahaba (love's) His Talmidym during His ministry on Arath, and now He loved them to the very end.
It was time for supper, and ha'shatan had already prompted Yudas, son of Simun Iscariut, to betray 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA knew that ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had given Him authority over everything and that He had come from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and would return to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA got up from the table, took off his robe, wrapped a towel around his waist,
and poured water into a basin. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA began to wash the Talmidym’s feet, drying them with the towel He had around Him.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA came to Simun Kafa, he said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, “Master, are you going to wash my feet?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “You do not understand now what I Am doing, but someday you will.”
“No,” Kafa protested, “you will never ever wash my feet!” And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “Unless I wash you, you will not belong to me.”
kafa exclaimed, “Then wash my hands and head as well, Master, not just my feet!”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “A person who has bathed all over does not need to wash, except for the feet, to be entirely clean. And you Talmidym are clean, but not all of you.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA knew who would betray Him. That is what he meant when he said, “Not all of you are clean.”
After washing their feet, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA put on His robe again and sat down and asked, “Do you understand what I was doing?
You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Master,’ and you are right, because that is what “I Am”.
And since I, your Master and Teacher, have washed your feet, you ought to wash each other’s feet.
I have given you an example to follow. Do as I have done to you.
I tell you the truth, slaves are not greater than their master. Nor is the messenger more important than the one who sends the message.
Now that you know these things, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will Barak you for doing them.
“I Am not saying these things to all of you; I know the ones I have chosen. But this fulfills the Scripture that says, ‘The one who eats my food has turned against me.’
I tell you this beforehand, so that when it happens you will believe that I Am Ha'Mashyach.
I tell you the truth, anyone who welcomes my messenger is welcoming Me, and anyone who welcomes Me is welcoming ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent me.”
Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was deeply troubled, and He exclaimed, “I tell you the truth, one of you will betray me!”
The Talmidym looked at each other, wondering whom He could mean.
The Talmidym 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA loved was sitting next to Him at the table.
Simun Kafa motioned to him to ask, “Who is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA talking about?”
So that Talmidym leaned over to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and asked, “Master, who is it?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA responded, “It is the one to whom I give the bread I dip in the bowl.” And when He had dipped it, He gave it to Yudas, son of Simun Iscariut.
When Yudas had eaten the bread, ha'shatan entered into him. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told him, “Hurry and do what you are going to do.”
None of the others at the table knew what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA meant.
Since Yudas was their treasurer, some thought 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was telling him to go and pay for the food or to give some money to the poor.
So Yudas left at once, going out into the night.
As soon as Yudas left the room, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “The time has come for the Son of Adam to enter into His Kabad, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be Exalted because of Him.
And since 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH receives Kabad because of the Son, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give His own Kabad to the Son, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will do so at once.
Dear children, I will be with you only a little longer. And as I told the Yahudym leaders, you will search for Me, but you can not come where I Am going.
So now I Am giving you a new commandment: Love each other. Just as I have loved you, you should love each other.
Your love for one another will prove to the world that you are my Talmidym.”
Simun Kafa asked, “Master, where are you going?” And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “You can’t go with Me now, but you will follow Me later.”
“But why can I not come now, Master?” he asked. “I’m ready to die for you.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered, “Die for Me? I say to you Kafa, the rooster shall not crow till you have denied Me three times.
“Do not let your hearts be troubled. Trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and also trust also in Me.
There is more than enough room in my ABBA’s home. If this were not so, would I have told you that I Am going to prepare a place for you?
When everything is ready, I will come and get you, so that you will always be with me where I Am.
And you know the way to where I am going.”
“No, we do not know, Master,” Thumas said. “We have no idea where you are going, so how can we know the way?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told him, “I Am the way, the Amat (Truth), and the Life. No one can come to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH except through me.
If you had really known Me, you would know who my ABBA is. From now on, you do know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and have seen 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!”
Philip said, “Master, show us 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and we will be satisfied.”

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “Have I been with you all this time, Philip, and yet you still do not know who I Am? Anyone who has seen me has seen ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! So why are you asking Me to show 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to you?
Do you not believe that I Am in ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is in me? The Dabarym (words) I speak are not my own, but My ABBA who lives in Me does HIS work through Me.
Just believe that I Am in ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and ABBA is in me. Or at least believe because of the work you have seen Me do.
“I tell you the truth, anyone who believes in Me will do the same works I have done, and even greater works, because I Am going to be with My ABBA.
You can ask for anything in my Name, and I will do it, so that the Son can bring honor to His ABBA.
Yes, ask me for anything in my Name, and I will do it!
“If you love me, obey my commandments.
And I will ask ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and He will give you another Comforter (Counselor, Helper, Intercessor, Advocate, Strengthener, and Standby), that He may remain with you forever.

He is the RUACH Ha'Qadash, who will lead you into all Truth, the world cannot receive the RUACH Ha'Qadash, because they are not looking for the RUACH Ha'Qadash and they do not recognize HIM. But you know HIM, because the RUACH Ha'Qadash lives with you now and later He will be in you.
No, I will not abandon you as orphans, I will come to you.
Soon the world will no longer see Me, but you will see Me. Since I live, you will also live.
When I Am raised to life again, you will know that I Am in my ABBA, and you are in Me, and I Am in you.
Those who accept My commandments and obey them, are those who love Me. And those who love Me will be loved by My ABBA, and I will love them and manifest Myself to them.”
Yudas (not Iscariut, but the other Talmidym with that name) said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, “Master, why are you going to reveal yourself only to us and not to the world at large?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “Those who love Me will do what I say. And My ABBA will love them, and we will come and make our home within each of them.
Anyone who does not love me will not obey me. And remember, My Dabarym (words) are not my own. What I am telling you is from ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me.
I am telling you these things now while I am still with you.
But when ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sends the Advocate as my representative, that is the RUACH Ha'Qadash, He will teach you everything and will remind you of everything I have told you.
“I Am leaving you with a gift, Shalum of mind and heart. And the Shalum I give is a gift the world cannot give. So do not be troubled or afraid.
Remember what I told you: I Am going away, but I will come back to you again. If you really loved Me, you would be happy that I Am going to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who is greater than I Am.
“And now I have told you before it comes, that when it does come to pass, you may believe.
“I do not have much more time to talk to you, because the ruler of this world approaches, he has no power over me,
But I will do what My ABBA requires of Me, so that the world will know that I love ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Come, let us be going.
“I Am the true grapevine, and My ABBA is the gardener.
ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will cut off every branch of mine that does not produce fruit, and ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH prunes the branches that do bear fruit so they will produce even more.
You have already been pruned and purified by the message I have given you.
Remain in me, and I will remain in you. For a branch cannot produce fruit if it is severed from the vine, and you cannot be fruitful unless you remain in me.
“Yes, I Am the vine; you are the branches. Those who remain in me, and I in them, will produce much fruit. For apart from me you can do nothing.
Anyone who does not remain in me is thrown away like a useless branch and withers. Such branches are gathered into a pile to be burned.
But if you remain in me and my Dabar remain in you, you may ask for anything you want, and it will be granted!
When you produce much fruit, you are My true Talmidym. This brings great Kabad to My ABBA.
“I have loved you even as ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has loved me. Remain in My love.
When you obey My commandments, you remain in My love, just as I obey My ABBA’s commandments and remain in ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's love.
I have told you these things so that you will be filled with my joy. Yes, your joy will overflow!
This is my commandment: Love each other in the same way I have loved you.
There is no greater love than to lay down one’s life for one’s friends.
You are My friends if you do what I command.
I no longer call you slaves, because a master does not confide in his slaves. Now you are my friends, since I have told you everything ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH told me.
You did not choose Me. I chose you. I appointed you to go and produce lasting fruit, so that ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give you whatever you ask for, using my Name.
This is My command: Love each other.
“If the world hates you, remember that the world hated me first.
The world would love you as one of their own if you belonged to them, but you are no longer part of the world. I chose you to come out of the world system, so the world hates you.
Do you remember what I told you? ‘A slave is not greater than the master.’ Since they persecuted Me, naturally they will persecute you. And if they had listened to Me, they would listen to you.
They will do all this to you because of Me, for they have rejected 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent me.
They would not be guilty if I had not come and spoken to them. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
Anyone who hates me also hates My ABBA.
If I had not done such miraculous signs among them that no one else could do, they would not be guilty. But as it is, they have seen everything I did, yet they still hate Me and My ABBA.
This fulfills what is written in the Scriptures: ‘They hated Me without cause.’
“But I will send you the Advocate, the RUACH of Truth. He will come to you from ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and will testify all about Me.
And you must also testify about Me because you have been with Me from the beginning of My ministration.
“I have told you these things so that you will not abandon your Amunah.
For you will be expelled from the congregation, and the time is coming when those who kill you will think they are doing a righteous service for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This is because they have never known ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH or Me.
Yes, I am telling you these things now, so that when they happen, you will remember My warning. I did not tell you earlier because I was going to be with You for a while longer.
“But now I Am going away to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sent Me, and not one of you is asking where I Am going.
Instead, you grieve because of what I have told you.
But in fact, it is best for you that I go away, because if I do not go, the Advocate will not come. If I do go away, then I will send the RUACH Ha'Qadash to you.
And when the RUACH Ha'Qadash comes, He will convict the world of its sin, and of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s righteousness, and of the coming judgment.
The world's sin is that they refuse to believe in Me.
Righteousness is available because I go to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and you will see me no more.
Judgment will come because the ruler of this world has already been judged.
“There is so much more I want to tell you, but you cannot bear it now.

When the RUACH of Amat (Truth) comes, He will guide you into all Amat. The RUACH Ha'Qadash will not speak on His own but will tell you what He has heard. The RUACH Ha'Qadash will tell you about the future.
The RUACH Ha'Qadash will bring Me Kabad by telling you whatever He receives from Me.
All that belongs to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is Mine; this is why I said, ‘The RUACH will tell you whatever He receives from Me.’
“In a little while you will not see Me anymore. But a little while after that, you will see me again.”
Some of the Talmidym asked each other, “What does 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA mean when He says, ‘In a little while you will not see me, but then you will see me,’ and ‘I am going to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’?
And what does He mean by ‘a little while’? We do not understand.”

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA realized they wanted to ask him about it, so He said, “Are you asking yourselves what I meant? I said in a little while you will not see Me, but a little while after that you will see Me again.
I tell you the truth, you will weep and mourn over what is going to happen to me, but the world will rejoice. You will grieve, but your grief will suddenly turn to wonderful joy.
It will be like a woman suffering the pains of labor. When her child is born, her anguish gives way to joy because she has brought a new baby into the world.
So you have sorrow now, but I will see you again; then you will rejoice, and no one can rob you of that joy.
At that time you will not need to ask me for anything. I tell you the truth, you will ask ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH directly, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will grant your request because you use my Name.
You have not done this before. Ask, using My Name, and you will receive, and you will have abundant joy.
“I have spoken of these matters in figures of speech, but soon I will stop speaking figuratively and will tell you plainly all about ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Then you will ask in My Name. I Am not saying I will ask ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on your behalf,
for ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Himself loves you dearly because you love Me and believe that I came from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yes, I came from ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH into the world, and now I will leave the world and return to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Then His Talmidym said, “At last you are speaking plainly and not figuratively.
Now we understand that you know everything, and there is no need to question you. From this we believe that you came from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA asked, “Do you finally believe?
But the time is coming, indeed it is here now, when you will be scattered, each one going His own way, leaving Me alone. Yet I Am not alone because ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is with me.
I have told you all this so that you may have Shalum in Me, here on Arath you will have many trials and sorrows. But take heart, because I have overcome the world.”
After 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had said this, He looked up to Shamaym and said, “ABBA the hour has come. Exalt your Son so He can give Kabad back to YOU.
For YOU have given Him authority over everyone, that Your son might give eternal life to everyone YOU have given Him.
The way to have eternal life, is to know YOU, the only true 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and to know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach the one YOU sent to the Arath.
I brought Kabad to YOU here on the Arath by completing the work YOU gave Me to do.
Now, ABBA, bring Me into the Kabad We shared before the world began.
“I have revealed YOU to the ones you gave me from this world. They were always yours. YOU gave them to me, and they have kept Your Dabar.
Now they know that everything I have is a gift from YOU,
For I have passed on to them the message YOU gave Me. They accepted it and know that I came from YOU, and they believe YOU sent Me.
“My prayer is not for the world, but for those YOU have given Me, because they belong to YOU.
All who are Mine belong to YOU, and you have given them to Me, so they bring Me Kabad.

Now I Am departing from the world; they are staying in this world, but I Am coming to you. Qadash ABBA, you have given Me your Name; now protect them by the power of Your Name so that they will be united just as we are.
During my time here, I protected them by the power of the Name YOU gave Me. I guarded them so that not one was lost, except the one headed for destruction, as the Scriptures foretold.
“Now I am coming to you. I told them many things while I was with them in this world so they would be filled with My joy.
I have given them Your Dabar. And the world hates them because they do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.
I Am not asking YOU to take them out of the world, but to keep them safe from the evil one.
They do not belong to this world any more than I do.
Make them Qadash by Your Amat (Truth); teach them Your Dabar, which is Amat (Truth).
Just as YOU sent Me into the world, I Am sending them into the world.
And I give Myself as a Qadash sacrifice for them so they can be made Qadash by Your Amat (Truth).
“I Am praying not only for these Talmidym but also for all who will ever believe in me through their message.
I pray that they will all be one, just as YOU and I are one, as YOU are in Me ABBA and I Am in YOU. And may they be in US so that the world will believe YOU sent Me.
“I have given them the Kabad you gave Me, so they may be one as We are one.
I Am in them and YOU are in me. May they experience such perfect unity that the world will know that you sent Me and that YOU love them as much as YOU love Me.
ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH I want these whom YOU have given me to be with me where I Am, then they can see all the Kabad you gave Me because YOU loved Me even before the world began!
“O righteous ABBA, the world does not know YOU, but I do; and these Talmidym know YOU sent Me.
I have revealed YOU to them, and I will continue to do so. Then Your love for Me will be in them, and I will be in them.”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had spoken these words, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA went out with His Talmidym over the Brook Kidrun, where there was a garden, which Him and His Talmidym entered.
Yudas, the betrayer, knew this place, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had often gone there with His Talmidym.
The leading Kuhanym and Pharisees had given Yudas a contingent of Roman soldiers and Temple guards to accompany him. Now with blazing torches, lanterns, and weapons, they arrived at the olive grove.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA fully realized all that was going to happen to Him, so He stepped forward to meet and ask them. “Who are you looking for?”
“They said we are looking for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA the Nazarym. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said. “I Am He,” (Yudas, who betrayed YAHUSHA was standing with them)
As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said “I Am He,” they all drew back and fell to the ground!
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA asked again, “Who are you looking for?” and they replied, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA the Nazarym.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said. “I told you that I Am He,” and since I Am the One you want, let these others go.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA did this to fulfill his own statement: “I did not lose a single one of those you have given me.”
Then Simun Kafa drew a sword and slashed off the right ear of Malchus, the high Kuhan’s slave.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to Kafa, “Put your sword back into its sheath. Shall I not drink from the cup of suffering ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given Me?”
So the soldiers, their commanding officer, and the Temple guards arrested 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and tied him up.
First they took 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to Annas, since he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high Kuhan at that time.
Caiaphas was the one who had told the other Yahudym leaders, “It’s better that one man should die for the people.”
Simun Kafa followed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, as did another of the Talmidym. That other Talmidym was acquainted with the high Kuhan, so he was allowed to enter the high Kuhan’s courtyard with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Kafa had to stay outside the gate. Then the Talmidym who knew the high Kuhan spoke to the woman watching at the gate, and she let Kafa in.
The woman asked Kafa, “You are one of that man’s Talmidym, are you? “No, Kafa said, “I am not.”
Because it was cold, the household servants and the guards had made a charcoal fire. They stood around it, warming themselves, and Kafa stood with them, warming himself.
Then the High Kuhan began questioning 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA about his followers and what he had been teaching them.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “Everyone knows what I teach. I have preached regularly in the congregation and the Temple, where the people gather. I have not spoken in secret.
Why are you asking Me this question? Ask those who heard Me. They know what I said.”
Then one of the Temple guards standing nearby slapped 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA on the face. “Is that the way to answer the high Kuhan?” he demanded.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “If I said anything wrong, you must prove it. But if I Am speaking the truth, why are you beating me?”
Then Annas bound 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and sent him to Caiaphas, the high Kuhan.
Meanwhile, as Kafa was standing by the fire warming himself, they asked him again, “You are one of His Talmidym, aren't you?” then Kafa denied it, saying, “No, I am not.”
But one of the household slaves of the high Kuhan, a relative of the man whose ear Kafa had cut off, asked, “Did I not see you out there in the olive grove with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA?”
Again kafa denied it. And immediately a rooster crowed.

And when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA’s trial before Caiaphas ended in the early hours of the morning. Then he was taken to the headquarters of the Roman governor. His accusers did not go inside because it would defile them, and they would not be allowed to celebrate the Passakh.
So Pilate, the governor, went out to them and asked, “What is your charge against this man?”
“We would not have handed him over to you if He were not a criminal!” they retorted.
“Then take Him away and judge Him by your own law,” Pilate told them. “Only the Romans are permitted to execute someone,” the Yahudym leaders replied.
(This fulfilled 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA’s prediction about the way He would die.)
Then Pilate went back into His quarters and called for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to be brought to him. “Are you the king of the Yahudym?” he asked 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA replied, “Are you speaking for yourself about this, or did others tell you this concerning Me?”
Pilate answered, “Am I a Yahudym? Your own nation and the chief Kuhanym have delivered You to me. What have You done?”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA answered, “My Kingdom is not an earthly kingdom. If it were, My followers would fight to keep Me from being handed over to the Yahudym leaders. But my Kingdom is not of this world.”
Pilate said, “So you are a king?”
“What is truth?” Pilate asked. Then he went out again to the people and told them, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is not guilty of any crime.
But you have a custom of asking me to release one prisoner each year at Passakh. Would you like me to release this ‘King of the Yahudym’?”
But they shouted back, “No! Not this man. We want Barabbas!” (Barabbas was a revolutionary.)
Then Pilate had 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA flogged with a lead-tipped whip.
The soldiers wove a crown of thorns and put it on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA‘s head, and they put a purple robe on Him.
“Hail! King of the Yahudym!” they mocked, as they slapped 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA on His face.
Pilate went outside again and said to the people, “I am going to bring 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA out to you now, but understand clearly that I find Him not guilty.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said, “Look, here is the man!”
When they saw Him, the leading Kuhanym and Temple guards began shouting, “Impale Him! Impale Him!”
The Yahudym leaders replied, “By our law he ought to die because He called himself the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
When Pilate heard this, he was more frightened than ever.
He took 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA back into the headquarters again and asked Him, “Where are you from?” But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA gave no answer.
“Why do you not talk to me?” Pilate demanded. “Do you not realize that I have the power to release you or impale you?”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said, “You have no power over Me at all, unless it were given to you from above. So the one who handed Me over to you has the greater sin.”
Then Pilate tried to release 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, but the Yahudym leaders shouted, “If you release this man, you are no ‘friend of Caesar.’ Anyone who declares himself a king is a rebel against Caesar.”
When they said this, Pilate brought 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA out to them again. Then Pilate sat down on the judgment seat on the platform that is called the Stone Pavement (in Abarym, Gabbatha).
It was now about sixth hour on the day of preparation for the Passakh. And Pilate said to the people, “Look, here is your king!”
“Away with him,” they yelled. “Away with him! Impale him!” “What? Impale your king?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” the leading Kuhanym shouted back.
Then Pilate turned 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA over to them to be impaled. So they took 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA away.
Carrying the execution stake by himself, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA went to the place called Place of the Skull (in Abarym, Gulgutha).
There they nailed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to the execution stake. Two others were impaled with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, one on either side, with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA between them.
And Pilate posted a sign on the execution stake that read, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA of Nazarym, the King of the Yahudym.”
The place where 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was impaled was near the city, and the sign was written in Abarym, Latin, and Greek, so that many people could read it.
Then the leading Kuhanym objected and said to Pilate, “Change it from ‘The King of the Yahudym’ to ‘He said, I am King of the Yahudym.’”
Pilate replied, “No, what I have written, I have written.”
When the soldiers had impaled 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, they divided His clothes among the four of them. They also took His robe, but it was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.

So they said, “Rather than tearing it apart, let’s throw dice for it.” This fulfilled the Scripture that says, “They divided my garments among themselves and threw dice for my clothing.” So that is what they did.
Standing near the execution stake were the mother of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, and his mother’s sister, Maryam (the wife of Clupas), and Maryam Magdalyn.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA saw His mother standing there beside the Talmidym He loved, He said to her, “Dear woman, here is your son.”
And He said to this Talmidym, “Here is your mother.” And from then on this Talmidym took her into his home.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA knew that His mission was now finished, and to fulfill Scripture He said, “I am thirsty.”
A jar of sour wine was sitting there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put it on a hyssop branch, and held it up to his lips.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA had tasted it, He said, “It is finished!” Then He bowed His head and released His Ruach.

It was the day of preparation, and the Yahudym leaders did not want the bodies hanging there the next day, which was the Sabbath (and a very special Sabbath, because it was the Passakh). So they asked Pilate to hasten their deaths by ordering that their legs be broken. Then their bodies could be taken down.
So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the two men impaled with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
But when they came to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, they saw that He was already dead, so they did not break His legs.
One of the soldiers, however, pierced His side with a spear, and immediately blood and water flowed out.
(This report is from an eyewitness giving an accurate account. He speaks the truth so that you also may continue to believe.)
These things happened in fulfillment of the Scriptures that say, “Not one of His bones will be broken,”
and “They will look on the one they pierced.”

Afterward Ya'asaf of Arimathaa, who had been a secret Talmidym of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA (because he feared the Yahudym leaders), asked Pilate for permission to take down the body of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA. When Pilate gave permission, Ya'asaf came and took the body away.
With him came Nicudamus, the man who had come to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA at night, he brought about seventy five pounds of perfumed ointment made from myrrh and aloes.
Following Yahudym burial custom, they wrapped the body of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA with the spices in long sheets of linen cloth.
The place where He was impaled is near a garden, where there was a new tomb, never used before.
And so, because it was the day of preparation for the Yahudym Passakh and since the tomb was close at hand, they laid 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA there.
Now the first day of the week Maryam Magdalyn went to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

Then she ran and came to Simun Kafa, and to the other Talmidym, whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA loved, and said to them, “They have taken 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid Him.”
Kafa and the other Talmidym started going to the tomb.
They were both running, but the other Talmidym outran Kafa and reached the tomb first.
He stooped and looked in and saw the linen wrappings lying there, but he did not go in.
Then Simun Kafa arrived and went inside. He also noticed the linen wrappings lying there,
while the cloth that had covered 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA’s head was folded up and lying apart from the other wrappings.
Then the Talmidym who had reached the tomb first also went in, and he saw and believed
for until then they still had not understood the Scriptures that said 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA must rise again from the dead.
Then they went home.
Maryam was standing outside the tomb crying, and as she wept, she stooped and looked in.
