Now, most people would not be willing to die for an upright person, though someone might perhaps be willing to die for a person who is especially good.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed His great ahaba (love) for us by sending 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to die for us while we were still sinners.
And since we have been made right in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by the blood of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, our MASTER will certainly save us from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s condemnation.
For since our friendship with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was restored by the death of His Son while we were still HIS enemies, we will certainly be saved through the life of the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So now we can rejoice in our wonderful new relationship with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because our Savior 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach has made us friends of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
When Adam sinned, sin entered the world. Adam’s sin brought death, so death spread to everyone, for everyone sinned.
Yes, people sinned even before the law was given. But it was not counted as sin because there was not yet any law to break.

Still, everyone died, from the time of Adam to the time of Musha, even those who did not disobey an explicit commandment of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as Adam did. Now Adam is a symbol, a representation of Ha'Mashyach, who was yet to come.

But there is a great difference between Adam’s sin and the merciful gift of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For the sin of this one man, Adam, brought death to many. But even greater is the wonderful favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and HIS gift of forgiveness to many through this other Man, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.

And the result of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s wonderful gift is very different from the result of that one man’s sin. For Adam’s sin led to condemnation, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s free gift leads to our being made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, even though we are guilty of many sins.

For the sin of this one man, Adam, caused death to rule over many. But even greater is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s wonderful favor and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH‘s gift of righteousness, for all who receive it will live in triumph over sin and death through this one man, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Yes, Adam’s one sin brings condemnation for everyone, but Ha'Mashyach’s one act of righteousness brings a right relationship with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and new life for everyone.
For because one man disobeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, many became sinners. But because one other Man obeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, many will be made righteous.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s law was given so that all mankind could see how sinful they were. But as people sinned more and more, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s wonderful favor became more abundant.

So just as sin ruled over all men and brought them to death, now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s wonderful favor rules instead, giving us right standing with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and resulting in eternal life through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our Master and Savior.
Well then, should we keep on sinning so that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH can show us more and more of his wonderful favor?
Of course not! Since we have died to sin, how can we continue to live in it?
Or have you forgotten that when we were joined with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach in baptism, we joined 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA in His death?
For we died and were buried with Ha'Mashyach by baptism. And just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was raised from the dead by the wonderful power of ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, now we also may live new lives.
Since we have been united with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA in his death, we will also be raised to life as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was.
We know that our old sinful selves were impaled with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA so that sin might lose its power in our lives. We are no longer slaves to sin.
For when we died with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach we were set free from the power of sin.
And since we died with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, we know we will also live with Ha'Mashyach.
We are sure of this because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was raised from the dead, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA will never die again. Death no longer has any power over 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA died, He died once to break the power of sin. But now that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA lives, He lives for the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So you also should consider yourselves to be dead to the power of sin and alive to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Do not let sin control the way you live; do not give in to sinful desires.

Do not let any part of your body become an instrument of evil to serve sin. Instead, give yourselves completely to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for you were dead, but now you have new life. So use your whole body as an instrument to do what is right for the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Sin is no longer your master, for you no longer live under the requirements of the law. Instead, you live under the freedom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Favor.
Well then, since 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s favor has set us free from the law, does that mean we can go on sinning? Of course not!
Do you not realize that you become the slave of whatever you choose to obey? You can be a slave to sin, which leads to death, or you can choose to obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, which leads to righteous living.
Tudah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Once you were slaves of sin, but now you wholeheartedly obey this teaching we have given you.
Now you are free from your slavery to sin, and you have become slaves to righteous living.

Because of the weakness of your man's nature, I am using the illustration of slavery to help you understand all this. Previously, you let yourselves be slaves to impurity and lawlessness, which led ever deeper into sin. Now you must give yourselves to be slaves to righteous living so that you will become Qadash.
When you were slaves to sin, you were free from the obligation to do right.
And what was the result? You are now ashamed of the things you used to do, things that end in eternal doom.
But now you are free from the power of sin and have become slaves of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Now you do those things that lead to righteousness and result in eternal life.
For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is eternal life through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our Master and Savior.
Now, dear Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters), you who are familiar with the law, do you not know that the law applies only while a person is living?
For example, when a woman marries, the law binds her to her husband as long as he is alive. But if he dies, the laws of marriage no longer apply to her.
So while her husband is alive, she would be committing adultery if she married another man. But if her husband dies, she is free from that law and does not commit adultery when she remarries.

So, my dear brothers and sisters, this is the point: You died to the power of the law when you died with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA. And now you are united with the one who was raised from the dead. As a result, we can produce a harvest of righteous fruits for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
When we were controlled by our old nature, sinful desires were at work within us, and the law aroused these evil desires that produced a harvest of sinful fruits, resulting in death.

But now we have been released from the law, for we died to it and are no longer captive to its power. Now we can serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, not in the old way of obeying the letter of the law, but in the new way of living in the RUACH.

Well then, am I suggesting that the law of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is sinful? Of course not! In fact it was the law that showed me my sin. I would never have known that coveting is wrong if the law had not said, “You must not covet.”
But sin used this command to arouse all kinds of covetous desires within me! If there were no law, sin would not have that power.
At one time I lived without understanding the law. But when I learned the command not to covet, for instance, the power of sin came to life,
And I died. So I discovered that the law’s commands, which were supposed to bring life, brought spiritual death instead.
Sin took advantage of those commands and deceived me; it used the commands to kill me.
But still, the law itself is Qadash, and the commandments are Qadash and right and good.

But how can that be? Did the law, which is good, cause my death? Of course not! Sin used what was good to bring about my condemnation to death. So we can see how terrible sin really is. It uses 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s good commandments for its own evil purposes.
So the trouble is not with the law, for it is spiritual and good. The trouble is with me, for I am carnally minded, a slave to sin.
I do not really understand myself, for I want to do what is right, but I do not do it. Instead, I do what I hate.
But if I know that what I am doing is wrong, this shows that I agree that the law is good.
So I am not the one doing wrong; it is sin living in me that does it.
And I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my sinful nature. I want to do what is right, but I cannot.
I want to do what is good, but I do not. I do not want to do what is wrong, but I do it anyway.
But if I do what I do not want to do, I am not really the one doing wrong; it is sin living in me that does it.
I have discovered this principle of life, that when I want to do what is right, I inevitably do what is wrong.
I love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s law with all my heart.
But there is another power within me that is at war with my mind. This power makes me a slave to the sin that is still within me.
Oh, what a miserable person I am! Who will free me from this life that is dominated by sin and death?

Tudah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! The answer is in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our Master and Savior. So you see how it is: In my mind I really want to obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s law, but because of my sinful nature I am a slave to sin.
So now there is no condemnation for those who belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
And because you belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, the power of the life giving RUACH has freed you from the power of sin that leads to death.

The law of Musha was unable to save us because of the weakness of our sinful nature. So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did what the law could not do. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent HIS own Son in a body like the bodies we sinners have. And in that body 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH declared an end to sin’s control over us by giving His Son as a sacrifice for our sins.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did this so that the just requirement of the law would be fully satisfied for us, who no longer follow our sinful nature but instead follow the Ruach.
Those who are dominated by the sinful nature think about sinful things, but those who are controlled by the RUACH Ha'Qadash think about things that please the RUACH.
To be Carnally minded (letting your sinful nature control your mind) leads to death. But letting the RUACH control your mind leads you to life and Shalum.
Because the carnal mind is an enemy that is against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. It never did obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s laws, and it never will.
That is why those who are still under the control of their sinful nature can never please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

But you are not controlled by your sinful nature. You are controlled by the RUACH Ha'Qadash, if you have the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH living in you. And remember that those who do not have the Ruach Ha'Qadash living in them do not belong to Mashyach at all.
And Ha'Mashyach lives within you, so even though your body will die because of sin, the RUACH gives you life because you have been made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

And if the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who raised 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA from the dead, lives in you. For just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has raised 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach from the dead, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give life to your mortal bodies by this same Ruach living within you.
Therefore, dear brothers and sisters, you have no obligation to do what your sinful nature urges you to do.
For if you live by its dictates, you will die. But if through the power of the Ruach you put to death the deeds of your sinful nature, you will live.
For all who are led by the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So you have not received a RUACH that makes you fearful slaves. Instead, you received the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH when HE adopted you as HIS own children. Now we call 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH joins with our Ruach to affirm that we are 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s children.

And since we are the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, we are joint heirs with Ha'Mashyach, we are heirs of the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. But if we are to share the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, we must also share in the suffering of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Yet what we suffer now is nothing compared to the Kabad 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will reveal to us later.
For all creation is waiting eagerly for that future day when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will reveal who His children really are.
Against its will, all creation was subjected to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s curse. But with eager hope,
The creation looks forward to the day when it will join 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s children in awesome freedom from death and decay.
For we know that all creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.

And we believers also groan, even though we have the Ruach Ha'Qadash within us as a foretaste of future Kabad, for we long for our bodies to be released from sin and suffering. We, too, wait with eager hope for the day when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give us our full rights as his adopted children, including the new bodies he has promised us.
We were given this hope when we were saved. (If we already have something, we do not need to hope for it.
But if we look forward to something we do not yet have, we must wait patiently and confidently.)

And the Ruach Ha'Qadash helps us in our weakness. For example, we do not know what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wants us to pray for. But the Ruach Ha'Qadash prays for us with groanings that cannot be expressed in words.
And ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who knows all hearts knows what the Ruach is saying, for the Ruach pleads for us believers in harmony with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s own Will.
And we know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH causes everything to work together for the good of those who love HIM and are called according to HIS purpose for them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knew HIS people in advance, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose them to become like HIS Son, so that HIS Son would be the firstborn among many Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters).

And having chosen them, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called them to come to HIM. And having called them, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave them right standing with HIMSELF. And having given them right standing, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave them HIS Kabad.
What shall we say about such wonderful things as these? If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is for us, who can ever be against us?
Since 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not spare even his own Son but gave Him up for us all, will 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH not also give us everything else?
Who dares accuse us whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen for His own? No one, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF has given us right standing with HIMSELF.

Who then will condemn us? No one, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach died for us and was raised to life for us, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is sitting in the place of honor at 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s right hand, pleading for us.

Can anything ever separate us from the love of Ha'Mashyach? Does it mean 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH no longer loves us if we have trouble or calamity, or are persecuted, or hungry, or destitute, or in danger, or threatened with death?
(As the Scriptures say, “For your sake we are killed every day; we are being slaughtered like sheep.”)
No, despite all these things, overwhelming victory is ours through Ha'Mashyach, who loved us.

And I am convinced that nothing can ever separate us from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s love. Neither death nor life, neither Malakym nor demons, neither our fears for today nor our worries about tomorrow, not even the powers of Hades can separate us from the Ahaba (love) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

No power in the sky above or in the Arath below, indeed, nothing in all creation will ever be able to separate us from the Ahaba (love) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that is revealed in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our Master and Savior.
With Ha'Mashyach as my witness, I speak with utter truthfulness. My conscience and the RUACH Ha'Qadash confirm it.
My heart is filled with bitter sorrow and unending grief
for my people, my Yahudym Achk (brothers) and Achutys (sisters). I would be willing to be forever cursed, cut off from Ha'Mashyach! if that would save them.

The people of Yashar'AL are chosen to be the adopted children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH revealed HIS Kabad to them. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made covenants with them and gave them HIS Turah (law), and HE gave them the privilege of worshiping HIM and to receive the wonderful promises HE gave to their ancestors.

Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Himself was a Yasharalym according to the flesh. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is also Ha'Mashyach, the one who rules over everything and is worthy of eternal Yadah!.
Well then, has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH failed to fulfill his promise to Yashar'AL? No, for not all who are born into the nation of Yashar'AL are truly members of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people!

Being descendants of Abraham does not make them truly Abraham’s children. For the Scriptures say, “Yachaq is the son through whom your descendants will be counted,” though Abraham had other children, too.
This means that Abraham’s physical descendants are not necessarily children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Only the children of the promise are considered to be Abraham’s children.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had promised, “I will return about this time next year, and Sharah will have a son.”
This son was our father Yachaq. When he married Rabakah, she gave birth to twins.
But before they were born, before they had done anything good or bad, she received a message from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. (This message shows that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chooses men according to HIS own purposes;
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH calls people, but not according to their good or bad works.) She was told, “Your older son will serve your younger son.”
In the Dabar of the Scriptures, “I loved Ya'aqub, but I rejected Ásau.”
Are we saying, then, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was unfair? Of course not!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to Musha, “I will show mercy to anyone I choose, and I will show compassion to anyone I choose.”
So it is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who decides to show mercy. We can neither choose it nor work for it.
For the Scriptures say that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH told Phar'uh, “I have appointed you for the very purpose of displaying my power in you and to spread My fame throughout the Arath.”
So you see, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chooses to show mercy to some, and he chooses to harden the hearts of others so they refuse to listen.
Well then, you might say, “Why does 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH blame men for not responding? Have they not simply done what He makes them do?”
No, do not say that. Who are you, a mere man, to argue with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Should the thing that was created say to the one who created it, “Why have you made me like this?”
When a potter makes jars out of clay, does he not have a right to use the same lump of clay to make one jar for decoration and another to throw garbage into?
In the same way, even 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has the right to show HIS anger and HIS power, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is very patient with those on whom HIS anger falls, who are destined for destruction.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does this to make the riches of HIS Kabad shine even brighter on those to whom He shows mercy, who were prepared in advance for Kabad.
And we are among those whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH selected, both from the Yahudym and from the other nations.
Concerning the other nations, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar in the prophecy of Husha (Hosea), “Those who were not my people, I will now call my people, And I will love those whom I did not love before.”
And, “Then, at the place where they were told, ‘You are not my people, ’there they will be called ‘children of the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.’”
And concerning Yashar'AL, Yashayahu the Nabym cried out, “Though the people of Yashar'AL are as numerous as the sand of the seashore, only a remnant will be saved.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, Because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make a short work upon the Arath.”
And Yashayahu said the same thing in another place: “If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut had not spared a few of our children, we would have been wiped out like Sudum and destroyed like Gumurrah.”
What does all this mean? Even though the other nations were not trying to follow 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s standards, they were made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And it was by Amunah that this took place.
But the people of Yashar'AL, who tried so hard to get right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by keeping the law, never succeeded.
Why not? Because they were trying to get right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by keeping the law instead of by trusting in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. They stumbled over the great rock in their path.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH warned them of this in the Scriptures when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I AM placing a stone in Yahushalam that makes people stumble, a rock that makes them fall. But anyone who trusts in HIM will never be dishonored.”
Dear Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters), the longing of my heart and my prayer to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is for the people of Yashar'AL to be saved.
I know what enthusiasm they have for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but it is misdirected zeal.

For they do not understand 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s way of making people right with HIMSELF. Refusing to accept 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s way, they cling to their own way of getting right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by trying to keep the law.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach has already accomplished the purpose for which the law was given. As a result, all who believe in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA are made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For Musha writes that the law’s way of making a person right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH requires obedience to all of its commands.
But the righteousness that comes from Amunah says, “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will go up to Shamaym?’ (that is, to bring Ha'Mashyach down),
Or ‘Who will go down into the depths?’ (that is, to bring Ha'Mashyach back from the dead).”
This is what the Scripture says, “The Good News message is very close at hand; it is on your lips and in your heart.” And that message is the very message about Amunah that we preach:
If you openly declare that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is Ha'Mashyach and believe in your heart that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH raised 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA from the dead, you will be saved.
For it is by believing in your heart that you are made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and it is by openly declaring your Amunah that you are saved.
As the Scriptures tell us, “Anyone who trusts in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will never be put to Shame.”
Yahudym and other nations are the same in this respect. They have the same 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who gives generously to all who call on HIM.
For “Everyone who calls on the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA will be saved.”

But how can they call on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to save them unless they believe in Him? And how can they believe in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA if they have never heard about Him? And how can they hear about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA unless someone tells them?
And how will anyone go and tell them without being sent? That is why the Scriptures say, “How beautiful are the feet of messengers who bring good news!”
But not everyone welcomes the Good News, for Yashayahu the Nabym said, Who has believed our message? To whom has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH revealed”
So Amunah comes from hearing, that is, hearing the Good News about Ha'Mashyach.
But I ask, have the people of Yashar'AL actually heard the message? Yes, they have: “The message has gone throughout the Arath, and the Dabar to all the world.”

But I ask, did the people of Yashar'AL really understand? Yes, they did, for even in the time of Musha, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I will rouse your jealousy through people who are not even a nation. I will provoke your anger through the foolish nations.”
And later Yashayahu spoke boldly for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, saying, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I showed myself to those who were not asking for me.”
But regarding Yashar'AL, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “All day long I opened my arms to them, but they were disobedient and rebellious.”
I ask, then, has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rejected HIS own people, the nation of Yashar'AL? Of course not! I myself am a Yasharalym, a descendant of Abraham and a member of the tribe of Banyamin.

No, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not rejected HIS own people, whom HE chose from the very beginning. Do you realize what the Scriptures say about this? AliYahu the Nabym complained to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH about the people of Yashar'AL and said,
“O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they have killed your Nabyms and torn down your altars. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me, too.”
And do you remember 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s reply? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said, “No, I have Seven thousand others who have never bowed down to Baal!”
So it is at this present time: there is a remnant, chosen by the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But if this is by favor, then it is no longer on the basis of actions. Otherwise, favor would no longer be favor.

So this is the situation: Most of the people of Yashar'AL have not found the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH they are looking for so earnestly. A few are the ones 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen, but the hearts of the rest were hardened.
As the Scriptures say, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has put them into a deep sleep to this day 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has shut their eyes so they do not see, and closed their ears so they do not hear.”
Likewise, Daud said, “Let their bountiful table become a snare, a trap that makes them think all is well. Let their Barakah cause them to stumble, and let them get what they deserve.
Let their eyes go blind so they cannot see, and let their backs be bent forever.”

Did 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people stumble and fall beyond recovery? Of course not! They were disobedient, so 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made salvation available to the other nations. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wanted His own people to become jealous and claim it for themselves.

Now if the other nations were enriched because the people of Yashar'AL turned down 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s offer of salvation, think how much greater a Barakah the world will share when they finally accept 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH‘s salvation.
I am saying all this especially for you other nations. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has appointed me as the Shaliach to the other nations. I stress this,
For I want somehow to make the people of Yashar'AL jealous of what you the other nations have, so I might save some of them.
For since their rejection meant that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH offered salvation to the rest of the world, their acceptance will be even more wonderful. It will be life for those who were dead!

And since Abraham and the other patriarchs were qadash, their descendants will also be qadash, just as the entire batch of dough is qadash because the portion given as an offering is qadash. For if the roots of the tree are qadash, the branches will be qadash too.

But some of these branches from Abraham’s tree, some of the people of Yashar'AL have been broken off. And you the other nations, who were branches from a wild olive tree, have been grafted in. So now you also receive the Barakah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised Abraham and his children, sharing in the rich nourishment from the root of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s special olive tree.
But you must not brag about being grafted in to replace the branches that were broken off. You are just a branch, not the root.
“Well,” you may say, “those branches were broken off to make room for me.”

Yes, but remember those branches were broken off because they did not believe in Ha'Mashyach, and you are there because you do believe in Ha'Mashyach. So do not think highly of yourself, but fear what could happen.
For if 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not spare the original branches, he will not spare you either.

Notice how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is both kind and severe. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is severe toward those who disobeyed, but kind to you if you continue to trust in HIS kindness. But if you stop trusting, you also will be cut off.
And if the people of Yashar'AL turn from their unbelief, they will be grafted in again, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has the power to graft them back into the tree.

You, by nature, were a branch cut from a wild olive tree. So if 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was willing to do something contrary to nature by grafting you into HIS cultivated tree, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be far more eager to graft the original branches back into the tree where they belong.

I want you to understand this mystery, dear brothers and sisters, so that you will not feel proud about yourselves. Some of the people of Yashar'AL have hard hearts, but this will last only until the full number of the other nations comes to Ha'Mashyach.
And so all Yashar'AL will be saved. As the Scriptures say, “The one who rescues will come from Yahushalam, and he will turn Yashar'AL away from unrighteousness.
And this is my covenant with them, that I will take away their sins.”

Many of the people of Yashar'AL are now enemies of the Turah (Good News), and this benefits you the other nations. Yet they are still the people 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves because HE chose their fathers Abraham, Yachaq, and Ya'aqub.
For the gift and calling of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH can never be withdrawn.
For as you the other nations were once disobedient to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, yet have now obtained mercy through the disobedience of the Yasharalym,
even so the Yasharalym also have now been disobedient, that through the mercy shown you the other nations, the Yasharalym also may obtain mercy.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has committed them all to disobedience, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH might have mercy on all nations.
Oh, how great are the riches and wisdom and knowledge of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! How impossible it is for us to understand the decisions and the ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
For who can know the thoughts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Who knows enough to give advice to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
And who has given 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH so much that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH needs to pay it back?
For everything comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and everything existed by the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, to Esteem and bring Kabad to the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

And so, dear brothers and sisters, I plead with you to give your bodies to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because of all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done for you. Let your bodies be a living and Qadash sacrifice, the sacrifice 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will find acceptable. This is truly the way to worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Do not copy the behavior and customs of this world, but let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH transform you into a new person by changing the way you think. Then you will learn to know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s will for you, which is good and pleasing and perfect.

Because of the privilege and authority 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given me, I give each of you this warning: Do not think you are better than you really are. Be honest in your evaluation of yourselves, measuring yourselves by the Amunah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us.
Just as our bodies have many parts and each part has a special function,
so it is with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA’s body. We are many parts of one body, and we all belong to each other.

In the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, HE has given us different gifts for doing certain things well. So if 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given you the ability to prophesy, speak out with as much Amunah as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given you.
If your gift is serving others, serve them well. If you are a teacher, teach well.

If your gift is to encourage others, be encouraging. If your gift is giving, give generously. If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given you leadership ability, take the responsibility seriously. And if you have a gift for showing kindness to others, do it gladly.
Do not just pretend to love others, love them for real. Hate what is wrong. Hold tightly to what is good.
Love each other with genuine affection, and take delight in honoring each other.
Never be lazy, but work hard and serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH diligently.
Be joyful in hope, be patient in trouble, and persistent in prayer.
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people are in need, be ready to help them. Always be eager to practice hospitality.
Barak those who persecute you. Do not curse them; pray that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will Barak them.
Be happy with those who are happy, and weep with those who weep.
Live in harmony with each other. Do not be too proud to enjoy the company of ordinary people. And do not think you know it all!
Never pay back evil with more evil. Do things in such a way that everyone can see you are honorable.
Do all that you can to live in Shalum with everyone.
Dear friends, never take revenge. Leave that to the righteous anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For the Scriptures say, “I will take revenge; I will pay them back,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Instead, “If your enemies are hungry, feed them. If they are thirsty, give them something to drink, in doing this, you will heap burning coals of shame on their heads.”
Do not let evil conquer you, but conquer evil by doing good.
Everyone must submit to governing authorities. For all authority comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and those in positions of authority have been placed there by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So anyone who rebels against authority is rebelling against what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has instituted, and they will be punished.

For the authorities do not strike fear in people who are doing right, but in those who are doing wrong. Would you like to live without fear of the authorities? Do what is right, and they will honor you.

The authorities are 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s servants, sent for your good. But if you are doing wrong, of course you should be afraid, for they have the power to punish you. They are 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s servants, sent for the very purpose of punishing those who do what is wrong.
So you must submit to them, not only to avoid punishment, but also to keep a clear conscience.
Pay your taxes too, for these same reasons. For government workers need to be paid. They are serving 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in what they do.
Give to everyone what you owe them: Pay your taxes and government fees to those who collect them, and give respect and honor to those who are in authority.
Owe nothing to anyone, except for your obligation to love one another. If you Ahaba (love) your neighbor, you will fulfill the requirements of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s law.

For the commandments say, “You must not commit adultery. You must not murder. You must not steal. You must not covet.” These and other such commandments are summed up in this one commandment: “Ahaba (Love) your neighbor as yourself.”
Ahaba (love) can not do wrong to others, so Ahaba (love) fulfills the requirements of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s law.
This is more urgent, for you know how late it is; time is running out. Wake up, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.
The night is almost gone; the day of salvation will soon be here. So remove your dark deeds like dirty clothes, and put on the shining armor of right living.

Because we belong to the day, we must live decent lives for all to see. Do not participate in the darkness of wild parties and drunkenness, or in sexual promiscuity and immoral living, or in quarreling and jealousy.
Instead, clothe yourself with the presence of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. And do not let yourself think about ways to indulge your evil desires.
Accept other believers who are weak in Amunah, and do not argue with them about what they think is right or wrong.
For instance, one person believes it is all right to eat anything. But another believer with a sensitive conscience will eat only vegetables.
Those who feel free to eat anything must not look down on those who do not. And those who do not eat certain foods must not condemn those who do, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has accepted them.
Who are you to condemn the servant of someone? Their own master will judge whether they stand or fall. And with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s help, they will stand and receive the approval of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
In the same way, some think one day is more Qadash than another day, while others think every day is alike. You should each be fully convinced that whichever day you choose is acceptable.

Those who worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on a special day do it to honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Those who eat any kind of food do so to honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, since they give Tudah (thanks) to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH before eating. And those who refuse to eat certain foods also want to please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For we do not live for ourselves or die for ourselves.
If we live, it is to honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And if we die, it is to honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. So whether we live or die, we belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Ha'Mashyach died and rose again for this very purpose, to be Master both of the living and of the dead.
So why do you condemn another believer? Why do you look down on another believer? Remember, we will all stand before the judgment seat of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For the Scriptures say, “‘As surely as I live,’ says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, ‘every knee will bow before me; and every tongue will acknowledge 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’”
Yes, each of us will give a personal account to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So let us stop condemning each other. Decide instead to live in such a way that you will not cause another believer to stumble and fall.
I know and am convinced on the authority of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA that there is nothing unclean of itself; but to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
And if another believer is distressed by what you eat, you are not acting in love if you eat it. Do not let your eating ruin someone for whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA died.
Then you will not be criticized for doing something you believe is good.
For the Kingdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not a matter of what we eat or drink, but of living a life of goodness and shalum and joy in the Ruach Ha'Qadash.
If you serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA with this attitude, you will please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and others will approve of you, too.
So then, let us aim for harmony in the Qadash assembly and try to build each other up.
Do not tear apart the work of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH over what you eat. Remember, all foods are acceptable, but it is wrong to eat something if it makes another person stumble.
It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else if it might cause another believer to stumble.
You may believe there is nothing wrong with what you are doing, but keep it between yourself and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Baraked are those who do not feel guilty for doing something they have decided is right.

But if you have doubts about whether or not you should eat something, you are sinning if you go ahead and do it. For you are not following your convictions. If you do anything you believe is not right, you are sinning.
We who are strong must be considerate of those who are sensitive about things like this. We must not just please ourselves.
We should help others do what is right and build them up in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For even Ha'Mashyach did not please Himself; but as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached You fell on Me.”
Such things were written in the Scriptures long ago to teach us. And the Scriptures give us hope and encouragement as we wait patiently for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s promises to be fulfilled.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who gives this patience and encouragement, help you live in complete harmony with each other, as is fitting for followers of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Then all of you can join together with one voice, giving Yadah and Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the Father of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Therefore, accept each other just as Ha'Mashyach has accepted you so that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be given Kabad.
Remember that Ha'Mashyach came as a servant to the Yahudym to show that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is true to the promises He made to their ancestors.

Ha'Mashyach also came so that the other nations might give Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for HIS mercies to them. That is what the Tahalym meant when he wrote: “For this, I will Yadah you among the other nations; I will sing Yadah to your Name.”
And in another place it is written, “Rejoice with the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you other nations.”
And yet again, “Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all you other nations. Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH all you people of the Arath.
And in another place Yashayahu said, “The heir to Daud’s throne will come, and he will rule over the other nations. They will place their hope on Him.”

I pray that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the source of hope, will fill you completely with joy and Shalum because you trust in HIM. Then you will overflow with confident hope through the power of the Ruach Ha'Qadash.
I am fully convinced, my dear brothers and sisters, that you are full of goodness. You know these things so well you can teach each other all about them.
Even so, I have been bold enough to write about some of these points, knowing that all you need is this reminder. For by the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,

I am a special messenger from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach to you the other nations. I bring you the Good News so that I might present you as an acceptable offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, made Qadash by the RUACH Ha'Qadash.
So I have reason to be enthusiastic about all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach has done through me in my service to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yet I dare not boast about anything except what Ha'Mashyach has done through me, bringing the other nations to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by my message and by the way I worked among them.

They were convinced by the power of miraculous signs and wonders and by the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s RUACH. In this way, I have fully presented the Good News of Ha'Mashyach from Yahushalam all the way to Illyricum.
My ambition has always been to preach the Basurah (Good News) where the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA has never been heard, rather than where a Qadash assembly has already been started by someone else.
I have been following the plan spoken of in the Scriptures, where it says, “Those who have never been told about Him will see, and those who have never heard of Him will understand.”
In fact, my visit to you has been delayed so long because I have been preaching in these places.
But now I have finished my work in these regions, and after all these long years of waiting, I am eager to visit you.
I am planning to go to Spain, and when I do, I will stop off in Rome. And after I have enjoyed your fellowship for a little while, you can provide for my journey.
But before I come, I must go to Yahushalam to take a gift to the believers there.
For you see, the believers in Macedonia and Achaia have eagerly taken up an offering for the poor among the believers in Yahushalam.

They were glad to do this because they feel they owe a real debt to them. Since the other nations received the spiritual Barakah of the Basurah (Good News) from the believers in Yahushalam, they feel the least they can do in return is to help them financially.
As soon as I have delivered this money and completed this good deed of theirs, I will come to see you on my way to Spain.
And I am sure that when I come, Ha'Mashyach will richly Barak our time together.

Dear brothers and sisters, I urge you in the Name of our Savior 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach to join in my struggle by praying to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for me. Do this because of your love for me, given to you by the RUACH Ha'Qadash.
Pray that I will be rescued from those in Yahudah who refuse to obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Pray also that the believers there will be willing to accept the donation I am taking to Yahushalam.
Then, by the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I will be able to come to you with a joyful heart, and we will be an encouragement to each other.
And now may 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who gives us His Shalum, be with you all.
I commend to you our Achuty (sister) Phoebe, who is a leader in the Qadash assembly in Cenchrea.
Welcome her in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as one who is worthy of honor among 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people. Help her in whatever she needs, for she has been helpful to many, and especially to me.
Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila, my co-workers in the ministry of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
In fact, they once risked their lives for me. I am thankful to them, and so are all the other nations Qadash Assemblies.
Also give my greetings to the Qadash Assembly that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epenetus. He was the first person from the province of Asia to become a follower of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Give my greetings to Maryam, who has worked so hard for your benefit.
Greet Andronicus and Yunia, my fellow Yahudym, who were in prison with me. They are highly respected among the Shaliachs and became followers of Ha'Mashyach before I did.
Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Greet Urbanus, our co-worker in Ha'Mashyach, and my dear friend Stachys.
Greet Apelles, a good man whom Ha'Mashyach approves. And give my greetings to the believers from the household of Aristobulus.
Greet Harudiun, my fellow Yahudym. Greet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people from the household of Narcissus.
Give my greetings to Tryphena and Tryphosa, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s workers, and to dear Persis, who has worked so hard for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Greet Rufus, whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH picked out to be HIS very own; and also his dear mother, who has been a mother to me.
Give my greetings to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters) who meet with them.
Give my greetings to Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and to Olympas and all the believers who meet with them.
Greet each other with a qadash kiss. All the Qadash assembly of Ha'Mashyach send you their greetings.

And now I make one more appeal, my dear brothers) and sisters. Watch out for people who cause divisions and upset people’s Amunah by teaching things contrary to what you have been taught. Stay away from them.
Such people are not serving 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA our Mashyach; they are serving their own personal interests. By smooth talk and glowing words they deceive innocent people.
But everyone knows that you are obedient to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. This makes me very happy. I want you to be wise in doing right and to stay innocent of any wrong.
The 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shalum will soon crush ha'shatan under your feet. May the favor of our Savior 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA be with you.
Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you his greetings, as do Lucius, Yasun, and Susipater, my fellow Yahudym.
I, Tertius, the one writing this letter for Shaul, send my greetings too, as one of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA’s followers.
Gaius says hello to you. He is my host and also serves as host to the whole Qadash assembly. Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you his greetings, and so does our brother Quartus.
The favor of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach be with you all, So it will be.

Now all Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who is able to make you strong, just as my Good News says. This message about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach has revealed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH‘s plan for you the other nations, a plan kept secret from the beginning of time.
But now as the Nabyms foretold and as the eternal 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has commanded, this message is made known to all the other nations everywhere, so that they too might believe and obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
All Kabad to the only wise 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach forever.

books.name: I Corinthians
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, chosen by the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to be a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, and from our Achk (brother) Sosthenes.

I am writing to the Qadash assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in Corinth, to you who have been called by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to be His own Qadash people. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made you Qadash by means of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did for all people everywhere who call on the Name of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, their Savior and ours.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our ABBA and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach give you favor and Shalum.
I always thank my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH for you and for the marvelous gifts 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given you, now that you belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Through Ha'Mashyach, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has enriched your Qadash Assembly in every way, with all of your eloquent words and all of your knowledge.
This confirms that what I told you about Ha'Mashyach is true.
Now you have every spiritual gift you need as you eagerly wait for the return of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will keep you strong to the end so that you will be free from all blame on the day when our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach returns.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will do this, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is faithful to do what He Dabar, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has invited you into partnership with HIS Son, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our Savior.

I appeal to you, dear Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters), by the authority of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, to live in harmony with each other. Let there be no divisions in the Qadash Assembly. Rather, be of one mind, united in thought and purpose.
For some members of Chloe’s household have told me about your quarrels, my dear brothers and sisters.
Some of you are saying, “I am a follower of Shaul.” Others are saying, “I follow Apollos,” or “I follow Kafa,” or “I follow only Ha'Mashyach.”
Has Ha'Mashyach been divided into factions? Was I Shaul impaled for you? Were any of you baptized in the name of Shaul? Of course not!
I Tudah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,
for now no one can say they were baptized in my Name.
Oh yes, I also baptized the household of Staphanas, but I don't remember baptizing anyone else.
For Ha'Mashyach did not send me to baptize, but to preach the Basurah (Good News) and not with clever speech, for fear that the execution stake of Ha'Mashyach would lose its power.
The message of the execution stake is foolish to those who are headed for destruction! But we who are being saved know it is the very power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
As the Scriptures say, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise and discard the intelligence of the intelligent.”
So where does this leave the philosophers, the scholars, and the world’s brilliant debaters? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made the wisdom of this world look foolish.
Since 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in his wisdom saw to it that the world would never know HIM through man's wisdom, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has used our foolish preaching to save those who believe.
It is foolish to the Yahudym, who ask for signs from Shamaym. And it is foolish to the Greeks, who seek man's wisdom.
So when we preach that Ha'Mashyach was impaled, the Yahudym are offended and the other nations say it is all nonsense.
But to those called by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to salvation, both Yahudym and the other nations, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the wisdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This foolish plan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is wiser than the wisest of man's plans, and the weakness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is stronger than the greatest of man's strength.
Remember, dear brothers and sisters, that few of you were wise in the eyes of the world or powerful or wealthy when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called you.
Instead, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose things the world considers foolish in order to shame those who think they are wise. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose things that are powerless to shame those who are powerful.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose things despised by the world, things counted as nothing at all, and used them to bring to nothing what the world considers important.
As a result, no one can ever boast in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has united you with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. For our benefit, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to be wisdom itself. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA made us right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA made us pure and Qadash, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA freed us from sin.
Therefore, as the Scriptures say, “If you want to boast, boast only about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
When I first came to you, dear Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters), I did not use lofty words and impressive wisdom to tell you the secret plan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For I decided that while I was with you I would forget everything except 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, the one who was impaled.
I came to you in weakness timid and trembling.
And my message and my preaching were very plain. Rather than using clever and persuasive speeches, I relied only on the power of the RUACH Ha'Qadash.
I did this so you would trust not in man's wisdom but in the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yet when I am among mature believers, I do speak with words of wisdom, but not the kind of wisdom that belongs to this world or to the rulers of this world, who are soon forgotten.
No, the wisdom we speak of is the mystery of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the plan that was previously hidden, even though 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made it for our ultimate Kabad before the world began.
But the rulers of this world have not understood it; if they had, they would not have impaled our Esteemed Master.
That is what the Scriptures mean when they say, “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, and no mind has imagined what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has prepared for those who love Him.”
But it was to us that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH revealed these things by His RUACH. For the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH searches out everything and shows us deep secrets of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
No one can know a man’s thoughts except that man’s own ruach, and no one can know the thoughts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH except the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
What we have received is not the spirit of the world, but the RUACH who is from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so that we may understand what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has freely given us.
When we tell you these things, we do not use words that come from man's wisdom. Instead, we speak words given to us by the RUACH, using the the words of the RUACH to explain divine truths.

But people who are not mindful of the RUACH cannot receive these truths from the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. It all sounds foolish to them and they cannot understand it, for only those who are Mindful of the RUACH can understand what the RUACH means.
Those who are Mindful of the RUACH can evaluate all things, but they themselves cannot be evaluated by others.
For “Who can know the thoughts of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Who knows enough to teach 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?” But we understand these things, for we have the mind of Ha'Mashyach.

Dear Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters), when I was with you I could not talk to you as I would talk to people who are Mindful of the RUACH. I had to talk as though you belonged to this world or as though you were infants in Ha'Mashyach.
I had to feed you with milk, not with solid food, because you were not ready for anything stronger. And you still are not ready,

For you are still controlled by your sinful nature. You are jealous of one another and quarrel with each other. Does that not prove that you are controlled by your sinful nature? Are you not living like people of the world?
When one of you says, “I am a follower of Shaul,” and another says, “I follow Apollos,” are you not acting just like people of the world?
After all, who is Apollos? Who is Shaul? We are only the servants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through whom you believed the Basurah (Good News). Each of us did the work 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave us.
I planted the seed in your hearts, and Apollos watered it, but it was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who made it grow.
It is not important who does the planting, or who does the watering. What is more important is that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH makes the seed grow.
The one who plants and the one who waters work together with the same purpose. And both will be rewarded for their own hard work.
For we are both the workers of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And you are the field of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and You are also the building of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Because of the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to me, I have laid the foundation like an expert builder. Now others are building on it. But whoever is building on this foundation must be very careful.
For no one can lay any other foundation than the one we already have which is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Anyone who builds on that foundation may use a variety of materials, gold, silver, jewels, wood, hay, or straw.
But on the judgment day, fire will reveal what kind of work each builder has done. The fire will show if each of our work has any value.
If the work survives, that builder will receive a reward.
But if the work is burned up, the builder will suffer great loss. The builder will be saved, but like someone barely escaping through a wall of flames.
Do you not realize that all of you together are the Haykal (Temple) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and that the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives in you?
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will destroy anyone who destroys this Temple. For the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is Qadash, and you are that Temple.
Stop deceiving yourselves. If you think you are wise by this world’s standards, you need to become a fool to be truly wise.
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. As the Scriptures say, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH traps the wise in the snare of their own cleverness.”
And again, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows the thoughts of the wise; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows they are worthless.”
Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours:
whether Shaul or Apollos or Kafa, or the world, or life and death, or the present and the future. Everything belongs to you,
And you belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA belongs to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So look at Apollos and me as mere servants of Ha'Mashyach who have been put in charge of explaining the mysteries of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Now, a person who is put in charge as a manager must be faithful.
As for me, it matters very little how I might be evaluated by you or by any man's authority. I do not even trust my own judgment on this point.
My conscience is clear, but that does not prove I am right. It is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH himself who will examine me and decide.

So do not make judgments about anyone ahead of the return of Ha'Mashyach, For He will bring our darkest secrets to light and will reveal our private motives. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give to each one whatever Yadah (praise) is due them.

Dear brothers and sisters, I have used Apollos and myself to illustrate what I have been saying. If you pay attention to what I have quoted from the Scriptures, you will not be proud of one of your leaders at the expense of another.
For what gives you the right to make such a judgment? What do you have that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not given you? And if everything you have is from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, why boast as though it were not a gift?

You think you already have everything you need. You think you are already rich. You have begun to reign in the kingdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH without us! I wish you really were reigning already, for then we would be reigning with you.

Instead, I sometimes think 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has put us Shaliachs on display, like prisoners of war at the end of a victor’s parade, condemned to die. We have become a spectacle to the entire world, to people and Malakym alike.
Our dedication to Ha'Mashyach makes us look like fools, but you claim to be so wise in Ha'Mashyach! We are weak, but you are so powerful! You are honored, but we are ridiculed.
Even now we go hungry and thirsty, and we do not have enough clothes to keep warm. We are often beaten and have no home.
We work wearily with our own hands to earn our living. We barak those who curse us. We are patient with those who abuse us.
We appeal gently when evil things are said about us. Yet we are treated like the garbage of the world, like everybody’s trash, right up to the present moment.
I am not writing these things to shame you, but to warn you as my beloved children.
For even if you had ten thousand others to teach you about Ha'Mashyach, you have only one father. For I became your father in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach when I preached the Basurah (Good News) to you.
So I urge you to imitate me.

That is why I have sent Timothy, my beloved and faithful child in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. He will remind you of how I follow 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, just as I teach in all the Qadash Assemblies wherever I go.
Some of you have become arrogant, thinking I will not visit you again.
But I will come and soon if 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lets me, and then I will find out whether these arrogant people just give pretentious speeches or whether they really have the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For the Kingdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not just a lot of talk; it is living by the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Which do you choose? Should I come with a rod to punish you, or should I come with love and a gentle ruach?

I can hardly believe the report about the sexual immorality going on among you, something that even pagans do not do. I am told that a man in your Qadash assembly is living in sin with his stepmother.
You are so proud of yourselves, but you should be mourning in sorrow and shame. And you should remove this man from your fellowship.
Even though I am not with you in person, I am with you in the Ruach. And as though I were there, I have already passed judgment on this man
In the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. You must call a meeting of the Qadash Assembly. I will be present with you in Ruach, and so will the power of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Then you must throw this man out and hand him over to ha'shatan so that his sinful nature will be destroyed and he himself will be saved on the day the Master returns.
Your boasting about this is terrible. Do you not realize that this sin is like a little yeast that spreads through the whole batch of dough?

Get rid of the old “yeast” by removing this wicked person from among you. Then you will be like a fresh batch of dough made without yeast, which is what you really are. Ha'Mashyach our Passover Lamb, has been sacrificed for us.
So let us celebrate the festival, not with the old bread of wickedness and evil, but with the new bread of sincerity and truth.
When I wrote to you before, I told you not to associate with people who indulge in sexual sin.
But I was not talking about unbelievers who indulge in sexual sin, or are greedy, or cheat people, or worship idols. You would have to leave this world to avoid people like that.

I meant that you are not to associate with anyone who claims to be a believer yet indulges in sexual sin, or is greedy, or worships idols, or is abusive, or is a drunkard, or cheats people. Do not even eat with such people.
It is not my responsibility to judge outsiders, but it certainly is your responsibility to judge those inside the Qadash Assembly who are sinning.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge those on the outside; but as the Scriptures say, “You must remove the evil person from among you.”
When one of you has a dispute with another believer, how dare you file a lawsuit and ask a secular court to decide the matter instead of taking it to other believers
Do you not know that the Qadash ones will judge the world? And if the world will be judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
Do you not know that we shall judge Malakym? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
If then you have judgments concerning things pertaining to this life, do you appoint those who are least esteemed by the Qadash assembly to judge?
I say this to your shame. Is there no wise man among you, not even one, who will be able to judge between his brethren?
But brother goes to law against brother, and that before unbelievers!
Now therefore, it is already an utter failure for you that you go to law against one another. Why do you not rather accept wrong? Why do you not rather let yourselves be cheated?
No, you yourselves do wrong and cheat, and you do these things to your brethren!

Do you not realize that those who do wrong will not inherit the Kingdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Do not fool yourselves. Those who indulge in sexual sin, or who worship idols, or commit adultery, or are male prostitutes, or practice homosexuality,
or are thieves, or greedy people, or drunkards, or are abusive, or cheat people, none of these will inherit the Kingdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Some of you were once like that. But you were cleansed; you were made Qadash; you were made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by calling on the Name of the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach and by the RUACH of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
You say, “I am allowed to do anything, ”but not everything is good for you. And even though “I am allowed to do anything,” I must not become a slave to anything.

You say, “Food was made for the stomach, and the stomach for food.” This is true, though someday 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will do away with both of them. But you cannot say that our bodies were made for sexual immorality. They were made for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and HE cares about our bodies.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will raise us from the dead by HIS power, just as he raised our Master and Savior from the dead.
Do you not realize that your bodies are actually parts of Ha'Mashyach? Should a man take his body, which is part of Ha'Mashyach, and join it to a prostitute? Never!
And do you not realize that if a man joins himself to a prostitute, he becomes one body with her? For the Scriptures say, “The two are united into one.”
But the person who is joined to Ha'Mashyach is one Ruach with Him.
Run from sexual sin! No other sin so clearly affects the body as this one does. For sexual immorality is a sin against your own body.
Do you not realize that your body is the Temple of the RUACH Ha'Qadash, who lives in you and was given to you by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? You do not belong to yourself,
for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH bought you with a high price. So you must honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with your body.
Now regarding the questions you asked in your letter. Yes, it is good to abstain from sexual relations.
But because there is so much sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife, and each woman should have her own husband.
The husband should fulfill his wife’s sexual needs, and the wife should fulfill her husband’s needs.
The wife gives authority over her body to her husband, and the husband gives authority over his body to his wife.

Do not deprive each other of sexual relations, unless you both agree to refrain from sexual intimacy for a limited time so you can give yourselves more completely to prayer. Afterward, you should come together again so that ha'shatan will not be able to tempt you because of your lack of self control.
I say this as a concession, not as a command.
But I wish everyone were single, just as I am. Yet each person has a special gift from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, of one kind or another.
So I say to those who are not married and to widows, that it is better to stay unmarried, just as I am.
But if they cannot control themselves, they should go ahead and marry. It is better to marry than to burn with lust.
But for those who are married, I have a command that comes not from me, but from Ha'Mashyach. A wife must not leave her husband.
But if she does leave him, let her remain single or else be reconciled to him. And the husband must not leave his wife.

Now, I will speak to the rest of you, though I do not have a direct command from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. If a fellow believer has a wife who is not a believer and she is willing to continue living with him, he must not leave her.
And if a believing woman has a husband who is not a believer and he is willing to continue living with her, she must not leave him.
For the believing wife brings righteousness to her marriage, and the believing husband brings righteousness to his marriage. Otherwise, your children would not be Qadash, but now they are Qadash.

(But if the husband or wife who is not a believer insists on leaving, let them go. In such cases the believing husband or wife is no longer bound to the other, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has called you to live in Shalum).
Do you wives not realize that your husbands might be saved because of you? And do you husbands not realize that your wives might be saved because of you?
Each of you should continue to live in whatever situation 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has placed you, and remain as you were when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH first called you. This is my rule for all the Qadash Assemblies.
For instance, a man who was circumcised before he became a believer should not try to reverse it. And the man who was uncircumcised when he became a believer should not be circumcised now.
For it makes no difference whether or not a man has been circumcised. The important thing is to Obey the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Yes, each of you should remain as you were when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called you.
Are you a slave? Do not let that worry you, but if you get a chance to be free, take it.
And remember, if you were a slave when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called you, you are now free in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And if you were free when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called you, you are now a slave of Ha'Mashyach.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH paid a high price for you, so do not be enslaved by the world.
Each of you, dear brothers and sisters, should remain as you were when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH first called you.

Now regarding your question about the young women who are not yet married. I do not have a command from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for them. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in HIS mercy has given me wisdom that can be trusted, and I will share it with you.
Because of the present crisis, I think it is best to remain as you are.
If you have a wife, do not seek to end the marriage. If you do not have a wife, do not seek to get married.

But if you do get married, it is not a sin. And if a young woman gets married, it is not a sin. However, those who get married at this time will have troubles, and I am trying to spare you those problems.
But let me say this, dear brothers and sisters: The time that remains is very short. So from now on, those with wives should not focus only on their marriage.
Those who weep or who rejoice or who buy things should not be absorbed by their weeping or their joy or their possessions.
Those who use the things of the world should not become attached to them. For this world as we know it will soon pass away.
I want you to be free from the concerns of this life. An unmarried man can spend his time doing the work of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and thinking how to please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But a married man has to think about his earthly responsibilities and how to please his wife.

His interests are divided. In the same way, a woman who is no longer married or has never been married can be devoted to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and Qadash in body and in ruach. But a married woman has to think about her earthly responsibilities and how to please her husband.
I am saying this for your benefit, not to place restrictions on you. I want you to do whatever will help you serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH best, with as few distractions as possible.
But if a man thinks that he is treating his fiancée improperly and will inevitably give in to his passion, let him marry her as he wishes. It is not a sin.
But if he has decided firmly not to marry and there is no urgency and he can control his passion, he does well not to marry.
So the person who marries his fiancée does well, and the person who does not marry does even better.
A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. If her husband dies, she is free to marry anyone she wishes, but only if he loves 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But in my opinion it would be better for her to stay single, and I think I am giving you counsel from the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH when I say this.

Now regarding your question about food that has been offered to idols. Yes, we know that “we all have knowledge” about this issue. But while knowledge makes us feel important, it is love that strengthens the Qadash Assembly.
Anyone who claims to know all the answers does not really know very much.
But the person who loves 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the one whom .𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH recognizes.
So, what about eating meat that has been offered to idols? Well, we all know that an idol is not really Mighty at all and that there is only one 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH (AL'Mighty One).
It is really not important if there are things called mighty ones in the sky or on the Arath and there are many of these “idols out there.

But for us, There is one 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the ABBA, by whom all things were created, and for whom we live. And there is one Master, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, through whom all things were created, and through whom we live.

However, not all believers know this. Some are accustomed to thinking of idols as being real, so when they eat food that has been offered to idols, they think of it as the worship of real mighty ones, and their weak consciences are violated.
It is true that we cannot win the approval of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by what we eat. We do not lose anything if we do not eat it, and we do not gain anything if we do.
But you must be careful so that your freedom does not cause others with a weaker conscience to stumble.
For if others see you with your superior knowledge” eating in the temple of an idol, will they not be encouraged to violate their conscience by eating food that has been offered to an idol?
So because of your superior knowledge, a weak believer for whom Ha'Mashyach died will be destroyed.
And when you sin against other believers by encouraging them to do something they believe is wrong, you are sinning against Ha'Mashyach.
So if what I eat causes another believer to sin, I will never eat meat again as long as I live, for I do not want to cause another believer to stumble.
Am I not as free as anyone else? Am I not a Shaliach? Have I not seen 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA our Master with my own eyes? Is it not because of my work that you belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
Even if others think I am not a Shaliach, I certainly am to you. You yourselves are proof that I am a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This is my answer to those who question my authority.
Do we not have the right to live in your homes and share your meals?
Do we not have the right to bring a believing wife with us as the other Shaliach and the brothers of Ha'Mashyach do, and as Kafa does?
Or is it only Barnabas and I who have to work to support ourselves?

What soldier has to pay his own expenses? What farmer plants a vineyard and does not have the right to eat some of its fruit? What shepherd cares for a flock of sheep and is not allowed to drink some of the milk?
Am I expressing merely a man's opinion, or does the law say the same thing?
For the law of Musha says, “You must not muzzle an ox to keep it from eating as it treads out the grain.” Was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH thinking only about oxen when He said this?
Was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH not actually speaking to us? Yes, it was written for us, so that the one who plows and the one who threshes the grain might both expect a share of the harvest.
Since we have planted spiritual seed among you, are we not entitled to a harvest of physical food and drink?

If you support others who preach to you, should we not have an even greater right to be supported? But we have never used this right. We would rather put up with anything than be an obstacle to the Basurah (Good News) about Ha'Mashyach.
Do you not realize that those who work in the Temple get their meals from the offerings brought to the Temple? And those who serve at the altar get a share of the sacrificial offerings.
In the same way 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH ordered that those who preach the Basurah (Good News) should be supported by those who benefit from it.
Yet I have never used any of these rights. And I am not writing this to suggest that I want to start now. In fact, I would rather die than lose my right to boast about preaching without charge.
Yet preaching the Basurah (Good News) is not something I can boast about. I am compelled by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to do it. How terrible for me if I did not preach the Basurah (Good News)!
If I were doing this on my own initiative, I would deserve payment. But I have no choice, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given me this set apart trust.
What then is my pay? It is the opportunity to preach the Basurah (Good News) without charging anyone. That is why I never demand my rights when I preach the Basurah.
Even though I am a free man with no master, I have become a slave to all men to bring many to Ha'Mashyach.

When I was with the Yahudym, I lived like a Yahudym to bring the Yahudym to Ha'Mashyach. When I was with those who follow the Yahudym law, I too lived under that law. Even though I am not subject to the law, I did this so I could bring to Ha'Mashyach those who are under the law.

When I am with the other nations who do not follow the Yahudym law, I too live apart from that law so I can bring them to Ha'Mashyach. But I do not ignore the law of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; I obey the law of Ha'Mashyach.
When I am with those who are weak, I share their weakness, for I want to bring the weak to Ha'Mashyach. Yes, I try to find common ground with everyone, doing everything I can to save some.
I do everything to spread the Basurah (Good News) and share in its Barakah.
Do you not realize that in a race everyone runs, but only one person gets the prize? So run to win!
All athletes are disciplined in their training. They do it to win a prize that will fade away, but we do it for an eternal prize.
So I run with purpose in every step. I am not just shadowboxing.
I discipline my body like an athlete, training it to do what it should. Otherwise, I fear that after preaching to others I myself might be disqualified.

I do not want you to forget, dear Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters), about our fathers in the wilderness long ago. All of them were guided by a cloud that moved ahead of them, and all of them walked through the sea on dry ground.
In the cloud and in the sea, all of them were baptized as followers of Musha.
All of them ate the same food of the RUACH,
And all of them drank the same water of the RUACH. For they drank from the rock of the RUACH that traveled with them, and that rock was Ha'Mashyach.
Yet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was not pleased with most of them, and their bodies were scattered in the wilderness.
These things happened as a warning to us, so that we would not crave evil things as they did,
Or worship idols as some of them did. As the Scriptures say, “The people celebrated with feasting and drinking, and they indulged in pagan festivals.”
And we must not engage in sexual immorality as some of them did, causing twenty three thousand of them to die in one day.
Nor should we put Ha'Mashyach to the test, as some of them did and then died from snakebites.
And do not grumble as some of them did, and then were destroyed by the Malak of death.
These things happened to them as examples for us. They were written down to warn us who live at the end of the age.
If you think you are standing strong, be careful not to fall.

The temptations in your life are no different from what others have experienced. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is faithful. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not allow the temptation to be more than you can stand, When you are tempted 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will show you a way out so that you can endure the temptation.
So, my dear friends, flee from the worship of idols.
You are reasonable people. Decide for yourselves if what I am saying is true.
When we Barak the cup at the table of Ha'Mashyach, are we not sharing in the blood of Ha'Mashyach? And when we break the bread, are we not sharing in the body of Ha'Mashyach?
And though we are many, we all eat from one loaf of bread, showing that we are one body.
Think about the people of Yashar'AL. Were they not united by eating the sacrifices at the altar?
What am I trying to say? Am I saying that food offered to idols has some significance, or that idols are real mighty ones?
No, not at all. I am saying that these sacrifices are offered to demons, not to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And I do not want you to participate with demons.
You cannot drink from the cup of Ha'Mashyach and from the cup of demons too. You cannot eat at the the Table of Ha'Mashyach and at the table of demons too.
What? Do we dare to rouse the jealousy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Do you think we are stronger than 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is?
You say, “I am allowed to do anything” but not everything is good for you. You say, “I am allowed to do anything”, but not everything is beneficial.
Do not be concerned for your own good but for the good of others.
So you may eat any meat that is sold in the marketplace without raising questions of conscience.
For “the Arath and everything in it belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
If someone who is not a believer asks you home for dinner, accept the invitation if you want to. Eat whatever is offered to you without raising questions of conscience.
But suppose someone tells you, “This meat was offered to an idol.” Do not eat it, out of consideration for the conscience of the one who told you.
It might not be a matter of conscience for you, but it is for the other person. For why should my freedom be limited by what someone else thinks?
If I can thank 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for the food and enjoy it, why should I be condemned for eating it?
So whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do it all for the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Never do anything that might make other people do wrong, either Yahudym, nor the non-Yahudym, or anyone in Qadash Assemblies of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I myself, I try to please everyone in everything I do. I do not just do what is best for me; I do what is best for others so that many may be saved.
