Follow my example, just as I follow example 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach has given us
I am so glad that you always keep me in your thoughts, and that you are following the teachings I passed on to you.
But there is one thing I want you to know: The head of every man is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, the head of the woman is man, and the head of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
A man dishonors his head if he covers his head while praying or prophesying.
But a woman dishonors her head if she prays or prophesies without a covering on her head, for this is the same as shaving her head.
Yes, if she refuses to wear a head covering, she should cut off all her hair! But since it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or her head shaved, she should wear a covering.
A man should not wear anything on his head when worshiping, for man is made in the image of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and reflects the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And woman reflects the Kabad of man.
For the first man did not come from woman, but the first woman came from man.
And man was not made for woman, but woman was made for man.
For this reason, and because the Malakym are watching, a woman should wear a covering on her head to show she is under authority.
But among the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, women are not independent of men, and men are not independent of women.
For although the first woman came from man, every other man was born from a woman, and everything comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Judge for yourselves. Is it right for a woman to pray to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in public without covering her head?
Is it not obvious that it is shameful for a man to have long hair?
But if a woman has long hair, it is her pride and joy; for her hair is given to her for a covering.
But if anyone wants to argue about this, I simply say that we have no other custom than this, and neither do the other Qadash Assemblies of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But in the following instructions, I cannot praise you. For it sounds as if more harm than good is done when you meet together.
First, I hear that there are divisions among you when you meet as a Qadash Assembly, and to some extent I believe it.
But, of course, there must be divisions among you so that you who have the approval of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be recognized!
When you meet together, you are not really interested in the the Supper of Ha'Mashyach.
For some of you hurry to eat your own meal without sharing with others. As a result, some go hungry while others get drunk.

What? Do you not have your own homes for eating and drinking? Or do you really want to dishonor the Qadash Assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and shame the poor? What am I supposed to say? Do you want me to praise you? Well, I certainly will not praise you for this!
For I pass on to you what I received from Ha'Mashyach Himself. On the night when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach was betrayed, He took some bread
And gave thanks to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for it. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA broke it in pieces and said, “This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in remembrance of me.”

In the same way, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA took the cup of wine after supper, saying, “This cup is the Renewed covenant between 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and His people, an agreement confirmed with my blood. Do this to remember me as often as you drink the cup.”
For every time you eat this bread and drink this cup, you are announcing the death of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach until He comes again.
So anyone who eats this bread or drinks this cup of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA unworthily is guilty of sinning against the body and blood of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
That is why you should examine yourself before eating the bread and drinking the cup.
For if you eat the bread or drink the cup without honoring the body of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, you are eating and drinking the judgment of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH upon yourself.
That is why many of you are weak and sick and some have even died.
But if we would examine ourselves, we would not be judged by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in this way.
Yet when we are judged by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned along with the world.
So, my dear brothers and sisters, when you gather for the Supper of Ha'Mashyach, wait for each other.
If you are really hungry, eat at home so you will not bring judgment upon yourselves when you meet together. I will give you instructions about the other matters after I arrive.
Now, dear brothers and sisters, regarding your question about the special abilities the Ruach gives us. I do not want you to misunderstand this.
You know that when you were still pagans, you were led astray and swept along in worshiping speechless idols.
So I want you to know that no one speaking by the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will say a curse word to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, and no one can say 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is Master, except by the RUACH Ha'Qadash.
There are different kinds of gifts of the Ruach, but the same RUACH is the source of them all.
There are different kinds of service, but we serve the same 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH works in different ways, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the same 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who does the work in all of us.
The gift of the Ruach is given to each of us so we can help each other.
To one person the RUACH gives the ability for wise advice; to another the RUACH gives a message of special knowledge.
The same RUACH gives great Amunah to another, and to someone else the RUACH gives the gift of healing.

The RUACH gives another the power to perform miracles, and another the ability to prophesy. The RUACH gives another the ability to discern whether a message is from the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH or from another spirit. Still another is given the ability to speak in unknown languages, while another is given the ability to interpret what is being said.
It is the one and only RUACH who distributes all these gifts. The RUACH alone decides which gift each person should have.
The body of a man has many parts, but the many parts make up one whole body. So it is with the body of Ha'Mashyach.
Some of us are Yahudym, some are the other nations, some are slaves, and some are free. But we have all been baptized into one body by one RUACH, and we all share the same RUACH.
Yes, the body has many different parts, not just one part.
If the foot says, “I am not a part of the body because I am not a hand,” that does not make it any less a part of the body.
And if the ear says, “I am not part of the body because I am not an eye,” would that make it any less a part of the body?
If the whole body were an eye, how would you hear? Or if your whole body were an ear, how would you smell anything?
But our bodies have many parts, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has put each part just where he wants it.
How strange a body would be if it had only one part!
Yes, there are many parts, but only one body.
The eye can never say to the hand, “I do not need you.” The head cannot say to the feet, “I do not need you.”
In fact, some parts of the body that seem weakest and least important are actually the most necessary.
And the parts we regard as less honorable are those we clothe with the greatest care. So we carefully protect those parts that should not be seen,
while the more honorable parts do not require this special care. So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has put the body together such that extra honor and care are given to those parts that have less dignity.
This makes for harmony among the members, so that all the members care for each other.
If one part suffers, all the parts suffer with it, and if one part is honored, all the parts are glad.
All of you together are the body of Ha'Mashyach, and each of you is a part of the body.

Here are some of the parts 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has appointed for the Qadash Assemblies: first are Shaliachs, second are Nabyms, third are teachers, then those who do miracles, those who have the gift of healing, those who can help others, those who have the gift of leadership, those who speak in unknown languages.
Are we all Shaliach? Are we all Nabyms? Are we all teachers? Do we all have the power to do miracles?
Do we all have the gift of healing? Do we all have the ability to speak in unknown languages? Do we all have the ability to interpret unknown languages? Of course not!
So you should earnestly desire the most helpful gifts. But now let me show you a way of life that is best for all.
If I could speak all the languages of the Arath and of the Malakym, but did not love others, I would only be a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.

If I had the gift of prophecy, and if I understood all of the secret plans of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and possessed all knowledge, and if I had such Amunah that I could move mountains, but did not love others, I would be nothing.
If I gave everything I have to the poor and even sacrificed my body, I could boast about it; but if I did not love others, I would have gained nothing.
Love is patient and kind. Love is not jealous or boastful or proud
Love is not rude. It does not demand its own way. It is not irritable, and it keeps no record of being wronged.
Love does not rejoice about injustice but rejoices whenever the truth wins out.
Love never gives up, never loses Amunah, is always hopeful, and endures through every circumstance.
Prophecy and speaking in unknown languages and special knowledge will become useless. But love will last forever!
Now our knowledge is partial and incomplete, and even the gift of prophecy reveals only part of the whole picture!
But when the time of perfection comes, these partial things will become useless.
When I was a child, I spoke and thought and reasoned as a child. But when I grew up, I put away childish things.

Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows me completely.
Three things will last forever, Amunah (Faith), Hope, and Ahaba (love) and the greatest of these is Ahaba (love).
Let Ahaba (love) be your highest goal! But you should also desire the special abilities the RUACH gives, especially the ability to prophesy.
For he that speaks in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: for no man can understand him; but in the RUACH he speaks mysteries to being.
But the one who prophesies strengthens others, encourages them, and comforts them.
The man who speaks in tongues is strengthened personally, but the one who speaks a word of prophecy strengthens the entire Qadash Assemblies.

I wish you could all speak in tongues, but even more I wish you could all prophesy. For prophecy is greater than speaking in tongues, unless someone interprets what you are saying so that the whole Qadash Assembly will be strengthened.

Dear brothers and sisters, if I should come to you speaking in an unknown language, how would that help you? But if I bring you a revelation or some special knowledge or prophecy or teaching, that will be helpful.
Even lifeless instruments like the flute or the harp must play the notes clearly, or no one will recognize the melody.
And if the bugler does not sound a clear call, how will the soldiers know they are being called to battle?
It is the same for you. If you speak to people in words they do not understand, how will they know what you are saying? You might as well be talking into empty space.
There are many different languages in the world, and every language has meaning.
But if I do not understand a language, I will be a foreigner to someone who speaks it, and the one who speaks it will be a foreigner to me.
And the same is true for you. Since you are so eager to have the special abilities the RUACH gives, seek those that will strengthen the whole Qadash Assembly.
So anyone who speaks in tongues should pray also for the ability to interpret what has been said.
For if I pray in tongues, my ruach is praying, but I do not understand what I am saying.
Well then, what shall I do? I will pray in the RUACH, and I will also pray in words I understand. I will sing in the Ruach, and I will also sing in words I understand.

For if you Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH only in the RUACH, how can those who do not understand you Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH along with you? How can they join you in giving Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, when they do not understand what you are saying?
You will be giving Tudah very well, but it will not strengthen the people who hear you.
I give TUDAH to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that I speak in tongues more than any of you.
But in a Qadash Assembly meeting I would rather speak five understandable words to help others than ten thousand words in an unknown language.
Dear brothers and sisters, do not be childish in your understanding of these things. Be innocent as babies when it comes to malice, but be mature in understanding matters of this kind.
It is written in the Scriptures: “I will speak to my own people through strange languages and through the lips of foreigners. But even then, they will not listen to me,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So you see that speaking in tongues is a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for the benefit of believers, not unbelievers.
Even so, if unbelievers or people who do not understand these things come into your Qadash Assembly meeting and hear everyone speaking in an unknown language, they will think you are crazy.
But if all of you are prophesying, and unbelievers or people who do not understand these things come into your meeting, they will be convicted of sin and judged by what you say.
As they listen, their secret thoughts will be exposed, and they will fall to their knees and worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, declaring, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is truly here among you.”

Well, my dear ones, let us summarize; When you meet together, one will sing, another will teach, another will tell some special revelation 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given, one will speak in tongues, and another will interpret what is said. But everything that is done must strengthen all of you.
No more than two or three should speak in tongues. They must speak one at a time, and someone must interpret what they say.
But if no one is present who can interpret, they must be silent in your Qadash Assembly meeting and speak in tongues to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH privately.
Let two or three people prophesy, and let the others evaluate what is said.
But if someone is prophesying and another person receives a revelation from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the one who is speaking must stop.
In this way, all who prophesy will have a turn to speak, one after the other, so that everyone will learn and be encouraged.
Remember that people who prophesy are in control of their ruach and can take turns.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not an 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of disorder but of Shalum, as in all the meetings of the Qadash ones of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Women should be silent during the Qadash Assembly meetings. It is not proper for them to speak. They should be submissive, just as the law says.
If they have any questions, they should ask their husbands at home, for it is improper for women to speak in the Qadash Assembly meetings.
Or do you think the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH originated with you Corinthians? Are you the only ones to whom it was given?
If you claim to be a Nabym or think you are spiritual, you should recognize that what I am saying is a command from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF.
But if you do not recognize this, you yourself will not be recognized.
So, my dear brothers and sisters, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.
But be sure that everything is done properly and in order.
Let me now remind you, dear ones, of the Basurah (Good News) I preached to you before. You welcomed it then, and you still stand firm in it.
It is this Good News that saves you if you continue to believe the message I told you, unless of course, you believed something that was never true in the first place.
I passed on to you what was most important and what had also been passed on to me. Ha'Mashyach died for our sins, just as the Scriptures said.
Ha'Mashyach was buried, and He was raised from the dead on the third day, just as the Scriptures said.
Ha'Mashyach was seen by Kafa and then by the Twelve Talmidym.
After that, Ha'Mashyach was seen by more than five of his followers at one time, most of whom are still alive, though some have died.
Then Ha'Mashyach was seen by Ya'aqub and later by all the Shaliach.
Last of all, as though I had been born at the wrong time, I also saw Ha'Mashyach.
For I am the least of all the Shaliachs. In fact, I am not even worthy to be called a Shaliach after the way I persecuted the Qadash Assemblies of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

But whatever I am now, it is all because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH poured out HIS special favor on me and not without results. For I have worked harder than any of the other Shaliachs; yet it was not I but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who was working through me by HIS divine favor.
So it makes no difference whether I preach or they preach, for we all preach the same message you have already believed.
But tell me this since we preach that Ha'Mashyach rose from the dead, why are some of you saying there will be no resurrection of the dead?
For if there is no resurrection of the dead, then Ha'Mashyach has not been raised either.
And if Ha'Mashyach has not been raised, then all our preaching is useless, and your Amunah is useless.
And we Shaliachs would all be lying about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for we have said that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH raised Ha'Mashyach from the grave. But that can not be true if there is no resurrection of the dead.
And if there is no resurrection of the dead, then Ha'Mashyach has not been raised.
And if Ha'Mashyach has not been raised, then your Amunah is useless and you are still guilty of your sins.
In that case, all who have died believing in Ha'Mashyach are lost!
And if our hope in Ha'Mashyach is only for this life, we are more to be pitied than anyone in the world.
But in fact, Ha'Mashyach has been raised from the dead. Ha'Mashyach is the first of a great harvest of all who have died.
So you see, just as death came into the world through a man, now the resurrection from the dead has begun through another man.
Just as everyone dies because we all belong to Adam, everyone who belongs to Ha'Mashyach will be given new life.
But there is an order to this resurrection: Ha'Mashyach was raised as the first of the harvest; then all who belong to Ha'Mashyach will be raised when Ha'Mashyach comes back.
After that the end will come, when Ha'Mashyach will turn the Kingdom over to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, having destroyed every ruler and authority and power.
For Ha'Mashyach must reign until 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH humbles all His enemies beneath his feet.
And the last enemy to be destroyed is death.

For the Scriptures says, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has put all things under Ha'Mashyach authority. Of course, when it says “all things are under Ha'Mashyach's authority,” that does not include 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF, who gave Ha'Mashyach His authority.

Then, when all things are under Ha'Mashyach authority, the Son will put Himself under the authority of ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who gave His Son authority over all things, will be all in all supreme over everything everywhere.
If the dead will not be raised, what point is there in people being baptized for those who are dead? Why do it unless the dead will someday rise again?
And why should we ourselves risk our lives hour by hour?
For I swear, dear brothers and sisters, that I face death daily. This is as certain as my pride in what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our Master has done in you.

And what value was there in fighting wild beasts, those people of Ephesus if there will be no resurrection from the dead? And if there is no resurrection, “Let us feast and drink, for tomorrow we die!”
Do not be fooled by those who say such things, for “bad company corrupts good character.”
Think carefully about what is right, and stop, do not sin. For to your shame I say that some of you do not know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH at all.
But someone may ask, “How will the dead be raised? What kind of bodies will they have?”
What a foolish question! When you put a seed into the ground, it does not grow into a plant unless it dies first.
And what you put in the ground is not the plant that will grow, but only a bare seed of wheat or whatever you are planting.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives it the new body he wants it to have. A different plant grows from each kind of seed.
Similarly there are different kinds of flesh, one kind for man, another for animals, another for birds, and another for fish.
There are also bodies in the Shamaym and bodies on the Arath. The Kabad of the Shamaym bodies is different from the Kabad of the Arath bodies.
The sun has one kind of Kabad, while the moon and stars each have another kind. And even the stars differ from each other in their Kabad.
It is the same way with the resurrection of the dead. Our Arath bodies are planted in the ground when we die, but they will be raised to live forever.
Our bodies are buried in brokenness, but they will be raised in Kabad. They are buried in weakness, but they will be raised in strength.
They are buried as natural man's bodies, but they will be raised as the ruach bodies. For just as there are natural bodies, there are also the ruach bodies.
The Scriptures tell us, “The first man, Adam, became a living person.” But Ha'Mashyach the second and last Adam, He is a life giving Ruach.
The man of the natural Arath’s body came first, then the Ruach being man from Shamaym came later.
Adam, the first man, was made from the dust of the Arath, while Ha'Mashyach, the second man, came from Shamaym.
The people of the Arath are like the Arath man, and the people who belong to Shamaym are like the man of Shamaym.
Just as we are now like the Arath man, we will someday be like the man of the Shamaym.
What I am saying, dear Achks and Achutys, is that our physical bodies cannot inherit the Kingdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. These dying bodies cannot inherit what will last forever.
But let me reveal to you a wonderful secret. We will not all die, but we will all be transformed!

It will happen in a moment, in the blink of an eye, when the last trumpet is blown. For when the trumpet sounds, those who have died will be raised to live forever. And we who are living will also be transformed.
For our dying bodies must be transformed into bodies that will never die; our mortal bodies must be transformed into immortal bodies.
Then, when our dying bodies have been transformed into bodies that will never die, this Scripture will be fulfilled: “Death is swallowed up in victory.
O death, where is your victory? O death, where is your sting?”
For sin is the sting that results in death, and the law gives sin its power.
But Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives us victory over sin and death through our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
So, my dear brothers and sisters, be strong and immovable. Always work enthusiastically for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for you know that nothing you do for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is ever useless.
Now regarding your question about the money being collected for the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in Yahushalam. You should follow the same procedure I gave to the Qadash ones in Galatia.

On the Motza’ai-Shabbat which is the first day evening (Shabbat sunset) of each week, you should each put aside a portion of the money you have earned. Do not wait until I get there and then try to collect it all at once.
When I come, I will write letters of recommendation for the messengers you choose to deliver your gift to Yahushalam.
And if it seems appropriate for me to go along, they can travel with me.
I am coming to visit you after I have been to Macedonia, for I am planning to travel through Macedonia.
Perhaps I will stay awhile with you, possibly all winter, and then you can send me on my way to my next destination.
This time I do not want to make just a short visit and then go right on. I want to come and stay awhile, if 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will let me.
In the meantime, I will be staying here at Ephesus until the Festival of Shabut (Pentecost).
There is a wide-open door for a great work here, although many oppose me.
When Timothy comes, do not intimidate him. He is doing the work of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, just as I am.
Do not let anyone treat Timothy with contempt. Send him on his way with your Barakah when he returns to me. I expect him to come with the other believers.
Now about our brother Apollos, I urged him to visit you with the other believers, but he was not willing to go right now, he will see you later when he has the opportunity.
Be on guard. Stand firm in the Amunah. Be courageous. Be strong.
And do everything with Ahaba (love).

You know that Stephanas and his household were the first of the harvest of believers in Greece, and they are spending their lives in service to the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I urge you, dear brothers and sisters,
To submit to them and others like them who serve with such devotion.
I am very glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have come here. They have been providing the help you were not here to give me.
They have been a wonderful encouragement to me, as they have been to you. You must show your appreciation to all who serve so well.
The the Qadash assembly here in the province of Asia send greetings in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as do Aquila and Priscilla and all the others who gather in their home for the Qadash Assembly meetings.
All the Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters) here send greetings to you. Greet each other with a sacred kiss.
HERE IS MY GREETING IN MY OWN HANDWRITING—SHAUL.
If anyone does not love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that person is cursed. Come Our Mashyach.
May the Favor of the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA be with you.
My love to all of you in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.

books.name: II Corinthians
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, chosen by the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to be a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, and from our brother Timothy. I am writing to the Qadash Assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in Corinth and to all of the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH throughout Greece.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our ABBA and our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach give you favor and Shalum.
All Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the ABBA of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is our merciful ABBA and the source of all comfort.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH comforts us in all our troubles so that we can comfort others. When they are troubled, we will be able to give them the same comfort 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us.
For the more we suffer for Ha'Mashyach, the more 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will shower us with his comfort through Ha'Mashyach.

Even when we are weighed down with troubles, it is for your comfort and salvation! For when we ourselves are comforted, we will certainly comfort you. Then you can patiently endure the same things we suffer.
We are confident that as you share in our sufferings, you will also share in the comfort 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives us.

We think you ought to know, dear Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters), about the trouble we went through in the province of Asia. We were crushed and overwhelmed beyond our ability to endure, and we thought we would never live through it.
In fact, we expected to die. But as a result, we stopped relying on ourselves and learned to rely only on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who raises the dead.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did rescue us from mortal danger, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will rescue us again. We have placed our confidence in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and HE will continue to rescue us.
And you are helping us by praying for us. Then many people will give Tudah because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has divinely answered so many prayers for our safety.

We can say with confidence and a clear conscience that we have lived with the righteousness that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave to us, and there is sincerity in all our dealings. We have depended on the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, not on our own man's wisdom. That is how we have conducted ourselves before the world, and especially toward you.
Our letters have been straightforward, and there is nothing written between the lines and nothing you cannot understand. I hope someday you will fully understand us,
Even if you do not understand us now. Then on the day when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach returns, you will be proud of us in the same way we are proud of you.
Since I was so sure of your understanding and trust, I wanted to give you a double Barakah by visiting you twice
first on my way to Macedonia and again when I returned from Macedonia. Then you could send me on my way to Yahudah.
You may be asking why I changed my plan. Do you think I make my plans carelessly? Do you think I am like people of the world who say “Yes” when they really mean “No”?
As surely as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is faithful, our word to you does not waver between “Yes” and “No.”

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, does not waver between Yes” and “No. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is the one whom Silas, Timothy, and I preached to you, and as the ultimate “Yes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He always does what He says.
For all of the promises of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have been fulfilled in Ha'Mashyach with a resounding “Yes!” And through Ha'Mashyach, our “YES” ascends to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for HIS Kabad.
It is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who enables us, along with you, to stand firm for Ha'Mashyach. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has commissioned us,
and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has identified us as HIS own by placing the RUACH Ha'Qadash in our hearts as the first installment that guarantees everything 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised us.
Now I call upon 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as my witness that I am telling the truth. The reason I did not return to Corinth was to spare you from a severe rebuke.

But that does not mean we want to dominate you by telling you how to put your Amunah into practice. We want to work together with you so you will be full of joy, for it is by your own Amunah that you stand firm.
So I decided that I would not bring you grief with another painful visit.
For if I cause you grief, who will make me glad? Certainly not someone I have grieved.

That is why I wrote to you as I did, so that when I do come, I will not be grieved by the very ones who ought to give me the greatest joy. Surely you all know that my joy comes from your being joyful.
I wrote that letter in great anguish, with a troubled heart and many tears. I did not want to grieve you, but I wanted to let you know how much Ahaba (love) I have for you.
I am not overstating it when I say that the man who caused all the trouble hurt all of you more than he hurt me.
Most of you opposed him, and that was punishment enough.
Now, however, it is time to forgive and comfort him. Otherwise he may be overcome by discouragement.
So I urge you now to reaffirm your love for him.
I wrote to you as I did to test you and see if you would fully comply with my instructions.
When you forgive this man, I forgive him too. And when I forgive whatever needs to be forgiven, I do so with the authority of Ha'Mashyach for your benefit,
So that ha'shatan will not outsmart us. For we are familiar with his evil schemes.
When I came to the city of Troas to preach the Basurah (Good News) of Ha'Mashyach, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH opened a door of opportunity for me.
But I had no Shalum of mind because my dear brother Titus have not yet arrived with a report from you. So I said good bye and went on to Macedonia to find him.

But Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made us HIS captives and continues to lead us along in the triumphal procession of Ha'Mashyach. Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH uses us to spread the knowledge of Ha'Mashyach everywhere, like a sweet perfume.
For we are to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the fragrance of Ha'Mashyach, But this fragrance is perceived differently by those who are being saved and by those who are perishing.
To those who are perishing, we are a dreadful smell of death and doom. But to those who are being saved, we are a life giving perfume. And who is adequate for such a task as this?

You see, we are not like the many hucksters who preach for personal profit. We preach the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with sincerity and with the authority of Ha'Mashyach, knowing that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is watching us.
Are we beginning to praise ourselves again? Are we like others, who need to bring you letters of recommendation, or who ask you to write such letters on their behalf? Surely not!
The only letter of recommendation we need is you yourselves. Your lives are a letter written in our hearts; everyone can read it and recognize our good work among you.

Clearly, you are a letter from Ha'Mashyach showing the result of our ministry among you. This “letter” is written not with pen and ink, but with the RUACH of the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. It is carved not on tablets of stone, but on man's hearts.
We are confident of all this because of our great trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through Ha'Mashyach.
It is not that we think we are qualified to do anything on our own. Our qualification comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has enabled us to be ministers of HIS renewed covenant. This is a covenant not of written laws, but of the RUACH. The first written covenant ends in death; but under the renewed covenant, the Ruach gives life.

The old way, with laws carved in stone, led to death, though it began with such Kabad that the people of Yashar'AL could not bear to look at the face of Musha. For his face shone with the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, even though the brightness was already fading away.
Should we not expect far greater Kabad under the new way, now that the RUACH Ha'Qadash is giving life?
If the old way, which brings condemnation, was great, how much more greatness is the new way, which makes us right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!
In fact, that first Kabad was not great at all compared with the overwhelming Kabad of the new way.
So if the first Covenant, which has been replaced, was great, how much more greatness is the renewed Covenant, which remains forever!
Since this renewed covenant gives us such confidence, we can be very bold.
We are not like Musha, who put a veil over his face so the people of Yashar'AL would not see the Kabad, even though it was destined to fade away.

But the minds of the people were hardened, and to this day whenever the first covenant is being read, the same veil covers their minds so they cannot understand the Truth. And this veil can be removed only by believing in Ha'Mashyach.
Yes, even today when they read the’ writings of Musha, their hearts are covered with that veil, and they do not understand.
But whenever someone turns to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the veil is taken away.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the RUACH, and wherever the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is, there is freedom (Liberty).
So all of us who have had that veil removed can see and reflect the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who is the RUACH makes us more and more like HIM as we are changed into HIS awesome image.
Therefore, since 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in his mercy has given us this new way of life, we do not get discouraged.

Instead, we have renounced secret and shameful ways. We do not use trickery or pervert the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. By clear statements of the Truth we commend ourselves to the conscience of everyone before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
If the Basurah (Good News) we preach is hidden behind a veil, it is hidden only from people who are perishing.

ha'shatan, who is the controller of this world's evil system, has blinded the minds of those who do not believe. They are unable to see the awesome light of the Basurah (Good News). They do not understand this message about the Kabad of Ha'Mashyach who is the exact likeness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You see, we do not go around preaching about ourselves. We preach that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach is Master, and we ourselves are your servants for the sake of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who said, Let there be light in the darkness, has made this light shine in our hearts so we could know the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that is seen in the face of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.

We now have this light shining in our hearts, but we ourselves are like fragile clay jars containing this great treasure. This makes it clear that our great power is from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, not from ourselves.
We are pressed on every side by troubles, but we are not crushed. We are perplexed, but not driven to despair.
We are hunted down, but never abandoned by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. We get knocked down, but we are not destroyed.
Through suffering, our bodies continue to share in the death of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA so that the life of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA may also be seen in our bodies.
Yes, we live under constant danger of death because we serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, so that the life of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA will be evident in our dying bodies.
So we live in the face of death, but this has resulted in eternal life for you.
But we continue to preach because we have the same kind of Amunah the tahalym (psalmist) had when he said, “I believed in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so I spoke.”
We know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who raised the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, will also raise us with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and present us to HIMSELF together with you.
All of this is for your benefit. And as the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reaches more and more people, there will be great thanksgiving, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will receive more and more Kabad.
Therefore we do not lose heart. Even though our outward man is perishing, yet the inward man is being renewed day by day.
For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, is working for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of Kabad,

Therefore we should not look at the things which are seen, but we should be Focus on the things which are not seen. For the things which you can see are temporary, but the things which you can not see are eternal.

For we know that when this Arath tent we live in is taken down (that is, when we die and leave this Arath body), we will have a house in Shamaym, an eternal body made for us by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF and not by man's hands.
We grow weary in our present bodies, and we long to put on our Shamaym bodies like new clothing.
For we will put on Shamaym bodies; we will not be ruach without bodies.

While we live in these Arath bodies, we groan and sigh, but it is not that we want to die and get rid of these bodies that clothe us. Rather, we want to put on our new bodies so that these dying bodies will be swallowed up by life.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF has prepared us for this, and as a guarantee 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us HIS RUACH Ha'Qadash.
So we are always confident, even though we know that as long as we live in these bodies we are not at home with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For we live by believing and not by seeing.
Yes, we are fully confident, and we would rather be away from these Arath bodies, for then we will be at home with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So whether we are here in this body or away from this body, our goal is to please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For we must all stand before Ha'Mashyach to be judged. We will each receive whatever we deserve for the good or the evil we have done in this Arath body.
Therefore, since we know what it means to fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, we should try to persuade people. We ourselves are perfectly known to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I hope we are also really known to your consciences.
We are not commending ourselves to you, we are giving you a reason to be proud of us, that you may have an answer for those who boast in appearance and not in heart.
If it seems we are crazy, it is to bring Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And if we are in our right minds, it is for your benefit.
Either way, the love of Ha'Mashyach controls us. Since we believe that Ha'Mashyach died for all, we also believe that we have all died to our old life.
Ha'Mashyach died for everyone so that those who receive His new life will no longer live for themselves. Instead, they will live for Ha'Mashyach, who died and was raised for them.
So we have stopped evaluating others from a man's point of view. At one time we thought of Ha'Mashyach merely from a man's point of view. How differently we know Him now!
This means that anyone who belongs to Ha'Mashyach has become a new person. The old life is gone; a new life has begun!
And all of this is a gift from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who brought us back to HIMSELF through Ha'Mashyach. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us this task of reconciling people to HIM.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was in Ha'Mashyach, reconciling the world to HIMSELF, no longer counting the sins of people against them. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave us this wonderful message of reconciliation.
So we are the ambassadors of Ha'Mashyach; and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is calling to people through us. We speak for Ha'Mashyach when we plead with you, “ To Come back to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut made Ha'Mashyach, who never sinned, to be the offering for our sin, so that we could
We are workers together with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. So we beg you: Do not let the favor that you received from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be for nothing.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “In an acceptable time I have heard you, And in the day of salvation I have helped you.” For now is the accepted time; And now is the day of salvation.
We live in such a way that no one will stumble because of us, and no one will find fault with our ministry.
In everything we do, we show that we are true ministers of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. We patiently endure troubles and hardships and calamities of every kind.
We have been beaten, been put in prison, faced angry mobs, worked to exhaustion, endured sleepless nights, and gone without food.
We prove ourselves by our purity, our understanding, our patience, our kindness, by the RUACH Ha'Qadash within us, and by our sincere love.
We faithfully preach the truth. The power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is working in us. We use the weapons of righteousness in the right hand for attack and the left hand for defense.
We serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH whether people honor us or despise us, whether they slander us or praise us. We are honest, but they call us impostors.
We are ignored, even though we are well known. We live close to death, but we are still alive. We have been beaten, but we have not been killed.
Our hearts ache, but we always have joy. We are poor, but we give the riches of the RUACH to others. We own nothing, and yet we have everything.
Oh, dear Corinthian friends! We have spoken honestly with you, and our hearts are open to you.
There is no lack of love on our part, but you have withheld your love from us.
I am asking you to respond as if you were my own children. Open your hearts to us!
Do not team up with those who are unbelievers. How can righteousness be a partner with wickedness? How can light live with darkness?
What harmony can there be between Ha'Mashyach and ha'shatan? How can a believer be a partner with an unbeliever?

And what union can there be between the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and idols? For we are the Temple of the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. As 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar: “I will live in them and walk among them. I will be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and they will be MY people.
Therefore, come out from among unbelievers, and separate yourselves from them, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Do not touch their filthy things, and I will welcome you.
And I will be your ABBA, and you will be my sons and daughters says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.”
Because we have these promises, dear friends, let us cleanse ourselves from everything that can defile our body or ruach. And let us work toward complete righteousness because we fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Please open your hearts to us. We have not done wrong to anyone, nor led anyone astray, nor taken advantage of anyone.
I am not saying this to condemn you. I said before that you are in our hearts, and we live or die together with you.
I have the highest confidence in you, and I take great pride in you. You have greatly encouraged me and made me happy despite all our troubles.
When we arrived in Macedonia, there was no rest for us. We faced conflict from every direction, with battles on the outside and fear on the inside.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who encourages those who are discouraged, encouraged us by the arrival of Titus.

His presence was a joy, but so was the news he brought of the encouragement he received from you. When he told us how much you long to see me, and how sorry you are for what happened, and how loyal you are to me, I was filled with joy!
I am not sorry that I sent that severe letter to you, though I was sorry at first, for I know it was painful to you for a little while.

Now I am glad I sent it, not because it hurt you, but because the pain caused you to repent and change your ways. It was the kind of sorrow 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wants HIS people to have, so you were not harmed by us in any way.

For the kind of sorrow 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wants us to experience leads us away from sin and results in salvation. There is no regret for that kind of sorrow. But worldly sorrow, which lacks repentance, results in spiritual death.

Just see what this righteous sorrow produced in you! Such earnestness, such concern to clear yourselves, such indignation, such alarm, such longing to see me, such zeal, and such a readiness to punish wrong. You showed that you have done everything necessary to make things right.
My purpose, then, was not to write about who did the wrong or who was wronged. I wrote to you so that in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH you could see for yourselves how loyal you are to us.
We have been greatly encouraged by this. In addition to our own encouragement, we were especially delighted to see how happy Titus was about the way all of you welcomed him and set his mind at ease.
I had told him how proud I was of you, and you did not disappoint me. I have always told you the truth, and now my boasting to Titus has also proved true!
Now Titus cares for you more than ever when he remembers the way all of you obeyed him and welcomed him with such fear and deep respect.
I am very happy now because I have complete confidence in you.

They are being tested by many troubles, and they are very poor. But they are also filled with abundant joy, which has overflowed in rich generosity.
For I can testify that they gave not only what they could afford, but far more. And they did it of their own free will.
They begged us again and again for the privilege of sharing in the gift for the believers in Yahushalam.
They even did more than we had hoped, for their first action was to give themselves to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and to us, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wanted them to do.
So we have urged Titus, who encouraged your giving in the first place, to return to you and encourage you to finish this ministry of giving.
Since you excel in so many ways, in your Amunah, in speech, in knowledge, in all diligence, and in your love for us, see that you abound in this favor also.
I am not commanding you to do this. But I am testing how genuine your love is by comparing it with the eagerness of the other Qadash Assemblies.
You know the generous favor of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. Though He was rich, yet for your sakes He became poor, so that by His poverty He could make you rich.
Here is my advice: It would be good for you to finish what you started a year ago. Last year you were the first who wanted to give, and you were the first to begin doing it.
Now you should finish what you started. Let the eagerness you showed in the beginning be matched now by your giving. Give in proportion to what you have.
Whatever you give is acceptable if you give it eagerly. And give according to what you have, not what you do not have.
Of course, I do not mean your giving should make life easy for others and hard for yourselves. I only mean that there should be some equality.
Right now you have plenty and can help those who are in need. Later, they will have plenty and can share with you when you need it. In this way, things will be equal.
As the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered a lot had nothing left over, and those who gathered only a little had enough.”
But Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! He has given Titus the same enthusiasm for you that I have.
Titus welcomed our request that he visit you again. In fact, he himself was very eager to go and see you.
We are also sending another brother with Titus. All the Qadash Assemblies praise him as a preacher of the Basurah (Good News).
He was appointed by the Qadash Assemblies to accompany us as we take the offering to Yahushalam, a service that Esteemed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and shows our eagerness to help.
We are traveling together to guard against any criticism for the way we are handling this generous gift.
We are careful to be honorable before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but we also want everyone else to see that we are honorable.

We are also sending with them another of our brother who has proven himself many times and has shown on many occasions how eager he is, he is now even more enthusiastic because of his great confidence in you.
If anyone asks about Titus, say that he is my partner who works with me to help you. And the brothers with him have been sent by the Qadash Assemblies, and they bring honor to Ha'Mashyach.
So show them your love, and prove to all the Qadash Assemblies that our boasting about you is justified.
I really do not need to write to you about this ministry of giving for the believers in Yahushalam.

For I know how eager you are to help, and I have been boasting to the Qadash Assemblies in Macedonia that you in Greece were ready to send an offering a year ago. In fact, it was your enthusiasm that stirred up many of the Macedonian believers to begin giving.
But I am sending these brothers to be sure you really are ready, as I have been telling them, and that your money is all collected. I do not want to be wrong in my boasting about you.
We would be embarrassed, not to mention your own embarrassment if some Macedonian believers came with me and found that you were not ready after all I had told them!
So I thought I should send these brothers ahead of me to make sure the gift you promised is ready. But I want it to be a willing gift, not one given grudgingly.
Remember this, a farmer who plants only a few seeds will get a small crop of harvest. But the one who plants generously will get a generous crop of harvest.
You must each decide in your heart how much to give. And do not give reluctantly or in response to pressure. “For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves a person who gives cheerfully.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will generously provide all you need. Then you will always have everything you need and plenty left over to share with others.
As the Scriptures say, “They share freely and give generously to the poor. Their good deeds will be remembered forever.”

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the one who provides seed for the farmer and then bread to eat. In the same way, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will provide and increase your resources and then produce a great harvest of generosity in you.
Yes, you will be enriched in every way so that you can always be generous. And when we take your gifts to those who need them, they will give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So two good things will result from this ministry of giving the needs of the believers in Yahushalam will be met, and they will joyfully express their Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
As a result of your ministry, they will give Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For your generosity to them and to all believers will prove that you are obedient to the Basurah (Good News) of Ha'Mashyach.
And they will pray for you with deep affection because of the overflowing favor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given to you.
Tudah be to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for HIS gift that is too wonderful to describe.
Now I Shaul, appeal to you with the gentleness and kindness of Ha'Mashyach though I realize you think I am timid in person and bold only when I write from far away.
Well, I am begging you now so that when I come I will not have to be bold with those who think we act from man's motives.
We are men, but we do not wage war as men do.
We use the mighty weapons of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, not worldly weapons, to knock down the strongholds of man's reasoning and to destroy false arguments.
We destroy every proud obstacle that keeps people from knowing 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. We capture their rebellious thoughts and teach them to obey Ha'Mashyach.
And after you have become fully obedient, we will punish everyone who remains disobedient.
Look at the obvious facts. Those who say they belong to Ha'Mashyach must recognize that we belong to Ha'Mashyach as much as they do.
I may seem to be boasting too much about the authority given to us by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. But our authority builds you up; it does not tear you down. So I will not be ashamed of using my authority.
I am not trying to frighten you by my letters.
For some say, “the letters of Shaul are demanding and forceful, but in person he is weak, and his speeches are worthless!”
Those people should realize that our actions when we arrive in person will be as forceful as what we say in our letters from far away.

Oh, do not worry; we would not dare say that we are as wonderful as these other men who tell you how important they are! But they are only comparing themselves with each other, using themselves as the standard of measurement. How ignorant!

We will not boast about things done outside our area of authority. We will boast only about what has happened within the boundaries of the work 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us, which includes our working with you.

We are not reaching beyond these boundaries when we claim authority over you, as if we had never visited you. For we were the first to travel all the way to Corinth with the Basurah (Good News) of Ha'Mashyach.
Nor do we boast and claim credit for the work someone else has done. Instead, we hope that your Amunah will grow so that the boundaries of our work among you will be extended.

Then we will be able to go and preach the Basurah (Good News) in other places far beyond you, where no one else is working. Then there will be no question of our boasting about work done in the territory of someone else.
As the Scriptures say, “If you want to boast, boast only about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
When people commend themselves, it does not count for much. The important thing is for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to commend them.
I hope you will put up with a little more of my foolishness. Please bear with me.
For I am jealous for you with the jealousy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF. I promised you as a pure bride to one husband (Ha'Mashyach).
But I fear that somehow your pure and undivided devotion to Ha'Mashyach will be corrupted, just as Chaya (Eve) was deceived by the cunning ways of the serpent.

You happily put up with whatever anyone tells you, even if they preach a different 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach than the one we preach, or a different kind of ruach than the one you received, or a different kind of Basurah than the one you believed.
But I do not consider myself inferior in any way to these “super Shaliach” who teach such things.
I may be unskilled as a speaker, but I am not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every possible way.
Was I wrong when I humbled myself and honored you by preaching the Basurah (Good News) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to you without expecting anything in return?
I “robbed” other Qadash Assemblies by accepting their contributions so I could serve you at no cost.

And when I was with you and did not have enough to live on, I did not become a financial burden to anyone. For the Achks (brothers) who came from Macedonia brought me all that I needed. I have never been a burden to you, and I never will be.
As surely as the truth of Ha'Mashyach is in me, no one in all of Greece will ever stop me from boasting about this.
Why? Because I do not love you? 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows that I do.
But I will continue doing what I have always done. This will undercut those who are looking for an opportunity to boast that their work is just like ours.
These people are false Shaliachs. They are deceitful workers who disguise themselves as Shaliachs of Ha'Mashyach.
But I am not surprised! Even ha'shatan disguises himself as a Malak of light.
So it is no wonder that the servants of ha'shatan also disguise themselves as servants of righteousness. In the end they will get the punishment their wicked deeds deserve.
Again I say, do not think that I am a fool to talk like this. But even if you do, listen to me, as you would to a foolish person, while I also boast a little.
Such boasting is not from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but I am acting like a fool.
And since others boast about their man's achievements, I will too.
After all, you think you are so wise, but you enjoy putting up with fools!
You put up with it when someone enslaves you, takes everything you have, takes advantage of you, takes control of everything, and slaps you in the face.
I am ashamed to say that we have been too “weak” to do that! But whatever they dare to boast about, I am talking like a fool again, I dare to boast about it too.
Are they Abarym (Hebrews)? So am I. Are they Yasharalym? So am I. Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I.

Are they servants of Ha'Mashyach? I know I sound like a madman, but I have served Ha'Mashyach far more! I have worked harder, been put in prison more often, been whipped times without number, and faced death again and again.
Five different times the Yahudym leaders gave me thirty nine lashes.
Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked. Once I spent a whole night and a day adrift at sea.

I have traveled on many long journeys. I have faced danger from rivers and from robbers. I have faced danger from my own people, the Yahudym, as well as from the other nations. I have faced danger in the cities, in the deserts, and on the seas. And I have faced danger from men who claim to be believers but are not.
I have worked hard and long, enduring many sleepless nights. I have been hungry and thirsty and have often gone without food. I have shivered in the cold, without enough clothing to keep me warm.
Then, besides all this, I have the daily burden of my concern for all the Qadash Assemblies.
Who is weak without me feeling that weakness? Who is led astray, and I do not burn with anger?
If I must boast, I would rather boast about the things that show how weak I am.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the ABBA of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, who is worthy of eternal Yadah, knows I am not lying.
When I was in Damascus, the governor under King Aretas kept guards at the city gates to catch me.
I had to be lowered in a basket through a window in the city wall to escape from him.
This boasting will do no good, but I must go on. I will reluctantly tell about visions and revelations from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I was caught up to the third Shamaym fourteen years ago. Whether I was in my body or out of my body, I do not know, only 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows.
Yes, only 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows whether I was in my body or outside my body. But I do know
That I was caught up to paradise and heard things so astounding that they cannot be expressed in words, things no man is allowed to tell.
That experience is worth boasting about, but I am not going to do it. I will boast only about my weaknesses.

If I wanted to boast, I would be no fool in doing so, because I would be telling the truth. But I will not do it, because I do not want anyone to give me credit beyond what they can see in my life or hear in my message,
Even though I have received such wonderful revelations from
Three different times I begged Ha'Mashyach to take it away.
Each time he said, “My favor is all you need. My power works best in weakness.” So now I am glad to boast about my weaknesses, so that the power of Ha'Mashyach can work through me.
That is why I take pleasure in my weaknesses, and in the insults, hardships, persecutions, and troubles that I suffer for Ha'Mashyach. For when I am weak, then I am strong.
You have made me act like a fool. You ought to be writing commendations for me, for I am not at all inferior to these “super Shaliach,” even though I am nothing at all.
When I was with you, I certainly gave you proof that I am a Shaliach. For I patiently did many signs and wonders and miracles among you.
The only thing I failed to do, which I do in the other Qadash Assemblies, was to become a financial burden to you. Please forgive me for this wrong!

Now I am coming to you for the third time, and I will not be a burden to you. I do not want what you have, I want you. After all, children do not provide for their parents. Rather, parents provide for their children.
I will gladly spend myself and all I have for you, even though it seems that the more I love you, the less you love me.
Some of you admit I was not a burden to you. But others still think I was sneaky and took advantage of you by trickery.
But how? Did any of the men I sent to you take advantage of you?
When I urged Titus to visit you and sent our other brother with him, did Titus take advantage of you? No! For we have the same ruach and walk in steps of each other, doing things the same way.

Perhaps you think we are saying these things just to defend ourselves. No, we tell you this as the servants of Ha'Mashyach, and with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as our witness. Everything we do, dear friends, is to strengthen you.

For I am afraid that when I come I will not like what I find, and you will not like my response. I am afraid that I will find quarreling, jealousy, anger, selfishness, slander, gossip, arrogance, and disorderly behavior.

Yes, I am afraid that when I come again, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will humble me in your presence. And I will be grieved because many of you have not given up your old sins. You have not repented of your impurity, sexual immorality, and eagerness for lustful pleasure.
This is the third time I am coming to visit you and as the Scriptures say, “The facts of every case must be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses”.
I have already warned those who had continued sin when I was there on my second visit. Now I again warn them and all others, just as I did before, that next time I will not spare them.
I will give you all the proof you want that Ha'Mashyach speaks through me. Ha'Mashyach is not weak when he deals with you; he is powerful among you.

Although Ha'Mashyach was impaled in weakness, Ha'Mashyach now lives by the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. We, too, are weak, just as Ha'Mashyach was, but when we deal with you we will be alive with Ha'Mashyach and will have the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Examine yourselves to see if your Amunah is genuine. Test yourselves. Surely you know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach is among you; if not, you have failed the test of genuine Amunah.
As you test yourselves, I hope you will recognize that we have not failed the test of the Shaliach's authority.

We pray to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that you will not do what is wrong by refusing our correction. I hope we will not need to demonstrate our authority when we arrive. Do the right thing before we come, even if that makes it look like we have failed to demonstrate our authority.
For we cannot oppose the truth, but must always stand for the truth.
We are glad to seem weak if it helps show that you are actually strong. We pray that you will become mature.

I am writing this to you before I come, hoping that I will not need to deal severely with you when I do come. For I want to use the authority Ha'Mashyach has given me to strengthen you, not to tear you down.

Dear brothers and sisters, I close my letter with these last words: Be joyful. Grow to maturity. Encourage each other. Live in harmony and Shalum. Then the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Ahaba (love) and Shalum will be with you.
Greet each other with a Qadash kiss.
All of the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH here send you their greetings.
May the favor of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, and the Ahaba (love) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and the fellowship of the RUACH Ha'Qadash be with you all.

books.name: Galatians
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, a Shaliach. I was not appointed by any group of people or any man's authority, but by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach Himself and by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the ABBA, who raised 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA from the dead.
All the Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters) here join me in sending this letter to the Qadash Assemblies of Galatia.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the ABBA and our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach give you favor and Shalum.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA gave His life for our sins, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our ABBA planned, in order to rescue us from this evil world in which we live.
All Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever and ever!.

I am shocked that you are turning away so soon from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who called you to Himself through the loving mercy of Ha'Mashyach. You are following a different way that pretends to be the Basurah (Good News)
But that is not the Basurah at all. You are being fooled by those who deliberately twist the truth concerning Ha'Mashyach.
Let the curse of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH fall on anyone, including us or even a Malak from Shamaym, who preaches a different kind of Basurah (Good News) than the one we preached to you.
I say again what we have said before: If anyone preaches any other Basurah than the one you welcomed, let that person be cursed.
Obviously, I am not trying to win the approval of men, I only focus on the approval of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. If pleasing people were my goal, I would not be the servant of Ha'Mashyach
Dear brothers and sisters, I want you to understand that the Basurah message I preach is not based on mere man's reasoning.
I received my message from no man's source, and no one taught me. Instead, I received it by direct revelation from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
You know what I was like when I followed the Yahudym religion, how I violently persecuted the Qadash Assemblies of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I did my best to destroy it.
I was far ahead of my fellow Yahudym in my zeal for the traditions of my ancestors.
But even before I was born, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose me and called me by His marvelous favor. Then it pleased 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH
To reveal HIS Son to me so that I would proclaim the Basurah (Good News) about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to the other nations. When this happened, I did not rush out to consult with any man.
Nor did I go up to Yahushalam to consult with those who were Shaliachs before I was. Instead, I went away into Arabia, and later I returned to the city of Damascus.
Then three years later I went to Yahushalam to get to know Kafa, and I stayed with him for fifteen days.
The only other Shaliach I met at that time was Ya'aqub, the the brother of Ha'Mashyach.
I declare before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that what I am writing to you is not a lie.
After that visit I went north into the provinces of Syria and Cilicia.
And still the Qadash Assemblies in Ha'Mashyach that are in Yahudah did not know me personally.
All they knew was that people were saying, “The one who used to persecute us is now preaching the very Amunah he tried to destroy!”
And they Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because of me.
Then after fourteen years I went up again to Yahushalam with Barnabas, and also took Titus with me.

And I went up by revelation, and communicated to them that the Basurah which I preach among the other nations, but privately to those who were of reputation, lest by any means I might run, or had run, in vain.
Yet not even Titus who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.
And this occurred because of false brethren secretly brought in (who came in by stealth to spy out our liberty which we have in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, that they might bring us into bondage),
To whom we did not yield submission even for an hour, that the truth of the Basurah might continue with you.

But from those who seemed to be something, whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH shows personal favoritism to no man, for those who seemed to be something added nothing to me.
But on the contrary, when they saw that the Basurah for the uncircumcised had been committed to me, as the Basurah for the circumcised was to Kafa
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who worked effectively in Kafa to be the Shaliach to the circumcised (Yahudym) also worked effectively in me to be the Shaliach toward the other nations,

And when Ya'aqub, Kafa, and Yahukanun, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the favor that had been given to me, they gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the other nations and they to the circumcised (Yahudym).
They desired only that we should remember the poor, the very thing which I also was eager to do.
But when Kafa came to Antiuch, I had to oppose him to his face, for what he did was very wrong.

When he first arrived, he ate with the other nations believers, who were not circumcised. But afterward, when some friends of Ya'aqub came, Kafa would not eat with the other nations anymore. He was afraid of criticism from these people who insisted on the necessity of circumcision.
As a result, other Yahudym believers followed the hypocrisy of Kafa, and even Barnabas was led astray by their hypocrisy.

When I saw that they were not following the truth of the Basurah message, I said to Kafa in front of all the others, “Since you, a Yahudym by birth, have discarded the Yahudym laws and are living like the other nations, why are you now trying to make these other nations follow the Yahudym traditions?
“You and I are Yahudym by birth, not ‘sinners’ like the other nations.

Yet we know that a person is made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, not by obeying the law. And we have believed in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, so that we might be made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because of our Amunah in Ha'Mashyach, not because we have obeyed the law. For no one will ever be made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by obeying the law.”

But suppose we seek to be made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through Amunah in Ha'Mashyach and then we are found guilty because we have abandoned the law. Would that mean Ha'Mashyach has led us into sin? Absolutely not!
Rather, I am a sinner if I rebuild the old system of law I already tore down.
For when I tried to keep the law, it condemned me. So I died to the law, I stopped trying to meet all its requirements so that I might live for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

My old self has been impaled with Ha'Mashyach. It is no longer I who live, but Ha'Mashyach lives in me. So I live in this Arath body by trusting in the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who loved me and gave Himself for me.
I do not treat the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as meaningless. For if keeping the law could make us right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, then there was no need for Ha'Mashyach to die.

Oh, foolish Galatians! Who has cast an evil spell on you? For the meaning of the death of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach was made as clear to you as if you had seen a picture of his death on the execution stake.
Let me ask you this one question: Did you receive the RUACH Ha'Qadash by obeying the law of Musha? Of course not! You received the RUACH because you believed the message you heard about Ha'Mashyach.
How foolish can you be? After starting your new lives in the RUACH, why are you now trying to become perfect by your own man's effort?
Have you experienced so much for nothing? Surely it was not in vain, was it?
I ask you again, does 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH give you the RUACH Ha'Qadash and work miracles among you because you obey the law? Of course not! It is because you believe the message you heard about Ha'Mashyach.
In the same way, Abraham believed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH counted Abraham as righteous because of his Amunah.”
The real children of Abraham, then, are those who put their Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

What is more, the Scriptures looked forward to this time when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would declare the other nations to be righteous because of their Amunah. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH proclaimed this good news to Abraham long ago when HE said, “All nations will be baraked through you.”
So all who put their Amunah in Ha'Mashyach share the same Barakah Abraham received because of his Amunah.

But those who depend on the law to make them right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are under HIS curse, for the Scriptures say, “Cursed is everyone who does not observe and obey all the commands that are written in the Law of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
So it is clear that no one can be made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by trying to keep the law. For the Scriptures say, “It is through Amunah that a righteous man has life.”
This way of Amunah is very different from the way of law, which says, “It is through obeying the law that a person has life.”

But Ha'Mashyach has rescued us from the curse pronounced by the law. When he was hung on the execution stake, Ha'Mashyach took upon himself the curse for our wrongdoing. For it is written in the Scriptures, “Cursed is everyone who is hung on a tree.”

For through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has baraked the other nations with the same Barakah he promised to Abraham, so that we who are believers might receive the promised RUACH Ha'Qadash through Amunah.
Dear brothers and sisters, here is an example from everyday life. Just as no one can set aside or amend an irrevocable agreement, so it is in this case.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave the promises to Abraham and his child. And notice that the Scripture does not say “to his children,” as if it meant many descendants. Rather, it says “to his child” and that, of course, means Ha'Mashyach.

This is what I am trying to say: The agreement 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made with Abraham could not be canceled four hundred and thirty years later when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave the law to Musha. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would be breaking HIS promise.
For if the inheritance could be received by keeping the law, then it would not be the result of accepting the promise of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave it to Abraham as a promise.
What purpose then does the law serve? It was added because of transgressions, till the Seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was appointed through Malakym by the hand of a mediator.
Now a mediator is helpful if more than one party must reach an agreement, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is One and HE did not use a mediator when HE gave HIS promise to Abraham.
Is there a conflict, then, between the law of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the promises of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Absolutely not! If the law could give us new life, we could be made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by obeying it.
But the Scriptures declare that we are all prisoners of sin, so we receive the promise of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for freedom only by believing in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Before the way of Amunah in Ha'Mashyach was available to us, we were placed under guard by the law. We were kept in protective custody, so to speak, until the way of Amunah was revealed.
Let me put it another way. The law was our guardian until Ha'Mashyach came; it protected us until we could be made right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach through Amunah.
And now that the way of Amunah has come, we no longer need the law as our guardian.
For you are all children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
And all who have been united with Ha'Mashyach in baptism have put on Ha'Mashyach, like putting on new clothes.
There is no longer Yahudym or the other nations, slave or free, male and female. For you are all one in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
And now that you belong to Ha'Mashyach, you are the true children of Abraham. You are Abraham heirs, and the promise of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to Abraham belongs to you.

Think of it this way. If a father dies and leaves an inheritance for his young children, those children are not much better off than slaves until they grow up, even though they actually own everything their father had.
They have to obey their guardians until they reach whatever age their father set.
And that is the way it was with us before Ha'Mashyach came. We were like children; we were slaves to the basic Ruach principles of this world.
But when the right time came, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent HIS Son, born of a woman, subject to the law.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent Him to buy freedom for us who were slaves to the law, so that HE could adopt us as HIS very own children.
And because we are HIS children, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has sent the Ruach of HIS Son into our hearts, prompting us to call out, “Abba 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Now you are no longer a slave, but the child of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And since you are HIS child, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made you HIS heir.
Before you other nations knew 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, you were slaves to so-called idols that do not even exist.

So now that you know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH or should I say, now that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows you, why do you want to go back again and become slaves once more to the weak and useless spiritual principles of this world?
You observe days and months and seasons and years.
I am afraid for you, lest I have labored for you in vain.
My dear ones, I urge you to become like me, for I became like you. You have not injured me at all.
You know that it was because I was ill that I brought you the Basurah the first time.
And my trial which was in my flesh you did not despise or reject, but you received me as a Malak of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, even as our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
What then was the Barakah you enjoyed? For I bear you witness that, if possible, you would have plucked out your own eyes and given them to me.
Have I therefore become your enemy because I tell you the truth?
Those false teachers are so eager to win your favor, but their intentions are not good. They are trying to shut you off from me so that you will pay attention only to them.
If someone is eager to do good things for you, that is all right; but let them do it all the time, not just when I am with you.
Oh, my dear children! I feel as if I am going through labor pains for you again, and they will continue until Ha'Mashyach is fully developed in your lives.
I wish I were with you right now so I could change my tone. But at this distance I do not know how else to help you.
Tell me, you who want to live under the law, do you know what the law actually says?
The Scriptures say that Abraham had two sons, one from his slave wife and one from his freeborn wife.

The son of the slave wife was born in a man's attempt to bring about the fulfillment of the promise of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. But the son of Sharah the freeborn wife was born as the fulfillment of the promise of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
These two women serve as an illustration of the two covenants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. The first woman, Hagar, represents Mount Sinai where people received the law that enslaved them.
And now Hagar is just like Mount Sinai in Arabia, because she and her children live in slavery to the law.
But the other woman, Sharah, represents the Yahushalam above. She is the free woman, and she is our mother.

As Yashayahu said, “Rejoice, O childless woman, you who have never given birth! Break into a joyful shout, you who have never been in labor! For the desolate woman now has more children than the woman who lives with her husband!”
And you, dear brothers and sisters, are children of the promise, just like Yachaq.
But you are now being persecuted by those who want you to keep the law, just as Ishmaal, the child born by man's effort, persecuted Yachaq, the child born by the power of Ruach Ha'Qadash.
But what do the Scriptures say about that? “Get rid of the slave and her son, for the son of the slave woman will not share the inheritance with the son of the free woman.”
So, dear brothers and sisters, we are not children of the slave woman; we are children of the free woman.
So Ha'Mashyach has truly set us free. Now make sure that you stay free, and do not get tied up again in slavery to the law.
Listen! I, Shaul, tell you this: If you are counting on circumcision to make you right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, then Ha'Mashyach will be of no benefit to you.
I will say it again. If you are trying to find favor with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by being circumcised, you must obey every regulation in the whole law of Musha.
For if you are trying to make yourselves right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by keeping the law, you have been cut off from Ha'Mashyach! You have fallen away from the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But we who live by the RUACH eagerly wait to receive by Amunah the righteousness 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised to us.
For when we place our Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, there is no benefit in being circumcised or being uncircumcised. What is important is Amunah expressing itself in Ahaba (love).
You were running the race so well. Who has held you back from following the truth?
This persuasion does not come from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who calls you.
