This false teaching is like a little yeast that spreads through the whole batch of dough!
I am trusting 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to keep you from believing false teachings. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge that person, whoever he is, who has been confusing you.

Dear brothers and sisters, if I were still preaching that you must be circumcised, as some say I do, why am I still being persecuted? If I were no longer preaching salvation through the execution stake of Ha'Mashyach, no one would be offended.
I just wish that those troublemakers who want to mutilate you by circumcision would mutilate themselves.
For you have been called to live in freedom, my brothers and sisters. But do not use your freedom to satisfy your sinful nature. Instead, use your freedom to serve one another in Ahaba (love).
For the whole law can be summed up in this one command: “AHABA (Love) your neighbor as yourself.”
But if you are always biting and devouring one another, watch out! Beware of destroying one another.
For I say to you, let the RUACH Ha'Qadash guide your lives. Then you will not be doing what your sinful nature craves.

The sinful nature wants to do evil, which is just the opposite of what the RUACH wants. And the RUACH gives us desires that are the opposite of what the sinful nature desires. These two forces are constantly fighting each other, so you are not free to carry out your good intentions.
But when you are directed by the RUACH, you are not under obligation to the law of Musha.
When you follow the desires of your sinful nature, the results are very clear: sexual immorality, impurity, lustful pleasures,
Idolatry, sorcery, hostility, quarreling, jealousy, outbursts of anger, selfish ambition, dissension, division,
Envy, drunkenness, wild parties, and other sins like these. Let me tell you again, as I have before, that anyone living that sort of life will not inherit the Kingdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But the RUACH Ha'Qadash produces this kind of fruit in our lives: Ahaba (love), Joy, Shalum, Patience, kindness, goodness, Amunah,
Gentleness, and self-control. There is no law against these things!
Those who belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach have nailed the passions and desires of their sinful nature to Ha'Mashyach‘s execution stake and impaled them there.
Since we are living by the RUACH, let us follow the the leading of the RUACH in every part of our lives.
Let us not become proud, or provoke one another, or be jealous of one another.

Dear brothers and sisters, if another believer is overcome by some sin, you who are righteous should gently and humbly help that person back onto the right path. And be careful not to fall into the same temptation yourself.
Share the burdens of each other, and in this way obey the law of Ha'Mashyach.
If you think you are too important to help someone, you are only fooling yourself. You are not that important.
Pay careful attention to your own work, for then you will get the satisfaction of a job well done, and you will not need to compare yourself to anyone else.
For we are each responsible for our own conduct.
Those who are taught the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH should provide for their teachers, sharing all good things with them.
Do not be misled, you cannot mock the justice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. You will always harvest what you plant.
Those who live only to satisfy their own sinful nature will harvest decay and death from that sinful nature. But those who live to please the RUACH will harvest everlasting life from the RUACH.
So let us not get tired of doing what is good. At just the right time we will reap a harvest of Barakah if we do not give up.
Therefore, whenever we have the opportunity, we should do good to everyone, especially to those in the family of Amunah.
Notice how large the letters i use, as i write these closing words in my own handwriting.
Those who are trying to force you to be circumcised want to look good to others. They do not want to be persecuted for teaching that the execution stake of Ha'Mashyach alone can save.
And even those who advocate circumcision do not keep the whole law themselves. They only want you to be circumcised so they can boast about it and claim you as their disciples.
As for me, may I never boast about anything except the execution stake of
It does not matter whether we have been circumcised or not. What counts is whether we have been transformed into a new creation.
May the Shalum and the mercy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be upon all who live by this principle; they are the new people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
From now on, do not let anyone trouble me with these things. For I bear on my body the scars that show I belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Dear brothers and sisters, may the favor of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach be with your ruach. So it will be.

books.name: Ephesians
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, chosen by the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to be a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. I am writing to the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in Ephesus, who are faithful followers of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our ABBA and the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach give you favor and Shalum.
All Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the ABBA of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, who has baraked us with every Barakah of the RUACH Ha'Qadash in the Shamaym realms because we are united with Ha'Mashyach.
Even before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made the world, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loved us and chose us in Ha'Mashyach to be Qadash and without fault in His eyes.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH decided in advance to adopt us into HIS own family by bringing us to HIMSELF through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. This is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wanted to do, and it gave HIM great pleasure.
So we Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for the marvelous favor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has poured out on us who belong to the dear Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is so rich in kindness and favor that he purchased our freedom with the blood of HIS Son and forgave our sins.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has showered HIS kindness on us, along with all wisdom and understanding.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has now revealed to us HIS mysterious plan regarding Ha'Mashyach, a plan to fulfill His own good pleasure.
And this is the plan: At the right time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bring everything together under the authority of Ha'Mashyach, everything in Shamaym and on Arath.
Furthermore, because we are united with Ha'Mashyach, we have received an inheritance from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for HE chose us in advance, and HE makes everything work out according to HIS plan.
The purpose of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was that we Yahudym who were the first to trust in Ha'Mashyach would bring Yadah and Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

And now you the other nations have also heard the truth, the Basurah (Good News) that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saves you. And when you believed in Ha'Mashyach, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH identified you as HIS own by giving you the RUACH Ha'Qadash, whom HE promised long ago.

The RUACH is the guarantee of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that He will give us the inheritance He promised and that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has purchased us to be His own people. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did this so we would Yadah and Esteemed HIM.
Ever since I first heard of your strong Amunah in our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and your love for the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH everywhere,
I have not stopped giving Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for you. I pray for you constantly,
Asking 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the Esteemed ABBA of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, to give you the RUACH of wisdom and insight so that you might grow in your knowledge of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I pray that your hearts will be flooded with light so that you can understand the confident hope 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given to those HE called HIS Qadash people who are HIS rich and awesome inheritance.
I also pray that you will understand the incredible greatness of the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for us who believe HIM. This is the same mighty power
That raised Ha'Mashyach from the dead and seated Him in the place of honor at the right hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the Shamaym realms.
Now Ha'Mashyach is far above any ruler or authority or power or leader or anything else, not only in this world but also in the world to come.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has put all things under the authority of Ha'Mashyach and has made Ha'Mashyach head over all things for the benefit of the Qadash Assemblies.
And the Qadash Assemblies is Ha'Mashyach's body; it is made full and complete by Ha'Mashyach, who fills all things everywhere with Himself.
Once you were dead because of your disobedience and your many sins.

You used to live in sin, just like the rest of the world, obeying ha'shatan, the commander of the powers in the unseen world. Ha'shatan is the spirit at work in the hearts of those who refuse to obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
All of us used to live that way, following the passionate desires and inclinations of our sinful nature. By our very nature we were subject to the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, just like everyone else.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is so rich in mercy, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loved us so much,
That even though we were dead because of our sins, he gave us life when he raised Ha'Mashyach from the dead. It is only by the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that you have been saved!
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH raised us from the dead along with Ha'Mashyach and seated us with Ha'Mashyach in the Shamaym realms because we are united with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.

So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH can point to us in all future ages as examples of the incredible wealth of his favor and kindness toward us, as shown in all 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has done for us who are united with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saved you by HIS favor when you believed. And you cannot take credit for this; it is a gift from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Salvation is not a reward for the good things we have done, so none of us can boast about it.
For we are the masterpiece of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has created us anew in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, so we can do the good things HE planned for us long ago.

Do not forget that you other nations used to be outsiders. You were called “uncircumcised heathens” by the Yahudym, who were proud of their circumcision, even though it affected only their bodies and not their hearts.

In those days you were living apart from Ha'Mashyach. You were excluded from citizenship among the people of Yashar'AL, and you did not know the covenant promises 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had made to them. You lived in this world without 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and without hope.
But now you have been united with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. Once you were far away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but now you have been brought near to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through the blood of Ha'Mashyach.

For Ha'Mashyach Himself has brought Shalum to us. He united Yahudym and the other nations into one people when, in his own body on the execution stake, Ha'Mashyach broke down the wall of hostility that separated us.

Ha'Mashyach abolished in His flesh the enmity, that is, the law of commandments contained in ordinances (regulations), so as to create in Himself one new man from the two, which is the Yahudym and the other nations, thus making Shalum,
Together as one body, Ha'Mashyach reconciled both groups to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by means of His death on the execution stake, and our hostility toward each other was put to death.
Ha'Mashyach brought this Basurah (Good News) of Shalum to you the other nations who were far away from Him, and Shalum to the Yahudym who were near.
Now all of us can come to ABBA through the same RUACH Ha'Qadash because of what Ha'Mashyach has done for us.
So now you the other nations are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens along with all of the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. You are members of the family of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Together, we are the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, built on the foundation of the Shaliachs and the Nabyms. And the cornerstone is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach Himself.
We are carefully joined together in Ha'Mashyach, becoming a Qadash Temple for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Through Ha'Mashyach you the other nations are also being made part of this dwelling where 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives by His RUACH.
When I think of all this, I Shaul, a prisoner of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach for the benefit of you the other nations.
Assuming, by the way that you know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me the special responsibility of extending HIS favor to you the other nations.
As I briefly wrote earlier, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF revealed HIS mysterious plan to me.
As you read what I have written, you will understand my insight into this plan regarding Ha'Mashyach.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not reveal it to previous generations, but now by the RUACH Ha'Qadash, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has revealed it to HIS Qadash Shaliachs and Nabyms.

And this is the plan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: Both the other nations and the Yahudym who believe the Basurah (Good News) share equally in the riches inherited by the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Both are part of the same body, and both enjoy the promise of Barakah because they belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
By the favor and mighty power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, I have been given the privilege of serving 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by spreading this Basurah (Good News).
Though I am the least deserving of all the Qadash ones, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me the privilege of telling the other nations about the endless treasures available to them in Ha'Mashyach.
I was chosen to explain to everyone this mysterious plan that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the Creator of all things, had kept secret from the beginning.
The purpose of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in all this was to use the Qadash Assemblies to display His wisdom in its rich variety to all the unseen rulers and authorities in the Shamaym places.
This was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's eternal plan, which HE carried out through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our MASTER.
Because of Ha'Mashyach and our Amunah in Ha'Mashyach, we can now come boldly and confidently into the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So please do not lose heart because of my trials here. I am suffering for you, so you should feel honored.
When I think of all this, I fall to my knees and pray to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
the Creator of everything in Shamaym and on Arath.
I pray that from HIS marvelous, unlimited resources 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will empower you with inner strength through HIS RUACH.
That Ha'Mashyach may dwell in your hearts through Amunah; that you, being rooted and grounded in Ahaba (love),
May be able to comprehend with all the Qadash ones what is the width and length and depth and height
To know the Ahaba (love) of Ha'Mashyach which passes knowledge; that you may be filled with all the fullness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
All Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power of the RUACH that is at work in us,
All Kabad be to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the Qadash Assemblies by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach to all generations, forever and ever. So it will be.
Therefore I Shaul, the prisoner serving Ha'Mashyach, beg you to lead a life worthy of your calling, for you have been called by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Always be humble and gentle. Be patient with each other, making allowance for the faults of each other because of your love.
Make every effort to keep yourselves united in the RUACH, binding yourselves together with Shalum.
For there is one body and one Ruach, just as you have been called to one precious hope for the future.
There is one Master, one Amunah, one baptism,
One 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and ABBA of all, who is over all, in all, and living through all.
However, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given each one of us a special gift through the generosity of Ha'Mashyach.
That is why the Scriptures say, “When Ha'Mashyach ascended to the heights, he led a crowd of captives and gave gifts to his people.”
Notice that it says “Ha'Mashyach ascended.” This clearly means that Ha'Mashyach also descended to our lowly Arath.
And the same one who descended is the one who ascended higher than all the Shamaym, so that He might fill the entire Arath (world) with Himself.
Now these are the gifts Ha'Mashyach gave to the Qadash Assemblies: the Shaliachs, the Nabyms, the ones to tell others about the Basurah, and the Shepherds and teachers.
Their responsibility is to equip the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to do His work and build up the Qadash Assemblies, the body of Ha'Mashyach.

This will continue until we all come to such unity in our Amunah and knowledge of the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that we will be mature in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, measuring up to the full and complete standard of Ha'Mashyach.

Then we will no longer be immature like children. We will not be tossed and blown about by every wind of new teaching. We will not be influenced when people try to trick us with lies so clever they sound like the truth.
Instead, we will speak the truth in love, growing in every way more and more like Ha'Mashyach, who is the head of his body, the Qadash Assemblies.
Ha'Mashyach makes the whole body fit together perfectly. As each part does its own special work, it helps the other parts grow, so that the whole body is healthy and growing and full of love.
With the authority of Ha'Mashyach I say this: Live no longer as the other nations do, for they are hopelessly confused.
Their minds are full of darkness; they wander far from the life 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives because they have closed their minds and hardened their hearts against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
They have no sense of shame. They live for lustful pleasure and eagerly practice every kind of impurity.
But that is not what you learned about Ha'Mashyach.
Since you have heard about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and have learned the truth that comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA,
throw off your old sinful nature and your former way of life, which is corrupted by lust and deception.
Instead, let the RUACH renew your thoughts and attitudes.
Put on your new nature, created to be like 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, truly righteous and Qadash.
So stop telling lies. Let us tell our neighbors the truth, for we are all parts of the same body.
And “do not sin by letting anger control you.” Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry,
for anger gives a foothold to ha'shatan.
If you are a thief, quit stealing. Instead, use your hands for good hard work, and then give generously to others in need.
Do not use unpleasant or abusive language. Let everything you say be good and helpful, so that your words will be an encouragement to those who hear them.
And do not grieve the RUACH Ha'Qadash of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by the way you live. Remember, Ha'Mashyach has identified you as his own, guaranteeing that you will be saved on the day of redemption.
Get rid of all bitterness, rage, anger, harsh words, and slander, as well as all types of evil behavior.
Instead, be kind to each other, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through Ha'Mashyach has forgiven you.
Imitate 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in everything you do, because you are dear children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Live a life filled with love, following the example of Ha'Mashyach. He loved us and offered Himself as a sacrifice for us, a pleasing aroma to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Let there be no sexual immorality, impurity, or greed among you. Such sins have no place among the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Also, there must be no evil talk among you. Do not say things that are foolish or filthy. These are not for you. But you should be giving Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You can be sure that no immoral, impure, or greedy person will inherit the Kingdom of Ha'Mashyach and of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For a greedy person is an idolater, worshiping the things of this world.
Do not be fooled by those who try to excuse these sins, for the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will fall on all who disobey HIM.
Therefore do not be partakers with them.
For once you were full of darkness, but now you have light from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. So live as people of light!
For this light within you produces only what is good and right and true.
Carefully determine what pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Take no part in the worthless deeds of evil and darkness; instead, expose them.
It is shameful even to talk about the things that Unrighteous people do in secret.
But their evil intentions will be exposed when the light shines on them,
For the light makes everything visible. This is why it is said, “Awake, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Ha'Mashyach will give you light.”
So be careful how you live. Do not live like fools, but should live like those who are wise.
Make the most of every opportunity in these evil days.
Do not act thoughtlessly, but understand what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wants you to do.
Do not be drunk with wine, because that will ruin your life. Instead, be filled with the RUACH Ha'Qadash,
Singing Tahalym (psalms) and hymns and spiritual songs among yourselves, and making music to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in your hearts.
And giving Tudah (thanks) Always for all things to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the Name of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
And further, submit to one another out of reverence for Ha'Mashyach.
For wives, this means submit to your husbands as to the Master.
For the husband is the head of his wife as Ha'Mashyach is the head of the Qadash Assemblies. Ha'Mashyach is the Savior of His body, the Qadash Assemblies.
As the Qadash Assemblies submits to Ha'Mashyach, so you wives should submit to your husbands in everything.
For husbands, this means you must love your wives, just as Ha'Mashyach loved the Qadash Assemblies. He gave up His life for her
To make her Qadash and clean, washed by the cleansing of the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
He did this to present her to Himself as a precious Qadash Assembly without a spot or wrinkle or any other blemish. Instead, she will be Qadash and without fault.
In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as they love their own bodies. For a man who loves his wife actually shows love for himself.
No one hates his own body but feeds and cares for it, just as Ha'Mashyach cares for the Qadash assembly.
And we are members of the body of Ha'Mashyach.
As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife, and the two are united into one.”
This is a great mystery, but it is an illustration of the way Ha'Mashyach and the Qadash Assembly are one.
So again I say, each man must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
Children, obey your parents because you belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for this is the right thing to do.
“Honor your father and mother.” This is the first commandment with a promise:
If you honor your father and mother, “things will go well for you, and you will have a long life on the Arath.”
Fathers, do not provoke your children to anger by the way you treat them. Rather, bring them up with the discipline and instruction that comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Bondservants, obey your Arath masters with deep respect. Serve them sincerely as you would serve Ha'Mashyach.
Try to please them all the time, not just when they are watching you. As servants of Ha'Mashyach, do the Will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with all your heart.
Work with enthusiasm, as though you were working for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rather than for people.
Remember that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will reward each one of us for the good we do, whether we are slaves or free.
Masters, treat your servants in the same way. Do not threaten them; remember, you both have the same Master in Shamaym, and there is no partiality with Him.
A final word: Be strong in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and in HIS mighty power.
Put on the whole armor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH so that you will be able to stand firm against all strategies of ha'shatan.

For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual hosts of wickedness in the Shamaym places.
Therefore take up the whole armor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, you will be standing.
Stand therefore, having girded your waist with Truth, and put on the breastplate of righteousness,
On your feet wear the Basurah (Good News) of Shalum to help you stand strong.
Above all, taking the shield of Amunah with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked one.
And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the RUACH, which is the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH;
Pray in the Spirit at all times and on every occasion. Stay alert and be persistent in your prayers for all believers everywhere.
And pray for me, too. Ask 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to give me the right words so I can boldly explain the mysterious plan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that the Basurah (Good News) is for Yahudym and the other nations alike.
I am in chains now, still preaching this message as the ambassador of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. So pray that I will keep on speaking boldly for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as I should.
To bring you up to date, Tychicus will give you a full report about what I am doing and how I am getting along. He is a beloved brother and great helper in the work of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I have sent him to you for this very purpose to let you know how we are doing and to encourage you.
Shalum be with you, dear brothers and sisters, and may ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach give you Ahaba (love) with faithfulness.
May the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be eternally upon all who love our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.

books.name: Philippians
chapters: Greetings from Shaul and Timothy, servants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. To all of you in Philippi who are the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, including your elders and special servants.
Favor and Shalum to you from ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
I Tudah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH every time I remember you.
And I always pray for all of you with joy.
I Tudah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for you have been my partners in spreading the Basurah (Good News) about Ha'Mashyach from the time you first heard it until now.
I am confident of this very thing, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who has begun a good work in you will complete it until the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach;

I know I am right to think like this about all of you because you are so close to my heart. This is because you have all played such an important part in the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to me, during this time that I am in prison, and whenever I am defending and proving the truth of the Basurah (Good News).
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my witness, how greatly I long for you all with the affection of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
This is my prayer for you: that your love will grow more and more; that you will grow in knowledge and understanding with your love;
That you will see the difference between what is important and what is not and choose what is important; that you will be pure and blameless for the coming of Ha'Mashyach;
That your life will be filled with the fruit of righteousness that are produced by Ha'Mashyach to bring Kabad and Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that all that has happened to me has helped to spread the Basurah (Good News).
All the Roman guards and all the others here know that I am in prison for serving Ha'Mashyach.
My being in prison has caused most of the believers to put their trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and to show more courage in telling people the message of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Some people are telling the message about Ha'Mashyach because they are jealous and bitter. Others do it because they want to help.
They are doing it out of love. They know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave me the work of defending the Basurah (Good News).
But those others tell about Ha'Mashyach because of their selfish ambition. Their reason for doing it is wrong. They only do it because they think it will make trouble for me in prison.
But that does not matter. What is important is that they are telling people about Ha'Mashyach, whether they are sincere or not. So I am glad they are doing it. I will continue to be glad,
Because I know that your prayers and the help the Ruach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, will cause this trouble to result in my freedom.

I am full of hope and feel sure I will not have any reason to be ashamed. I am certain I will continue to have the same boldness to speak freely that I always have. I will let 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH use my life to bring more honor to Ha'Mashyach. It does not matter whether I live or die.
To me, the only important thing about living is Ha'Mashyach. And even death would be for my benefit.
If I continue living here on Arath, I will be able to work for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. But what would I choose, is it to live or to die? I do not know.
It would be a hard choice. Sometimes I want to leave this life and be with Ha'Mashyach. That would be much better for me;
However, you people need me here alive.
I am sure of this, so I know that I will stay here and be with you to help you grow and have joy in your Amunah.
And when I come to you again, you will have even more reason to take pride in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach because of what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is doing through me.

Just be sure you live as the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in a way that honors the Good News of Ha'Mashyach. Then if I come and visit you or if I am away from you, I will hear good things about you. I will know that you stand together with the same purpose and that you work together like a team to help others believe the Basurah (Good News).
And you will not be afraid of those who are against you. All of this is proof from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that you are being saved and that your enemies will be lost.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have given you, not only the privilege of trusting in Ha'Mashyach but also the privilege of suffering for Ha'Mashyach.
We are in this struggle together. You have seen my struggle in the past, and you know that I am still in the midst of it.
Is there any encouragement from belonging to Ha'Mashyach? Any comfort from His Ahaba (love)? Any fellowship together in the Ruach? Are your hearts tender and compassionate?
Then make me truly happy by agreeing wholeheartedly with each other, loving one another, and working together with one mind and purpose.
Do not be selfish; do not try to impress others. Be humble, thinking of others as better than yourselves.
Do not look out only for your own interests, but take an interest in others, too.
You must have the same attitude that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach had.
Ha'Mashyach had the nature of 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, but He did not think of Himself equal with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Instead, Ha'Mashyach gave up his divine privileges; He took the humble position of a slave and was born as a man. When He appeared in man's form,
Ha'Mashyach humbled Himself in obedience to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and died a criminal’s death on an execution stake.
Therefore, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH elevated Him to the place of highest honor and gave Him the Name above every other names,
That at the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA every knee must bow, in Shamaym and on Arath and under the Arath,
And every tongue should declare that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach is Master, to the Kabad of ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

My beloved, you always followed my instructions when I was with you, now that I am away, it is even more important, keep on working on your salvation with the fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. Because for you to complete your salvation is more important,
Always remember that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is working in you, giving you the desire and the power to do what pleases HIM.
Do everything without complaining and arguing,
So that no one can criticize you. Live clean innocent lives as children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, shining like bright lights in a world full of crooked and perverse people.
Hold firmly to the Dabar of life; then, on the day that Ha'Mashyach’s return, I will be proud that I did not run the race in vain and that my work was not useless.

But I will rejoice even if I lose my life, pouring it out like a liquid offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, just like your faithful service is an offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And I want all of you to share that joy.
Yes, you should rejoice, and I will share your joy.
If the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is willing, I hope to send Timothy to you soon for a visit. Then he can cheer me up by telling me how you are getting along.
I have no one else like Timothy, who genuinely cares about your welfare.
All the others care only for themselves and not for what matters to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
But you know how Timothy has proved himself. Like a son with his father, he has served with me in preaching the Basurah (Good News).
I hope to send him to you just as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me here.
And I have confidence from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that I myself will come to see you soon.
Meanwhile, I thought I should send Epaphroditus back to you. He is a true brother, co-worker, and fellow soldier. And he was your messenger to help me in my need.
I am sending him because he has been longing to see you, and he was very distressed that you heard he was ill.
And he certainly was ill; in fact, he almost died. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had mercy on him and also on me, so that I would not have one sorrow after another.
So I am all the more anxious to send him back to you, for I know you will be glad to see him, and then I will not be so worried about you.
Welcome him in the Ahaba (love) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and with great joy, and give him the honor that people like him deserve.
For he risked his life for the work of Ha'Mashyach, and he was at the point of death while doing for me what you could not do from far away.
Whatever happens, my dear brothers and sisters, rejoice in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I never get tired of telling you these things, and I do it to safeguard your Amunah.
Watch out for those dogs, those people who do evil, those mutilators who say you must be circumcised to be saved.
For we who worship by the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are the ones who are truly circumcised. We rely on what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach has done for us. We put no confidence in man's effort,
Though I could have confidence in my own effort if anyone could. Indeed, if others have reason for confidence in their own efforts, I have even more!

I was circumcised when I was eight days old. I am a pure blooded citizen of Yashar'AL and a member of the tribe of Banyamin a real Abarym (Hebrew) if there ever was one! I was a member of the Pharisees, who demand the strictest obedience to the Yahudym law.
I was so zealous that I harshly persecuted the Qadash Assemblies. And as for righteousness, I obeyed the law without fault.
I once thought these things were valuable, but now I consider them worthless because of what Ha'Mashyach has done.

Yes, everything else is worthless when compared with the infinite value of knowing 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach my Master. For His sake I have discarded everything else, counting it all as garbage, so that I could gain Ha'Mashyach

And become one with Ha'Mashyach. I no longer count on my own righteousness through obeying the law; rather, I became righteous through Amunah in Ha'Mashyach. For the way of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in making us right with HIMSELF depends on Amunah.
I want to know Ha'Mashyach and experience the mighty power that raised Him from the dead. I want to suffer with Him, sharing in His death,
So that one way or another I will experience the resurrection from the dead!

I do not mean to say that I have already achieved these things or that I have already reached perfection. But I press on to possess that perfection for which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach first possessed me.
No, dear brothers and sisters, I have not achieved it, but I focus on this one thing: Forgetting the past and looking forward to what lies ahead,
I press on to reach the end of the race and receive the Shamaym prize for which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach has called us.
Let all who are mature in the RUACH agree on these things. If you disagree on some point, I believe 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make it plain to you.
But we must hold on to the progress we have already made.
Dear brothers and sisters, pattern your lives after mine, and learn from those who follow our example.
For I have told you often before, and I say it again with tears in my eyes, that there are many whose conduct shows they are really enemies of the execution stake of Ha'Mashyach.
They are headed for destruction. Their mighty one is their appetite, they brag about shameful things, and they think only about this life here on Arath.
But we are citizens of Shamaym, where our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA lives. And we are eagerly waiting for Ha'Mashyach to return as our Savior.
Ha'Mashyach will take our weak mortal bodies and change them into precious bodies like His own, using the same power with which he will bring everything under His control.
Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stay true to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I love you and long to see you, dear friends, for you are my joy and the crown I receive for my work.
Now I appeal to Euodia and Syntyche. Please, because you belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, settle your disagreement.

And I ask you, my true partner, to help these two women, for they worked hard with me in telling others the Basurah (Good News). They worked along with Clement and the rest of my co-workers, whose names are written in the Book of Life.
Always be full of joy in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. I say it again Rejoice!
Let everyone see that you are considerate in all you do. Remember, the Master is coming soon.
Do not worry about anything; instead, pray about everything. Tell 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH what you need, and give Tudah (thanks) to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for all HE has done.
Then you will experience the Shalum of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, which exceeds anything we can understand. The Shalum of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will guard your hearts and minds as you live in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.

And now, dear brothers and sisters, one final thing. Fix your thoughts on what is true, fix your heart on what is honorable, and right, and pure, and lovely, and admirable. Think about things that are excellent and worthy of Yadah.
Keep putting into practice all you learned and received from me, everything you heard from me and saw me doing. Then the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shalum will be with you.
How I Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that you are concerned about me again. I know you have always been concerned for me, but you did not have the chance to help me.
Not that I was ever in need, for I have learned how to be content with whatever I have.
I know how to live on almost nothing or with everything. I have learned the secret of living in every situation, whether it is with a full stomach or empty, with plenty or little.
For I can do everything through Ha'Mashyach, who gives me strength.
Even so, you have done well to share with me in my present difficulty.
As you know, you Philippians were the only ones who gave me financial help when I first brought you the Basurah (Good News) and then traveled on from Macedonia. No other Qadash Assemblies did this.
Even when I was in Thessalonica you sent help more than once.
I do not say this because I want a gift from you. Rather, I want you to receive a reward for your kindness.
At the moment I have all I need and more! I am generously supplied with the gifts you sent me with Epaphroditus. They are a sweet smelling sacrifice that is acceptable and pleasing to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And this same 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who takes care of me will supply all your needs from HIS precious riches, which have been given to us in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Now all Kabad to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever and ever! So It Will Be.
Give my greetings to each of the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, all who belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. The brothers who are with me send you their greetings.
And all the rest of the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH send you greetings too, especially those in the household of Caesar.
May the favor of the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach be with your ruach.

books.name: Colossians
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, chosen by the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to be a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, and from our brother Timothy.
We are writing to the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the city of Colosse, who are faithful Achks (brothers) and Achutys (sisters) in Ha'Mashyach. May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our ABBA give you favor and Shalum.
We always pray for you, and we give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the Father of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
For we have heard of your Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach and your Ahaba (love) for all of the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
Which come from your confident hope of what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has reserved for you in Shamaym. You have had this expectation ever since you first heard the truth of the Basurah (Good News).

This same Basurah that came to you is going out all over the world. It is bearing fruit everywhere by changing lives, just as it changed your lives from the day you first heard and understood the truth about the wonderful favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You learned about the Basurah (Good News) from Epaphras, our beloved co-worker. He is a faithful servant of Ha'Mashyach, and he is helping us on your behalf.
He has told us about the love for others that the Ruach Ha'Qadash has given you.
So we have not stopped praying for you since we first heard about you. We ask 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to give you complete knowledge of His will and to give you the Ruach of wisdom and understanding.
Then the way you live will always honor and please Ha'Mashyach, and your lives will produce every kind of good fruit. All the while, you will grow as you learn to know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH better and better.
We also pray that you will be strengthened with all the marvelous power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH so you will have all the endurance and patience you need. May you be filled with joy,
Always give Tudah to Abba 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has enabled you to share in the inheritance that belongs to His people, who live in the light.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has rescued us from the kingdom of darkness and transferred us into the Kingdom of His dear Son 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach,
who purchased our freedom and forgave our sins.
Ha'Mashyach is the visible image of the invisible 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. For Ha'Mashyach existed before anything was created and Ha'Mashyach is supreme over all creation,

For through Ha'Mashyach, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH created everything in the Shamaym realms and on Arath. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made the things we can see and the things we can not see, such as thrones, kingdoms, rulers, and authorities in the unseen world. Everything was created through Ha'Mashyach and for Him.
Ha'Mashyach existed before anything else, and Ha'Mashyach holds all creation together.

Ha'Mashyach is also the head of the Qadash Assemblies, which is His body. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach is the beginning, and supreme over all who rise from the dead. So Ha'Mashyach is first in everything.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in all HIS fullness was pleased to live in Ha'Mashyach,
And through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH reconciled everything to HIMSELF. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made Shalum with everything in Shamaym and on Arath by means of the blood on the execution stake.
This includes you who were once far away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. You were His enemies, separated from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by your evil thoughts and actions.

Yet now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has reconciled you to HIMSELF through the death of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach in his physical body. As a result 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has brought you into HIS own presence, and you are Qadash and blameless as you stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH without a single fault.

But you must continue to believe this truth and stand firmly in it. Do not drift away from the assurance you received when you heard the Basurah (Good News). The Basurah has been preached all over the world, and I Shaul, have been appointed as the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to proclaim it.
I am glad when I suffer for you in my body, for I am participating in the sufferings of Ha'Mashyach that continue for His body, the Qadash Assemblies.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given me the responsibility of serving HIS Qadash Assemblies by proclaiming HIS entire message to you.
This message was kept secret for centuries and generations past, but now it has been revealed to the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wanted them to know that the riches and Kabad of Ha'Mashyach are for you the other nations too. And this is the secret: that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach lives in you. This gives you assurance of sharing Ha'Mashyach's Kabad.

So we tell others about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, warning everyone and teaching everyone with all the wisdom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us. We want to present them to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, perfect in their relationship to Ha'Mashyach.
That is why I work and struggle so hard, depending on the mighty power of Ha'Mashyach that works within me.
I want you to know how much I have agonized for you and for the Qadash Assembly at Laodicea, and for many other believers who have never met me personally.

I want them to be encouraged and knit together by strong ties of Ahaba (love). I want them to have complete confidence that they understand the mysterious plan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, which is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach himself.
In Ha'Mashyach lie hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
I am telling you this so no one will deceive you with well crafted arguments.
For though I am far away from you, my heart is with you. And I rejoice that you are living as you should live and that your Amunah in Ha'Mashyach is strong.
And now, just as you accepted 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach as your Master, you must continue to follow Him.
Let your roots grow down into Ha'Mashyach, and let your lives be built on Ha'Mashyach. Then your Amunah will grow strong in the truth you were taught, and you will overflow with thankfulness.
Do not let anyone capture you with empty philosophies and deception that come from man's thinking and from the spiritual powers of this world, and not according to Ha'Mashyach.
For in Ha'Mashyach dwells all the fullness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in a man's body.
So you also are complete through your union with Ha'Mashyach, who is the head over every ruler and authority.
When you came to Ha'Mashyach, you were “circumcised,” but not by a physical procedure. Ha'Mashyach performed a spiritual circumcision, the cutting away of your sinful nature.

For you were buried with Ha'Mashyach when you were baptized. And with Ha'Mashyach you were raised to new life because you trusted the mighty power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who raised Ha'Mashyach from the dead.
You were dead because of your sins and because your sinful nature was not yet cut away. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made you alive with Ha'Mashyach, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forgave us all our sins.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach canceled the record of the charges against us and took it away by nailing it to the execution stake.
In this way, Ha'Mashyach disarmed the spiritual rulers and authorities. He shamed them publicly by His victory over them on the execution stake.
So let no one judge you in food or in drink, or regarding a festival or a new moon or shabbats,
For these rules are only shadows of the reality yet to come. And Ha'Mashyach Himself is that reality.
Let no one cheat you of your reward, by taking delight in false humility and worship of Malakym, intruding into those things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
And they are not connected to Ha'Mashyach, the head of the body. For Ha'Mashyach holds the whole body together with its joints and ligaments, and it grows as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH nourishes it.
You have died with Ha'Mashyach, and Ha'Mashyach has set you free from the spiritual powers of this world. So why do you keep on following the rules of the world, such as,
“Do not handle! Do not taste! Do not touch!”?
Such rules are mere man's teachings about things that deteriorate as we use them.
These things have the appearance of wisdom in promoting self-made religion, humility, and harsh treatment of the body, but they have no value against self indulgence of the flesh.
Since you have been raised to new life with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, set your sights on the realities of Shamaym, where Ha'Mashyach sits in the place of honor at the right hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Think about the things of Shamaym, not the things of Arath.
For you died to this life, and your real life is hidden with Ha'Mashyach in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And when Ha'Mashyach, who is your life, is revealed to the whole world, you will share in all His Kabad.

So put to death the sinful, Arath things lurking within you. Have nothing to do with sexual immorality, impurity, lust, and evil desires. Do not covet, for a covetous person is an idolater, worshiping the things of this world.
Because of these sins, the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is coming.
You used to do these things when your life was still part of this world.
But now is the time to get rid of anger, rage, malicious behavior, slander, and dirty language.
Do not lie to each other, for you have stripped off your old sinful nature and all its wicked deeds.
Put on your new nature, and be renewed as you learn to know your Creator and become like HIM.

In this new life, it does not matter if you are a Yahudym or a Non-Yahudym, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbaric, uncivilized, slave, or free. Ha'Mashyach is all that matters, and Ha'Mashyach lives in all of us.
Since 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose you to be the Qadash people HE loves, you must clothe yourselves with tenderhearted mercy, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
Make allowance for the faults of each other, and forgive anyone who offends you. Remember, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forgave you, so you must forgive others.
Above all, clothe yourselves with Ahaba (love), which binds us all together in perfect harmony.
And let the Shalum that comes from Ha'Mashyach rule in your hearts. For as members of one body you are called to live in Shalum. And always be thankful.

Let the message about Ha'Mashyach in all its richness, fill your lives. Teach and counsel each other with all the wisdom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives. Sing Tahalym and hymns and the songs the RUACH to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with the hearts TUDAH.
And whatever you do, whether by speech or action, do everything in the Name of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, and giving Tudah to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting for those who belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Husbands, love your wives and never treat them harshly.
Children, always obey your parents, for this pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Fathers, do not aggravate your children, or they will become discouraged.
Slaves, obey your Arath masters in everything you do. Try to please them all the time, not just when they are watching you. Serve them sincerely because of your reverent fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Work willingly at whatever you do, as though you were working for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rather than for people.
Remember that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give you an inheritance as your reward, and that the MASTER you are serving is Ha'Mashyach.
But if you do what is wrong, you will be paid back for the wrong you have done. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has no favorites.
Masters, be just and fair to your servants. Remember that you also have a MASTER in Shamaym.
Devote yourselves to prayer with an alert mind and a heart full of Tudah.
Pray for us, too, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give us many opportunities to speak about HIS mysterious plan concerning Ha'Mashyach. That is why I am here in chains.
Pray that I will proclaim this message as clearly as I should.
Live wisely among those who are not believers, and make the most of every opportunity.
Let your conversation be awesome and attractive so that you will have the right response for everyone.
Tychicus will give you a full report about how I am getting along. He is a beloved brother and faithful helper who serves with me in the work of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I have sent him to you for this very purpose to let you know how we are doing and to encourage you.
I am also sending Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, one of your own people. He and Tychicus will tell you everything that is happening here.
Aristarchus, who is in prison with me, sends you his greetings, and so does Mark, Barnabas’s cousin. As you were instructed before, welcome Mark if he comes your way.
Yustus also sends his greetings. These are the only Yahudym believers among my co-workers; they are working with me here for the Kingdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And what a comfort they have been!

Epaphras, a member of your own fellowship and a servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, sends you his greetings. He always prays earnestly for you, asking 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to make you strong and perfect, fully confident that you are following the whole will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I can assure you that he prays hard for you and also for the believers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
Luke, the beloved doctor, sends his greetings, and so does Demas.
Please give my greetings to our brothers and sisters at Laodicea, and to Nympha and the Qadash Assembly that meets in her house.
After you have read this letter, pass it on to the Qadash Assembly at Laodicea so they can read it, too. And you should read the letter I wrote to them.
And say to Archippus, “Be sure to carry out the ministry 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave you.”
HERE IS MY GREETING IN MY OWN HANDWRITING—SHAUL. Remember my chains.

books.name: I Thessalonians
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, Silas, and Timothy. We are writing to the Qadash Assembly in Thessalonica, to you who belong to ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH give you Favor and Shalum.
We always give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for all of you and pray for you constantly.
As we pray to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and ABBA about you, we think of your work of Amunah, your loving deeds, and the enduring hope you have because of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
We know, dear brothers and sisters, that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves you and has chosen you to be HIS own people.

For when we brought you the Basurah (Good News), it was not only with words but also with power, for the RUACH Ha'Qadash gave you full assurance that what we said was true. And you know of our concern for you from the way we lived when we were with you.
So you received the message with joy from the RUACH Ha'Qadash in spite of the severe suffering it brought you. In this way, you imitated both us and Ha'Mashyach.
As a result, you have become an example to all the believers in Greece, throughout both Macedonia and Achaia.

And now the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is ringing out from you to people everywhere, even beyond Macedonia and Achaia, for wherever we go we find people telling us about your Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. We do not need to tell them about it,
For they keep talking about the wonderful welcome you gave us and how you turned away from idols to serve the living and true 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.

And they speak of how you are looking forward to the coming of the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from Shamaym, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA whom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH raised from the dead. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the one who has rescued us from the terrors of the coming judgment.
You yourselves know, dear brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not a failure.

You know how badly we had been treated at Philippi just before we came to you and how much we suffered there. Yet our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH gave us the courage to declare HIS Basurah (Good News) to you boldly, in spite of great opposition.
So you can see we were not preaching with any deceit or impure motives or trickery.
For we speak as messengers approved by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to be entrusted with the Basurah (Good News). Our purpose is to please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, not men. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH alone examines the motives of our hearts.
Never once did we try to win you with flattery, as you well know. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is our witness that we were not pretending to be your friends just to get your money!
As for man's praise, we have never sought it from you or anyone else.
As Shaliachs of Ha'Mashyach we certainly had a right to make some demands of you, but instead we were like children among you. Or we were like a mother feeding and caring for her own children.
We loved you so much that we shared with you not only the Basurah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but our own lives, too.
Do you not remember how hard we worked among you? Night and day we toiled to earn a living so that we would not be a burden to any of you as we preached the Basurah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to you.
You yourselves are our witnesses and so is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that we were devout and honest and faultless toward all of you believers.
And you know that we treated each of you as a father treats his own children.
We pleaded with you, encouraged you, and urged you to live your lives in a way that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would consider worthy. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called you to share in His Kingdom and Kabad.

Therefore, we never stop giving Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that when you received HIS message from us, you did not think of our words as mere man's ideas. You accepted what we said as the very Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, which of course it is. And this Dabar continues to work in you who believe.

And then you suffered persecution from your own countrymen. In this way you imitated the believers in the Qadash Assemblies of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in Yahudah who because of their belief in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, suffered from their own people, the Yahudym.
For some of the Yahudym killed the Nabyms, and some even killed the MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA. Now they have persecuted us, too. They fail to please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and they work against all mankind
As they try to keep us from preaching the Basurah of salvation to the other nations. By doing this they continue to pile up their sins. But the anger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has caught up with them at last.
Dear brothers and sisters, after we were separated from you for a little while, though our hearts never left you, we tried very hard to come back because of our intense longing to see you again.
We wanted very much to come to you, and I, Shaul, tried again and again, but ha'shatan prevented us.
After all, what gives us hope and joy, and what will be our proud reward and crown as we stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA our MASTER when He returns? It is you!
Yes, you are our pride and joy.
Finally, when we could stand it no longer, we decided to stay alone in Athens,
And we sent Timothy to visit you. Timothy is our brother and he is a servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in proclaiming the Basurah of Ha'Mashyach. We sent him to strengthen you, to encourage you in your Amunah,
And to keep you from being shaken by the troubles you were going through. But you know that we are destined for such troubles.
Even while we were with you, we warned you that troubles would soon come and they did, as you well know.

That is why, when I could bear it no longer, I sent Timothy to find out whether your Amunah was still strong. I was afraid that the tempter had gotten the best of you and that our work had been useless.

But now Timothy has just returned, bringing us good news about your Amunah and love. Timothy reports to us that you always remember our visit with joy and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
So we have been greatly encouraged in the midst of our troubles and suffering, dear brothers and sisters, because you have remained strong in your Amunah.
It gives us new life to know that you are standing firm in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
How we Tudah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for you! Because of you we have great joy as we enter the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Night and day we pray earnestly for you, asking 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to let us see you again to fill the gaps in your Amunah.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our Abba and our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA bring us to you very soon.
And may 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH make your love for one another and for all men grow and overflow, just as our love for you overflows.

May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as a result, make your hearts strong, blameless, and Qadash as you stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our Abba when our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA comes again with all His Qadash people. So it will be.

Finally, dear brothers and sisters, we urge you in the name of the MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to live in a way that pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as we have taught you. You live this way already, and we encourage you to do so even more.
For you remember what we taught you by the authority of the Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
The will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is for you to be Qadash, so stay away from all sexual sin.
Then each of you will control his own body and live in Qadash and honor
Not in lustful passion like the pagans who do not know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and His ways.
Never harm or cheat a fellow believer in this matter by violating his wife, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH avenges all such sins, as we have solemnly warned you before.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has called us to live righteous lives, not impure lives.
Therefore, anyone who refuses to live by these rules is not disobeying man's teaching but is rejecting 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who gives HIS Ruach Ha'Qadash to you.
But we do not need to write to you about the importance of loving each other, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF has taught you to love one another.
Indeed, you already show your love for all the believers throughout Macedonia. Even so, dear brothers and sisters, we urge you to love them even more.
Make it your goal to live a quiet life, minding your own business and working with your hands, just as we instructed you before.
Then people who are not believers will respect the way you live, and you will not need to depend on others.
And now, dear brothers and sisters, we want you to know what will happen to the believers who have died so you will not grieve like people who have no hope.
For since we believe that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA died and was raised to life again, we also believe that when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA returns, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will bring back with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA the believers who have died.
Our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA told us that when He comes, we who are alive will not go up to meet him ahead of His followers who have already died.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Himself will come down from Shamaym with a commanding shout, with the voice of the leading Malakym, and with the trumpet call of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. The believers who have died will rise from their graves first.
Then, together with them, we who are still alive and remain on the Arath will be caught up in the clouds to meet Ha'Mashyach in the air. Then we will be with Ha'Mashyach forever.
So encourage each other with these words.
Now concerning how and when all this will happen, dear brothers and sisters, we do not really need to write you.
For you know quite well that the day of the MASTER's return will come unexpectedly, like a thief in the night.
When people are saying, “Everything is in Shalum and secure,” then disaster will fall on them as suddenly as a pregnant woman’s labor pains begin. And there will be no escape.
But you are not in the dark about these things, dear brothers and sisters, and you will not be surprised when the day of the MASTER comes like a thief.
For you are all children of the light and of the day; we do not belong to darkness and night.
So be on your guard, not asleep like the others. Stay alert and be clearheaded.
Night is the time when people sleep and drinkers get drunk.
But let us who live in the light be clearheaded, protected by the armor of Amunah and Ahaba (love), and wearing as our helmet the confidence of our salvation.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not destined us to receive wrath, but to obtain salvation through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Ha'Mashyach died for us so that, whether we are asleep or alive, we can live with Him forever when He returns.
So encourage each other and build each other up, just as you are already doing.
Dear brothers and sisters, honor those who are your leaders in the work of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. They work hard among you and give you guidance from the RUACH.
Show them great respect and wholehearted love because of their work. And live in Shalum with each other.
Brothers and sisters, we urge you to warn those who are lazy. Encourage those who are timid. Take tender care of those who are weak. Be patient with everyone.
See that no one pays back evil for evil, but always try to do good to each other and to all people.
Rejoice always,
Pray continually, do not give up,
Give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in all circumstances you find yourself; for this is the Will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for you in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach
Do not quench the RUACH Ha'Qadash in you.
Do not treat prophecies with contempt
But test them all; hold on to what is good,
Reject every kind of evil.
Now may the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shalum make you Qadash in every way, and may your whole ruach and soul and body be kept blameless until our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach comes again.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who chose you can be trusted, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make it happen.
Dear brothers and sisters, pray for us.
Greet all the brothers and sisters with a righteous kiss.
I charge you in the Name of the MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to read this letter to all the brothers and sisters.
May the favor of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach be with you all. So it will be.

books.name: II Thessalonians
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, Silas, and Timothy. We are writing to the Qadash Assembly in Thessalonica, to you who belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our ABBA and the MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our Abba and our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach give you Favor and Shalum.
We are bound to give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH always for you our family, as it is fitting, because your Amunah grows exceedingly, and the Ahaba (love) of every one of you all abounds toward each other,
We proudly tell the other Qadash Assemblies of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH about your endurance and Amunah in all the persecutions and hardships you are suffering.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will use this persecution to show HIS justice and to make you worthy of HIS Kingdom, for which you are suffering.
For the justice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will pay back those who persecute you.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will provide rest for you who are being persecuted and also for us when our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA appears from Shamaym. He will come with His mighty Malakym,
In flaming fire, bringing judgment on those who do not know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and on those who refuse to obey the Basurah (Good News) of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
They will be punished with eternal destruction, forever separated from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and from His marvelous power.
When Ha'Mashyach comes on that day, He will receive Kabad from His Qadash people, and Yadah from all who believe. And this includes you, for you believed what we told you about Ha'Mashyach.

So we keep on praying for you, asking our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH to enable you to live a life worthy of HIS call. May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH give you the power to accomplish all the good things your Amunah prompts you to do.

Then the Name of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA will be honored because of the way you live, and you will be honored along with Ha'Mashyach. This is all made possible because of the favor of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and our MASTER, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Now, dear brothers and sisters, let us clarify some things about the coming of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach and how we will be gathered to meet Him.

Do not be so easily shaken or alarmed by those who say that the day of Ha'Mashyach has already begun. Do not believe them, even if they claim to have had a spiritual vision, a revelation, or a letter supposedly from us.
Do not be fooled by what they say. For that day will not come until there is a great rebellion against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the man of lawlessness is revealed, the one who brings destruction.

The lawless one will exalt himself and defy everything that people call their mighty ones and every object of worship, the lawless one will even sit in the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, claiming that he himself is mighty one.
Do you not remember that I told you about all this when I was with you?
And you know what is holding Ha'Mashyach back, for Ha'Mashyach can only be revealed when His time has come.
For this lawlessness is already at work secretly, and it will remain secret until the one who is holding it back steps out of the way.
Then the man of lawlessness will be revealed, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA will kill the lawless one with the breath of His mouth and destroy him by the brightness of His coming.
This man will come to do the work of ha'shatan with counterfeit power and signs and miracles.
He will use every kind of evil deception to fool those on their way to destruction, because they refuse to Ahaba (love) and accept the Àmát (truth) that would save them.
So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will cause them to be greatly deceived, and they will believe these lies.
Then they will be condemned for enjoying evil rather than believing the truth.

As for us, we can not help but Tudah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for you, dear brothers and sisters loved by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. We always Tudah that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose you to be among the first to experience salvation, a salvation that came through the RUACH who makes you Qadash and through your belief in the Amunah.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called you to salvation when we told you the Basurah (Good News); now you can share in the Kabad of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
With all these things in mind, dear brothers and sisters, stand firm and keep a strong grip on the teaching we passed on to you both in person and by letter.
Now may our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Himself and our ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who loved us and by HIS favor gave us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope,
To encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.
Finally, dear brothers and sisters, we ask you to pray for us. Pray that the the message of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will spread rapidly and be honored wherever it goes, just as when it came to you.
Pray, too, that we will be rescued from wicked and unreasonable evil men, for not everyone is a believer.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is merciful; for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.
And we are confident in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for what you are doing, and you will continue to do the things we instructed you.
May the Ruach Ha'Qadash lead your hearts into a full understanding and expression of the Ahaba (love) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the patient and endurance that comes from Ha'Mashyach.

And now, dear brothers and sisters, we give you this instructions in the Name of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach: Stay away from all believers who live disorderly and do not follow the teachings they received from us.
For you know that you ought to imitate us. We were not disordered when we were with you.
We never accepted food from anyone without paying for it. We worked hard day and night so we would not be a burden to any of you.
We certainly had the right to ask you to feed us, but we wanted to give you an example to follow.
Even while we were with you, we gave you this instructions: “Those unwilling to work will not get to eat.”
Yet we hear that some of you are living disordered lives, refusing to work and meddling in the business of other people.
We gave instructions to such people and urge them in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach to settle down and work to earn their own living.
As for the rest of you, dear brothers and sisters, never get tired of doing good.
And if anyone does not obey our word in this letter. Stay away from them so they will be ashamed.
Do not think of them as enemies, but warn them as you would a brother or sister.
Now may the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shalum HIMSELF give you HIS Shalum at all times and in every situation. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be with you all.
HERE IS MY GREETING IN MY OWN HANDWRITING—SHAUL. I DO THIS IN ALL MY LETTERS TO PROVE THEY ARE FROM ME.
May the favor of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach be with you all. So it will be.

books.name: I Timothy
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, appointed by the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our Savior and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, who gives us hope.
I am writing to Timothy, my true son in the Amunah. May ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our MASTER give you Favor, mercy, and Shalum.
When I left for Macedonia, I urged you to stay there in Ephesus and stop those whose teaching is contrary to the truth.

Do not let them waste their time in endless discussion of myths and spiritual pedigrees. These things only lead to meaningless speculations, which do not help people live a life of Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The purpose of my instruction is that all believers would be filled with love that comes from a pure heart, a clear conscience, and genuine Amunah.
But some people have missed this whole point. They have turned away from these things and spend their time in meaningless discussions.
They want to be known as teachers of the law of Musha, but they do not know what they are talking about, even though they speak so confidently.
We know that the law is good when used correctly.

For the law was not intended for people who do what is right. It is for people who are lawless and rebellious, who are Unrighteous and sinful, who consider nothing sacred and defile what is Qadash, who kill their father or mother or commit other murders.
The law is for people who are sexually immoral, or who practice homosexuality, or are slave traders, liars, promise breakers, or who do anything else that contradicts the wholesome teaching
That comes from the awesome Basurah (Good News) entrusted to me by our baraked 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
I give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our MASTER, who has given me strength to do His work. Ha'Mashyach considered me trustworthy and appointed me to serve Him,
Even though I used to blaspheme the Name of Ha'Mashyach. In my insolence, I persecuted His people. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had mercy on me because I did it in ignorance and unbelief.
The favor of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH was poured out on me abundantly, along with the Amunah and Ahaba (love) that are in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach
This is a trustworthy saying, and everyone should accept it: “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach came into the world to save sinners” and I am the worst of them all.

But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had mercy on me so that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA could use me as a prime example of his great patience with even the worst sinners. Then others will realize that they, too, can believe in Ha'Mashyach and receive eternal life.
All honor and Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever and ever! Ha'Mashyach is the eternal King, and to the unseen ONE who never dies; 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH alone is 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Timothy, my son, here are my instructions for you, based on the prophetic words spoken about you earlier. May they help you fight well in the battles of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Cling to your Amunah in Ha'Mashyach, and keep your conscience clear. For some people have deliberately violated their consciences; as a result, their Amunah has been shipwrecked.
Hymenaeus and Alexander are two examples. I threw them out and handed them over to ha'shatan so they might learn not to blaspheme 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
I urge you, first of all, to pray for all people. Ask 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to help them; intercede on their behalf, and give Tudah for them.
Pray this way for kings and all who are in authority so that we can live in Shalum and quiet lives marked by righteousness and dignity.
This is good and pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our Savior,
Who wants everyone to be saved and to understand the truth.
For there is one 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and one Mediator who can reconcile 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and mankind, the man 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Ha'Mashyach gave His life to purchase freedom for everyone. This is the message 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave to the world at just the right time.
And I have been chosen as a preacher and Shaliach to teach the other nations this message about Amunah and truth. I am not exaggerating, just telling the truth.
In every place of worship, I want men to pray with Qadash hands lifted up to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, free from anger and controversy.

And I want women to be modest in their appearance. They should wear decent and appropriate clothing and not draw attention to themselves by the way they fix their hair or by wearing gold or pearls or expensive clothes.
For women who claim to be devoted to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH should make themselves attractive by the good things they do.
Women should learn quietly and submissively.
And women should not teach men or have authority over men. Let the women listen quietly.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made Adam first, and afterward He made Chaya (Eve).
And it was not Adam who was deceived. It was the woman who was deceived and became disobedient,
But women will be saved through childbearing, assuming they continue to live in Amunah (faith), Ahaba (love), righteousness, and modesty (Self-control).
This is a trustworthy saying: “If someone aspires to be an elder, he desires an honorable position.”

So an elder must be a man whose life is above reproach. He must be faithful to his wife. He must exercise self-control, live wisely, and have a good reputation. He must enjoy having guests in his home, and he must be able to teach.
He must not be a heavy drinker or be violent. He must be gentle, not quarrelsome, and not love money.
He must manage his own family well, having children who respect and obey him.
For if a man cannot manage his own household, how can he take care of the Qadash Assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
An elder must not be a new believer, because he might become proud, and ha'shatan would cause him to fall.
Also, people outside the Qadash Assembly must speak well of him so that he will not be dishonored and fall into the trap of ha'shatan.
In the same way, an official servant in the Qadash Assembly must be well respected and have integrity. They must not be heavy drinkers or dishonest with money.
They must be committed to the mystery of the Amunah now revealed and must live with a clear conscience.
Before they are appointed as official servant, let them be closely examined. If they pass the test, then let them serve as official servant in the Qadash Assembly.
In the same way, their wives must be respected and must not slander others. They must exercise self-control and be faithful in everything they do.
An official servant must be faithful to his wife, and he must manage his children and household well.
Those who do well as official servant will be rewarded with respect from others and will have increased confidence in their Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
I am writing these things to you now, even though I hope to be with you soon,

so that if I am delayed, you will know how people must conduct themselves in the household of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. This is the Qadash Assembly of the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, which is the pillar and foundation of the Truth.

Without question, this is the great mystery of our Amunah: Ha'Mashyach was revealed in a man's body and vindicated by the RUACH. Ha'Mashyach was seen by Malakym and announced to the nations. People believed in Ha'Mashyach throughout the world and Ha'Mashyach was taken to Shamaym in Esteemed Kabad.
Now the RUACH Ha'Qadash tells us clearly that in the latter times some will turn away from the true Amunah; they will follow deceptive spirits and teachings that come from demons.
These people are hypocrites and liars, and their consciences are dead.
They will say it is wrong to be married and wrong to eat certain foods. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH created those foods to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
Since everything 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH created is good, we should not reject any of it but receive it with thanks.
For we know it is made acceptable by the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and prayer.

If you explain these things to the brothers and sisters, Timothy, you will be a worthy servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, one who is nourished by the message of Amunah and the good teaching you have followed.
Do not waste time arguing over Unrighteous ideas and old wives’ tales. Instead, train yourself to be righteous.
“Physical training is good, but training for righteousness is much better, promising benefits in this life and in the life to come.”
This is a trustworthy saying, and everyone should accept it.
This is why we work hard and continue to struggle, for our hope is in the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, who is the Savior of all people and particularly of all believers.
Teach these things and insist that everyone learn them.
Do not let anyone think less of you because you are young. Be an example to all believers in what you say, in the way you live, in your love, your Amunah, and your purity.
Until I get there, focus on reading the Scriptures to the Qadash assembly, encouraging the believers, by teaching them.
