Do not neglect the gift of the RUACH you received through the prophecy spoken over you when the elders of the Qadash Assembly laid their hands on you.
Give your complete attention to these matters. Throw yourself into your tasks so that everyone will see your progress.
Keep a close watch on how you live and on your teaching. Stay true to what is right for the sake of your own salvation and the salvation of those who hear you.
Never speak harshly to an older man, but appeal to him respectfully as you would to your own father. Talk to younger men as you would to your own brothers.
Treat older women as you would your mother, and treat younger women with all purity as you would your own sisters.
Take care of any widow who has no one else to care for her.
But if she has children or grandchildren, their first responsibility is to show righteousness at home and repay their parents by taking care of them. This is something that pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Now a true widow, a woman who is truly alone in this world, has placed her hope in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. She prays night and day, asking 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for His help.
But the widow who lives only for pleasure is dead in the RUACH even while she lives.
Give these instructions to the Qadash Assembly so that no one will be open to criticism.
But those who will not care for their relatives, especially those in their own household, have denied the true Amunah. Such people are worse than unbelievers.
A widow who is put on the list for support must be a woman who is at least sixty years old and was faithful to her husband.

She must be well respected by everyone because of the good she has done. Has she brought up her children well? Has she been kind to strangers and served other believers humbly? Has she helped those who are in trouble? Has she always been ready to do good?
The younger widows should not be on the list, because their physical desires will overpower their devotion to Ha'Mashyach and they will want to remarry.
Then they would be guilty of breaking their previous pledge.
And if they are on the list, they will learn to be lazy and will spend their time gossiping from house to house, meddling in the business of other people and talking about things they should not.
So I advise these younger widows to marry again, have children, and take care of their own homes. Then the enemy will not be able to say anything against them.
For I am afraid that some of them have already gone astray and now follow ha'shatan.

If a woman who is a believer has relatives who are widows, she must take care of them and not put the responsibility on the Qadash Assembly. Then the Qadash Assembly can care for the widows who are truly alone.
Elders who do their work well should be respected and paid well, especially those who work hard at both preaching and teaching.
For the Scripture says, “You must not muzzle an ox to keep it from eating as it treads out the grain.” And in another place, “Those who work deserve their pay!”
Do not listen to an accusation against an elder unless it is confirmed by two or three witnesses.
Those who sin should be reprimanded in front of the whole Qadash Assembly; this will serve as a strong warning to others.
I solemnly command you in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach and the highest Malakym to obey these instructions without taking sides or showing favoritism to anyone.
Never be in a hurry about appointing a Qadash Assembly leader. Do not share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
Do not drink only water. You ought to drink a little wine for the sake of your stomach because you are sick so often.
Remember, the sins of some people are obvious, leading them to certain judgment. But there are others whose sins will not be revealed until later.
In the same way, the good deeds of some people are obvious. And the good deeds done in secret will someday come to light.
All slaves should show full respect for their masters so they will not bring shame on the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH

If the masters are believers, that is no excuse for being disrespectful. Those slaves should work all the harder because their efforts are helping other believers who are well loved. Teach these things, Timothy, and encourage everyone to obey them.
Some people may contradict our teaching, but these are the wholesome teachings of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. These teachings promote a righteous life.

Anyone who teaches something different is arrogant and lacks understanding. Such a person has an unhealthy desire to quibble over the meaning of words. This stirs up arguments ending in jealousy, division, slander, and evil suspicions.
These people always cause trouble. Their minds are corrupt, and they have turned their backs on the truth. To them, a show of righteousness is just a way to become wealthy.
Yet true righteousness with contentment is itself great wealth.
After all, we brought nothing with us when we came into the world, and we cannot take anything with us when we leave the world.
So if we have enough food and clothing, let us be content.
But people who long to be rich fall into temptation and are trapped by many foolish and harmful desires that plunge them into ruin and destruction.
For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. And some people, craving money, have wandered from the true Amunah and pierced themselves with many sorrows.
But you, Timothy, you are a servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH; so run from all these evil things. Pursue righteousness and a righteous life, along with Amunah, Ahaba (love), perseverance, and gentleness.
Fight the good fight for the True Amunah. Hold tightly to the eternal life to which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has called you, which you have declared so well before many witnesses.
And I charge you before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who gives life to all, and before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, who gave a good testimony before Pontius Pilate,
That you obey all the instructions without wavering. Then no one can find fault with you from now until our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach come again.
For, At just the right time Ha'Mashyach will be revealed from Shamaym by the Baraked and only Almighty 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the Ruler of all kings and MASTER of all masters.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH alone can never die, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives in light so brilliant that no man can approach HIM. No man's eye has ever seen 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, nor ever will. All honor and power to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever! So it will be.

Teach those who are rich in this world not to be proud and not to trust in their money, which is so unreliable. Their trust should be in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who richly gives us all we need for our enjoyment.
Tell them to use their money to do good. They should be rich in good works and generous to those in need, always being ready to share with others.
By doing this they will be storing up their treasure as a good foundation for the future so that they may experience true life.
Timothy, guard what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has entrusted to you. Avoid Unrighteous foolish discussions with those who oppose you with their so-called knowledge.
Some people have wandered from the Amunah by following such foolishness. May the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be with you all. So it will be.

books.name: II Timothy
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, chosen by the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to be a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. I have been sent out to tell others about the life 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised through Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
I am writing to Timothy, my dear son.
I give Tudah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH I serve with a clear conscience, just as my ancestors did. Night and day I constantly remember you in my prayers.
I long to see you again, for I remember your tears as we parted. And I will be filled with joy when we are together again.
I remember your genuine Amunah, for you share the Amunah that first filled your grandmother Lois and your mother, Eunice. And I know that same Amunah continues strong in you.
This is why I remind you to fan into flames the gift of the RUACH 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave you when I laid my hands on you.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not given us a RUACH of fear, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave us the RUACH of power and of love and of a sound mind.

So never be ashamed to tell others about our MASTER. And do not be ashamed of me either, even though I am in prison for Ha'Mashyach. With the strength 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave to you, be ready to suffer with me for the sake of the Basurah (Good News).

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saved us and called us to live a Qadash life. HE did this, not because we deserved it, but because that was HIS plan from before the beginning of time, to show us HIS favor through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.

And now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made all of this plain to us by the appearing of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, our Savior. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH broke the power of death and illuminated the way to life and immortality through the Basurah (Good News).
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose me to be a preacher, a Shaliach, and a teacher of this Basurah.

That is why I am suffering here in prison. But I am not ashamed of it, for I know the one in whom I trust, and I am sure that he is able to guard what I have entrusted to him until the day of Ha'Mashyach's return.
Hold on to the pattern of wholesome teaching you learned from me, a pattern shaped by the Amunah and Ahaba (love) that you have in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Through the power of the RUACH Ha'Qadash who lives within us, carefully guard the precious truth that has been entrusted to you.
As you know, everyone from the province of Asia has deserted me, even Phygelus and Hermogenes.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH show special kindness to Onesiphorus and all his family because he often visited and encouraged me, he was never ashamed of me because I was in chains.
When he came to Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH show him special kindness on the day Ha'Mashyach will return. And you know very well how helpful he was in Ephesus.
Timothy, my dear son, be strong through the favor that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave you in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
You have heard me teach things that have been confirmed by many reliable witnesses. Now teach these truths to other trustworthy people who will be able to pass them on to others.
Endure suffering along with me, as a good soldier of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Soldiers do not get tied up in the affairs of civilian life, for then they cannot please the officer who enlisted them.
And athletes cannot win the prize unless they follow the rules.
And hardworking farmers should be the first to enjoy the fruit of their labor.
Think about what I am saying. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will help you understand all these things.
You should always remember that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, a descendant of King Daud, was raised from the dead. This is the Basurah (Good News) I preach.
And because I preach this Basurah, I am suffering and have been chained like a criminal. But the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH cannot be chained.
So I am willing to endure anything if it will bring salvation and eternal Kabad in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to those 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen.
This is a trustworthy saying: If we die with Ha'Mashyach, we will also live with Ha'Mashyach.
If we endure hardship, we will reign with Ha'Mashyach, If we deny Ha'Mashyach, He will deny us.
If we are unfaithful, Ha'Mashyach remains faithful, for He cannot deny who He is.
Remind everyone about these things, and command them in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to stop fighting over words. Such arguments are useless, and they can ruin those who hear them.
Study to show yourself approved unto 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Be a good worker, one who does not need to be ashamed and who correctly explains the Dabar of Truth.
Avoid worthless, foolish talk that only leads to more Unrighteous behavior.
This kind of talk spreads like cancer, as in the case of Hymenaeus and Philetus.
They have left the path of truth, claiming that the resurrection of the dead has already occurred; in this way, they have turned some people away from the Amunah.
But the truth of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH stands firm like a foundation stone with this inscription: “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows HIS own people,” and “All who belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must turn away from evil.”
In a wealthy home some utensils are made of gold and silver, and some are made of wood and clay. The expensive utensils are used for special occasions, and the cheap ones are for everyday use.
If you keep yourself pure, you will be a special utensil for honorable use. Your life will be clean, and you will be ready for the Master to use you for every good work.
Run from anything that stimulates youthful lusts. Instead, pursue righteous living, Amunah, love, and Shalum. Enjoy the companionship of those who call on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with pure hearts.
Again I say, do not get involved in foolish, ignorant arguments that only start fights.
A servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must not quarrel but must be kind to everyone, be able to teach, and be patient with difficult people.
Gently instruct those who oppose the truth. Perhaps 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will change their hearts, and they will learn the truth.
Then they will come to their senses and escape from the the trap of ha'shatan. For they have been held captive by ha'shatan to do whatever he wants.
You should know this, Timothy, that in the last days there will be very difficult times.
For people will love only themselves and their money. They will be boastful and proud, scoffing at 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, disobedient to their parents, and ungrateful. They will consider nothing Qadash.
They will be unloving and unforgiving; they will slander others and have no self-control. They will be cruel and hate what is good.
They will betray their friends, be reckless, be puffed up with pride, and love pleasure rather than 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
They will act religious, but they will reject the power that could make them righteous. Stay away from people like that!
They are the kind who work their way into the homes of people and win the confidence of vulnerable women who are burdened with the guilt of sin and controlled by various desires.
Such women are forever following new teachings, but they are never able to understand the Truth.
These teachers oppose the Truth just as Yannas and Yambras opposed Musha. They have depraved minds and a counterfeit Amunah.
But they will not get away with this for long. Someday everyone will recognize what fools they are, just as with Yannas and Yambras.
But you, Timothy, certainly know what I teach, and how I live, and what my purpose in life is. You know my Amunah, my patience, my love, and my endurance.
You know how much persecution and suffering I have endured. You know all about how I was persecuted in Antiuch, Iconium, and Lystra, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rescued me from all of it.
Yes, and everyone who wants to live a righteous life in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach will suffer persecution.
But evil men and impostors will flourish. They will deceive others and will themselves be deceived.
But you must remain in Amunah to the things you have been taught. You know they are true, for you know you can trust those who taught you.
You have been taught the Qadash Scriptures from childhood, and they have given you the wisdom to receive the salvation that comes by trusting in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
All Scripture is inspired by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and is useful to teach us what is true and to make us realize what is wrong in our lives. It corrects us when we are wrong and teaches us to do what is right.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH uses it to prepare and equip HIS people to do every good work.
I solemnly urge you in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, who will someday judge the living and the dead when He comes to set up His Kingdom:
Preach the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Be prepared, whether the time is favorable or not. Patiently correct, rebuke, and encourage your people with good teaching.

For a time is coming when they will no longer listen to sound and wholesome teaching. They will follow their own desires and will look for teachers who will tell them whatever their itching ears want to hear.
They will reject the truth and chase after made up stories.

But you should keep a clear mind in every situation. Do not be afraid of suffering for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Work at telling others the Basurah (good news), and fully carry out the ministry 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given you.
As for me, my life has already been poured out as an offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. The time of my departure is near.
I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, and I have remained in Amunah.

And now the prize awaits me, the crown of righteousness, which Ha'Mashyach, the righteous Judge, will give me on the day of His return. And the prize is not just for me but for all who eagerly look forward to His appearing.
Timothy, please come as soon as you can.
Demas has deserted me because he loves the things of this life and has gone to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
Only Luke is with me. Bring Mark with you when you come, for he will be helpful to me in my ministry.
I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
When you come, be sure to bring the coat I left with Carpus at Troas. Also bring my books, and especially my papers.
Alexander the coppersmith did me much harm, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge him for what he has done.
Be careful of him, for he fought against everything we said.
The first time I was brought before the judge, no one came with me. Everyone abandoned me. May it not be counted against them.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH stood with me and gave me strength so that I might preach the Basurah (Good News) in its entirety for all the the other nations to hear. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rescued me from certain death.
Yes, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will deliver me from every evil attack and will bring me safely into his Shamaym Kingdom. All Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever and ever! So it will be.
Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and those living in the household of Onesiphorus.
Erastus stayed at Corinth, and I left Trophimus sick at Miletus.
Do your best to get here before winter. Eubulus sends you greetings, and so do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers and sisters.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be with your ruach. And may the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be with all of you.

books.name: Titus
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, a slave of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. I have been sent to proclaim Amunah to those 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has chosen and to teach them to know the truth that shows them how to live righteous lives.
This truth gives them confidence that they have eternal life, which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who does not lie promised them before the world began.
And now at just the right time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has revealed this message, which we announce to everyone. It is by the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our Savior that I have been entrusted with this work for HIM.
I am writing to Titus, my son in the Amunah that we share. May ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our Savior give you favor and Shalum.
I left you on the island of Crete so you could complete our work there and appoint elders in each town as I instructed you.
An elder must live a blameless life. He must be faithful to his wife, and his children must be believers who do not have a reputation for being wild or rebellious.
An elder is a manager of the household of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so he must live a blameless life, he must not be arrogant or quick-tempered; he must not be a heavy drinker, violent, or dishonest with money.
Rather, he must enjoy having guests in his home, and he must love what is good. He must live wisely and be just he must live a devout and disciplined life.
He must have a strong belief in the trustworthy message he was taught; then he will be able to encourage others with wholesome teaching and show those who oppose it where they are wrong.
For there are many rebellious people who engage in useless talk and deceive others. This is especially true of those who insist on circumcision for salvation.
They must be silenced, because they are turning whole families away from the truth by their false teaching. And they do it only for money.
Even one of their own men, a Nabym from Crete, has said about them, “The people of Crete are all liars, cruel animals, and lazy gluttons.”
This is true. So reprimand them sternly to make them strong in the Amunah.
They must stop listening to Yahudym myths and the commands of people who have turned away from the truth.
Everything is pure to those whose hearts are pure. But nothing is pure to those who are corrupt and unbelieving, because their minds and consciences are corrupted.
Such people claim they know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but they deny HIM by the way they live. They are detestable and disobedient, worthless for doing anything good.
As for you, Titus, promote the kind of living that reflects wholesome teaching.
Teach the older men to exercise self-control, to be worthy of respect, and to live wisely. They must have sound Amunah and be filled with love and patience.
Similarly, teach the older women to live in a way that honors 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. They must not slander others or be heavy drinkers. Instead, they should teach others what is good.
These older women must train the younger women to love their husbands and their children,
To live wisely and be pure, to work in their homes, to do good, and to be submissive to their husbands. Then they will not bring shame on the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
In the same way, encourage the young men to live wisely.
And you yourself must be an example to them by doing good works of every kind. Let everything you do reflect the integrity and seriousness of your teaching.
Teach the truth so that your teaching cannot be criticized. Then those who oppose us will be ashamed and have nothing bad to say about us.
Servants must always obey their masters and do their best to please them. They must not talk back
Or steal, but must show themselves to be entirely trustworthy and good. Then they will make the teaching about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our Savior attractive in every way.
For the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has been revealed, bringing salvation to all people.
And we are instructed to turn from Unrighteous living and sinful pleasures. We should live in this evil world with wisdom, righteousness, and devotion to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
While we look forward with hope to that wonderful day when the Kabad of our great 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and Savior, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach will be revealed.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA gave His life to free us from every kind of sin, to cleanse us, and to make us His very own people, totally committed to doing good deeds.
You must teach these things and encourage the believers to do them. You have the authority to correct them when necessary, so do not let anyone disregard what you say.
Remind the believers to submit to the government and its officers. They should be obedient, always ready to do what is good.
They must not slander anyone and must avoid quarreling. Instead, they should be gentle and show true humility to everyone.
Once we, too, were foolish and disobedient. We were misled and became slaves to many lusts and pleasures. Our lives were full of evil and envy, and we hated each other.
But When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our Savior revealed his kindness and love,
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH saved us, not because of the righteous things we had done, but because of His mercy. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH washed away our sins, giving us a new birth and new life through the RUACH Ha'Qadash.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH generously poured out the RUACH upon us through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our Savior.
Because of His favor he declared us righteous and gave us confidence that we will inherit eternal life.

This is a trustworthy saying, and I want you to insist on these teachings so that all who trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will devote themselves to doing good. These teachings are good and beneficial for everyone.
Do not get involved in foolish discussions about the Ruach pedigrees or in quarrels and fights about obedience to Yahudym laws. These things are useless and a waste of time.
If people are causing divisions among you, give a first and second warning. After that, have nothing more to do with them.
For people like that have turned away from the truth, and their own sins condemn them.
I am planning to send either Artemas or Tychicus to you. As soon as one of them arrives, do your best to meet me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to stay there for the winter.
Do everything you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos with their trip. See that they are given everything they need.
Our people must learn to do good by meeting the urgent needs of others; then they will not be unproductive.
Everybody here sends greetings. Please give my greetings to the believers, all who love us. May the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be with you all.

books.name: Philemon
chapters: This letter is from Shaul, a prisoner for preaching the Basurah (Good News) about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, and from our brother Timothy. I am writing to Philemon, our beloved co-worker,
And to our sister Apphia, and to our fellow soldier Archippus, and to the Qadash Assembly that meets in your house.
May ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach give you favor and Shalum.
I always Tudah to my 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH when I pray for you, Philemon,
because I keep hearing about your Amunah in our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and your love for all of the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And I am praying that you will put into action the generosity that comes from your Amunah as you understand and experience all the good things we have in Ha'Mashyach.
Your love has given me much joy and comfort, my brother, for your kindness has often refreshed the hearts of the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
That is why I am boldly asking a favor of you. I could demand it in the Name of Ha'Mashyach because it is the right thing for you to do.
But because of our love, I prefer simply to ask you. Consider this as a request from me Shaul, an old man and now also a prisoner for the sake of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
I appeal to you to show kindness to my child, Onesimus. I became his father in the Amunah while here in prison.
Onesimus has not been of much use to you in the past, but now he is very useful to both of us.
I am sending him back to you, and with him comes my own heart.
I wanted to keep him here with me while I am in these chains for preaching the Basurah (Good News), and he would have helped me on your behalf.
But I did not want to do anything without your consent. I wanted you to help because you were willing, not because you were forced.
It seems you lost Onesimus for a little while so that you could have him back forever.
He is no longer like a slave to you. He is more than a slave, for he is a beloved brother, especially to me. Now he will mean much more to you, both as a man and as a brother in Ha'Mashyach.
So if you consider me your partner, welcome him as you would welcome me.
If he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to me.
I, SHAUL, WRITE THIS WITH MY OWN HAND: I WILL REPAY IT. AND I WILL NOT MENTION THAT YOU OWE ME YOUR VERY SOUL!
Yes, my brother, please do me this favor for the sake of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Give me this encouragement in Ha'Mashyach.
I am confident as I write this letter that you will do what I ask and even more!
One more thing please prepare a guest room for me, for I am hoping that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will answer your prayers and let me return to you soon.
Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, sends you his greetings.
So do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my co-workers.
May the favor of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach be with your ruach.

books.name: Hebrews
chapters: Long ago 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke many times and in many ways to our fathers through the Nabyms.
And now in these final days, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has spoken to us through HIS Son. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH promised everything to the Son as an inheritance, and through the Son 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH created the universe.

The Son shows the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is a perfect copy of the nature of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and He holds everything together by His powerful command. The Son made people clean from their sins. Then He sat down at the right Hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the Great One in Shamaym.
This shows that the Son is far greater than the Malakym, just as the Name 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave Him is greater than their names.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH never said to any Malakym what HE said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA: You are my Son, Today I have become your ABBA. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also said, “I will be His ABBA, and He will be MY Son.”
And when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought HIS supreme Son into the world, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said, “Let all of His Malakym worship the Son.”
Regarding the Malakym, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH says, “HE sends HIS Malakym like the winds, HIS servants like flames of fire.”
But about the Son, however, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said: “Your kingdom will last forever and ever! You rule over your people with justice.
You love righteousness and hate evil. Therefore your 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH has anointed you, pouring out the oil of joy on you more than on anyone else.”
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also says to the Son, “In the beginning you laid the foundation of the Arath and made the Shamaym with your hands.
They will perish, but you remain forever. They will wear out like old clothing.
You will fold them up like a cloak and discard them like old clothing. But you are always the same; you will live forever.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH never said to any of the Malakym, “Sit in the place of honor at my right hand until I humble your enemies, making them a footstool under your feet.”
Therefore, Malakym are only servants ruach sent to care for people who will inherit salvation.
So we must listen very carefully to the truth we have heard, or we may drift away from it.
For the message 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH delivered through Malakym has always stood firm, and every violation of the law and every act of disobedience was punished.
So what makes us think we can escape if we ignore this great salvation that was first announced by our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Himself and then delivered to us by those who heard Him speak?
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH confirmed the message by giving signs and wonders and various miracles and gifts of the RUACH Ha'Qadash whenever HE chose.
And furthermore, it is not Malakym who will control the future world we are talking about.
For in one place the Scriptures say, “What are mere mortals that you should think about them, or a Son of Adam that you should care for him?
Yet you made them only a little lower than the Malakym and crowned them with Kabad and honor.
You gave them authority over all things.” Now when it says “all things,” it means nothing is left out. But we have not yet seen all things put under their authority.

What we do see is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, who was given a position “a little lower than the Malakym”; and because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA suffered death for us, he is now “crowned with Kabad and honor.” Yes, by the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA tasted death for everyone.

The Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for whom and through whom everything was made, chose to bring many children into Kabad. And it was only right that He should make 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA through His suffering, a perfect leader, fit to bring them into their salvation.
So now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and the ones He makes Qadash have the same ABBA. That is why 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is not ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I will proclaim your Name to my brothers and sisters. I will Yadah you among your assembled people.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA also said, “I will put my trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “I and the children 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given me.”

Because the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are men made of flesh and blood, the Son also became flesh and blood. For only as a man He could die, and only by dying He could break the power of ha'shatan, who had the power of death.
Only in this way He could set free all who have lived their lives as slaves to the fear of dying.
We also know that the Son did not come to help Malakym; He came to help the descendants of Abraham.

Therefore, it was necessary for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to be made in every respect like us, His brothers and sisters, so that he could be our merciful and faithful High Kuhan before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA could offer a sacrifice that would take away the sins of the people.
Since 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Himself has gone through suffering and testing, He is able to help us when we are being tested.

And so, dear brothers and sisters who belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and are partners with those called to Shamaym, think carefully about this 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA whom we declare to be the messenger of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and High Kuhan.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was full of Amunah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who appointed Him, just as Musha served faithfully when he was entrusted with the entire house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA deserves far more Kabad than Musha, just as a person who builds a house deserves more praise than the house itself.
For every house has a builder, but the one who built everything is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Musha was certainly full of Amunah in the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as a servant, his work was an illustration of the truths 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would reveal later.
But Ha'Mashyach, as the Son, is in charge of the entire house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And we are the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, if we keep our courage and remain confident in our hope in Ha'Mashyach.
That is why the RUACH Ha'Qadash says, “Today when you hear His voice,
Do not harden your hearts as Yashar'AL did when they rebelled, when they tested me in the wilderness.
There your ancestors tested and tried my patience, even though they saw my miracles for forty years.
So I was angry with them, and I said, ‘Their hearts always turn away from me. They refuse to do what I tell them.’
So in my anger I took an oath: ‘They will never enter my place of rest.’”
Be careful then, dear brothers and sisters. Make sure that your own hearts are not evil and unbelieving, turning you away from the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
You must warn each other every day, while it is still “Today,” so that none of you will be deceived by sin and hardened against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For if we are faithful to the end, trusting 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH just as firmly as when we first believed, we will share in all that belongs to Ha'Mashyach.
Remember what it says: “Today when you hear the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, do not harden your hearts as Yashar'AL did when they rebelled.”
And who was it who rebelled against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, even though they heard the voice of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? Was it not the people Musha led out of Mitzraym?
And who made 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH angry for forty years? Was it not the people who sinned, whose corpses lay in the wilderness?
And to whom was 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH speaking when HE took an oath that they would never enter His rest? Was it not the people who disobeyed HIM?
So we see that because of their unbelief they were not able to enter the rest of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The promise of entering the Shabbat Rest of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH still stands, let us be careful that none of you be found to have fallen short of it.

For this good news that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has prepared this Shabbat rest has been announced to us just as it was to them. But it did them no good because they did not share the Amunah of those who listened to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

For we who have believed enter that rest, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has said, “So I declared on oath in my anger, ‘They shall never enter my rest.’” And yet HIS works have been finished since the creation of the world.
We know it is ready because of the place in the Scriptures where it mentions the seventh day: “On the seventh day 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rested from all HIS work.”
But in the other passage 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said, “They will never enter my place of rest.”
So the Shabbat rest of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is there for people to enter, but those who first heard this good news failed to enter because they disobeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH set another time for entering His Shabbat rest, and that time is TODAY. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH announced this through King Daud much later in the words already quoted: “TODAY when you hear HIS voice, do not harden your hearts.”
Now if Yahusha son of Nun had succeeded in giving them this rest, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would not have spoken about another day of rest still to come.
So there is a Shabbat rest still waiting for the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For all who have entered into the Shabbat rest of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have rested from their own labors, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did after creating the world in six days and Rested on the seventh day.
So let us do our best to enter that rest. But if we disobey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as the people of Yashar'AL did, we will fall.

For the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is living and powerful. The Dabar is sharper than the sharpest two-edged sword, piercing until it divides soul and spirit, joints and marrow, as it judges the thoughts and purposes of the heart.
Nothing in all creation is hidden from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Everything is naked and exposed before the eyes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and HE is the One to whom we are accountable.
So then, since we have a great High Kuhan who has entered Shamaym, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, let us hold firmly to what we believe.
For we do not have a high Kuhan who is unable to empathize with our weaknesses, but we have One who has been tempted in every way, just as we are yet He did not sin.
Let us therefore come boldly to the Throne of FAVOR, that we may obtain mercy and find favor to help us in time of need.
Every high Kuhan is a man chosen to represent other people in their dealings with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, he presents their gifts to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and offers sacrifices for their sins.
And he is able to deal gently with ignorant and wayward people because he himself is subject to the same weaknesses.
That is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins as well as theirs.
And no one can become a high Kuhan simply because he wants such an honor, he must be called by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for this work, just as Aarun was.
That is why Ha'Mashyach did not honor Himself by assuming He could become High Kuhan. No, He was chosen by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your ABBA.”
And in another passage 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, “You are a Kuhan forever in the order of Malchizadak.”

While 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was here on Arath, He offered prayers and pleadings, with a loud cry and tears, to the one who could rescue him from death. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH heard His prayers because of His deep reverence for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Even though 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA was the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He learned obedience from the things He suffered.
In this way, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH qualified Him as a perfect High Kuhan, and He became the source of eternal salvation for all those who obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH designated 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA to be a High Kuhan in the order of Malchizadak.
There is much more we would like to say about this, but it is difficult to explain, especially since you are dull in the Ruach and do not seem to listen.

You have been believers so long now that you ought to be teaching others. Instead, you need someone to teach you again the basic things about the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. You are like babies who need milk and cannot eat solid food.
For someone who lives on milk is still an infant and does not know how to do what is right.
Solid food is for those who are mature, who through training have the skill to recognize the difference between right and wrong.

So let us stop going over the basic teachings about Ha'Mashyach again and again. Let us go on instead and become mature in our understanding. Surely we do not need to start again with the fundamental importance of repenting from evil deeds and placing our Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You do not need further instruction about baptisms, the laying on of hands, the resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.
And so, by the Will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, we will move forward to further understanding.
For it is impossible to bring back to repentance those who were once enlightened, those who have experienced the good things of Shamaym and shared in the Ruach Ha'Qadash,
Who have tasted the goodness of the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the power of the age to come

And who then turn away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. It is impossible to bring such people back to repentance; by rejecting the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they themselves are nailing Ha'Mashyach to the execution stake once again and holding Him up to public shame.
When the ground soaks up the falling rain and bears a good crop for the farmer, it has the Barakah of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But if a field bears thorns and thistles, it is useless. The farmer will soon condemn that field and burn it.
Dear friends, even though we are talking this way, we really do not believe it applies to you. We are confident that you are meant for better things, the things that come with salvation.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not unjust. He will not forget how hard you have worked for HIM and how you have shown your love to HIM by caring for other believers, as you still do.
Our great desire is that you will keep on loving others as long as life lasts, in order to make certain that what you hope for will come true.
Then you will not become spiritually dull and indifferent. Instead, you will follow the example of those who are going to inherit the promises of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because of their Amunah and endurance.
For example, there was the promise of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to Abraham. Since there was no one greater to swear by, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH took an oath in HIS own Name, saying:
“I will certainly Barak you, and I will multiply your descendants beyond number.”
Then Abraham waited patiently, and he received what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had promised.
Now when people take an oath, they call on someone greater than themselves to hold them to it. And without any question that oath is binding.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also bound HIMSELF with an oath, so that those who received the promise could be perfectly sure that he would never change HIS mind.

So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given both His promise and HIS oath. These two things are unchangeable because it is impossible for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to lie. Therefore, we who have taken refuge in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH can have great confidence as we hold to the hope that is before us.
This hope is a strong and trustworthy anchor for our souls. It leads us through the curtain into the inner Qadash place of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA has already gone in there for us. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA has become our eternal High Kuhan in the order of Malchizadak.

This Malchizadak was king of the city of Shalum and also a Kuhan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH AL'ALYUN. When Abraham was returning home after winning a great battle against the kings, Malchizadak met him and baraked him.
Then Abraham took a tenth of all he had captured in battle and gave it to Malchizadak. The name Malchizadak means “king of justice,” and king of Shalum means “king of Shalum.”
Without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, he remains a Kuhan continually.
Consider then how great this Malchizadak was. Even Abraham, the great patriarch of Yashar'AL, recognized this by giving him a tenth of what he had taken in battle.
Now the law of Musha required that the Kuhan, who are descendants of Lauy, must collect a tithe from the rest of the people of Yashar'AL, who are also descendants of Abraham.
But Malchizadak, who was not a descendant of Lauy, collected a tenth from Abraham. And Malchizadak placed a Barakah upon Abraham, the one who had already received the promises of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And without question, the person who has the power to give a Barakah is greater than the one who is Baraked.
The Kuhanym who collect tithes are men who die, so Malchizadak is greater than they are, because we are told that he lives on.
In addition, we might even say that these Lauym, the ones who collect the tithe paid a tithe to Malchizadak when their ancestor Abraham paid a tithe to him.
For although Lauy was not born yet, the seed from which he came was in Abraham’s body when Malchizadak collected the tithe from Abraham.

So if the Kuhanhood of Lauy, on which the law was based, could have achieved the perfection 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH intended, why did 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH need to establish a different Kuhanhood, with a Kuhan in the order of Malchizadak instead of the order of Lauy and Aarun?
And if the Kuhanhood is changed, the law must also be changed to permit it.
For the Kuhan we are talking about belongs to a different tribe, whose members have never served at the altar as Kuhanym.
What I mean is, our MASTER came from the tribe of Yahudah, and Musha never mentioned Kuhanym coming from that tribe.
This change has been made very clear since a different Kuhan, who is like Malchizadak, has appeared.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA became a Kuhan, not by meeting the physical requirement of belonging to the tribe of Lauy, but by the power of a life that cannot be destroyed.
And the Tahalym pointed this out when he prophesied, “You are a Kuhan forever in the order of Malchizadak.”
Yes, the old requirement about the Kuhanhood was set aside because it was weak and useless.
For the Turah never made anything perfect. But now we have confidence in a better hope, through which we draw near to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This new system was established with a solemn oath. Aarun’s descendants became Kuhanym without such an oath,
but there was an oath regarding 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to Him, “I have taken an oath and will not break the vow: ‘You are a Kuhan forever.’”
Because of this oath, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is the one who guarantees this better covenant with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
There were many Kuhanym under the old system, for death prevented them from remaining in office.
But because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA lives forever, His Kuhanhood lasts forever.
Therefore 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is able, once and forever, to save those who come to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through Him. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA lives forever to intercede with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on their behalf.
Ha'Mashyach is the kind of high Kuhan we need because He is Qadash and blameless, unstained by sin. He has been set apart from sinners and has been given the highest place of honor in Shamaym.

Unlike those other high Kuhanym, Ha'Mashyach does not need to offer sacrifices every day. They did this for their own sins first and then for the sins of the people. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA did this once for all when he offered Himself as the sacrifice for the sins of everyone.
The law appointed high Kuhanym who were limited by man's weakness. But after the law was given, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH appointed HIS Son with an oath, and HIS Son has been made the perfect High Kuhan forever.
Here is the main point: We have a High Kuhan who sat down in the place of honor beside the throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in Shamaym.
There 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA ministers in the Shamaym Tabernacle, the true place of worship that was built by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and not by man's hands.
And since every high Kuhan is required to offer gifts and sacrifices, our High Kuhan must make an offering, too.
If he were here on Arath, he would not even be a Kuhan, since there already are Kuhanym who offer the gifts required by the law.

They serve in a system of worship that is only a copy, a shadow of the real one in Shamaym. For when Musha was getting ready to build the Tabernacle, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave him this warning: “Be sure that you make everything according to the pattern I have shown you here on the mountain.”

But now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, our High Kuhan, has been given a ministry that is far superior to the old Kuhanhood, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is the one who mediates for us a far better covenant with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, based on better promises.
If the first covenant had been faultless, there would have been no need for a second covenant to replace it.
But when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH found fault with the people, he said: “The day is coming, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Yashar'AL and Yahudah.

This covenant will not be like the one I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and led them out of the land of Mitzraym. They did not remain faithful to my covenant, so I turned my back on them, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

But this is the Renewed covenant I will make with the people of Yashar'AL on that day, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: I will put my laws in their minds, and I will write them on their hearts. I will be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and they will be my people.

And they will not need to teach their neighbors, nor will they need to teach their relatives, saying, ‘You should know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.’ For everyone, from the least to the greatest, will know me already.
And I will forgive their wickedness, and I will never again remember their sins.”
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH speaks of a “Renewed” covenant, it means He has made the first one obsolete. It is now out of date and will soon disappear.
That first covenant between 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and Yashar'AL had regulations for worship and a place of worship here on Arath.
There was two rooms in that Tabernacle. In the first room were a lampstand, a table, and sacred loaves of bread on the table. This room was called the Qadash Place.
Then there was a curtain, and behind the curtain was the second room called the Most Qadash Place.

In that room were a gold incense altar and a wooden chest called the Ark of the Covenant, which was covered with gold on all sides. Inside the Ark were a gold jar containing manna, Aarun’s staff that sprouted leaves, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
Above the Ark were the charubim of divine Kabad, whose wings stretched out over the Ark’s cover, the place of atonement. But we cannot explain these things in detail now.
When these things were all in place, the Kuhanym regularly entered the first room as they performed their religious duties.
But only the high Kuhan ever entered the Most Qadash Place, and only once a year. And he always offered blood for his own sins and for the sins the people had committed in ignorance.
By these regulations the Ruach Ha'Qadash revealed that the entrance to the Most Qadash Place was not freely open as long as the Tabernacle and the system it represented were still in use.
This is an illustration pointing to the present time. For the gifts and sacrifices that the Kuhanym offer are not able to cleanse the consciences of the people who bring them.
For that old system deals only with food and drink and various cleansing ceremonies, physical regulations that were in effect only until a better system could be established.

So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA has now become the High Kuhan over all the good things that have come. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA has entered that greater, more perfect Tabernacle in Shamaym, which was not made by man's hands and is not part of this created world.
With 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA‘s own blood, not the blood of goats and calves, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA entered the Most Qadash Place once for all time and secured our redemption forever.
Under the old system, the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer could cleanse people’s bodies from ceremonial impurity.

Just think how much more the blood of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA will purify our consciences from sinful deeds so that we can worship the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. For by the power of the eternal RUACH, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA offered Himself to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as a perfect sacrifice for our sins.

That is why 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is the one who mediates the Renewed covenant between 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and men, so that all who are called can receive the eternal inheritance 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised them. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA died to set them free from the penalty of the sins they had committed under that first covenant.
Now when someone leaves a will, it is necessary to prove that the person who made it is dead.
The will goes into effect only after the person is dead. While the person who made it is still alive, the will cannot be put into effect.
That is why even the first covenant was put into effect with the blood of an animal.

For after Musha had read each of the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to all the people, Musha took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, and sprinkled both the book of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s law and all the people, using hyssop branches and scarlet wool.
Then Musha said, “This blood confirms the covenant 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made with you.”
And in the same way, he sprinkled blood on the Tabernacle and on everything used for worship.
In fact, according to the law of Musha, nearly everything was purified with blood. For without the shedding of blood, there is no forgiveness.

That is why the Tabernacle and everything in it, which were copies of things in Shamaym, had to be purified by the blood of animals. But the real things in Shamaym had to be purified with far better sacrifices than the blood of animals.

For Ha'Mashyach did not enter into a Qadash place made with man's hands, which was only a copy of the true one in Shamaym. He entered into Shamaym itself to appear now before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on our behalf.
And Ha'Mashyach did not enter Shamaym to offer himself again and again, like the high Kuhan here on Arath who enters the Most Qadash Place year after year with the blood of an animal.

If that had been necessary, Ha'Mashyach would have had to die again and again, ever since the world began. But now, once for all time, Ha'Mashyach has appeared at the end of the age to remove sin by His own death as a sacrifice.
And just as each person is destined to die once and after that comes judgment,

So also Ha'Mashyach was offered once for all time as a sacrifice to take away the sins of many people. Ha'Mashyach will come again, not to deal with our sins, but to bring salvation to all who are eagerly waiting for Him.

The old system under the law of Musha was only a shadow, a dim preview of the good things to come, not the good things themselves. The sacrifices under that system were repeated again and again, year after year, but they were never able to provide perfect cleansing for those who came to worship.
If they could have provided perfect cleansing, the sacrifices would have stopped, for the worshipers would have been purified once for all time, and their feelings of guilt would have disappeared.
But instead, those sacrifices actually reminded them of their sins year after year.
For it is not possible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.
That is why, when Ha'Mashyach came into the world, He said to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, “You did not want animal sacrifices or sin offerings. But you have given me a body to offer.
You were not pleased with burnt offerings or other offerings for sin.
Then I said, ‘Look, I have come to do your will, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, as is written about Me in the Scriptures.’”

First, Ha'Mashyach said, “You did not want animal sacrifices or sin offerings or burnt offerings or other offerings for sin, nor were you pleased with them” (though they are required by the law of Musha).
Then He said, “Look, I have come to do your Will.” Ha'Mashyach cancels the first covenant in order to put the second covenant into effect.
For the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was for us to be made Qadash by the sacrifice of the body of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, once for all time.
Under the old covenant, the Kuhan stands and ministers before the altar day after day, offering the same sacrifices again and again, which can never take away sins.
But our High Kuhan offered Himself to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH as a single sacrifice for sins, good for all time. Then He sat down in the place of honor at the right hand of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
There Ha'Mashyach waits until His enemies are humbled and made a footstool under His feet.
For by that one offering Ha'Mashyach forever made perfect those who are being made Qadash.
And the Ruach Ha'Qadash also testifies that this is so. For He says,
“This is the Renewed covenant I will make with my people on that day, says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: I will put my laws in their hearts, and I will write them on their minds.”
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar, “I will never again remember their sins and lawless deeds.”
And when sins have been forgiven, there is no need to offer any more sacrifices.
And so, dear brothers and sisters, we can boldly enter Shamaym’s Most Qadash Place because of the blood of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
By His death, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA opened a new and life-giving way through the curtain into the Most Qadash Place.
And since we have a great High Kuhan who rules over the house of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,

let us go right into the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with sincere hearts fully trusting HIM. For our guilty consciences have been sprinkled with the blood of Ha'Mashyach to make us clean, and our bodies have been washed with pure water.
Let us hold tightly without wavering to the hope we affirm, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH can be trusted to keep HIS promise.
Let us think of ways to motivate one another to acts of love and good works.
And let us not neglect our meeting together, as some people do, but encourage one another, especially now that the day of Ha'Mashyach return is drawing near.
Dear friends, if we deliberately continue sinning after we have received knowledge of the Truth, there is no longer any sacrifice that will cover these sins.
There is only the terrible expectation of the judgment of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the raging fire that will consume HIS enemies.
For anyone who refused to obey the law of Musha was put to death without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

Just think how much worse the punishment will be for those who have trampled on the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and have treated the blood of the covenant, which made us Qadash, as if it were common and unqadash, and have insulted and disdained the Ruach Ha'Qadash who brings the mercy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to us.
For we know the one who said, “I will take revenge. I will pay them back.” He also said, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge HIS own people.”
It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
Think back on those early days when you first learned about Ha'Mashyach. Remember how you remained in Amunah even though it meant terrible suffering.
Sometimes you were exposed to public ridicule and were beaten, and sometimes you helped others who were suffering the same things.
You suffered along with those who were thrown into jail, and when all you owned was taken from you, you accepted it with joy. You knew there were better things waiting for you that will last forever.
So do not throw away this confidence and trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Remember the great reward it brings you!
Patience and endurance is what you need now, so that you will continue to do the Will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Then you will receive all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised.
“For just a little while, and Ha'Mashyach who is coming will come and will not delay.
The Scripture said my righteous ones will live by Amunah. But I will take no pleasure in the one who turns away.”
But we are not like those who turn away from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to their own destruction. We are the ones with Amunah, whose souls will be saved.
Amunah is the sure confidence of what we hope for and Amunah gives us proof of what we cannot see (the evidence of things not seen).
Through their Amunah, the people in the days of old earned a good reputation.
By Amunah we understand that the entire universe was formed at the command of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that what we now see did not come from anything that can be seen.

It was by Amunah that Ábál brought a more acceptable offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH than Cain did. Abál’s offering gave evidence that he was a righteous man, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed HIS approval of Ábál's gifts. Although Ábál is long dead, Ábál still speaks to us by his example of Amunah.

It was by Amunah that Chanuk was taken up to Shamaym without dying “Chanuk disappeared, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH took him.” For before he was taken up, Chanuk was known as a person who pleased 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And it is impossible to please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH without Amunah. Anyone who wants to come to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must believe that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH exists and that HE rewards those who sincerely seek HIM.

It was by Amunah that Nuah built a large boat to save his family from the flood. Nuah obeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who warned him about things that had never happened before. By his Amunah Nuah condemned the rest of the world, and he received the righteousness that comes by Amunah.

It was by Amunah that Abraham obeyed when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called him to leave home and go to another land that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would give him as his inheritance. Abraham went without knowing where he was going.
And even when he reached the land 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH promised him, Abraham lived there by Amunah for he was like a foreigner, living in tents. And so did Yachaq and Ya'aqub, who inherited the same promise.
Abraham was confidently looking forward to a city with eternal foundations, a city designed and built by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
It was by Amunah that even Sharah was able to have a child, though she was barren and was too old. She believed that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH would keep HIS promise.
And so a whole nation came from this one man who was as good as dead, a nation with so many people that, like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore, there is no way to count them.

All these people died still believing what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had promised them. They did not receive what was promised, but they saw it all from a distance and welcomed it. They agreed that they were foreigners and nomads here on Arath.
Obviously people who say such things are looking forward to a country they can call their own.
If they had longed for the country they came from, they could have gone back.
But they were looking for a better place, a Shamaym homeland. That is why 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not ashamed to be called their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has prepared a city for them.
It was by Amunah that Abraham offered Yachaq as a sacrifice when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was testing him. Abraham, who had received the promises from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, was ready to sacrifice his only son, Yachaq,
Even though 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had told him, “Yachaq is the son through whom your descendants will be counted.”
Abraham reasoned that if Yachaq died, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was able to bring him back to life again. And in a sense, Abraham did receive his son back from the dead.
It was by Amunah that Yachaq promised Barakah for the future to his sons, Ya'aqub and Àsau.
It was by Amunah that Ya'aqub, when he was old and dying, baraked each of the sons of Ya'asaf and bowed in worship as he leaned on his staff.
It was by Amunah that Ya'asaf, when he was about to die, said confidently that the people of Yashar'AL would leave Mitzraym. Ya'asaf even commanded them to take his bones with them when they left.
It was by Amunah that Musha’s parents hid him for three months when he was born. They saw that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had given them an unusual child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king’s command.
It was by Amunah that Musha, when he grew up, refused to be called the son of Pharuh’s daughter.
Musha chose to share the oppression of the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH instead of enjoying the fleeting pleasures of sin.
Musha thought it was better to suffer for the sake of Ha'Mashyach than to own the treasures of Mitzraym, for Musha was looking ahead to his great reward.
It was by Amunah that Musha left the land of Mitzraym, not fearing the king’s anger, he kept right on going because he kept his eyes on the one who is invisible.
It was by Amunah that Musha commanded the people of Yashar'AL to keep the Passakh and to sprinkle blood on the doorposts so that the Malak of death would not kill their firstborn sons.
It was by Amunah that the people of Yashar'AL went right through the Red Sea as though they were on dry ground. But when the Mitzraym tried to follow, they were all drowned.
It was by Amunah that the people of Yashar'AL marched around Yarichu for seven days, and the walls came crashing down.
It was by Amunah that Rahab the prostitute was not destroyed with the people in her city who refused to obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For she had given a friendly welcome to the spies.
How much more do I need to say? It would take too long to recount the stories of the Amunah of Gidaun, Barak, Samsun, Yaphthah, Daud, Shamual, and all the Nabyms.
By Amunah these people overthrew kingdoms, ruled with justice, and received what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had promised them. They shut the mouths of lions,
Quenched the flames of fire, and escaped death by the edge of the sword. Their weakness was turned to strength. They became strong in battle and put whole armies to flight.

Women received their loved ones back again from death. But others were tortured, refusing to turn from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in order to be set free. They placed their hope in a better life after the resurrection.
Some were shout at, and their backs were cut open with whips. Others were chained in prisons.
Some died by stoning, some were sawed in half, and others were killed with the sword. Some went about wearing skins of sheep and goats, destitute and oppressed and mistreated.
They were too good for this world, wandering over deserts and mountains, hiding in caves and holes in the ground.
All these people earned a good reputation because of their Amunah, yet none of them received all that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had promised.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had something better in mind for us, so that they would not reach perfection without us.

Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a huge crowd of witnesses to the life of Amunah, let us strip off every weight that slows us down, especially the sin that so easily trips us up. And let us run with endurance the race 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has set before us.

We do this by keeping our eyes on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, the champion who initiates and perfects our Amunah. Because of the joy awaiting 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, He endured the execution stake, disregarding its shame. Now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is seated in the place of honor beside the throne 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Think of all the hostility he endured from sinful people; then you will not become weary and give up.
After all, you have not yet given your lives in your struggle against sin.
And have you forgotten the encouraging words 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Dabar to you as HIS children? HE said, “My child, do not make light of the discipline of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and do not give up when HE corrects you.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH disciplines those HE loves, and HE punishes each one HE accepts as HIS child.”
As you endure this divine discipline, remember that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is treating you as HIS own children. Who ever heard of a child who is never disciplined by its father?
If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not discipline you as HE does all of HIS children, it means that you are illegitimate and you are not really HIS children at all.
Since we respected our earthly fathers who disciplined us, should we not submit even more to the discipline of the ABBA of our ruachs, and live forever?
For our earthly fathers disciplined us for a few years, doing the best they knew how. But the discipline of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is always good for us, so that we might share in his righteousness.
No discipline is enjoyable while it is happening, it is painful! But afterward there will be a harvest of Shalum in living right for those who are trained in this way.
So take a new grip with your tired hands and strengthen your weak knees.
Mark out a straight path for your feet so that those who are weak and lame will not fall but become strong.
Work at living in Shalum with everyone, and work at living a Qadash life, for those who are not Qadash will not see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Look after each other so that none of you fails to receive the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Watch out that no poisonous root of bitterness grows up to trouble you, corrupting many.
Make sure that no one is immoral or Unrighteous like Àsau, who traded his birthright as the firstborn son for a single meal.
You know that afterward, when he wanted his father’s Barakah, he was rejected. It was too late for repentance, even though he begged with bitter tears.
You have not come to a physical mountain, to a place of flaming fire, darkness, gloom, and whirlwind, as the Yasharalym did at Mount Sinai.
For they heard an awesome trumpet blast and a voice so terrible that they begged 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to stop speaking.
They staggered back under the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: “If even an animal touches the mountain, it must be stoned to death.”
Musha himself was so frightened at the sight that he said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
No, you have come to Mount Ziun, to the city of the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the Shamaym Yahushalam, and to countless thousands of Malakym in a joyful gathering.

You have come to the assembly of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s firstborn children, whose names are written in Shamaym. You have come to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF, who is the judge over all things. You have come to the Ruach of the righteous ones in Shamaym who have now been made perfect.

You have come to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, the one who mediates the renewed covenant between 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and mankind, and to the sprinkled blood, which speaks of forgiveness instead of crying out for vengeance like the blood of Ábál.

Be careful that you do not refuse to listen to the One who is speaking. For if the people of Yashar'AL did not escape when they refused to listen to Musha, the Arath messenger, we will certainly not escape if we reject the One who speaks to us from Shamaym!
When 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH spoke from Mount Sinai HIS voice shook the Arath, but now 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH makes another promise: “Once again I will shake not only the Arath but the Shamaym also.”
This means that all of creation will be shaken and removed, so that only unshakable things will remain.
Since we are receiving a Kingdom that is unshakable, let us be thankful and please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by worshiping 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with Qadash fear and awe.
For our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH is a devouring Fire.
Keep on loving each other as brothers and sisters.
Do not forget to show hospitality to strangers, for some who have done this have entertained Malakym without realizing it!
Remember those in prison, as if you were there yourself. Remember also those being mistreated, as if you felt their pain in your own bodies.
Give honor to marriage, and remain in Amunah to one another in marriage. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will surely judge people who are immoral and those who commit adultery.
Let your conduct in life be without covetousness; be content with what you have. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF has said, “I will never leave you nor forsake you.”
So we may boldly say: 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is my helper; I will not fear. What any man can do to me?”
Remember your leaders who taught you the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Think of all the good that has come from their lives, and follow the example of their Amunah.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
So do not be attracted by strange, new ideas. Your strength comes from the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, not from rules about food, which do not help those who follow them.
We have an altar from which the Kuhanym in the Tabernacle have no right to eat.
Under the old system, the high Kuhan brought the blood of animals into the Qadash Place as a sacrifice for sin, and the bodies of the animals were burned outside the camp.
So also 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA suffered and died outside the city gates to make His people Qadash by means of his own blood.
So let us go out to Him, outside the camp, and bear the dishonor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA bore.
For this world is not our permanent home; we are looking forward to a home yet to come.
Therefore, let us offer through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA a continual sacrifice of Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, proclaiming our allegiance to HIS name.
And do not forget to do good and to share with those in need. These are the sacrifices that please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Obey your leaders in the RUACH, and do what they say. Their work is to watch over your souls, and they are accountable to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Give them reason to do this with joy and not with sorrow. That would certainly not be for your benefit.
Pray for us, for our conscience is clear and we want to live honorably in everything we do.
And especially pray that I will be able to come back to you soon.
Now may the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shalum who brought up from the dead our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, the great Shepherd of the sheep, and ratified an eternal covenant with His blood

May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH equip you with all you need for doing His will. May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH produce in you, through the power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, every good thing that is pleasing to HIM. All Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever and ever! So it will be.
I urge you, dear brothers and sisters, to pay attention to what I have written in this brief exhortation.
I want you to know that our brother Timothy has been released from jail. If he comes here soon, I will bring him with me to see you.
Greet all your leaders and all the believers there. The believers from Italy send you their greetings.
May the favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be with you all. So it will be.

books.name: James
chapters: This letter is from Ya'aqub, a servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and of the MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. I am writing to the “twelve tribes” of Yashar'AL's believers scattered abroad. Greetings!
Dear brothers and sisters, when troubles of any kind come your way, consider it an opportunity for great joy.
For you know that when your Amunah is tested, your endurance has a chance to grow.
So let it grow, for when your endurance is fully developed, you will be perfect and complete, needing nothing.
If you need wisdom, ask our generous 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and HE will give it to you. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will not rebuke you for asking.

But when you ask 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, be sure that your Amunah is only on 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with no doubting, for a man with divided loyalty is as unsettled as a wave of the sea that is blown and tossed by the wind.
Such people should not expect to receive anything from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Their loyalty is divided between 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the activities of this world, for they are unstable in everything they do.
Believers who are poor have something to boast about, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has honored them.
And those who are rich should boast that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has humbled them. They will fade away like a little flower in the field.
The hot sun rises and the grass withers; the little flower droops and falls, and its beauty fades away. In the same way, the rich will fade away with all of their achievements.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH only gives Barakah to those who patiently endure testing and temptation. Afterward they will receive the crown of life that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised to those who love HIM.
And remember, when you are being tempted, do not say, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is tempting me.” for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH can never be tempted by evil, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH never tempts anyone else.
Temptation comes from our own desires, which entice us and drag us away.
These desires give birth to sinful actions. And when sin is allowed to grow, it gives birth to death.
So do not be misled, my dear brothers and sisters.
Whatever is good and perfect is a gift coming down to us from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our ABBA, who created all the lights in the Shamaym. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH never changes or casts a shifting shadow.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose to give birth to us by giving us HIS true Dabar. And we, out of all creation, became the prized possession of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Understand this, my dear brothers and sisters: You must all be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to get angry.
Man's anger does not produce the righteousness 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH desires.
So get rid of all the filth and evil in your lives, and humbly accept the Dabar 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has planted in your hearts, for it has the power to save your souls.
But do not just listen to the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. You must do what the Dabar says. Otherwise you are only fooling yourselves.
For if you listen to the Dabar and do not obey, it is like glancing at your face in a mirror.
You see yourself, walk away, and forget what you look like.
But if you look carefully into the perfect law that sets you free, and if you do what it says and do not forget what you heard, then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will Barak you for doing it.
If you claim to be religious but do not control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is worthless.
Religion that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our ABBA accepts as pure and faultless is this: to look after orphans and widows in their distress and to keep oneself from being polluted by the world.
My dear brothers and sisters, how can you claim to have Amunah in our Esteemed MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach if you favor some people over others?
For example, suppose someone comes into your assembly dressed in fancy clothes and expensive jewelry, and another comes in who is poor and dressed in dirty clothes.
If you give special attention and a good seat to the rich person, but you say to the poor one, “You can stand over there, or else sit on the floor” at my feet,
Then you are guilty of creating distinctions among yourselves and of making judgments based on evil motives.

Listen to me, dear brothers and sisters, has 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH not chosen the poor in this world to be rich in Amunah? Are they not the ones who will inherit the Kingdom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH promised to those who love HIM?
But you dishonor the poor! Is it not the rich who oppress you and drag you into court?
Are they not the ones who slander 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, whose noble Name you bear?
Yes indeed, it is good when you obey the royal law as found in the Scriptures: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
But if you favor some people over others, you are committing a sin. You are guilty of breaking the law.
For the man who keeps all of the laws except one is as guilty as a person who has broken all of the laws of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For the same 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who said, “You must not commit adultery,” also said, “You must not murder.” So if you murder someone but do not commit adultery, you have still broken the law.
So whatever you say or whatever you do, remember that you will be judged by the law that sets you free.
There will be no mercy for those who have not shown mercy to others. But if you have been merciful, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be merciful when he judges you.
What good is it, dear brothers and sisters, if you say you have Amunah but do not show it by your actions? Can that kind of Amunah save anyone?
Suppose you see a brother or sister who has no food or clothing,
And you say, “Good bye and have a good day; stay warm and eat well” but then you did not give that person any food or clothing. What good does that do?
So you see, Amunah by itself is not enough. Unless it produces good deeds, it is dead and useless.
Now someone may argue, “Some people have Amunah; others have good deeds.” But I say, “How can you show me your Amunah if you do not have good deeds? I will show you my Amunah by my good deeds.”
You say you have Amunah, for you believe that there is one 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. Good for you! Even the demons believe this, and they tremble in terror.
How foolish! Can you not see that Amunah without good deeds is useless?
Do you not remember that our ancestor Abraham was shown to be right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by his actions when he offered his son Yachaq on the altar?
You see, the Amunah of Abraham and his actions worked together. His actions made his Amunah complete.
And so it happened just as the Scriptures say: “Abraham believed
So you see, we are shown to be right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by what we do, not by Amunah alone.
Rahab the prostitute is another example. She was shown to be right with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by her actions when she hid those messengers and sent them safely away by a different road.
Just as the body is dead without the ruach and breath, so also Amunah is dead without putting it to work.
Dear brothers and sisters, not many of you should become teachers in the Qadash Assembly, for we who teach will be judged more strictly.
Indeed, we all make many mistakes. For if we could control our tongues, we would be perfect and could also control ourselves in every other way.
We can make a large horse go wherever we want by means of a small bit in its mouth.
