And a small rudder makes a huge ship turn wherever the pilot chooses to go, even though the winds are strong.
In the same way, the tongue is a small member of the body that makes grand speeches. But a tiny spark can set a great forest on fire.

The tongue is like a fire. It is a world of evil among the parts of our body. It spreads its evil through our whole body and starts a fire that influences all of life. It gets this fire from eternal furnace of fire.
People can tame all kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and fish,
But no one can tame the tongue. It is restless and evil, full of deadly poison.
Sometimes you use it to Yadah ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and other times it curses those who have been made in the image of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And so Barakah and cursing come pouring out of the same mouth. Surely, my brothers and sisters, this is not right!
Does a spring of water bubble out with both fresh water and bitter water?
Does a fig tree produce olives, or a grapevine produce figs? No, and you cannot draw fresh water from a salty spring.
If you are wise and understand the ways of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, prove it by living an honorable life, doing good works with the humility that comes from wisdom.
But if you are bitterly jealous and there is selfish ambition in your heart, do not cover up the truth with boasting and lying.
For jealousy and selfishness are not wisdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Such things are evil and not from the Ruach, they are demonic.
For wherever there is jealousy and selfish ambition, there you will find disorder and evil of every kind.

But the Wisdom from above is first of all pure. It is also Shalum Ahaba (loving), gentle at all times, and willing to yield to others. It is full of mercy and the fruit of good deeds. It shows no favoritism and is always sincere.
And a harvest of righteousness is grown from the seed of Shalum planted by Shalum-makers.
What is causing the quarrels and fights among you? Do they not come from the evil desires at war within you?

You want what you do not have, so you scheme and kill to get it. You are jealous of what others have, but you cannot get it, so you fight and wage war to take it away from them. Yet you do not have what you want because you did not ask 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for it.
And even when you ask, you did not get it because your motives are all wrong, you want only what will give you pleasure.

You adulterers! Do you not realize that your friendship with the world makes you an enemy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH? I say it again: If you want to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Do you think the Scriptures mean nothing? The Scriptures say, “The Ruach 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made to live in us wants us only for Himself.”
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives favor generously. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH resists the proud, But gives favor to the humble.”
So humble yourselves before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Resist ha'shatan, and he will flee from you.
Come close to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will come close to you. Wash your hands, you sinners; purify your hearts, for your loyalty is divided between 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the world system.
Let there be tears for what you have done. Let there be sorrow and deep grief. Let there be sadness instead of laughter, and gloom instead of joy.
You must humble yourselves before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will lift you up in honor.

Do not speak evil of one another believers of Truth, he who speaks evil of a brother and judges his brother, speaks evil of the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH alone, who gave the law, is the Judge. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH alone has the power to save or to destroy. So what right do you have to judge your neighbor?
Look here, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we are going to a certain town and will stay there a year. We will do business there and make a profit.”
How do you know what your life will be like tomorrow? Your life is like the morning fog, it’s here a little while, then it’s gone.
What you ought to say is, “If 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wants us to, we will live and do this or that.”
Otherwise you are boasting about your own pretentious plans, and all such boasting is evil.
Remember, it is sin to know what you ought to do and then not do it.
Look here, you rich people: Weep and groan with anguish because of all the terrible troubles ahead of you.
Your wealth is rotting away, and your fine clothes are moth-eaten rags.
Your gold and silver are corroded. The very wealth you were counting on will eat away your flesh like fire. This corroded treasure you have hoarded will testify against you on the day of judgment.
So listen! Hear the cries of the field workers whom you have cheated of their pay. The cries of those who harvest your fields have reached the ears of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
You have spent your years on Arath in luxury, satisfying your every desire. You have fattened yourselves for the day of slaughter.
You have condemned and killed innocent people, who do not resist you.

Dear brothers and sisters, be patient as you wait for the return of Ha'Mashyach. Consider the farmers who patiently wait for the rains in the fall and in the spring. They eagerly look for the valuable harvest to ripen.
You, too, must be patient. Take courage, for the coming of the MASTER is near.
Do not grumble about each other, or you will be judged: Look the Judge is standing at the door!
For examples of patience in suffering, dear brothers and sisters, look at the Nabyms who spoke in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

We give great honor to those who endure under suffering. For instance, you know about Ayub, a man of great endurance. You can see how 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was kind to him at the end, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is full of tenderness and mercy.
But most of all, my brothers and sisters, never take an oath, by Shamaym or Arath or anything else. Just say a simple yes or no, so that you will not sin and be condemned.
Are any of you suffering hardships? You should pray. Are any of you happy? You should sing Yadah.
Are any of you sick? You should call for the elders of the Qadash Assembly to come and pray over you, anointing you with oil in the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Such a prayer offered in Amunah will heal the sick, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make you well. And if you have committed any sins, you will be forgiven.
Confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The earnest prayer of a righteous man has great power and produces wonderful results.
AliYahu was as man as we are, and yet when he prayed earnestly that no rain would fall, none fell for three and a half years!
Then, when he prayed again, the sky sent down rain and the Arath began to yield its crops.
My dear brothers and sisters, if someone among you wanders away from the truth and is brought back,
You can be sure that whoever brings the sinner back from wandering will save that person from death and bring about the forgiveness of many sins.

books.name: I Peter
chapters: This letter is from Kafa, a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. I am writing to the chosen people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who are living as foreigners in the provinces of Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.

ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knew you and chose you long ago, and the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has made you Qadash. As a result, you have obeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and have been cleansed by the blood of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH give you more and more favor and Shalum.

All Yadah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, the ABBA of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. It is by the great mercy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that we have been born again, because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH raised 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach from the dead. Now we live with great expectation,
And we have a priceless inheritance, an inheritance that is kept in Shamaym for you, pure and undefiled, beyond the reach of change and decay.
And through your Amunah, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is protecting you by HIS power until you receive this salvation, which is ready to be revealed on the last day for all to see.
So be truly glad. There is wonderful joy ahead, even though you must endure many trials for a little while.

These trials will show that your Amunah is genuine. It is being tested as fire tests and purifies gold, though your Amunah is far more precious than mere gold. So when your Amunah remains strong through many trials, it will bring you much Yadah and Kabad and Honor on the day when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach is revealed to the whole world.
You love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA even though you have never seen him. Though you do not see 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA now, you trust Him; and you rejoice with a great inexpressible joy.
The reward for trusting Ha'Mashyach will be the salvation of your souls.
This salvation was something even the Nabyms wanted to know more about when they prophesied about this marvelous salvation prepared for you.
They wondered what time or situation the Ruach of Ha'Mashyach within them was talking about when he told them in advance about the suffering of Ha'Mashyach and His great Kabad afterward.

They were told that their messages were not for themselves, but for you. And now this Basurah (Good News) has been announced to you by those who preached in the power of the RUACH Ha'Qadash sent from Shamaym. It is all so wonderful that even the Malakym are eagerly watching these things happen.
So prepare your minds for action and exercise self control. Put all your hope in the awesome salvation that will come to you when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach is revealed to the world.
So you must live as the obedient children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Do not slip back into your old ways of living to satisfy your own desires. You did not know any better then.
But now you must be Qadash in everything you do, just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who chose you is Qadash.
For the Scriptures say, “You must be Qadash because I AM Qadash.”

And remember that our ABBA in Shamaym to whom you pray has no favorites. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will judge or reward you according to what you do. So you must live in reverent fear of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH during your time here as “temporary residents.”
For you know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH paid a ransom to save you from the empty life you inherited from your ancestors. And it was not paid with mere gold or silver, which lose their value.
It was the precious blood of Ha'Mashyach, the sinless, spotless Lamb of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose Ha'Mashyach as your ransom long before the world began, but now in these last days Ha'Mashyach has been revealed for your sake.
Through Ha'Mashyach you have come to trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And you have placed your Amunah and hope in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because HE raised Ha'Mashyach from the dead and gave Him great Kabad.
You were cleansed from your sins when you obeyed the Truth, so now you must show sincere Ahaba (love) to each other as brothers and sisters. Love each other deeply with all your heart.
For you have been born again, but not to a life that will quickly end. Your new life will last forever because it comes from the eternal, living Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
As the Scriptures say, “People are like grass; their beauty is like a flower in the field. The grass withers and the flower fades.
But the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH remains forever.” And that Dabar is the Basurah (Good News) that was preached to you.
So get rid of all evil behavior. Be done with all deceit, hypocrisy, jealousy, and all unkind speech.
Like newborn babies, you must crave pure spiritual milk so that you will grow into the full experience of salvation. Cry out for this nourishment,
Now that you have had a taste of the kindness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You are coming to Ha'Mashyach, who is the living cornerstone of the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Ha'Mashyach was rejected by people, but He was chosen by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for great Honor.

And you also are living stones that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is building into the Temple of HIS Ruach. What’s more, you are 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Qadash Kuhanym. Through the mediation of Ha'Mashyach, you offer the sacrifices of the RUACH that please 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
As the Scriptures say, “I am placing a cornerstone in Yahushalam, chosen for great honor, and anyone who trusts in Him will never be dishonored.”
Yes, you who trust Ha'Mashyach recognize the honor 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given Him. But for those who reject Ha'Mashyach, “The stone that the builders rejected has now become the chief cornerstone.

And, “Ha'Mashyach is the stone that makes men stumble, the rock that makes them fall.” They stumble because they do not obey the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and so they meet the destiny that was planned for them.

But you are not like that, for you are a chosen people. You are royal Kuhanym, a Qadash nation, the very own possession of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. As a result, you can show others the goodness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called you out of the darkness into HIS marvelous Light.
“In the past you had no identity as a people; but now you are the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. In the past you received no mercy; but now you have received the mercy of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
Dear friends, I warn you as “temporary residents and foreigners” to keep away from worldly desires that wage war against your very souls.

Be careful and live properly among your unbelieving neighbors. Then even if they accuse you of doing wrong, they will see your honorable behavior, and they will give honor to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH when HE judges the world.
For the sake of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, submit to all governing authority, whether the king as head of state,
Or the officials he has appointed. For the king has sent them to punish those who do wrong and to honor those who do right.
It is the Will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that your honorable lives should silence those ignorant people who make foolish accusations against you.
For you are free, yet you are the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so do not use your freedom as an excuse to do evil.
Respect everyone, and love the family of believers. Fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and respect the king.
You who are servants must submit to your masters with all respect. Do what they tell you, not only if they are kind and reasonable, but even if they are cruel.
For this is commendable, because of your conscience toward 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH one endures grief, suffering wrongfully.
Of course, you get no credit for being patient if you are beaten for doing wrong. But if you suffer for doing good and endure it patiently, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is pleased with you.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH called you to do good, even if it means suffering, just as Ha'Mashyach suffered for you. For Ha'Mashyach is your example, and you must follow in Ha'Mashyach's steps.
Ha'Mashyach never sinned, nor ever deceived anyone.
Ha'Mashyach did not retaliate when he was insulted, nor threaten revenge when he suffered. Ha'Mashyach left his case in the hands of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who always judges fairly.
Ha'Mashyach personally carried our sins in His body on the execution stake, so that we can be dead to sin and live for what is right, by the wounds of Ha'Mashyach you are healed.
Once you were like sheep who wandered away. But now you have turned to your Shepherd, the Guardian of your souls.

In the same way, you wives must accept the authority of your husbands. Then, even if some husband refuse to obey the Good News, your righteous lives will speak to them without any words. They will be won over
By observing your pure and reverent lives.
Do not be concerned about the outward beauty of fancy hairstyles, expensive jewelry, or beautiful clothes.
You should clothe yourselves instead with the beauty that comes from within, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet ruach, which is so precious to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This is how the Qadash women of old made themselves beautiful. They put their trust in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and accepted the authority of their husbands.
For instance, Sharah obeyed her husband, Abraham, and called him her master. You are her daughters when you do what is right without fear of what your husbands might do.

In the same way, you husbands should live with your wives in an understanding way, since they are weaker than you. You should show them respect, because the Barakah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave to you, is the same Barakah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave to your wife, the favor of life. Do this so that nothing will stop your prayers from being heard by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Finally, all of you should be of one mind. Sympathize with each other. Love each other as brothers and sisters. Be tenderhearted, and keep a humble attitude.

Do not repay evil for evil. Do not retaliate with insults when people insult you. Instead, pay them back with a Barakah. That is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has called you to do, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will grant you HIS Barakah.
For the Scriptures say, “If you want to enjoy life and see many happy days, keep your tongue from speaking evil and your lips from telling lies.
Turn away from evil and do good. Search for Shalum, and work to maintain it.
The eyes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH watch over those who do right, and the ears of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are open to their prayers. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH turns HIS face against those who do evil.”
Now, who will want to harm you if you are eager to do good?
But even if you suffer for doing what is right, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will reward you for it. So do not worry or be afraid of their threats.
Instead, you must worship Ha'Mashyach as MASTER of your life. And if someone asks about your hope as a believer, always be ready to explain it.

But do this in a gentle and respectful way. Keep your conscience clear. Then if people speak against you, they will be ashamed when they see what a good life you live because you belong to Ha'Mashyach.
Remember, it is better to suffer for doing good, if that is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH wants, than to suffer for doing wrong!

Ha'Mashyach suffered for our sins once for all time. He never sinned, but He died for sinners to bring you safely home to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Ha'Mashyach suffered physical death, but He was raised to life in the Ruach.
So Ha'Mashyach went and preached to the ruachs in prison
Those who disobeyed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH long ago when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH waited patiently while Nuah was building his boat. Only eight people were saved from drowning in that terrible flood.

And that water is a picture of baptism, which now saves you, not by removing dirt from your body, but as a response to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from a clean conscience. It is effective because of the resurrection of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Now Ha'Mashyach has gone to Shamaym. Ha'Mashyach is seated in the place of honor next to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and all the Malakym and authorities and powers accept the authority of Ha'Mashyach.

So then, since Ha'Mashyach suffered physical pain, you must arm yourselves with the same attitude He had, and be ready to suffer, too. For if you have suffered physically for Ha'Mashyach, you have finished with sin.
You will not spend the rest of your lives chasing your own desires, but you will be anxious to do the will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
You have had enough in the past of the evil things that Unrighteous people enjoy, their immorality and lust, their feasting and drunkenness and wild parties, and their terrible worship of idols.
Of course, your former friends are surprised when you no longer plunge into the flood of wild and destructive things they do. So they slander you.
But remember that they will have to face 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who stands ready to judge everyone, both the living and the dead.
That is why the Basurah (Good News) was preached to those who are now dead, so although they were destined to die like all people, they now live forever with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in the Ruach.
But the end of all things is at hand; therefore be serious and watchful in your prayers.
Most important of all, continue to show deep love for each other, for love covers a multitude of sins.
Cheerfully share your home with those who need a meal or a place to stay.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given each of you a gift from his great variety of Ruach‘s gifts. Use them well to serve one another.

Do you have the gift of speaking? Then speak as though 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF were speaking through you. Do you have the gift of helping others? Do it with all the strength and energy that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH supplies. Then everything you do will bring Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. All Kabad and power to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever and ever.
Dear beloved, do not be surprised at the fiery trials you are going through, as if something strange were happening to you.
Instead, be very glad, for these trials make you partners with Ha'Mashyach in His suffering, so that you will have the wonderful joy of seeing His Kabad when it is revealed to all the world.
If you are insulted because you bear the Name of Ha'Mashyach, you will be baraked, for the awesome RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rests upon you.
If you suffer, however, it must not be for murder, stealing, making trouble, or prying into other people’s affairs.
But it is no shame to suffer for being a Qadash one. Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH for the privilege of being called by HIS Name!

For the time has come for judgment, and it must begin with the household of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And if judgment begins with us, what terrible fate awaits those who have never obeyed the Basurah (Good News) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH?
And also, “If the righteous are barely saved, what will happen to the Unrighteous sinners?”
So if you are suffering in a manner that pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, keep on doing what is right, and trust your lives to the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who created you, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will never fail you.

And now, a word to you who are elders in the Qadash Assembly. I am also an elder and a witness to the sufferings of Ha'Mashyach. And I will also share in the Kabad of Ha'Mashyach when He is revealed to the whole world. As a fellow elder, I appeal to you:
Care for the flock that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has entrusted to you. Watch over it willingly, not grudgingly, not for what you will get out of it, but because you are eager to serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Do not be like a ruler over those you are responsible for. But be good examples to them.
And when the Great Shepherd appears, you will receive a crown of never ending Kabad and honor.

In the same way, you who are younger must accept the authority of the elders. And all of you, dress yourselves in humility as you relate to one another, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH resist and opposes the proud but gives favor to the humble.”
So humble yourselves under the mighty power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and at the right time 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will lift you up in honor.
Give all your worries and cares to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH cares about you.
Stay alert! Watch out for your great enemy, ha'shatan, he moves around like a roaring lion, looking for someone to devour.
Stand firm against ha'shatan, and be strong in your Amunah. Remember that your family of believers all over the world is going through the same kind of suffering you are going through.

Yes, you will suffer for a short time. But after that, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make everything right. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will make you strong. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will support you and keep you from falling. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who gives all favor. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH chose you to share in HIS Kabad in Ha'Mashyach. That Kabad will continue forever.
All power to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever! So it will be.
Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a dear brother, I have written this short letter to encourage you and to testify that this is to be the true favor of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in which you are to stand firm!
The Qadash Assembly here in Babylun sends you greetings, and so does my son Mark.
Greet each other with a kiss of love. Shalum be with all of you who are in Ha'Mashyach.

books.name: II Peter
chapters: Simun Kafa, a servant and a Shaliach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, to them that have obtained the same precious Amunah with us through the righteousness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and our Savior 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach:
Favor and Shalum be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut and of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA our Master,
The divine power of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given to us all things that we need to live a life of righteousness, through the knowledge of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who called us to HIMSELF by HIS Kabad and excellent way,

And because of HIS Kabad and excellence, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us great and precious promises. These are the promises that enable you to share the divine nature of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and escape the corruption of this world, caused by man's desires.
For this very reason, you must make every effort and add to your Amunah with moral character, your moral character with knowledge,
And knowledge with self-control, and self-control with patient-endurance, and patient-endurance with righteousness,
And righteousness with brotherly affection, and brotherly affection with Ahaba (love) for everyone.
The more you grow like this, the more productive and useful you will be in your knowledge of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
But those who fail to develop in this way are shortsighted or blind, forgetting that they have been cleansed from their old sins.
So, dear brothers and sisters, work hard to prove that you really are among those 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has called and chosen. Do these things, and you will never fall away.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give you a grand entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Master and Savior 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
Therefore, I will always remind you about these things—even though you already know them and are standing firm in the truth you have been taught.
And it is only right that I should keep on reminding you as long as I live.
For our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach has shown me that I must soon leave this Arath life,
So I will work hard to make sure you always remember these things after I am gone.
For we were not making up clever stories when we told you about the powerful coming of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. We saw His majestic splendor with our own eyes
When Ha'Mashyach received honor and Kabad from ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. The voice from the majestic Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH said to Him, “This is my dearly loved Son, who brings me great joy.”
We ourselves heard that voice from Shamaym when we were with Ha'Mashyach on the Qadash mountain.

Because of that experience, we have even greater confidence in the message proclaimed by the Nabyms. You must pay close attention to what they wrote, for their words are like a lamp shining in a dark place, until the Day dawns, and Ha'Mashyach the Morning Star shines in your hearts.
Above all, you must realize that no prophecy in Scripture ever came from the Nabym’s own understanding,
Or from man's initiative. No, those Nabyms were moved by the Ruach Ha'Qadash, and they spoke from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

But there were also false Nabyms in Yashar'AL, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will cleverly teach destructive heresies and even deny the MASTER who bought them. In this way, they will bring sudden destruction on themselves.
Many will follow their evil teaching and shameful immorality. And because of these teachers, the way of truth will be slandered.
In their greed they will make up clever lies to get hold of your money. But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH condemned them long ago, and their destruction will not be delayed.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not spare even the Malakym who sinned. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH threw them into punishment, in gloomy pits of darkness, where they are being held until the day of judgment.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH did not spare the ancient world except for Nuah and the seven others in his family. Nuah warned the world of the righteous judgment of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH protected Nuah when He destroyed the world of Unrighteous people with a vast flood.
Later, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH condemned the cities of Sudum and Gumurrah and turned them into heaps of ashes. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made them an example of what will happen to Unrighteous people.
But 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH also rescued Lut out of Sudum because Lut was a righteous man who was sick of the shameful immorality of the wicked people around him.
Yes, Lut was a righteous man who was tormented in his soul by the wickedness he saw and heard day after day.
So you see, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows how to rescue righteous men from their trials, even while keeping the wicked under punishment until the day of final judgment.

This is especially for those who follow their corrupt nature along the path of impure desires and who despise the authority of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. These people are proud and arrogant, daring even to mock at supernatural beings without so much as trembling.
But the Malakym, who are far greater in power and strength, do not dare to bring from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH a charge of blasphemy against those supernatural beings.
These false teachers are like unthinking animals, creatures of instinct, born to be caught and destroyed. They mock at things they do not understand, and like animals, they will be destroyed.

Their destruction is their reward for the harm they have done. They love to indulge in evil pleasures in broad daylight. They are shame and a stain among you. They delight in deception even as they eat with you in your fellowship meals.
They commit adultery with their eyes, and their desire for sin is never satisfied. They lure unstable people into sin, and they are well trained in greed. They live under the curse of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
They have wandered off the right road and followed the footsteps of Balaam son of Baur, who loved to earn money by doing wrong.
But Balaam was stopped from his mad course when his donkey rebuked him with a man's voice.
These people are as useless as dried-up springs or as mist blown away by the wind. They are doomed to blackest darkness.
They brag about themselves with empty, foolish boasting. With an appeal to twisted sexual desires, they lure back into sin those who have barely escaped from a lifestyle of deception.
They promise freedom, but they themselves are slaves of sin and corruption. For you are a slave to whatever controls you.
And when people escape from the wickedness of the world by knowing our MASTER and Savior 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach and then get tangled up and enslaved by sin again, they are worse off than before.
It would be better if they had never known the way to righteousness than to know it and then reject the command they were given to live a Qadash life.
They prove the truth of this proverb: “A dog returns to its vomit.” And another says, “A washed pig returns to the mud.”
This is my second letter to you, dear friends, and in both of them I have tried to stimulate your wholesome thinking and refresh your memory.
I want you to remember what the Qadash Nabyms said long ago and what our MASTER and Savior commanded through your Shaliachs.
Most importantly, I want to remind you that in the last days scoffers will come, mocking the truth and following their own desires.
They will say, “What happened to the promise that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is coming again? From before the times of our ancestors, everything has remained the same since the world was first created.”
They deliberately forget that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made the Shamaym long ago by the Dabar of HIS command, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH brought the Arath out from the water and surrounded it with water.
Then 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH used the water to destroy the ancient world with a mighty flood.
And by the same Dabar, the present Shamaym and Arath have been stored up for fire. They are being kept for the day of judgment, when Unrighteous people will be destroyed.
But you must not forget this one thing, dear friends: A day is like a thousand years to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and a thousand years is like a day.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is not really being slow about HIS promise, as some people think. No, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is being patient for your sake. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not want anyone to be destroyed, but wants everyone to repent.

But the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will come as unexpectedly as a thief. Then the Shamaym will pass away with a terrible noise, and the very elements themselves will disappear in fire, and the Arath and everything on it will be found to deserve judgment.
Since everything around us is going to be destroyed like this, you must live a Qadash and righteous life,
Looking forward to the day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and hurrying it along. On that day, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will set the Shamaym on fire, and the elements will melt away in the flames.
But we are looking forward to the new Shamaym and new Arath 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has promised, a world filled with the righteousness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And so, dear friends, while you are waiting for these things to happen, make every effort to be found living the life of Shalum, that is pure and blameless in the sight of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And remember, the patience of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gives people time to be saved. This is what our beloved brother Shaul also wrote to you with the wisdom 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave him,

Speaking of these things in all of his letters. Some of his comments are hard to understand, and those who are ignorant and unstable have twisted his letters to mean something quite different, just as they do with other parts of Scripture. And this will result in their destruction.
You already know these things, dear friends. So be on guard; then you will not be carried away by the errors of these wicked people and lose your own secure footing (Salvation).
Rather, you must grow in the favor and knowledge of our MASTER and Savior 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. All Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, both now and forever! So it will be.

books.name: I John
chapters: We proclaim to you the one who existed from the beginning, whom we have heard and seen. We saw Him with our own eyes and touched Him with our own hands. He is the 𐤃𐤁𐤓𐤉_Dabar of life.
The Life itself was revealed to us, and we have seen Him. And now we testify and proclaim to you that He is the eternal life, which was with ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and then He was revealed to us.

We proclaim to you what we ourselves have actually seen and heard Him, so that you may have fellowship with us. And our fellowship is with ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and with HIS Son, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
We are writing these things so that you may fully share our joy.
This is the message we heard from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and now declare to you: that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is light, and in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH there is no darkness at all.
So we are lying if we say we have fellowship with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH but go on living in spiritual darkness; we are not practicing the truth.
But if we are living in the light, as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is in the light, then we have fellowship with each other, and the blood of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, cleanses us from all sin.
If we claim we have no sin, we are only fooling ourselves and not living in the truth.
But if we confess our sins to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, He is merciful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all wickedness.
If we claim we have not sinned, we are calling 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH a liar and showing that HIS Dabar has no place in our hearts.
My dear children, I am writing this to you so that you will not sin. But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate who pleads our case before
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Himself is the sacrifice that atones for our sins and not only our sins but the sins of all the world.
And we can be sure that we know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH if we obey HIS commandments.
If someone claims, “I know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,” but does not obey the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, that person is a liar and is not living in the truth.
But those who obey the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH truly show how completely they love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. That is how we know we are living in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Those who say they live in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH should live their lives as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA did.
Dear friends, I am not writing a new commandment for you; rather it is an old one you have had from the very beginning. This old commandment to Love one another is the same message you heard before.
Yet it is also new. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA lived the truth of this commandment, and you also are living it. For the darkness is disappearing, and the true light is already shining.
If anyone claims, “I am living in the light,” but hates a fellow believer, that person is still living in darkness.
Anyone who loves a fellow believer is living in the light and does not cause others to stumble.
But anyone who hates a fellow believer is still living and walking in darkness. Such a person does not know the way to go, having been blinded by the darkness.
I am writing to you who are the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, because your sins have been forgiven through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.

I am writing to you who are mature in the Amunah because you know Ha'Mashyach, who existed from the beginning. I am writing to you who are young in the Amunah because you have won your battle with the evil one.

I have written to you who are the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because you know ABBA. I have written to you who are mature in the Amunah because you know Ha'Mashyach, who existed from the beginning. I have written to you who are young in the Amunah because you are strong. The Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives in your hearts, and you have won your battle with the evil one.
Do not love this world nor the things it offers you, for when you love the world, you do not have the love of ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in you.

For the world offers only a craving for physical pleasure, a craving for everything we see, and pride in our achievements and possessions. These are not from ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but are from this world.
And this world is fading away, along with everything that people crave. But anyone who does the Will of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will live forever.
Dear children, the last hour is here. You have heard that the Anti-Mashyach is coming, and even now such Anti-Mashyach have appeared. From this we know that the last hour has come.
These people left our Qadash Assemblies, but they never really belonged with us; otherwise they would have stayed with us. When they left, it proved that they did not belong with us.
But you are not like that, for the Qadash One has given you His Ruach, and all of you know the Truth.
So I am writing to you not because you do not know the truth but because you know the difference between truth and lies.
And who is a liar? Anyone who says that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is not the Ha'Mashyach. Anyone who denies ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the Son is an Anti-Mashyach.
Anyone who denies the Son does not have ABBA either. But anyone who acknowledges the Son has ABBA also.
So you must remain in Amunah to what you have been taught from the beginning. If you do, you will remain in fellowship with the Son and with ABBA.
And in this fellowship we enjoy the eternal life 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH promised us.
I am writing these things to warn you about those who want to lead you astray.

But you have received the Ruach Ha'Qadash, and He lives within you, so you do not need anyone to teach you what is true. For the Ruach teaches you everything you need to know, and what the RUACH teaches is true, it is not a lie. So just as the Ruach has taught you, remain in fellowship with Ha'Mashyach.
And now, dear children, remain in fellowship with Ha'Mashyach so that when he returns, you will be full of courage and not shrink back from Him in shame.
Since we know that Ha'Mashyach is righteous, we also know that all who do what is right are the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

See how very much our ABBA loves us, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH calls us HIS children, and that is what we are! But the people who belong to this world do not recognize that we are the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because they do not know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

Dear ones, we are already the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has not yet shown us what we will be like when Ha'Mashyach appears. But we do know that we will be like Ha'Mashyach, for we will see Him as he really is.
And all who have this eager expectation will keep themselves pure, just as Ha'Mashyach is pure.
Everyone who sins is breaking the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for all sin is contrary to the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And you know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA came to take away our sins, and there is no sin in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
Anyone who continues to live in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA will not sin. But anyone who keeps on sinning does not know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA or understand who he is.
Dear children, do not let anyone deceive you about this: When people do what is right, it shows that they are righteous, even as Ha'Mashyach is righteous.
But when people keep on sinning, it shows that they belong to ha'shatan, who has been sinning since the beginning. But the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came to destroy the works of ha'shatan.
Those who have been born of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, do not make a practice of sinning, because the life of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is in them. So they can not sin, because they are children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
So now we can tell who are children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and who are children of ha'shatan. Anyone who does not live righteously and does not love other believers does not belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This is the message you have heard from the beginning: We should Ahaba (love) one another.
We must not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and killed his brother. And why did he kill him? Because Cain had been doing what was evil, and his brother had been doing what was righteous.
So do not be surprised, dear brothers and sisters, if the world hates you.
If we love our brothers and sisters who are believers, it proves that we have passed from death to life. But a person who has no love is still dead.
Anyone who hates another brother or sister is really a murderer at heart. And you know that murderers do not have eternal life within them.
We know what real love is because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA gave up His life for us. So we also ought to give up our lives for our brothers and sisters.
If someone has enough money to live well and sees a brother or sister in need but shows no compassion, how can the love of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH be in that person?
Dear children, let us not merely say that we love each other; let us show the truth by our actions.
Our actions will show that we belong to the truth, so we will be confident when we stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Even if we feel guilty, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is greater than our feelings, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH knows everything.
Dear friends, if we do not feel guilty, we can come to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with bold confidence.
And we will receive from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH whatever we ask because we obey 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and do the things that please HIM.
And this is HIS commandment: We must believe in the Name of His Son, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, and love one another, just as HE commanded us.
Those who obey the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, remain in fellowship with HIM, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with them. And we know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives in us because the RUACH 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave us lives in us.
Dear brethren, do not believe everyone who claims to speak by the Ruach. You must test them to see if the Ruach they have comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For there are many false Nabyms in the world.

This is how we know if they have the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH: If a person claiming to be a Nabym acknowledges that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach came in a real body, that person has the RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

But if someone claims to be a Nabym and does not acknowledge the truth about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, that person is not from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Such a person has the spirit of the Anti-Mashyach, which you heard is coming into the world and indeed is already here.
But you belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, my dear children. You have already won a victory over those people, because the RUACH who lives in you is greater than the ruach who lives in the world.
Those people belong to this world, so they speak from the world’s viewpoint, and the world listens to them.

But we belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and those who know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH listen to us. If they do not belong to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they will not listen to us. That is how we know if someone has the RUACH of truth or the ruach of deception.
Dear friends, let us continue to love one another, for love comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. Anyone who loves is a child of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and he knows 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
But anyone who does not love does not know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, for HE is love.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH showed how much HE loved us by sending HIS one and only Son into the world so that we might have eternal life through Him.
This is real love, not that we loved 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, but it is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who loved us and sent HIS Son as a sacrifice to take away our sins.
Dear brethren, since 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loved us that much, we surely ought to love each other.
No one has ever seen 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. But if we love each other, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives in us, and HIS love is brought to full expression in us.
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us HIS RUACH as proof that we live in HIM and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in us.
Furthermore, we have seen with our own eyes and now testify that ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH sent HIS Son to be the Savior of the world.
All who declare that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH have 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH living in them, and they live in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
We know how much 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loves us, and we have put our trust in the love of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is love, and all who live in love live in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH lives in them.

And as we live in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, our love grows more perfect. So we will not be afraid on the day of judgment, but we can face 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH with confidence because we live like 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA here in this world.
Such love has no fear, because perfect love expels all fear. If we are afraid, it is for fear of punishment, and this shows that we have not fully experienced 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH‘s perfect love.
We love each other because 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH loved us first.
If someone says, “I love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,” but hates a fellow believer, that person is a liar; for if we do not love people we can see, how can we love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, whom we cannot see?
And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has given us this command: that Those who love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must also love their fellow believers.
Everyone who believes that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is Ha'Mashyach has become a child of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. and everyone who loves the father will also love the children.
We know we love the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH if we love 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and obey HIS Commandments.
Loving 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH means keeping the Commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are not burdensome.
For every child of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must defeat this evil world, and we only achieve this victory through our Amunah.
And who can win this battle against the world? Only those who believe that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA is the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach was revealed as the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH by His baptism in water and by shedding His blood on the execution stake, not by water only, but by water and blood. And the RUACH who is truth, confirms it with His testimony.
So we have these three witnesses
The Ruach, the water, and the blood and all three agree.
Since we believe man's testimony, surely we can believe the greater testimony that comes from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has testified about HIS Son.

All who believe in the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH know in their hearts that this testimony is true. Those who do not believe this are actually calling 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH a liar because they do not believe what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has testified about HIS Son.
And this is what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has testified: HE has given us eternal life, and this life is in HIS Son.
Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH does not have life.
I have written this to you who believe in the Name of the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, so that you may know you have eternal life.
And we are confident that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hears us whenever we ask for anything that pleases HIM.
And since we know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH hears us when we make our requests, we also know that HE will give us what we ask for.

If you see a fellow believer sinning in a way that does not lead to death, you should pray, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will give that person life. But there is a sin that leads to death, and I am not saying you should pray for those who commit it.
All wicked actions are sin, but not every sin leads to death.
We know that the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH do not make a practice of sinning, for the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH holds them securely, and the evil one cannot touch them.
We know that we are children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and that the world around us is under the control of the evil one.
We know that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has come and has shown us the true 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. And because of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA, we now belong to the true 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who gives eternal life.
Dear children, stay away from all kinds of idols.

books.name: II John
chapters: This letter is from Yahukanun, the elder. I am writing to the chosen lady and to her children, whom I love in the truth, as does everyone else who knows the truth,
Because the Truth lives in us and will be with us forever.
Favor, mercy and Shalum, which come from ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach the Son of ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will continue to be with us who live in truth and love.
How happy I was to meet some of your children and find them living according to the truth, just as our ABBA commanded.
I am writing to remind you, dear friends, that we should love one another. This is not a new commandment, but one we have had from the beginning.
Ahaba (Love) means doing what 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has commanded us, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has commanded us to Ahaba (love) one another, just as you heard from the beginning.
I say this because many deceivers have gone out into the world. They deny that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach came in a real body. Such a person is a deceiver and an Anti-Mashyach.
Watch out that you do not lose what we have worked so hard to achieve. Be diligent so that you receive your full reward.
Anyone who wanders away from this teaching has no relationship with 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. But anyone who remains in the teaching of Ha'Mashyach has a relationship with both the ABBA and the Ban (Son).
If anyone comes to your meeting and does not teach the truth about Ha'Mashyach, do not invite that person into your home or give any kind of encouragement.
Anyone who encourages such people becomes a partner in their evil work.
I have much more to say to you, but I do not want to do it with paper and ink. For I hope to visit you soon and talk with you face to face. Then our joy will be complete.
Greetings from the children of your sister, chosen by 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

books.name: III John
chapters: This letter is from Yahukanun, the elder. I am writing to Gaius, my dear friend, whom I Ahaba (love) in the Àmát (truth).
Dear friend, I hope all is well with you and that you are as healthy in body as you are strong in ruach.
Some of the traveling teachers recently returned and made me very happy by telling me about your Amunah and that you are living according to the Truth.
I could have no greater joy than to hear that my children are following the truth.
Dear friend, you are being productive in Amunah to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH when you care for the traveling teachers who pass through, even though they are strangers to you.
They have told the Qadash Assembly here of your loving friendship. Please continue providing for such teachers in a manner that pleases 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
For they are traveling for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and they accept nothing from people who are not believers.
So we ourselves should support them so that we can be their partners as they teach the Truth.
I wrote to the Qadash Assembly about this, but Diutraphas who loves to be the leader, refuses to have anything to do with us.

When I come, I will report some of the things he is doing and the evil accusations he is making against us. Not only does he refuse to welcome the traveling teachers, he also tells others not to help them. And when they do help, he puts them out of the Qadash Assembly.

Dear friend, do not let this bad example influence you. Follow only what is good. Remember that those who do good prove that they are the children of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and those who do evil prove that they do not know 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Everyone speaks highly of Damatrius, as does the truth itself. We ourselves can say the same for him, and you know we speak the truth.
I have much more to say to you, but I do not want to write it with pen and ink.
For I hope to see you soon, and then we will talk face to face.
Shalum be with you. Your friends here send you their greetings. Please give my personal greetings to each of our friends there.

books.name: Jude
chapters: This letter is from Yahudah, a servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach and a brother of Ya'aqub. I am writing to all who have been called by ABBA 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who loves you and keeps you safe in the care of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
May 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH give you more and more mercy, Shalum and Ahaba (love).

Dear brethren, I had been eagerly planning to write to you about the salvation we all share. But now I find that I must write about something else, urging you to defend the Amunah that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has entrusted once for all time to his Qadash people.

For some certain individuals whose condemnation was written about long ago have secretly slipped in among you. They are Unrighteous people, who pervert the favor of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH into a license for immorality and they deny 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our only Savior and Master.
So I want to remind you, though you already know these things, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH first rescued the nation of Yashar'AL from Mitzraym, but later he destroyed those who did not believe in HIM.

And I remind you of the Malakym who did not stay within the limits of authority that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave them, but left the place where they belonged by disobedience:" 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has kept them securely chained in prisons of darkness, waiting for the great day of judgment.

And do not forget Sudum and Gumurrah and their neighboring towns, which were filled with immorality and every kind of sexual perversion. Those cities were destroyed by fire and serve as a warning of the eternal fire of the judgment of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
In the same way, these people who claim authority from their dreams, live immoral lives, defy authority, and scoff at supernatural beings.

But even the Malak MakyAL, one of the mightiest of the Malakym, did not dare accuse ha'shatan of blasphemy, but simply said, “𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH rebuke you!” This took place when MakyAL was arguing with ha'shatan about the body of Musha.
But these people scoff at things they do not understand. Like unthinking animals, they do whatever their instincts tell them, and so they bring about their own destruction.
What sorrow awaits them! For they follow in the footsteps of Cain, who killed his brother. Like Balaam, they deceive people for money. And like Kurah, they perish in their rebellion.

When these people eat with you in your fellowship meals commemorating the love of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, they are like dangerous reefs that can shipwreck you. They are like shameless shepherds who care only for themselves. They are like clouds blowing over the land without giving any rain. They are like trees in autumn that are doubly dead, for they bear no fruit and have been pulled up by the roots.
They are like wild waves of the sea, churning up the foam of their shameful deeds. They are like wandering stars, doomed forever to blackest darkness.
Chanuk, who lived in the seventh generation after Adam, prophesied about these people. He said, “Listen! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is coming with countless thousands of HIS Qadash ones

To execute judgment on the people of the world. He will convict every person of all the Unrighteous things they have done and for all the insults that Unrighteous sinners have spoken against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
These people are grumblers and complainers, living only to satisfy their desires. They brag loudly about themselves, and they flatter others to get what they want.
But you, my dear ones, must remember what the Shaliachs of our Master 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach predicted.
They told you that in the last times there would be scoffers whose purpose in life is to satisfy their Unrighteous desires.
These people are the ones who are creating divisions among you. They follow their natural instincts because they do not have the Ruach of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH in them.
But you, dear ones, must build each other up in your most Qadash Amunah, pray in the power of the Ruach Ha'Qadash,
And await the mercy of our MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, who will bring you eternal life. In this way, you will keep yourselves safe in the love of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Help those who have doubts.
Rescue those who are living in danger of eternal furnace of fire. There are others you should treat with mercy, but be very careful that their filthy lives do not rub off on you.
Now all Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who is able to keep you from falling away and will bring you with great joy into HIS Esteemed presence without a single fault.

All Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who alone is 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH our Savior through 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach our MASTER. All Kabad, majesty, power, and authority are HIS before all time, and in the present, and beyond all time!.

books.name: Revelation of John
chapters: This is a revelation from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach, which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH gave Him to show His servants the events that must soon take place. Ha'Mashyach sent a Malak to present this revelation to His servant Yahukanun,
Who faithfully reported everything he saw. This is Yahukanun‘s report of the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the testimony of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will Barak the one who reads the Dabar of this prophecy to the Qadash Assemblies, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will Barak all who listen to its message and obey what it says, for the time is near.

This letter is from Yahukanun to the seven Qadash Assemblies in the province of Asia. Favor and Shalum to you from the one who is, who always was, and who is still to come; from the sevenfold RUACH before HIS throne;

And from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA Ha'Mashyach. He is the faithful witness to these things, the first to rise from the dead, and the ruler of all the kings of the world. All Kabad to Ha'Mashyach who loves us and has freed us from our sins by shedding His blood for us.
Ha'Mashyach has made us a Kingdom of Kuhanym for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH His ABBA. All Kabad and power to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH forever and ever! So it will be.
Look! Ha'Mashyach comes with the clouds of Shamaym. And everyone will see Him, even those who pierced Him. And all the nations of the world will mourn for Ha'Mashyach. Yes!!
“I AM the Alaph and the Tab (Alpha and Omega), the beginning and the end,” says 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut. “I am the one who is, who always was, and who is still to come, the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH (Almighty One)

I, Yahukanun, am your brother and your partner in suffering and in the Kingdom of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and in the patient and endurance to which 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA calls us. I was exiled to the island of Patmos for preaching the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and for my testimony about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.
It was the Set Apart Day, and I was worshiping in the Ruach. Suddenly, I heard behind me a loud voice like a trumpet blast.
It said, “Write in a book everything you see, and send it to the seven Qadash Assemblies in the cities of Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
And standing in the middle of the lampstands was someone like the Son of Adam. He was wearing a long robe with a gold sash across his chest.
His head and His hair were white like wool, as white as snow. And His eyes were like flames of fire.
His feet were like polished bronze refined in a furnace, and His voice thundered like mighty ocean waves.
He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp two-edged sword came from his mouth. And His face was like the sun in all its brilliance.
When I saw Him, I fell at His feet as if I were dead. But Ha'Mashyach laid His right hand on me and said, “Do not be afraid! I Am the First and the Last.
I Am the living one. I died, but look—I Am alive forever and ever! And I hold the keys of death and the grave.
“Write down what you have seen, both the things that are now happening and the things that will happen.

This is the meaning of the mystery of the seven stars you saw in my right hand and the seven gold lampstands: The seven stars are the Malakym of the seven Qadash Assemblies, and the seven lampstands are the seven Qadash Assemblies.
“Write this letter to the Malak of the Qadash Assembly in Ephesus. This is the message from the one who holds the seven stars in His right hand, the one who walks among the seven gold lampstands:

“I know all the things you do. I have seen your hard work and your patient and endurance. I know you do not tolerate evil people. You have examined the claims of those who say they are Shaliachs but are not. You have discovered they are liars.
You have patiently suffered for me without quitting.
“But I have this complaint against you. You do not love Me or each other as you did at first!
Look how far you have fallen! Turn back to Me and do the works you did at first. If you do not repent, I will come and remove your lampstand from its place among the Qadash Assemblies.
But this is in your favor: You hate the evil deeds of the Nicolaitans, just as I do.

“Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Ruach and understand what He is saying to the Qadash Assemblies. To everyone who is victorious I will give fruit from the tree of life in the paradise of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
“Write this letter to the Malak of the Qadash Assembly in Smyrna. This is the message from the one who is the First and the Last, who was dead but is now alive:

“I know about your suffering and your poverty, but you are rich! I know the blasphemy of those opposing you. They say they are Yahudym, but they are not, because their congregation belongs to ha'shatan.

Do not be afraid of what you are about to suffer, ha'shatan will throw some of you into prison to test you. You will suffer for ten days. But if you remain in Amunah even when facing death, I will give you the crown of life.
“Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Ruach and understand what He is saying to the Qadash Assemblies. Whoever is victorious will not be harmed by the second death.
“Write this letter to the Malak of the Qadash Assembly in Pergamum. This is the message from the One with the sharp two-edged sword:

“I know that you live in the city where ha'shatan has his throne, yet you have remained loyal to Me. You refused to deny Me even when Antipas, my faithful witness, was martyred among you there in this city of ha'shatan.

“But I have a few complaints against you. You tolerate some among you whose teaching is like that of Balaam, who showed Balak how to trip up the people of Yashar'AL. He taught them to sin by eating food offered to idols and by committing sexual sin.
In a similar way, you have some Nicolaitans among you who follow the same teaching.
Repent of your sin, or I will come to you suddenly and fight against them with the sword of My mouth.

“Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Ruach and understand what He is saying to the Qadash Assemblies. To everyone who is victorious I will give some of the manna that has been hidden away in Shamaym. And I will give to each one a white stone, and on the stone will be engraved a new name that no one understands except the one who receives it.
“Write this letter to the Malak of the Qadash Assembly in Thyatira. This is the message from the Son of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, whose eyes are like flames of fire, whose feet are like polished bronze:
“I know all the things you do. I have seen your love, your Amunah, your service, and your patient endurance. And I can see your constant improvement in all these things.

“But I have this complaint against you. You are permitting that woman, that Yazabal who calls herself a Nabym, to lead my servants astray. She teaches them to commit sexual sin and to eat food offered to idols.
I gave her time to repent, but she does not want to turn away from her immorality.
“Therefore, I will throw her on a bed of suffering, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer greatly unless they repent and turn away from her evil deeds.

I will strike her children dead. Then all the Qadash Assemblies will know that I Am the one who searches out the thoughts and intentions of every person. And I will give to each of you whatever you deserve.
“But I also have a message for the rest of you in Thyatira who have not followed this false teaching (‘deeper truths,’ as they call them—depths of ha'shatan, actually). I will ask nothing more of you
except that you hold tightly to what you have until I come.
To all who are victorious, who obey Me to the very end, to them I will give authority over all the nations.
They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash them like clay pots.
They will have the same authority I received from My ABBA, and I will also give them the morning star!
“Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the Ruach and understand what He is saying to the Qadash Assemblies.

“Write this letter to the Malak of the Qadash Assembly in Sardis. This is the message from the One who has the sevenfold RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the seven stars: “I know all the things you do, and that you have a reputation for being alive, but you are dead.

“Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the RUACH and understand what He is saying to the Qadash Assemblies.

“Because you have obeyed my command to persevere, I will protect you from the great time of trials that will come upon the whole world to test those who belong to this world.

And I will write on them the name of My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and they will be citizens in the city of My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the new Yahushalam that comes down from Shamaym from My 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. “Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the RUACH and understand what He is saying to the Qadash Assemblies.

“Write this letter to the Malak of the Qadash Assembly in Laodicea. This is the message from the one who is the So be it, the Amunah and Amat (true) witness, the beginning of the new creation of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH:
“I know all the things you do, that you are neither hot nor cold. I wish that you were one or the other!
But since you are like lukewarm water, neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of My mouth!

“Look! I stand at the door and knock. If you hear My voice and open the door, I will come in, and we will share a meal together as friends.
