“Anyone with ears to hear must listen to the RUACH and understand what He is saying to the Qadash Assemblies.”

Then as I looked, I saw a door standing open in Shamaym, and the same voice I had heard before spoke to me like a trumpet blast. The voice said, “Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after this.”
And instantly I was in the Ruach, and I saw a throne in Shamaym and someone sitting on it.
The one sitting on the throne was as brilliant as gemstones, like jasper and carnelian. And the glow of an emerald circled HIS throne like a rainbow.
Twenty-four thrones surrounded HIM, and twenty-four elders sat on them. They were all clothed in white and had gold crowns on their heads.
From the throne came flashes of lightning and the rumble of thunder. And in front of the throne were seven torches with burning flames. This is the sevenfold RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
In front of the throne was a shiny sea of glass, sparkling like crystal. In the center and around the throne were four living beings, each covered with eyes, front and back.
The first of these living beings was like a lion; the second was like an ox; the third had a man's face; and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.

Each of these living beings had six wings, and their wings were covered all over with eyes, inside and out. Day after day and night after night they keep on saying, “Qadash, Qadash, Qadash is 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the One who always was, who is, and who is still to come.”
Whenever the living beings give Kabad and honor and Tudah to the One sitting on the throne (the One who lives forever and ever),
The twenty-four elders fall down and worship the one sitting on the throne (the One who lives forever and ever). And they lay their crowns before the throne and say,
“You are worthy, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, to receive Kabad and honor and power. For you O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH created all things, and they exist because You created what You pleased.”
Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the one who was sitting on the throne. There was writing on the inside and the outside of the scroll, and it was sealed with seven seals.
And I saw a strong Malak, who shouted with a loud voice: “Who is worthy to break the seals on this scroll and open it?”
But no one in Shamaym or on Arath or under the Arath was able to open the scroll and read it.
Then I began to weep bitterly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll and read it.

But one of the twenty-four elders said to me, “Stop weeping! Look, the Lion of the tribe of Yahudah, the heir to Daud’s throne, has won the victory. He is worthy to open the scroll and its seven seals.”

Then I saw a Lamb that looked as if it had been slaughtered, but it was now standing between the throne and the four living beings and among the twenty-four elders. He had seven horns and seven eyes, which represent the sevenfold RUACH of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH that is sent out into every part of the Arath.
He stepped forward and took the scroll from the right hand of the one sitting on the throne.

And when He took the scroll, the four living beings and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb. Each one had a harp, and they held gold bowls filled with incense, which are the prayers of the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.

And they sang a new song with these words: “You are worthy to take the scroll and break its seals and open it. For you were slaughtered, and your blood has ransomed people for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from every tribe and language and people and nation.
And you have caused them to become a Kingdom of Kuhanym for our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. And they will reign on the Arath.”
Then I looked again, and I heard the voices of thousands and millions of Malakym around the throne and of the living beings and the elders.
And they sang in a mighty chorus: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and Kabad and Barakah.”

And then I heard every creature in Shamaym and on Arath and under the Arath and in the Yam (sea). They sang: “Barakah and honor and Kabad and power belong to the One sitting on the throne and to the Lamb forever and ever.”
And the four living beings said, “So be it!” And the twenty-four elders fell down and worshiped the Lamb.
As I watched, the Lamb broke the first of the seven seals on the scroll. Then I heard one of the four living beings say with a voice like thunder, “Come!”
I looked up and saw a white horse standing there. Its rider carried a bow, and a crown was placed on his head. He rode out to win many battles and gain the victory.
When the Lamb broke the second seal, I heard the second living being say, “Come!”
Then another horse appeared, a red one. Its rider was given a mighty sword and the authority to take Shalum from the Arath. And there was war and slaughter everywhere.
When the Lamb broke the third seal, I heard the third living being say, “Come!” I looked up and saw a black horse, and its rider was holding a pair of scales in his hand.
And I heard a voice from among the four living beings say, “A loaf of wheat bread or three loaves of barley will cost a day’s pay. And do not waste the olive oil and wine.”
When the Lamb broke the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living being say, “Come!”

I looked up and saw a horse whose color was pale green. Its rider was named Death, and his companion was the Grave. These two were given authority over one-fourth of the Arath, to kill with the sword and famine and disease and wild animals.
When the Lamb broke the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of all who had been martyred for the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and for being faithful in their testimony.
They shouted to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and said, “O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, Qadash and True, how long before you judge the people who belong to this world and avenge our blood for what they have done to us?”

Then a white robe was given to each of them. And they were told to rest a little longer until the full number of their brothers and sisters, their fellow servants of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA who were to be martyred had joined them.
I watched as the Lamb broke the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became as dark as black cloth, and the moon became as red as blood.
Then the stars of the sky fell to the Arath like green figs falling from a tree shaken by a strong wind.
The sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all of the mountains and islands were moved from their places.
Then everyone, the kings of the Arath, the rulers, the generals, the wealthy, the powerful, and every slave and free person all hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
And they cried to the mountains and the rocks, “to fall on them and hide them from the face of the One who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb.
For the great day of their wrath has come, and who is able to survive?”
After these things I saw four Malakym standing at the four corners of the Arath, holding the four winds of the Arath, that the wind should not blow on the Arath, on the Yam (sea), or on any tree.
Then I saw another Malak ascending from the east, having the seal of the living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH. And he cried with a loud voice to the four Malakym to whom it was granted to harm the Arath and the sea,
Saying, “Do not harm the Arath, the sea, or the trees till we have sealed the servants of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH on their foreheads.”
And I heard the number of those who were sealed. One hundred and forty-four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Yashar'AL were sealed:
Of the tribe of Yahudah twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Rauban twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand were sealed;
Of the tribe of Ashar twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Manassah twelve thousand were sealed;
Of the tribe of Simaun twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Lauy twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand were sealed;
Of the tribe of Zabulun twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Ya'asaf twelve thousand were sealed; of the tribe of Banyamin twelve thousand were sealed.

After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no one could number, of all nations, tribes, and tongues, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed with white robes, with palm branches in their hands,
And crying out with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation belongs to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”
All the Malakym stood around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and fell on their faces before the throne and worshiped 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,
Saying: “So be it! Barakah and Kabad and Chukmah (wisdom), Tudah and honor and power and might, Be to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH forever and ever. So it will be”
Then one of the elders answered, saying to me, “Who are these arrayed in white robes, and where did they come from?”
And I said to him, “Sir, you know who they are.” So he said to me, “These are the ones who came out of the great tribulation, and washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
Therefore they are before the throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and they will serve 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH day and night in HIS Temple. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who sits on the throne will dwell among them.
They will never again be hungry or thirsty; they will never be scorched by the heat of the sun.
For the Lamb on the throne will be their Shepherd. The Lamb will lead them to springs of life giving water. And 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will wipe every tear from their eyes.”
When the Lamb broke the seventh seal on the scroll, there was silence throughout Shamaym for about half an hour.
I saw the seven Malakym who stand before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and they were given seven trumpets.

Then another Malak with a gold incense burner came and stood at the altar. And a great amount of incense was given to him to mix with the prayers of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s people as an offering on the gold altar before the throne.
The smoke of the incense, mixed with the prayers of the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, ascended up to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from the altar where the Malak had poured them out.
Then the Malak filled the incense burner with fire from the altar and threw it down upon the Arath; and thunder crashed, lightning flashed, and there was a terrible earthquake.
Then the seven Malakym with the seven trumpets prepared to blow their mighty blasts.

The first Malak blew his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the Arath. One-third of the Arath was set on fire, one-third of the trees were burned, and all the green grass was burned.
Then the second Malak blew his trumpet, and a great mountain of fire was thrown into the sea. One-third of the water in the sea became blood,
One-third of all things living in the sea died, and one-third of all the ships on the sea were destroyed.
Then the third Malak blew his trumpet, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch. It fell on one-third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
The name of the star was Bitterness. It made one-third of the water bitter, and many people died from drinking the bitter water.

Then the fourth Malak blew his trumpet, and one-third of the sun was struck, and one-third of the moon, and one-third of the stars, and they became dark. And one-third of the day was dark, and also one-third of the night.

Then I looked, and I heard a single eagle crying loudly as it flew through the air, “Terror, terror, terror to all who belong to this world because of what will happen when the last three Malakym blow their trumpets.”
Then the fifth Malak blew his trumpet, and I saw a star fallen to the Arath from Shamaym, and the fifth Malak was given the key to the shaft of the bottomless pit.
When he opened it, smoke poured out as though from a huge furnace, and the sunlight and air turned dark from the smoke.
Then locusts came from the smoke and descended on the Arath, and they were given power to sting like scorpions.
They were told not to harm the grass or plants or trees, but only the people who did not have the seal of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on their foreheads.
They were told not to kill them but to torture them for five months with pain like the pain of a scorpion sting.
In those days people will seek death but will not find it. They will long to die, but death will flee from them!
The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. They had what looked like gold crowns on their heads, and their faces looked like man's faces.
They had hair like the hair of women and teeth like the teeth of a lion.
They wore armor made of iron, and their wings roared like an army of chariots rushing into battle.
They had tails that stung like scorpions, and for five months they had the power to torment people.
Their king is the agent messenger from the bottomless pit; his name in Hebrew is Abaddun, the Destroyer.
The first terror is past, but look, two more terrors are coming!
Then the sixth Malak blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice speaking from the four horns of the gold altar that stands in the presence of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And the voice said to the sixth Malak who held the trumpet, “Release the four Malakym who are bound at the great Euphrates River.”
Then the four Malakym who had been prepared for this hour and day and month and year were turned loose to kill one-third of all the people on Arath.
Now the number of the army of the horsemen was two hundred million;

And in my vision, I saw the horses and the riders sitting on them. The riders wore armor that was fiery red and dark blue and yellow. The horses had heads like lions, and fire and smoke and burning sulfur came out from their mouths.
One-third of all the people on Arath were killed by these three plagues, by the fire and smoke and burning sulfur that came from the mouths of the horses.
Their power was in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails had heads like snakes, with the power to injure people.

But the people who did not die in these plagues still refused to repent of their evil deeds and turn to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. They continued to worship demons and idols made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood, idols that can neither see nor hear nor walk!
And they did not repent of their murders or their witchcraft or their sexual immorality or their thefts.
Then I saw another mighty Malak coming down from Shamaym, surrounded by a cloud, with a rainbow over his head, his face shone like the sun, and his feet were like pillars of fire.
And in his hand was a small scroll that had been opened. The Malak stood with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
And the Malak gave a great shout like the roar of a lion. And when he shouted, the seven thunders answered.
When the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write. But I heard a voice from Shamaym saying, “Keep secret what the seven thunders said, and do not write it down.”
Then the Malak I saw standing on the sea and on the land raised his right hand toward Shamaym.

The Malak swore an oath in the Name of the One who lives forever and ever, who created the Shamaym and everything in them, the Arath and everything in it, and the Yam (sea) and everything in it. He said, “There will be no more delay.
When the seventh Malak blows his trumpet, the mysterious plan of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be fulfilled. It will happen just as 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH announced it to HIS servants the Nabyms.”
Then the voice from Shamaym spoke again to me Yahukanun: “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the Malak who is standing on the sea and on the land.”
So I went to the Malak and told him to give me the small scroll. “Yes, take it and eat it,” the Malak said. “It will be sweet as honey in your mouth, but it will turn sour in your stomach!”
So I took the small scroll from the hand of the Malak, and I ate it! It was sweet in my mouth, but when I swallowed it, it turned sour in my stomach.
Then I was told, “You must prophesy again about many people, nations, languages, and kings.”
Then I Yahukanun was given a measuring stick, and I was told, “Go and measure the Haykal (Temple) of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the altar, and count the number of worshipers.
But do not measure the outer courtyard, for it has been turned over to the nations. They will trample the Qadash city for forty two months.
And I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will be clothed in burlap and will prophesy during those one thousand two hundred and sixty days.”
These two Nabyms are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of all the Arath.
If anyone tries to harm them, fire flashes from their mouths and consumes their enemies. This is how anyone who tries to harm them must die.

They have power to shut the sky so that no rain will fall for as long as they prophesy. And they have the power to turn the rivers and oceans into blood, and to strike the Arath with every kind of plague as often as they wish.
When they complete their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the bottomless pit will declare war against the two Nabyms, and the beast will conquer the two Nabyms and kill them.
And the bodies of the two Nabyms will lie in the main street of the great city, the city that is figuratively called “Sudum” and “Mitzraym,” the city where Ha'Mashyach was impaled.
And for three and a half days, all peoples, tribes, languages, and nations will stare at the bodies of the two Nabyms. No one will be allowed to bury them.
All the people who belong to this world will gloat over them and give presents to each other to celebrate the death of the two Nabyms who had tormented them.
But after three and a half days, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH breathed life into them, and they stood up! Terror struck all who were staring at them.
Then a loud voice from Shamaym called to the two Nabyms, “Come up here!” And they rose up to Shamaym in a cloud as their enemies watched.

At the same time there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people died in that earthquake, and everyone else was terrified and gave Kabad to the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shamaym.
The second terror is past, but look, the third terror is coming quickly.

Then the seventh Malak blew his trumpet, and there were loud voices shouting in Shamaym: “The world has now become the Kingdom of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH and of HIS Mashyach, and HE will reign forever and ever.”
The twenty-four elders sitting on their thrones before 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH fell with their faces to the ground and worshiped 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And they said, “We give Tudah to you, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the one who is and who always was, for now you have assumed your great power and have begun to reign.

The nations were filled with wrath, but now the time of your wrath has come, it is time to judge the dead and reward your servants the Nabyms, as well as your Qadash people, and all who fear your Name, from the least to the greatest, it is time to destroy all who have caused destruction on the Arath.”

Then, in Shamaym, the Temple of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH was opened and the Ark of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH‘s covenant could be seen inside the Temple. Lightning flashed, thunder crashed and roared, and there was an earthquake and a terrible hailstorm.
Then I witnessed in Shamaym an event of great significance. I saw a woman clothed with the sun, with the moon beneath her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
She was pregnant, and she cried out because of her labor pains and the agony of giving birth.
Then I witnessed in Shamaym another significant event. I saw a large red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, with seven crowns on his heads.

His tail swept away one-third of the stars in the Shamaym, and he threw them to the Arath. He stood in front of the woman as she was about to give birth, ready to devour her baby as soon as it was born.
She gave birth to a son who was to rule all nations with an iron rod. And her child was snatched away from the dragon and was caught up to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and to His throne.
And the woman fled into the wilderness, where 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had prepared a place to care for her for one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
Then there was war in Shamaym. MakyAL and his Malakym fought against the dragon and his agents of darkness.
And the dragon lost the battle, and the dragon and his agents were forced out of Shamaym.
This great dragon, the ancient serpent called ha'shatan, the one deceiving the whole world, was thrown down to the Arath with all his forces.

Then I heard a loud voice shouting across the Shamaym, “It has come at last, salvation and power and the Kingdom of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and the authority of Ha'Mashyach. For the accuser of our brothers and sisters has been thrown down to Arath, the one who accuses them before our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH day and night.
And they have defeated him by the blood of the Lamb and by their testimony. And they did not love their lives so much that they were afraid to die.

Therefore, rejoice, O Shamaym! And you who live in the Shamaym, rejoice! But terror will come on the Arath and the Yam (sea), for ha'shatan has come down to you in great anger, knowing that he has little time.”
When the dragon realized that he had been thrown down to the Arath, he pursued the woman who had given birth to the male child.

But she was given two wings like those of a great eagle so she could fly to the place prepared for her in the wilderness. There she would be cared for and protected from the dragon for a time and times, and half a time.
Then the dragon tried to drown the woman with a flood of water that flowed from his mouth.
But the Arath helped her by opening its mouth and swallowing the river that gushed out from the mouth of the dragon.
And the dragon was angry at the woman and declared war against the rest of her children, all who keep the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and maintain their testimony for
Then the dragon stood on the sand of the seashore.
Then I saw a beast rising up out of the sea. It had seven heads and ten horns, with ten crowns on its horns. And written on each head were names that blasphemed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
This beast looked like a leopard, but it had the feet of a bear and the mouth of a lion! And the dragon gave the beast his own power and throne and great authority.
I saw that one of the heads of the beast seemed wounded beyond recovery, but the fatal wound was healed! The whole world marveled at this miracle and gave allegiance to the beast.
They worshiped the dragon for giving the beast such power, and they also worshiped the beast. “Who is as great as the beast?” they exclaimed. “Who is able to fight against him?”
Then the beast was allowed to speak great blasphemies against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And he was given authority to do whatever he wanted for forty-two months.
And he spoke terrible words of blasphemy against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, slandering HIS Name and HIS dwelling, that is those who dwell in Shamaym.
And the beast was allowed to wage war against the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and to conquer them. And he was given authority to rule over every tribe and people and language and nation.

And all the people who belong to this world worshiped the beast. They are the ones whose names were not written in the Book of Life that belongs to the Lamb who was slaughtered before the world was made.
Anyone with ears to hear should listen and understand.

Anyone who is destined for prison will be taken to prison. Anyone destined to die by the sword will die by the sword. This means that the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must endure persecution patiently and remain in Amunah.
Then I saw another beast come up out of the Arath, he had two horns like those of a lamb, but he spoke with the voice of a dragon.
The second beast exercised all the authority of the first beast. And the second beast required all in the Arath and its people to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound had been healed.
The second beast did astounding miracles, even making fire flash down to Arath from the sky while everyone was watching.

And with all the miracles the second beast was allowed to perform on behalf of the first beast, the second beast deceived all the people who belong to this world, the second beast ordered the people to make a great statue of the first beast, who was fatally wounded and then came back to life.
The second beast was then permitted to give life to the statue of the first beast so that it could speak. Then the statue of the first beast commanded that anyone refusing to worship it must die.
the image statue required everyone, small and great, rich and poor, free and slave to be given a mark on the right hand or on the forehead.
And no one could buy or sell anything without that mark, which was either the name of the beast or the number representing his name.
Wisdom is needed here. Let the one with understanding solve the meaning of the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man, his number is 666.
Then I saw the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him were one hundred and forty four thousand (144,000) who had the Name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH written on their foreheads.
And I heard a sound from Shamaym like the roar of mighty ocean waves or the rolling of loud thunder. It was like the sound of many harpists playing together.

This great choir sang a wonderful new song in front of the throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and before the four living beings and the twenty-four elders. No one could learn this song except the one hundred and forty four thousand (144,000) who had been redeemed from the Arath.
They have kept themselves as pure as virgins, following the Lamb wherever He goes. They have been purchased from among the people on the Arath as a special offering to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and to the Lamb.
They have told no lies; they are without blame.
And I saw another Malak flying through the sky, carrying the eternal Basurah (Good News) to proclaim to the people who belong to this world, to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

“Fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH,” the Malak shouted. “Give Kabad to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For the time has come when 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will sit as judge. Worship 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH who made the Shamaym, the Arath, the Yam (sea), and all the springs of water.”
Then another Malak followed him through the sky, shouting, “Babylun is fallen, that great city is fallen, because she made all the nations of the world drink the wine of her passionate immorality.”
Then a third Malak followed them, shouting, “Anyone who worships the beast and his image (statue) or who accepts his mark on the forehead or on the hand

Must drink the wine of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s anger. It has been poured full strength into the cup of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH's wrath. And they will be tormented with fire and burning sulfur in the presence of the Qadash Malakym and the Lamb.

The smoke of their torment will rise forever and ever, and they will have no relief day or night, for they have worshiped the beast and his image (statue) and have accepted the mark of the beast name.”
This means that the Qadash (Set Apart) people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH must endure patiently, obeying the commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and maintaining their Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.

And I heard a voice from Shamaym saying, “Write this down: Baraked are those who die in the righteousness of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH from now on. Yes, says the RUACH, they are baraked indeed, for they will rest from their hard work; for their good deeds follow them!”
Then I saw a white cloud, and seated on the cloud was someone like the Son of Adam. He had a gold crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand.
Then another Malak came from the Haykal (Temple) and shouted to the one sitting on the cloud, “Swing the sickle, for the time of harvest has come; the crop on the Arath is ripe.”
So the one sitting on the cloud swung his sickle over the Arath, and the whole Arath was harvested.
After that, another Malak came from the Haykal (Temple) in Shamaym, and he also had a sharp sickle.

Then another Malak, who had power to destroy with fire, came from the altar, he shouted to the Malak with the sharp sickle, “Swing your sickle now to gather the clusters of grapes from the vines of the Arath, for they are ripe for judgment.”
So the Malak swung his sickle over the Arath and loaded the grapes into the great winepress of the wrath of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
And the winepress was trampled outside the city, and blood came out of the winepress, up to the horses’ bridles, for one thousand six hundred furlongs.
Then I saw in Shamaym another marvelous event of great significance. Seven Malakym were holding the seven last plagues, which would bring the wrath of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH to completion.

I saw before me what seemed to be a glass sea mixed with fire. And on it stood all the people who had been victorious over the beast and his image (statue) and the number representing his name. They were all holding harps that 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH had given them.

And they were singing the song of Musha, the servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and the song of the Lamb: “Great and marvelous are your works, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the Almighty. Just and true are your ways, O RULER of the nations.
Who will not fear you O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, and Esteem your Name? For you alone are Qadash. All nations will come and worship before you, for your righteous deeds have been revealed.”
Then I looked and saw that the Haykal (Temple) in Shamaym, the Tabernacle of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, was widely open.
The seven Malakym who were holding the seven plagues came out of the Temple. They were clothed in spotless white linen with gold sashes across their chests.
And one of the four Living Beings handed each of them a golden flask filled with the terrible wrath of the Living 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH who lives forever and forever.
The Temple was filled with smoke from the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and power. No one could enter the Temple until the seven Malakym had completed pouring out the seven plagues.
Then I heard a mighty voice from the Temple say to the seven Malakym, “Go your ways and pour out on the Arath the seven bowls containing the wrath of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”
So the first Malak left the Temple and poured out his bowl on the Arath, and horrible, malignant sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped his image statue.
Then the second Malak poured out his bowl on the sea, and it became like the blood of a corpse. And everything in the sea died.
Then the third Malak poured out his bowl on the rivers and springs, and they became blood.
And I heard the Malak who had authority over all water saying, “You are just, O Qadash One, who is and who always was, because you have sent these judgments.
Since they shed the blood of your Qadash people and your Nabyms, you have given them blood to drink. It is their just reward.”
And I heard a voice from the altar, saying, “Yes, O 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, the Almighty, your judgments are true and just.”
Then the fourth Malak poured out his bowl on the sun, causing it to scorch everyone with its fire.

Everyone was burned by this blast of heat, and they cursed the name of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who had control over all these plagues. They did not repent of their sins and turn to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and give HIM Kabad.
Then the fifth Malak poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was plunged into darkness. His subjects ground their teeth in anguish,
And they cursed the 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH of Shamaym for their pains and sores. But they did not repent of their evil deeds and turn to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
Then the sixth Malak poured out his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it dried up so that the kings from the east could march their armies toward the west without hindrance.
And I saw three evil spirits that looked like frogs leap from the mouths of the dragon, the beast, and the false prophet.
They are demonic spirits who work miracles and go out to all the rulers of the world to gather them for battle against 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH on that great judgment day of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut.
“Look, I will come as unexpectedly as a thief! Baraked are all who are watching for me, who keep their clothing ready so they will not have to walk around naked and ashamed.”
And the demonic spirits gathered all the rulers and their armies to a place with the Abarym (Hebrew) name Armageddon.
Then the seventh Malak poured out his bowl into the air. And a mighty shout came from the throne in the Haykal (Temple), saying, “It is finished!”
Then the thunder crashed and rolled, and lightning flashed. And a great earthquake struck, the worst since people were placed on the Arath.

The great city of Babylun split into three sections, and the cities of many nations fell into heaps of rubble. So 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH remembered all of Babylun’s sins, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH made her drink the cup that was filled with the wine of HIS fierce wrath.
And every island disappeared, and all the mountains were leveled.

There was a terrible hailstorm, and hailstones weighing as much as seventy-five pounds fell from the sky onto the people below. They cursed 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH because of the terrible plague of the hailstorm.

One of the seven Malakym who had poured out the seven bowls came over and spoke to me Yahukanun. “Come with me,” he said, “and I will show you the judgment that is going to come on the great prostitute, who rules over many waters.
The kings of the world have committed adultery with her, and the people who belong to this world have been made drunk by the wine of her immorality.”
And he carried me away in the Ruach into a wilderness, and I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was full of blasphemous names, and it had seven heads and ten horns.

The woman wore purple and scarlet clothing and beautiful jewelry made of gold and precious gems and pearls. In her hand she held a gold goblet full of obscenities and the impurities of her immorality.
A mysterious name was written on her forehead: “Babylun the Great, Mother of All Prostitutes and Obscenities in the World.”
I could see that she was drunk, with the blood of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Qadash ones who were witnesses for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA. I stared at her in complete amazement.
“Why are you so amazed?” the Malak asked. “I will tell you the mystery of this woman and of the beast with seven heads and ten horns on which she sits.

The beast you saw was once alive but is not alive now. And yet he will soon come up out of the bottomless pit and go to eternal destruction. And the people who belong to this world, whose names were not written in the Book of Life before the world was made, will be amazed at the reappearance of this beast who had died.
“This calls for a mind with understanding: The seven heads of the beast represent the seven hills where the woman rules. They also represent seven kings.
Five kings have already fallen, the sixth now reigns, and the seventh is yet to come, but his reign will be brief.
“The scarlet beast that was, but is no longer, is the eighth king. He is like the other seven, and he, too, is headed for destruction.
The ten horns of the beast are ten kings who have not yet risen to power. They will be appointed to their kingdoms for one brief moment to reign with the beast.
They will all agree to give him their power and authority.

Together they will go to war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will defeat them because the lamb is the MASTER of all masters and KING of all kings. And the called out and chosen ones with Amunah will be with the Lamb.”
Then the Malak said to me, “The waters where the prostitute is ruling represent masses of people of every nation and language.
The scarlet beast and his ten horns all hate the prostitute. They will strip her naked, eat her flesh, and burn her remains with fire.

For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has put a plan into their minds, a plan that will carry out the purposes of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. They will agree to give their authority to the scarlet beast, and so the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will be fulfilled.
And this woman you saw in your vision represents the great city that rules over the kings of the world.”
After all this I saw another Malak coming down from Shamaym with great authority, and the Arath grew bright with his splendor.

He gave a mighty shout: “Babylun is fallen, that great city is fallen! She has become a home for demons. She is a hideout for every unclean and foul spirit, a hideout for every foul vulture and every foul and dreadful animal.

For all the nations have fallen because of the wine of her passionate immorality, the kings of the world have committed adultery with her. Because of her desires for extravagant luxury, the merchants of the world have grown rich.”
Then I heard another voice calling from Shamaym, “Come away from her, my people. Do not take part in her sins, or you will be punished with her.
For her sins are piled as high as Shamaym, and 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH remembers her evil deeds.
Pay her back as she has done to others. Double her penalty for all her evil deeds. She brewed a cup of terror for others, so brew twice as much for her.
She esteemed herself and lived in luxury, so match it now with torment and sorrow. She boasted in her heart, ‘I am queen on my throne. I am no helpless widow, and I have no reason to mourn.’
Therefore, these plagues will overtake her in a single day, death and mourning and famine. She will be completely consumed by fire, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut who judges her is AL'Mighty.”
And the kings of the world who committed adultery with her and enjoyed her great luxury will mourn for her as they see the smoke rising from her charred remains.

They will stand at a distance, terrified by her great torment. They will cry out, “How terrible, how terrible for you, O Babylun, you great city! In a single moment the judgment of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH came on you.”
The merchants of the world will weep and mourn for her, for there is no one left to buy their goods.

She bought great quantities of gold, silver, jewels, and pearls; fine linen, purple, silk, and scarlet cloth; things made of fragrant thyine wood, ivory goods, and objects made of expensive wood; and bronze, iron, and marble.
She also bought cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, wagons, and bodies, that is man's slaves.
“The fancy things you loved so much are gone,” they cry. “All your luxuries and splendor are gone forever, never to be yours again.”
The merchants who became wealthy by selling her these things will stand at a distance, terrified by her great torment. They will weep and cry out,
“How terrible, how terrible for that great city! She was clothed in finest purple and scarlet linens, decked out with gold and precious stones and pearls!
In a single moment all the wealth of the city is gone!” And all the captains of the merchant ships and their passengers and sailors and crews will stand at a distance.
They will cry out as they watch the smoke ascend, and they will say, “Where is there another city as great as this?”

And they will weep and throw dust on their heads to show their grief. And they will cry out, “How terrible, how terrible for that great city! The shipowners became wealthy by transporting her great wealth on the sea, in a single moment it is all gone.”
Rejoice over her fate, O Shamaym and people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and Shaliachs and Nabyms! For at last 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has judged her for your sakes.

Then a mighty Malak picked up a boulder the size of a huge millstone. He threw it into the ocean and shouted, “Just like this, the great city Babylun will be thrown down with violence and will never be found again.
The sound of harps, singers, flutes, and trumpets will never be heard in you again, no craftsmen and no trades will ever be found in you again. The sound of the mill will never be heard in you again.

The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The happy voices of brides and grooms will never be heard in you again. For your merchants were the greatest in the world, and you deceived the nations with your sorceries.
In your streets flowed the blood of the Nabyms and of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Qadash people and the blood of people slaughtered all over the world.”
After this, I heard what sounded like a vast crowd in Shamaym shouting, “Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! Salvation and Kabad and power belong to our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH.
For the judgments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH are true and just. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has punished the great prostitute who corrupted the Arath with her immorality. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has avenged the murder of his servants.”
And again their voices rang out: “Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! The smoke from that city ascends forever and ever!”
Then the twenty four elders and the four living beings fell down and worshiped 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, who was sitting on the throne. They cried out, “Surely! Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!”
And from the throne came a voice that said, “Yadah our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, all HIS servants, all who fear 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, from the least to the greatest.”

Then I heard again what sounded like the shout of a vast crowd or the roar of mighty ocean waves or the crash of loud thunder: “Yadah 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH! For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, the AL'Mighty, reigns.
Let us be glad and rejoice, and let us give honor to 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For the time has come for the wedding feast of the Lamb, and the bride of the Lamb has prepared herself.
She has been given the finest of pure white linen to wear.” For the fine linen represents the good deeds of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH’s Qadash people.
And the Malak said to me, “Write this: Baraked are those who are invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” And he added, “These are true Dabar that come from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.”

Then I fell down at the Malak‘ feet to worship him, but he said, “No, do not worship me. I am a servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, just like you and your brothers and sisters who testify about their Amunah in 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA. Worship only 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For the essence of foretell is to give a clear witness for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA.”
Then I saw Shamaym opened, and a white horse was standing there. Its rider was named righteous and True, for he judges fairly and wages a righteous war.
His eyes were like flames of fire, and on his head were many crowns. A name was written on Him that no one understood except Himself.
He wore a robe dipped in blood, and His title was the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
The armies of Shamaym, dressed in the finest of pure white linen, followed him on white horses.

From his mouth came a sharp sword to strike down the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He will release the fierce wrath of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH the Almighty One, like juice flowing from a winepress.
On His robe at His thigh was written this title: KING of all kings and MASTER of all masters.
Then I saw a Malak standing in the sun, shouting to the vultures flying high in the sky: “Come! Gather together for the great banquet 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH has prepared.
Come and eat the flesh of kings, generals, and strong warriors; of horses and their riders; and of all mankind, both free and slave, small and great.”
Then I saw the beast and the kings of the world and their armies gathered together to fight against the One sitting on the horse and his army.

And the beast was captured, and with him the false prophet who did mighty miracles on behalf of the beast, miracles that deceived all who had accepted the mark of the beast and who worshiped his image statue. Both the beast and his false prophet were thrown alive into the fiery lake of burning sulfur (eternal flame).
Their entire army was killed by the sharp sword that came from the mouth of the One riding the white horse. And the vultures all gorged themselves on the dead bodies.
Then I saw a Malak coming down from Shamaym with the key to the bottomless pit and a heavy chain in his hand.
He seized the dragon, that old serpent, who is ha'shatan and bound him in chains for a thousand years.

The Malak threw him into the bottomless pit, which he then shut and locked so ha'shatan could not deceive the nations anymore until the thousand years were finished. Afterward he must be released for a little while.

Then I saw thrones, and the people sitting on them had been given the authority to judge. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for their testimony about 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA and for proclaiming the Dabar of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. They had not worshiped the beast or his image statue, nor accepted the mark of the beast on their foreheads or their hands. They all came to life again, and they reigned with Ha'Mashyach for a thousand years.
This is the first resurrection. (The rest of the dead did not come back to life until the thousand years had ended.)

Baraked and Qadash are those who share in the first resurrection. For them the second death holds no power, but they will be Kuhanym of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and of Ha'Mashyach and will reign with Ha'Mashyach a thousand years.
When the thousand years has come to an end, ha'shatan will be let out of his prison.
He will go out to deceive the nations, called Gog and Magog, in every corner of the Arath. He will gather them together for battle, a mighty army, as numberless as sand along the seashore.

And I saw them as they went up on the broad plain of the Arath and surrounded the people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and the beloved city. But fire from Shamaym came down on the attacking armies and consumed them.
Then ha'shatan, who had deceived them, was thrown into the fiery lake of burning sulfur, joining the beast and the false prophet. There they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
And I saw a great white throne and the one sitting on it. The Arath and Shamaym fled from His presence, but they found no place to hide.

I saw the dead, both great and small, standing before the throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. And the books were opened, including the Book of Life. And the dead were judged according to what they had done, as recorded in the books.
The sea gave up its dead, and death and the grave gave up their dead. And all were judged according to their deeds.
Then death and the grave were thrown into the lake of fire. This lake of fire is the second death.
And anyone whose name was not found recorded in the Book of Life was thrown into the lake of fire.
Then I saw a new Shamaym and a new Arath, for the old Shamaym and the old Arath had disappeared. And the Yam (sea) were also gone.
And I saw the Qadash city, the new Yahushalam, coming down from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH out of Shamaym like a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.

I heard a loud shout from the throne, saying, “Look the home of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH is now among HIS people! 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will live with them, and they will be HIS people. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH HIMSELF will be with them.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will wipe every tear from their eyes, and there will be no more death or sorrow or crying or pain. for the former things have passed away.”
And the One sitting on the throne said, “Look, I am making everything new!” And then He said to me, “Write this down, for what I tell you is trustworthy and true.”
And I heard also, “It is finished! I AM the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To all who are thirsty I will give freely from the springs of the water of life.
All who are victorious will inherit all these Barakah, and I will be their 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and they will be my children.

“But cowards, unbelievers, the corrupt, murderers, the immoral, those who practice witchcraft, idol worshipers, and all liars, their fate is in the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death.”
Then one of the seven Malakym who held the seven bowls containing the seven last plagues came and said to me, “Come with me! I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”
So he took me in the Ruach to a great, high mountain, and he showed me the Qadash city, Yahushalam, descending out of Shamaym from 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
It shone with the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and sparkled like a precious stone, like jasper as clear as crystal.
The city wall was broad and high, with twelve gates guarded by twelve Malakym. And the names of the twelve tribes of Yashar'AL were written on the gates.
There were three gates on each side, east, north, south, and west.
The wall of the city had twelve foundation stones, and on them were written the names of the twelve Shaliachs of the Lamb.
The Malak who talked to me held in his hand a gold measuring stick to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.
The city is laid out as a square; its length is as great as its breadth. And he measured the city with the reed: twelve thousand furlongs. Its length, breadth, and height are equal.
Then he measured its wall: one hundred and forty four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of a Malak.
The construction of its wall are of jasper; and the city is pure gold, like clear glass.
The foundations of the wall of the city is adorned with all kinds of precious stones: the first foundation is jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
The fifth sardonyx, the sixth sardius, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.
The twelve gates were twelve pearls: each individual gate was of one pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
I saw no Temple in the city, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut and the Lamb are its Temple.
And the city has no need of sun or moon, for the Kabad of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its light.
The nations will walk in its light, and the kings of the world will enter the city in all their Kabad.
Its gates will never be closed at the end of day because there is no night there.
And all the nations will bring their Kabad and honor into the city.
Nothing evil will be allowed to enter, nor anyone who practices shameful idolatry and dishonesty, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
Then the Malak showed me a river with the water of life, clear as crystal, flowing from the throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and of the Lamb.

It flowed down the center of the main street. On each side of the river grew a tree of life, bearing twelve crops of fruit, with a fresh crop each month. The leaves were used for medicine to heal the nations.
No longer will there be a curse upon anything. For the throne of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH and of the Lamb will be there, and HIS servants will worship HIM.
And they will see the face of our 𐤀𐤋𐤅𐤄_ALUAH, and HIS Name will be written on their foreheads.
And there will be no night there, no need for lamps or sun, for 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut will shine on them. And they will reign forever and ever.
Then the Malak said to me, “Everything you have heard and seen is trustworthy and true. 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH Tsaba'ut, who inspires HIS Nabyms, has sent HIS Malak to tell HIS servants what will happen soon.”
“Look, I Am coming soon! Baraked are those who obey the Dabar foretell and written in this book.”
For I Yahukanun, am the one who heard and saw all these things. And when I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the Malak who showed them to me.
But he said, “No, do not worship me. I am a servant of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH, just like you and your brothers the Nabyms, as well as all who obey what is written in this book. Worship only 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH!”
Then he instructed me, “Do not seal up the prophetic words in this book, for the time is near.

Let the one who is doing harm continue to do harm; let the one who is vile continue to be vile; let the one who is righteous continue to live righteously; let the one who is Qadash continue to be Qadash.”
“Look, I Am coming soon, bringing my reward with Me to repay everyone according to their deeds.
I Am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.”
Baraked are those who wash their robes by obeying the Commandments of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH. For they will be permitted to enter through the gates of the Qadash city and eat the fruit from the tree of life.
Outside the city are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idol worshipers, and all who love to live a lie.
“I, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA have sent my Malak to give you this message for the Qadash Assemblies. I Am the Root and the Offspring of Daud, I Am the Bright and Morning Star.”
The RUACH and the bride say, “Come.” Let anyone who hears this say, “Come.” Let anyone who is thirsty come. Let anyone who desires drink freely from the water of life.
And I WARN everyone who hears the words foretell and written in this book: If anyone adds anything to what is written here, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will add to that person the plagues described in this book.
And if anyone removes any of the words from this book of instructions, 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH will remove that person’s share in the tree of life and in the Qadash city that are described in this book.
For 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA who is the Qadash witness to all these things says, “Yes, I Am coming soon!”
May the favor of the MASTER 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤔𐤏_YAHUSHA be with the Qadash people of 𐤉𐤄𐤅𐤄_YAHUAH.
